name: FUEL_ESCAPE_PULSAR
text: Taking advantage of the last of your fuel reserves, you were able to navigate to a safe distance from the pulsar.

name: FUEL_ESCAPE_PDS
text: Using your impulse engines, you were able to pull to a safe distance from the hostile planet.

name: FUEL_ESCAPE_FLEET
text: Your pilot deftly avoids the artillery fire from the surrounding fleet while you try to sort out exactly what your plan is....

event.text: You spot a weakness in the targeting satellites. Your crew is able to launch a hacking drone to confuse the Anti-Ship Battery's targeting matrix. It should also fire on the Rebel ship now.

choice.text: (Hacking Weapon) Confuse the Anti-Ship Battery's targets.

event.text: You spot a weakness in the targeting satellites, and are able to use your hacking weapon to confuse the Anti-Ship Battery's targeting matrix. It should also fire on the Rebel ship now.

choice.text: (Advanced Hacking) Overwrite the Anti-Ship Battery's target.

event.text: You spot a weakness in the targeting satellites. Your crew is able to launch an improved hacking drone to overwrite the Anti-Ship Battery's targeting matrix. It will fire on the Rebel ship instead!

choice.text: (Simple Hacking) Confuse the Anti-Ship Battery's targets.

event.text: You spot a weakness in the targeting satellites. Your crew is able to launch a hacking drone to periodically confuse the ASB's lock signal. It should sometimes fire on the Rebel ship now.

choice.text: (Hacking Weapon) Confuse the Anti-Ship Battery's targets.

You spot a weakness in the targeting satellites. Your crew is able to launch an improved hacking drone to overwrite the ASB's target locks. It will fire on the Rebel ship instead!

event.text: The enemy hands over their excess fuel and powers off their weapons.

	Hello! Welcome to FTL: Multiverse. It appears this is your first run as of version 5.4. A new in-game tutorial is available to get you introduced to some new game mechanics. Would you like to try it?
	
	You will be able to revisit the tutorial at any time on future runs

			You may also skip the tutorial now and play it again at a later time at the start of any new run.

choice.text: Nevermind, take me to the tutorial.
Yes, I would like to skip the tutorial.

name: AUTO_ESCAPE

name: ABANDONED_CRYSTAL_TOURIST
text: A Crystal ship skitters between various burnt out wrecks and the withered skeletons of long-forgotten stations. They don't seem to notice you.

event.text: "Oh, hello there! I didn't see you, I thought you were just part of the scenery. What a fine sector this is! Such interesting design choices for their ships, whoever lives here has excellent taste!"

choice.text: Explain that this sector has been abandoned.

event.text: "Oh heavens. This shows just how ignorant I am. I should explore more, I've been roaming around this sector for months now! Perhaps I should come with you, you look like you've been to other places before."

choice.text: Ask if they have anything that can help with your mission.

event.text: "Oh, certainly. I've been collecting relics from these fascinating structures... I hope the owners don't mind, but no one was ever home to argue... maybe you'll find use in them."

choice.text: (Crystal Crew) Request access to their data storage.

event.text: "Our maps? Why of course! These should be of use to you. Happy travels!"

While you make small talk with the Crystals, you configure the Hacking system to get a read of their data storage, and download their map data. Once the download is complete, you bid farewell and the Crystals even offer a small reward for being so pleasant.
You have no interest in the strange Crystal ship.

name: ABANDONED_SLAVER_MOON
text: A very faint signal from an unidentified ship is emitting from a small moon in the local system. It's a little choppy, but you manage to make out the words "workers - great price - stop by."

event.text: It seems a slave trader is selling their 'goods' on the nearby moon, knowing it's far away from the eye of the Federation out here in this sector.

choice.text: Check out the slaves being offered.

event.text: The slavers notice your interest and show you several offers.
The slavers might have thought they were safe here, but you've arrived and you aren't going to let their business carry on for any longer.
It's more than clear this is some sort of slave trade, and you have no interest.

name: ABANDONED_COLONY
text: An abandoned colony lies on the nearby planet; its surface borne defense turrets appear to be disabled due to a lack of power, but you can't be certain. You don't see any ships lurking about, but that doesn't mean they aren't hiding.

choice.text: (Signal Diluter) Make certain the defense turrets are offline.
(Flares) Launch some flares to distract the defense turrets while you explore.
(Adv. Sensors) Run some heavier scans on the colony.
(Long-Ranged Scanners) Run some heavier scans on the colony.

event.text: You don't have time to explore every abandoned colony you come across.

name: ABANDONED_LANIUS_SCRAP
text: Upon your arrival, you spot a distant dogfight between a vessel of the Elite Defense Cadre and a pair of Lanius ships. The Militiamen manage to strike down one, prompting the other to activate their FTL drive and escape. Eager to finish their job, the Militia vessel gives chase and jumps away as well, leaving you free to pillage the remains of their fight undisturbed.

name: ABANDONED_CIVILIAN_LOST_ITEMS
text: A civilian ship hails you, requesting you do them a favor. "You're operating on Federation comms, so we hope you support what the Federation stands for. We were some of the civilians forced to evacuate this sector, but we left some important personal items behind. This ship isn't designed for combat, and it is dangerous for us to be here. Could you grab our belongings? We'll pay you of course."

event.text: You approach the colony; a hostile Vagabond ship comes flying out to meet you!

choice.text: (Vagabond Crew) Reason with the aggressive ship.

event.text: Your Vagabond convinces the other Ghosts to stand down. They might be loose-cannon scavengers, but it seems they're more interested in protecting themselves than actually fighting you.
The civilians are disappointed but say they understand.

name: ABANDONED_CIVILIAN_LOST_ITEMS_WIN
text: You dig through the withering settlements until you find the items in question, a few family photos, a box of children's toys, and a replica sword of some obscure Mantis warlord. The civilians are pleased and pay you.

name: ABANDONED_WRECK
text: The wreckage of an old ship drifts nearby, but it's possible that the ship may still contain some supplies.

event.text: You have higher standards than the filthy Lanius, Ghosts, and pirates that swarm this sector.

name: ABANDONED_REBEL_DELUSIONAL
text: A Rebel ship, presumably a straggler from the Rebel fleet hails you. "The battles, the horrors! You have wrought this battle upon us, and now you have come to finish the job? Around us civilians are dying and the planets burn, and you would rather fight us than help your own people?"

choice.text: Explain to the Rebels the battles ended a long time ago.

event.text: The Rebel is surprised to see Jerry and seems to calm down. Jerry softly informs them that everyone here is supportive of them and doesn't wish to see civilians die or planets burn any more than they do. The Captain offers to join, feeling at ease around Jerry.

choice.text: (MFK Ace Crew) Claim to be a Rebel ship to comfort them.

event.text: The Rebels captain is completely delusional but put at ease. It becomes clear they must have PTSD of some sort. Since you can't convince them the battles already ended, you talk the captain into joining your crew instead to 'escape'.

choice.text: (Engineer Crew) Claim to be a Rebel ship to comfort them.

event.text: The Rebels captain is completely delusional but put at ease. It becomes clear they must have PTSD of some sort. Since you can't convince them the battles already ended, you talk the captain into joining your crew instead to 'escape'.

choice.text: (Mind Control) Convince him the battles already ended.

event.text: It seems these Rebels are further gone than you expected - your mind control struggles to compete with the madness that has infected his mind, and soon instead it drives the Rebel captain into rage!

choice.text: (Upg. Mind Control) Convince him the battles already ended.

event.text: Your mind control temporarily cancels out the Rebel captain's madness. In this newfound clarity you explain the situation to him - and his reaction surprises you. "I've been wandering this sector for weeks raving out of my mind. This Rebellion is not suited for giving one peace of mind. Perhaps it's time I leave these days behind."

choice.text: (Mind Control Weapon) Convince him the battles already ended.

event.text: Your mind control temporarily cancels out the Rebel captain's madness. In this newfound clarity you explain the situation to him - and his reaction surprises you. "I've been wandering this sector for weeks raving out of my mind. This Rebellion is not suited for giving one peace of mind. Perhaps it's time I leave these days behind."

choice.text: (Medic Crew) Have your medic evaluate the Rebel.

event.text: Your medic carefully runs a few checks on the Rebel and helps him through several mental exercises to clear his head. In this newfound clarity you explain the situation to him - and his reaction surprises you. "I've been wandering this sector for weeks raving out of my mind. This Rebellion is not suited for giving one peace of mind. Perhaps it's time I leave these days behind."
The Rebels may be delusional about the 'battles' still raging in this sector, but that doesn't mean they aren't a threat that you need to neutralize.

choice.text: These Rebels are crazy. Avoid them.

event.text: Luckily, the Rebels are still busy with their delusional ramblings to notice you sneaking away.

name: ABANDONED_GHOST_LANIUS_DUEL
text: It seems a Vagabond and Lanius ship are in the midst of a stand-off over a wreck, in a fashion that would put old-earth cowboys to shame.

choice.text: Assist the Vagabonds and fight the Lanius.

event.text: You power up the thrusters and approach the Lanius vessel.

choice.text: (Ghost Crew) Talk the Vagabonds into surrendering.

event.text: Though they certainly wouldn't listen to anyone else, your Ghost manages to talk the reason into the Vagabonds. They jump away, and the Lanius hails you. "Impress communication, wandering towards peace conditioning. Further engaging of peace. Will share?" Seems they're offering to share the wreck that started this feud.

choice.text: Assist the Lanius and fight the Vagabonds.

event.text: You power up the thrusters and approach the Vagabond vessel.

choice.text: (Lanius Crew) Talk the Lanius into surrendering.

event.text: Though they certainly wouldn't listen to anyone else, your Lanius manages to reason their peers. They jump away, and the Vagabonds hails you. "Your vernacular does not cease to impress me. How have you managed to talk down the savage metal beasts? Oh, no matter. It seems this is the hour of good deeds, and it is my turn." Seems they're offering to share the wreck that started this feud.

Of all the partially aggressive, mysterious, scavenging alien races in existence, the Ghosts and Lanius are the two who deserve each other the most. You make sure to do several checks around the ship to discourage the crew from betting over which ship will win.

name: ABANDONED_GHOST_LANIUS_DUEL_GHOST
text: You aren't sure whether the Ghosts are merely paying you back for your assistance or are afraid of a ship who could so easily take on a formidable Lanius combatant, but the Ghosts avoid you and jump away. You scrap the wreckage that they were fighting over.

name: ABANDONED_GHOST_LANIUS_DUEL_LANIUS
text: It's hard to communicate with the Lanius, but you manage to work out a deal with splitting the wreckage evenly between your two ships.

event.text: You charge your weapons, which quickly gets the pirate ship's attention.

choice.text: (Flares) Use the flares to make a distraction so the Civilian ship can escape.

event.text: The pirate is startled by the sudden barrage of flares but quickly realizes he isn't alone. Uncertain where the flares are coming from, the pirate flees rather than take the risk of fighting a bigger ship.
Unfortunately it is not your mission to save every person affected by this war or the Lanius invasion.

name: ABANDONED_LANIUS_AUTO_REBEL
text: You come across a Lanius ship in the process of absorbing a Rebel automated scout. If you scare off the Lanius you could probably make use of it.

event.text: You power up your weapons, which quickly gets the attention of the ship.

choice.text: (Lanius Crew) Request access to the Auto-ship first.

event.text: The other Lanius at first become territorial, refusing to give up the Auto, but when you explain you only intend to download the data stores, the Lanius oblige. You find the Auto-ship still has a fully functional system to warn the fleet on your location, so you feed it false data and download the map information.

choice.text: (Flares) Use the flares to guide the Lanius away from the auto.

event.text: You've heard stories the Lanius have poor eyesight and poor attention spans, and where that's true or not, this lanius certainly is drawn to your flares. It moves away from the auto temporarily to chase the disc, giving you just enough time to move in closer.
Whatever assistance the disabled scout could provide is not worth the risk of fighting another Lanius. You prepare to move on.

name: ABANDONED_LANIUS_GROUP_AUTO
text: You notice a number of Lanius ships absorbing a forward Rebel base and its automated scouts. They don't seem to be aggressive. Perhaps their desire for metal could prove to be useful?

choice.text: Try to use them to delay the Rebels.

event.text: You decide it would be better to leave them be.

choice.text: (Lanius Crew) Try to use them to delay the Rebels.

event.text: Your crewmember tells them of the approaching fleet and the number of automated ships they use to scout ahead. They thank you for the tip and prepare to jump in the direction you came. That will hopefully delay the fleet. You scrap what remains of the Rebel station.

name: ABANDONED_FUELING_STATION
text: You detect a refueling platform near the beacon, although its broadcast signal is garbled, and you can't make out the message.

choice.text: Hail the platform and attempt to communicate.

event.text: There is a screech from your comm system, and the broadcast suddenly cuts off. The platform suddenly begins to move, revealing itself to be a Lanius ship!
Your ship enters one of the refueling station berths, grateful for a rest.

choice.text: (Blast Doors) Secure your blast doors - best to be safe when docked.

event.text: Your reinforced doors save you from an attempted ambush by the Lanius, who cluster around the doors and hull, attempting to consume your ship. Coldly, you wipe them out one by one with your weapon array, then take control of the station and take its fuel reserves.
You leave the platform alone, and prepare to jump.

name: ABANDONED_FUELING_STATION_END
text: It looks as if the Lanius were uninterested in the fuel reserves on the station, and there is a good amount of fuel left. You take what your ship can hold and prepare to jump to the next beacon.

name: DISTRESS_ABANDONED_GHOST_CONSTRUCTION
text: A Federation construction vessel is under attack by a clan of Vagabonds. "Help! These Ghosts have come for our ship! Please, do something!"

choice.text: Dock with their ship and draw away the Ghosts.

event.text: The Ghosts notice you docking and abandon their current target in favor of your much larger ship. The Federation crew are grateful for your assistance and offer pay, which you bring back to the ship after dealing with the Ghost invaders.
You erase the Ghosts with ease, making sure not to harm the Federation crew. They're grateful and pay you some supplies.

choice.text: (Crew Damaging Bomb Weapon) Exterminate the Ghosts. [-3}]

event.text: You erase the Ghosts with ease, making sure not to harm the Federation crew. They're grateful and pay you some supplies.
You connect the Proton Pack to the Federation vessel then get to work capturing the Ghosts one by one. The Feds are so impressed by the efficiency of this they offer double the reward.
You can't risk your ship dealing with the Ghosts.

name: DISTRESS_ABANDONED_ASTEROID_COLONY
text: An abandoned space colony drifts nearby, a massive hole in its no-longer functional shield generator. It seems the distress signal comes from a band of refugees who've bunkered down in the skeletal remains. "Help us! Our scans show a massive meteor is heading straight for this colony and there's no way for us to evacuate or defend ourselves!"

event.text: Your promise to assist is one thing, but you still need a way to stop the asteroid.

choice.text: We can tank some damage. Plant the ship in front of the asteroid.

event.text: It's not the smartest choice, but hell if it works. You take a pretty big hit but the asteroid shatters upon contact. The refugees are grateful for your help and offer one of the augments left behind by the old settlers, along with some supplies they don't need.

choice.text: (Adv. Shields) Deflect the asteroid with your shields.

event.text: Your shields take the blunt of the blow, shattering the asteroid. A few pieces manage to make their way through and scrape up the hull, but you're otherwise unharmed. The refugees are grateful for your help and offer one of the augments left behind by the old settlers, along with some supplies they don't need.

choice.text: (Hull Armor) Your armor can take a hit. Ricochet the asteroid off of your plating.

event.text: An asteroid colliding with the hull is still an asteroid colliding with the hull, and you take some damage regardless of your armor. Still, you resist most of the damage and the asteroid shatters on impact. The refugees are grateful for your help and offer one of the augments left behind by the old settlers, along with some supplies they don't need.

choice.text: Guess we can't help after all.

event.text: You mute the comms and fly away.
You mute the comms and fly away.

name: DISTRESS_ABANDONED_STOLEN_TECH
text: An Engi vessel, the source of the local distress signal, contacts you. "Assistance required. Job details: Lanius military vessel taken drone technology. Engi ship is poorly equipped, not combat ready. Your ship: adequate for mission. Should Federation accept, payment will be given."

choice.text: Agree to hunt down the Lanius.

event.text: Turns out the Lanius aren't far, but it seems they've already downloaded the schematic and consumed the original drone. If you want it back, you're going to have to find a way to download it off of their databanks.

choice.text: Fight the Lanius ship to try and take back the schematic.

event.text: You have decided to fight the Lanius ship. If you want the schematic back, you'll have to make sure their computers aren't damaged.

choice.text: (Hacking) Hack their systems and transfer the schematic.

event.text: The data transfer goes without problem, but you've also alerted the Lanius of your presence, and they aren't happy.

choice.text: (Long-Ranged Scanners) Transfer the schematic over to your computer.

event.text: The data transfer goes without problem, and the Lanius remain oblivious to your presence.

choice.text: (Adv. Sensors) Transfer the schematic over to your computer.

event.text: The data transfer goes without problem, and the Lanius remain oblivious to your presence.
You power up the engines and fly far away until your computer can no longer detect the signal.

name: DISTRESS_ABANDONED_STOLEN_TECH_WIN
text: The Engi are not pleased that their drone was destroyed, but they still offer solid payment for the schematic.

choice.text: (Drone Control) Construct the drone yourself and give it to the Engi.

event.text: You briefly construct the drone tech before transferring it over to the Engi ship.

The Engi are baffled, confused as to why you felt it necessary to build the drone yourself when they too could construct the drone. They let you keep it and simply take the schematic instead, and transfer over regular payment.

name: QUEST_ABANDONED_RAID
text: At first this system looks rather ordinary, but a blip on your computer shows a new hail from a ship you cannot see.

event.text: As soon as you open up the communications interface you spot a pirate ship slinking out of the shadows of a nearby planet. "Psssst, hey Feddy boy, ova' here! I gotta job offer for you. Me and my gang was heading to this ratha fine lookin' colony hopin' to find a large score of supplies when a buncha' spikey metal dudes come busin' outta nowhere! Nowhere, I tell ya'! Why don't yah do us one big favor and clear that place outta the Lanius ships? We gots pay, if that's what you lookin' for..."
The pirates give you the coordinates to the colony.
You explain you aren't in the mercenary line of work and cut communications.
You power up the engines and fly far away until your computer can no longer detect the signal.

name: QUEST_ABANDONED_RAID_COLONY

unvisitedTooltip.text: A pirate has asked that you clear out the presence of Lanius ships at an abandoned colony.

text: You've arrived at the abandoned colony. It seems that it's much better protected than you thought, with a group of Lanius ships, albeit small, in the dozens laying dormant nearby.

choice.text: Attack the leader of the Lanius to drive away the others.

event.text: You single out the strongest of the ships, a dangerous Elite Lanius. If you can kill it, the other smaller ships likely won't be interested in sticking around.

choice.text: Pick off one of the smaller ships.

event.text: You single out one of the smaller Lanius ships and engage.

choice.text: This is a bad idea. Slip away while they still haven't noticed you.

event.text: This isn't what you expected. The pirates will have to find someone else to do the job.

name: QUEST_ABANDONED_RAID_WIN
text: Now that the colony is no longer protected by the Lanius, you have a choice to make.

choice.text: Contact the pirates and tell them the colony is free from the Lanius threat.

event.text: Not too long after the pirates jump in and thank you for the help. They pay you some supplies and a brand new weapon.

choice.text: Forget the pirates, scrap the colony yourself.

event.text: You quickly scrap all that you can from the colony before the pirates arrive.

name: ENCOUNTER_LANIUS_ABANDONED_SUN
text: A Lanius ship hails you, spouting nonsense about the nearby star. "Heat... die, must not stay!" You think they're trying to warn you, but they're attacking as well. You're confused on their motives but you have no choice but to defend your ship.

name: ENCOUNTER_GHOST_ABANDONED_ASTEROID
text: A Ghost ship has come to this asteroid field looking for a new ship to acquire. It seems they're willing to settle with yours, despite the hazard here.

name: ENCOUNTER_MILITIA_ABANDONED
text: It seems a nearby Militia ship trying desperately to protect this sector has made a mistake and identified you as a scavenger. You don't have time to explain because they've muted comms and are moving in quickly.

name: ASTEROID_REFINERY
text: A small Union refinery is operating away from all the asteroids. Though they mostly just process raw ores, you can probably pay them to refine some of your scrap.

choice.text: Pay them to create a weapon.

event.text: "Bit of an unconventional request, but we appreciate the donation. We'll see what we can do."

choice.text: Pay them to create an augment.

event.text: "Bit of an unconventional request, but we appreciate the donation. We'll see what we can do."
"Wait wait! What did we do?!" You mute the civilians and open fire.
There likely isn't anything good to come out of exploring this place. Let's move on.

name: ASTEROID_CACHE
text: Unfortunately, the beacon here has been engulfed by an intense swarm of asteroids. You're about to prepare to leave when you notice several radar blips. A hollow artificial object is drifting amongst the rocks. If you had to guess, it's likely a supply cache.

choice.text: (Adv. Piloting) Navigate to the cache safely.
(Adv. Shields) Navigate to the cache safely.
(Adv. Engines) Navigate to the cache safely.
We're already getting pelted. We should just leave.

event.text: Too risky trying to access the cache. You distance yourself away from the swarm of asteroids.

name: ASTEROID_DEADPLATFORM
text: A rather large mining platform has been embedded on the side of a hollowed-out asteroid. It's not returning any hails and shows no signs of activity, but you aren't sure just how long it has been abandoned, or for what reasons.

event.text: There likely isn't anything good to come out of exploring this place. Let's move on.

name: ASTEROID_HURTMINER
text: It seems another ship is exploring the beacon through the dense asteroid field. However, moments after you spot them, a large asteroid strikes their ship, crippling their engines and sending them flying!

choice.text: Attempt to salvage some of the wreckage from the collision.
(Upg. Piloting) Use your advanced auto-pilot to correct their trajectory.
(Arm Upgrade) Use your arm to correct their trajectory.

event.text: You latch onto the ship and pull them out of the path of the larger asteroids. You take a little bit of a beating, but the captain is very grateful for your help and, considering his ship is totaled, he offers to help you instead.
You're not willing to put yourself through the same risk.

name: ASTEROID_LENNY
text: Though the asteroid field here isn't terribly dense, a nearly moon sized chunk of rock supports a small Federation mining colony in its orbit, which doesn't respond to any hails. A complex cave system seems to have been artificially carved through the largest of the rocks.

event.text: You dive into the depths of the cave, exploring freely until you come across a wall of what seems to be made of flesh. Horrified, you pull away just in time as the "wall" gives way and reveals itself to be part of a gigantic worm-like creature!

choice.text: Get the hell out of here!

event.text: Nothing to do here. It's unlikely there's anything of value in the caves anyways.

name: ASTEROID_LENNY_SCAN
text: To your horror, your scans reveal a massive worm-like creature has burrowed itself inside the asteroid. Large enough to swallow a ship, this could pose a threat to the colonists!

choice.text: Get the hell out of here!

name: ASTEROID_LENNY_WARN
text: You rush to the colony, hailing them until they finally respond, staring at you as if you were mad. You warn them about the worm, and their eyes go wide in terror. "Is something wrong with Lenny?! Please say it isn't so!"

event.text: "Yes, Lenny! The worm! He is the most cherishable one! We bring him gifts in return for eternal youth! He is our savior!" The colonists each fall to their knees in prayer, chanting "Praise be Lenny the worm, PRAISE BE!"
"You are unworthy! You have brought us false news of Lenny's misfortune, and now we shall feed you to him!" Great, now looks like you have some wacko cultists to deal with.

name: ASTEROID_LENNY_HELP
text: You step aboard the colony cautiously, and convince the colonists to listen to you. Some examining reveals most of them are suffering psychologically, likely caused by prolonged isolation due to no one else wanting to come mess with "Lenny". You aren't sure there's much you can do to help them, but one colonist pulls you aside. It seems they haven't fully gone insane yet, and they were only pretending so as not to draw the others' ire. They beg you to take them with you.

name: ASTEROID_ABUSE
text: Despite not having authority to do so in the Free Excavation Act, a Coalition station is operating in full view, harvesting the asteroids near this beacon.

event.text: A Mantis captain, wearing a smug grin, appears on your camera. "Hahah, are you thinking of so, captain? Big riot, FREE Excavation act! You forgetting doctrine saying nothing of Federation, but you exploiting merely of Union and Ministry benefits. Well, funny pebble man and gross worm thing sign act too! And if you are noticing, we are having funny pebble man AND gross worm thing on board. Thus, Coalition having as much right as you are! Hahah! Dumb dumb!"
"Hahahah, yes, fight me infant brain man! I welcome your slaughter! Hahah!"
"What?! No! No no! You aren't supposed to be agreeing! You getting mad! Madder! Agh! Curses you! Hmph. Well, uh, not knowing what to do now. Uh... you needing sell and buy things?"

choice.text: (Anti-Bio Weapon) Snipe the Rockman and Leech.

event.text: You configure your weapon and lock onto both of the crew the Mantis had proudly displayed, near instantly killing them both. The Mantis gawks in horror. "You are... how?! This cheating! Agh!" From offscreen the Slug aboard shuffles on. "Heh. You kinda sssuck. I'm outta here, Fed dude'sss got cooler gunsss."
You have nothing to gain but conflict from bothering these guys. Better to stay away.

name: ASTEROID_REBELOUTPOST
text: Seems a small Rebel outpost has been stealthily placed between the asteroids here. By law they aren't meant to be here, but mining operations aren't exactly known for hurting anyone.

choice.text: Take the law into your own hands!

event.text: "Damn you! And you wonder why there was ever a Rebellion! This isn't law, this is corruption!"

choice.text: (MFK Ace Crew) Pretend to be Rebels to trade.

event.text: You can tell the Rebels are skeptical, but apparently they're desperate to sell off some old equipment thanks to a lack of support this far from Rebel space.

choice.text: (Engineer Crew) Pretend to be Rebels to trade.

event.text: You can tell the Rebels are skeptical, but apparently they're desperate to sell off some old equipment thanks to a lack of support this far from Rebel space.
Harmless or not, bothering these Rebels is risky. Better not to get involved.

name: ASTEROID_STANDOFF
text: Despite the presence of a large approaching asteroid storm, two ships appear to be in the middle of a standoff. A Ministry and Theocracy ship are squaring off over access to some sort of depot. As expected, the Rockmen are using offensive racial slurs and the Zoltans are spewing legal jargon. What else is new?

event.text: You think for a moment the Zoltans are considering helping you, until they suddenly jump away! The reason is obvious moments later when the beacon is engulfed by the approaching asteroid storm!

As you lock onto the Zoltan ship, the Rockmen continue to provide 'support' by shouting more obscenities at the Zoltan. That is, until the asteroids engulf the beacon and the Rockmen give up and abandon the depot!

choice.text: (Upg. Cloaking) Stealthily raid the depot yourself.

event.text: You slip past the two squabbling ships and storm the depot, grabbing everything that isn't nailed down that's within reach, and quickly leave.

choice.text: These two can duke it out alone.

event.text: Coming between two vessels like these is pointless. Best let them handle each other like the manchildren they are.

name: ASTEROID_STANDOFF_DEPOT
text: With the ship out of the way, you have the opportunity to go after the depot yourself - but you might take some extra damage from the asteroids!

event.text: You storm the depot, grabbing everything that isn't nailed down that's within reach and quickly leave. Some asteroids strike your hull, but hopefully it was worth it.

name: ASTEROID_ENGILAB
text: You receive a hail from a nearby Engi station monitoring the nearby asteroid fields. "Engi presence is with permission of Ministry. Goals: test and establish remote mining operation through use of drone technology. Problem: Vagabond settlement continues to steal tech. Solution: Federation vessel may 'blow shit up'. Can a deal be made?"

event.text: "There is an understanding - you are at a lack of the limited resource of time. Three Vagabond ships have been identified as problematic. We request you defeat one."

choice.text: Take on the ship populated by Gouls.

event.text: "Understood. Coordinates for target are being transfered."

choice.text: Take on the ship populated by Mares.

event.text: "Understood. Coordinates for target are being transfered."

choice.text: Take on the ship populated by Wraiths.

event.text: "Understood. Coordinates for target are being transfered."

choice.text: Ignore the Engi and attack them instead!

event.text: "Critical error. Unexpected hostility from Federation vessel. Appropriate response: 'oh shit'. Activating combat protocols."
"Your response has been evaluated as: rude. Unfortunate circumstances. We will cease contact with your vessel."

name: ASTEROID_ENGILAB_CONTACT
text: "Impressive demonstration. Federation vessel has successfully 'kicked ass'. Payment is due. Expect to receive reward momentarily."

name: DISTRESS_ASTEROID_PRESSURE_TANK
text: The distress signal is coming from a mining facility on a large asteroid. They quickly explain: this belt is a fantastic source of a particularly volatile and valuable gas. Their warehouse was hit by debris, and the pressure of one of the storage tanks is rising at an alarming rate. If it blows, it could cause a chain reaction, destroying the whole colony.

choice.text: (Damaging Pinpoint Beam) Precisely puncture the damaged tank to allow a controlled leakage.

event.text: You fly over the damaged warehouse, take aim, and fire - your perfectly precise pinpoint punctures the tank. Since the warehouse is currently exposed to the vacuum of space, the gas is able to harmlessly spill out.
The mining crew are impressed at your ingenious solution. They offer to reward you with some of their resources and even a piece of mining equipment.

choice.text: (Beam Drone) Precisely puncture the damaged tank to allow a controlled leakage.

event.text: Your drone flies down to the tank and precisely pierces the chemical containment. Since the warehouse is currently exposed to the vacuum of space, the gas is able to harmlessly spill out of the tank.
The mining crew are impressed at your ingenious solution. They offer to reward you with some of their resources and even a piece of mining equipment.

choice.text: (Damaging Beam Weapon) Try to cut the tank open with your beam weapon.

event.text: You stay back and watch. Sure enough, the tank explodes, which causes a massive chain reaction rippling explosions throughout the habitat, then the surface of the asteroid. The habitat is completely destroyed. There's a little bit left for you to salvage from their remains.

choice.text: (Teleporter) Stay clear and evacuate the ship from afar with your teleporter.

event.text: You stay back and teleport as many miners as you can onboard without risking harm to your ship. After the asteroid explodes, many of the miners are devastated. Their jobs, their equipment as well as all of the work they'd just done is all destroyed, but one of them is grateful enough to offer to join your crew. You salvage what little you can from the asteroid.

choice.text: Risk your ship to save the miners.

event.text: You swoop in as the pressure builds and rescue as many miners as you can. Once the tank begins to rupture, you try to fly away... but despite your best efforts, you are hit by a part of the explosion.

Many of the miners are devastated. Their jobs, their equipment as well as all of the work they'd just done is all destroyed. One of them is grateful enough to offer to join their crew. You salvage what little you can from the asteroid.

name: DISTRESS_ASTEROID_FREEDUMB
text: The distress beacon here is coming from a Rock mining platform, which has taken heavy damage. They hail you almost immediately; "We don't care who you are or what your stake is - there are some lunatic Mantis running around here massacring us by the dozen! We need you to track them down and put an end to this murder!"

choice.text: Agree to track down the murderers.

event.text: You make some scans of the system and detect another ship some distance away. Moving closer reveals it to be piloted by Free Mantis, who greet you with great jubilation. "Merry day, captain! You are coming here claiming great bounties too?"

choice.text: Are you the ones killing Theocracy miners?

event.text: "Huh? Not knowing what you are talking of. We come here harvest rocks! Many rocks, they tell us! Kill rock, it gives you fuel! And when I am hearing this, I thinking to myself, 'This is making greatest profits!' You are saying words is wrong? Truth be, we not finding any fuel! Doing something wrong I am thinking..."

choice.text: You've been terribly mistaken - the Rockmen are not asteroids.

event.text: "What? You are saying there is a Rock... AND man? Is this why screaming and running when I slice them open? Huh... Revolutionary ideas! You think big smart, biggest smarter even! Some days I wishing I have biggest smart. So, I come with you, and hoping knowledge coming off with me!"
"Oh, okay! Just unlucky supposing. Many thanks, captain! While not having many fuels, we do offering you great basket of assorted metals we pick from bigger rock after small ones dead!"
The Rockmen make no attempt to say anything more.

name: DISTRESS_ASTEROID_BACTERIA
text: As soon as you arrive a Zoltan science vessel hails you, deeply concerned. "It is a woeful day, captain! You must help us! Despite ordinance section C67I-O23W-B... er... maybe it was C, not B... regardless, despite being in violation of very important rulings, a nearby Confederate outpost has had the AUDACITY to pollute this region, and it has endangered a very rare species of completely useless asteroid-borne microbacteria no one cares about! This cannot stand!"

event.text: "Oh thank goodness. I was afraid I'd have to do something for myself for once. Welp, here are the co-ordinates. Do whatever it is you Renegades do and go murder them or something." You make your way to the outpost, which is protected by a single ship.
Words are for pansies. Your job as a mercenary is to kill, and kill you shall. In the name of... useless microbacteria.

choice.text: Try and explain to the Vampweeds.

event.text: "I'm afraid I don't understand. Why do these bacteria matter? And what do you mean by 'stop polluting'? What are we polluting? We produce about as much waste, if not less as any other settlement in this sector."

choice.text: A Zoltan told us all this. We're just mercenaries.

event.text: "Uhuh... and why should I care? We aren't Ministry citizens. Hell, the Ministry was only included in the Excavation Acts because we knew they'd be the most careful of enforcing them. I understand you have a job to do... but maybe you could just, I dunno, tell the Zoltan you did it anyways?"

You head back to the Zoltan and inform them the job is complete. Despite having no proof you did anything, the Zoltan lights up. "Incredible work! Now we can all go on to continue not caring about the bacteria in peace! Here's your reward!"

choice.text: Finish the job properly and kill the Vampweeds.

event.text: You promised to help the Zoltan, and you'll follow through with it. Prepare for combat!
"Gah, you're worthless. Why is no one willing to do my work FOR me?!"

name: ASTEROID_BACTERIA_HELP
text: "Incredible work! Now we can all go on to continue not caring about the bacteria in peace! Here's your reward!"

name: QUEST_ASTEROID_TRANSPORT
text: A small Eargen transport hails you, their Leech captain bleeding from a long gash down its back. "You, you can help us. We're supposed to be taking these back to the Capital, but some pirates got in our way and stole the cargo. We're in no fighting order, but maybe you could get it back for us?"

event.text: "Great. We had a tracking beacon in the cargo, and those idiots seem to have grabbed it themselves. Shouldn't be too hard to track them down."
You apologize, but you aren't here to run errands.

name: ASTEROID_TRANSPORT_PIRATES

unvisitedTooltip.text: A Leech captain asked for your help to retrieve a stolen cargo from pirates.

text: It seems you've found the pirate ship in question. With no time to waste, you engage them immediately. Be careful not to damage the cargo!

name: AUGMENTED_ANOINTED

unvisitedTooltip.text: The location of the augmented leader, the Anointed.

visitedTooltip.text: Visited location.

text: You've arrived at the exit...

event.text: A white Lanius with purple details stands up from her large throne as soon as you arrive.
"You are Federation ship I hear about. I understand you have brought with you one of ancient creatures. I will buy it from you, modest price."
You wait for the Lanius to come aboard and take the ancient from you. This will likely be the last you see of this great mystery, but you've made a good profit from it.

choice.text: Ask what she intends to use it for first.

event.text: "Food, naturally. My diet, very complicated. Hard to get hands on these, especially live ones. He will make tasty snack, though I would preferred royal to commoner..."

choice.text: Refuse, we aren't going to let this creature eat another living being!

event.text: "So you are turning down offer? Most disappointing. Perhaps price too low for you? I raise it, being fair."
"You really stubborn. Fine, no final offer. You not giving me creature, then I taking it myself!"
You wait for the Lanius to come aboard and take the ancient from you. This will likely be the last you see of this great mystery, but you've made a good profit from it.
You wait for the Lanius to come aboard and take the ancient from you. This will likely be the last you see of this great mystery, but you've made a good profit from it.
Looks like the Anointed's ship is gone now, but the Rebel fleet has taken control of the beacon! You'll have to fight your way out!

choice.text: (Adv. Engines) Try to escape the Elite.

name: ANOINTED_SURRENDER
text: "Ok, you winning. You may keep creature, not worth dying over. Taking this, and leave us here. Apologies for attack."

name: ANOINTED_SURRENDER_ACCEPT
text: You accept the Anointed's surrender, and she transfers over a good amount of scrap. As you prepare to leave though, she asks to speak with you about one more thing.

event.text: The Lanius hands you a strange key-like device. "This ancient, like many other, is in hibernation. This device seeming able to awaken them. There is mystery here, yes? I wishing I could solve it, but you are one now with privileged. You will need this and fuel as catalyst. Good luck."

choice.text: Offer to take her with you.

event.text: "Oh, could not. Sorry, but busy here. My life, very difficult. The material of body very unstable, always needing to feed on more. Without it, I decay, die. Very painful, you understand."

choice.text: Offer her an Ancient Laser to feed on.
Offer her an Ancient Beam to feed on.
Offer her an Ancient Pinpoint to feed on.
Offer her an Ancient Missile Launcher to feed on.
Offer her an Ancient Bomb Launcher to feed on.
Offer her an Ancient Peacekeeper to feed on.
Offer her an Ancient Laser Drone to feed on.
Offer her an Ancient Ion Drone to feed on.
Offer her an Ancient Missile Drone to feed on.
Offer her an Ancient Overwatcher Drone to feed on.
Offer her an Ancient Mender to feed on.
Offer her an Ancient Director to feed on.
Offer her an Ancient Atomizer to feed on.
Offer her an Ancient Atomizer to feed on.

name: ANOINTED_DESTROYED
text: The Anointed's cruiser explodes. There's plenty left to scrap from the wreckage, but with her dies any chance that you might figure out what to do with this alien.

name: ANOINTED_DEADCREW
text: The crew of the cruiser has been neutralized. You move in to inspect the ship and collect the remains.

event.text: As you inspect the ship, you find the Anointed decaying on the ground. She gestures for you to come closer, and slaps a strange looking device in your hands. She manages to choke out the words: "This is activator key. Along with fuel catalyst, will wake ancient... from h-hibernation. There is great mystery here... my mistake for interrupting. You will solve it, I am sure..." With that, she falls to the ground, dead.

name: AUGMENTED_FREESCRAP
text: It seems this beacon was once home to an Ancient ship, but has been scrapped down to the core. There is just enough left however for you to get some extra scrap.

name: AUGMENTED_ARTIST
text: This region of space is very different from its surroundings. Someone has gone through the trouble of turning the shells of the ruins into a nice, long tunnel wide enough for your ship to fly through, rather than leaving the shattered vessels strewn randomly across the system.

event.text: As you pilot your ship into the tunnel, you become aware that someone has been drawing on the walls with a strange sticky, particulate substance. The art depicts Lanius alongside ships, strange cubes, and diamonds, and the quality seems to improve as you delve deeper into the tunnel. Eventually, some rudimentary drawings of solar systems enter your view - though the details you can discern seem to refer to systems that haven't existed for eons. Towards the end of the tunnel, you see a picture where a looming black-and-gold figure is shooing away a small group of Augmented, while a crowd of Lanius watches. A larger, purple-and-white figure is cut off by the edge of the mural, leading the outcasts elsewhere.

You come upon the most recent string of paintings deep within the tunnel, where an Augmented is finishing up a portrait of the purple and white figure you saw before. It looks almost impressionistic, a glow radiating off of the wall. The Lanius finally notices your ship and pushes off the wall to land on your hull.
"Outsider. Make what see. Other Lanius not understand. You are not seen. Not known. Can make image?"

choice.text: (Human Crew) Let the Lanius sketch your Human.

event.text: You send your human to stand in front of the window for the Augmented to see. "New creature! Haven't seen! Fleshy... with strands on head... Got inspiration!" The Lanius jumps to a wall and begins drawing. Although the Lanius has developed some skill, the depiction looks very... odd. Your human feels that the depiction looks like a few strands of bacon with a brush for a head. The artist is satisfied.

choice.text: (Engi Crew) Let the Lanius sketch your Engi.

event.text: You send your Engi to stand in front of the window for the Augmented to see. "New creature! Haven't seen! Metallic... hunched... focused... Got inspiration!" The Lanius jumps to a wall and begins drawing. Although the Lanius has developed some skill, the depiction looks very... odd. Despite this, your Engi seems fine with the depiction, noting that it sees the resemblance. The artist is satisfied.

choice.text: (Zoltan Crew) Let the Lanius sketch your Zoltan.

event.text: You send your Zoltan to stand in front of the window for the Augmented to see. "New creature! Haven't seen! Glowy... small... transparent... Got inspiration!" The Lanius jumps to a wall and begins drawing. Although the Lanius has developed some skill, the depiction looks very... odd. Your Zoltan feels that the depiction looks like a burnt out L.E.D. The artist is satisfied.

choice.text: (Orchid Crew) Let the Lanius sketch your Orchid.

event.text: You send your Orchid to stand in front of the window for the Augmented to see. "New creature! Haven't seen! Flimsy... colorful... Got inspiration!" The Lanius jumps to a wall and begins drawing. Although the Lanius has developed some skill, the depiction looks very... odd. Your Orchid feels it looks like an piece of origami taped to a garden hose. The artist is satisfied.

choice.text: (Shell Crew) Let the Lanius sketch your Shell.

event.text: You send your Shell to stand in front of the window for the Augmented to see. "New creature! Haven't seen! Round... slimy... Got inspiration!" The Lanius jumps to a wall and begins drawing. Although the Lanius has developed some skill, the depiction looks very... odd. Your Shell feels it looks like a muddy old tire. The artist is satisfied.

choice.text: (Mantis Crew) Let the Lanius sketch your Mantis.

event.text: You send your Mantis to stand in front of the window for the Augmented to see. "New creature! Haven't seen! Sharp... crawly... Got inspiration!" The Lanius jumps to a wall and begins drawing. Although the Lanius has developed some skill, the depiction looks very... odd. Your Mantis feels it looks like a treadmill made of swords, which means they like it. The artist is satisfied.

choice.text: (Rock Crew) Let the Lanius sketch your Rockman.

event.text: You send your Rock to stand in front of the window for the Augmented to see. "New creature! Haven't seen! Big... Rough... Got inspiration!" The Lanius jumps to a wall and begins drawing. Although the Lanius has developed some skill, the depiction looks very... odd. Your Rock feels it looks like a misshapen potato. The artist is satisfied.

choice.text: (Slug Crew) Let the Lanius sketch your Slug.

event.text: You send your Slug to stand in front of the window for the Augmented to see. "New creature! Haven't seen! Fat... Slimy... Got inspiration!" The Lanius jumps to a wall and begins drawing. Although the Lanius has developed some skill, the depiction looks very... odd. Your Slug feels it looks like a bratwurst with a propeller cap. The artist is satisfied.

choice.text: (Leech Crew) Let the Lanius sketch your Leech.

event.text: You send your Leech to stand in front of the window for the Augmented to see. "New creature! Haven't seen! Long... Thin... Got inspiration!" The Lanius jumps to a wall and begins drawing. Although the Lanius has developed some skill, the depiction looks very... odd. Your Leech feels it looks like a ruined slinky. The artist is satisfied.

choice.text: (Spider Crew) Let the Lanius sketch your Giant Alien Spider.

event.text: You send your Spider to stand in front of the window for the Augmented to see. "New creature! Haven't seen! Many legs... many eyes... Got inspiration!" The Lanius jumps to a wall and begins drawing. Although the Lanius has developed some skill, the depiction looks very... odd. Your Spider doesn't even seem to realize what's going on. The artist is satisfied.

choice.text: (Equinoid Crew) Let the Lanius sketch your Equinoid.

event.text: You send your Equinoid to stand in front of the window for the Augmented to see. "New creature! Haven't seen! Many legs... Colorful... Got inspiration!" The Lanius jumps to a wall and begins drawing. Although the Lanius has developed some skill, the depiction looks very... odd. Your Equinoid doesn't even seem to realize what's going on. The artist is satisfied.

You have Wealsey perch in front of the window for the Augmented to see. "New creature! Haven't seen! Small... Light... Majestic... Got inspiration!" The Lanius jumps to a wall and begins drawing. Although the Lanius has developed some skill, the depiction looks very familiar. In fact, it looks surprisingly similar to the Rebel MFK logo. The artist is satisfied.

choice.text: (Lizard Crew) Let the Lanius sketch your Lizard.

event.text: You send your Lizard to stand in front of the window for the Augmented to see. The Lanius seems at a loss for words, but nods. It jumps to a wall and begins drawing. The Lanius draws the Lizard with almost perfect accuracy. The Lizard nods in satisfaction. The artist is satisfied.

choice.text: (Morph Crew) Let the Lanius sketch your Morph.

event.text: You send your Morph to stand in front of the window for the Augmented to see. "New creature! Haven't seen! Doughy... dull colors... Got inspiration!" The Lanius jumps to a wall and begins drawing. Although the Lanius has developed some skill, the depiction looks very... odd. Your Morph momentarily adjusts its shape to match the drawing. The artist is satisfied.

choice.text: (Siren Crew) Let the Lanius sketch your Siren.

event.text: You send your Siren to stand in front of the window for the Augmented to see. "New creature! Haven't seen! Can't... Think...!" The Lanius grabs its head, as if in pain before it starts drawing. But instead of drawing the Siren, it draws a picture of what looks like a dead Slug and some broken circles. The artist looks woozy and passes out.
With the Lanius unconscious, the best you can do is take whatever scrap you can find lying around.

choice.text: (Eldritch Crew) Let the Lanius sketch an Eldritch creature.

event.text: You let the Lanius see your eldritch crew. Upon seeing them, the Augmented claps. "The inspiration! It flows freely!" The artist jumps to a wall and begins drawing. For some reason, the Lanius has made what looks like a children's picture book on the wall, full of simple rhymes and goofy animal characters. The art is very tasteful.

choice.text: (Obelisk Crew) Let the Lanius sketch your Ancient crewmember.

event.text: "You!! Anointed wants!" The Lanius looks like it's about to attack... but then pauses. "Not fighter. Can't take. Will sketch." The Lanius sketches the Ancient crewmember. It comes out looking pretty good.
"Anointed warn us. You go." The Lanius stares at your ship, then scurries into a room, coming back with a gift. "Then take. But go."
"Very sad. Need inspiration." The Lanius hops off your ship and resumes painting. All that's left to do is to leave the tunnel.
You exercise discretion and leave the tunnel alone.

name: AUGMENTED_ARTIST_REWARD
text: "Friendly creature! Will continue depicting! Have present. Not need weapon when have art."

name: AUGMENTED_HUNGRY
text: A small shuttle flies past, carrying a single augmented Lanius. They hail you, pleading for a favor. "My body, it decomposing fast. Need to eat hull to live. This shuttle small, begging you let take small bite of yours. Nothing you can't managing."

event.text: The Lanius flies the shuttle close and exits out the bottom, gliding its way onto yours. He attaches and begins to liquify a small portion of the hull. It's barely anything, much less than you expected, but the Lanius is grateful and even offers to join your crew.
You refuse. The Lanius looks frightened, but not for long before their arms fall off and they melt into a puddle of metal. Guess when he said fast, he meant very fast...

name: AUGMENTED_WAYSTONE
text: This sector is home to all kinds of weird sights, and now you can add Crystal Elites to your list of unexpected visitors you didn't think you'd see in this sector.

event.text: The Crystal Sentinels are equally surprised to see a Federation ship here, but they regard you in at least a decently passive way. "We've come looking for several parts from these structures. We believe their tech was combined with that of our ancestors to create the waystone that sealed away our homeworlds. However, navigating this sector is difficult. If you happen to have any map data, we'll gladly take it."

choice.text: Sell them whatever basic data you've already collected.
(Adv. Navigation) Sell them the data your navigator has picked up.
(Long-Ranged Scanners) Sell them the data your scanners have collected.
(Adv. Sensors) Sell them the data your sensors have collected.

event.text: In true barbarian fashion, you prove that you love nothing more than to attack first and ask questions later. You attack the Crystalline vessel without mercy.
The Crystals spend some time exploring two nearby wrecks before jumping away. You figure if they didn't find anything, you won't either.

name: AUGMENTED_FEEDING
text: Nearby is a small ancient ruin with some augmented Lanius feeding on it. As you approach, they hail you. "You visitor? If having any fellow Lanius, feel free join in. Enough here to change composition!"

choice.text: (Lanius Crew) Let your Lanius feed on the ruins.

event.text: Your Lanius glides out of the ship towards the ruins and attaches to them along with the others...
You watch in fascination as your Lanius's metal body slowly turns dark black. Soon they return, looking the same as all the other augmented Lanius you've seen, and with the same abilities too.

choice.text: Your Augmented crew would not gain any benefit from these ruins, as they've already undergone substantial transformation from feeding on similar salvage.
Attack them to access the ruins on your own!

event.text: You move closer, firing on the Lanius. They detach from the structure, allowing you to move in and salvage it. However, they aren't deterred long enough, and they re-attach themselves to the hull and break their way in!
The Lanius make no further attempts at contacting you.
You power up your weapons and fight the Augmented ship.
You decide not to fight the Lanius, and fly away.

name: AUGMENTED_LANIUS
text: It seems tensions have gotten high between the nearby augmented and elite Lanius vessel over possession of some ancient wreckage. Do you want to get involved?

event.text: You power up your weapons and fight the elite ship.
You power up your weapons and fight the augmented ship.
You decide not to interact with the Lanius, and fly away.

name: AUGMENTED_GHOST
text: The Ancient vessel nearby is in much better condition than usual, but that's not the only thing off about it... scans show Vagabonds have taken control of the ship!

choice.text: Attack them, maybe the ship has something of value!

event.text: The Vagabonds, determined not to give up their ship, prepare to defend themselves against your attack.

choice.text: Hail the Vagabonds and offer to trade.

event.text: You send your message and wait for a response, knowing your translator needs some time to properly decipher the static noises of the Ghosts. "Hello, you are acknowledged. We have recovered this new vessel, but we lack the resources required for its upkeep. If you have generous amounts of fuel, we will accept an exchange of goods."

choice.text: Give them a small amount of fuel.

event.text: "This is a quantifiable amount of fuel, but only barely. I hope you did not expect payment higher than this."

choice.text: Give them a medium amount of fuel.

event.text: "This will service well. Thank you."

choice.text: Give them a large amount of fuel.

event.text: "This is a large quantity of fuel. You have our highest appreciation. Please accept this piece of armament, it belonged to the former residents of this ship, whoever they might have been."
You wait for any further response from the Vagabonds, but get none. You pull away from the Ancient ship and leave the Ghosts behind.
If the Vagabonds have managed to secure an Ancient ship, good for them. That's not a band of gas beings you want to deal with.

name: AUGMENTED_SEPARATISTS
text: A lone Engi Separatist is scanning a long abandoned ancient vessel. When you jump in, they put some distance between your ships, but don't leave.

event.text: "Local Federation vessel, we [assure] you that you have been detected. Please do not interfere, we are searching for ways to [disable] the Harmony."

The Separatist lets out an audible sigh. "The [cubical] vessels that populate this sector belonged to ancient race. It is believed, though 60% speculation, that these creatures first developed Harmony. There is your [lore], now please leave."

choice.text: Attack them, maybe they have something valuable on board!

event.text: You've decided to attack the Separatist ship. Prepare for battle.

choice.text: Do what they say and leave them alone.

event.text: The ship isn't bothering you, so you won't bother them either.

choice.text: (Separatist Crew) "Your mission is of [high] importance. However, so is ours. Requesting: supplies."

event.text: Your Separatist explains your mission to the other Engi. "This request is acceptable. Transferring supplies now."

choice.text: (Engi Crew) "This is unacceptable. Preventing Separatist success is highest priority."

event.text: Your Engi demands that you take care of the Separatists before they can complete their mission.

choice.text: Do what they say and leave them alone.

event.text: The ship isn't bothering you, so you won't bother them either.
You'll be damned if you let some Engi run away from you. You'll solve this the only way you know - with needless murder.
The ship isn't bothering you, so you won't bother them either.

name: AUGMENTED_INQUISITION
text: Here you've found perhaps the last thing you would have thought to see, an abandoned Inquisition vessel. The Elders must have sent this scout here to press their influence even further, or perhaps they know more than you do...

event.text: The Rock vessel remains motionless while you fly away.

name: DISTRESS_AUGMENTED_EXPLOSIVE
text: An Augmented ship frantically contacts you. "Hurry! Ruin explode! Need act quick for eat!" There is a nearby piece of old technology that is flashing and heating up.

choice.text: (Hacking) Hack into the tech to stop the explosion.

event.text: Fortunately, you are able to diagnose and address the problem - a self-destruct had been tripped, likely by the Augmented ship. With the self-destruct disabled, your ship and the Lanius are able to convene over the ruin.

choice.text: (Hacking Weapon) Attempt to stop the explosion.

name: DISTRESS_AUGMENTED_EXPLOSIVE_HACK
text: The Augmented ship flies over to inspect. "Good job. Share in ruin. Half, half." Even just half of the bounty is a high yield - you are able to get quite a lot of scrap out of it.

name: DISTRESS_AUGMENTED_EXPLOSIVE_FAIL
text: The Augmented ship quickly flies away from the wreckage as it explodes. It then confronts you - "Our meal, gone. We eat your ship!"

name: DISTRESS_AUGMENTED_WENTWORTH
text: The distress signal originates from a disabled Wentworth Industries Auto-scout. Before you can investigate further, you receive a hail from a nearby Augmented vessel: "Found ship. Claim ship. Not give. But, had weird thing, hurts to touch. Can't eat. Don't want. Promise to leave alone, you take?"

event.text: The Lanius detaches the technology from the ship: a Sentry weapon. Whatever allowed a Wentworth Industries scout to come into the sector can't be good, but at least it's being destroyed.

choice.text: We will be taking the whole wreck. Power up weapons.

name: AUGMENTED_WENTWORTH_SCRAP
text: With the ship deactivated, it is safe to scrap.

name: DISTRESS_AUGMENTED_NEAR_DEATH
text: "Help. Help. Falling life! Hull critical! Destruction imminent!" The Augmented are frantically translating their SOS as fast as they can.

event.text: The medical bomb restores the Augmented to full fitness, and they quickly calm down. "In fight. Won, barely. Have - we found this."

choice.text: (Repair Burst) Repair their ship with a repair bomb. [-1}]

event.text: The repair bomb repairs the Lanius vessel, giving them the capability to fix themselves using the hull - after which, they calm down. "In fight. Won, barely. Have - we found this."

choice.text: (Hull Repair Drone) Repair their ship with a drone. [-1|]

event.text: The drone repairs the Lanius vessel, giving them the capability to fix themselves using the hull - after which, they calm down. "In fight. Won, barely. Have - we found this."

choice.text: (Medical Crew) Have your medical crew help them out.

event.text: It's a little awkward to help them out, given that your medical crew breathes the oxygen that the Lanius deplete, but they do their best from the safety of their shuttle. Your crew returns with a gift from the rescued vessel.

choice.text: (Repair Arm) Use your repair arm to patch them up. [-25~]

event.text: Your repair arm manages to fix their ship, giving the Lanius the capability to fix themselves using the hull - after which, they calm down. "In fight. Won, barely. Have - we found this."

name: DISTRESS_AUGMENTED_NEAR_DEATH_EXPLOSION
text: You watch as the Augmented have to pick between hunger and destruction. Unsurprisingly, one of them cracks and eats their hull, compromising its integrity.

name: QUEST_AUGMENTED_AUTOMATED_SIGNAL
text: An ancient communication receiver resides here, picking up a garbled signal from a different system. Unfortunately, it is in the language of the species that created it.

event.text: The communication originates from a nearby system. An Auto-ship is transmitting a message about a ruin that drifted into a Pulsar. You can likely find some valuable salvage there, but the Auto-ship will likely attack whoever manages to get close to the ruin.

The communication originates from a nearby system. An Auto-ship is transmitting a message about a ruin that drifted into a Pulsar. You can likely find some valuable salvage there, but the Auto-ship will likely attack whoever manages to get close to the ruin.
You leave the signal alone to focus on other things.

name: AUGMENTED_AUTOMATED_SIGNAL_QUEST

unvisitedTooltip.text: An Ancient Auto-Ship is protecting a ruin at this beacon.

text: The Auto-ship orbits the Pulsar, activating as soon as you jump in. You'll have to fight it in order to gain access to the ruin!

name: ENCOUNTER_AUGMENTED_AUTOANCIENT
text: Another automated ship similar to the one you saw has managed to survive the Lanius swarm in this sector. As soon as you approach, it seems to recognize you as a threat and attacks!

name: ENCOUNTER_AUGMENTED_PIRATE
text: You receive a hail from a pirate ship, but on the other line you hear nothing but loud screaming as an augmented Lanius cuts open the pirate captain and devours him. "Apologies for witnessing. Need food. You next."

name: AUGMENTED_DISCOVERY

unvisitedTooltip.text: These are the coordinates you found at the Harmony Link.

visitedTooltip.text: Explored location. Nothing left of interest.

text: You've arrived at the coords marked on your map. You notice the remains of some much smaller but similar cubical ships as before. The main difference from last time however, other than location, is three massive Lanius vessels in colors you've never seen before.

event.text: You hail the ships, but receive no verbal response. Instead, a strangely colored Lanius pops out of their hull, and glides towards you. It attaches to your hull, and burrows its way through, but the damage shouldn't be too hard to patch up quickly.
The Lanius unfolds, spitting out some metal. It speaks in a monotone but strangely well-translated voice. "Apologies damage. Not wanting take airlocks, my bad. You call me, assuming question have?"

The strange Lanius inspects the robot before speaking. "No, not robot. Lifeform, like you. Metal, like me. Showing this to leader, best option. She wanting see this, rare find one alive! Allowing me to assist FTL drive?"

choice.text: Agree to let him "assist the FTL Drive".

event.text: The Lanius waddles over to the engines and fiddles around with your drive. "We going now. Grab thing bolted down, bumpy ride!" Suddenly, the engines activate and you can feel the ship entering lightspeed!
"So the boring! Be taking alien then, needing food." They press some button on a device in their hands, and the ship in the distance moves towards you with its weapons powered on!
Despite coming all this way with some great mystery afoot, you'd decide to be a stick in the mud and quit now. That's pretty lame.

name: AUTO_ITEM_NAMED
text: There's some comm chatter at this beacon, and despite the fact that engineers are usually careful about that sort of thing, the channel is unsecured. It should be possible to listen in, if you so choose.

event.text: The message is a bit garbled at first, you have to move a certain distance into the system in order to pick up the message.

"...you if your stupid drones never do their delivery, then what's the damn point of them?"
"My Auto-ships are top notch. You're probably screwing up the protocols."
"Bah, you engineers and your protocols..."
"What drone was tasked to deliver your supply drop?"
"I can never keep their stupid names straight."
"I believe the only one out on task right now is Miekkakala."
"I'm never going to remember that."
"See? That's a part of your problem. If you don't send them their own name, they won't be able to validate your identity. And it should be on your digital receipt."
"Tch. Whatever, I'll get back to you when THAT doesn't work either."

"...you if your stupid drones never do their delivery, then what's the damn point of them?"

"I can never keep their stupid names straight."
"I believe the only one out on task right now is Hwangsaechi."
