We've already developed viruses that, if introduced locally, will compromise all their systems. That's the best long-term solution. If we can't, then destroying it is probably fine, but it's got serious defenses. We don't have the resources to launch an assault, so we're just gathering intel... but you? You could sabotage it or interfere. What do you say?"

choice.text: (Upg. Hacking) Create a gap in their security.

event.text: You exploit a vulnerability in the production facility's defense grid. You can either slip in undetected, or deactivate their ability to call for help as you blow them up.

You and the stealth ship bombard the surface of the planet with your weapons systems. While they catch on and try to call for help or respond by using their defense grid, your hack prevents them from taking any action to defend themselves. The loss of this facility is likely to be noticed before too long, but you're still able to recover some salvage from the wreckage.

choice.text: (Teleporter) Beam down into a sensitive area.

event.text: As you seize control of the security systems, you send some crew down, and make sure that the system is unaware of their presence.
"That's... it? That's all you were able to do...? I guess we'll just... take advantage of this security flaw at some point." The recon returns to its hiding spot.

choice.text: (Upg. Mind Control) Clear one of your shuttles for landing.

event.text: Since this facility is not in a nebula, it is mostly staffed by Mantises and Rockmen. It's not difficult to sway one of them to sneak your shuttle through security.

choice.text: (Mind Control Weapon) Clear one of your shuttles for landing.

event.text: Since this facility is not in a nebula, it is mostly staffed by Mantises and Rockmen. It's not difficult to sway one of them to sneak your shuttle through security.

You and the stealth ship bombard the surface of the planet with your powerful weapons systems. Your overwhelming force destroys the production facility before they even realize what is happening. The loss of this facility is likely to be noticed before too long, but you're still able to recover some salvage from the wreckage.
"You can't help, huh? Well, that's a shame. We'll bide our time, then." The stealth ship returns to its hiding spot.

name: COALITION_FACILITY_DESTROYED
text: The commander of the stealth ship seems satisfied. "We've accomplished our objective. Now all that's left is to get home; we have a lot of intel about Coalition production operations to give to our superiors. We'll shadow you, cloaked, from one jump behind until we get out of this awful place. Best of luck on your mission."

name: COALITION_FACILITY_SABOTAGE_AFTERMATH
text: "Fantastic job. We'll gather intel from the virus. In sabotaging this facility, they will unknowingly produce defective ships; that ought to throw them for a loop. We'll remain here. Once they figure it out, we'll exploit the vulnerabilities you left behind and finish this place off." They give you a small scrap reward for making their job much easier.

name: COALITION_VAMP_DIPLOMAT
text: While this beacon provides a break from the oppressive nebula in this sector, you remain on high alert for the Coalition's scouts. However, an unexpected guest arrives shortly after you - a Vampweed ship, with its weapons powered down and comms open.

event.text: The Vampweed that answers your hail seems irritated at your presence, but maintains a calm tone as he begins to address you. "Greetings, Federation vessel. Our charts didn't show you as controlling any space near here. Is there anything you need?"

choice.text: Ask what they're doing in Coalition space.

event.text: "Coalition? Ah, that'd explain why we haven't seen a fuel station nearby. Well then, if we shouldn't be here, you certainly shouldn't. Why don't you get out of here, and we'll follow your trail out of this sector?"

"Ah, much obliged, captain. Please, do take the lead, we'll be right behind you." As you spool up the FTL drive, you don't detect any signs that the ship is following you, but you don't have any choice but to trust that they will as you prepare to jump.

choice.text: That's not an answer - press further.

event.text: "Not enough? Fine, that's about what I expected. This is a diplomatic vessel of the Confederacy, on orders to open a line of contact with the Coalition to provide food aid to several planets under quarantine in their jurisdiction. Now, I understand your Federation has their issues with the Coalition, so how about we make this easy? You get some scrap to help you forget that we're here, and some defenseless civilians get the supplies they need. Why let politics get in the way of helping people?"

choice.text: What planets? Where in the sector?

event.text: "Oh, there are several scattered all around the sector. Dreadful business. Our contact has their locations, but I don't think you'd want to stick around and meet them. Now, about that offer?"

"Damn it, you Feds sure are insistent. I'm sorry captain, I know you mean well, but this mission is more important than one Federation ship." The Vampweed cuts the call, and you can see their weapons coming online!
You aren't sure if the Vampweed is lying, but you aren't taking any chances in hostile space. You begin to charge your weapons, and their ship does the same.
You aren't sure if the Vampweed is lying, but you aren't taking any chances in hostile space. You begin to charge your weapons, and their ship does the same.

choice.text: (Mind Control) Demand to know what they're doing there.

event.text: "We were ordered to come to this sector in order to receive a data slate from a Coalition liaison. They said they'd meet us on the edge of the nebula, but we ran into you first."

choice.text: Press him further - who sent them?

event.text: "No clue, but the authorization codes on the order checked out. Would have to have been sent by the premier, or one of his cabinet members. This is all classified though... why am I telling you this, again?" As the Vampweed processes his situation, you can see panic begin to spread across his face, and he seems too stunned to speak further.

The Vampweed on the viewscreen grumbles at your demands, but eventually relents and jettisons a cargo container from their storage. Satisfied, you order your crew to collect the container while you prepare for the next jump.

choice.text: Attack them before they can flee.

event.text: The Coalition doesn't need any more allies against the Federation, and hopefully a messenger going missing will encourage the Confederacy not to push the matter further. You charge weapons and prepare to engage.

choice.text: Leave before they realize they've been controlled.

event.text: You aren't sure how long it'll take for the Vampweed pilot to notice that he's been controlled, but apparently, they haven't figured it out by the time your FTL drive is charged. On to the next mystery.

choice.text: (Ivar) Demand to know what they're doing here.

event.text: "Hrm, funny. I think I would recall if I had ordered a vessel to enter Coalition space. Care to explain what you're doing in this sector?" The Vampweed on the screen cringes in fear, but forces himself to attention as he begins to speak. "Secret diplomatic mission, direct orders from your cabinet. We were told to come to this sector and meet with a Coalition liaison to pick up a data slate. Beyond that, we weren't told much... we aren't in trouble, are we?"
"Of course, of course. Anything for our beloved premier. And if this mission could stay off of our service record, I think we'd all thank you."
"Of course, of course. Anything for our beloved premier. And I don't see any downsides to leaving this ship before punishments are handed down..."

choice.text: Ask them to delay the Rebels.

event.text: "Of course, of course. Anything for our beloved premier. Of course, by doing this, I hope we can expect this awful incident scrubbed from our records..."

choice.text: (Ty E'Rel) Ask what they're doing here.

event.text: At the sight of Ty E'Rel, the Vampweed captain seems stunned into silence, and the ambassador begins to speak. "You came all the way out into Coalition territory without any backup? You're either a fool, or under direct orders from someone who is. Would you care to tell me who sent you here?"

"Ambassador E'Rel, sir! We were ordered to collect a data slate from a Coalition liaison, under direct orders from... someone in the cabinet. Not sure who, but the authorization codes checked out. That said, this entire operation seems off to me. I'd trust you over some faceless cabinet stiff any day. Are you in need of any assistance?
"Of course, of course. I'll order one of my men to send over what we can muster, then we can try and get out of this system before the Coalition spots us. Safe travels, Ambassador."

"Well, I'm not sure I can just give away my crew to a Federation vessel. But at the same time, I don't think my second-in-command will raise too many objections if he receives a surprise promotion. I'll be over shortly, Ambassador."

choice.text: Ask them to delay the Rebels.

event.text: The captain stiffens a bit as the Ambassador delivers your request. "Ah, I see. Well, I can't promise we'll take them head-on, but we should be able to run them in circles for a bit. Safe travels, Ambassador."
You aren't on orders to interrogate every ship you come across. You politely say your goodbyes and prepare to jump.
Whatever their reson for being in this sector, they can't be good. You cut the call and order your crew to charge weapons, and the Vampweed ship responds in turn.
You aren't sure why this ship is here, and it doesn't matter to you. If it's on Coalition territory, it can't have good intentions.
You wait to see if the ship responds to your presence, but you don't detect any changes while you're waiting for the FTL drive to recharge.

name: COALITION_HACKER_INFO_BROKER
text: A Slug hacker ship arrives right after you. "Jussst who we were looking for, heh heh. We've got sssome premium quality information from around the sssector. We ssstrongly insssissst that you purchasssse sssome. I'll throw in a map for free on purchassse."

choice.text: Buy some information about visitors to the sector.

event.text: "You sssshould keep your eye out for a certain legendary Pirate. If you want to find out where he'ssss gone, look for a distressss beacon within the nebula with no ssship presssence. Glad to have your businessss."

"Sssomewhere in the nebula, there ssshould be a sssship resssponsssible for expanding Coalition territory. It'sss in the nebula, but they know how to masssk their presssence well. Make ssssure you can properly track it, asss it isss quite ssssslippery once sssspotted."
"The Coalition wassss right about you, Federation!" The hacker prepares to defend itself.
"You know what they sssay, Feddy. If you don't pay for the product, then you are the product!" They begin to warm up their engines... they might be planning on selling your whereabouts to the Rebels.

name: COALITION_ROCK_ENVOY
text: You nearly bump into a Theocracy ship as you drop out of FTL. "Hmph. What's the Federation doing here? Stirring up trouble, no doubt. No matter. We have no quarrel with you. This sector is infuriating enough as it is. I'm sure we don't want to be here any more than you do."

choice.text: Ask them why they're here if they'd rather not be.

event.text: "We represent the interests of Theocracy civilians. Honorable Chrysolosists are enslaved and swindled by soldiers in the Hive and civilians from the Kleptocracy." The Rock pauses and makes a small aside. "...The Leeches are fine though, we have no issue with them." He then clears his throat. "Anyway, as disgusting and unacceptable as this is, the Elders have not taken any action to liberate them. We made our demands, but the representatives we met with laughed in our faces."

choice.text: Is there any way we can help?

event.text: "You're... offering help? How is it that the enemies of the Theocracy care more about its civilians than their own allies?" The Rockman grunts. "Fine. You can help. Since dishonesty is the only thing these scum understand, here's how it will go down. We'll send you the location of the station where we met with the representative. You will rough up their station. Then we will come in and 'scare you off'. Deal?"

choice.text: Ignore their statements and attack them.

event.text: "Typical violent heathens! You were only here to shed blood."
"Go back to your home, Renegade. It's doubtless better than here."

name: COALITION_ROCK_ENVOY_QUEST

unvisitedTooltip.text: You promised a Rock envoy you'd harass a Coalition station.

text: The moment you arrive, the station immediately arms its weapons. The fight begins as soon as you arrive!

name: COALITION_FED_AUTO
text: You're shocked to see a Federation Auto-ship here. "This ship has been deployed by the Federation to provide relief to soldiers on the Coalition front. It's dangerous to go alone, take this."

event.text: "Best of luck Captain." The Auto-ship jumps away.

choice.text: (Upg. Hacking) Disable the Auto and download its data stores.

event.text: You power down the Auto-ship then download all of the data onboard. Seems it has already mapped most of this sector, which is very helpful for you!

choice.text: (Hacking Weapon) Disable the Auto and download its data stores.

event.text: You disable the Auto-ship then download all of the data onboard. Seems it has already mapped most of this sector, which is very helpful for you!

choice.text: Attack the ship, there must be more supplies on board.

event.text: "Treachery detected. Activating combat procedures."

name: COALITION_FED_AUTO_WIN
text: As you scrap the ship, you notice the cargo bay managed to survive the wreckage.

choice.text: (Elite Crew) Have your elite carefully open the door.

event.text: Your crew approaches the storage bay, taking note of a subtle explosive trap to deter pirates. Your crew disables the trap and enters.

name: COALITION_HEKTAR
text: As soon as you arrive, an ear-bleedingly loud advertisement blasts through your ship's stereo. "ATTENTION ALL SHOPPERS! HEKTAR INDUSTRIESSS ISSS PROUD TO ANNOUNCE THE ARRIVAL OF OUR NEW HEKTAR BRAND MILITARY SSSUPPLY DEPOTSSS, OPEN TO ALL COALITION SHIPSSS (or anyone elssse willing to give usss money) SSSO COME IN AND SSSSHOP SSSSHOP SSSSHOP! I DEMAND IT OF YOU!"

event.text: "Ah, another brainlesss idi- er... no way, no that'sss right. Another brainlessss idiot who'll give usss their money! Welcome to Hektar Indussstriesss! If you like what you sssee here, conssssider visssiting the Hektar Mega-Market ssssome time in the future!"

"AHAHAHAHAHAHHAHAHAH! HAH! AHAH! Hah... oh boy. An employee dissscount? Are you ssstupid? Hektar doesssn't give employee dissscountsss, it gives employee markupsss! How dare you try and sssteal money from me, you leech!"

choice.text: (Billy) Request a Hektar(tm) brand supply package.

event.text: It only takes a few minutes before Billy returns, and soon after a Hektar package is deposited in your hold. Guess it pays to have the CEO of a major corporation aboard your ship.
Hektar, for as good as their products might be, is a villainous corporation. If they're selling to the Coalition now, then it's your duty to shut them down.
"Hey! Where do you think you're going? I sssaid I DEMAND you come in and sssshop! Damn it, you WILL SSSHOP OR DIE!"

name: COALITION_REBEL_STRANDED
text: A Rebel ship is stuck at this beacon, with noticeable damage to their engines. They make no attempt to attack you, too heavily damaged to take the risk.

event.text: "God damn it, not the Feds. What the hell do you want? If you're going to kill us, make it quick."

The Rebel captain chuckles weakly. "Yeah, right. Well if you're telling the truth, we could use some help with repairs, or some scrap. Took a pretty bad shot from the Coalition guard, and we leaked the fuel all the way here."

The Rebel captain growls, expecting the cargo to be trapped. But when nothing explodes and he's certain theres no infectious murder-bugs inside, he reluctantly thanks you and promises to delay the fleet when he returns to them.

choice.text: Take some time to repair their engines.

event.text: It takes a while, but you're able to patch up the damage. The Rebel captain is surprised at your willingness to help. "Maybe I misjudged you... don't think this changes anything, but it's only right that you are paid for your efforts."

choice.text: (Repair Burst) Use your Repair Bomb to repair their engines. [-1}]

event.text: With but a single missile, your weapon is able to instantaneously repair the damage. The Rebel captain is surprised at your willingness to help. "Maybe I misjudged you... don't think this changes anything, but it's only right that you are paid for your efforts."

choice.text: (MFK Ace Crew) Pretend to be a Rebel ship to leech supplies.

event.text: You explain the importance of your mission to "stop the Federation" and quickly snap to a salute. To your surprise, the Rebel captain salutes back. "For the glory and for the Rebellion!" Seems their loyalty to the Rebellion is undying even in a desperate situation, though their intelligence is questionable.

choice.text: (Engineer Crew) Pretend to be a Rebel ship to leech supplies.

event.text: You explain the importance of your mission to "stop the Federation" and quickly snap to a salute. To your surprise, the Rebel captain salutes back. "For the glory and for the Rebellion!" Seems their loyalty to the Rebellion is undying even in a desperate situation, though their intelligence is questionable.

You pass over the "scrap" to the Rebels. They pry open the crate to see a ticking bomb that lights their ship ablaze. The captain rushes back to the bridge, coughing. "Ok, you win. Take this garbage and leave us alone."
You take the supplies from them and prepare to leave.
"Yeah, not surprised. Get lost."
With no engines to run away, the Rebel ship is forced to fight you completely stationary.
With no engines to run away, the Rebel ship is forced to fight you completely stationary.
You don't have time to mess with the Rebels too in this dangerous sector. You fly away, and as expected the Rebel ship is powerless to follow.

name: COALITION_FREEMANTIS_SLAVES
text: Seeing a Free Mantis ship in Coalition space isn't the only unexpected thing at this beacon. It appears the ship has also managed to take a Coalition ship hostage. "Hello friend! Great day today! We have wide selection of crew for you to pick. Taken from fresh Coalition kill!"

event.text: The Free Mantis transfer over the Slug slave.
The Free Mantis transfer over the Mantis slave.
The Free Mantis transfer over the Rockman slave.
The Free Mantis transfer over the Leech slave.
"Oh! Federation so kind, so forgiving. You are true hero!" You thank the Free Mantis and leave.

name: NEBULA_LIGHT_COALITION_MANTIS_UNREST
text: There seems to be some commotion going on at a nearby Coalition settlement. The planet is broadcasting a message.

choice.text: Tune in to the radio chatter.

event.text: The display shows that several Mantises are holding Slugs and Leeches hostage. A Mantis civilian is angrily ranting, "This planet once proud Hive world! Mantis enjoying warm glow of sun! Now, evil cloud blocks sunshine! Demand nebula destroy!" As this broadcast is happening, the planet-side Slugs and Theocracy law enforcement are exchanging communication about how to break in and rescue the hostages.

Using your ship's combat systems, you bring ruin to the entire settlement, and the planet is unable to defend itself. Coalition or not, the inhabitants were mostly civilians. You harvest the remains of the city.
No need to interrupt the enemy when they are squabbling amongst themselves.

name: NEBULA_COALITION_CACHE
text: A Leech ship is at this beacon, FTL fully charged. They're broadcasting on an open channel. "Alright you guys, you didn't get your package in time, so we're just gonna leave it here." The Leech's voice quiets to an annoyed mumble. "I hate cache duty." The Leech waits a few more moments before jumping off, leaving the cache behind.

event.text: The cache is locked, and it also seems quite sturdy. However, a person familiar with Leeches or the Coalition might know the trick to opening it.
Your crew is familiar enough with the Coalition to know how to open the cache. After verifying their biology and with some quick fiddling, the cache opens.
Tony smiles. "This technology is out of date. I should know, we sell the damn things in bulk." The cache verifies his biology and pops open.
Alkram nods, opening it with ease, bypassing even the security measures he probably doesn't have to. "We steal these all the time. It's always useful to appropriate your enemy's supplies."
By the time your attacks deal enough damage that the cache opens, whatever's inside is reduced to a melted lump of scrap. Better than nothing.
The Leech cache will likely be found by its intended target, if it's not destroyed by the Rebels.

name: NEBULA_COALITION_ROCK_FAKING_DEATH
text: A message seemingly of Theocracy origin is broadcast towards your ship. However, it seems to come from a lone Rock. "At last, an outsider. I am tired of the Theocracy... tired of Chrysolisism, and now I've become tired of the Coalition as well. But still, if I were to defect, I worry that my family would see punishment... so I beg of you - please, help me fake my death." You receive a set of coordinates. "I'm transmitting the location of my encampment. I can get a shuttle. You're going to have to figure out the rest."

choice.text: (Hacking) Falsify logs relating to his death. [-1|]

event.text: You send a hacking probe into the encampment's record log to falsify a shuttle crash, and change his records to be listed as KIA, with the location data set to several sectors away. After his shuttle is out of the encampment's sight, you welcome the outcast aboard, then scrap his shuttle for what little it's worth.

choice.text: (Clone Bay) Who said anything about "faking" your death?

event.text: You invite the Rockman onto your ship. He cocks his head and asks how you intend to fake his death. As your clone bay registers the new passenger, you have him unceremoniously kicked back out of the airlock to smash into the ground below. Moments later, he stumbles out of your clone bay looking very upset. Still, at least the Coalition won't doubt that he's dead.

choice.text: (Ion Weapon) Disable his engines before he clears the planet.

event.text: You fire upon his shuttle. It is ripped it apart just after it clears the atmosphere, leaving the wreck in high orbit. On the plus side, the Coalition troops will technically believe the defecting Rock to be dead. Unfortunately for him, they will be correct. Either way, his shuttle has a modicum of scrap for you to harvest.

choice.text: Pretend to not receive the message.

event.text: You ignore the signal, and there are no further messages from the Rockman.

name: NEBULA_LIGHT_COALITION_AMPERE_TRAINING
text: A structure of Leech origin is (poorly) hidden on a planet within this part of the nebula. From afar, it appears to be a training facility. The Coalition is known to have developed a method to turn Leeches to Amperes, and this facility is likely to be related.

event.text: You fire from orbit to no avail, as your weapons hardly make a dent.

choice.text: (Ampere Crew) Have your Ampere infiltrate the center.
(Leech Crew) Have your Leech pose as a trainee.

event.text: Alkram manages to pass himself off as one of the Amperes. With a finesse typical of a revolutionary such as himself, he sneaks into the reactor, sabotages it, and leaves. Moments later, the facility starts glowing and shaking before going out in an explosion. Alkram returns with a shuttle, carrying a few things he managed to steal - a weapon and some resources. "Let's get out of here while they try to figure out what's happening."

Tyrdeo hails the training center. "Hello. President Tyrdeo stopping by. I'm gonna have to ask one of you Amperes to accompany me - top secret business. Preferably one of you that doesn't mind occasional contact with people outside of the Coalition." One of the Amperes jumps at the chance to leave Coalition space.

choice.text: (Tony Sr.) Offer an Ampere a small commission to work for you.

event.text: Tony chuckles and calls the center. He launches into salesman mode, clearly giddy at an opportunity to make a deal. "Hey, are you tired of being stuck here? I can offer you a chance to see worlds beyond, and also fight those slimy Rebels. Any takers?" One of the Amperes jumps at the opportunity.
Given that it's hidden, you are confident they will not pose a threat as you remain at the beacon.
You engage the Coalition ship.

choice.text: (Flares) Use the flares to make a distraction so the Civilian ship can escape.

event.text: The Coalition ship notices the flares and redirects its weapons towards them. Even though it quickly realizes it's a trick, the Civilian ship has already flown far away.
You quickly fly away. Soon, the signals coming from the civilians are replaced by the flash of an explosion from their ship.

name: COALITION_JAILER
text: You catch sight of a Coalition Jailer resting nearby. Knowing the Coalition, the ship's prisoners likely consist of mainly Federation officers.

event.text: You power up your weapons and engage the Coalition vessel.

Your crew, armed to the teeth, board the Jailer and quickly take down the Coalition crew staffing it. With the jailers turned prisoners, you free everyone locked up who you don't think will kill you immediately.
You aren't in the mood to hole a jailbreak today. You distance yourself from the Jailer.

name: COALITION_JAILER_DESTROY
text: The Jailer has been destroyed. While an excess of scrap remains, it's very unlikely any prisoners survived.

name: COALITION_JAILER_KILL
text: The crew of the Jailer has been emptied. You scrap the externals of the ship.

name: COALITION_CONSTRUCTION_YARD
text: A large Coalition construction yard has been established nearby. It doesn't seem to boast any particularly large ships, but there's a few ships still under construction scattered around.

choice.text: Attempt to access the unconstructed ships.

event.text: As expected, the Coalition isn't going to just let you steal from them without a fight. One of their military vessels is deployed to stop you!

choice.text: (MFK Ace Crew) Attack the construction yard while pretending to be a Rebel.

event.text: You open fire on the construction yard, as the Coalition enforcers engage. You make it pretty clear you're a "Rebel", shouting xenophobic insults alongside your crew member and plenty of hearty 'Glory to the Rebellion!'. You're pretty sure the Coalition gets the message, and they probably won't be so welcoming to the Rebel fleet once it passes by either.

choice.text: (Flares) Launch the flares to distract the Coalition guards.

event.text: Messing with a Coalition construction yard isn't on your agenda for the day, and frankly you'd rather it stay that way.

name: COALITION_LOSTSUN_CHOICE
text: This beacon holds an unusual sight. A rare Lost Sun ship is dueling with a Coalition vessel. Neither seem to notice you.

event.text: You power up your weapons and engage the Coalition vessel.
You power up your weapons and engage the Lost Sun vessel.

choice.text: [Federation Database] What do these two have against each other?

event.text: This is a fight you don't want to get involved in. You leave them to their fighting.

name: COALITION_LOSTSUN_CHOICE_COALITION
text: The Coalition ship has been neutralized. You scrap what remains.

event.text: "While Admiral Obadann might be more occupied with the Theocracy, there was a promise made in our alliance. The Federation, while reluctantly, has held their end of the bargain, and so I intend to uphold ours. Perhaps my strength may be of further benefit aboard your vessel."

name: COALITION_LOSTSUN_CHOICE_LOSTSUN
text: The Lost Sun ship has been neutralized. You scrap what remains.

event.text: The Slug captain of the Coalition vessel responds. "The hell issss wrong with you? Aren't you sssuppossssed to be alliesss with them? The Federation really isss full of backssstabbing traitorouss sssscum! Heh. That'sss pretty rad. Here, take sssome crap or whatever."

name: COALITION_SLUG_PEACEFUL
text: This ship here may not be a Coalition ship, but it's still a Slug! However, they still haven't attacked. "What, ssssuprisssed we aren't itching to fight you? In casssse you didn't know, not every Sssslug likesss thievery and vengeance. We're just here to watch and ssspectate thingsss unfold."

event.text: "Great. We come here to esscape from the Kleptocracy ssshithole and inssstead we run into an angry Renegade freak in the middle of Coalition ssspace. What the hell, man."
"Sssure, a deal can be made... It would be cussstomary to charge for thessse, but I'll be nice..."
You ignore the peaceful Slug ship and do something onboard.
You engage the Coalition ship.
You quickly fly away. Soon, the signals coming from the civilians are replaced by the flash of an explosion from their ship.

name: NEBULA_COALITION_COOL_SLUG
text: "Ssssup." You jump and turn around to see a Slug wearing sunglasses "sitting" in a folding chair.

name: NEBULA_COALITION_SQUABBLING
text:
You catch a conversation between the crew of the nearby elite Coalition ship.
		
"Told you idiot, this place bad idea go to!"

"Oh ssssshut up, there'sssss nothing wrong with nebulasssss!"

"The weapons need calibrating! BAH! Quit all of your whining and get someone to help me."

"You guys argue more than pops and his three girlfriends! I can't believe this is worse than back home..."

choice.text: Tune in: Nebulas are great for hiding.

event.text: The Slug chuckles. "Hah, thessse guyssss get it! You guysss sssssuck, I'm chilling with the Fedsss now! Later, lossssers."

choice.text: Tune in: Nebulas are horribly annoying.

event.text: The Mantis roars in triumph. "Yes! Someone understand me! I feel so validated! I prove loyalty to new friends by killing old sucky friends!"

choice.text: Tune in: Sounds like a pointless argument that could be solved with lots of guns.

event.text: The Rockman bellows in laughter. "Hahahahahah! I could not agree more. All these idiots want is stealth this, stealth that, but they won't let me just install 30 missile launchers on this thing and blast everyone to oblivion! Maybe you guys will let me pursue my dreams!"

choice.text: Tune in: For a supposedly mighty military force, you all seem awfully uncoordinated.

event.text: The Leech snickers. "Yeah, what the Federation ship said! You guys are no fun, you get your kicks from blowing up civvies! Take that stick out of your assholes and go roll in some mud or something. I'm outta here!"
You distance yourself from the arguing Coalition ship.

name: NEBULA_COALITION_HARVESTING
text: While the Coalition ship at this beacon is no surprise, the fact that it is trying to harvest the nebula gasses is! You've never seen a ship try to do this before, but maybe you can steal some from them?

event.text: You engage the Coalition ship.
You watch the curious process a little longer before moving deeper into the nebula to hide.

name: DEAD_CREW_COALITION_NEBULA_HARVEST
text: After salvaging the externals of the ship, you find several tubes of the gas scattered around the inside, which you collect. You can probably sell these at a store for a lot of scrap.

name: NEBULA_COALITION_SUZERAIN_CHOICE
text:
A Suzerain ship is patrolling this nebula. You catch some chatter between their crew.
		
	"You know, I prefer this place before nebula."
	
	"Yes, agree. Nebulas annoying. How long before Slug bits are attached to ship and we see again?"

event.text: You raise your weapons and attack the Suzerain ship.
The Suzerain ship doesn't notice you as you fly away.

name: DISTRESS_COALITION_PIRATE_FEAR
text: This beacon has a very rare sight. The source of this distress beacon is coming from the pirate ship here! A hyperventilating pirate captain hails you. "Oh god, I'm so sick of this sector. You gotta help us man, no one should be subjected to this torment! I came here to blow up some Civilians and rob some colonies, not have my right hand man sliced in half by a Mantis and my engineer zapped to death by stinky worms!"

event.text: You have no sympathy for the pirates. You raise your weapons and attack.
You hand over the supplies to the pirates.
The pirates are shocked that you were willing to help them. They gift you a weapon that they "borrowed" from a previous victim.

name: DISTRESS_COALITION_TRAP_BEACON
text: "I knew a fool like you would stumble into this trap!" Your Life Support immediately shuts off, suggesting the Coalition ship here is wielding a combat augment against you!

event.text: Your Oxygen system is restored to full power.

name: DISTRESS_COALITION_FED
text: The source of the distress beacon is a Federation ship, running away from its Coalition pursuer.

event.text: You engage the Coalition ship.
You fly away from the ships, trying not to think of the inevitable fate of the Federation ship.

name: NEBULA_DISTRESS_COALITION_SPILL
text: Something is off about the nebula in this beacon. A ways off from your entry is a Coalition ship with its engines disabled emitting a distress signal. Upon your entrance, however, they close their hailing channels.

choice.text: (Upg. Sensors) Find out what's wrong with the nebula.

event.text: Your sensors may not function in the nebula, but they're just functional enough to give you a reading of the nebula itself.

choice.text: (Long-Ranged Scanners) Find out what's wrong with the nebula.

event.text: Your scanners quickly determine the problem with the nebula.
The Coalition ship arms weapons, but doesn't activate their engines.
You leave the Coalition behind. No need to risk a confrontation under strange circumstances.

name: COALITION_SPILL_SCAN
text: Your ship tells you that the nebula is flammable - there must have been a large fuel spill from the Coalition ship. If you have the right kind of weapon, you might be able to cause a chain reaction.

choice.text: (Fire Weapon) Use a fire weapon to ignite the flammable part of the nebula.

event.text: You throw your engines in reverse and fire your weapon at the ship from afar- in a huge explosion, the enemy ship is badly damaged! They turn their ship to attack yours in retaliation!

choice.text: (Ballistic Fire Weapon) Detonate a fire explosive to ignite the flammable part of the nebula.

event.text: You throw your engines in reverse and fire your weapon at the ship from afar- in a huge explosion, the enemy ship is badly damaged! They turn their ship to attack yours in retaliation!
The Coalition ship arms weapons, but doesn't activate their engines.
You leave the Coalition behind. No need to risk a confrontation under strange circumstances.

name: POST_FUEL_SPILL_DETONATION
text: Unfortunately, the detonation seems to have spent some of the fuel.

choice.text: (Fuel Conserver) Reprocess the nebula for some extra fuel.

name: POST_FUEL_SPILL
text: After defeating the enemy ship, you turn your attention to the flammable nebula around the wreckage. You're able to harvest it for a sizable fuel yield.

name: NEBULA_DISTRESS_COALITION_SENTINEL
text:
It looks like a skirmish is already happening at this beacon. A Crystal Sentinel is fending off multiple Coalition vessels.
       
A Rockman on the lead ship warns you, "Stay out of this if you want to live, Renegade."

event.text: You attack the elite Coalition vessel. "You just sealed your fate, Federation scum!"
The smaller ship directs its energy at you. "Crap, the Renegade issss getting involved!"
You leave the scene behind, hoping that they do not notice you.

name: DEFEAT_COALITION_ELITE_CRYSTALS_SAVED
text: The R.U.E.S. ship has been vanquished by your superior might. The Coalition vessel leaves behind quite the bounty of wealth.

event.text: The Crystal ship has managed to vanquish their own foe. They contact you. "You saved us. We overextended ourselves trying to rescue an SSLG operation that spiraled out of control. For saving us, we can provide you with one of our weapons."

name: COALITION_SHELL_WORN
text: A worn down Militant Shell vessel hails you. "Who are you and what do you want?"

event.text: "Hmphhh! We'll see about thhhhat. We were escorting our scientists, and thhhhey caught us by surprise. Thhhhe scientists are probably still alive... but we shouldn't return home empty handed. If you're really friendly, prove it. Here's thhhheir last known location."

After a short pause, they reply. "Fine thhhhen, Mannan will join you."
						
"What, because I said I liked thhhe Federation?"
						
"No, because you screwed up withhh that 'shortcut'."
"This is thhhhe worst sector. We should never come here again."
"Good enoughhh." The Shells promptly hang up.

name: SCIENTISTS_ABDUCTED_QUEST

unvisitedTooltip.text: Some Shell scientists have been captured by a Coalition ship.

text: The Coalition ship immediately turns towards you. Without hesitation, they attack!

name: ABDUCTED_SCIENTISTS_RETRIEVED
text: The prisoners are more than happy to be freed from the clutches of the Coalition, but still seem apprehensive.

choice.text: Signal to the escort that the rescue mission was a success.

event.text: The escort jumps in. "You have done what we could not! We'll reward you as much as we can." As you transfer the Scientists aboard the escort's ship, you overhear them complaining about their "idiot captor's" requests.

choice.text: (Shell Crew) Convince the Shells you would make a better escort.

event.text: Your Shell tells the scientists about your exploits and assures them that they will be safe aboard your ship. One of the scientists seems to immediately agree that your ship is better than their old escort.
After thinking for a moment, the other scientist decides to join you too.

choice.text: Convince the Shells that their escort has died.

name: ENCOUNTER_COALITION_ASTEROID
text: The nearby Coalition's Rock soldier appears on the vid-screen, noticeably upset. "Bro, why you in my rock patch? Bro, you don't know how hard it was to convince the Coalition to let me have this... bro. Not cool."

name: ENCOUNTER_COALITION_PULSAR
text: The Pulsar isn't the only obstacle this beacon has. A Coalition ship wastes no time to attack.

name: COALITION_CHECKPOINT
text: A looping message plays over the stereo. "This beacon is a security checkpoint. Submit to processing. If you have nothing to hide, you have nothing to fear." You can hear a Rockman chuckling as the track ends. There's no way they'll let you pass as a Federation ship.

event.text: You prepare to fight the checkpoint.
The Coalition station stands no chance at detecting you with your superior cloaking. You slip past completely unnoticed.
With the station completely immobile, you easily speed past them.

name: ENCOUNTER_MANTIS_COALITION
text: An eager Mantis contacts you. "Yes! This is chance to prove myself! Your blood is path to leading glorious Coalition ship of own!"

name: ENCOUNTER_LEECH_COALITION
text: A Leech revolutionary flies past. "Are you even aware of what the Coalition has done to Eargen space? The Federation has done nothing to prevent this chaos! Nothing! It's all YOUR fault! GAAAH! Like, specifically yours. Don't ask me why, just accept your responsibility and die!"

name: NEBULA_COALITION_ABDUCTOR
text: A Coalition Abductor is hiding in this beacon. They hail you ominously: "Choose your death, travelers. Betrayal by one of your crew, or destruction at our hands?"

event.text: "An interesting choice. Enjoy!" One of your crew buckles over, completely mad. They charge you, turned hostile by the Abductor's mind control. The ship quickly slips away into the nebula.
"So you wish to taste the bitter end at the end of our guns? What a great choice!"
"Ah yes yes, you are a skilled negotiator. Silly of me to think such tricks would work on you. Heheh..."
"Ah yes yes, you are a skilled negotiator. Silly of me to think such tricks would work on you. Heheh..."
"Ah yes yes, you are a skilled negotiator. Silly of me to think such tricks would work on you. Heheh..."

name: NEBULA_COALITION_CHECKPOINT
text: A looping message plays over the stereo. "This beacon is a security checkpoint. Submit to processing. If you have nothing to hide, you have nothing to fear." You can hear a Rockman chuckling as the track ends. There's no way they'll let you pass as a Federation ship.

event.text: You prepare to fight the checkpoint.
The Coalition station stands no chance at detecting you with your superior cloaking. You slip past completely unnoticed.
With the station completely immobile, you easily speed past them.

name: NEBULA_ENCOUNTER_COALITION_ELITE
text: A sinister ship that could easily blend in the nebula catches your attention - it's one of the Coalition's elite fighters! They clearly aren't happy about your presence, and you figure you should waste no time to ready your offensive prowess.

name: NEBULA_KAZ_START
text: The distress beacon is what brought you here, but this isn't an ordinary scene in front of you. A Slug town, seemingly once under Coalition occupation, has been completely wasted. An ominous scent of rotting bodies drifts through the stale and smokey air. Whatever or whoever did this did it quite clearly out of spite. The Coalition is no friend of yours either, but who would do this?

event.text: At first you assume the red smears on the wall are blood, but the Slug inhabitants of this colony would only have bled green. Settling that it's paint, you notice the marking of a claw and a cutlass, painted large and boastfully on the side of the town-hall, which is now less of a hall and more a single wall and some rubble. It's strangely familiar, but you can't remember where you've seen it...

You continue to look through the wastes until you come across a lone survivor. A young Slug, missing one of his eyestalks, is elated to see you. Or at least, as elated as the sole survivor of a genocidal rampage could be. "You- you have to help. The Mantissss, they did thisss... a pirate, but with the banner of the Hive. Pleassse, don't leave me here..."

choice.text: Take the Slug with you and follow the pirate.

event.text: With the coordinates marked on your map, you help the Slug onto your ship and get ready to search for the culprit of this attack.

choice.text: Leave the Slug and this mystery.

event.text: You help the Slug stand up, but apologize and explain you cannot hang around. At the very least, you can offer solace that the chances of the pirate returning are minimal.
Searching for the culprit of this massacre will only put you closer to danger. The only safe course of action is to stay clear of this place.

name: KAZ_QUEST

unvisitedTooltip.text: Location of the genocidal pirate.

visitedTooltip.text: Explored location. Nothing left of interest.

text: Looks like you've found the right location, because the ship in front of you is most certainly a pirate. Just... a very well equipped one.

choice.text: We do not want to mess with this ship.

event.text: Messing with the culprit of this massacre will only put you closer to danger. The only safe course of action is to stay clear of this encounter.

name: KAZ_HAIL
text: As soon as the Mantis appears on the screen, the memories come flooding back. This is no ordinary pirate - this is Kazaaakplethkilik. Perhaps the most infamous warrior in the galaxy, if not the Multiverse. The only question is, why is Kazaaakplethkilik here so deep in Coalition space? It seems you're about to find out...

event.text: A muscular Mantis in red armor flexes his sharp appendages in front of the camera. "You are not of Coalition, but you carry boldness to approach me. It would seem neither of us meant to be here... What is Federation ship doing in Coalition space? It has been longest time since I have drawn arms against your people."

choice.text: We could ask the same about you.

event.text: "Clever words, but you should know it is foolish not to answer question of Mantis captain. I am here doing what YOU could not. Prized though dear Leikonpliiinakra is to me, she has made grave mistake in forming this 'Coalition'. It is dishonorable, and I can see that it not meant to last. Federation sees it too, but they will not act. They would rather allow Coalition to collapse on itself than take action. You use precious bureaucracy as a shield of responsibility rather than taking action to prevent galactic-scale destruction!"

choice.text: So to solve this you're massacring entire towns?

event.text: "I taking action where no one else would! All filth who live in these lands are far from innocent. They allow Coalition to exist, and so they are no better than the Federation or the Coalition. You are pointing finger but I do not see you taking action. You know not honor. I will show you what warrior of virtues fights like!" It's not impossible you could convince him to stand down, but that means you'll have to fight him like a 'warrior of virtue'. Try not to damage his hull too much, and neutralize enough of his crew that he surrenders.
"Yes, yes. Leave like the cowards you all are. You know what I say is true, and you have not even heart to refute it. I spit in faces of men and women like you."

name: KAZ_SURRENDER
text: The crew of the mighty warrior Kazaaakplethkilik has been reduced to a sliver of its former size. The wounded warrior still continues to fight on, but you can tell his heart isn't in it anymore. Perhaps this is the time to show him your honor.

event.text: "You... you letting me live? I... I do not understand. Is this some Federation trick? You have chance to strike me down, avenge men and women I killed during the war, yet you would let me live?"

choice.text: The Federation-Mantis War was in the past. Neither side was free from blame.

event.text: "Oh do not giving me history lesson. I live through it, I know how things go. Still, so you spare old Mantis. What of Coalition?"

choice.text: The Coalition is a problem, but the Rebellion is a bigger threat.

event.text: "Hmmm, Rebellion. You know, I fight Vance once, long ago. Much slimmer then, but human not fare well after months of concentration camps. Perhaps... perhaps you are right. The Hive and I's approach, while more direct, could be to blame for this Rebellion. Perhaps if we had been more patient and trusting of humanity, Vance never would have turned to genocide."

"You have teaching me, Federation captain. Or at least, I think. Perhaps I have lessons yet to learn, as I'm sure you do as well. But now that my crew has been slaughtered and I am without purpose, maybe it's time I repent for my mistakes. I have no need for this ship of mine any longer. Perhaps it will service you better."
"Asking one more favor of you, captain, if you are not minding. I wish to return to Hive, speak with queen. I am giving you coordinates now, in case we are not finding it on journeys."

name: NEBULA_COALITIONHOLD_CEALAFORMER_1
text: The nebula at this beacon is very thick. Too thick, in fact. You can just barely make out part of a ship slipping through the nebula. You're being followed.

event.text: The ship that comes out of the nebula is no ship you've ever seen or heard of before. Despite being armed as well as any other military ship, the ship hastily moves to escape as soon as you discover its presence!

name: NEBULA_COALITIONHOLD_CEALAFORMER_2
text: The ship's speedy retreat has left you very confused.

choice.text: (Upg. Sensors) Lock onto their jump signature and follow them.

event.text: Luckily, you're able to pick up their jump signature. You enter their new co-ordinates into your database.

choice.text: (Slug Crew) Have your Slug track their ship.

event.text: Luckily, your Slug is able to detect their jump signature. You enter their new co-ordinates into your database.

choice.text: (Telepathic Shell) Have your Shell track their ship.

event.text: Luckily, your Shell is able to detect their jump signature. You enter their new co-ordinates into your database.
Luckily, you're able to pick up their jump signature. You enter their new co-ordinates into your database.
Luckily, you're able to pick up their jump signature. You enter their new co-ordinates into your database.
You're sure there was something significant about this encounter, but it's too late now.

name: COALITIONHOLD_CEALAFORMER_3

unvisitedTooltip.text: Location of the strange vessel.

visitedTooltip.text: Explored location. Nothing left of interest.

text: You've tracked down the strange ship - but your destination isn't quite what you expected. In the middle of an ion storm, you find a rogue planet submerged entirely in darkness except for a glowing spire and fields of tesla coils drawing power from the storm. A warning appears on your screen; "Warning: you are approaching a restricted zone. Only authorized Coalition personnel may enter."

event.text: As you move closer to the spire, you're stopped by an approaching ship - the same as you saw earlier! Now that you have time to scan it properly, it seems it's using tech similar to the cealaforming stations deployed by the Kleptocracy - except mobile! This must be where the artificial nebulas in this sector came from! To figure out the mystery behind the giant structure in the distance, you'll have to take care of this ship first.
This must be some kind of secret Coalition facility - far too risky to even consider approaching armed the way you are.

name: COALITIONHOLD_CEALAFORMER_4
text: It seems most of the lower levels of the structure were already evacuated... or maybe never even populated at all. The whole place is strangely empty.

event.text: You push forward, exploring empty hallway after empty hallway, barren room after barren room. Laboratories filled with shelves that are empty, even hangars with nothing but a few scattered trollies. There's no signs of a struggle nor any bodies, so you can only make one assumption. This place was built in preparation of something, some plan that hasn't yet come to fruition. But what could it be?

choice.text: There must be something here - keep looking!

event.text: You do another once-over of the facility, searching for any clues. It takes some time, but eventually you come across a secret compartment that leads deeper underground. The security systems look unfinished, so the Coalition must have been relying on the secrecy of this location as protection for the time being.

The secret room reveals itself to be some kind of meeting room. 4 ornate chairs encircle a large holotable - one for the leader of all 4 factions within the Coalition. A door behind the table leads into a huge cathedral-like space. There's so many things to look through, but first you head over to the most obvious. An unfinished frame and blueprints for a prototype Coalition cruiser - something to compete with the Federation and Rebellion's own advanced warships. You make scans of the blueprints then set fire to them. This should set the Coalition back a bit, though they probably have copies.

choice.text: Take a look at the rest of the room.

event.text: The rest of the room is filled with ruins of some ancient technology made from Aether, similar to that of the vessel the first Multiverse drive was reverse engineered from. On the table are papers with partial translations of the alien hieroglyphics, detailing strange and worrying descriptions of "doomsday bombs", "reality altering monoliths", and a drawing of a cubical robot with a single eye. You heard the Coalition recovered some precursor tech during the Aquarian invasions, but you had no idea their research was this in-depth. You don't have time to bring all of this back to the ship, but you grab one of the seemingly functional weapons to bring with you.
You don't have time to keep digging through everything in this facility. You've already found vital information to assist the Federation - that's good enough.

choice.text: We can only hope that, whatever it is, it never comes to be.

event.text: Assuming you live, you'll have to bring this up to your superiors at the Federation. For now though, you must carry on with your mission.

escape.text: "Madness, madness! My legacy does not end here, dying to a Fed with no honor. You are not taking my life today, captain!"

gotaway.text: Kazaaak jumps away, a rare display of cowardice by a Mantis, but apparently you were so unworthy he did not even consider you worthy enough an opponent to die to.

destroyed.text: The once proud and esteemed Mantis warrior has fallen. And for what? His message was not a lie, but without him to tell it, no one else will.

deadCrew.text: The once proud and esteemed Mantis warrior has fallen. And for what? His message was not a lie, but without him to tell it, no one else will.

destroyed.text: The Cealaformer has been eliminated. You scrap the remains.

deadCrew.text: The Cealaformer has been eliminated. You scrap the remains.

name: VAMPWEED_SLAVES
text: "It ain't easy finding work nowadays! The moral fiber of the galactic work force has decayed! People don't want to work anymore. They don't show up, they're constantly demanding better pay while their productivity diminishes, it's a real pandemic! Wouldn't you agree?!" The slaver stares at you, waiting for your response.

event.name: VAMPWEED_SLAVES_2
event.text: Before you can even finish your sentence, the slaver cuts you off. "And THAT is why I'm excited to announce our brand new "loyal workers" program! Paid and provided for by Tiiikaka." The slaver flashes a grin and has his crew step out to peddle various 'workers'.
Slavers are the scum of the galaxy. You'll be doing great justice by wiping this one out.
"A great purchase. May they serve you well, captain..."
"A great purchase. May they serve you well, captain..."

choice.text: (Vampweed Crew) "We do not need your 'workers'. The Confederacy is strong thanks to the hardwork of us greenbloods."

event.text: "Ah, gross vine thing! I often forget your kind can even speak! Isn't it adorable, you sound like you'll grow up to be quite the little fascist some day!" The slaver pretends to pat your Orchid on the head. "Here you go little guy, have some scrap for all your hard work in the sweatshop."

choice.text: Ignore the slaver and continue on your way.

event.text: You're not interested in slavers.

choice.text: I don't feel comfortable answering that.

name: VAMPWEED_GARDEN
text: An Orchid vessel is passing through when it stops as you jump in. With proficient sign language, they hail you. "Captain, greetings! We're on a special mission from the Gathering at the request of Ambassador Ty E'Rel. A disease has overcome one of the local Confederate Gardenworlds and we've been sent to cure it! A small problem though... uh... we have no idea what we're doing. I know, I know, it's our job but like, I just water the plants? Our chief botanist was already out so they sent us instead. By chance, do you have anything that could help us?"

event.text:
Ty E'Rel's poker face doesn't even flinch as he dresses down the Gathering delegation. "I am very disappointed in your performance. You did not leave with everything you needed to complete the task as requested. I will fax you some documents that will outline some basic procedures, but if you are unable to carry out your duties, then you will return to the Gathering and not come back until you are properly equipped."
            
The Gathering Delegation sheepishly accept his documents and promise to do better. "Um, we were given this Spore Launcher. Please be gentle in your performance review."

choice.text: Take this opportunity to attack them!

event.text: "Gah! Not another one!" The caretakers arm their weapons and ready to defend themselves.
Disappointed, the Orchids nod and prepare to carry on - unprepared.

name: VAMPWEED_SCRAPYARD
text: A large scrapyard has been assembled nearby, littered with the scraps from factory rejects. A few Vampweed ships are guarding it, but considering no one else seems to be using it, maybe they'll let you in?

event.text: The Vampweeds shake their vines, urging you not to go in. "Trust me, you don't want to go in there! The scrapyard is haunted by a ghoul that steals people's likenesses! And it speaks in riddles!"

choice.text: There's a Vagabond in the scrapyard? We can take care of it.

event.text: "No, it's not a Vagabond! This is something supernatural! If I was a greenleaf I'd say it's a being from the afterlife, but this I think is just your ordinary demon. If you want to take the risk we won't stop you, but be warned!" Not deterred, you decide to explore the scrapyard yourself and assess the situation.

As your crew traverse the scrapyard in search of supplies and maybe a ghoul, you hear strange noises. "Pakooj! Makoo makoo tipple lajook!" A small grey blob jumps out from behind a scrap pile, taking on the form of one of your crew! The creature seems docile and despite your cautious movements follows you with childlike curiosity. Maybe you could bring this thing back with you? It could take a bit of time and effort...
The little blob makes itself at home on your ship once you manage to convince it to follow you back. As you prepare to leave, you notify the Vampweeds the situation's been taken care of.

choice.text: Ignore the blob and just bring back some scrap instead.

event.text: Although intrigued by the blob, you don't have time to go recruiting every mysterious and possibly sentient creature you come across. On your way back you inform the Vampweeds they should look into finding out the origins of the creature in case it's important for something.

In response to OOJ's presence, the little Morph wiggles with excitement. Seems you've found another of OOJ's children to tag along. If you had to guess, this thing snuck its way here aboard a scientist vessel.

choice.text: (Shell Scientist) Your Shell knows what this is.

event.text: It seems this blob is a Morph, one of the Geniocracy Science District's most recent creations and also their biggest mistake. Your Shell seems to think this Morph must have snuck its way aboard a scientist vessel and traveled all the way here. Although the creatures went rogue, controlling them should fortunately not be too difficult for your crew.

choice.text: That does sound spooky! We'll leave.

event.text: No way are you going to mess with the supernatural.
You have no use for whatever might be in there.

name: VAMPWEED_TERRAFORMING
text: A collection of terraforming vessels gathered around a large Gathering outpost that has been constructed around the nearby planet. You see vessels of both Confederate and Gathering origin, a rare display of unity between the two.

event.text: The terraforming group looks highly busy, although one of the foremen humor your questions. "Provision 16 of the Kadahellian'ek Treaty instated what is known as the 'Joint Conservation Act'. To help improve relations while providing essential service, the Gathering and Confederacy have set aside each a pool of resources to help in the process of terraforming potential host planets for new garden worlds." The Vampweed scratches their chin, inspecting your vessel. "You're military, I figure at least based on your weapons. Think you could do us a favor? The Gathering was insistent we sent down some monks to 'bless the grounds' before the process began, but we haven't heard back from them since. Mind taking a look into it? It'll save us a lot of trouble."

choice.text: (Caretaker Crew) Offer to send your own monk down to bless the grounds.

event.text: "I appreciate your offer, but you must understand simply sending a new team down isn't an option. If something bad happened to the first group, it could be a nightmare for PR. We have to ensure their safety first and foremost."
You see no particular reason to get involved here and decide to leave.

name: VAMPWEED_INJECTION
text: A Shell research station hails you nearby. "So you're a Renegade, right? I've heard thhhe likes of you tend to collect a menagerie of varied species aboard your ships. I'm part of thhhhe Cultivator project, helping develop and harvest thhhe spores used to manufacture bothhh Spore Launchers and Shell neurotoxin systems. Would you mind if I injected some of your crew withhhh poisonous spores to see what happens? If you have anythhhhing REALLY exotic I'll pay you extra!"

choice.text: Even MORE scientists that will have to look elsewhere for test dummies.
Submit one of your crew to testing.

event.text: Having drawn straws as per tradition, one of your crew reluctantly heads off to the lab to have god-knows-what injected into their bloodstream for the sake of science. The Shells seem confident in their experiments, but you can't say you have the same certainty.
"Er... I'm not sure what to really do with thhhhhis thhhing. It is exotic thhhhough, so I'll give you thhhat. Alright, let's see..."
"Er... I'm not sure what to really do with thhhhhis thhhing. It is exotic thhhhough, so I'll give you thhhat. Alright, let's see..."
"Er... I'm not sure what to really do with thhhhhis thhhing. It is exotic thhhhough, so I'll give you thhhat. Alright, let's see..."
"Er... I'm not sure what to really do with thhhhhis thhhing. It is exotic thhhhough, so I'll give you thhhat. Alright, let's see..."
"Er... I'm not sure what to really do with thhhhhis thhhing. It is exotic thhhhough, so I'll give you thhhat. Alright, let's see..."
The Shell shakes his head in shame at your lack of scientific curiosity and hangs up.

name: VAMPWEED_RIOT
text: Noticing a nearby inhabited planet, you pull closer to inspect the city and instead find chaos has taken over the streets. A Zoltan peacekeeper vessel lays in the middle of the streets while crowds of rioting Vampweeds are rocking its hull back and forth and trying to tear off its armor to get inside. Shouts can be heard - "We are tired of the Federation getting involved in our lives! You are not welcome here, energy freak!", and "Your days are numbered, Federation! Ivar's tainted line will trouble us no more!"

choice.text: Ask the city officials what is happening.

event.text: "Oh thank the lucky stars, backup has arrived? A Zoltan merchant was traveling through here earlier, and their escort docked here briefly and according to a witness, got drunk and started hitting on some women. The bar got mad and chased them out of the streets, chanting what-not about the Federation. I don't give a damn about politics right now. This kind of chaos has been happening ever since someone in the Premier's cabinet started a conspiracy against the government to overthrow Ivar and join the Coalition. We've tried, but we can't restore order on our own - can you please help us?"

choice.text: Fire on the crowd to make them disperse.

event.text: You march out of the city office and into the streets, chanting alongside the Vampweeds. They're fairly confused as to who you are or why you're there, but they see you have weapons and are eager to let you in on the chaos. You get sucked into the moment, completely losing focus on what you're doing or why you're there. By the time you snap back to reality, the Zoltan is dead, your cargo is full of stolen scrap, and a rioter seems to have pledged themselves to your crew.
No way are you risking your mission by getting involved in a violent riot like that. You pull away from the planet.

name: VAMPWEED_FIRE
text: A few signs of industrial infrastructure dot the space around the beacon, guiding your eyesight towards what appears to be a Vampweed factory that's currently ablaze!

event.text:
You rush aboard the factory station, trying to survey the damage. However, most of the station seems perfectly fine. Despite obvious charring, the flames themselves have been extinguished in most of the important areas and the crew is huddled in one of the assembly rooms. One of the factory directors notices your presence. "Oh, Renegades. I... appreciate your hasty effort to save the day, but there was no need. All Confederate factories are by law required to have sufficient fire suppressant systems installed in case of emergencies like this. However, since you're here, we could use some help."
			
			The Vampweed pulls a small canteen full of some lightly intoxicating beverage and takes a few sips. "Fires like this don't usually happen by accident. Our equipment is top notch and our workers are trained well. Seems to me the only probable cause was some kind of Greenleaf communard, trying to destabilize the heart of the capitalist industry! Damn Florals despise our flourishing economy, they say the Gathering council is being pressured to revise their economic system now that the Confederacy has surpassed them. A Gathering ship was seen passing through here a few days ago. Do me a favor and track them down, and see to it that justice is served. I'll pay you handsomely."

choice.text: Agree to track down the Floral.

event.text: Like the Vampweed warned, after not too much exploring you find a Floral vessel. They're fairly startled to see you, and rapidly rush through some sequences of sign language. "Federation! I was not expecting this. You are friendly I hope?" Wasting no time, you ask them about the fire and they send back a few more messages. "The fire? Yes, it was a terrible tragedy. We were not there, but we did see it passing by. Would have helped, but their kind can be aggressive even when we're only trying to aid them..." Something about the way they used 'their kind' rubs you the wrong way, but is it enough to accuse them?

While you still aren't entirely certain if they're responsible, the evidence seems stacked against them. The Florals, while scared, don't protest against your aggression and instead prepare to defend themselves!

choice.text: Return to the Vampweeds and tell them the Florals aren't responsible.

event.text: You bid farewell to the Florals and return to the factory, with its fire now mostly extinguished. "They're not responsible? Seriously? I can't tell if you're just stupid or if you're a co-conspirator!" The Vampweed takes a deep breath in and puts away his canteen. "Sorry, I'm stressed out and I've been drinking a bit too much lately. I appreciate you trying to help us. The Federation can't be so bad if it's got people like you. I'm sure my men can find a way to help you."
"Fine then. I suppose it should be expected the Federation butcher would choose to side with the Gathering in the end. At least you TRIED to put out this fire..."

choice.text: We can't risk the mission, we shouldn't get involved.

event.text: You have no use for whatever might be in there.

name: VAMPWEED_FIRE_WIN
text: By the time you return to the factory most of the fire has been put out already. "I KNEW they were responsible. Kadahellian'ek was a mistake, we never should have tried to make peace with these filthy greenleaves! Thank you for your help. I'll see to it my men give you something for your trouble on your way out.

name: VAMPWEED_THEFT
text: Two vessels are trading near the beacon, one a Union ship and the other a Confederate. Not too long after the two vessels part ways with their new cargo in tow. You could chase after one of them and try to take their cargo, if you think you could kill their crew quickly enough.

event.text: You power up your weapons and fly after the Union vessel, hoping to seize its cargo.
You power up your weapons and fly after the Confederate vessel, hoping to seize its cargo.
You're not a pirate, and you're not going to go chasing down and robbing innocent civilians like this.

name: VAMPWEED_BADREBEL
text: The dark blue hull of a Rebel vessel straight out of Universe 1 is orbiting the area, patrolling for ships. In the background, it seems a Vampweed colony has just recently been torched to the ground.

event.text:
The captain catches sight of your vessel and immediately sends a hail. "My my, what do we have here? My lucky day, once again! Well, every day is lucky when you stand with the Rebellion! Admiring my handywork?" The Rebel moves his hand in the general direction of the burning colony. "Thing is, I was sent on an express mission by Van-1 to harass Federation allies in this reality, put the fear of humanity in them. Thing is... there's really not much a difference between the weeds, is there? Both are just pests you have to pluck from the garden, so the bigger stronger species can survive."
			
			Beneath the smug sneer you sense a bit of regret, desperately being hidden beneath a blanket of false bravado. "The Confederation is halfway between the Feds and the Coalition anyways. No matter what they choose, they're more of a problem than the Florals."

"Hmph! As if you're the moral authority on what's justified! You think the Federation's hands are any cleaner than ours? We're in total war. Anything goes, as long as it gets you to the end. You're a butcher for a bureaucracy built on the reluctant shoulder of tyrants, and I'm an agent for the glory of mankind. For Universe 1!"

Jerry shakes his head sadly. "Listen to what you're saying. These people have done nothing to you. Even if you have to follow orders, even if you must wage war... can't you at least spare respect for innocent civilians?"
			
			The Rebel's face grows pale. "I... Jerry? What's he doing here?" The Rebel swallows. "But... they aren't... they don't deserve..." One of the other Rebels pulls him away, and soon his first officer steps in. "I don't know if we fully agree with what you're saying. But the rest of us want to prove to you we can do better than this. The captain will spend the rest of his time in the brig. Please, I hope you will forgive us. And in return, we'll keep the fleet off your back."

"You truly sicken me. You who does not value life, but only dogma. Spreading your sickness far beyond your contaminated universe of origin."
						Mayeb's glare intensifies. She points at the Rebel on the screen.
						"Your kind connotes weeds as unwanted, spreading far outside their domain. Can't you understand that the acts you're committing destroy so much more than an Earth weed ever could?"
			
			The Rebel growls, but seems to digest what she is saying - he slows down as he tries to formulate a response. His response is stilted: "We humans... are only sticking together... making a world where we could prosper." He shakes his head. "A weed could never understand!" He terminates comms before Mayeb can respond. Conflict was inevitable.

Ty E'Rel straightens his posture and clears his throat. "Us 'weeds' as you call us have a much greater difference in genetic diversity than you humans. While we can interbreed, we are different subspecies. Yes, the Gathering and the Confederacy have conflicted with each other, but we are still able to cooperate. Can you say the same? You aren't even a different species than the humans in your Federation. That which would slaughter its own... would you really want such a plant in your garden?"
			
			The human seems stumped. "You..." After stuttering for a moment, he activates his ship's weapons. "Plants will always be lesser. You can't stomach what it takes to make your kind stronger!"

Ivar blinks, seemingly needing a moment to process his emotions about the colony that was destroyed. "You're right about one thing there, buddy." Ivar says. "The Orchids are more similar than many give us credit for. We won't always be at each other's throats. We'll learn from each other and better each other. Some day, I will petition for the Confederacy to join the Federation. The Rebellion will wish we had stayed neutral, and the Federation will be stronger than it has ever been!"
			
			"You stupid... bumbling plant! If the humans couldn't make the Federation strong, then no species can. The Federation will be your downfall!" The Rebel proceeds to approach you with hostile intent!

choice.text: (Floral Crew) "You slaughter my kind! You deserve swift retribution. May the tree of life have mercy on your soul."

event.text: "Hmph. Your advanced technology betrays the outdated customs of your species, plant! You will die amongst all your Federation friends, standing for nothing more than a Multiverse polluted by broken dreams and a false sense of unity." Even as he orders his crew to attack, you can sense the Rebel's heart isn't quite in it. Still, he carries out the orders anyways, meaning conflict is inevitable.

choice.text: (Vampweed Crew) "Uncivilized monsters! That colony posed no threat to you!"

event.text: "What you call uncivilized I call a day's work spreading the glory of the Rebellion. We are the future, and if you can't accept that, then history will forget you." Even as he orders his crew to attack, you can sense pain in the Rebel's heart from the words your Vampweed spoke. Still, he carries out the orders anyways, meaning conflict is inevitable.

choice.text: I literally do not care, please just stop talking.

event.text: The Rebel scowls at your insult but says nothing more. You expect conflict, but instead he just stays silent.

name: VAMPWEED_CAMPAIGN
text: From nearby, you receive a hail from a Shell science vessel. "Hey, you. I don't care who you are or why you're here, I need your help. You have guns, right? Well I need someone who knows how to fire thhhheir guns very, very precisely. Thhhhink thhhat describes you?"

event.text: "We have some friends, some Vamps, who've gotten thhhhemselves into some trouble. Namely, thhhey're convinced thhhat Ayr would be a better leader than Ivar, and thhhat thhhe Confederacy would really be better off in thhhhe Coalition. If thhhat were to... go thhhhrough... well it'd be thhhe end of our current scientific alliance. Thhhe Geniocracy is adamant on refusing all offers to join thhhe Coalition. We do thhhings our own way and pick our own allies. And also, we're not working withhh any damn Slugs. Could you do us a favor and... knock some sense into our friends? Make sure thhhey understand the gravity of thhhheir situation, if you catch my drift."

You navigate to the coordinates given to you by the Shells and lock onto the Vampweed vessel. Immediately, they begin shouting insults at you. "Butcher! Federation assassin! You're no better than a Rebel!" The stale, lifeless way in which they shout these cookie cutter phrases leads you to believe these aren't the brightest nor most inspired believers the Coalition has ever attracted.

choice.text: Attack them to force them into compliance!

event.text: The only way to convince these guys requires force. Just don't go too hard on them - the Shells don't want them dead.

choice.text: This isn't worth our time, leave.

event.text: The Shell grunts in annoyance and hangs up.
The other end goes silent and the call terminates immediately.

name: VAMPWEED_CAMPAIGN_SURRENDER
text: "You've beaten us, pig! We get it, the Federation has no moral limits to how far it will go to enforce supreme sovereignty over all people!"

choice.text: We're not here to harass you - your friends are concerned about you.

event.text:
"My friends hired a Renegade to almost kill me? I don't care the reason, that's just cold! These Shells sometimes, I swear." The Vampweed scratches their petals. "Well, I guess it's a taste of what life is like being with the Coalition. To be honest, I didn't even know Renegades had the self control to not kill everyone they see."
			
			The Vampweed sighs. "Fine, I guess I'll give up this Coalition business for now. Keyword is 'for now'. I will consider the alternatives and weigh which side is better."

"Good, you brought at least a little sense into thhhhem. Thhhhe Federation may not be my favorite assembly, but it suits thhhe interests of thhhe galaxy much better thhhan thhhe Coalition. Here, have thhhis as a reward."

name: VAMPWEED_ALKRAM
text: A Leech revolutionary flies past you at breakneck speeds, but suddenly stops and reverses. An out of breath and overweight Leech appears on your vidscreen. "Huff... huff... The brink of war is nigh! It is now that the consequences of our actions are more paramount than ever before! The damned fool Tyrdeo has put doom on the agenda of the Republic. But I shan't be witness to the end. I shall fight! Fight to save the Republic, fight to save the galaxy! I will right the wrongs before their motion cannot be undone."

choice.text: Why are you talking like a Phantom?

event.text: "Er... is it not working? I was told it would make me sound smarter. If it's not working I'll just stop, because it's really hurting my brain. As you may or may not already know, President Tyrdeo of the Eargen Republic is currently engaged in a civil war, and the Confederacy has taken the side of the revolutionaries. I was chosen by our leader, Alkram, to ensure relations stay positive. I was supposed to bring a gift to the embassy here... but uhm... I have no idea what to bring. The last two times a Leech presented a diplomatic gift to another head of state, it caused an all-out war. I don't really want to be the third."

choice.text: Come up with some random ideas.
Offer a gift of your own.

event.text: "Wow, really? This is so much! Thank you, Renegade. Maybe this mission won't be a failure after all. There's hope yet for the Republic."
Before they leave, the Leeches offer you a gift of gratitude, including a previous token candidate for the embassy.

choice.text: (Orchid Children) Offer some corpses as a gift.

event.text:
"................................."
						
					The Leech is silent for a few moments. "You insult our history? This is exactly how Tyrdeo began this war in the first place! You idiot, we will not tolerate such a flagrant jab at our history!"

choice.text: (Alkram) Alkram wishes to have a word.

event.text:
Alkram moves forward towards the comms, and as he gets closer the Leech on the other end withdraws slightly. He soon speaks up in a commanding tone.
					
					"It seems you misunderstood my assignment to you. No, I did not instruct you to bring a gift to the embassy. My instructions were for you to show the embassy the finest of what we can offer them, by which I meant our unshakeable prowess in combat. However, I suppose this scenario is better than unintentionally provoking yet another conflict. There is no shame to be found in seeking wisdom from others for such matters. Now, come with me, soldier, and we shall demonstrate our finest to the Confederacy, together!" Encouraged by such a strong speech, the other Leech joins your crew, bringing along a weapon they had in their storage.
"Shit!" The Leech hangs up and flies off again at high speeds.
Any revolutionary is a traitor to their nation. Furthermore - this is a chance for scrap! Arm the guns!

choice.text: Ignore the rambling Leech and leave.

event.text: You mute the Leech in the middle of his grand speech and fly away.

name: VAMPWEED_CARGO
text: A Confederate vessel is protecting a loading platform with various assortments of cargo. From the looks of it, it'll all be shipping out soon. If you want to take advantage of this, you'll have to act quickly. That is of course, if you're willing to risk losing the Confederacy's respect.

choice.text: Attack the ship to access the cargo!

event.text: You arm the weapons and engage the Vampweed ship.

choice.text: (Upg. Cloaking) Sneak up on the platform and steal the cargo stealthily.

event.text: What good is pilfering through any supplies you see if that gets you the ire of anyone you come in contact with? You're better than that.

name: DISTRESS_VAMPWEED_NOFUEL
