text: You're a bit surprised to find a Federation vessel nearby, the source of the distress beacon. They hail you almost immediately. "Good, a friendly face! We ran out of fuel on the way through this sector, and we're terrified of what will happen if a Coalition or a hostile Confederate fleet passes through. Could you spare any fuel?"

event.text: "Thanks so much! It's not a ton, but it may be just enough to get us to a store or even out of the sector!"
"Thanks so much! This should be just enough to get out of danger and maybe even to our destination!"
"Thanks so much! This should be more than enough to get to our destination!"
"Hey, wait, what are you doing?!" You mute the Federation captain and get prepared to fight.

The Federation captain nods, although clearly still terrified. "Okay... I understand. Good luck against the Flagship, captain. Even if we don't make it - it's all worth it as long as this reality is safe!"

name: DISTRESS_VAMPWEED_DELUSION
text: The distress beacon here is coming from a Confederate government building, which seems to have been taken hostage by a band of Vampweed radicals! An aging Vampweed carrying a rather large gun paces back and forth, spouting delusional ramblings about the Federation-Mantis war and how Premier Ivar has betrayed them all. From the sounds of it, it almost seems like he thinks the war is still on-going!

choice.text: Robots are not particularly known for their ability to defuse these situations in a diplomatic manner.
Try to send some crew in there to defuse the situation.
(Ty E'Rel) "I am the one who presided over those negotiations."

event.text: The Vampweed immediately aims his attention directly towards Ty E'Rel. He starts spewing vitriol about how the negotiations were handled, but Ty E'Rel is able to swiftly counter every one of his talking points, being both more sound of mind and also having direct knowledge of what he's talking about. The radical sputters trying to counter his arguments, and is thoroughly distracted as the law enforcements seize him. The Confederates are pleased that you brought the perfect person for the job.

choice.text: (Human Crew) Send in your human as a 'Federation Ambassador'.

event.text: Your human approaches the Vampweed cautiously, pretending to be a direct representative of the Federation. The Vampweed immediately buys it, and after a few painful minutes of deliberation you distract the terrorist enough for law enforcement to seize him. You're rewarded for your efforts.

choice.text: (Leech Crew) Send in your Leech as a 'fellow soldier'.

event.text: Your Leech cautiously approaches the Vampweed, pretending to believe the same delusions of the war. The Vampweed buys it immediately, and to your surprise offers to go with you! You're unsure about it, but your crew assures you his delusions are so deep he won't be of any concern.

choice.text: (Hive Mantis Crew) Send in your Mantis as a 'fellow soldier'.

event.text: Your Mantis cautiously approaches the Vampweed, pretending to believe the same delusions of the war. The Vampweed buys it immediately, and to your surprise offers to go with you! You're unsure about it, but your crew assures you his delusions are so deep he won't be of any concern.
There's nothing you can do here to ease the situation. It's best to just leave it alone.

name: DISTRESS_VAMPWEED_LOST
text:
Two Engi aboard the nearby vessel appear to be debating each other. "You are [reading] the map wrong. The Floral sector is he-he-he-here! This is Confederate space."

"I lack: understanding. I was informed that Orchids welcome all -peaceful- refugees. Are Confederates not: Orchids?"

event.text: After a few moments, the two Engi realize you're listening and panic. "You heard: nothing. Any suggestions this v-v-v-vessel is no longer in service of the Harmony = complete nonsense and is to be disregarded immediately."

choice.text: You both sound like Separatists. Are you lost?
(Harmony Crew) "Speech patterns match known Harmony vocals by only 30%. Evidence suggests: Separatist influence."

event.text: The two Separatists glance at each other then back at your Engi, then scramble to press the jump button. Their ship escapes before you can react.

choice.text: Just nod and leave them alone.

event.text: You have no reason to intrude on their business, and decide to carry on.

name: DISTRESS_VAMPWEED_LOST_HELP
text:
The two Engi whisper to each other before deciding you won't be a threat to them. "We were sent [by] the Harmony to calibrate a haywire Federation defense system in the adjacent sector. However, once we became d-d-d-disconnected from the Harmony... we decided we do not: wish to return."
   
The other Engi nods. "We were told that refuge for all lifeforms could be found in Orchid territory. On our w-w-way there... we got lost. This, I do not believe, is the -correct- sector. Maybe you can assist?"

event.text: You attempt to make up directions, but it's not very convincing. The Engi pay you sparsely in case your efforts were legitimate, but they aren't too grateful.

choice.text: (Separatist Crew) Offer directions to the nearest Separatist sector.

event.text: Both Engi are very grateful for your assistance and pay you handsomely. "Thank you. Because of your efforts - there is a chance we will av-av-avoid: recycling. Stay safe."

choice.text: (Floral Crew) Offer directions to the nearest Gathering sector.

event.text: Both Engi are very grateful for your assistance and pay you handsomely. "Thank you. Because of your efforts - there is a chance we will av-av-avoid: recycling. Stay safe."

choice.text: (Adv. Sensors) Offer directions to the nearest Gathering sector.

event.text: Both Engi are very grateful for your assistance and pay you handsomely. "Thank you. Because of your efforts - there is a chance we will av-av-avoid: recycling. Stay safe."

name: VAMPWEED_AUTO
text:
A Confederate factory is humming away with usual business, and you're about to pass it by when you notice a bulletin board has been posted outside with a job offer.
	
	It reads; "Looking for: Combat ready vessel willing to sabotage Rebels. If interested, speak to manager."

event.text: You reach out to the factory's manager, who's eager to explain the issue. "As you may or may not know, the Confederacy takes up the large majority of intergalactic manufacturing for drones and other automated equipment. Even Arcadia outsources to us, because we're just that efficient! Thing is, I was thinking it's about time we step up our game. Why stop at drones? Let's think bigger! I'm talking Auto-ships, baby! I just need to get my hands on a Rebel Auto-ship, and I don't feel like paying them for it. So, if you're willing, I can forward the co-ordinates of an automated Rebel hangar nearby. Just take out their security and we can do the rest. Deal?"
"Excellent! This is an unusual scenario but I don't mind paying you up-front - I trust you'll do the task since it suits both of our best interests well."
You don't have time for spare oddjobs. You ignore the bulletin and carry on.

name: VAMPWEED_AUTO_QUEST

unvisitedTooltip.text: A Vampweed has contracted you to secure an Auto-ship at a nearby Rebel hangar.

text: You've tracked down the coordinates of the Rebel hangar. A singular active Auto-ship is protecting the area.

event.text: "Hostile ship detected in protected zone. Activating deterrence mode."
You've changed your mind about completing the job.

name: VAMPWEED_AMBASSADOR
text: A Federation vessel lingers nearby, its systems still active but with clear signs something is wrong. The ship responds to no hails or any other form of communication, and drifts aimlessly through space.

choice.text: Board and see if anyone needs help.

event.text: While scrapping the ship, you find a choking Federation captain. You pull them out from under some collapsed debris, and once they've recovered they thank you. They inform you they were sent to escort a Federation ambassador on a diplomatic mission to the Confederacy when they were attacked by a Coalition vessel. The life signatures of the ambassador are still being tracked - you might still be able to save them!

You move in to scrap the hull, still wondering if the ship will react. It doesn't, and your salvage mission goes completely undisturbed. Maybe you could have done something to help, but now your cargo is lined with extra scrap.
You don't have time to go investigating every mysterious ship you stumble across, even if they're Federation.

name: VAMPWEED_AMBASSADOR_QUEST

unvisitedTooltip.text: Life signs of a Federation ambassador are tracked here.

text: Following the ambassador's life signatures has led you to a Coalition base. Activity seems to be as usual, save for even further increased security. They're refusing all hails.

choice.text: Engage the station and force them to give up the ambassador.

event.text: As far as you can tell, there's only two ways to get the ambassador out of this. One; force the Coalition to give up somehow, or two; get rid of all the security. Neither will be easy, so get ready to fight!
You've decided maybe engaging this Coalition station isn't the greatest idea.

name: ENCOUNTER_VAMPWEED_STATION
text: "Stop right there! This sector is a designated safe zone, non-Confederate military vessels are forbidden from entering this region!" You don't remember seeing such restrictions posted anywhere, but it seems you don't have time to argue. Get ready to fight!

name: ENCOUNTER_VAMPWEED_ELITE
text: "The Confederacy is not the stomping grounds of the Federation or its hitmen! Your presence here violates the basic rights of any person to enjoy peace and prosperity without the invasion of intrusive foreign governments!" A proud Cultivator, claiming to act in the goodwill of his people, raises his weapons and attacks your ship!

name: VAMPWEED_STORE_RESTAURANT
text: As you arrive, you're barraged with an oppressive array of advertisements surrounding a Vampweed store. The nearest billboard displays a popular diner chain attached to the station. As you check out the restaurant, you notice that there's two Vampweed ships docking, so the restaurant might be crowded.

event.text: You make your way inside. The restaurant is mostly full, with the crews of both ships taking up several booths. In the back is the smoking section, where you can see the ranking officers. They seem to be in the middle of talking about something.
Try as you might, you can't get close - every booth near them is full of Vampweeds. You might have to convince them to let you through.
You eat your Vampweed cuisine with your own crew, not mingling with the servicemen at all. It's tasty, but the meal is uneventful.

Ty E'Rel marches up to the table. "Good evening. Is there something we can help you with?"

"Ambassador E'Rel! We were just... Well, we're worried. The civilian offices are telling us to avoid Central Command, and we don't know why."

"...I think I know. We'll head over there at once."

"Just like that? ...Well, you don't have to go alone. We can lend you our finest officer."

Ivar plops himself next to the officers. Their reaction is immediate - they salute. "I-Ivar! To what do we owe the pleasure?"

"Something tells me you're worried, lads. What seems to be the problem?"

"Of course we're worried! The civilian offices are telling us to avoid Headquarters, and we don't know why."

"Oh, we can investigate, don't worry. Hopefully by the time we're through, everything will be okay."

"Just like that? ...Well, you don't have to go alone. We can lend you our finest officer."
You eat your Vampweed cuisine with your own crew, not mingling with the Vampweeds at all. It's tasty, but the meal is uneventful.
You focus on shopping, leaving you plenty of time on your ship.

name: DINE_WITH_VAMPWEEDS
text: The Vampweed crew eye you suspiciously. They don't seem keen to let you join them. "What do YOU want?"

event.text: "Ay! This Federation captain's buying drinks!" Upon ordering the alcohol, the Vampweeds immediately warm up to you. As your crews mingle, one of the Vampweeds even asks to join your crew.

choice.text: (Tuco) Intimidate the restaurant owner into giving a round to the crew.

event.text: Tuco slams the counter. "HEY! Don't you see the mood of this place? What are you running, a diner or a mausoleum? You'd best serve up every table a bottle of wine on the house or I'll crash my way back there and do it myself!" The manager trembles and directs the waitresses to acquiesce. A round of drinks is distributed throughout the diner, and the Vampweeds are more than happy to have you join them.  As your crews mingle, one of them even asks to join your crew.
You keep to yourself and the Vampweeds leave you alone.

name: DINER_EAVESDROP_VAMPWEEDS
text:
You carefully seat yourself near enough to the officers that you can hear them without crossing their line of sight. They seem apprehensive. By the time you catch up to them, they're tensely talking about something innocuous, before one of them eventually diverts back to the topic at hand.

"Are you absolutely sure...? Absolutely nothing?"

"I'm telling you, headquarters went completely radio silent. Met another patrol on the way, they haven't heard anything either."

"Maybe HQ's communications systems are down?"

"Doesn't explain why we can't reach any other ship in that area. And..." The officer's voice quiets down. "I wasn't supposed to mention this - I got orders from the civilian offices routing my patrols away from stars I almost always go through, including Sigma Reticulus."

"Sigma Reticulus... So you were ORDERED to stay away from the Headquarters? But the order didn't come from Headquarters itself? This doesn't sound good..."

"Maybe we should stop discussing this. I don't want to lose my commission for asking too many questions." An awkward silence falls over the officers.

choice.text: Jot down the star system they mentioned.

event.text: Your navigation system is able to locate the nearest beacon to that star, and presumably their headquarters.

name: VAMPWEED_SECURITY_CRUISER_QUEST

unvisitedTooltip.text: A Vampweed Security HQ went dark here.

text: A Coalition vessel hovers menacingly over the HQ, nearly side-by-side with a damaged Vampweed Cruiser drifting through orbit- all contrasted by the dead-silent security alarms planetside. The Coalition hails you. "I had a feeling you'd sssshow up, Renegade. Your kind hassss alwaysss sssstuck their nosssse where it doesssn't belong. The Confederacy will never be your ally! Their dessstiny is with the greatessst faction in the galaxy - the Coalition!" As they start attacking you, you notice that you've been boarded by some Cultivators!

name: VAMPWEED_SECURITY_RESCUE
text: Coalition elites are a formidable foe, especially with Vampweeds among their number. The Agency contacts you shortly after your victory, just as you start scrapping the Coalition ship.

event.text: The agency's director appears on your screen. "How fitting that we are saved by a Renegade after an attack by the Coalition! You have our eternal gratitude! I cannot think of a better way to repay you than by letting you take a look at the schematics of our Cruiser... well, you can see it adrift in our orbit, yes?"

choice.text: Why did we get boarded by Vampweeds?
Why did we get boarded by Vampweeds?

name: QUEST_OFFER_IVAR_PLUS_TYEREL
text: "We were compromised. The Confederacy is rife with Coalition sympathizers... but your arrival shifted the balance of power here back into our favor. We're not out of the woods yet, though... something terrible is about to happen. The Coalition would not have targeted us without a motive! We have reason to believe Premier Ivar, Secretary Ayr and Ambassador Ty E'Rel are in danger."

event.text: "What, you need a reason to save our head of state or something? Ivar's appointment is something of a point of contention. His parentage is... disputed. Let's just say there's probably a reason he's so buddy-buddy with the Gathering. He's not the most professional either. Stubborn. A clown, really. As for E'Rel, he's pretty much the exact opposite. A life-time of mediating between two Orchid cultures has made him entirely stone-faced, but he's very well respected. Ayr is in Ivar's cabinet. A very polite, organized man who worked for the previous Premier."
"I'm not sure what we will be able to do after the attack... but we will do what we can. I just hope a civil war doesn't break out because of our involvement..."
"I'm not sure what we will be able to do after the attack... but we will do what we can. I just hope a civil war doesn't break out because of our involvement..."

name: VAMPWEED_SECURITY_OFFER_ASSISTANCE
text: "I may have buried the lede somewhat. They're not in the same place - Ivar and Ayr should be at Ivar's party hall on Tar'eyl. Ivar is so open that without us keeping tabs on him, I fear for his safety. Ayr is at least quite cautious, so hopefully he is safe. Still, we're not getting any responses from our homeworld, so please make haste!"

event.text: "As for Ty E'Rel, we believe that the Coalition is lying in wait for him to leave the Confederacy. If it got out that they attacked him in our sector, it would negatively affect their reputation. They're probably biding their time until he leaves. Ty keeps in contact with us, so we should be able to send you directly to his transponder - I'm sure you can flush them out yourself."

event.name: VAMPWEED_SECURITY_REQUISITION
event.text: "One last thing. Our requisition officer wants to speak with you. One moment." The director steps back and is replaced with a strangely cheerful Vampweed. "'ello there! If you're 'eading over to the 'omeworld to 'elp us out, surely you'll be needin' some supplies! What'd'ya like?"
"'ere you are! Best of luck!"
"'ere you are! Best of luck!"
"Want a buddy, then? I know just the person for the job!"

name: QUEST_OFFER_IVAR_ONLY
text: "We were compromised. The Confederacy is rife with Coalition sympathizers... but your arrival shifted the balance of power here back into our favor. We're not out of the woods yet... something terrible is about to happen. The Coalition would not have targeted us without a motive! We have reason to believe Premier Ivar and Secretary Ayr are in danger."

event.text: "What, you need a reason to save our head of state or something? Ivar's appointment is something of a point of contention. His parentage is... disputed. Let's just say there's probably a reason he's so buddy-buddy with the Gathering. He's not the most professional either. Stubborn. Ayr is in Ivar's cabinet. A very polite, organized man who worked for the previous Premier."
"I'm not sure what we will be able to do after the attack... but we will do what we can. I just hope a civil war doesn't break out because of our involvement..."
"I'm not sure what we will be able to do after the attack... but we will do what we can. I just hope a civil war doesn't break out because of our involvement..."

name: VAMPWEED_SECURITY_OFFER_ASSISTANCE_IVAR_ONLY
text: "They should be at Ivar's party hall on Tar'eyl. He's so open that without us keeping tabs on him, I fear for his safety. Ayr is at least quite cautious, so hopefully he is safe. Still, we're not getting any responses from our homeworld, so please make haste!"

name: VAMPWEED_HOMEWORLD_QUEST

unvisitedTooltip.text: The Vampweeds have warned you their Premier is in danger.

text: You arrive at Tar'eyl, the Vampweed Homeworld, and birthplace of both Orchid subspecies. In orbit near Ivar's last known position is a Cultivator Cruiser. You receive a hail from the planet.

event.text: You receive a private call from the planet. When you answer, a Vampweed politician appears on your viewscreen, looking exceptionally smug. "Welcome to our homeland, Plan B. Your arrival has only ensured our victory."

Alkali glares at the politician. "I always thhhought of you to be thhhe treacherous type, Ayr. As usual, my intuition was well founded."

Ayr's smug expression is replaced with a poker face. "You scientists are all alike. Pretentious. You knew nothing substantial, don't act like you had any idea."

"You have thhhe nerve to call me pretentious, as you intimidate me withhhh a creation of my own design?" Alkali gestures to the Cultivator ship trained on you. "What reason would thhhey ever have to attack us?"

"A tragic incident. The Federation Renegade had taken the Premier's dear friend hostage." Ayr shakes his head. "Those barbarians tortured you before they killed you. We did our best."

choice.text: Alkali turns to his personal communicator.

event.text:
"Thhhis is thhhhe man who represents you?" You notice Alkali had been hailing the Cultivator ship surreptitiously. "Do you share his low opinion of your people's intellect? Ivar may be silly, but he would not lie to you like thhhis."

Ayr looks shaken momentarily. "They... They are loyal, they would never..." But there is a momentary explosion - some unrest occurs among their ranks. One of the Cultivators defects to your side! It looks like the remainder of them are resolved to fight you.

"Oh, forgive my rudeness. I am Secretary Ayr. I regret to inform you that your campaign of terror is at an end. For the crime of assassinating our current Premier, we will have to put you to death. The people will need justice, and I intend to give it to them."

"Oh, don't worry, my friend. My personal investigators will do all they can to uncover exactly what the public needs to hear. And, as I said earlier, you won't be alive to share your side of the story." The Cultivator cruiser begins to charge weapons. "Goodbye, Renegade."

choice.text: Why don't we just go, and we forget this ever happened?

event.text: "Why not, indeed? I've already gotten what I want out of this. What a shame that we weren't able to avenge poor, dumb Ivar." Ayr chuckles, and it seems you're free to go.

name: VAMPWEED_HOMEWORLD_AYR_DEFEAT
text: You've vanquished the Cultivator Cruiser. However, as you're in the midst of finishing the fight, you receive another communique from Ayr's office. "I underestimated you... but if you think this is the end of it, you're mistaken! I will not be defeated!" He presses some buttons on his desk. "I have no doubt this will be traced back to me, but I will deal with that later, even if it divides my people!"

event.text: Moments later, Ivar's dining hall bursts into flames! It seems that Ayr has somehow signaled a Hellfire drone to burn it down!

choice.text: (Fireproof Crew) Send in your crew to find Ivar.
(Repair Drone) Send a repair drone into the fire.
(Fire Extinguishers) Use your ship's fire suppression on the party hall.
We can't help. Scrap the ship while you can.

name: LOCATE_IVAR_QUICKLY_SCAN
text: You quickly locate the premier. As soon as you do, however, the party hall bursts into flames! It seems that Ayr has somehow signaled a Hellfire drone to burn the place down!

choice.text: (Teleporter) Lock on to Ivar and teleport him onto your ship.
(Fireproof Crew) Send in your crew to find Ivar.
(Repair Drone) Send a repair drone into the fire.
(Fire Extinguishers) Use your ship's fire suppression on the party hall.
Can't help. Scrap the ship while you can.

name: SAVE_IVAR_GARRISON
text: Alkali is one step ahead of you. As you turn to him, he is using his communicator. "No time to talk. Send thhhe entire garrison as well as a scientist into Ivar's party hall and rescue him." You hear a brief protest, but Alkali interrupts. "Thhhhe research and embassy can go undefended for an hour or so. Thhhhis is a direct order." Moments later, an entire garrison of Shell troops swoop in around the flaming building. They immediately start coordinating the effort to put out the fire and begin rescuing the occupants. Eventually, a Shell soldier comes out of the building, with a small group of Vampweeds behind him. Among the survivors is Ivar, leaning against his spear as a walking stick.

name: TELEPORT_IVAR
text: You're able to find Ivar's exact location within the building as it begins to burn. You have more than enough time to teleport him and all the other people trapped inside out of the building. Ivar looks around, then breathes a sigh of relief once he realizes what happened.

name: SEND_CREW_TO_IVAR_FIREPROOF
text: Your crew charges into the building without fear of fire. They put out whatever fires they can. It's tricky, but in doing so, a path is forged straight to the survivors. Your crew leads them outside. Ivar stumbles out of the building leaning against your crew member.

name: SAVE_IVAR_REPAIR_DRONE
text: Your drone crashes into the building through a window. It quickly puts out any fires it encounters and locates the survivors. You order your drone to lead the survivors to the exit, where your crew are unblocking the barricades. Ivar stumbles out of the building leaning against his spear as a walking stick.

name: SAVE_IVAR_FIRE_EXTINGUISHERS
text: You aim your ship's fire suppression externally in an attempt to put out the fire. The suppression system is quickly able to snuff out the majority of the flames. With your ship's intervention, the on-site fire response team is able to perform an evacuation. Ivar stumbles out of the building leaning against his spear as a walking stick.

name: SEND_CREW_TO_IVAR_NORMAL
text: Your crew tries to enter, but they can't make it in time. The hall burns out before you can offer any assistance. The Vampweeds on the scene recognize your attempt to help, but unfortunately they don't appear to be very eager to interact with you. It seems they managed to clean up most of the fight, leaving you a small fraction of what remained.

name: ABANDON_IVAR
text: There's nothing you can do but watch. It's clear that the doors have been barricaded from the outside, meaning anybody inside was trapped. You take what you can and get out.

name: IVAR_SAVED
text: Ivar gives you a big smile as he lays his eyes on you. "Well hello there, savior! I'm sure I don't have to introduce myself." He gestures to himself with the ceremonial spear he's holding. "But I'm Ivar! Oh, no need to use my title. I'm just happy to be here. Well, If you don't mind I would like to use your screen for one moment, I have some... things to say."

event.text:
Ivar makes a conference call to several figures in his cabinet. Ayr is there, and he does not look happy. Ivar folds his arms. "I couldn't help but notice that fire drone sent to burn down my dining hall. In fact, if I'm not mistaken, it looks like the signal was coming from the planet. Now, who do you think that could have been? Hm? Do you have something to say, Ayr?"

"We... we'll look into it..."

"'We'? No, I wouldn't want to burden you with this. In fact..." There is a knock on Ayr's door. "I think you're going to be very busy."
Ayr is taken away. Ivar talks for a minute or so with the rest of his cabinet, before calling a short recess. He turns back to you.

choice.text: Alkali wants to talk to his friend.

event.text:
Ivar's face is beaming. "Alkali, you cunning bastard, I should have known you'd swoop in like a hero! How have you been?"

Alkali looks happier than he usually seems. "Taking a sabbatical from my labwork to play space buccaneer, apparently. It must be Tuesday, because yet again I get to tell you 'I told you so'."

"What, you've never been stabbed in the back by a family-friend? Mr. High and Mighty Scientist Ball over here." The two have a laugh. Ivar turns to you. "Well now, as long as Alkali is on board, I wouldn't mind tagging along as well. What do you say?"

"Wonderful! After a career of getting backstabbed, a punch to the face will be very refreshing. Let me tidy up some business with my cabinet and I'll be ready to go. Oh, one more thing! I managed to secure you the right to salvage the ship the conspirators used against you. You can also have the blueprints, if you want."

choice.text: Scrap the ship as Ivar finishes his meeting.

event.text: "That's a shame. I was hoping to catch up with Alkali. You can hand me over to the CSA, and I'll be out of your hair. Oh, one more thing. I managed to secure you the right to salvage the ship the conspirators used against you. You can also have the blueprints, if you want."

"Hoo, meetings can be so stressful, huh? Always full of busywork and contention. I could use a break from it all. To think, the busybody in my cabinet wanted me dead. Politics is a little too spicy sometimes. You got room on that ship for me?"

"Wonderful! After a career of getting backstabbed, a punch to the face will be very refreshing. Let me tidy up some business with my cabinet and I'll be ready to go. Oh, one more thing! I managed to secure you the right to salvage the ship the conspirators used against you. You can also have the blueprints, if you want."

choice.text: Scrap the ship as Ivar finishes his meeting.

event.text: "That's a shame. Might have been nice to see some new faces. You can hand me over to the CSA, and I'll be out of your hair. Oh, one more thing. I managed to secure you the right to salvage the ship the conspirators used against you. You can also have the blueprints, if you want."

name: TYEREL_QUEST

unvisitedTooltip.text: The Orchid Ambassador is being shadowed.

text: Upon jumping in you notice Ty E'Rel's Ambassadorial Cruiser docked at a nearby spaceport. There's no immediate sign of the Coalition stalker.

event.text: His ship is deserted, but the call is rerouted and you're greeted by a visibly withered Orchid. Both of Ty E'Rel's heritages are identifiable, having notable traits from both the Florals and the Vampweeds. "Good day, Renegade. A Federation captain coming all this way to meet me? This must be important."

choice.text: Inform him about the potential attempt on his life.

event.text: "Unsurprising. I'll contact the station and see what they can find." Ty E'Rel types something into a terminal. The station lights up as its sensor array begins actively scanning the area, a probe launching from the station's bay. In response to this, a Coalition ship reveals itself and hails you.
With no Coalition plainly in sight, you decide not to bother.

name: TY_EREL_COALITION_HAIL
text: As you hail the Coalition Predator, you're greeted by the sight of a Mantis Bishop. "You have stuck your ugly nose where it doesn't belong, Renegade! The Hive has unfinished business with this meddlesome bureaucrat. This will be your one chance to escape death at our hands."

choice.text: Ask them why they hate Ty E'Rel.

event.text: "Pah, Renegades and their insipid curiosity." The Bishop hesitates, but then unloads into a furious rant. "The Hive was winning! When those simpering flowers joined the Federation, we thought it had no chance to affect the outcome of the war... That worthless shrub convinced the Confederacy to abandon us! We could win a hundred fights on the ground and never make up for the losses the Federation would inflict in a single space battle. Without their weapons, their shipyards, the Hive could never maintain a fleet to continue our conquest." The Bishop pounds the console viciously. He finishes with a cold remark. "His infestation must be burned from the galaxy, to send a message to all who would refuse an alliance with the Hive."

The Bishop aims a sharp appendage at you. "Had it not been for my queen, I would have killed him long ago. But she was convinced they would turn against us even more if we attacked their diplomats."
						
The Bishop spreads its appendages wide. "But the Coalition has shown her a new path... and now there is nothing holding us back!" The Coalition ship turns to face yours - it looks like a conflict is now inevitable! "You ask too many questions. You cannot be allowed to live!"
The Coalition ship is all too willing to engage in combat with you.
You decide not to mess with the Coalition, abandoning Ty E'Rel to his fate.
The Coalition ship is all too willing to engage in combat with you.
You decide not to mess with the Coalition, abandoning Ty E'Rel to his fate.

name: TY_EREL_RESCUE_CONFEDERACY
text: The Coalition Predator is vanquished. You get a message from Ty E'Rel as you scrap the Predator's remains.

event.text: The elderly plant appears on your viewscreen. He gives a very slight, gentle smile. "My compliments on the intervention. I was about to leave for a trip to the Gathering, which would surely be an opportune moment to strike. I would be more than happy to offer the schematics of my ship to the Federation."

name: TY_EREL_RECRUITMENT_CHOICE
text: "Hmm.... retirement, eventually. It never feels like the right time, what with the galaxy constantly trying to rip itself to pieces." He straightens his back stem, groaning. "I could help you out for a short time on the off chance you need an ambassador or just an experienced set of hands."

event.text: "I will report to your ship right away. Pleasure to make your acquaintance, Captain." Ty E'Rel walks onto your ship carrying stacks of books and documents.
"In that case, I will take my ship and head over to the Federation for the time being. Good travels."

name: FINISH_BEACON_DROPPOINT
text: You've reached the end of the first step of your journey. However, it appears you aren't alone. The Rebel fleet must have sent one of their fighters after you!

name: NEBULA_FINISH_BEACON_DROPPOINT
text: You've arrived at the Long-Range Beacon. When the FTL Drive is charged you can jump to the next Sector.

name: FINISH_BEACON_DROPPOINT_WIN
text: You've successfully defeated the Rebel ship. You now have some time to do something else on the ship.

name: FINISH_BEACON_DROPPOINT_WIN_FLEET
text: You've successfully defeated the Elite ship, but you don't have any time to do something else because of the fleet.

name: MV_STORE_RESCUE
text: Once you arrive at this populated region, you immediately pick up a distress signal. A small shuttle is asking anyone who'll listen for help protecting their family from a Rebel ship. Unsurprisingly, no one has yet responded to their request.

choice.text: See if you can assist them.

event.text: It seems that a small space dock has done something to anger the Rebels. The store there is run by his family and he pleads that you rescue them. He uploads the coordinates of the station to your navigation system.
You block the channel and prepare to jump as soon as possible.

name: MV_QUEST_STORE_RESCUE

unvisitedTooltip.text: A Rebel ship is harassing a space dock at these coordinates.

text: Once you arrive at the beacon you detect a Rebel scout assaulting a compound on a nearby desolate moon.

choice.text: Engage the Rebel and rescue the space dock.

event.text: You lock onto the Rebel and move in to engage.
After a time the ship powers down its weapons and jumps away. No life-signs are detected on the moon.
"Great. Take this bit of fuel as a down-payment. We'll be one step behind you, following your jump signatures. Don't want to take any risks now, do we?"
"We understand. Not everyone is confident they can survive in these hostile times, let alone take the responsibility of protecting others."
The civilians are shocked by your sudden hostility, but have no chance to escape.

name: MV_DISTRESS_TRAPPED_MINER
text: You arrive at the distress beacon near a small asteroid belt and find a ship with pirate markings partially crushed between two large rocks. It must have been illegally mining the belt without proper equipment.

choice.text: Try to dislodge the ship by shooting at the rocks.
Destroy and loot the ship. They're just pirates.
(Beam Weapon) Carefully cut the ship out.

event.text: You use your beam to make a few precision cuts in the asteroid. The ship gives a quick burst of thrust and the rock crumbles away. They thank you and offer some of the resources they have collected.

choice.text: (Damaging Pinpoint Weapon) Attempt to meticulously cut out the pirate ship.

event.text: With what is possibly the dumbest decision you have ever made, you take the increduously long time to chip away at the asteroid with your Pinpoint. You're certain the fleet has caught up by now and you've barely made any impact, giving you no choice but to abandon the pirate ship.

choice.text: (Beam Drone) Have your drone cut the ship out.

event.text: You program the drone to work carefully around the trapped ship. In a short time it allows the ship to easily slip out of its cage. They thank you and offer some of the resources they have collected.

name: MV_DISTRESS_CRASH_LANDING
text: You arrive at a lonely planet orbiting a dying star. A quick scan of the surface reveals a ship crash landed on the far side of the planet. It's in shambles, but there is a chance someone may have survived.

event.text: Even if someone did survive, there's not much you could do to help them.

name: MV_ASTEROID_EXPLORE
text: Scans reveal a large asteroid field nearby. Short-range scanners may discover useful materials while we wait for the FTL to recharge.

choice.text: Too dangerous. We'll just wait for the FTL to charge.

event.text: You decide to not risk exploring the asteroid field.

choice.text: (Scrap Recovery Arm) Attempt to mine the asteroids.

event.text: You carefully extract as much usable material as possible from the nearest asteroids while waiting for the FTL to charge.

choice.text: (Magnetic Arm) Attempt to mine the asteroids.

event.text: Your magnetic arm is not well suited to the task, but it is able to salvage a very small portion of space junk drifting around nearby.

choice.text: (Mining Equipment) Attempt to mine the asteroids.

event.text: You carefully extract as much usable material as possible from the nearest asteroids while waiting for the FTL to charge.

choice.text: (Beam Drone) Attempt to mine the asteroids. [-1|]

event.text: You carefully extract as much usable material as possible from the nearest asteroids while waiting for the FTL to charge.

name: MV_TAVERN_HIRE
text: It appears several mercenaries are competing for attention at a small inn, hoping to find work aboard a Multiverse vessel.

event.text: You ignore the crew.

name: MV_HELP_MINERS
text: You come across a mining operation around this beacon. "Hail, captain! We've been dispatched to harvest the ores from these asteroids to be used in development of a new experimental fuel source for Multiverse drives. However, we've run short on ammunition... perhaps you could lend us some?"

choice.text: (Explosive Replicator) Use the replicator to synthesize the missiles for them.
(Missile Weapon) Offer to blast through the mine with your Launcher.

event.text: "I don't think you quite understand. I understand your... enthusiasm... but it's not exactly 'union friendly' to use military ballistic weapons in mining operations. Perhaps it's best we don't make any trades..."

choice.text: (Bomb Weapon) Offer to solve their problem by using a controlled explosion from your bomb. [-1}]

event.text: "Curious. I did not consider the practicality of using a bomb for such matters. I suppose it should be safe enough. You have my permission."

choice.text: (Lost Sun Crew) Offer to teach them how to construct makeshift explosives.

event.text: Your commando, being both an experienced arsonist and knowledgeable in the ways of explosives, explains to the miners how the Lost Suns have been using "recycled" ammunition to save costs. Thoroughly impressed by this knowledge, the colony's leader grants you access to some of their latest spoils.
"I understand. Good luck out there. We'll try to make do with what we have."

name: MV_TERRAFORMING_SCAN
text: A small terraforming team working on a nearby moon hails you, and a short, stubby Rockman captain appears on the screen. "We require assistance, and you are the first ship we've seen in this system for weeks. We're in the middle of terraforming this barren moon, but our sensors aren't strong enough to break through the atmosphere."

event.text: "Thank you! We need to scan this planet for life before we can begin terraforming, but our sensors can't get the necessary power to scan through this atmosphere. We've got a schedule to keep, any chance you can help?"

choice.text: (Upg. Sensors) Set sensors to maximum and scan.
(Bonus Power Crew) Send your crewman to overcharge their systems.
(Osmian Crew) Generate a hologram to overcharge their systems.
(Shell Scientist) Have your Shell assist them.

event.text: "We understand. Best of luck on your mission, sir!"

choice.text: Go looking for the Rebel ship.
No time to search, you prepare to jump away.

event.text: You decide not to go hunting for Rebels.

choice.text: (Upg. Sensors) Perform a scan of the area.

event.text: You quickly find the Rebel ship's location and move to intercept.
You find the Rebel ship hiding on a nearby asteroid. You are able to get a shot off and permanently disable their engines before they notice you.

name: MV_REFUGEE_NO_DISTRESS
text: Your sensors have picked up a refugee ship drifting through the system, no doubt one of many fleeing the Rebel advance. It doesn't appear to have detected you... or else it is trying to avoid notice.

event.text: You decide to ignore the refugees.

name: DROPPOINT_SKETCHY_UPGRADES
text: You're surprised to find another Multiverse ship at this beacon, bearing markings of a pirate vessel.

event.text: The pirates hail you. "Ah, a fellow traveller! I'm sure we can both relate over the difficulty of upkeep with these MV drives, yes? Well, we've been running low on fuel and I'm sure you could use an upgrade, maybe we can trade?"
Surprisingly, the pirates do honor their deal, and your engines have gained in efficiency. This will be a welcome boost for the road ahead.

"Wait wait wait, before you do that. Look, do the math, right? It's only a handful of fuel, 3 scrap each, right? What I am offering is an upgrade for basically 9 scrap. Think about it! It's a great offer!"
Surprisingly, the pirates do honor their deal, and your engines have gained in efficiency. This will be a welcome boost for the road ahead.
"Wow, you must really be bad at math, or desperate for fuel. Your stupidity bodes well for me!"
"Your loss."

name: DROPPOINT_SLAVER
text: A slaver ship approaches, one of the Tiiikaka clan's distributers. In a bold display of characteristic pirate arrogance, the ship opens comms with you and offers several slaves.

choice.text: We can't let pirates waltz in Federation space. Take these guys down!

event.text: These pirates have gotten out of hand. Best you clean this reality up of their kind.
The pirate scoffs and cuts comms.

name: DROPPOINT_CACHE
text: An abandoned supply cache drifts through space nearby. It must have been lost during an attack. You aren't sure who it belongs to - but you could use it for a trap against the fleet, or try your luck with opening it.

event.text: As a wise man once said - when you can't be certain, just apply a very large amount of militry grade explosives and pray to the high heavens you don't go up in flames.

choice.text: Set a trap for the fleet.

event.text: This'll throw them off for a bit. Let's just hope no civilians or Feds get greedy and try to open it first.
You pull away from the cache and leave.

name: DROPPOINT_ORCHIDS
text: To your surprise, an Orchid ship is waiting for you here. Sure, they're a loyal part of the Federation, but the Florals typically prefer to keep to their own turf. What's this about?

event.text: An Orchid appears on screen, gesturing with their hands in native Orchid sign language, which your translator converts into actual audio. "Hello! You must be professor Orwell. We have reviewed the files you gave us and we are most excited to share our scientific findings with the board. We have left a few annotated questions for your review, and will send them over along with payment shortly!"

choice.text: Yes, that's me. I'm Orwell. Definitely.

event.text: "Wonderful!" The Orchids send over a series of annotated videos of what appears to be human adult films with extremely questionable titles, and some scrap.
"Oh. I am terribly sorry. Would you happen to know the location of the professor?"
The Orchid stares blanky at you. "I'm afraid I don't understand. Are you, as the humans call it, 'pulling my leg'? It would be appreciated if you did not mess with foreigners." The Orchids hang up.
"Understandable. I appreciate your straightforwardness. Good day!" The Orchid ship jumps away, but not before leaving you with a few fuel cells as a customary gift.
You're barely out the gate of your mission and you're already murdering random innocents. This really does not speak well to your motives.

choice.text: Ignore the Orchids and fly away.

event.text: You simply fly past the ship, and they make no attempt to follow you. Odd, but nothing for you to worry about now.

name: DROPPOINT_PIRATE_RAID
text: It appears this beacon is home to a Federation outpost... or at least it was, until a band of pirates came by and ravaged the place! There might be some supplies left behind if you can clear out the attackers.

event.text: Those supplies belong to the Federation, not these damn pirates! You prepare for combat.

choice.text: Ignore them, it's not worth the effort.

event.text: The pirates can help themselves to those supplies, they'll need everything they can get until the Rebel fleet catches up and destroys them.

name: DROPPOINT_PIRATE_RAID_WIN
text: You've defeated the pirates. Not eager to mess with you further, the rest of their clan scatter.

event.text: You skirt around the edge of the depot, looking for any remaining loot. Though the pirates took all of the weapons and armor, quite a few resources remain.

name: DROPPOINT_FORTIFICATIONS
text: Nearby are some Federation fortifications that have taken heavy damage. A couple workers are busy trying to patch up the damage.

choice.text: Hail and ask if they need any assistance.

event.text: "Any help you could offer would be a life saver. We only just barely managed to chase away those damn Rebels, and they'll no doubt be returning with reinforcements soon. We're undermanned and we won't be able to get these repairs done in time."

choice.text: Offer to wait behind longer and fight off the Rebels.

event.text: You wait behind until you spot a small squadron of Rebel ships approaching. Hurry to combat positions!

choice.text: Lend a crew member to stay and assist them.

event.text: Though it's only one man, the Federation officers seem to understand the weight of your decision and pay you greatly for your sacrifice.

removeCrew.text: Your crew cannot be cloned as they are not dead.

choice.text: You cannot lend any crew, as you don't have any to begin with.

event.text: You apologize and end comms.
The staff will hopefully be able to repair their defenses in time before the fleet arrives.

name: DROPPOINT_FORTIFICATIONS_GOTAWAY
text: The Rebel ships jump away once again, leaving you and the fortifications behind.

event.text: "Thank you for your help, but I am afraid this is very unfortunate that they got away. We know you can't wait behind any longer, and I don't think anyone else will arrive in time to assist us. Still, at least it buys us some time. We can't offer too much, but perhaps this fuel will help."

name: DROPPOINT_FORTIFICATIONS_WIN
text: It appears the rest of the Rebel squadron is trying to flee after watching their comrades be destroyed by you. The Federation officers thank you and offer payment.

name: DROPPOINT_PROTESTORS
text: Several Union civillian vessels have landed on a nearby moon around a Federation Multiverse warp-bay. You can see crowds gathering but you aren't sure why.

event.text: The civilians appear to be protesting, gathering in large groups and holding up signs. It appears the crowd is against the use of Multiverse travel, thinking it endangers their ways of life. The Federation soldiers hold their ground and try to fend off the civilians, but it appears the situation is getting heated.

choice.text: Attack one of the Union vessels.

event.text: You open fire on one of the Union vessels nearby.

choice.text: Send in a team of crew to assist.
The giant killing machine you are flying is not currently equipped to handle rioters with a non-lethal approach.

event.text: You pull away from the moon before you're spotted.
You have no interest in whatever is happening on the moon.

name: DROPPOINT_CRAZYZOLTAN
text: A blip on the communicator shows an incoming transmission from a Zoltan ship out of your field of view. When you pick up, you're greeted by the unwelcome sounds of a raving madman screeching about 'cowering beneath the prophet eye'. He demands a prayer and offering, or else suffer his wrath.

choice.text: (Monk Crew) Retaliate with even greater spiritual nonsense.

event.text: Both Zoltans launch into a long debate that gets so heated it eventually reaches a point not even your translator can comprehend the words they are saying. That's mostly because they aren't words, just primal screeching. Your monk returns and reports that the second Zoltan died during the argument, and implores you to not ask questions. You scrap his ship.

Your crew determines he has some kind of mind erosion, not uncommon for elderly Zoltan as their hard-light forms start to deteriorate. They manage to talk some sense into the Zoltan, and convince him to stand down while they take a look at his situation. They manage to patch him up, and in return he joins your crew.

Your drone determines he has some kind of mind erosion, not uncommon for elderly Zoltan as their hard-light forms start to deteriorate. They manage to talk some sense into the Zoltan, and convince him to stand down while they take a look at his situation. They manage to patch him up, and in return he joins your crew.
You've barely started your journey, and you don't intend to dedicate time to listen to the ramblings of a grumpy Zoltan elder.

name: DROPPOINT_FREEMANTIS
text: A Free Mantis greets you eagerly, their broken dialogue challenging the translator to keep up. "Oh Federation captain, I asking of you if you are worthy of my support! Yes, I having faith, but I must seeing proof. Fighting me, winning and I joining of crew. Just knowing be careful, I not taking mercies on you!"

event.text: "Then battle shall commencing!" You'll have to rough their hull up a bit to win. If you kill them all, there won't be anyone left to join your crew.
"You are most of borings." The Free Mantis don't seem all that offended despite their message, and wave goodbye as you pass.

name: DROPPOINT_BULKY_SMUGGLER
text: It's rare to see an Argeonn vessel with no weapons system, and this one is trying to stay away. "I didn't get into this business looking for a fight. If you'll excuse me, I have places to be."

choice.text: Attack the vessel to reclaim its possessions.

event.text: They may not be looking for a fight, but smugglers are not welcome in Federation space.

choice.text: Ask them if they need any help.

event.text: "Funny you should ask. There's a checkpoint at this beacon. If you could keep their eyes off of us, we'd be very grateful."

choice.text: (Elite Federation Crew) Clear the smuggler for passage.

event.text: Your crew explains to the checkpoint that your ship is escorting the smuggler vessel on its way to be decommissioned. Without a second thought, the checkpoint waves you past. "Connections really are a smuggler's best friend, huh? Thanks for the assist."

choice.text: (Mind Control) Convince the checkpoint to let them through.

event.text: Your crew explains to the checkpoint that your ship is escorting the smuggler vessel on its way to be decommissioned. As you finish explaining, you toggle on your mind control systems to wipe away whatever skepticism they might have had. The smuggler wastes no time getting through the checkpoint.

choice.text: (Mind Control Weapon) Convince the checkpoint to let them through.

event.text: Your crew explains to the checkpoint that your ship is escorting the smuggler vessel on its way to be decommissioned. As you finish explaining, you target them with your mind control weapon to wipe away whatever skepticism they might have had. The smuggler wastes no time getting through the checkpoint.

choice.text: (Mind Affecting Weapon) Distract the guard with infighting.

event.text: Your crew explains to the checkpoint that your ship is escorting the smuggler vessel on its way to be decommissioned. As they listen you abruptly hit them with your mind affecting weapon. Full of madness, they start to bicker and shout with each other over procedure, as the smuggler sneaks through. Once they regain their senses they look very cross with you, catching on that this was your fault somehow.
The hack goes off without a hitch. As the checkpoint guards wave you in, the smuggler passes through with you, undetected. "Thanks for the assist, that was going to be a real headache."

choice.text: Distract the checkpoint with idle chatter.

event.text: You drag the checkpoint into a long winded conversation. It's hard to keep their attention, as the smuggler seems to be taking their sweet time circumventing the security. By the time you're done with your distraction, it seems like they've caught on to what you're doing. You get the impression it's not wise for you to stick around much longer.
You're able to catch the Smuggler on the other end of the checkpoint, just out of range of the station. "Not exactly an artful solution, but a deal is a deal."

choice.text: Report the smuggler to the checkpoint.

event.text: After you identify the smuggler ship's location, it is surrounded by Federation ships, their crew escorted away. The checkpoint guard offers you some supplies for helping them locate the smuggler.

choice.text: Apologize and say there's nothing you can do.

event.text: You give the smuggler some space. It's not worth the trouble to get involved.

name: DISTRESS_DROPPOINT_ZOLTAN
text: A Zoltan ship hails you as you arrive. "You have to help us! Our energy shield hasn't been working properly ever since we came to this sector. It's acting like it doesn't have the power to start even though it does."

choice.text: (Energy Shield) Use your own shield to jumpstart theirs.

event.text: Their shield projector hums back to life. "All systems are nominal... Great! It should come back on once we jump. Thanks for the help."

choice.text: (Emergency Generator) Use the Emergency Generator to jumpstart it.

event.text: Their shield projector hums back to life. "All systems are nominal... Great! It should come back on once we jump. Thanks for the help."

choice.text: (Backup Battery) Use your battery subsystem to jumpstart it.

event.text: Their shield projector hums back to life. "All systems are nominal... Great! It should come back on once we jump. Thanks for the help."

choice.text: (Leech Crew) Your Leech will check what's wrong with the generator.

event.text: Your Leech seems doubtful that the generator is actually carrying current. Experimentally, your Leech begins to nibble on it. You hear a horrid electrical sound as they yelp out a warbling scream of pain. Moments later your Leech stumbles back onto your ship looking... different. The Zoltans don't seem impressed with your attempt to help.
You need all the scrap you can get, and this ship will be an easy target.

choice.text: Apologize and say you can't help.

event.text: The Zoltan sigh. "Send someone our way if you can."

name: DISTRESS_DROPPOINT_HAZARDOUS_FACILITY
text: A station at this beacon has alarms going off, and a distress call is out to save the civilians on board. However, when you arrive, there's already a Federation ship at the location, which hails you. "No worries, we have the situation under control. There was a hazardous chemical leak that proliferated into the station's life support. We have already evacuated this station; it looks like everyone's okay, but we have a civilian on board who wishes to make a request."

event.text: The civilian gets onto the comm. "Ah, hello. I'm a merchant who trades with this station. My ship is fortunately unharmed, but still docked - unfortunately, the toxins have contaminated everything, so I can't undock it myself. If you could steer my ship away and vent the atmosphere, it would likely be safe for me to use it again. It's not quite as contaminated as the station, but you probably won't survive if you aren't careful."

Your anaerobe happens to be able to resist the toxins - they quickly disengage the docking clamps from the vessel and pilot it away. Your crew then proceeds to flush all contaminants from the ship and reactivate life support to refill it with fresh oxygen.

choice.text: Return the ship to its owner.

event.text: Your Shell happens to be able to resist the toxins - they quickly disengage the docking clamps from the vessel and pilot it away. Your crew then proceeds to flush all contaminants from the ship and reactivate life support to refill it with fresh oxygen.

choice.text: Return the ship to its owner.

event.text: Your crew's hologram travels to the ship with no issue - they quickly disengage the docking clamps from the vessel and pilot it away. Your crew then proceeds to flush all contaminants from the ship and reactivate life support to refill it with fresh oxygen.

choice.text: Return the ship to its owner.

event.text: "Toxic chemical spills in an enclosed environment just sound like another day in the lab, shouldn't take more than a few minutes." Mafan soaks a rag in a dizzying array of chemicals, then covers their face with it and strolls into the contamination area. You almost begin preparations for their funeral, but soon see the merchant's ship detach from the station, airlock ajar - Mafan reboards your ship soon afterwards.

choice.text: Return the ship to its owner.

event.text: "Well, I suppose I should have asked that you refill the oxygen after you flushed it, but it's better than the state it was in. Here's your reward- I'd give you more, but the rest of my scrap is on my ship."

choice.text: (Respirators) Have a crewmember enter the ship.

event.text: Your crew pulls on a mask and enters the vessel, then detaches it from the station as fast as they can. They proceed to flush all the toxins from the ship and then reactivate life support to refill it with fresh oxygen.

choice.text: Return the ship to its owner.
(System Drone) Send a system-manning drone onto the ship.

event.text: Your system drone is more than capable of executing the commands you've programmed into it. It pilots the ship away from the station, flushes all toxins from the atmosphere, and then replenishes the oxygen using the life-support system.

choice.text: Return the ship to its owner.

event.text: The merchant gives a frustrated sigh as the Federation officer comes back onto the line. "We'll drop all the civilians off at the nearest settlement until the toxins clear away. Good luck on your mission!"
As monstrous as it is, you turn off the communications console and attack the Federation ship that had just saved the evacuees.

name: DROPPOINT_SHIP_TOXIN_FLUSHED
text: "Thank goodness. I need my ship for my livelihood. Who knows how long I would have been without it. Here's a small token of my appreciation." The merchant gifts you an augment.

name: QUEST_DROPPOINT_POD
text: A small escape pod is adrift at this location. Judging from the markings, this pod originated from some multiversal equivalent of Earth: someone likely had to abandon their universe and wound up at the drop point. There's no sign of a ship that this pod may have ejected from. However, before you can pick it up, a Rebel intercepts. "This human will no doubt make a fine recruit for the Rebel cause!"

name: DROPPOINT_ACQUIRE_ESCAPE_POD
text: The pod is still adrift. It's unlikely to be a trap, but sometimes it's better to be safe than sorry.

event.text: The resident of the pod is surprised, as they didn't expect to end up in this universe. You explain your mission, but the human inside seems hesitant to get involved in this conflict without learning more. They request to be dropped off at a nearby colony.
There's no telling who could be in the pod, so you leave it to drift.

name: DROPPOINT_ESCAPE_POD_QUEST

unvisitedTooltip.text: Drop off the pod survivor at this colony to introduce them to this universe.

text: The human thanks you for delivering them to a colony. "This timeline seems more stable than the one I came from, at least. I might join your cause, but give me some time to think about it. In the meantime, I have a reactor core that I hope you will find useful."

name: DROPPOINT_SUPPLY_DEPOT_NORMAL
text: A brief scan of your ID is all it takes until a Federation Auto-ship is dispatched to transfer over some supplies.

name: DROPPOINT_SUPPLY_DEPOT_DESTROYED
text: It appears you've arrived a little too late. Something, whether they be pirate or Rebel, has razed this place and destroyed everything in sight. You grab what little salvage remains and carry on.

name: DROPPOINT_SUPPLY_DEPOT_REPAIR
text: You scan your ID, but no supplies are dispensed. A Federation officer apologizes, explaining their delivery drones were damaged or destroyed by pirates. To compensate, they send one of their repair drones instead, followed by a small team of crew carrying some additional scrap.

name: DROPPOINT_SUPPLY_DEPOT_SHORTAGE_FUEL
text: The Federation officer who greets you apologizes and explains they're short on supplies. The best they can offer is a small helping of fuel and scrap.

name: DROPPOINT_SUPPLY_DEPOT_SHORTAGE_MISSILES
text: The Federation officer who greets you apologizes and explains they're short on supplies. The best they can offer is a small helping of ammunition and scrap.

name: DROPPOINT_SUPPLY_DEPOT_SHORTAGE_DRONES
text: The Federation officer who greets you apologizes and explains they're short on supplies. The best they can offer is a small helping of drone parts and scrap.

name: DROPPOINT_SUPPLY_DEPOT_ATTACK_REBEL
text: Little remains of the supply depot other than a small helping of scrap. From the rubble descends a Rebel vessel, but they don't seem interested in fighting.

event.text: You prepare for battle.
You pull away from the supply depot.

name: DROPPOINT_SUPPLY_DEPOT_ATTACK_PIRATE
text: Little remains of the supply depot other than a small helping of scrap. A pirate ship jumps in nearby, disappointed to find the supply depot already destroyed.

event.text: You prepare for battle.
You pull away from the supply depot.

name: DROPPOINT_SUPPLY_DEPOT_ATTACK_MANTIS
text: Little remains of the supply depot other than a small helping of scrap. A Mantis hunter approaches menacingly, their weapons humming with power, but not firing yet.

event.text: You prepare for battle.
You pull away from the supply depot.

destroyed.text: You've demolished the Union vessel, and their scrap is yours.

deadCrew.text: You've erased all life from the Union vessel, and their scrap is yours.

surrender.text: "Stop! Stop! Take a slave and let us go. Kill us, and they all die regardless!"

escape.text: As if they were ready for this, they immediately power on their engines. You'd better be quick, this ship's engines are unusually strong.

gotaway.text: The pirate jumped away.

surrender.text: "Look, we just want to deliver our package! Take this and leave us alone!"

destroyed.text: The smuggler's ship rips itself apart as the engines go up in flames.

deadCrew.text: With nothing stopping you from exploring the hold, you're able to find something. It's not clear if this was the important delivery they were making, but it's yours for the taking.

surrender.text: The pirates hail you. "Ok, you've made your point Mr. Feddy Man. These are your supplies, yes yes, but we need to be able to feed ourselves too! How about we make a compromise?"

choice.text: Agree to their compromise and split the supplies.

event.text: You collect the supplies and leave the pirates alone.

surrender.text: "You winnings! Most greatest of fighters. As promise, I coming with."

destroyed.text: By mistake... or by intent, it appears you have slain the Free Mantis. There's nothing left but to scrap their hull.

deadCrew.text: By mistake... or by intent, it appears you have slain the Free Mantis. There's nothing left but to scrap their hull.

event.text: Once safely returned to the realm of the living, the Free Mantis applauds you. "Excellency of fighter beyond any realm of imaginings! I must coming with and see you in further action."
Once safely returned to the realm of the living, the Free Mantis applauds you. "Excellency of fighter beyond any realm of imaginings! I must coming with and see you in further action."

choice.text: (Upg. Clone Bay) Revive the Free Mantis.

event.text: Once safely returned to the realm of the living, the Free Mantis applauds you. "Excellency of fighter beyond any realm of imaginings! I must coming with and see you in further action."
Once safely returned to the realm of the living, the Free Mantis applauds you. "Excellency of fighter beyond any realm of imaginings! I must coming with and see you in further action."
Once safely returned to the realm of the living, the Free Mantis applauds you. "Excellency of fighter beyond any realm of imaginings! I must coming with and see you in further action."

destroyed.text: The outpost hails you, "Thank you! I don't know what we did to anger the Rebels, but they were ready to kill us. I'll show you our goods and patch up your hull."

deadCrew.text: The outpost hails you, "Thank you! I don't know what we did to anger the Rebels, but they were ready to kill us. I'll show you our goods and patch up your hull."

destroyed.text: You've defeated the Rebel ship. You scrap its remains.

event.text: The Rebel carrier was in worse condition than you thought. The rest of its fleet is offline and they are defenseless against you. They give you some supplies as a surrender.

deadCrew.text: You've defeated the Rebel ship. You scrap its remains.

event.text: The Rebel carrier was in worse condition than you thought. The rest of its fleet is offline and they are defenseless against you. They give you some supplies as a surrender.

name: DUSK_PLANNERS
text: It's unusual to see non-military Rebel vessels outside of safezones, but an Auto-escort is leading the way for a party of Rebel architects who seem to be preparing something at the nearby system.

event.text: The Rebels seem fairly annoyed by your pestering. "We're busy, idiot! Trying to build a new residential zone somewhere nearby. Don't you have orphans to murder somewhere?"

choice.text: Isn't this sector controlled by Duskbringers though?

event.text: "Well yeah, right NOW it is. But Universe 1'll plow through them soon enough. We were sent ahead of time to prepare for the inevitable surge in population once we wrench this place out of the hands of those hardlight freaks. Ex-warzones are all the rage nowadays."

choice.text: (Duskbringer Crew) Trick them into heading straight into the Dusk fleet.

event.text: With some smooth talking (and failing to mention the source of the information) you convince the Rebels to head in the direction of a supposed Duskbringer outpost. This should delay the Rebels for a bit...

choice.text: (Engineer Crew) Convince them you've also been sent by the Rebels.

event.text: "Universe 1 hires Renegades now? Since when? I know Vance ain't always the most rational guy but... really? Well, not my place to complain. If you're travelling through here you'll need to be extra cautious you don't step into a trap. Here's some flight plans, hopefully it helps."

choice.text: (Adv. Sensors) Recommend them a good spot.

event.text: They might be skeptical at first, but after looking over the map plans the Rebels seem to realize you've given them quite the prime location. "Well I'll be, I guess Renegades are useful for more than just kicking puppies after all. Hah! Eh whatever, I'll pay you if it keeps you from making a flesh suit out of me."

choice.text: (Long-Ranged Scanners) Recommend them a good spot.

event.text: They might be skeptical at first, but after looking over the map plans the Rebels seem to realize you've given them quite the prime location. "Well I'll be, I guess Renegades are useful for more than just kicking puppies after all. Hah! Eh whatever, I'll pay you if it keeps you from making a flesh suit out of me."
As soon as you open fire, the escort locks onto your hull and the Rebels jump away, leaving you alone to fight the drone.
They might not be military, but that doesn't mean these Rebels are any safer to mess with. Better to leave them alone.

name: DUSK_MILITIA_ESCORT
text: Friends of the Federation aren't all that common in these parts, but a Militia transport protected by an escort is passing through. They must have noticed you, but they don't attempt to make contact.

event.text: It appears that the transport has sustained some damage, and judging from the nature of the damage it appears to have been Energy Cannons, meaning they were most likely attacked by the Duskbringers.

choice.text: Offer some scrap to help repair.

event.text: The Militiamen are surprised by your offer, but they graciously accept.
They offer you a gift as thanks for your generous donation.
The escort isn't about to let you get away with your attack. The transport is unable to fight back and watches the battle in despair.

choice.text: (Repair Drone) Offer to use the drone to fix up their ship.

event.text: The Militiamen are surprised by your offer, but they graciously accept.
They offer you a gift as thanks for your generous donation.

choice.text: (Repair Cluster) Offer to use the bomb to fix up their ship.

event.text: The Militiamen are surprised by your offer, but they graciously accept.
They offer you a gift as thanks for your generous donation.

choice.text: (Pro-Hull Beam) Offer to use the Beam to fix up their ship.

event.text: The Militiamen are surprised by your offer, but they graciously accept.
They offer you a gift as thanks for your generous donation.

choice.text: (Repair Arm) Offer to use the arm to fix up their hull.

event.text: The Militiamen are surprised by your offer, but they graciously accept.
They offer you a gift as thanks for your generous donation.
The caravan doesn't bother you, and eventually the ships jump away.
The Militiamen don't bother you, and eventually the ships jump away.

name: DUSK_MILITIA_ESCORT_SURRENDER
text: The Militia escort can't escape without leaving the transport unprotected. Instead, they opt to surrender, pleading for you to let them live.

event.text: You decide to pull back from your assault. The envoy is left almost completely destroyed, and most likely won't be able to repair the transport in time to save both of them before the Duskbringers arrive. Still, they hand over a weapon from the transport's cargo as "thanks" for "sparing" them.

name: DUSK_MILITIA_ESCORT_DESTROY
text: The escort is destroyed, leaving the transport unprotected. They have nowhere to run, and are completely at your mercy.

choice.text: Destroy the transport and salvage the wreck.

event.text: The militiamen aboard the transport plead for you to spare them, but you end transmissions and destroy their ship. It explodes much more violently than expected, the shockwave throwing back your ship and sending debris scattering across the hull. You don't know what the ship was carrying, but it must have been something explosive. You're certain the rest of the cargo is destroyed, but there still remains some wreckage to salvage.

choice.text: Demand the transport transfer their cargo.

event.text: The militiamen hurry to meet your demands. It appears their ship was carrying high grade explosives and ballistic weaponry, of which you now hold ownership over. You leave them to their certain demise.

name: DUSK_SLAVER_TRADE
text: Not too long after you jump to this beacon, a slaver also jumps nearby. They hail you. "Interesting, a Renegade. Ain't a common sight down here. Don't suppose you need some crew?"

event.text: "Shame, I was hoping you might be different... Men, arm the guns!"
"Yes yes, to be expected. Have fun dealing with the Duskys!" They jump away, and a Duskbringer ship jumps in almost immediately after. The slavers must have been followed!

name: DUSK_SLAVER_TRADE_BUY_2
text: The inside of the slaver ship is no pretty sight. All around various aliens are chained to the walls, many of which have sickening bruises or scars all over their bodies. To turn against the slavers now would be a death sentence, so you better buy someone or get out.

event.text: "Excellent choice!" The pirates unchain the slave and toss them in your direction. You bring them back to your ship before telling them that they've been liberated. Perhaps the Duskbringers aren't as bad as the pirates after all...

"Excellent choice!" The pirates unchain the slave and toss them in your direction. You bring them back to your ship before telling them that they've been liberated. Perhaps the Duskbringers aren't as bad as the pirates after all...

"Excellent choice!" The pirates unchain the slave and toss them in your direction. You bring them back to your ship before telling them that they've been liberated. Perhaps the Duskbringers aren't as bad as the pirates after all...
"Ah what a shame. If you ever need some extra hands, you can always find us again!" You quickly leave before they can consider taking you captive as well.

name: DUSK_PROPAGANDA
text: A massive machine floats nearby, akin to a station in size, but appears to be fully automated and Zoltan made. As soon as lies start flooding in through your radio, it becomes clear that this is some sort of automated propaganda broadcaster. "Federation officers eat BABIES! That's a fact! Think of the children. Join the Duskbringers today and make the monsters pay!"

event.text: The Duskbringers and their fascist lies can go to hell. You take apart the power source for the machine and strip apart its outer hull.

choice.text: (Engi Crew) Reprogram the machine to spread lies about your location.

event.text: The Rebels and Duskbringers have worked together on occasion but wouldn't normally take advice from propaganda like this. Still - the location of your ship is information they wouldn't want to pass up and they wouldn't expect the Duskbringers to have any reason to lie.

choice.text: (Engineer Crew) Reprogram the machine to spread lies about your location.

event.text: The Rebels and Duskbringers have worked together on occasion but wouldn't normally take advice from propaganda like this. Still - the location of your ship is information they wouldn't want to pass up and they wouldn't expect the Duskbringers to have any reason to lie.

choice.text: (Hacking) Reprogram the machine to spread lies about your location.

event.text: The Rebels and Duskbringers have worked together on occasion but wouldn't normally take advice from propaganda like this. Still - the location of your ship is information they wouldn't want to pass up and they wouldn't expect the Duskbringers to have any reason to lie.

choice.text: (Hacking Weapon) Scramble its defenses and upload a message to lie about your location.

event.text: The Rebels and Duskbringers have worked together on occasion but wouldn't normally take advice from propaganda like this. Still - the location of your ship is information they wouldn't want to pass up and they wouldn't expect the Duskbringers to have any reason to lie.

name: DUSK_IDOL
text: You receive a hail from a young Duskbringer soldier. At first you assume he has some sort of threat for you, but instead he seems amazed to be meeting a Multiverse traveler in person. "Woah, you're one of those special timey wimey ships!"

event.text: "Wow! Oooh ooh, have you ever been to Earth?! There was this guy... oh here's a picture!" He holds up a small, black and white photograph of a man saluting to a crowd of people. "He's like a hero of mine! I don't know how to say his name in human language, but he was like a famous leader and he almost conquered the world or something! Have you ever met him?"

choice.text: Tell the truth and say you haven't.

event.text: "You haven't? Man... Well, fun chat! Best I kill you now."

choice.text: (Human Crew) Your human knows who it is.

event.text: Your human coughs, and briefly explains that the man in the photo was no hero, and most of the people of Old Earth resented him for years after he died. "O-oh. I assumed he must have been a famous human warrior! I guess in a sense I was right... but not like that. You know so much more than I do! Oh, command will be so mad at me... but I can't pass up this opportunity!"

name: DUSK_MFKHELP
text: A nearby Zoltan city on the nearest planet's surface appears to have been damaged heavily from some kind of recent attack. An MFK vessel is parked in orbit, observing the city from a safe distance. You can't quite ascertain what its intentions are.

event.text: At first, the MFK's won't receive your hails. Finally, after enough repeated pestering, they pick up. "Yes, I hear you. God damn it, do you have anything better to do than harass us? What do you want?!"

"Responsible? No, we were sent to clean up this mess. Universe 1's gotten too big for its britches and thinks it can decide how the local Rebellions should run their politics! Well damn that to hell, we fought a Civil War too! The one mistake the Rebellion made back in the day, was thinking that just because humans are superior we couldn't cooperate with other races. Just look at these Zoltans. They get the idea. Sure, we have some... ideological incompatibilities, but we can both agree different species are better off unified and separate. But the collective egos of Universe 1 have gone too far, and now they think they can just wipe the Duskbringers out entirely! Screw that and screw them, not if I have my say. We're helping locate survivors and escort them to medical facilities. If you want to be useful, you could try helping."

choice.text: Assist in locating the survivors - though it'll take some time.

event.text: You send a team down the city and navigate through the ruins. You find several survivors, but less than a dozen. It's a pitiful haul, but the Rebels have a similar turnout of their own. "Damn it! Damn it, damn it, damn it!" The MFK stomps his foot on the ground and clenches his fists. "Look at this, all of this pointless destruction. Going after civilians? Is this what we've come to? This city didn't even have a military installation, it was a trading port! Back in the Civil War the fleet was purely occupational, we held the territory but let people go on with business. Now, it has become a ravaging death omen, burning down cities and killing any poor vessel caught in its wake." He takes a deep breath and tries to recollect his emotions. "Regardless, thank you for your collaboration. We'll move these people to the nearest medical facility and come back to search later. I'll have my men give you something on your way out."

choice.text: (Slug Crew) Assist in locating the survivors.
(Telepathic Shell) Assist in locating the survivors.
(Lifeform Scanner) Assist in locating the survivors.
(Adv. Sensors) Assist in locating the survivors.
(Long-Ranged Scanners) Assist in locating the survivors.

event.text: "Damn Renegade scum, always getting in the way! You're no heroes or glorious crusaders of justice, you're just pests devoid of morals!"
"Who do you think you are? The Rebellion won't take those words from anyone, let alone Renegade scum like you!"
The MFK hangs up and mutes your communications. When you continue to try and hail them, the ship flies to the other side of the city.
"God damn Renegades, making life hell for anyone that dares enter their line of sight. We'll be making the whole Multiverse safer without you around!"
