The Soldier nods, satisfied with their answers. The other ship hasn't contacted you at all.

choice.text: Demand that the other ship surrender and prepare to be boarded.
Your hacking suite isn't sophisticated enough to detect forgeries.
(Adv. Hacking) Demand that the ships allow you to hack their ships.

event.text: You inform the ships that your hacking system is sophisticated enough that it can detect any forgeries that might have been set in place within the security records. The captain of the corvette scoffs in outrage. "How dare you, Renegade! We won't let you invade our privacy!" It looks like they're about to attack!

choice.text: (Mind Control) Force the impostors to reveal themselves.

event.text: Your mind control system hums to life. The fighter captain maintains her innocence - but the corvette captain clumsily blurts out his intentions. The Rebel crew behind him scramble into formation.

choice.text: (Adv. Mind Control) Force the impostors to surrender.

event.text: Your mind control system hums to life. The fighter captain maintains her innocence - but the corvette captain surrenders the moment your mind control seizes his will.

choice.text: Grill both ships until you can catch one in a lie.

event.text: You put both ships under an immense amount of pressure. As you interrogate them, you begin to put the pieces together. You're able to eventually break through the facade of the turncoat. It takes a considerable amount of time, but you're able to resolve the situation bloodlessly.

choice.text: Attack the one who's under least suspicion - this must be a trick!

event.text: You feel very clever as you turn your weapons on the light cruiser that told you about the dilemma. "What are you doing? Are you mad?"
You're not interested in what's happening here. They can work it out for themselves.

name: KNIGHTS_AND_KNAVES_SURRENDER
text: The crew of the compromised Federation ship surrender and allow the other ships to take their crew prisoner. The captain of the light cruiser invites you into another call.

name: KNIGHTS_AND_KNAVES_AFTERMATH
text: The captains of the fighter and light cruiser applaud your effort. "Splendid work. With the Rebel prisoners, the defector and our ship intact, you've resolved this conflict in a perfectly ideal way. We wish you good luck on your mission."

name: DISTRESS_FEDERATION_TEAMUP
text: You detect three ships in the system as you arrive at the beacon. A Duskbringer and a Rebel are trying to outflank a Federation guard as it transmits its distress call. The uneasy alliance of your enemies has broken through the Federation's defenses!

event.text: You power up your weapons and engage the Duskbringer vessel. As soon as you do, the Federation ship turns to fight the Rebel.
You power up your weapons and engage the Rebel vessel. As soon as you do, the Federation ship turns to fight the Duskbringer.

choice.text: (Devorak) Convince the Duskbringer to turn on the Rebel.

event.text: Devorak hails the Duskbringer ship. "Those treacherous Rebels are not to be trusted. Turn on them and we'll send you back to base." The Duskbringers hardly blink as they turn on their allies. The Rebel ship is promptly surrounded and eradicated by the force of three ships. Your crew begins to harvest the remains.

The Duskbringers grimace, but agree to be escorted out of Federation space. It's clear they're uneasy with any sort of compliance to the Federation, but they don't seem broken up about the deaths of the Rebels. The Federation captain is impressed. "Renegades make some strange bedfellows, don't they?"
The Federation ship can likely find help if they continue to evade. Your mission is too important to be distracted by a skirmish like this.

name: FEDERATION_TEAMUP_FOLLOWUP
text: The Federation Captain salutes you. "Thanks for stopping to help, Renegade. When the Rebels and Duskbringers started playing nice, I was hoping their alliance would fall apart. Guess it was just wishful thinking. Good luck on your mission, captain."

name: DISTRESS_FEDERATION_COLONY_HOSTAGE
text: Arriving at this beacon, there is a Federation ship and a strange, heavily armored transport ship with some old-fashioned technology. The Federation ship hails you. "This is Commodore Freamon. We have a major crisis on our hands here. That pirate transport has important hostages on board; we can't fire upon it, and you shouldn't either." The Federation officer pauses, and then continues. "They're also threatening to start attacking the colony from orbit if their demands aren't met."

event.text: Commodore Freamon sighs. "One of their demands is a powerful ship, and they have the means to take one. If you even try to get close enough to fight, they'll send boarding pods and try to take over your ship. But if you can handle a lot of attackers, we might be able to stage a counter-strike and save the hostages. Are you up for this?"

choice.text: Agree to take on the pirates.

event.text: "Best of luck, Renegade. You know what to do." The boarding pods hurtle towards your ship at a blisteringly fast pace. You're going to have to get ready for a fight!

choice.text: (Strong Defense Drone) Attempt to shoot down the pods with your Defense Drone.

event.text: Your Defense Drone fires at the incoming pods. The pods are tough, but your drone is powerful enough to destroy one of the pods before the arrival. The other one still manages to break through!

tooltip.text: More boarding pods are approaching!

choice.text: (Weak Defense Drone) Attempt to shoot down the pods with your Defense Drone.

event.text: The pods impact your Energy Shield. Unfortunately, it was unable to stop them from tunneling in. You'll have to fight them!

tooltip.text: More boarding pods are approaching!

event.text: The first two pods break through your hull. It's a fight!

tooltip.text: More boarding pods are approaching!

choice.text: Tell Freamon your crew isn't ready for this.

event.text: "If you can't do it, we'll find another way. Good luck on your mission."

name: FEDERATION_BOARDINGPODS_WAVE2
text: Three more boarding pods come hurtling towards the hull. The pirates are serious about taking your ship.

choice.text: (Strong Defense Drone) Attempt to shoot down the pods with your Defense Drone.

event.text: Your Defense Drone fires at the incoming pods. The pods are tough, but your drone is powerful enough to destroy one of the pods before it gets to you. The other two still manage to break through!

tooltip.text: More boarding pods are approaching!

choice.text: (Strong Defense Drone) Attempt to shoot down the pods with your Defense Drone.

event.text: Your Defense Drone fires at the incoming pods. The pods are tough, but your drone is powerful enough to destroy one of the pods before it gets to you. The other two still manage to break through!

tooltip.text: More boarding pods are approaching!

choice.text: (Weak Defense Drone) Attempt to shoot down the pods with your Defense Drone.

event.text: You finally decide to deploy your drone...

choice.text: (Weak Defense Drone) Attempt to shoot down the pods with your Defense Drone.

event.text: All three pods break into your ship. More are surely on their way!

tooltip.text: More boarding pods are approaching!

name: FEDERATION_BOARDINGPODS_WAVE3
text: They're committing fully to taking your ship. Four more pods are approaching!

choice.text: (Strong Defense Drone) Attempt to shoot down the pods with your Defense Drone.

event.text: Your Defense Drone fires at the incoming pods. The pods are tough, but your Defense Drone is powerful enough to destroy one of the pods before it gets to you. The other three still manage to break through. This is it!

choice.text: (Strong Defense Drone) Attempt to shoot down the pods with your Defense Drone.

event.text: Your Defense Drone fires at the incoming pods. The pods are tough, but your Defense Drone is powerful enough to destroy one of the pods before it gets to you. The other three still manage to break through. This is it!

choice.text: (Weak Defense Drone) Attempt to shoot down the pods with your Defense Drone.

event.text: You finally decide to deploy your drone...

choice.text: (Weak Defense Drone) Attempt to shoot down the pods with your Defense Drone.

event.text: All four pods break into your ship. This is it!

name: FEDERATION_BOARDINGPODS_WIN
text: "This is Freamon. We've successfully secured the hostages. I want to extend my utmost appreciation for what you've done here today. We're going to get them all to safety. The pirates had some military equipment on their ship - if you want it, it's yours." As the Commodore has his crew bring you the pirate's belongings, one of them passes on a thank-you note from a child that had been taken.

name: DISTRESS_FEDERATION_EMBASSY
text: A repeating distress signal guides you towards the local Ministry Embassy. It's alarming to find a distress signal here - made even more alarming by the Duskbringer ship posted outside the station.

event.text: You stealthily dock in one of the two hangars and make your way to the center lobby, stepping over the bodies of several deceased guards on the way. When you arrive, you find that countless civilians and guards, primarily Ministry but also numerous other species, have been tied up and gagged. Several guards stand on the sides, guns drawn, but are incapable of action without risking the civilians. A team of fully-suited up Duskbringers are holding guns to the heads of several officials, while their leader marches back and forth. "The time of complacency in our species is over! The Zoltan race did not rise from the ashes of a torched civilization to sit voicelessly on a council and die in wars caused by Human greed! A united Federation is a myth! It is time we rise up and claim our rightful place among the stars!" The Zoltan speaks stiffly, as if reciting a speech he heard spoken elsewhere.

choice.text: Reveal yourself and attempt to debate with the Duskbringer.

event.text: This is far too risky to be worth getting involved in.

name: FED_EMBASSY_MESSY
text: The embassy staff are less than pleased with your intervention. "Why does the Federation insist on hiring Renegades when they are as reckless with the lives of others as you?! None of these people had to die, but now their blood is on your hands."

event.text: While you can tell the Zoltans don't accept your apology, they at least stop their ranting and turn to handling the situation, allowing you to slip away without further consequences.

choice.text: You didn't have the situation under control at all!

event.text: Your insensitive response only angers the Zoltan further. "Well that wasn't your call to make. Now we have a diplomatic nightmare on our hands. Do you really think the project that not only hired you but allows people of your type to lawfully exist in this galaxy will continue to receive support when you act like this?" You figure it's best to leave before things get even uglier.

"You really think 30 scrap is going to make up for this? At least a dozen people are dead because of your reckless behavior." The Zoltan puts his hands over his head and paces back and forth. "This wouldn't even cover the property damage, let alone reimbursements to the families of the deceased. Just... go. You aren't wanted here."

name: FED_EMBASSY_BAD
text: Unfortunately, risky moves go haywire quickly. The Duskbringers react quickly, triggering their explosive vests and taking out several hostages. While the guards join the fray, you're forced to retreat back to the ship and fight off the now hostile vessel outside.

name: FED_EMBASSY_GOOD
text: The head of the embassy even comes to shake your hand for your help. "It's a shame any bloodshed had to come from today at all - you did marvelously, disarming your opponents with words rather than guns. It was unlikely you could have convinced them to abandon their ways, but it seems much of our kind has forsworn old principles. Either way, here is your reward."

name: FED_EMBASSY_DEVORAK
text:
Devorak steps out into the open, turning all heads. "We have never been voiceless, soldier. For the Ministry to sit upon a council means to take great caution. More caution than the younger races would ever take."

"General? Why are you here? On a Renegade ship, no less?"

"Stand down, soldier. That's an order. You've made your point. Release the hostages and go."

"But we... this wasn't..." The Duskbringer visibly slackens his stance. "Yes, General. ...Even if none of you died, you will remember this."

event.text:
"Unbelievable, you resolved this peacefully?" The Zoltans are in awe. "Here is your reward. And, after this business with the Rebels, we may be able to offer you a position here."

"I... what? You do...?" Devorak seems totally caught off guard. "You do... know who I am, don't you...?"

name: FEDERATION_SHIP_STOLEN
text: A charred and smoking hangar resides at this beacon, barely functional. "We've been waiting for help to come by... we have truly awful news! A Federation ship has been taken by the Coalition! Please, you have to do something! We have no idea what they're going to do with it, but whatever they are planning cannot happen!"

event.text: "We can still track their ship... fortunately we were not all killed in their escape. Please hurry!"
"Are you insane? The importance of this mission is... no, I'm sorry. I know your mission is important too. We will find somebody else."

name: FEDERATION_SHIP_STOLEN_QUEST

unvisitedTooltip.text: The Coalition has seized a Federation ship, and it is currently at this beacon.

text: The occupied Federation ship is approaching a Union station. But as soon as you move within sensor range, it disengages to face your ship instead!

name: ENCOUNTER_FED_SALVAGE
text: You find the wreck of a Federation ship nearby. Before you can even begin to consider salvaging it, another Federation ship jumps in. They demand an explanation for what happened.

choice.text: Tell them you didn't destroy this ship.

event.text: Your good reputation precedes you. Once they realize who you are, they apologize for the mix-up and offer to help you harvest the ship faster. Though not much remains, you find some usable equipment, and a small helping of scrap for your troubles.

choice.text: Tell them you didn't destroy this ship.
Tell them you didn't destroy this ship.

event.text: Whilst you try to convince them that they're mistaken, they don't seem inclined to believe you. "We've heard about all your misdeeds here! You really expect us to buy that you're not responsible?"

choice.text: Fight your way out of this.

event.text: You mute comms and prepare to fight them. Judging by how quickly they move to defend themselves, it seems this was what they expected you to do.

name: ENCOUNTER_FED_REBELTAKEOVER
text: You receive an urgent hail from the nearby Federation ship. "You have to help, the Rebels, they've taken over the ship!" The call suddenly goes to static and the ship turns hostile!

name: REBELTAKEOVER_SURRENDER
text: The new Rebel "captain" of the ship hails you. "Alright, you've caused enough damage. Let us go, and we'll spare the last survivor of the original crew."

choice.text: The death of one more Fed is worth the death of even more Rebels.

name: REBELTAKEOVER_DESTROY
text: You've destroyed the Federation ship, and with it the Rebel and Federation crew. You salvage what's left of the wreck.

name: REBELTAKEOVER_DEADCREW
text: You've killed off all of the Rebel crew. As you salvage the ship, you notice the body of one of the old Federation crew. You find they're still alive, and help them to their feet. After some washing and first-aid they're good as new and ready to serve on your ship.

name: STEALTH_UNLOCK_1
text: You arrive near a small fleet of Federation and Engi ships. A simple decryption and translation of their comm frequency tells you that they are having a frantic discussion about something obviously troubling them.

choice.text: Message them and ask if you can help.

event.text: Slightly shocked at your question, their leader quickly responds, "Declined offer with apologetic gratitude. Topic of discussion private matter, no concern of Multiverse vigilantes."
You can't help but wonder what they were discussing as you prepare to jump.

choice.text: (Harmony Crew) Have your Engi crewmember contact them.

event.text: Your crewmember syncs with the comm unit to communicate with them directly. You offer your help and a summary of the ship's mission. They respond, "Our goals have analogous elements. However, not all available for disclosure, discretion necessary."

"Secret prototype stolen by Mantis, initiating high profile trade with Rebels. Cargo ship location: unknown. Mantis Suzerain dispatched to Rebel base to deliver information on prototype whereabouts. Transmitting location of known data transfer location."

"However, Mantis ship potentially stopped by second base on travel. Would calculate probability of transfer occuring here but data insufficient. Cannot risk obvious Rebel-Engi conflict. Also, need time to acquire military ships. Assist in finding technology?"

name: STEALTH_UNLOCK_2FAKE

unvisitedTooltip.text: Suspected location of the stolen Engi prototype.

text: You arrive at one of the Rebel bases that the Engi told you about. It appears abandoned except for one well armed Elite ship. Perhaps you could extract information from them.

name: STEALTH_UNLOCK_2FAKE_SURRENDER
text: "Stop! Stop! Why is the Federation so damn ravenous! Don't you have better things to do than hunting down random Rebel ships when you have other battles to fight?"

choice.text: Demand information on the stolen technology.

event.text: "Ah, so that's what you're after. Too bad, you followed the wrong ship. The envoy that passed through here was a fake, to trick fools like you. Now let us go!"
"Hah! And don't think the fleet won't hear about this!" The Rebels jump away.
"No, wait!" You cut the transmission and continue the assault.

name: STEALTH_UNLOCK_2REAL

unvisitedTooltip.text: Suspected location of the stolen Engi prototype.

text: You arrive at one of the Rebel bases that the Engi told you about. It appears mostly abandoned, save for a Suzerain ship. This must be the one the Engi were searching for!

name: STEALTH_UNLOCK_2REAL_SURRENDER
text: "Eek! Me not want to die here! Many apologizing Federation, now stop firing!"

choice.text: Demand information on the stolen technology.

event.text: "Oh yes yes, that why you here. Yes, MFK ship arrive, paying much well for data! We give them location of envoy, and taking pay! You understanding it's just job, yes? You surely run mercenary job time to time!"
You prepare an FTL message containing the coordinates to send to the Engi and get ready to jump.

name: STEALTH_UNLOCK_3

unvisitedTooltip.text: Confirmed location of the stolen Engi prototype.

text: You have finally caught up with the MFK Ace ship. A hangar-sized Mantis cargo ship has stopped nearby, guarded by a mix of Mantis and Rebels. As you reconsider the assault, a squadron of Engi ships with pirate emblems jump in and assist you. You get involved and attack one of the nearby Rebels head-on.

name: STEALTH_UNLOCK_4
text: The Engi emerge victorious from their battles with only minor losses. They message you, "Project X-ME56 commissioned by Federation military research division. Advanced Stealth Cruiser. Project finished during rebellion. Unable to reconnect with Federation military command."

event.text: "Likely ploy by Rebels to avoid breaking non-aggression pact with Engi. 97.56 percent likely. Your mission to assist last Federation fleet, correct? Coordinates?"

"Satisfactory. Delivery of tech will assist in Federation cause. Gratitude alone insufficient. Commencing ship repair and compensation." Their crews deliver an advanced augmentation for installation but you're more pleased to hear that the Federation will have an improved arsenal.

name: FED_MEMORIAL
text: It's clear from the minute you jump in that this is an important location. A massive, stunning memorial has been built here, so large it can easily be seen from space.

event.text: The memorial appears to have been constructed in honor of Universe 0, and more specifically the battle of Node 17. You exit your ship to observe a giant wall of names, a list of every Federation officer who gave their lives fighting in Node 17, whether they died from a kamikaze Auto, a Rebel ship, or a fatal injury sustained during battle. It moves you greatly, having come from Universe 0.

A blazing siren screams throughout the city, and a monotone voice speaks. "This is not a drill. Repeat, this is not a drill. A Rebel squadron has been seen approaching the city. All civilians are to clear out of any unprotected areas and seek out shelter immediately. Any Federation personnel within the city limits are to report to command immediately to defend against the approaching threat."

choice.text: You won't stand for this. Do all you can to help!

event.text: At the lead of the Rebel squadron is an unusual Rebel ship, one unlike anything you've seen before. It wields a powerful artillery weapon. If you can take it down, maybe it'll discourage the rest of the fleet.
You aren't interested in getting caught up in this fight. You're certain the Federation ships here will be able to fend off the Rebels.

name: FED_MEMORIAL_INTERMEDIATE
text: Around you, you can see Rebel ships beginning to flee as the Federation forces push them back. Their last hope, the Gunboat and your target, has already taken critical damage. You have to keep fighting!

name: FED_MEMORIAL_DESTROY
text: The Gunboat has received critical damage, too much for it to sustain. Its artillery system crackles and the engines explode. The ship goes spiraling down into the nearby lake. It explodes one last time once it collides with the water, showering the coast. The sight of their leading ship dispatched so efficiently is enough to chase away the rest of the Rebels. Every last hostile ship jumps away, leaving the Federation the undisputed victor.

name: FED_MEMORIAL_DEAD_CREW
text: The lifeless Gunboat begins to plummet towards the ground. It smashes into the coast, erupting into a glorious display of flames, though luckily it causes no damage to any of the infrastructure of the city. The sight of their leading ship dispatched so efficiently is enough to chase away the rest of the Rebels. Every last hostile ship jumps away, leaving the Federation the undisputed victor.

name: FED_MEMORIAL_WIN
text: You are hailed by a Federation officer in the city, who requests that you land. As you exit your vessel, all around civilians cheer for you. You recognize Vice Admiral Adara, the voice who spoke to you. "You have done us a great service today. I do not know how to thank you for protecting this city. I have heard stories, well, myths and legends really, of the Multiverse Renegades, and I've always been skeptical. Now, all of my doubts have been assuaged."

event.text: Adara puts a shiny medal around your neck, an honor that you will carry on for life, assuming you succeed in your mission. Every support ship in the district is dispatched to aid you in every way they can, and you're even given a fresh new Federation cruiser from one of their hangars. You don't really have a use for this ship, so you forward its blueprints to the hangar.

As you are leaving, Adara pulls you aside to tell you one last thing. "This package, it is extremely important that it arrives to Tully in time. I don't have time to bring it to him myself, but I know I can trust you with it. Godspeed, captain."

tooltip.text: The testing session will end after this much time. Do not do any hull damage to the drone before then!

escape.text: As soon as they see you, they power up their engines to jump away. Stop them!

gotaway.text: With the ship gone you search through the abandoned base for any signs of their destination but find none.

destroyed.text: You take what you can from the debris.

deadCrew.text: A quick search of their communication logs shows that the tech you were searching for never passed through this base... It must have been a decoy! You strip what you can and prepare to jump.

escape.text: As soon as they see you they power up their engines to jump away. Stop them!

gotaway.text: With the ship gone, you search through the abandoned base for any signs of their destination but find none.

destroyed.text: You take what you can from the debris.

deadCrew.text: Once their crew is dead you scan the ship for the stolen blueprints but find none. Instead, you find recordings of a conversation with an MFK Ace... the Mantis must have already transfered off the data. You strip the ship and prepare to pursue.
You strip what you can and contact the Engi ships.

name: FINISH_BEACON_FREEMANTIS
text: You've arrived at the Long-Range Beacon. When the FTL Drive is charged you can jump to the next Sector.

name: FREEMANTIS_DEMAND_INFO
text: You have little time to prepare before a Free Mantis dropship beams some crew aboard. They demand you explain why you are in their territory.

event.text: You explain your mission to the Free Mantis, and they seem to believe you. They transfer over some scrap in hopes it will help you succeed.

Seeing as you already have one of them on board, you don't even have to finish your explanation before the Free Mantis start gathering supplies to aid you. They transfer over some resources in hopes it will help you succeed.
Just the sight of your Warlord aboard is enough to instantly convince them. The Free Mantis start gathering as many supplies as possible to aid you as a sign of good will.

Their team does a double take when they realize who's aboard your ship. The Free Mantis start gathering supplies to aid you, and one of them even desires to stay and help with your mission as a sign of good will.

Their team does a double take when they realize who's aboard your ship. The Free Mantis start gathering supplies to aid you, and one of them even desires to stay and help with your mission as a sign of good will.
The leader of the Free Mantis huffs. "Fine, then we take your ship and information as ours."

name: FREEMANTIS_SLAVE_OFFER
text: Two wrecks, both formerly Rebel ships, drift nearby. A Free Mantis ship hails you, its weapons raised boastfully in pride at its latest kill.

event.text: "Federation captain, have you seen latest kill?" You nod. "Yes, we hope to make proud."
"You, Federation, you have protected us, given us home when we had nowhere to go. You save us, we are forever grateful. We offer you a slave, from this pitiful Rebel ships we kill for you."
Two Free Mantis guards come aboard and throw the Rebel officer onto the ground in front of you. They wave happily with their sharpened claws and bid you farewell.
You explain that you aren't interested in slavery. "Oh... Yes yes, you Federation are so kind. Truly kinder than anyone else. Please, take some supplies. We beg of you to accept some gift from us."

name: FREEMANTIS_ENGI_SURRENDER
text: An Engi ship nearby hails you, as a Free Mantis ship approaches from behind.

event.text: "Danger: Imminent. Free Mantis in pursuit. Request: contact Free Mantis, ask for intent."

choice.text: Agree and contact the Free Mantis ship.

event.text: The Free Mantis captain seems happy to see you, and welcomes you to the sector. You waste no time and ask for his intent with the Engi. "Harm them? No. This war, very troubling. Alliances are crucial, and best way is through mutually beneficial agreements, such as a trade. But the Engi run, we suspect they are afraid. I promise, we wish them no harm."

choice.text: Explain the situation to the Engi.

event.text: "Gratitude, high. Appreciation, high. Simulated fear, low. Many thanks." The Engi pay you and jump away. The Free Mantis captain shrugs and thanks you for trying.

choice.text: (Engi Crew) "Your concern = warranted. Free Mantis however are: allies to the Federation."

event.text: Your Engi manages to convince them that the Free Mantis will be of no threat to them. They reluctantly believe you, and soon the Free Mantis ship catches up to both of you. "Harm? No. This war, very troubling. Alliances are crucial, and best way is through mutually beneficial agreements, such as a trade. Engi afraid, but promise, we wish no harm."

What follows between them is surely one of the most awkward exchange you've ever seen. They do both reward you for your assistance however, and soon after the Engi jump away. The Free Mantis captain shrugs and leaves you as well.
You tell the Engi that you can't help. They almost immediately jump away afterwards.
The Engi ship continues to try to contact you before giving up and jumping away. The Free Mantis ship lingers a bit longer before jumping away as well, in the opposite direction.

name: FREEMANTIS_EXECUTIONER
text: There is a rather large gathering of Free Mantis ships nearby. You don't know what's going on, but it might be important.

event.text: As you assimilate with the crowd, you notice most of the ships are empty. All of the Mantis seem to have gathered in one large capital ship in the center. You come aboard, confident the Free Mantis won't mind your presence - although any brash action would be extremely dangerous. You find yourself overlooking a large colosseum-like structure, and in the center stands a Mantis wielding a blade over a Human officer.

The executioner speaks to the crowd, "At last! We have caught infamous Captain Briggs of Rebel Fleet! We kill him, in the name of our Federation brothers!" A massive outroar from the crowd overwhelms the stadium as the executioner brings the sword down on the officer's head, slicing it clean off. Sickened by the show of brutality, you and your crew head back to your ship, not sure how to feel about what you just watched.

Your crew aren't sure of the idea of upsetting hundreds of Mantis, but you're set on the idea. You jump down from the balcony, push the executioner off of the Human, and carry him back to your ship, with an angry crowd in pursuit!

choice.text: Leave the Free Mantis to their business.

event.text: You slip away unnoticed, but you can't help but wonder what you might have missed.

name: FREEMANTIS_DEFEND
text: Your ship is almost immediately hailed by a nearby Free Mantis ship under attack by a Rebel. "Federation captain, please save us from Rebels!"

event.text: You fire up the weapons and prepare to defend your Mantis allies.
You try to ignore their pleas for help as you fly away.

name: FREEMANTIS_DEFEND_WIN
text: The Free Mantis are grateful for your aid. They pay you in thanks.

name: FREEMANTIS_THEFT
text: A few Free Mantis ships from different clans are trading supplies nearby. Most of them are small, and you could probably steal some of their supplies if you're up to the risk.

choice.text: Wait for the bigger ships to leave and then steal the supplies.

event.text: You don't need to get involved, and messing with multiple Free Mantis clans at once isn't a good idea.

name: FREEMANTIS_WEIRD_TRADE
text: A lone Free Mantis ship nearby hails you. You are greeted by a Mantis dressed in a shirt decorated with 2D tropical flowers, and wearing a bizarre, beaten sombrero atop his head. "Welcome to beacon! I wish to show you most amazing prize of mine, but you must earn it!"

event.text: "Perfect! Prepare combat!" His weapons go online, and you ready yours. If you want to prove yourself, you'll have to go for their hull and spare them in time.
The Mantis shakes his head, "Where your sense of fight? Disappointing." He ends transmissions.

name: FREEMANTIS_REBEL_SAVE
text: Rebel ships are all about, firing upon a group of unarmed civilians and a Free Mantis ship escorting them. You haven't been noticed.

choice.text: Take on the biggest ship to scare off the smaller Rebels.

event.text: You target the strongest of the Rebel ships, an Elite Bomber. This won't be fun.

name: FREEMANTIS_PULSARRAID
text: The pulsar at this beacon is flooding this system with powerful electromagnetic pulses, but the entire Free Mantis fleet flying towards it doesn't seem to care! You watch as the ships approach the massive orb, with doubtful intent.

event.text: The Free Mantis leading the group appears to be a Warlord! However, he's so dopey from his pheromones that he can barely sling out an intelligible sentence. "P-pullllsar *hick* zap sssship! Heheh, we show... *hick* pulsar who boss in this ssssystem!"
"Dooooo not insult intelligence! I... *hick* kill you for this!"

choice.text: Scam them into buying some missiles to "blow up" the Pulsar.

event.text: "You arrrre most generous, captain! We take these, for use... *hick* in glorious battle!" You know these missiles will never do anything, but that's not your problem.

choice.text: (Engineer Crew) Have your Engineer explain how Pulsars work.

event.text: Your Engineer sits down with the Free Mantis, and takes almost half an hour explaining that a pulsar is just a star, and that a bunch of ships literally won't be able to do anything against it.

choice.text: (Shell Scientist Crew) Have your Scientist explain how Pulsars work.

event.text: Your Shell gathers the attention of the Free Mantis, and takes almost half an hour explaining that a pulsar is just a star, and that a bunch of ships literally won't be able to do anything against it.

choice.text: Whatever, you do you I guess.

event.text: You fly away from the Free Mantis, knowing their mission won't end very well.
You can't imagine what those ships are attempting to do, but you shouldn't get involved.

name: FREEMANTIS_PHEROMONES
text: The nearby planet is home to a large Zoltan city, whose original population has since abandoned it in favor of its new Free Mantis inhabitants.

choice.text: Land, the Free Mantis should welcome us.

event.text: You land near a coastal region, where you find a peace-keeper vessel waiting! Some Free Mantis are shouting at it, but an armed battalion of peace-keepers stands stonefaced watching them.

It appears the Zoltans are actually stationed in front of a huge laboratory. You don't know what the Free Mantis are using the factory for, but clearly it is high enough priority for the Zoltans to target it.
Attacking a Zoltan Peacekeeper in technically Zoltan territory in order to defend Free Mantis inhabiting an ex-Zoltan city? An action bold enough that it might actually work!
You don't care to disturb the Free Mantis and ignore the city.

name: FREEMANTIS_PHEROMONES_WIN
text: The Free Mantis cheer for you as you land once again. "Federation has done it, saving us from Zoltan!"

event.text: "This? This pheromone concoction laboratory! Here, make finest pheromones. Though, very addictive, sometimes crippling. Oh well, they make soldier very strong! Here, have some, may bring great toughness to crew."

name: FREEMANTIS_BURIAL
text: At first you think the ship nearby might be a transport, but scans show it has been repurposed as a mass grave for the Free Mantis! In Free Mantis culture, the dead are buried with their finest weapons. Maybe we can loot something from the ship?

choice.text: Attack and take what you can!

event.text: "Eek! Ship attacking, run run!" It seems the Free Mantis are running!

choice.text: Request to come aboard and take some stuff.

event.text: "What?! No no no, we cannot allow. These possession key to gate of great beyond! Cannot offering anything more than apologies."
"Eek! Ship attacking, run run!" It seems the Free Mantis are running!

choice.text: (Free Mantis Crew) Convince them it's for a good cause.

event.text: "Well... maybe souls understand, if their key used in name of Federation? Go ahead, take it."
You hand over some scrap to the Free Mantis, in hopes they'll accept the bribe...
You aren't willing to harass the Free Mantis and their past. You apologize and leave.

name: FREEMANTIS_DIPLOMACY
text: The local system this beacon resides in contains a populated world. A Free Mantis Warlord and a Zoltan Peacekeeper vessel seem to be at a tense standoff in orbit. Strangely, their weapons systems are functional, but unpowered. The comm channels are extremely busy, suggesting that a dialogue between the ships is currently going on.

event.text:
The Zoltan vessel responds first. "Renegade, you have caught us in an important talk. This is Ministry Diplomatic Vessel Myrdal, and I am Jelinek. For the past few weeks, we have been in talks with this Warlord, trying to figure out whether we can find a less destructive solution to our territorial dispute."
			The Mantis ship also speaks up to contribute - the voice is noticeably more gentle than most Free Mantis tend to be. "Yes, we were talking to make both sides happy. Talks are hard though, not having a fair voice to determine who is being right and making fair promises."
			The Zoltan sighs. "It would be nice to have an arbitrator. Unfortunately, the Federation is supposedly tied up with the Rebels, and the Gathering doesn't seem to want to send anybody here. Will you hear us out?"

choice.text: Help arbitrate the two sides with your ship as meeting grounds.

event.text:
Two Zoltans and two Free Mantises teleport aboard your ship. The two diplomats are accompanied by a Warlord and a Peacekeeper.
					"Thank you. We'll both present an abbreviated form of our arguments and you can give us some advice. Diplomat Ziiilizekii, would you like to start?"
					"Needing time to review documents, will let Jelinek go first!"

					Nodding, Jelinek begins. "After the Mantis schism following the conflict between the Humans and Hive, the faction known as the Free Mantis coveted territory. The Free Mantis began to settle on worlds within Ministry borders without permission, worlds not far from the planet we hover over today. The Ministry, after a short grace period, sent a cease and desist order, along with a small contingent of ships. The bureaucracy of the Ministry demands that proper procedure be followed at all times within the Ministry. If that is done, we can be very reasonable. However, the ships sent to inform the Free Mantis of their unwarranted occupation of Ministry territory were met with escalation as the ships demanded to continue staying, and violence broke out once the Free Mantis categorically refused to move. It is the opinion of the Ministry that if the Free Mantis wished to settle any worlds, that a full petition should be sent through the bureaucracy of the Federation, where all the members can peaceably discuss which worlds the Free Mantis may settle. The Myrdal has been sent to determine if concessions can possibly be made that can satisfy both parties and end both the fighting and the occupation." Jelinek pauses. "Is my opposing counsel ready?"
					"Yes. Have documents, am ready." Ziiilizekii replies.

Ziiilizekii begins reading from a written document, struggling. "All of us in the Free Mantis were vulnerable shortly after leaving the Hive. We had nowhere to go. The culture we'd grown up with was brutal and violent, it didn't value talking or procedure. We didn't even know that the worlds we first settled belonged to the Zoltans. We picked systems that were close to the Humans, but not within their space. Just when we had started to get our bearings, a fleet of angry vessels came down to demand that we leave. Our leaders told them that we had no knowledge of how to know where we could settle, how to go through Federation or Zoltan bureaucracy. We found worlds to support us and we had our people live there. Our leaders decided we weren't leaving without another world to go to, and the Zoltans said that wasn't their problem, that we had to go. A fight broke out, and the Free Mantis needed to expand. We tried to have the smartest among us petition the Federation for help, but they kept telling us to wait. We understood this to mean that we should wait here, on these worlds... and we have waited. But in the meantime we have to fight the Zoltans who say we cannot wait, we must leave." Ziiilizekii looks up from the paper towards you.
"Well, Renegade. You have heard our arguments. Do you have any suggestions?"

You support the Free Mantis, explaining to the Ministry that they are political fugitives that had no good options. The Ministry diplomat seems frustrated. "What am I supposed to do with that, Renegade? Should I tell the brass that we should feel sorry for the Free Mantis? Our people are being killed over this. You may have... a point, but there is absolutely nothing I can take away from this."
											Ziiilizekii looks to you. "I don't know if that helped, but it encouraging us. Writing is hard, proper writing is harder."
											The Warlord gives you some resources as thanks.

You support the Ministry, explaining to the Mantis that they have to protect their people to the best of their ability and that even sending a diplomatic vessel at all is a show of good faith. The Warlord by Ziiilizekii's side seems furious, but Ziiilizekii doesn't change his tone. "What would you have us do, Renegade? The Federation won't help. The Ministry is attacking us. The Hive wants us dead. We are being shamed, but not shown a good path."
											As the Mantis leave, Jelinek pulls you aside. "We appreciate you listening to reason. This might give us the leverage we need. We can offer you some payment for this."

You tell them that both sides have a point, and tell them that they both need to do better. Once you stop talking, only silence is left in the room. After a beat, both of the diplomats do something resembling a face palm, the Peacekeeper groans, and the Warlord just laughs.
											Jelinek, after a moment, speaks up. "Renegade, do you even understand why we're here? Do you understand why you're here? That's exactly what we've been talking about for weeks."
											Ziiilizekii sighs. "Arbitrators... not what they're cracked up to be. At least, when they're a random multiversal Renegade who doesn't know what's going on."
											"Fair point, we probably shouldn't have expected anything to begin with." Well, at least they agree on something.

Both diplomats look at Mafan strangely. "Hear me out! The Ministry is easily swayed by utilitarian argumentation, so why not take advantage of that? If the Free Mantis can prove that they can contribute to the cause of scientific and societal progress in a mutually beneficial way, then they will have no choice but to accept."
											"Do... you hear yourself?" Jelinek asks.
											Ziiilizekii holds up a limb. "Mantis very happy to help! Many ships, many mantis, many exuberances! Very low regard for our own personal safety. Will be willing to try!"
											Jelinek looks bewildered, but humors Mafan. "Huh... A provisional ceasefire on the basis of scientific progress... well, I guess we might as well see if it works."

Anurak makes soup, and invites both crews aboard your ship. All of them sit in a circle as Anurak passes the soup to all parties. The atmosphere lightens up considerably: as the Zoltans relax, the Mantises begin to see their humanity (for lack of a better term). As the Mantises talk, the Zoltans begin to see them as the friendly, idealistic sort they present themselves to be. Instead of talking about politics or the issues, the Mantis and Zoltan crews seem to start becoming friends. You're not sure if this actually solved any larger problems, but even if it didn't, it seems like the Mantises and the Zoltans might have healed some old wounds.
											
											[Your Zoltan crew have gained 5 more permanent health thanks to Anurak's delicious soup.]

choice.text: (Zoltan Monk) "This dialogue is an important step!"

event.text: The introduction of the Monk makes the Free Mantises wary, but fortunately your Monk is more interested in the prospect of peace than in a biased perspective. A lot of what your monk has to say comes off as a lot of spiritualism and platitudes to you, but both sides seem to take their words with the heart they were clearly intended. Both ships offer you a small reward, but the debate is far from over. After a healthy discussion, you tell both diplomats that you can't stay for too long, but the situation seems better than when you first arrived. Both ships give you some resources to help on your mission.

choice.text: (Freddy) "We're a young civilization, we have a lot of growing to do."

event.text: Freddy apologizes to the Zoltan for the actions of his people and talks about where his people have come in the few years since they've established themselves. Upon talking to Freddy, the Zoltan side claims they understand the Mantis' perspective more now. Peace might still be a ways off, but it does seem more possible now, especially as Freddy's influence with the Free Mantis diplomat will allow for concessions from the Free Mantis side of the debate to come much easier. The Zoltan agree to go back to the Ministry and make a more institutional effort to broker peace if the Free Mantis are willing to do the same. Instead of returning to the diplomatic ship, the Peacekeeper bodyguard offers to remain aboard your ship, showing an interest in your mission.

choice.text: (Ty E'Rel) Have Ty E'Rel show them how it's done.

event.text:
Ty E'Rel cracks his stem and pulls out some legal documents. He quickly commands the respect of both sides with the skill at which he navigates two societies with different sets of values. The treaty is drafted with a language that appeals to both sides without complaint, answering and anticipating questions before they can even be asked. Even small minutiae are covered and addressed, protocols that might seem incidental but clearly have great importance to all parties involved.
											Jelinek salutes the aging Orchid out of respect. "Ty E'Rel... you deserve every bit of fame that you have within the Federation. Perhaps there should be a holiday named after you."
											Ziiilizekii mimes his diplomatic opposite. "Yes, Free Mantis ambassadors will being required to read Ty E'Rel's book! Very glad to meet!"

Your Praetor turns out to be a skilled arbitrator. With the presence of a strong, yet peaceful voice that has no vested interest in either side, the parties begin to feel a lot more comfortable. Your Praetor is able to use their connections to immediately establish communications with the Orchid government; a contingent of skilled Floral diplomats are on their way to continue the arbitration process after you leave.
											"Renegade, I can't express to you how much progress we've achieved today. I'm sure that everything will work out."
											"If Gathering will help, the Free Mantis will finally feel the respect that all Federation species get. Thank you, Renegade!"

Your Caretaker turns out to be a skilled arbitrator. With the presence of a strong, yet peaceful voice that has no vested interest in either side, the parties begin to feel a lot more comfortable. Your Orchid navigates document after document of proposals on each side and quickly drafts notes on every one of them to consider.
											"Will be hard to get word out, but if the Warlords will listen, then we will definitely accept many of these terms!"
											"Some might be hard sell to the Ministry brass, but we have made too much progress for them to ignore. You've done a good deed here, Renegade!"

Your Orchid is a moderately effective arbitrator. The meeting is long and arduous as the Orchid needs to look through several documents and proposals, doing their best to try and find compromises without holding you up too long.
											"Will be hard to get word out, but if the Warlords will listen, then we will definitely accept many of these terms!"
											"Some might be hard sell to the Ministry brass, but we have made too much progress for them to ignore. You've done a good deed here, Renegade!"

choice.text: Help arbitrate the two sides with your ship as meeting grounds.

event.text: You decide to hold the peace talks on your ship, all whilst forgetting the minor detail that your ship is short on oxygen and thus inhospitable to them. They seem aware of this situation though, and decline your offer. They offer you a small consolation gift for trying to help though.

choice.text: I'm not interested in playing politics!

event.text:
The Zoltan diplomat sighs. "Very well. Then we will wait for another mediator. Hopefully it doesn't take too long, but if you can take care of these Rebels, that could certainly go a long way."
					"Beating Rebels will make many things easier. Good luck, Renegade!"
You've seen enough in this sector to suspect that the Zoltans might reward you for eliminating their enemy. You charge your weapons and face the Warlord.
The Free Mantis often pay very generously to protect their new borders. Removing this Peacekeeper will surely be profitable.
It's probably wise to not take part in this matter. You fly to a spot with less company.

name: DISTRESS_FREEMANTIS_BREACHES
text: A Free Mantis ship is adrift near a gas giant in the system. They send you a message upon your arrival: "Needing help! Ghost attack, left lots of holes in ship! Not fast enough to fix... Saving our strength!"

choice.text: (Repair Drone) Have a drone patch up their breaches.
(Anaerobic Crew) Have your anaerobic crew patch up their breaches.
(Orchid Crew) Have your Orchid boost their oxygen output to help them patch up their breaches.
(Adv. Life Support) Counteract the loss of oxygen.
(Clone Bay) Have your crew recklessly fix the breaches to save time.

event.text: You tell your crew not to delay and to fix the breaches as fast as possible. Not everyone makes it back to the ship, but the ship's hull is patched up properly.

removeCrew.text: One of your crewmembers stumbles out of the Clone Bay. They mutter something resembling "this better be worth it".

choice.text: Have your crew patch up their breaches.

event.text: Your crew is careful to repair the breaches. However, accomplishing this feat without suffocating to death ends up being quite time consuming.
The Free Mantis respond to your hostility very quickly. As friendly as they are, they are also quick to fight back.
"Send help, Renegade! Not able to fix! No air!" They don't seem willing to follow you.

name: DISTRESS_FREEMANTIS_STANDOFF
text: Your computer appears to be detecting two separate distress signals here, one from a Federation ship and the other from a Free Mantis ship.

event.text: Indeed, it appears a Federation vessel has gotten into a conflict with some Free Mantis. Who will you help?
This is Free Mantis territory, and you could use their help. You attack the Federation vessel.
The Free Mantis might usually be friendly, but the Federation are with who your true loyalties lie.

choice.text: No one, let's get out of here!

name: QUEST_FREEMANTIS_CAPTIVE
text: You receive a distress call from a Free Mantis clan, who eagerly request your assistance. "Our chief, Kakpakakakakakakakakakakakak has been captured by Suzerains! Please, you must save him!"

event.text: "You are of the kindest beings! Here are co-ordinates, and please bring us back Kakpakakakakakakakakakakakak alive!"
You don't have time to go tracking down missing Free Mantis. You apologize and leave.

name: FREEMANTIS_JAILER_ARRIVAL

unvisitedTooltip.text: A Suzerain Jailer has detained Kakpakakakakakakakakakakakak here.

text: You've found the Suzerain ship you've been tracking! They seem to know you're following them - or maybe they're just really angry - because they attack you as soon as you enter the system!

name: QUEST_FREEMANTIS_MATE
text: It isn't clear what you're looking at at first, but it appears to be the aftermath of two Free Mantis ships colliding with each other at a high velocity. There seems to be minimal power signatures and one of the engines miraculously is still running, but you aren't sure anyone is actually alive.

choice.text: You cannot scrap the remains all on your own.

event.text: To your surprise, you almost immediately receive a response. A cheerful Mantis speaks. "Ah! Federation, this is most fortuitous time. As you see, we are in major predicament. Many my brothers die, but they die valiantly. Are you here to save?"
"Oh, yes. We see Engi do this. Two ships, come together quickly, and they make bigger, stronger ship! We try it too. However, it doesn't work as expected. Clearly, we forgot step."

choice.text: Try to pry their ships apart.

event.text: "Oh, I don't think that's greatest of idea. True, we did pretty stupid thing. But, too late to separate ships."

choice.text: Offer to transport their crew to their clan.

event.text: "Oh, greatest of thanks. I bring my friends, one second." A large group of ten or so Free Mantis come aboard carrying various possessions. You tell them to make themselves at home in the cargo bay until you can find their clan grounds.

"Oh, understandable. You have important Fed things to do, yes. But, if it happens, here are locations of clan. Maybe you see them, and tell them where we are?" You agree to notify their clan if you happen to see them.

choice.text: Offer to transport their crew to their clan.

event.text: "Oh, greatest of thanks. I bring my friends, one second." A large group of ten or so Free Mantis come aboard carrying various possessions. You tell them to make themselves at home in the cargo bay until you can find their clan grounds.

"Oh, understandable. You have important Fed things to do, yes. But, if it happens, here are locations of clan. Maybe you see them, and tell them where we are?" You agree to notify their clan if you happen to see them.
You don't feel like looting wrecks that might still have survivors aboard. You leave them to drift.

name: FREEMANTIS_MATE_RESCUE_CLAN

unvisitedTooltip.text: Location of the clan of the Free Mantis survivors you took aboard.

text: You have arrived at the location of the Free Mantis clan. You drop off the survivors, and the clan thanks you greatly. They offer you one of their finest soldiers in tribute.

name: FREEMANTIS_MATE_CLAN

unvisitedTooltip.text: Location of a Free Mantis clan to inform about an 'accident'.

text: You have arrived at the location of the Free Mantis clan. You explain the situation to the clan leader, who seems rather perplexed. "Yes... they aren't smartest of Mantis. Still, we thank you." They gather a group to go retrieve the survivors, and pay you in scrap.

name: ENCOUNTER_FREEMANTIS_BOAST
text: An entourage of Free Mantis ships approach, and their leader hails you, boasting of his success in combat. "Fleshmeat! You surely come to see myself in combat? Yes, see it you shall. Prepare to be amazed!"

name: ENCOUNTER_FREEMANTIS_CONFUSED_NORMAL
text: You are hailed by a Free Mantis ship, whose captain immediately begins to slander you. "Rebel scum! You will rue the day you messed my clan! I will remove head, and bring it as gift to my Federation friends!" He roars and ends the transmission. You aren't sure how they confused you as a Rebel ship, but looks like there's no talking your way out of this one.

name: ENCOUNTER_FREEMANTIS_CONFUSED_REBEL
text: You are hailed by a Free Mantis ship, whose captain immediately begins to slander you. "Rebel scum! You will rue the day you messed my clan! I will remove head, and bring it as gift to my Federation friends!" He roars and ends the transmission. You have no one but yourself to blame this time, seeing as you had the splendid idea of flying an actual Rebel vessel right in the territory of the Free Mantis.

name: ENCOUNTER_FREEMANTIS_BROKEN_COMM
text: A nearby Free Mantis ship sends you a message. "Wanting fight practice! But comm broken, can't hear... Idea! You firing on us if you want to say no, or not doing so to say yes."

event.text: "We're under attack! Return fire!" You aren't sure if they misunderstood you or if you misunderstood them, but now it looks like you'll have to fight your way out of this.
"Good! We are wanting to fight too." The Free Mantis ship understands your lack of action to mean that you want to fight!
"Renegade? Where have you gone?" It looks like you managed to get away from the clueless Mantises.

choice.text: (Repair Bomb) Remotely fix their communications and tell them you don't want to fight.

event.text: The Mantises are shocked at your ability to remotely repair their systems. "You are fixing our ship? From over there?" The grateful Free Mantis decide to gift you with some of their leftover spoils.

name: ENCOUNTER_FREEMANTIS_SUN
text: A Free Mantis ship and a sun both share this beacon. "Ah, fellow fighter! Welcome, and let us test skills against each other."

name: ENCOUNTER_MANTIS_FREEMANTIS_ASTEROID
text: A Mantis hunter adorned with Mantis intestines, most likely once belonging to the Free Mantis, is hiding in the nearby asteroid field. They move in to attack!

name: ENCOUNTER_ZOLTAN_FREEMANTIS_RESCUE
text: Ever since the Free Mantis stepped foot in Ministry territory, the two factions have been going at it for years. It looks like a Zoltan vessel is assaulting a Free Mantis outpost - but as soon as they see you they think you've come to assist the Mantis and attack!

name: ENCOUNTER_FREEMANTIS_ELITE
text: The Free Mantis have designated this sector as their hunting grounds, and as such many powerful Free Mantis Warlords linger, waiting for prey. Though they don't usually target Federation ships, it seems the elite vessel here is taking its chances!

name: FREEMANTIS_ZOLTAN_KILLER
text: The Free Mantis haven't reacted well to the Zoltan's aggressive resistance to their presence, but the ship at this beacon appears to have taken that to the next level...

event.text: "Federation? Have come to admire brilliant arsenal of disgusting Zoltan piglet murder? If wanted, we share tech with you, so you may murder energy freak too!"
"Enjoy murdering, Federation! Come by again sometime, and we share mutual stories of hunt!"

choice.text: Ask about their large Beam weapon.

event.text: "Eh? This is Zoltan Deleter, cherished weapon that murder Zoltan fast! But not to kill others, that rude. If Federation want gun, they must prove worthy!"
"Oh? Then let most daunting battle begin!"
"Heheh, smart choice. None best me yet, Zoltan Deleter mine forever!"
"Alright, not all scrap spent when sometimes arsenal already kill!"
If these guys are willing to go this far to express their hatred of the Zoltans, chances are they won't be very friendly to others either.

name: FREEMANTIS_FLEET_MONITION
text: This system appears to be primarily empty, save for a singular Free Mantis vessel. Biometric scans, even from long range, show they're panicking, though nothing on their ship seems out of the ordinary.

event.text: "Oh dear oh dear oh dear oh dear oh dear oh dear, we doomed, royally screwed, very oh not good! Zoltan, Mantis, working together, sent massive fleet, attacking Freddy, grand leader of ours! This truly end of Free Mantis, all is doomed!"

choice.text: Calm down, maybe we can help.

event.text: "YOU HELP?! MOST WONDERFUL YES! TAKE COORDINATES, HURRY HURRY, NOT TIME TO LOSE!" The Mantis transmit the coordinates of a Mantis Bishop. This ship must be the one keeping "Freddy" captive.
"OH OH, ONE MORE! MANY THANKS, FEDERATION!" The Mantis transmit more coordinates, this time of a Zoltan cruiser. This ship must be the one leading the attack.

choice.text: These guys are crazy, we need to leave.

event.text: These guys are probably crazed pheromone addicts, nothing worth messing with.

name: FREEMANTIS_FLEET_BISHOP
text: You've arrived at the coordinates given, where you find a very well armed Bishop vessel. On your vid screen appears a Mantis Bishop, one of Queen Leikonpliiinakra's own ruling sovereigns!

event.text: "Ugh, Federation filth? The Zoltans promised no interference. If you want a fight, so be it!" If you want to save Freddy from them, you'll have to kill their crew... which could prove to be quite the challenge.

name: FREEMANTIS_FLEET_FREDDYSAVE
text: You dig through the cargobay of the Bishop ship, and find a prison hold. One cell is marked by a crudely written document describing its prisoner as "dumb stupid free mantis leader man".

event.text: You pry open the prison cell, only to be greeted by an elegant and well composed Free Mantis sipping tea through an antique human teapot. He speaks to you in a suave and unnaturally human voice. "Ahhh, friends. Welcome to my most... er, humble abode. Yes yes, quite humble indeed. Would you care to join me? Come, have a seat. You can have my chair, my biology is not well suited for sitting anyways."

"Why yes, technically. That is the name I go by. A long time ago I met a man, a kind man, and I taught him my language. In return, he taught me his. He struggled to say my name, and so he gave me a new one. My real name has too many syllables, it brings an unpleasant taste to my tongue. So please, call me Freddy."

choice.text: You seem unusually well spoken for a Mantis.

event.text: Freddy snorts. "Yes well, we could all speak this well if we gave ourselves a proper education and didn't rot our braincells away with pheromones. I'm one of the original founders of the Free Mantis. Yes yes, I know, I'm quite old. But make no hasty assumptions, I'm as skilled a fighter as they come. Just let my armor be evidence. These claws have laid waste to some of Leikonpliiinakra's finest Bishops."

"Now then, without further ado... You've come here to rescue me, yes?" He wastes no time waiting for you to respond. "Let us hurry. I wish to linger as little as possible in this dank cave of suffering. I do hope you have tea aboard your vessel..."

name: FREEMANTIS_FLEET_ZOLTAN
text: You've arrived at the coordinates given, where you find a strangely colored Monk Cruiser. On your vid screen appears a colorfully robed monk, probably some prestigious prophet of sorts.

event.text: "I foresaw you coming here. You have come to kill us, in the name of the barbaric Mantis laborers that you continue to manipulate for your own gain? Truly sad, but it matters little. As the Great Eye has promised me, thou shall not be alive much longer!"

choice.text: Isn't murder against the monk lifestyle?

event.text: "Welllll yes, but I'm sure the Great Eye won't mind, and holy texts can always be appended. Besides, I won't be the one killing you. My men will!"

name: FREEMANTIS_FLEET_ZOLTAN_WIN
text: The ASB in the distance stops as the Zoltan fleet falls silent. "Well uh, now that the prophet is dead, we'll just leave I guess. No one really cared about the Free Mantis other than him anyways." The Zoltans jump away.

event.text: Several Free Mantis ships jump in, applauding you. "Federation did it, liberated us from attackers! They save all Free Mantis from Zoltan plague! They hero, chant for them!" The Free Mantis begin to chant your name in unison, and several ships are sent forth to bestow you with many gifts of honor.

destroyed.text: The Bishop vessel has been destroyed. The Hive is now short of one more Bishop, but the Free Mantis are now short of one more leader as well.

deadCrew.text: The last of the Mantis warriors have fallen, and the Bishop vessel comes to a halt.

destroyed.text: "NOOOOO, HOW COULD THIS BE? THE EYE NEVER LIIIIEEEESSSSS!" The Monk cruiser explodes, sending rainbow pieces of debris flying in all directions.

deadCrew.text: "NOOOOO, HOW COULD THIS BE? THE EYE NEVER LIIIIEEEESSSSS!" The Monk cruiser suddenly falls silent, void of any life signs.

name: ORCHID_UNARMED
text: A tiny Orchid civilian vessel awaits you at the beacon. They sign to you, "A Renegade? I never thought I'd really be face to face with one of you! Oh oh, wait! Here, have this as a gift! Thank you for your service to the Federation, captain!"

choice.text: Extort additional resources: they surely have more.

event.text: "What are you doing? No no no, please! Don't hurt us! I'll give you everything I can, just please let me go! I have a family! My children haven't even outgrown their planter yet!"

As soon as they've finished transferring the supplies, the Orchids jump away. Your pockets are a lot heavier now, but it's not often you meet someone with a high respect for Renegades, and now you've tarnished it forever.

choice.text: Kill the Orchid and take everything he has.

event.text: You send your crew over aboard to the ship and slaughter the Orchid and his few crew members. In his final moments, the captain manages only to whisper his first spoken word since you met him - a simple "Why?" Disappointingly, you don't find too much more than what he had already offered.

name: ORCHID_BOTANICAL_GALLERY
text: A giant Orchid station is located at the beacon. It's marked as an "Augmented Botanical Gallery" on your star map.

event.text: The atmosphere of tranquillity with a small touch of curiosity fills the main hall. There are all kinds of strange exhibits in the gallery. You wonder which to visit.

choice.text: Pay an entry fee to visit "May's Burst".

event.text: The exhibit contains a giant sphere, protected from all sides with reinforced metal coating. Giant trees are growing inside. You are a bit disappointed.

Suddenly, a series of explosions rocks the entire station wing. The trees are bursting, releasing giant kernels out. The protective sphere can barely stop the kernels from destroying the station. The service Orchids offer a weapon created for firing kernels for free.

choice.text: Pay an entry fee to visit "Ham Pie".

event.text: The exhibit contains a field of... grass. It looks like usual Earth grass with plain flowers but has a strangely familiar leaf pattern. Was it really worth it?

After a few minutes on the meadow you feel your worries go away, a desire to laugh, and an irresistible urge to hug a Mantis nearby. After a while, you and the Mantis who turned out to be another visitor become best friends and they agree to join your crew.

choice.text: Pay an entry fee to visit "Quick Sap".

event.text: This exhibit is a giant machine which is made entirely from plant matter. The contraption tap lean white-barked trees of sap and moves the sap into the processing part which outputs a liquid advertised as high quality FTL fuel.
Since you have already paid for entry, the Orchids are offering some of the experimental fuel for free.

choice.text: Leave the gallery without visiting anything.

event.text: You have no interest in the station.

name: ORCHID_SEEDS
text: A large seed-like pod drifts by, made partly of organic matter and clearly of Gathering design. Typically, these pods contain various valuables, resources, or humanitarian supplies. This one however seems different, althought you're not quite sure why.

choice.text: Take the risk and open it.
(Floral Crew) Have your Orchid inform you about the pod's purpose.

event.text: Your Orchid explains that this is a seedling pod, made from the strongest of titanwood. They can contain numerous different things, from Orchid crew to Kernel weapons!

choice.text: If we can't predict what's inside, we shouldn't open it.

event.text: Though you now know the pod's purpose, that doesn't eliminate any risk of opening it.

choice.text: Ignore the pod, it could be dangerous.

event.text: You let the bizarre pod drift on through space.

name: ORCHID_TERRAFORMERS
text: A Gathering scout hails you, asking for the "prudent services of a well-equipped vessel". They explain that the nearby planet which they've been tasked to investigate is a candidate for a terraforming operation. However, they've since heard rumors of a potential Coalition spy operation hosted on the surface, and command didn't properly outfit them to handle such matters. They request that you investigate for them, and permit you to keep anything valuable you find.

event.text: You don't have the time, or maybe the courage, to go poking around for potential Coalition bases.

name: ORCHID_TERRAFORMER_COALITION_WIN
text: The Florals are thankful for your assistance, although highly alarmed at the presence of the base. "It's the Weedlings, trying to join the Coalition! It's given them justification to start spying on us to try and win those swampland bastards over! Hopefully once we report this to command, they'll file a request for Federation support."

name: ORCHID_PETITION
text: A Gathering vessel nearby hails you. "Captain, are you of high standing with the Federation? If so, we could use your influence! The Gathering's insistence on maintaining our economic system in such fashions has proved disastrous for our economy! The Confederates are outcompeting us ten-fold! Would you sign this petition, so that we may one day soon begin heavier industrialization ourselves?"

event.text:
Mayeb points sternly at the Orchid. "Pardon me, but wouldn't your organization happen to be funded by the Flowering Infrastructure of the Gathering?"

The Orchid lowers his paper and he starts to squint. "Oh no."

"Yes, of course I know who you are. Your organizations are always trying to pitch a fit about 'oh, the economy, the poor economy' - You're just looking out for yourselves! Not that I particularly care about money, but for the average civilian, true economic enrichment requires that we keep them and their environment in safety."

"I don't have to listen to this!" The Orchid's ship starts to arm itself - it looks like she's provoked them.
You scribble your name on the paper, pledging your support to the industrialization of the Gardenworlds. "Thank you so kindly captain! Some day the Gathering will thank you for this!"

choice.text: Sign the petition and offer a charitable donation.

event.text: You scribble your name on the paper and also have your crew pass over some extra scrap from the cargo bay.
"Oh, wow! May Cyrtal'y Mncolo provide you its greatest bounties! I did not know foreigners could be so generous... Some day the Gathering will thank you for this!"
The Florals nod. "I am dissapointed, but I can respect your decision. Safe travels."

You point your finger at the plants and laugh at their silly attempts to improve the economy. The Floral captain growls, and their vines perk up in anger. "You could simply have said no! There was no necessity in mocking us for wishing better for our own people!"

name: ORCHID_KERNEL_FOREST
text: This planet boasts a stunning array of alien flora. It's quite the spectacle.

event.text: You find a lone Orchid wandering about the forest, a single watering can in hand. He waves to you as you land nearby and exit your ship. "Welcome to my gardens. I hope you enjoy!"
"Yes, that is correct. I am the Caretaker of this planet. This is one of the planets on which we grow the plant components of our Kernel weapons. Would you care to purchase one?"

choice.text: (Floral Crew) Ask the Caretaker to join you.

event.text: "Oh... I don't know if I could... this is a very important job... though I don't get out much... I'm sure the gardens will be fine until I return."

choice.text: Attempt to steal one of the weapons.

event.text: You arm your weapons, hoping it won't take much to convince the Orchid to hand over a weapon. Instead, an Orchid ship comes flying from nowhere and attacks! You're chased out of the garden by the ship, but they won't let you go without a fight.

choice.text: We aren't interested in buying anything.
Ok, time's up. Let's get moving.

event.text: You don't have time to gaze at all the plant life, you must hurry on with your mission.

name: ORCHID_MEGATREE
text: In the distance lies a giant, well-developed Orchid city. You don't often see Orchid communities up close, and this one appears to be unique. A giant tree with a stadium around it has been built in the center of the city for all to see. It looks to be a tourist attraction of sorts.

event.text: You receive a popup on your screen asking for your native language. After configuring it from a very long list of dialects, a voice welcomes you to what is referred to as D'Wretq Aeth in Orchid dialect, though people in your language often call it 'The Mega Tree'.
The virtual tour guide offers to give you a full guide of the tree and the history of its origins, for a small fee.

The tour guide then launches into a long and incredibly boring tale of Orchid diplomatic missions with the Rockmen, some minor civil wars among two Orchid clans, the founding of the new Orchid government, an increase in intergalactic pesticide usage, and concerns over vegetarianism. One story does catch your attention however, a tale about a powerful Kernel weapon buried underneath the tree during a pirate raid.
You attempt to land near the base of the tree, but an Orchid guard stops you, furious that you dare try to harm the tree.

choice.text: (Floral Crew) Convince the Mega-Tree guards to let you have the weapon.
(Caretaker Crew) Convince the Mega-Tree guards to let you have the weapon.
(Praetor Crew) Convince the Mega-Tree guards to let you have the weapon.
(Mayeb) Convince the Mega-Tree guards to let you have the weapon.

event.text: Mayeb explains to the guards that with her years of gardening experience, retrieving the Kernel weapon without harming the tree should be easy with her supervision. After a brief discussion among themselves, they agree to this proposal. It doesn't take long to excavate it, and indeed the tree appears to be entirely unharmed at the end of it.

choice.text: (Ty E'Rel) Convince the Mega-Tree guards to let you have the weapon.

event.text: You leave Ty E'rel on the comms to organize an agreement with the guards regarding the buried weapon. The negotiating is almost astonishingly boring, with the names of numerous treaties and agreements you didn't even know existed flying around throughout. After a few dull minutes, your crew are cleared to retrieve the Kernel weapon.

choice.text: (Flares) Launch a flare to distract the guards and buy you time.

event.text: Baffled by the array of holographic discs, most of the tree's defense moves to investigate. Your crew slip past and quickly dig up the weapon and some spare ammunition then slip away without being noticed.

choice.text: We can't risk it. Just leave.

event.text: The voice doesn't speak to you again. After a while you get bored and leave.
Your mission is too important to be spending time at alien tourist locations.

name: ORCHID_MEGATREE_WIN
text: Civilians and tourists alike flee in terror as the guard plummets into the base of the tree, setting it ablaze. You hurry out of the ship and break a hole in the trunk, surprised to find it hollow. You hurry through the smoke and grab the Kernel weapon and head back to the ship.

name: ORCHID_REFUGEES
text: As you approach the beacon, you notice a Syndicate vessel accosting what seems to be a Gathering immigration center! You catch a few scattered messages between the two parties. "Hand over the fugitive immediately and no one else has to get hurt! You think you can hide them forever? The Theocracy will just keep sending more and more troops until you're all dead! You fancy a Crusader bashing down your doors right now?"

event.text: You won't stand for such a blatant injustice when you can have your word in it. You align your crosshairs on mercenary scum once more.
There's not much reason for you to get involved in this, and it could be dangerous anyways.

name: ORCHID_REFUGEES_WIN
text: The station is in utter disarray, with prospectful immigrants and Gathering staff members alike huddled under makeshift shelter, and a scattering of disorganized security guards on the alert. You receive a hail not from the staff but rather from a lone Rockman. "Thank god you came! The Mercenaries jammed the comms and the staff couldn't send a distress signal to the Praetorian in time! My name's Korben, and I trust you're friendly faces. I was a Lost Sun once, but I wanted a new life away from the fighting. Bless Ariadne, she arranged everything personally to get me out of there! The Gathering seemed a better choice over the Union for a new life, but now it seems I'll never be free of these mercenaries!"

choice.text: Offer to take him with you.

event.text: "I'm not... too inclined to join back up with another military operation, but I suppose saving the Multiverse takes a bit of a higher precedent anyways, right? Maybe once this is over, the Theocracy will finally give up on me."

choice.text: (Ariadne) "Buckle up soldier, the Multiverse needs all the help it can get."

event.text: At the sight of the admiral, Korben breaks into a salute. "Admiral! Of course! I will do everything I can to assist. I can seek a new life after, but under the rule of the Rebellion, none of us will be safe!"
"Er... yes, of course. You've already helped more than enough. I'll talk to the staff, and make sure you're rewarded for this..."

name: ORCHID_ESCAPE
text: You encounter a giant Gathering transport ship with a military escort. You receive a hail from somewhere onboard. "Please help me. I've been wrongfully detained and broken free from my cell. They'll find me soon, if you rescue me I'll do whatever you want!"

event.text: The Floral captain is pleased with your effort to help them. "I knew the Federation had our back." He gestures towards the Orchid you just turned in. "We caught this one stealing government secrets. Some kind of capitalist spy from the Confederacy, I presume. He'll face just action in time, but for your loyalty it seems a reward is in order!"

choice.text: (Upg. Teleporter) Teleport the Orchid aboard unnoticed.

event.text: You lock onto the Orchid with your teleporter and beam him aboard. "Thank you, captain. I was so afraid... they think I'm a spy for the Confederacy! I'd have been executed if you hadn't helped me! The Praetorian has been cracking down, to the point anyone's a suspect unless they're a true greenblood! It's madness!"
You don't need any more crew, and this sounds shady regardless.

name: ORCHID_MERCENARY
text: An unarmed Floral Caretaker vessel is trying to flee from a Syndicate mercenary vessel that's chasing them. You have no idea what the reason would be, but should you do something to save them?

event.text: You fire a warning shot and the pirate ship changes direction to face you. "Ah shit, Renegade scum? Of course it'd be you who decides to interfere with Syndicate contracts! Fine, have it your way. We'll just kill you first!"

choice.text: Bribe the Syndicate into leaving them alone.

event.text: "Hmmm... that is a lot of scrap. And if we can get the bounty too, well that's even better!" The mercenary turns to the Orchids and warns them. "Now you better play nice and play dead! Otherwise, we'll be back here soon to finish the job!" Once the mercenaries jump away, the Floral thanks you and pleads for you in sign language to take them. "Please, ever since I got involved in that radical cell wanting to ditch communism, I've been followed everywhere by people wanting me dead! I can't go back to my old life, but maybe I can find a new one with you!"

choice.text: Decline and ask for alternative payment.

event.text: For as much as the Syndicate and Renegades don't get along, no reason to get involved in this business.

name: ORCHID_SLAVES
text: A rogue ship awaits you at the beacon. "Laborers for cheap! Can be used as oxygen emitters, cannon fodder, gifts to tribal chiefs, firewood, or healthy food!" The pirate scratches his chin. "Not that I support cannibalism. I'm just saying, they're very versatile."

choice.text: Piracy is despicable. Attack the slavers!

event.text: You attack the slavers.

choice.text: (Caretaker Crew) Appeal to the pirates' better interests.

event.text: You don't bother engaging the slaver.

name: ORCHID_INSULT
text: You are surprised to find a Kleptocracy vessel here, considering the Slugs have few connections to the Gathering. The Slugs are requesting to communicate using an encrypted channel.

choice.text: Agree to talk with the Slugs.
