name: HEKTAR_HEADQUARTERS
text: This distress beacon has landed you somewhere unexpected - a lush terraformed paradise, housing in its center a vast ring shaped building which is home to none other than Hektar HQ. Strangely, the distress beacon is broadcasting only on a few specific frequencies, one of which is a more secretive Federation channel.

event.text: You land on the HQ landing pad, surprised to find no intervention from any kind of security. As you approach the building however, you're stopped by a rather dangerous looking security system, which refuses you entry.

Your attempt at entry is met by alarms, which activate security turrets that fire upon your ship! Fortunately, you're able to shut them down and gain access afterwards, but your ship has taken a beating.

choice.text: Let this one go - could be a trap.

event.text: Very strange for such a signal to be so far out here. It has to be a trap, there's no other explanation, right? You prepare to leave.

name: BILLY
text: Looks like your attempt to enter was successful. You carry on throughout the building, but it's clear things aren't too good in here. Faint blood stains decorate the walls, mostly the bright green sludge known to spill out of dead Slugs. It's weeks old though, a foreboding omen of the state of what you might find deeper inside.

event.text: At last, you come across an open office door. Stepping inside, you find a blue Slug slumped over a desk, silently sobbing to himself. He perks up when he sees you, and his demeanor quickly changes between shock, terror, anger, and finally defeat. "Sssso, you've finally come to kill me? I knew the deadline would arrive... Well, you have me now. I give up. Jusssst kill me."

choice.text: Who are you? And who is trying to kill you?

event.text: The Slug seems to realize you aren't who he expected. "Wait - you aren't Taurussss! I'm SSSSAVED! SSSSAVED! Hahah! I am Billy Hektar, CEO of Hektar and Great Grand-child to Carle Hektar, founder of Hektar Industriesss! I knew that sssignal would reach sssomeone eventually! Unfortunately, I've been trapped in my office for monthssss, forced to run thisss company like a crime ring rather than a bussssinessss..."

choice.text: You trapped yourself in your office?

event.text: "What? No, you dumbassss. Hektar hasss alwaysss been the underdog, but when I inherited the company along with my brother, we hoped to make thissss company really sssshine! And then Zulfiqar came along and completely monopolized the entire weapon indussstry. I tried to sssave the company, but my brother didn't appreciate my methodssss. Sssso what if I enssslaved a ssspecies of primitive lizardssss?!"

choice.text: I don't see how that led to you being trapped in an office.

event.text: "I'm getting there, relax! After he left the company... okay well, I kind of forced him out. But that'ssss not the point! Thingssss went downhill. I couldn't keep my invessstorsss paid. One by one, they left. Sssoon, only sssome grease ssstain named Tony Senior and that bassstard Vael wasss left. That handsssome ssson of a bitch... er, I mean, that sssson of a bitch."

choice.text: Wait- Do you mean THE Vael? Leader of the Syndicate?!

event.text: "The one in charge of all mercenariessss in the galaxy? Yeah that one. Oh, and by the way. Might be important to mention that by entering thissss facility, you've set off an alarm, and now he'ssss probably going to send an assssassssin to come and kill usss both. Fair warning, and all that."

choice.text: Get the hell out of here!

event.text: As you're hurrying out of the office, you stop to notice a second ship has landed on next to yours. A massive Stealth-like vessel, and next to it is a human, dressed in a painted MFK uniform. "A nice ship you got there, partner. Now, hand over the Slug and no one gets hurt."

The man pauses as if contemplating how to respond. "Name's Taurus. One of Vael's 'enforcers'. Folks like you call us the Angels o' Death. Ain't that fitting?" He turns his attention to Billy. "Now now Billster, your time is up. Vael's tired of your malarkey. You oughta know by now when you mess with men like him, you better keep your promises." He turns back to you. "Now, last time I'm gonna ask. Hand over the Slug, and we can all walk away like nothing happened."

"Ain't that sweet. I was hoping you'd refuse. You've got one sweet bounty on your skull and I'd love to cash you in." Taurus smiles menacingly then dashes back to his ship, whose engines have already powered up. This is going to be a rough one.

Taurus smiles smugly, mockingly shakes your hand, then handcuffs Billy and escorts him back to his ship. "This goes without saying, but you best hope we don't run into each other again, partner. There's one hell of a bounty on your head, and frankly, I'm making a mistake not cashing it in..."

You have no idea who this guy is, but you don't care. He literally said to kill him - why wouldn't you oblige? You shoot the Slug square in the head, killing him almost instantly and painting the wall green. Looks like that's the end to this mystery.

name: BILLY_SAVE
text: With Billy now safe, you take one last trip past the wreckage. To your surprise, you dig out what appears to be a highly advanced weapon powered by bizarrely foreign yet similar tech. You aren't sure where it's from, but you'll take it. Billy also has a team come in to scan the ship and retrieve its blueprint, which will make a fine addition to your hangar.

event.text: Billy seems to be making himself comfortable in your ship's lounge. "I think nowsss asss good of a time asss any for old Billy to take a relaxing vacation from all of thisss chaossss. And taxesss. Sssay, ssstranger, where you headed?"

choice.text: We're off to save all of reality from the interdimensional Rebellion.

event.text: "O-oh. Wait... interdimensssional heroesss probably don't pay their taxessss, do they? Hahah baby, no more taxesss here I come! Oh, and sssaving reality issss cool too, I guessss."

choice.text: One last thing - what about our debt?

event.text: "Right... right... Yeah I can take care of that, fair isss fair. You know, it might be a good idea to let everyone here go now. Thisss will be a PR disssasster if it ever got out..."

name: BILLY_DEAD
text: You look around the ship to see where Billy went, but it dawns on you - he didn't survive the fight. Looks like you won't be clearing off that debt any time soon then...

event.text: You make one last trip back to the Angel's ship, and see what you might find inside. To your surprise, you dig out what appears to be a highly advanced weapon powered by bizzarely foreign yet familiar tech. You aren't sure where it's from, but you'll take it.

name: HEKTAR_SHIPYARDS
text: At first this beacon seems rather unassuming, until you spot the massive spherical shipyard hovering above the ground. Upon further inspection, beneath it appears to be a rural village of some sort, definitely not one of a space-faring species at least. The village below is bustling with what looks to be lizard creatures. You've noticed these guys working aboard Hektar ships before, but with an educated guess you can assume this is where they live. Very strange, but as you approach the shipyard, it becomes apparent there's more here than you first observed. An orange spectacled lizard with a suit and backwards tie is screaming into a megaphone trying to calm down a crowd of irate lizards with picket signs and armed weapons.

event.text: You land your ship nearby, unnoticed by the crowd. The lizard in charge turns to you, while you catch shouts of "traitor" and more offensive terms being hurled towards them. "Yes, yes, hello. I am Metyunt, the manager of this facility and caretaker of the Lizard... uh... population. Workforce. Yes, that's the word." Metyunt pushes the glasses back up onto his face, unfazed while a flaming stone is thrown nearby and some lizard rioters tear apart a Hektar ship in the background. You also notice a very large Slug ship hovering above the crowd. It's not firing yet, but you suspect if the crowd pushes things too far, this is their plan to suppress it.

Metyunt seems slightly uncomfortable. "Yes, I am glad to see you are not in fact blind. These riots are common, but what can you do? They call me a traitor because I 'sold out my own species to a corporation', but look at it this way. It's paid labor, and they signed the contracts. We were living in squalor, but our queen-chief Thek and her council thought it wise to make some... trade agreements with Hektar after we were approached by two Slugs with a deal. I'm just the mediator, and we're better off with this path anyways. Hektar supplies our species with weapons and armaments, and we supply them with work. If we didn't arrange this, then soon enough we'd either be forced to migrate to some wasteland planet by a Ministry contractor looking to build a new law school, or left for dead when the Rebels come calling." 
					
					Metyunt reaches for a bottle of eye drops and drips them into his eye, then ducks as some alien fruit comes whirling by. "I'm doing my best to keep the working conditions fair and orderly, but they just can't see that! I need them to open their eye, because if it weren't for me, Hektar would be a hell of a lot crueler." 
					
					Metyunt makes a sideways glance up at the ship above you both.

choice.text: That doesn't sound like helping your species.

event.text: "Well I'm sorry if you don't agree, but as I may remind you, you're in debt to the Hektar corporation, so I'm not inclined to take advice from you. I suggest you leave, I have enough to handle at the present moment." Metyunt only barely finishes his sentence when an explosion sends you all flying forward as one of the rioters accidentally sets off an explosive charge in one of the ships stored in the hangar. The Hektar officers watching spring into action and Metyunt follows behind them latching onto the one in charge and trying to stop him from giving the order to fire. The Slug grabs the lizard by the tail and flings Metyunt away, then orders the vessel above to open fire on the crowd. The lizards scatter as lasers pelt them from above. If you're going to get involved, now is the time to do so!
You rush back to your ship as quick as possible and return to the hangar to fight the vessel.

choice.text: They're just blind, you're right. Side with Metyunt.

event.text: Using all the might in your voice that you can muster, you call out to the crowd and demand they stand down. They refuse, but using a charismatic technique in the Renegade business called "pointing your gun at someone", the lizards seem to see the reason in your words and go scurrying back to their huts. Strangely, Metyunt seems more perturbed than relieved by this, but the Hektar officers who were watching are grateful and offer a reward.

choice.text: (Guntput) "You are big idiot! Our species still in danger!"

event.text:
Metyunt does a double take when he sees Guntput aboard your crew. "Shaman? Wh-what are you doing here?" Guntput wacks him on the top of his head with a large branch laying nearby.
							
							"Hektar has betrayed us, fool! The weapons never came, and the queen-chief has abandoned us! Now, we are being taken as slaves, yet you stand here and say we are better off? You are either naive idiot or malevolent jester! Take your pick!" Guntput swipes his spear at Metyunt, who leaps backwards as several Hektar employees shuffle forward and draw their guns in precaution, but Metyunt tells them to put their guns away.
							"Shaman, I'm tr-"
							"Do not call me that name! You do not owe me respect when you have abandoned our species for greedy capitalist slimemongers!"
							"Okay, then Guntp-"
							"No, do not call me by name either! You are not deserving to utter it!"
							"Please, I'm trying to reason with you! I didn't abandon our species, I did my best to HELP us! Thek made up her mind on the deal, all I did was negotiate a more hospitable offer. It wasn't even going to be paid labor! There's only so much leeway I can get with Hektar, but I did everything I could!"
							"Nonsense and malarkey! You are lying through teeth. If you did not abandon us, then why are you living here, wearing suit and backwards tie, monocle and carrying clipboard!"
							
							Metyunt is left at a loss for words, but before he can find any, an explosion sends you all flying forward as one of the rioters accidentally sets off an explosive charge in one of the ships stored in the hangar. The Hektar officers watching spring into action and Metyunt follows behind them latching onto the one in charge and trying to stop him from giving the order to fire. The Slug grabs the lizard by the tail and flings Metyunt away, then orders the vessel above to open fire on the crowd. The lizards scatter as lasers pelt them from above. If you're going to get involved, now is the time to do so!
As you rush back to your ship Guntput turns around and yells one final insult at Metyunt, "Now we go to save our species, unlike you ever could! Maybe you can learn something from it!"

choice.text: This isn't our business. Stay uninvolved.

event.text: Curious as it is, it's very unlikely there's anything here that requires your input.

name: HEKTAR_SHIPYARDS_WIN
text: With the ship out of the way, you return to the shipyard. During the battle, the rioters seem to have taken control a large portion of the hangar, but the remaining Hektar staff are pushing back. This could end in even more bloodshed if you don't step in.

choice.text: Convince Metyunt to talk them into standing down.

event.text: You call out to Metyunt, appealing to him to defuse the situation. He falters but calls out to Hektar, demanding they stand down. They refuse at first, but once Metyunt threatens to get Billy involved they stand down. Once Hektar has cleared out, the lizards swarm the rest of the place and capture Metyunt while cheering for your crew. All that seems in question now is the fate of Metyunt.

The lizards groan, but they aren't going to question you after how much you helped them. Metyunt seems shocked he hasn't been torn limb from limb yet. "Well uh, I uh... why did you spare me? Second chances? My kind doesn't believe in those, but I guess I'm too far displaced from our traditions to care." It's obvious the lizards don't want Metyunt around. You offer to drop him off somewhere else in the sector, but he declines. "I'm afraid it is best if I find a different occupation. Hektar will have to make do without my help, because I'm done. I guess I'll stick with you now. Oh, and before we go, let me repay you..."

choice.text: He's had his chance. He shouldn't get any more.

event.text: The lizards agree, and a makeshift gallow is constructed from which Metyunt is hung. You didn't quite expect things to be taken that far, but it's too late now. The lizards applaud their newfound freedom, though chances are it won't last as soon as you're gone and Hektar sends in reinforcements. Nevertheless, the lizards thank you and offer a reward "borrowed" from another Hektar ship.

choice.text: We can't risk it. Take what you've got and leave.

destroyed.text: Taurus' ship explodes, plummeting into the ground. You pilot closer and scrap the wreckage.

deadCrew.text: Taurus' ship is now empty of crew, plummeting into the ground. You pilot closer and scrap the wreckage.

destroyed.text: The Hektar ship has been defeated. Maybe you should feel guilty, considering they were just employees following orders, but you don't feel any sympathy whatsoever.

deadCrew.text: The Hektar ship has been defeated. Maybe you should feel guilty, considering they were just employees following orders, but you don't feel any sympathy whatsoever.

name: MANTIS_VAMPWEED_CURIOUS
text: You receive a hail from a station at this beacon. "You Renegade? Having contact with Vampweed Confederation? We curious about them!"

event.text: The Mantises are in awe that the Premier himself is aboard your ship. Ivar regales the Mantises with his own exploits, leading to a good time for all. When he returns to your ship, he's carrying a bottle of wine he didn't have when he left.
The Mantises give you a complementary weapon for your time. They seem happy to have had a discussion with the premier.

choice.text: (Ty E'Rel) The Vampweed-Floral Ambassador has some things to say.

event.text: Ty E'Rel nods. "Yes, I can tell you about many historical events that I was there for. Are you more interested in the Vikikikikikipa-Te'Non Accord or the Grainery Pact?" After Ty E'Rel tells a number of stories the Mantises give you a gift.
The Mantises give you a complementary weapon for your time. "Ty E'Rel wanted by Bishop... Very angry. But we not Bishop."

choice.text: (Mayeb) Mayeb has some little-known insight on the Vampweeds.

event.text: The Mantises are unfamiliar with Mayeb, but she is more than capable of answering the questions that they have. The Mantises are grateful for her time.

choice.text: (Alkali) Alkali is the leading non-Orchid expert on Vampweeds.

event.text: Alkali launches into a lecture about the history of the Vampweeds from a Shell perspective. No stranger to symposiums of all kinds, he manages to give them a lecture that even the Mantis layperson can appreciate.

choice.text: (Cultivator Crew) Your Vampweed is eager to fulfill their curiosity, for a price.

event.text: Your Vampweed is more than happy to spend some time conversing with the Mantises, regaling them of seldom-told tales and fun facts that haven't made it to the Hive. When your Vampweed returns to the ship, it's obvious they're a little drunk.
The Mantises were impressed by the elite Cultivator abilities, and included an extra gift.

choice.text: (Vampweed Crew) Your Vampweed is eager to fulfill their curiosity, for a price.

event.text: Your Vampweed is more than happy to spend some time conversing with the Mantises, regaling them of seldom-told tales and fun facts that haven't made it to the Hive. When your Vampweed returns to the ship, it's obvious they're a little drunk.

choice.text: (Caretaker Crew) Your Orchid knows a thing or two.

event.text: Your Orchid tells tales about the conflict between the different subspecies, and their shared history. The Mantises ask a few questions that the Caretaker is capable of answering. They grant you a polite reward for your time.

choice.text: (Praetor Crew) Your Orchid knows a thing or two.

event.text: Your Orchid tells tales about the conflict between the different subspecies, and their shared history. The Mantises ask a few questions that the Praetor is capable of answering. They grant you a polite reward for your time.

choice.text: (Floral Crew) Your Orchid knows a thing or two.

event.text: Your Orchid tells tales about the conflict between the different subspecies, and their shared history. It's not what the Mantises were looking for, but they give you a small reward anyway.

choice.text: (Shell Scientist Crew) Talk to them about the Shell's dealings with Vampweeds.

event.text: Your scientist talks about the history between the Shells and the Vampweeds, and about some interesting biological facts about Vampweeds. The Mantises start interested, but seem to become bored once the topic starts to turn to more scientific matters. Even still, they reward you for your time.
You impress the Mantises with the Vampweed technology that you carry on your ship. After examining it for a short time, they seem satisfied.

choice.text: Show them an Elite Spore weapon.

event.text: You impress the Mantises with the elite Vampweed technology that you carry on your ship. After examining it for a short time, they seem satisfied.
You impress the Mantises with the Vampweed technology that you carry on your ship. After examining it for a short time, they seem satisfied.
You do your best to explain what you know, but it's clear that your limited knowledge of the Vampweeds doesn't interest them.

choice.text: Apologize, you don't have any experts on board.

event.text: The communication ends, but there's still time to do something at this beacon.

name: MANTIS_WARLORD_MUNITIONS
text: As you enter this region of space, a Warlord ship comes out from the shadows, accompanied by a fellow Free Mantis Dropship likely filled to the brim with warriors. This might ordinarily be a threatening sight, but they warmly welcome your ship. "Renegade friend! We destroying Hive scum! Running low on missiles though... You have?"

event.text: "Not enough, but will manage! Maybe find Hive stash."
"One of our finest weapons! Killing many enemies with."
"Our latest kill! Proud of this one... hope has something good."
Rather than give them missiles, you instead train your weapons upon them. "Enemy spies! Both ships, attack!!" You're being boarded by the other Free Mantis ship. This will be tough!
"Understand! This place violent, will finding missiles elsewhere."

name: MANTIS_SLAVES_EXPENSIVE
text: There is a Mantis slaver here. On a hailing frequency, they display the contents of their dungeon, and the prices thereof. The prices are definitely not the usual accepted rate of a crewmember.

event.text: You acquire the slave. You can't help but feel you've been swindled, but you did agree to it.
You acquire the slave. You can't help but feel you've been swindled, but you did agree to it.

choice.text: Demand an explanation for their exorbitant prices.

event.text: You accuse the slaver of offering outrageous prices. The Mantis don't hesitate to attack you in response to your accusation.

choice.text: (Mind Control) "Convince" them to give you a slave for a reasonable price.

event.text: The Mantis seems to blank out for a moment and then offers the same slaves again, this time for considerably cheaper.
You acquire the slave. The Mantis slaver still seems to be under the impression that they pulled one over on you.
You acquire the slave. The Mantis slaver still seems to be under the impression that they pulled one over on you.
You turn away from the slaver, giving them a wide berth.

choice.text: (Upg. Mind Control) "Convince" them to give you a slave for free.

event.text: The Mantis seems to think that you've already paid and asks which slave you want.
You acquire the slave. The Mantis slaver still seems to be under the impression that they pulled one over on you.
You acquire the slave. The Mantis slaver still seems to be under the impression that they pulled one over on you.
You turn away from the slaver, giving them a wide berth.

choice.text: (Mind Control Weapon) "Convince" them to give you a slave for free.

event.text: The Mantis seems to think that you've already paid and asks which slave you want.
You acquire the slave. The Mantis slaver still seems to be under the impression that they pulled one over on you.
You acquire the slave. The Mantis slaver still seems to be under the impression that they pulled one over on you.
You turn away from the slaver, giving them a wide berth.
You turn away from the slaver, giving them a wide berth.

name: MANTIS_GAMBLE_MV
text: This node is currently home to a Mantis leisure ship: a place of brothels and combat arenas for warriors to release steam. When they scan your inventory they indicate that you're eligible to engage in a grand game of chance.

choice.text: You don't gamble with crooks. Prepare to jump.

event.text: Better not to get involved in what's going on in there.

choice.text: Bet 50 scrap on the warrior with blue paint.

event.text: You watch over the view-screen as two Mantis juveniles are pitched at one another in combat.

choice.text: Bet 50 scrap on the warrior with red paint.

event.text: You watch over the view-screen as two Mantis juveniles are pitched at one another in combat.

name: MANTIS_CAPTURE_SUZERAIN_COMMANDO
text: You come across an Engi wreck with one life-sign aboard; it turns out to be a Suzerain, and the sole survivor of the Mantis boarding party that wiped out the ship's crew. He's in no state to fight and he's brought aboard.

event.text: Your mind control device allows you to quickly get his story without resistance. It appears the boarding party was attempting to steal a weapon that the Engi ship was transporting. However their team was wiped out by drones.
You find the weapon in a hidden storage hold and decide to patch the ship up enough to let the Mantis leave.

Your mind control weapon allows you to quickly get his story without resistance. It appears the boarding party was attempting to steal a weapon that the Engi ship was transporting. However their team was wiped out by drones.
You find the weapon in a hidden storage hold and decide to patch the ship up enough to let the Mantis leave.

name: MANTIS_BROKEN_TELEPORTER
text: You're hailed by a Mantis vessel. "You not know how hard repair with claw is. Teleporter is broken, can you fix? We will pay you, as we are so kind."

choice.text: Agree to help repair their teleporter.
(Upg. Doors) Agree, but lock your doors tight in case of a trap.
(Repair Drone) Dispatch the repair drone to fix it. [-1|]
(Repair Burst) Use the bomb to fix the teleporter. [-1}]

name: MANTIS_PIRATE_FAKE
text: A Mantis pirate ship defends this beacon, claiming to be one of the Hive's enforcers. They demand you pay them either scrap or a slave, or be obliterated.

event.text: You make it clear to the pirate that you have no interest in giving them anything but death. You both hurry to prepare for battle.
The Mantis seem satisfied and fly away, leaving you to grumble over your lost scrap.
The Mantis come aboard and pick one of your crew to take back with them. Your crew struggles, trying to free themselves, but the last you see of them is screaming, being dragged out of the ship.

removeCrew.text: Tempting as it is to clone your crew, you made the decision to give them up, and you aren't going to break Federation code for it.

choice.text: The onboard AI recommends terminating these pirates with extreme prejudice.

name: MANTIS_SLUG_TAUNT
text: A Slug and Mantis ship appear to be squaring off at this beacon, but weapons have not yet been fired. Both ships simultaneously hail you. The Slug speaks first, "Federation, how fortuitousss that sssomeone elssse who I'm ssssure will appreciate the humor of thessse feeble pea-brained Mantisss and their pitiful attemptsss at dialect!" The Mantis cuts them off, "You stupid ones! Listen, how you drag out s's. True sign of inferiority." Both ships eagerly await your input on the situation.

choice.text: Agree that the Slugs are superior.

event.text: The Slug points at the Mantis and laughs, but is cut off when the Mantis becomes enraged and powers up its weapons and attacks!

choice.text: Agree that the Mantis are superior.

event.text: The Slug grumbles as the Mantis gloats. Furious at your shot at their ego, the Slug activates its weapon barrels towards you!

choice.text: Can't you both just get along?

event.text: The Mantis and Slug glance at each other for a solid minute before they both simultaneously say "nahhhh", and fly straight towards each other, weapons blazing. You fly away before you get caught up in the fighting.

name: MANTIS_SLUG_TAUNT_MANTIS_WIN
text: The Slug cackles, his already massively inflated ego having been expanded once again. Though he clearly still thinks of you as inferior, he gives you some additional fuel along with the remains of the Mantis ship.

name: MANTIS_SLUG_TAUNT_SLUG_WIN
text: The Mantis lets out a cry of victory, and performs a strange ritual dance. They leave you with the remains of the Slug ship and fly away.

name: MANTIS_ALISON_CREW
text: You arrive just in time to see an unusually well-armed Engi ship destroying a small pirate craft. A teleporter signal is detected...intruder on deck!

event.text: A young Mantis in a charred uniform has teleported onto the deck. He begs for sanctuary from the Engi, and offers to serve in exchange for your protection. The Engi have already traced the teleporter signal and are offering a deal in exchange for the prisoner.

choice.text: Side with the fugitive and fight the Engi ship.
Agree to offer up the Mantis in exchange for a bounty.
(Mind Control) Ensure the Mantis is passive before you make a decision.

event.text: Thanks to the Mantis's simple mind, it is quickly subdued by the effects of your mind control.

choice.text: Side with the fugitive and fight the Engi ship.
Agree to offer up the Mantis in exchange for a bounty.

event.text: You prepare for combat.
You frown, power up the weapons and prepare to engage the Mantis ship. Not today.

name: MANTIS_CREW
text: You detect and retrieve an escape pod floating nearby. You consider returning it to space when you learn it's Mantis.

event.text: You send the pod back out the airlock. You're not stupid.

choice.text: There's no way you're risking opening this pod without anyone around.
(Adv. Sensors) Access the interior footage of the pod.
(Shell Crew) Have your Shell open the pod.
(Rock Crew) Have your Rock open the pod.
(Obelisk Crew) Have your Obelisk open the pod.

name: HIVE_VETERAN
text: This beacon is home to a Suzerain ship. They hail you, "I too old for this. Days long since having fought in Mantis-Human war, invasion of Earth left many scars of body and mind. Let not fight here, needless bloodshed from pointless hatred gets nowhere."

choice.text: We will avenge all of those you killed!

event.text: "Ha, what did expect? Let us fight, so that he who dies here may go to bliss."

choice.text: (Mantis Crew) Convince the Suzerain to join you.

event.text: "You wish to form friendship? One, what, which lasts years come? Yes, accept I do."
The Suzerain keeps true to their word and doesn't chase after you.

name: HIVE_MANTIS_AUTO_SITUATION
text: A Mantis ship appears to be circling the area nearby the beacon. You intercept their conversation with what you assume to be their Suzerain leader, "No, no. We not yet kill living ship. We continue trying, but it hard without weapon. Last crew... suffocate. Quite unpleasant."

choice.text: Offer to kill the "living ship", whatever that means.

event.text: The Mantis are shocked that you have the courage to hail them, but seem open to your offer. They explain that the ship in question is actually an automated Rebel ship that is lost and has begun to attack Mantis settlements, and that they have been dispatched to handle the issue. "You need something special if want to kill living ship. Do so and we are grateful, and pay you. Better accept help from enemy, than decapitated by Suzerain Karazawaka."
"Good, yes this might work. Come, we show you to ship." They lead you to the Auto-ship, which is in the middle of tormenting a civilian Mantis ship. You prepare to fight.

choice.text: (Hacking Weapon) We have a hacking weapon.

event.text: "Strange, but this might work. Come, we show you to ship." They lead you to the Auto-ship, which is in the middle of tormenting a civilian Mantis ship. You prepare to fight.

choice.text: (Adv. Weapons) We have a superior weapon system.

event.text: "Good, yes this might work. Come, we show you to ship." They lead you to the Auto-ship, which is in the middle of tormenting a civilian Mantis ship. You prepare to fight.

choice.text: (Anaerobic Crew) We have crew capable of surviving in environments devoid of oxygen.

event.text: "Good, yes this might work. Come, we show you to ship." They lead you to the Auto-ship, which is in the middle of tormenting a civilian Mantis ship. You prepare to fight.

choice.text: (Missile Weapon) We have a missile weapon to bypass their defenses.

event.text: "Good, yes this might work. Come, we show you to ship." They lead you to the Auto-ship, which is in the middle of tormenting a civilian Mantis ship. You prepare to fight.

choice.text: We don't have anything special, but we're still just as qualified.

event.text: "No no! You not understand, this ship kill you if you not be prepare. You useless. Maybe Karazawaka spare us if we bring in dead Federation ship..."
You have no interest but to kill the Mantis ship. You power up the weapons and engage.
You suspect the Mantis ship must have seen you, but they make no attempt to pursue.

name: HIVE_MANTIS_AUTO_SITUATION_SUCCESS
text: "Surprising, we counting on you die, and we bring corpses back to leader. Still, this works too." You scrap the Auto-ship.

event.text: The Mantis grumbles. "Fine, yes this promised. Here, take this, and never speak this again."

name: HIVE_JAILER_CHOICE
text: The Hive often sends about Jailer ships to abduct invaders, a term that also includes you. Luckily, the Jailer here has not yet seen you. You could attack the Jailer to try and free its captives, or escape while you still can.

event.text: You move in to destroy the Jailer, knowing that you'll have to kill their crew if you want the prisoners to live.

Your crew, armed to the teeth, board the Jailer and quickly take down the Suzerain crew staffing it. With the jailers turned prisoners, you free everyone locked up who you don't think will kill you immediately.
The Jailer doesn't seem to notice as you slip away.

name: HIVE_JAILER_KILL
text: You've destroyed the Jailer, but unfortunately none of the captives survived the explosion. You scrap the remains and try to avoid the drifting corpses.

name: HIVE_JAILER_CAPTURE
text: The Jailer's crew is dead but most of the captives survived the fight. Most of them request to be dropped off as soon as you're out of the Hive, but one volunteers to stay behind and work aboard your ship.

name: ENCOUNTER_BISHOP_CHOICE
text: Those who are unlucky enough to encounter a Mantis Bishop are rarely able to tell the tale afterwards. The same might have been said for you, had it not been for the fact the ship here has not yet spotted you. There's still time to slip away if you desire.

event.text: You've decided to take a huge risk here and fight the Bishop vessel. Let's hope it pays off.

name: HIVE_SUZERAIN_COMPLEX
text: The Suzerains are chosen from birth by the Mantis Bishops to be trained as elite warriors in special institutions scattered around the Hive. One such complex has been set up on the planet nearby. If you had to guess, it's likely protected very well.

event.text: As to be expected, your weapons can barely even dent their defenses. The minute you start shooting, you alert them to your presence, and one of their finest guards is dispatched to destroy you.

choice.text: (Teleporter) Send a boarding team to sabotage the complex.

event.text: You have more important things to do than go raiding important Mantis structures.

name: HIVE_SUZERAIN_COMPLEX_WIN_STUPID
text: You've defeated the guard, but you know more are no doubt on their way. You quickly scrap what you can and leave.

choice.text: (Magnet Arm) Use the magnet to draw in some extra supplies.

name: DISTRESS_MANTIS_FLORAL
text: A Gathering vessel is desperately trying to evade a hostile Mantis. Currently, the ships are too occupied with each other to bother with you.

event.text: You move to intercept the Mantis ship, and it veers off to meet you.
The affairs of the other ships do not concern you at this time.

name: MANTIS_FLORAL_SAVED
text: "Many thanks, Renegade. I wanted to impress my Oro'Bache hosts on my next visit to the Confederacy. They love Hive wine so much, but unfortunately these Mantis don't seem to like us Ctl'Yae quite as much as them. Here, a token of my gratitude."

name: DISTRESS_MANTIS_DERELICT
text: The origin of this distress call is a drifting Mantis ship. It does not respond to your arrival. The ship seems to be undamaged, but life support is not functioning.

choice.text: (Orchid Crew) Send in your Orchid crewmember.
(Anaerobic Crew) Send in your anaerobic crewmember.

event.text: You're familiar enough with Mantis regions to know this could be some kind of ambush.

name: MANTIS_DERELICT_SCRAP
text: Derelict ships make for good scrap. You harvest what you can and clean the mess up.

name: MANTIS_DERELICT_ORCHID_SAFE
text: Your crew finds the struggling Engi slave on board. The natural production of oxygen manages to stabilize the Engi's condition long enough to get them back to your ship. "Renegade has: good timing. O2 sabotage: worked. Can offer: assistance."

name: MANTIS_DERELICT_NO2_SAFE
text: Your crew finds the struggling Engi slave on board. Unfortunately, it takes them time to bring it back to the ship. The Engi won't survive unless medical intervention is taken.

choice.text: (Upg. Clone Bay) Enter the Engi into the clone bay.

event.text: You quickly aim a healing bomb at the Engi, which proves effective at stabilizing their condition.

choice.text: We can't save them. Scrap the ship instead.

name: MANTIS_DERELICT_REFILL
text: You connect your powerful life support to the Mantis ship and refill it as fast as you can. The remaining Engi on board manages to catch its breath. "Renegade has: good timing. O2 sabotage: worked. Can offer: assistance."

name: MANTIS_DERELICT_ENGI_SAVE
text: "Renegade has: good timing. O2 sabotage: worked. Can offer: assistance."

name: DISTRESS_SUZERAIN_WARRING
text: As you arrive, it looks like a battle is coming to a close - a Mantis attack force led by a Suzerain is chasing some stragglers of a smaller clan. Over an open channel, the winning Suzerain makes a declaration. "Tikinakariiika clan is strongest! All ships, exterminating Pafinakinaaalara forces that not yield!"

event.text: "Fool! Challenging Tikinakariiika is death sentence!" As you attack them, boarders from surrounding ships teleport on board, although many of their attack ships are still tied up pursuing fleeing Pafinakinaaalara-aligned ships.

tooltip.text: Mantises from other ships are still boarding you!

choice.text: (Kaz) Challenge the Tikinakariiika in combat for the territory.

event.text:
Kazaaakplethkilik presents himself before the Suzerain. The posture he assumes belies a ceremony to it. "Strongest? Saying that in my presence, you must either kill me or surrender your territory!"
               
The Suzerain on the other end makes an opposing gesture, broadening their stance and displaying their arms before proceeding to perform an exotic display of intimidation and strength in some kind of Mantis pre-battle war dance. A display that most certainly drew the ire of the Suzerain before him. "Kazaaakplethkilik, not name it was being! You are being destroyed by me alone, proving Tikinakariiika strength!" All other ships, including the losing side, surround the battle to become your audience.

choice.text: (Bishop Crew) Demand a tribute from the warring clans.

event.text: The fighting pauses in recognition of the Bishop's sovereignty. The Tikinakariiika gift a large amount of scrap, and the Pafinakinaaalara a Mantis weapon. After the gifts are presented, the Bishop presides over the conflict, officially ceding the territory to the victors, but granting the losing side safe passage out of the sector.
Your Warlord disparages the skills of the Tikinakariiika, declaring that the Free Mantis are far stronger. Enraged, the full might of the Tikinakariiika onslaught turns on you. This will be tough!

tooltip.text: Mantises from other ships are still boarding you!

choice.text: Fight your way out, drawing as little attention to yourself as possible.

event.text: There are so many Mantis ships in the area that it's impossible to avoid them all. You'll have to fight your way away from this beacon!

With your cloaking, you're able to stay hidden from any of the ships that get close until your FTL drive is warmed up. The ships seem to be more interested in claiming the territory than they are looking for errant ships like yours.

name: TERRITORY_DISPUTE_NORMAL_AFTERMATH
text: "Being very grateful! Tikinakariiika our longtime foe... Very cruel, very nasty! Pafinakinaaalara owing debt... will follow!"

choice.text: Accept the grateful Suzerain onto your crew.

name: DEFEAT_SUZERAIN_TERRITORY_DISPUTE
text: You finish off the Tikinakariiika Suzerain. Their ship provides a healthy amount of scrap.

choice.text: Survey the rest of the territory.

event.text: Upon surveying your surroundings, you realize that the battle was over before you returned to this beacon. The Suzerain must have stayed around to wait for you... but it's too late for the Mantis faction that used to reside here.

choice.text: Turn your attention to the rest of the battle.

event.text: There is a shift in morale. The losing side - the Pafinakinaaalara clan - now has a second wind, as the Tikinakariiika retreat back into their own territory. You scrap the Suzerain ship as the tide turns. In the aftermath, another broken-down Suzerain hails your ship.

choice.text: Turn your attention to the rest of the battle.

event.text: With so much of the enemy forces focusing on your own ship, the battle becomes a slaughter once the Suzerain dies. The Pafinakinaaalara are able to destroy almost all of the ships due to their tactical blunder. In the aftermath, another broken-down Suzerain hails your ship.

"Assistance from a Free Mantis... not expected." There is a tense pause. "But not unwelcome. Tikinakariiika our longtime foe... Very cruel, very nasty! Pafinakinaaalara owing debt... will follow!" The clan offers to let you scrap some of the debris from the ships you enabled them to destroy, on top of offering to join you.

choice.text: Accept the grateful Suzerain onto your crew.

event.text: After your victory, the fighting ends. The remaining Tikinakariiika clan present you with a large scrap reward before departing from the space.

The Pafinakinaaalara perform a ceremony, pledging their allegiance to Kazaaakplethkilik in recognition of his victory. "This territory belonging to Kazaaakplethkilik now! At your service!" Now subordinate to Kazaaakplethkilik, the Suzerain joins you.

choice.text: Turn your attention to the rest of the battle.

event.text: Kazaaakplethkilik died during the ensuing fight. The fighting briefly resumes, but with the Suzerain of the Tikinakariiika dead, their forces are in disarray. The Pafinakinaaalara are able to chase away the remainder of their forces. In the aftermath, another broken-down Suzerain hails your ship.

name: QUEST_MANTIS_REFINERY_CONVOY
text: A convoy of Mantis ships are passing through this beacon, protecting a cargo ship. Upon noticing you, an escort breaks off and attacks!

name: QUEST_MANTIS_REFINERY_INVESTIGATE

unvisitedTooltip.text: Destination of a Hive cargo convoy.

text: You arrive at the destination beacon - it appears as though there is an ore refinery at this location. However, this beacon is protected by a Suzerain guard ship, which does not hesitate to attack on sight!

name: QUEST_MANTIS_REFINERY_FREE
text: The refinery is staffed with mostly Rock slaves. Their Mantis slavers gone, they ask for passage away from the refinery. Out of gratitude for their rescue, they offer the materials they've been processing as a reward. Some of the Rocks even offer to join.

name: QUEST_HIVE_FREEMANTIS_HUNTER
text: Free Mantis returning to the Hive that they hate so much is rare, so it is considerably shocking to see a Free Mantis ship that appears to be making minor repairs at this beacon.

event.text: The Free Mantis is ecstatic to see you. "Perfect day, how glad we are to meet you here, Captain! We have important information to tell you. Here are co-ordinates of Mantis camp we find. Do with what you want, we must leave soon and return to clan. Best of luck."
Though you doubt the ship poses a threat, you have no interest in communicating.

name: QUEST_HIVE_FREEMANTIS_HUNTER_CAMP

unvisitedTooltip.text: Location of a Hive camp revealed to you by a Free Mantis.

text: A Mantis warcamp revealed to you by the Free Mantis is much smaller than expected. A single station surrounded by Mantis ships of different sizes orbits the beacon. They don't see you.

choice.text: Attack the station, knowing it will anger the other, much larger ships.

event.text: You fly towards the station, attacking its main infrastructure. One of the largest ships detaches to defend the station.

choice.text: (Cloaking) Sabotage the station while hidden by your cloak.
(Adv. Cloaking) Sabotage the station while hidden by your cloak.

event.text: Hidden by your cloak, you successfully manage to deal massive damage to hull, compromising the station. The explosions send the docked Mantis ships flying away, leaving you alone with the wreck.
You would have to be suicidal to attack any sort of Mantis camp, regardless of size. You fly away until you're certain you're out of their sight.

name: QUEST_HIVE_FREEMANTIS_HUNTER_CAMP_WIN
text: In a rare display of cowardice the remaining Mantis ships make no attempt to fight you and flee. You scrap the hull of the ship you just defeated before moving onto the station.

event.text: With no ships left to defend it, the station gives into your demands and hands over more scrap.

name: ENCOUNTER_MANTIS_SUN
text: Who knows why the Mantis would venture so close to a sun. Perhaps it makes for more of a challenge?

name: MANTIS_CHASE
text: You are immediately hailed by an impressive looking Mantis ship, "Ship make a mighty fine prize. Prepare for battle!"

name: MANTIS_CHASE2

unvisitedTooltip.text: Tracked location of a peculiar Mantis warrior.

text: You catch up with the Mantis ship that escaped before, only to see them transferring their crew into an even bigger ship!

event.text: "Not YOU again! You know how much repairs going to cost me? Time to take the big guns."

name: ENCOUNTER_COALITION_HIVE
text: As the Coalition receives the backing of the Mantis Hive, their ships can often be found here. Not the kind to miss out on the opportunity to destroy a Federation ship, they attack.

name: ENCOUNTER_MANTIS_KAMIKAZE
text: You're hailed by a Mantis, who frantically moves around the room in circles before facing you. "The Hive's security compromised, your fault! Death is only way. I die, so that the Hive may live!"

name: ENCOUNTER_MANTIS_STATION_HIVE
text: A Mantis station appears to be positioned here. For what reason you don't know, but the station deems you a threat and fires in your direction, leaving you with no choice but to fight back.

name: ENCOUNTER_GUILD_HIVE
text: A Clansman ship is already at this beacon. They hail you, their captain snickering. "Oh goodnesss, a Federation ssship here? I come here often to harrasss thessse freaksss for entertainment, but thisss isss too good a chance to missss!"

name: HIVE_MERCENARY
text: You can't help but shake the feeling you're being followed through this system. After some time spent running basic scans on the surroundings, it becomes clear your suspicions weren't unfounded. A Bishop vessel reveals itself, though its weapons are offline.

event.text: A female Bishop appears on the screen, out of breath as if she had been running despite being on a spaceship. "You are a Federation Multiverse Vessel, correct? Please disregard informalities and past inconveniences, for her royal majesty Queen Leikonpliiinakra has a request for you. We cannot offer you the Hive's allegiance or promises of safe travels, but you shall be given esteemed honor of queen's thanks! And if you so insist, perhaps ample cash reward."

"In this territory, there is a hatchery for future Suzerains and Bishops. However, dangerous rogue defectors have taken hold of it. By order of the queen, the eggs must be secured and moved to a new location. I will transfer the coordinates of the Hatchery to you now. I hope to see you there."
"Disappointing stance, but I haven't time to protest. If you will not assist, then it would be my recommendation that you leave the Hive quickly before Leikonpliiinakra's forces discover you."
You're no man of patience, and even though this was likely something important, you've forgone that possibility entirely by making the first strike!

name: HIVE_MERCENARY_HATCHERY

unvisitedTooltip.text: Location of the Mantis hatchery.

visitedTooltip.text: Explored location. Nothing left of interest.

text: You've arrived at the Hatchery, but you don't see any sign of the other Bishop ship. There is, however, a massive Suzerain cruiser here. You aren't sure how to proceed.

event.text: The cruiser seems to have several Suzerains led by a Bishop. That messenger wasn't lying, this Hatchery must be important to deserve this much security. Time for a colossal fight!
Without the other Bishop, you can't be certain what the plan is. It's better not to take the risk and leave while you're still alive.

name: HIVE_MERCENARY_HATCHERY_TIMER
text: You happen to notice that while you've been fighting, the other Bishop ship has arrived. However, instead of coming to assist you, it has landed next to the Hatchery and begun to load its cargo with the eggs. It seems they have no intentions of sticking around, so if you want to confront them you'll have to quickly remove this cruiser!

tooltip.text: If you can't neutralize the Suzerain Cruiser before the time runs out, the Bishop will escape with the eggs.

name: HIVE_MERCENARY_HATCHERY_FAIL
text: It seems you weren't fast enough - and now the Bishop has jumped away with the eggs! The Suzerain cruiser has noticed as well, because it immediately switches focus from you onto the trajectory of the fleeing Bishop and jumps away after it! Seems this was all just one giant ruse...

name: HIVE_MERCENARY_HATCHERY_WIN
text: The Suzerain cruiser has been defeated. The immense hull of the ship comes crashing down onto the planet's surface, though fortunately it lands in the nearby river rather than on the Hatchery itself. Below, Mantis workers and Engi slaves flee, but the Bishop ship has not yet finished loading their cargo.

event.text: "You survived? Impossible, but impressive! You fight as well as my father!"

choice.text: Why did you use us as a distraction? What's going on?

event.text: "I did not plan for a confrontation like this, but it is time I confess. I am Laiiikarkapi, the first female Bishop appointed since the founding of the Episcopacy under queen Riiipiokinith. It would seem I have failed her majesty Leikonpliiinakra, but it is greater service to Mantis-kind that I prevent these eggs from pursuing lives of warriors than serve my purpose and raise them the same as I was."

choice.text: Where will you take the eggs then?

event.text: "I have arranged plans. A Free Mantis colony, away from Hive, has agreed to take and raise them as their own. I have faith this will be a better home. I do not know what will happen to me after. It seems fate has it my death as traitor to Hive is certain - but a noble death it will be. That is not of worry to you. Be it may that I trick you, you have helped me greatly. I will show you how to gain access to the blueprints of the cruiser you have defeated today, so that your Federation might take advantage of its power."

choice.text: Offer to take her with you.

event.text: "Huh? You are serious? I would not normally consider, but... saving reality could mean pardon, and life in the Federation certainly is better than death in the Hive. Perhaps my legacy does not end here then. I will have my crew transport the eggs on their own. They are capable. I shall be with you momentarily, captain."

choice.text: Wish her the best of luck and carry on.

event.text: "Yes, may you having the best of luck as well. Perhaps you will hear news of my fate in the Federation some time soon..."

choice.text: Request her help in finding the queen.

event.text: "Huh? You are serious? I do not know what you are hoping to achieve, but it is certainly better than a certain death at hands of the Episcopacy. I will have my crew transport the eggs on their own. They are capable. I shall be with you momentarily, captain."

With Laiiikarkapi's directions and Kaz's plans, you should now be able to track down the Mantis Queen herself. This won't be easy, but who knows what you might able to accomplish if you pull this off. Make sure you keep Laiiikarkapi and Kazaaak around, as without them, you won't be able to find your way.

name: HIVE

unvisitedTooltip.text: Location of the Mantis Hive.

visitedTooltip.text: Explored location. Nothing left of interest.

text: This is it- the Mantis Hive. No wonder it's so hard to find, as the bulk of the city is located in a massive cavern underground. Thermal power plants are scattered around massive pits of magma and a large city stands in the center. Even from such a distance, you can see the royal palace...

choice.text: We have both Kaz and Lai, we can do this.

event.text: As you start to approach the palace, a Bishop guard stops you. "You cannot be here! You will regret stepping so close to her majesty's palace!"

choice.text: Have Lai talk it out with the guard.

event.text: "So you carry two traitors, yet you still wish to gain access to Hive? I would kill you on the spot, but the Queen has heard of dishonorable Kazaaakplethkilik's arrival and wishes to see him..."

You're ceremoniously 'welcomed' into the palace, and with some brief fanfare Leikonpliiinakra emerges, dressed in golden robes. By the way you see Kazaaak looking at her, she must be quite desirable for a Mantis. She pays little attention to you or Lai, instead flirting with the Mantis warrior by your side. After some exchanged formalities, she walks back into the palace and you are ushered to follow.

The next location you find yourself in is a long dining hall, its tables decorated in Mantis cuisine. At last, Leikonpliiinakra speaks to your group as a whole, and strangely well spoken for a Mantis at that. "As soon as I heard my darling Kaz had returned, I knew you would come here. Sit, and feast as much as you like. We will discuss whatever business you have come here for after."

You spend most of the feast in awkward silence, with only occasional conversation between Kazaaak and Leik. Eventually, things turn more serious. "I am not oblivious to Kaz's recent movements in Coalition space, but I have chosen to turn a blind eye to them. I can only expect that you have come here to negotiate the Hive's withdrawal from the alliance."

"Then I'm afraid that I both cannot do such a thing nor would it have any impact. Even if I were to withdraw from the Coalition, which frankly is an idea I would not entirely be opposed to, you would have to convince the Leikonpliiinakra of every reality to withdraw as well. You might not realize it, but the Coalition has secured many realities of its own. But regardless of this, the Hive is not in a position to cut ties with the Coalition. After the Federation-Mantis War our economy has been in ruin, and the industrial might of the Kleptocracy and Theocracy have aided us greatly."

With that conclusion made, Leik turns back to Kazaaak. "My apologies dear, but in your absence the Hive has not grown fond of you. Traveling in-arms with another traitor to the Episcopacy and a Federation Captain has not helped your image. I love you, but my role as queen means I must place the safety of the Hive first. It is clear where your line in the sand has been drawn, so this must mark the end of us. And I'm afraid there is another reason I have allowed you here: the capture of the fugitive you have brought with you, Laiiikarkapi. I apologize my dear, for it was my fault appointing you to this role. But such things cannot go unpunished. This is the last stop for all of you. I can at least promise you your funerals will be held with honor." Leikonpliiinakra stands up, and her guards draw their weapons. You hurry out of the palace just in time to witness a massive cruiser approaching to stop you! Seems it's time to fight your way out of here.
You are not prepared for this mission. Better to turn back now than risk going any further.

name: HIVE_BISHOP_WIN
text: The Bishop cruiser has been defeated. Clearly this ship must have had some importance, because without it the Bishop forces have scattered. From its wreckage you salvage a special weapon. With the knowledge Laiiikarkapi gave you with the Suzerain cruiser, you figure out how to access the ship's consoles and download its blueprints.

event.text: Your demands are not met, and you aren't certain what you expected. It's not in the Mantis code of honor to surrender, and especially not to a Federation ship.

name: HIVE_DESTROY
text: With its Bishop forces scattered and defenses damaged from the impact of the cruiser, the destruction of the palace does not take long. It's almost certain the queen was killed during the attack. You aren't certain what will become of the Hive now or its involvement in the Coalition, but your work here is done. More or less.

name: HIVE_LEAVE
text: This is not the day for genocide. Killing the Queen like this would lead to the collapse of the Hive, and for all its done the Mantis don't deserve that fate. No more ships attempt to stop you as you leave.

name: ESTATE_DEBRIS
text: This beacon appears to harbor the debris of two crashed ships, one civilian and the other automated. Some sort of malfunction, perhaps? Unfortunate for those involved, but good for a fortune seeking Renegade like yourself!

name: ESTATE_BOLTS
text: You notice two technician vessels, weapons trained on each other, placed at dueling distance on two ends of the system. Their captains are shouting at each other, but when they spot you, they both clamor for you to pitch in.

event.text: "Hey, I'm Cole, and that idiot over there is Gabe." Gabe begins to say something, but Cole tells him to shut up. "The idiot over here claims that bolts are called nuts, which is stupid! Everyone knows they're called bolts, not nuts. A nut is something you eat, they aren't made of metal!" To prove his point, Cole holds up the aforementioned bolt, which is a screw. Both await for you to tell them which is the right name.

In glorious triumph, Gabe raises both of his arms and chears, rubbing his victory in Cole's face. "HAH! I toooooold you! It's a NUT! Dumbass! Oh yeah! I'm right! You're wrong! Oh yeah! In. Your. FACE! HAHAH!" You wait a while for the two to finish, and once settled, Gabe offers you a reward for declaring him the victor.

Gabe slams his fist down while Cole shouts in triumph. "I knew you were wrong! I bet you've never even SEEN a nut!" Cole proceeds to do a little dance, placing one arm around his belt, another in the shape of an L on his forehead, and waggling his legs back and forth. After several painfully long minutes of this, Cole offers you a reward for declaring him the victor.

Both technicians look at you, one confused and the other annoyed. Gabe, indignant, explains. "Dude, you can't say that. That's a bad word! We're talking about nuts here, get lost with your pervy nonsense." The two go back to arguing, ignoring you.

choice.text: (Engineer Crew) Explain that Cole is holding a screw.

event.text: After some painful and tiresome explaining, which involves both a heavily detailed infographic, a slideshow, several graphs, and when things get desperate an informational video, you finally help reconcile the difference for the two. "Wait... they've been called SCREWS the whole time?! WHAT?! Dude, no wonder everyone at the workshop looks like they have food poisoning when we talk to them. Thanks man, we really owe you one."

Your Lanius frantically gestures, trying to explain that the item Cole is holding is in fact food. None of you, and probably your Lanius neither, understand what their point is, but Gabe takes it as an excuse to justify his own point and Cole concedes. Once Gabe accidentally breaks one of his teeth trying to bite into the food, the two call it quits and offer you a reward for clearing up the confusion.

Your Morph begins to eagerly chant the same word over and over. "Pook! Pook! Pook! Pook! Pook! Pook! Pook! Pook!" It alarms both of the technicians, who apparently have no experience with the grey blobs. At first, they assume the creature simply means to tell them that the object is in fact called a 'Pook', but your Morph doesn't stop. Growing ever more concerned at the increasingly more aggressive chanting, the technicians beg you to make it stop, and offer you consolation to leave. Your Morph, unfortunately, doesn't stop. Looks like you'll have to put up with that for another couple jumps.
Once the technicians realize you aren't going to give them your time, they give up and go back to shouting.

name: ESTATE_INVESTOR
text: Nearby, the ship of a wealthy tycoon is exploring the beacon. Might be an interesting chat.

event.text: You fly away from the shuttle and find somewhere else to do something aboard the ship.

name: ESTATE_INVESTOR_QUESTIONS_NOTMET
text: "Oh, good cheer and a bucket of biscuits good sir or madam! I am Count Dinkleman Reichster Von Applebuzz Tri Tri the Fourth, at your service. I have journeyed far to this place to observe Wentworth Innovations with my own eyes and assess what they might offer for me and my immense wealth. Tell me, what are your opinions on Wentworth Innovations?"

choice.text: They're Rebel supporters, and owned by Admiral Vance himself!

event.text: "Hah! Who wasn't. That civil war was quite the scare, but I started making my fortune the minute I hung that Rebel flag outside my door. Of course, I took it down once the Feds started winning, but with the way this new war is going, well... can you hardly blame anyone for staying on their side? My own daughter still works for them! I'm sure you think it's horrible though, because you aren't disgustingly rich. Anyways, thanks for the chat, gotta go!" The man sprints back to his ship, dropping several piles of scrap from his pockets as he goes.

choice.text: They're responsible for making Auto-ships that murder millions daily!

event.text: "Brilliant, murder is the most profitable business! Why, I've had 3 attempts on my own life, and each time before I beat the bloody daylights out of the poor blokes, I quizzed them on their rates, and my word! 6 figures! Now imagine instead of one man whose head is easily caved in by a walking stick you had a thousand cold machines to do the killing! Of course I wouldn't expect you to get it, because you aren't disgustingly rich. Anyways, thanks for the chat, gotta go!" The man sprints back to his ship, dropping several piles of scrap from his pockets as he goes.

"You've seen worse, eh? How reassuring. Well, what about their products? I do believe you're a Renegade, so surely you've had a run in with at least a dozen Autos by this point. How do they fare? Clearly you're still alive, so they can't be that high in standards, but you look like the savage, 'murder you with a broken coffee mug' kind of bloke, so I'm willing to let that slide."

"Deadly, eh? Just what I like to hear! Well, if a bonafide Renegade tells me something's deadly, I'd be daft not to listen! I foresee a lucrative investment career in Wentworth Innovations for me! As for you... Here, take this. I bought it thinking it would save me some work, but all it's done is beep uselessly at me. I miss the days these things were automatic and I could just be lazy. And it's not like I care to pay someone else to move them for me."

"A shame, a shame indeed! You may not be a reliable individual to take financial advice from, you are poor after all, but I've got plenty of dollars to waste. Speaking of which, here, I got this for only a few bucks from a vendor who told me it would miraculously cure hairloss. I... I'm not really sure how that was supposed to work, but at the moment it seemed brilliant. It's only the 5th time I've fallen for it too!"

choice.text: I'll murder you with a coffee mug.

event.text: "Ugh... you sure are a Renegade alright. Simple, brainless. Poor! Hah! Oh imagine needing work to make money. What a sap. Well, thanks for the chat, gotta go!" The man sprints back to his ship, dropping several piles of scrap from his pockets as he goes.

name: ESTATE_INVESTOR_QUESTIONS_MET
text: "Strange poor person, we meet again! It is me, Count Dinkleman Reichster Von Applebuzz Tri Tri the Fourth! What a coincidence we happen upon each other on this occasion. I have journeyed far to this place to observe Wentworth Innovations with my own eyes and assess what they might offer me and my immense wealth. Tell me, what are your opinions on Wentworth Innovations?"
