event.text: "Well if you do not think risssk issss a necesssarry ssstep in sssscientific advancement, then you clearly aren't the people to tessst thiss anywayssss."

choice.text: We aren't interested in being experimented on.

event.text: "Ssssily sssimple minded Fedsss, never open to new ideasss..."

name: NEBULA_SLUG_CASINO
text: Deep in the nebula here is perhaps the last thing you expected to ever see...

event.text: It's a busy casino! Ships come and go, and while most are Slugs, there are those of other sorts as well.

choice.text: Stop by and check it out.

event.text: Inside you see several different games, but most require other players. Unfortunately, those players happen to be Slugs, and you doubt you'd stand a chance. You notice a few odd slot machines configured to accept scrap and output supplies...
You input the scrap into the slot machine...

choice.text: Pull the lever and wait for the result.

event.text: You input the scrap into the slot machine...

choice.text: Pull the lever and wait for the result.

event.text: You input the scrap into the slot machine...

choice.text: Pull the lever and wait for the result.

event.text: A casino run by Slugs can't be trusted. Regardless, you don't have time for gambling anyways.

name: SLUG_CASINO_FAIL
text: Disappointed, you exit the casino. However as you leave, you overhear several of the visitors arguing. Things sound like they're getting heated, but you aren't sure what for.

choice.text: Come back in to see what's happening.

event.text: The situation inside is much worse than you thought. It appears someone found out the machines were rigged, and now the customers want their money refunded... but the casino staff aren't going to surrender their money without a fight.

choice.text: You're not going to help anyone all alone on your own.
(Zoltan Crew) Convince them to reach a peaceful solution.

event.text: Your Zoltan lectures the two groups about peaceful resolution and the necessity of pacifism... but all it accomplishes is putting the entire crowd to sleep. You take advantage of the situation and salvage some supplies laying around the casino and head back to the ship.

name: NEBULA_SLUG_ILLEGAL_CLONES
text: A Slug Laboratory nearby appears to be conducting research on cloning technology. They hail you, offering a "unique offer".

event.text: "Assss you know, the sshort-sssighted Federation hasss decided to outlaw the cloning of ssstill living organissssmssss. Luckily for ussss, thisss iss not Federation territory. For a sssmall fee, we would be willing to duplicate one of your crew, though the clone will not ssshare the sssame memoriesss or ssskillss asss the original."
"What a ssstrange creature. Ah well, if they can be cloned, then I won't asssk quessstionsss." The Slugs drop off the clone before disappearing back into their ship.

choice.text: We will not break the Federation's laws.

event.text: You don't give the Slugs a chance to explain and cease communications with them.

name: NEBULA_STORM_SLUG_POWER
text: The Slugs here appear to have achieved something unique. A powerplant here appears to be generating power by harvesting the charge from the ion storm here!

event.text: For some reason you have decided to attack the Slugs. Though the facility is unarmed, one of their vessels rises to meet you and defend them.

choice.text: Pay them to do some work on your reactor.

event.text: The Slugs have worked on many reactors in the past, and with their expertise in power (not to mention the nice portion of scrap given to them), the Slugs go to work on your reactor.
You decide to move past the power plant.

name: NEBULA_SLUG_DRUGS
text: A nearby immaculate Slug ship hails you. "Hello, welcome to thissss beacon. Would you care to come aboard for a drink? It is cussstomary for usss to welcome visssitorsss."

event.text: The Slugs welcome you onboard, giving you a tour of their ship. It's actually rather nice, and you don't see any illegal contraband either. They offer you a glass of juice from some alien fruit, have a toast for your new friendship, and then return back to your ship.
You decline the Slugs offer. They say they understand, and even give you some fuel out of good will.

name: ROCK_DRUGS_WIN
text: Your confused stupor wears off, and you suddenly come to the realization that the ship you were fighting was no Rock Picket at all. Instead, it was simply a few asteroids that had drifted dead into the nebulae. Luckily, the damage you dealt to them exposed some harvestable fuel.

name: NEBULA_SLUG_JAILER
text: A Slug Jailer is slinking through the nebula looking for fugitives to capture. It doesn't appear they've noticed you.

event.text: You power up your weapons and engage the Slug vessel.

Your crew, armed to the teeth, board the Jailer and quickly take down the Slug crew staffing it. With the jailers turned prisoners, you free everyone locked up who you don't think will kill you immediately.
You aren't in the mood to hold a jailbreak today. You distance yourself from the Jailer.

name: SURRENDER_SLUG_JAILER
text: "I sssee your weaponsss are rather... well ssstocked. However, you look a little low on crew. Perhapsss we could offer one of our prisssonersss to you?"

name: SLUG_JAILER_DESTROY
text: The Jailer has been destroyed. While an excess of scrap remains, it's very unlikely any prisoners survived.

name: SLUG_JAILER_KILL
text: The crew of the Jailer has been emptied. You scrap the externals of the ship.

name: NEBULA_REFUGEE_SLUG_MV
text: Your sensors have picked up a refugee ship drifting through the system, no doubt one of many fleeing the Rebel advance. It doesn't appear to have detected you... or else it is trying to avoid notice.

event.text: You're wary of the refugees but figure it's safe to do something on the ship.

name: NEBULA_SLUG_DRINK_MV
text: A Slug captain hails and invites himself aboard your ship to present a flask of something slimy. "Now, most gracioussss captain, you must join me please in a drink to our alliance!"

event.text: The Slug feigns offense at your refusal, but you sense that he respects your caution. This does not, however, prevent him from returning to his ship and opening fire.

choice.text: (Rock Crew) Have your Rockman pose as captain.
(Shell Crew) Have your Shell pose as captain.
(Ghost Crew) Have your Ghost pose as captain.

name: NEBULA_SLUG_CHOOSE_DEATH_MV
text: You are immediately hailed by a dangerous looking ship guarding a station. "I'm feeling generouss today. I shall allow you to choose your own death. Which do you like leasst: shields, oxygen, or weaponsss?"

event.text: "Very good then!" Your shield power suddenly drops and they charge.
Your shield system is restored to full power.
"Your acceptance of death is almosst admirable... Almosst." Your weapons system registers a hacking module. You hardly have time to respond before they attack.
Your weapon system is restored to full power.
"A being that would choose sssuffocation? Who am I to judge..." Your life support is sabotaged and they move in to attack.
Your oxygen system is restored to full power.

choice.text: Offer 35 scrap to leave you alone.

event.text: "I really am feeling generousss..." They take the scrap and leave.
"Sssilence won't protect you. I'll make the choice mysself... Wait. Why isssn't thisss working?" You cut transmission and move in to attack.

name: NEBULA_SLUG_HULLFIX_MV
text: You arrive to find a small Slug repair station. "Greetingsss traveller! Care for a fix up? We could eassily patch up ssome of that damage."

event.text: "Too bad! Trussst iss a rare commodity these days." You prepare to jump.

choice.text: Ask if they would like payment.

name: NEBULA_ROCK_SLUG_ARGUMENT_MV
text: You detect multiple ships running at maximum power nearby, but you can't see anything through this thick nebula.

event.text: You distance yourself from the ships, just in case.

name: NEBULA_SLUG_IMPORTANT_PRISONER
text: A Slug Elite appears to be protecting a small Slug Jailer. You aren't certain why, but surely something important must be kept in there?

choice.text: Attack the elite to get to the Jailer.

event.text: The Jailer ship slinks back while the much stronger Elite moves to fight you.
Not too long after the Slugs disappear into the nebula.

name: NEBULA_LIGHT_SLUG_GRAVE
text: Several sombre Slug ships are departing from a barren planet. It doesn't look particularly habitable, but the computer informs you the planet is used as burial place for prior Slug Kings and other members of the Slug Royal Family.

event.text: As you approach the gravesite, an Elite Slug vessel moves in to protect the planet!
You'd have to be suicidal to try and rob the tombs of ex-Slug royals in the Slug Homeworlds.

name: SLUG_GRAVE_WIN
text: Though the gravesite is dotted with many different tombs, 3 in particular stand out to you.

event.text: Arsagh's tomb includes a detailed sculpture of his greatness, made out of pure gold. It's so bright you nearly go blind looking at it.
It appears Terlack has a long, deep life story, etched across several thousand paragraphs on his epitome. Luckily you have an excuse not to read it.
Orsek must not have led a very interesting life, because his tomb has almost no decorations, and his epitome is a single sentence, that simply reads 'he died as he lived'.

name: NEBULA_LIGHT_SLUG_MINDSLAVES
text: A Cealaformer Station is orbiting a nearby planet, though it doesn't attempt to contact you. Nebulous clouds have begun to fill the beacon, but not enough to tamper with your sensors completely.

choice.text: Land on the planet and see if they have a market.

event.text: The surface of one of the nearby colonies is a very strange sight. The residents, a variety of different races, shamble about like mindless puppets in orderly lines. It seems as though they are being controlled... perhaps by the cealaformer you saw from space?
These people need to be rescued! You power up the engines and engage the Cealaforming Station.

choice.text: We need to get out of here!

event.text: You quickly pilot away from the station before the Slugs attempt to pull any other tricks on you.

choice.text: We need to get out of here!

event.text: You decide not to land on the planet. If the Slugs are somehow involved, that can't be good.

name: NEBULA_SLUG_DISTRESS_TRICK
text: You find a Slug vessel broadcasting the distress signal and contact them. "Ah, yesss, we are having problems with our oxygen generation unit. Perhaps your crew can assist in repairsss?"

choice.text: You have no crew to help.

event.text: You know better than to trust the Slugs. You cut communications and prepare to jump.

choice.text: (Mantis Crew) Have your Mantis oversee the repairs.

event.text: Once on board, it becomes clear that nothing is wrong with their O2 system. Almost expecting this, your Mantis calmly responds to the trap. Once a couple of the Slugs have been spread across the walls of their ship, the rest surrender.

choice.text: (Repair Drone) Send a drone to solve their problem.

event.text: Your drone easily handles the situation. In no time at all, it is able to make the necessary repairs, and you head off with some extra scrap in your hold.

choice.text: (Repair Burst) Launch a repair bomb into their Life Support. [-1}]

event.text: A single repair bomb is all it takes to fully repair their Life Support. The Slugs pay you nicely for the repairs.

name: NEBULA_SLUG_DISTRESS_ROCK
text: You arrive to find a Slug ship in the middle of boarding a disabled Rock freighter.

name: NEBULA_DISTRESS_SLUG_QUESTION
text: You arrive near the distress beacon's signal.

name: SLUG_DISTRESS_QUESTION_FALSE
text: "That issss... incorrect." Further, I have taken advantage of your lack of acuity to beam aboard your ship and steal your stuff!

name: SLUG_DISTRESS_QUESTION_TRUE
text: "That isss... correct. You sssurprise me. Federation, is it? Yesss... we can be partners." The Slug beams aboard and joins your crew!

name: NEBULA_SLUG_ROCK_SALTY
text: The nearby nebula has been polluted with the remains of Slug ships of all kinds. In center of the wreckage is a single elite Rock ship, the lone survivor of what must have been a terrible battle.

event.text: The Rockmen explain that they have come to avenge their fallen brothers from the Slug Expansion wars. They have been hunting Slugs in this nebula for some time now, but one ship has managed to evade their capture so far. They hope that you may be able to track the Slugs down. If you succeed, there will be a reward waiting for you.

choice.text: Agree to hunt down the Slugs.

event.text: Despite the Slug Expansion wars having happened over 5 years ago and having been resolved in a truce between the Slugs and Rockmen, you're more than willing to do the Rockman's dirty work if it means you get some scrap out of it.
The Rockmen don't seem to care and cut comms.
For some reason you have decided to tangle with the Rock Elite. You hurry to combat positions.

choice.text: We should get the hell out of here.

event.text: Tangling with a Rock Elite is the worst thing you could do. You leave the ship alone.

name: NEBULA_SLUG_ROCK_SALTY_HUNT

unvisitedTooltip.text: A Rock Crusader has asked you to pursue a Slug vessel here.

text: You spot the Slug ship in question slinking away into the nebula. You aren't sure if they noticed you.

event.text: The Slugs try desperately to shake you, but you won't relent. At last, they give up and hail you. "Thossse filthy Rocksss ssent you, didn't they! Pleassse, we'll pay you. Jussst let uss live."
You aren't letting the Slugs go without a fight.
You've lost interest in the reward, and decide not to chase down the Slugs.

name: NEBULA_SLUG_ROCK_SALTY_HUNT_WIN
text: You jump as the Rock ship comes out of its hiding place in the nebula before you can even contact them. "Excellent work. You have made Rock-kind proud. Payment is in order, as promised."

name: NEBULA_QUEST_SLUG_PIRATE_TRAP
text: You arrive to the sight of two Slug ships in communication range. They don't see you.

event.text: You overhear their conversation and learn they're planning to raid an infamous and likely wealthy pirate ship in the area. The pair jump off and you note down their target co-ordinates.
You have no interest in anything the Slugs could make business out of. Time to move on.

name: NEBULA_QUEST_SLUG_PIRATE_TRAP2

unvisitedTooltip.text: Location of a supposed wealthy pirate targeted by a pair of Slug ships.

text: You catch up with the two Slug ships and they're already carrying out their raid! One is in close combat with the pirate, the other seems to be heading for a small space cache the pirate was protecting.

event.text: Suddenly the first ship bursts into flames, and an urgent call arrives from the remaining Slugs. "We sssuggessst you distract the pirate vesssel while we retrieve the valuables. Fifty fifty sssplit."
There's money to be made here. The Slugs know that. You turn on the pirate and intercept just before he can reach the cache!
When he sees you making for the cache the Slug captain hails: "Foolish alienss, no eye for profit. Bessst of luck to you." They jump off, leaving you toe to toe with the pirate!

name: NEBULA_SLUG_MANTIS
text: The Mantis attack ship here looks to have been hunting Slugs on their home turf - a rare test of honor for the mightiest Mantis crews. Weapons up!

name: NEBULA_SLUG_PIRATE
text: You're surprised to find a ship without Slug markings stranded all the way out here, and move in to provide assistance. When you see the pirate insignia on the hull you quickly reconsider.

event.text: You prepare for combat.

choice.text: Keep your distance and hope they haven't seen you yet.

name: NEBULA_SLUG_INFECTOR
text: You hear a shout from your crew and come running. A Slug has injected one of them with a long needle and promptly beams away. They hail you, claiming to have injected your crewmember with a deadly chemical, and unless you pay them for the antidote, your crewmember will die.

tooltip.text: Your crewmember has been poisoned. If you jump away without curing them, they'll die.

choice.text: We aren't paying for your damn antidote! We'll take it from you!

event.text: You hurry to man the weapons and take back the antidote from the Slugs.
The Slug chuckles and sends over the antidote. You don't have much choice other than to give it to your crewmember. Luckily, they seem to feel better afterwards. The Slug jumps away.
Luckily you're able to treat your crew. The Slugs are annoyed, but now that they have no leverage they're helpless and pay you some scrap to let them go in peace.

name: SLUG_INFECTOR_DEATH
text: Your crew buckles over in pain, gasping for air. Without the antidote there's nothing you can do but watch them die.

removeCrew.text: It seems whatever the Slugs used carries over to your crew in the next life. You have no choice but to remove their entries from the Clone Bay.

name: NEBULA_SLUG_DOORS
text: There are few more vicious beasts in the galaxy than a Slug with his back to the wall. The faltering ship armed with fire-weapons uses a remote hacking tool to try and disable your door system - they're going to burn you out!

event.text: Your hacking system automatically counters the digital assault and you move in to fight the ship.
Your Anti-virus module automatically counters the digital assault and you move in to fight the ship.

name: NEBULA_SLUG_OXYGEN
text: The Slugs here use a tactic you hoped you'd never see: they use a remote hacking satellite to sabotage your oxygen production system and then charge fire-weapons - you're going to suffocate!

choice.text: (Upg. Oxygen) Try to squeeze some extra power to the system.

event.text: Thankfully your improved subsystem is able to counter their hacking enough to keep the life support barely functional. That should keep you alive at least...
Your hacking system automatically counters the digital assault and you move in to fight the ship.
Your Anti-virus module automatically counters the digital assault and you move in to fight the ship.

name: NEBULA_SLUG_MEDBAY
text: A Slug ship hails you: "We've detected sssome worrying radiation coming from your medical unit, perhapsss you ssshould take a look?" As he signs off, your system shuts off and their crew teleports aboard from a nearby station. They don't look like engineers.

event.text: Your medical system shuts off. You prepare to defend your ship.

choice.text: (Upg. Medbay) Try to squeeze some extra power to the system.

event.text: Fearing the imminent battle you desperately try to get the Medbay working again. Its lights flicker back on and you turn to face the intruders.

choice.text: (Upg. Clone Bay) Try to squeeze some extra power to the system.

event.text: Fearing the imminent battle you desperately try to get the Clone Bay working again. Its lights flicker back on and you turn to face the intruders.
You are able to undo the damage of their remote hacking satellite but it's taking everything your hacking system has. Time to take out the enemy the old fashioned way.
Your Anti-virus module automatically counters the digital assault and you move in to fight the ship.

name: NEBULA_ENCOUNTER_SLUG_HACKER
text: The Slug Hackers are surprisingly rare, even in Slug territory. Despite this, you seem to have had the misfortune to have encountered one at this beacon.

name: NEBULA_ENCOUNTER_SLUG_ELITE
text: Despite the unruly nature of the Slugs, they have a devout sense of pride in their empire and the royal family. The Slug Elite here seems to take your intrusion in their territory as an insult, and have decided to remove you from it.

name: NEBULA_LIGHT_DISTRESS_SLOCKNOG_START
text: The distress beacon here appears to be broadcasting through a clearing in the nebula. Following it, you come across a rogue planet drifting through the abyss. Scans indicate that something has crashed on the surface.

event.text: You know better than to fall for a potential trap in Slug space.

name: DISTRESS_SLOCKNOG_INVESTIGATE
text: You pilot closer to the planet. Though it is almost entirely pitch black, a single light is emitting from a large elite Slug cruiser! As soon as you approach a bright yellow Slug comes crawling out from inside, a weapon drawn.

event.text: "Ah, a sssentient ssspecies, after all this time. I am Slocknog, a wandering hero ssseeking adventure. I have been marooned here for sssso ssso long... I need help with my sssship, and all of my crew are dead. Could you be sssso kind asss to lend jussst a little bit of ssscrap?"

choice.text: Give him the "little bit of scrap" he asks for.

event.text: It's a lot more than you were hoping for, but you gift him the amount he requests. "Oh, you are truly an unexpected blessssing. I have ssspent sso long running thisss empire, I have nearly forgotten the kindnessss othersss outside these nebulasss often have..."

choice.text: Wait, did you say RUNNING this empire?
That's way too much, give him half.

event.text: "Thissss isss not a lot, but I sssupposse it iss better than nothing."
"I need not thisss weapon any longer, it will sssservice you inssstead. Asss thankss, for your mossst generous offer."

choice.text: (Repair Drone) Use the drone and a few drone parts to fix his ship completely.

event.text: "Oh, you are truly an unexpected blessssing. I have ssspent sso long running thisss empire, I have nearly forgotten the kindnessss othersss outside these nebulasss often have..."

choice.text: Wait, did you say RUNNING this empire?

event.text: "You are most uncharitable, and a massssive wassste of time. Had I the weaponsss to chassse you off thisss rock I would, but alasss my only option isss to glare at you until you leave."

choice.text: Blast him and scrap his ship.

event.text: Taking no chances, you immediately shoot the Slug first, turning him into a smoking puddle of blood and ooze. You land the ship and dismantle his cruiser.

name: SLOCKNOG_REVEAL
text: "Oh, heheh, yessss. I lied about the wandering hero part, I am but in fact Sssssir Ssslocknog Dssilli. I WASSS king of thissss place, until that bassstard Nightsss cheated and ssstole the crown, then exiled me!"

choice.text: Nights? As in, the pirate captain?

event.text: "Yesss, that Nightsss, who's alssso a ssself proclaimed 'badassss'. Every 4 yearsss the Sssslugs hold their Crown Theft Fesssstival, where thievesss compete to sssteal the crown and become the next king. It isss a time honored and non-violent tradition, at leasssst until Nightsss came and killed my men and forced me into giving the crown to him!"

"I wasss KING until that sssscumlord cheated and took everything from me! But now with thisss scrap, I can fix up my ssship and retake my throne! Thank you captain. Have thissss augment, and sssshould you wissh to sssee the sspectacle for yoursself, here are the coordinatesss to the Royal Nebula."

name: DISTRESS_SLOCKNOG_INVESTIGATE_BORING
text: Feeling a strange sense of deja-vu, you pilot closer to the planet. Alas, nothing remains but rubble of a Slug Transport. Mere scrap to bring back to the ship, though you aren't complaining.

name: NEBULA_SLUG_UNLOCK
text: It appears a Slug Clairvoyant is defending this system. Spotting you, as a Federation ship, they attack!

name: SURRENDER_SLUG_UNLOCK
text: "Pleasssse, pleasssse! You have besssted usss! Let ussss go, and we can make it worth your while! You might know Ssslugsss asss trickssstersss, but when our back isss againsst the wall we can keep promisssesss too!"

event.text: "All we can offer issss thissss prototype modified Bio-beam. They won't be happy about ussss giving thissss up..."
The weapon given by the Slugs appears to be some kind of prototype variant of a standard Anti-bio beam. Fascinating, and it leads you to wonder how many other variants might be out there.

choice.text: As a Clairvoyant, surely you know who you were bringing this gun to.

event.text: "Gah, you're too curiousss. We're going to be killed for thissss! Thisss weapon isss to be inssstalled on our finessst new line of Sssslug warssshipss. Asss the Coalition growssss, it doesssn't hurt to keep the Slug armada prepared if thosssse Rockmen or Mantisss cave firssst." After a little more questioning, the Slugs reluctantly hand over the coordinates for the construction platform.

name: SLUG_UNLOCK_2_MV

unvisitedTooltip.text: Location of a secret Slug construction platform.

text: Your arrival at the co-ordinates given to you by the Clairvoyant puts you dangerously close to a massive Slug construction yard, protected by a well armed elite Slug station. Fortunately you slip away into the nebula quickly before you're spotted. At least you can be certain this is the right location.

event.text: You'll be damned if you came all this way just to flake out. You raise the weapons and attack the station.

choice.text: Seems like a wise idea to leave.

name: SLUG_UNLOCK_3_MV
text: The station has been defeated. In the background blares a loud siren as a small, poorly equipped defense team come out but stop when they see your ship. It appears the Slugs were relying almost entirely on that station for defense.

event.text: It doesn't take much to get the Slugs to surrender at this point. So afraid you'll wipe the entire construction crew out of existence, they offer a similar prototype weapon to the one earlier, some scrap, and the blueprints to one of the Slug cruisers!

name: NEBULA_LIGHT_SLUG_PLEASURE_1
text: The nebula at this beacon has cleared partially, revealing a massive Slug pleasure barge! These ships are populated to the brim with Slugs looking to have an... enjoyable experience. Despite its size, the ship doesn't seem to wield any weapons at all.

choice.text: Should be easy enough, raid the barge.

event.text: As you move in to attack, a smaller ship escorting the barge moves in to defend. You must have missed them from behind the immense size of the barge, but a fight is now unavoidable.
The ship is filled with Slug civilians, there's little incentive to attack.

name: SLUG_PLEASURE_1_WIN
text: Scans show the barge won't remain at this beacon for much longer, as its engines are already charging and it's attempting to flee. You won't have time to fight it here before it escapes.

choice.text: There's nothing else we can do. Let it jump.

event.text: You might not be able to fight it here, but maybe you'll have the luck to run into it again in this sector or the next.
You might not be able to fight it here, but you're able to lock onto the ship's jump signatures. You'll be able to follow it with ease now.
You might not be able to fight it here, but your Slug is able to lock onto the ship's jump signatures. You'll be able to follow it with ease now.
You might not be able to fight it here, but your Shell is able to lock onto the ship's jump signatures. You'll be able to follow it with ease now.
You might not be able to fight it here, but you're able to lock onto the ship's jump signatures. You'll be able to follow it with ease now.

name: SLUG_LIGHT_PLEASURE_2_NOQUEST
text: It must be your lucky day, it seems you've stumbled across the Pleasure Barge once again!

name: SLUG_LIGHT_PLEASURE_2

unvisitedTooltip.text: Presumed location of the Pleasure Barge.

text: This time you've tracked down the Barge again, and it has no escort. It is completely unprotected save for its teleporter system.

event.text: You approach the barge and prepare to finish it off once and for all.

choice.text: You've done enough. Leave them alone.

event.text: You've already needlessly scared the Slugs on board, there's no reason to continue your attack.

escape.text: As you continue your assault on the barge, you notice several life pods dispensing from the vessel! It appears the civilians are attempting to escape. Meanwhile, the Pleasure Barge begins to charge its engines.

choice.text: Cease attacking and pick up some of the pods.

event.text: You abandon the barge and scoop up some of the lifepods. It seems you've lucked out once again with your find... this pod contains a Slug Saboteur!

choice.text: They're at our mercy. Force them to serve on the ship.
Force them to surrender all they have in return for their lives.

surrender.text: You receive a hail from the captain of the pleasure barge. "Pleasssse, there are sssso many innocent people on thisss ssship. I will give you everything, jussst do not kill usss!"

event.text: "Ok, ok! I will beam the ssssuppliesss over now."

choice.text: Your offer does not interest us. Is this the best you can do?

event.text: "Ok! I sssaid I will give you everything! I will ssserve on your sssship, how doesss thisss ssound?"
The Slug teleports over, reluctant to work among you but realizing it's the only way to save the civilians from your wrath.

choice.text: You have to think bigger, grander! Think of what is at stake.

event.text: "Fine! Take the entire sssship! I don't care. Jussst let ussss all go."

choice.text: Now that's an offer we can't refuse.

event.text: The rest of the civilians clear out of the pleasure barge. You raze the interior, salvaging as much as you can. It would be a shame to let this ship go to waste. You reprogram the ship's FTL drive to direct the ship back to the nearest Federation base, where it will be scanned and rebuilt for future Multiverse travelers.

choice.text: We will not accept your surrender.

destroyed.text: The Pleasure Barge explodes, scattering debris and the corpses of dozens of civilian Slugs. You salvage the debris, of which there is quite a decent portion of.

event.text: As you fly away, you spot a single life-pod that survived the explosion. Inside is a slave who was forced to work aboard the barge. Now free, they join your crew.

deadCrew.text: You have emptied the barge entirely of its crew. As you move about salvaging what you can, you also come across an odd drone blueprint and plenty of resources.

event.text: The ship is eerily quiet. You've done a proficient job of clearing out the crew, and it would be a shame to let it go to waste. You reprogram the ship's FTL drive to direct the ship back to the nearest Federation base, where it will be scanned and rebuilt for future Multiverse travelers.

name: KNIGHT_CALL_CENTER
text:
There's a Slug station at this beacon, and a fairly active one at that; you pick up tons of transmissions coming from it. It doesn't seem like they've noticed you yet. You tap into one of the many signals, and luckily, it seems they're all unencrypted.
        
"...yesss ma'am, our ssssoftware will keep your sssstuff safe. You're welcome, ma'am. Now, for payment, we actually only take Tony'ssss giftcardssss - it'ssss much more ssssecure than normal transsssactionsss..."
You swap to another transmission. "...long losssst relative of a prince of a remote ssssysssstem..." a Slug says in what sounds like an attempt at mimicking a Mantis, "and many goodiessss await you! Jusssst need identi-" You've heard enough to get a decent idea of what's going on here.

event.text: You power up your weapons and charge towards the station before they can react.

You carefully fly closer to the station. It takes little time for them to notice you, and very quickly all the transmissions go quiet. A hail follows after. "Hi, uh, Renegade. We're not up to anything at all. Nope. Not even a little. And even if we hypothetically were, you're not that attached to the Fedssss, right? Not that we are, but you'd let ussss go if we were. Hypothetically. In theory."

choice.text: No, we definitely are. Pretty sure scamming is a crime.

event.text: "Aw, ssssshit. Well, in that case..." The station begins charging its weapons. No other option but to engage!

"Thank god. In an absssstract, theoretical way. Becausssse we're not doing anyth-" These guys aren't fooling anyone, but they aren't your problem to deal with. You cut the comm and prepare to jump away.

choice.text: Who cares about some scammers? Leave.

event.text: You prepare to jump away.

Your Slug directs you to hail the station. The second they connect, they immediately start babbling in a croaky, frail voice. "Issss thissss the technology ssssupport center? My grandsssson found thissss sssship and it keepssss not working..."
			
Another Slug onboard the station responds with poorly concealed glee, apparently not caring that they're scamming one of their own. "Yessss, yesss, it issss. We can help, you jussst need to let ussss interface with your sssship."
			
Your Slug grins at you. "Oh, okay. What'ssss 'interface'?"

Your Slug spends the next while being as dense and obstructive as possible, talking in complete circles and generally being annoying. The scammer lasts for a surprisingly long time, but eventually, after your Slug asks what an engine is for the fifth time, he cracks. There's a banging noise over the comm punctuated by a scream of rage. "Sssstupid little- how isss it posssssible to be too dumb to sssscam? How can you even pilot that thing? AGHHH."

The comm cuts off and your Slug starts howling with laughter. Knowing you've done an incredible service - a.k.a. waste someone's time - you prepare to jump away. Right before you're about to, though, you watch as one of the airlocks on the station opens and a computer comes sailing out, with a schematic saved in it! It's not much, but it's honest work.

name: KNIGHT_ORCHID_LOVER
text: There's a Knight ship hanging outside the nebula. Rather than making any motions to attack, the ship seems to ignore you. A private communication comes from within the ship. "You... you are an outssssider. Have you ever heard of the Gathering? I have lived my whole life in thissss nebula, but I have grown tired of thissss place. The latesssst hunt for the crown hassss ssssettled it. I long to go to an arboreal world of lusssh foresstsss and friendly cussstomsss. Get away from thissss sssstresssful life. But... with my reputation assss a Knight of the Crown, I don't think a life outsssside of thissss nebula would ever accept me."

event.text:
Mayeb speaks up. "...hello. I am Mayeb, Caretaker of the Gathering. ...It is true that you won't fit in. They will judge you for your past, and for being different. But that does not mean you can't make a life for yourself. If you are not fit for your current position, maybe a life of tending to the plants can be very fulfilling. It is the life I will return to once I am released from my duties. Perhaps we can teach you. Would you like to accompany me?"
			
The Knight's voice is filled with joy. "I will come with you!" Moments later, the Knight appears on your ship.
The ship arms weapons and hails you. "Quan?? You are defecting to thissss Renegade'ssss sssship?! Dissssloyal knightssss musssst be sssslain!"

choice.text: (Ivar) Tell the Knight about the Gathering.

event.text:
"Aye lad! The Gathering is lovely, I support you on your pilgrimage. Though if you ask me, they're a bit too restrained for my tastes. They need to lighten up! I'm always telling them this in my dinner parties."

"Ivar? The Premier of the Oro'Bache?"

Ivar laughs. "That's what the nameplate on my desk says!"

The Knight seems invested. "The rumorssss sssay you are a quarter Ctl'Yae. Issss that true?"

"I got a bit of diversity in my sap, that's true. How about this, next time I have a dinner party, I'll invite you and some of my Floral buddies and we can all have a good time. I'm sure I can turn the ear of your government. Sounds good?"

"Yessss! That ssssoundssss lovely. Thank you. My name is Quan. Pleasssse remember it." Quan presents you with a nice gift of scrap and a weapon.

"So, you want to move to the Gathering? This is doable. The Gathering would be willing to support an expatriated Knight if you can take a carnivorous pledge and a citizen exam."

The Knight nods fervently. "I've been a carnivore for yearssss. I've alwayssss wanted to be a Ctl'Yae."

Ty nods. "Got it. You would, of course, be subjected to more scrutiny than an Oro'bache might. If you want to pursue that path, I'm certain it would look good if you would join the guard of the Gardenworlds."

The Knight pauses. "If I leave the nebula, there issss no coming back."

Ty E'Rel nods. "If you come with us, I will do everything I can for you." Moments later, the Knight appears on your ship.
The ship arms weapons and hails you. "Quan?? You are defecting to thissss Renegade'ssss sssship?! Dissssloyal knightssss musssst be sssslain!"

Your Praetor talks about their time protecting the homelands and about the beautiful gardens that the Caretakers maintain.
			
"Meeting a Praetor issss going to be the highlight of my year. Thank you for your time." The Knight sends you a stockpile of scrap for your time.

choice.text: (Caretaker Crew) Tell the knight about the Gardens.

event.text:
Your Caretaker begins to talk about their experiences in the gardens caring for the flora of the Gardenworlds. They pore through their personal picture collection and send images to the curious Knight.
			
"Meeting a Caretaker thissss deep in Kleptocracy sssspace... I'm very fortunate. Thank you, I will ussse thesssse picturessss when I am feeling down." The Knight sends a weapon in return.

Your Orchid is happy to talk about how nice their homeland is, going on about the lush gardens and their friends and family. The Knight seems happy to hear about your Orchid's life. You're rewarded with a modest pile of scrap.

choice.text: (Vampweed Crew) Have your Vampweed talk about their experiences.

event.text: Your Vampweed begins to talk about their experiences with their floral cousins. The Knight is attentive, but seems vaguely unsatisfied. Nevertheless, you are paid for your time.

choice.text: Offer the knight a Kernel Burst 1.

event.text: "I have alwayssss wanted a Kernel weapon. Maybe when I usssse thissss, I will feel at easssse."

choice.text: Offer the knight a Kernel Burst 2.

event.text: "I have alwayssss wanted a Kernel weapon. Maybe when I usssse thissss, I will feel at easssse."

choice.text: Offer the knight a Heavy Kernel.

event.text: "I have alwayssss wanted a Kernel weapon. Maybe when I usssse thissss, I will feel at easssse."

choice.text: Offer the knight a Fire Kernel.

event.text: "I have alwayssss wanted a Kernel weapon. Maybe when I usssse thissss, I will feel at easssse."

choice.text: Offer the knight a Chain Kernel.

event.text: "I have alwayssss wanted a Kernel weapon. Maybe when I usssse thissss, I will feel at easssse."

choice.text: Offer the knight a Charge Kernel.

event.text: "I have alwayssss wanted a Kernel weapon. Maybe when I usssse thissss, I will feel at easssse."

choice.text: Offer the knight a Kernel Mine Launcher.

event.text: "I have alwayssss wanted a Kernel weapon. I've never even heard of a Kernel Mine Launcher! Maybe when I usssse thissss, I will feel at easssse."

choice.text: Offer the knight an elite Kernel Burst 1.

event.text: "I have alwayssss wanted a Kernel weapon. An elite Kernel isss even better! Maybe when I usssse thissss, I will feel at easssse."

choice.text: Offer the knight an elite Kernel Burst 2.

event.text: "I have alwayssss wanted a Kernel weapon. An elite Kernel isss even better! Maybe when I usssse thissss, I will feel at easssse."

choice.text: Offer the knight an elite Heavy Kernel.

event.text: "I have alwayssss wanted a Kernel weapon. An elite Kernel isss even better! Maybe when I usssse thissss, I will feel at easssse."

choice.text: Offer the knight an elite Fire Kernel.

event.text: "I have alwayssss wanted a Kernel weapon. An elite Kernel isss even better! Maybe when I usssse thissss, I will feel at easssse."

choice.text: Offer the knight an elite Chain Kernel.

event.text: "I have alwayssss wanted a Kernel weapon. An elite Kernel isss even better! Maybe when I usssse thissss, I will feel at easssse."

choice.text: Offer the knight an elite Charge Kernel.

event.text: "I have alwayssss wanted a Kernel weapon. An elite Kernel isss even better! Maybe when I usssse thissss, I will feel at easssse."

choice.text: Offer the knight a Strawberry Gun.

event.text: "What'ssss thisss? Thisss lookssss extremely rare, issss thissss a Renegade weapon? Maybe I sssshould become a Renegade too. Thank you."

choice.text: Offer the knight a Chaotic Strawberry Gun.

event.text: "Thissss... issss the mosssst bizarre weapon I've ever sssseen. What have you given me...?"

win.text: The galaxy is completely unrecognizable now.

event.text: The private communication is cut. The Knight ship immediately responds to your assault!
The knight makes no moves to interfere with you.

name: KNIGHT_KERNEL_PAYMENT_OR_TRADE
text: "I'll let you pick. Would you prefer payment, or a weapon?"

name: KNIGHT_KERNEL_DOUBLE_PAYMENT
text: As a repayment for your generous gift, the Knight gives you one of his own weapons, plus a modest amount of scrap to accompany it.

name: KNIGHT_STRAWBERRY_REWARD
text: "You've been too generoussss... I wissssh that I could come with you, but leaving the Kleptocracy would leave me homelessss, and after the excitement fadessss I'd like ssssomewhere to live. What I can do for you, in addition to one of my own weaponssss, isss offer you a tune-up on your weaponssss and reactor. I hope it will ssssuffice."

name: KNIGHT_HEKTAR
text: The ship here clearly has a different affiliation to the rest. "Welcome to the Royal Nebula, outssssidersss. We've come here on behalf of Hektar to try and capitalize on thisss hissstoric moment. Would you like to buy a memento of the crown hunt? A limited edition crown, a perfect sssouvenir!"

choice.text: (Billy) "Are you wassssting company money on thissss?"

event.text: The Slug does a double take. "CEO Billy!!! Um... Lisssten, I can explain!" Billy narrows his eyes. "You'd better, your job dependssss upon it." The Hektar employee begins to sputter. He spouts out a number of excuses, before sheepishly shutting up and giving Billy a bribe.
Before you shop, you still have some time to do something else aboard the ship.

Metyunt starts to quote the Hektar employee handbook. As he does, the Slug on the other side has a moment of comprehension. "Oh. Pleasssse, don't report me... If it would have worked, I might have been rewarded!" Metyunt sighs. "Well, the very least you can do is give us a look at your store. With credit." The Slug nods.
You have the opportunity to do something on your ship after you shop.

choice.text: (Hektar Employee) Ask them if they really expect this to work.

event.text: "A fellow Hektar employee...? Well, I did but... sssshowssss what I know." Your Employee tells them they might as well recoup some of the cost by letting you use their store. "...Fine."
You have the opportunity to do something on your ship after you shop.

"Ah, good tasssste, loyal customer. Come, ssssee what elsssse we have in sssstore!" The speaker leans away from the microphone, and you can faintly hear him say to someone else: "Wow, finally ssssold one... I wassss worried my bossss would yell at me for thissss boneheaded idea."
The salesman quickly shuts off the display and activates their weapons.

choice.text: Don't waste your money on this weirdo.

event.text: "Renegade, you have no tasssste!"

name: KNIGHT_AMPERE_HOPEFUL
text: Strangely, a Republic ship has made its way into this region of space. "Hey, hi, how ya doin'? Since you're not affiliated with these Slugs, I just wanted to ask for your opinion on this disguise. It'll be great, I'm going to find the crown and become ruler of the Slugs." The Ampere's dressed up in a full Slug suit. It's not terrible.

choice.text: Tell him it's nice and wish him good luck.

event.text: "Damn right! I'm gonna win this thing. And... uh, here's a little something for keeping quiet about this."

"I got it all figured out!" He opens up his costume and shows you that the head of the costume is insulated with tin-foil. "...you'll see! It'll all work out." You shake your head. "Ah whatever. Take this and get outta here." He gives you some fuel.

choice.text: You're going to need a Slug ship if you're going to pass.

event.text: "...Oops! Can't believe I forgot about that. Uhhh... I guess I'll just have my guys drop me off somewhere and I'll hitchhike or something. Thanks for the tip." He graciously gives you a decent amount of scrap.
You roll your eyes and power up your weapons. The Leeches are quick to respond.

name: NEBULA_KNIGHT_QUIZ
text: It's not too common to see Clairvoyant ships about, but you've seen far less than expected here in this Slug-filled nebula. It seems you've finally run into one though, and they aren't firing on you just yet. Instead, it looks like they want to communicate.

event.text: "If our data issss correct, might it be true that you are the ssship everyone iss talking about? The one that hasss brought back to usss Ssslocknog, our great king?"
"Fasssscinating. Now I am wondering, do you think Sssslocknog is the bessst king for the Kleptocracy? Or do you prefer Nightsss and hisss... more radical way of leading usss?"
"Interesssting. And what makesss you sssay that?"

choice.text: He keeps things traditional. No need to change what works.

event.text: "Yesss, if it ain't broke, don't fix it... Well then, I cannot thank you enough for sssaving our king. Accept thisss asss humble payment."

choice.text: His name has a lot of S's in it.

event.text: "I don't think you underssstand what definesss a good trait in a king. Maybe you are not the bessst perssson to be getting involved in our politicsss..." You assume that's the end of it, but suddenly the Clairvoyant ship attacks! The Slugs must really not appreciate your intervention...

choice.text: He has yellow skin. That's pretty cool.

event.text: "I don't think you underssstand what definesss a good trait in a king. Maybe you are not the bessst perssson to be getting involved in our politicsss..." You assume that's the end of it, but suddenly the Clairvoyant ship attacks! The Slugs must really not appreciate your intervention...

"Interesssting. Ssso you would think that a drug addicted ssscumlord with three wivesss isss the chosssen king for the Ssslug people? Really ssshows how ignorant the Federation is..." You assume that's the end of it, but suddenly the Clairvoyant ship attacks! The Slugs must really not appreciate your intervention...
"Hmmm, yesss bessst not for foreignerssss to get involved in we Sssslugsss more peculiar formssss of government. All isss well then, take thisss ass a gift for sssaving Sssslocknog."
"Oh... how unfortunate." The ship jumps away, leaving you with nothing to do.
"My liege! I ssswear to follow you wherever you ssshall tread." The Clairvoyants offer supplies and one of them even join your crew.
The irredeemable bastard you are, you've decided to assault the ship without even giving them a chance.

name: NEBULA_LIGHT_KNIGHT_TRAP
text: A Slug vessel nearby is approaching a planet without any signs of civilization. You can't imagine what they'd be doing, unless they're hiding from something, or know something you don't.

event.text: "Huh? Oh, we're here to partake in the Crown Theft Fesssstival! We were told by some lovely fellowssss in a black and red sssship that thissss isss the place the contesst is being held."

choice.text: There's no one on that planet.

event.text: "Huh? What ever do you mean? That... Oh. I ssssee. It appearsss we have been played for foolssss. Thank you for sssaving us."

choice.text: Don't tell them the truth, but kill them and go investigate yourself.

event.text: "Wait, what are you doing?!" You cut off the Slugs and attack.
You watch as the Slugs fly past you with mild curiosity.

name: KNIGHT_TRAP_PLANET
text: You move closer to the planet. You can't see anything visibly of interest, but it's hard to say from a distance.

choice.text: (Upg. Sensors) Scan the surface from a distance.
(Long-Ranged Scanners) Scan the surface from a distance.

name: NEBULA_KNIGHT_SMUGGLER
text: Though Slugs have few qualms with transporting illicit contraband themselves, sometimes they'll pay the Smuggler clan to do their business. A Smuggler ship is attempting to avoid being seen by passing traffic, but fails to hide from you.

choice.text: Hail them, maybe we can buy some contraband off of them.

event.text: The smuggler captain appears on the screen. Though he tries to put on a menacing appearance, you can tell from his eager smug grin he's pleased by the prospect of another client. "If you're looking for guns or explosives, can't help you there Feddy boy. I'm on an express trip to Nights himself to deliver some brain melting power. These narcotics sell for premium price among the Slugs here, though not much in any other place."

choice.text: Buy the narcotics, they could be a valuable bargaining chip among Nights' men.

event.text: "An excellent purchase! Just don't ask what they're made of." You hear the pirate mumble something about Orchid children and Equinoid droppings, then hangs up.

choice.text: (Engine Disabler) Cripple their engines and demand they hand over the narcotics!

event.text: "Alright, alright! God damn, why are you so aggressive. You're the one who wanted to trade anyways..."

choice.text: (FTL Jammer) Cripple their engines and demand they hand over the narcotics!

event.text: "Alright, alright! God damn, why are you so aggressive. You're the one who wanted to trade anyways..."

choice.text: (Upg. Hacking) Cripple their engines and demand they hand over the narcotics!

event.text: "Alright, alright! God damn, why are you so aggressive. You're the one who wanted to trade anyways..."

choice.text: (Hacking Weapon) Cripple their engines and demand they hand over the narcotics!

event.text: "Alright, alright! God damn, why are you so aggressive. You're the one who wanted to trade anyways..."
The smugglers slip away into the nebula not much longer.

name: SLUG_NARCOTICS
text: It appears the Slugs are intrigued by your offer. They gladly accept the narcotics in turn for not fighting you, and even offer some scrap in return.

name: NEBULA_KNIGHT_DUEL
text: Out of nowhere, a Slug beams aboard your ship, brandishing a long sword. "On guard ye! I challenge you to a duel. Non-fatal, of coursssse. Defeat me and I will give you all the sssscrap my sssship carriessss. Lossse, and I take all of your fuel. Decline, and I ssshall leave without another word."

event.text: You send out your Mantis to duel. They give their all, and manage to disarm the Slug! "Alright, a deal isss a deal... Though I don't like the way you played, here'sssss my ssscrap."

Being a perfect match for such opportunity, Dessius accepts the challenge and unsheaths his own blade. Both fighters give their all, and this chivalrous clash results in the Slug getting disarmed! "Alright, a deal isss a deal. Your companion's prowesss and ssstyle is remarkable, and you do dessserve thisss ssscrap."

Being a perfect match for such opportunity, Devorak accepts the challenge and unsheaths his own blade. Both fighters give their all, and this chivalrous clash results in the Slug getting disarmed! "Alright, a deal isss a deal. Your companion's prowesss and ssstyle is remarkable, and you do dessserve thisss ssscrap."

"I wasssn't expecting to sssee one of my brothersss aboard your vesssel, and even lesss that I'd be going againsst them, but I ssstill look forward to it." Both Slugs fiercely fight, and after a long clash, your own Knight prevails! "Alright, a deal isss a deal. I greatly enjoyed thisss valiant ssskirmisssh, and you do dessserve thisss ssscrap."

name: NEBULA_KNIGHT_COALITION
text: You knew the Coalition consisted of Slugs among other races, but it's not terribly often you see their ships so deep in Slug space.

event.text: You power up your weapons and engage the Coalition vessel.

choice.text: Bribe the Coalition with the Narcotics.

event.text: You aren't willing to risk getting involved with another galactic super power today. For another reality, maybe.

name: NEBULA_LIGHT_KNIGHT_CHOICE
text: Short range scans show two Slug vessels are in a dogfight at this beacon: one belong to the Knights, and the other to the Clairvoyants.

event.text: You make your presence known, flying towards the ships. But who will you attack?
You arm the weapons and attack the Knight vessel.

choice.text: (Slug Narcotics) Bribe the Knights to stop fighting.

event.text: It appears the Knights are willing to swallow their pride and surrender if it means they get free hard drugs.
The Clairvoyant ship thanks you and offers a weapon.
You arm the weapons and attack the Clairvoyant vessel.
Slugs have never been known to be reliable allies, so you don't bother helping any side.

name: NEBULA_KNIGHT_PROTESTERS
text: You jump when a disembodied voice suddenly speaks to you. From behind, a Saboteur uncloaks, wearing a pin of the Knight logo. "You're... an outsssider, right? The one Sssslocknog sssent. Normally I'd kill you on the ssspot, but I think we can work together here. There'ssss sssome pesssky reformisssstss nearby who are trying to overhaul our government. We want them dead. Kill them, I pay you. Deal?"

event.text: The Saboteur leads you to a small moon with a Slug colony where several Slugs are protesting, led by a rogue Clairvoyant vessel. Take out their leader, and the rest will likely shut up.
You raise the weapons and engage the ship.

choice.text: (Slug Narcotics) Bribe the Clairvoyant to turn on its own people.

event.text: It seems drugs outweigh any moral quandaries in Slug society. The Clairvoyants take hold of the drugs, then turn their weapons upon the colonists, forcing them to surrender. Behind you, the Knight-aligned Saboteur is so humored by your 'creative' problem solving he offers an even larger reward.
The Saboteur frowns and beams away to whatever ship is hiding nearby in the nebula watching you.

name: KNIGHT_PROTESTERS_WIN
text: The rest of the colony is terrified. "Pleasssse, all we want isss peacce! The Kleptocracy isss sssso needlesssly cruel, regardlesss of the king! We want to progressss Sslug sssociety into sssomething the ressst of the galaxy can look at with more than dissstasste!"

choice.text: Ignore them and force the colony to surrender.

event.text: You ignore the colonists, raising your weapons and firing a warning shot. This sends them running for cover, and inevitably surrendering. The Saboteur returns and thanks you for your help, and rewards you as promised.

choice.text: Kill the Saboteur and free the colony.

event.text: You draw your blaster, and quickly spin around to blast the Saboteur. They're faster at first, but quickly get lost in the unfamiliar corridors of your ship and are dispatched with relative ease. Though a future Knight vessel will likely return to prey on the colony, they're free for now, and reward you in a somewhat unconventional way.

choice.text: (Fire Weapon) Make an example, torch the colony.

event.text: In a short period of time, the colony is ablaze and about half of its population dead. It's a gruesome display that will undoubtedly be used as propaganda in the future, but it's had quite the impression on the Saboteur. So amazed at your dedication to the task, he even offers to join your crew!

name: NEBULA_KNIGHT_SHAKESPEARE
text: "Hail th're did Feed'ration. Though mine own w'rds might beest rough, I asketh thee to holdeth with me. I may give you nay harmeth, lest thee stow thine weapons 'r brandish dram m're than the bravado one might beest accustom'd to. Aye? Art these reasonable t'rms 'r might we beest needing a duel?"

event.text: The Slug captain looks at you expectantly, though you don't understand a word he said.

choice.text: Try to speak back in whatever language that was.

event.text: Haynes explains that the Slugs are speaking in old Earth English. After a quick translation, you learn the Slugs are offering a truce, which you accept and bring back a weapon from their ship as a sign of goodwill!

choice.text: (Slug Crew) Have your Slug speak with them.

event.text: Your Slug bickers back and forth with the knights for a while, then reports back to you. "They sssspeak fine, they're jusssst ssstubborn and refussse to talk to ussss normally. They sssseem to want to make friendssss though, and are offering fuel."

choice.text: (Engi Crew) Analyze their speech patterns to translate.

event.text: "Language detected: old Earth English. Updating databases..." Your Engi explains the Slugs don't wish to fight, but actually wish to give you some fuel out of good will.

name: NEBULA_KNIGHT_JAILER
text: A Knighted Jailer flies past, only to briefly sling an insult at you. "Pissss off Federation, don't get involved lesssst you want a hole in your ssskull!"

event.text: You power up your weapons and engage the Slug vessel.

Your crew, armed to the teeth, board the Jailer and quickly take down the Slug crew staffing it. With the jailers turned prisoners, you free everyone locked up who you don't think will kill you immediately.

choice.text: Bribe them with the narcotics to let the prisoners go.

event.text: You aren't in the mood to hold a jailbreak today. You distance yourself from the Jailer.

name: SURRENDER_KNIGHT_JAILER
text: "Crap, you're better armed than predicted. Uh, will you let usss go if you take thissss prisssoner?"

name: KNIGHT_JAILER_DESTROY
text: The Jailer has been destroyed. While an excess of scrap remains, it's very unlikely any prisoners survived.

name: KNIGHT_JAILER_KILL
text: The crew of the Jailer has been emptied. You scrap the externals of the ship.

event.text: It appears most of the prisoners are dissenters from Nights' reign. A Saboteur loyal to Slocknog, recognizing you as the Federation ship sent by his hero, offers to work for you.

name: KNIGHT_JAILER_BRIBE
text: The Jailer seems more than willing to betray their nation in turn for some hard drugs.

event.text: It appears most of the prisoners are dissenters from Nights' reign. A Saboteur loyal to Slocknog, recognizing you as the Federation ship sent by his hero, offers to work for you.

name: NEBULA_DISTRESS_KNIGHT_TAXES
text: The distress beacon here originates from a small Slug colony, which is being oppressed by a Knighted vessel. You catch a small excerpt from their conversation on the radio. "Thisss iss OUTRAGEOUSSSSS. We haven't been paying taxesss for yearsss! No one doesss. They're merely a concept, not sssomething you enforce! Don't tell me that coward Nightsss finally got ssso greedy he'sss going to sssteal hissss own citizensss' money too?"

event.text: You intend to liberate the Slug colony, and attack the Knighted vessel.
You fire upon the colony, but in response they send a Clairvoyant ship to deal with you!

choice.text: (Slug Narcotics) Bribe the Knights with the narcotics to leave the colony alone.

event.text: The Knights seems more than willing to betray their nation in exchange for some hard drugs. The Knights fly away from the colony, presumably intending to put their new drugs to good use.
You have better things to do than help Slugs commit tax evasion.

name: KNIGHT_TAXES_COLONYHELP
text: The colony is grateful for your help. "Thankssss. Under Sssslocknog, there were no taxesss, we all got along jussst fine and the government got itsss money from extorting other nationsss. Like it sssshould be! Nightsss doesssn't even want the money to run the Kleptocracy, he just wantsss to ssspend it all on liquor and a mate." The colony brings out a weapon they've been keeping for defensive purposes but no longer need thanks to you.

name: KNIGHT_TAXES_KNIGHTHELP
text: Without their ship, the colony surrenders to the Knights. After their taxes have been collected and a few fugitives rounded up, the Knights contact you next. "The hell wasss that? You're probably looking for a reward. Uh... here, have one of the criminalssss. We'll just tell Nightsss they died of some obssscure disssseasse that rapidly decaysss the body or sssomething."

name: NEBULA_DISTRESS_KNIGHT_SHELLSPY
text: Surprisingly, it seems a Shell Radiant ship has found their way into the nebula here. They hail you, requesting aid.

event.text: "Oh good Federation captain, please help! We're here on a mission for thhhhhe Geniocracy to observe thhhe Slug operations, but our commander was taken hostage! Could you track down thhhe ship thhhat took thhhhhem and bring thhhem back?"
You plunge further into the nebula until you find the ship they were talking about, but they're already prepared for an attack and lock onto you immediately!

choice.text: Bribe them with the narcotics to let the Shells go.

event.text: Once again your sadistic tendencies have taken control, and you've abandoned all decency. But no matter, man the weapons!
You aren't here to participate in random side quests.

name: KNIGHT_SHELLSPY_BRIBE
text: The Knights seems more than willing to betray their nation in turn for some hard drugs.

event.text: Once free, you offer to bring the Radiant back, but he refuses. "Can't, our mission has been compromised. I'll order my men back, but I can't return to thhhe Geniocracy. Thhhhey have little tolerance for failure from Radiants like me. I will come withhh you instead, if thhhat is alright withhh you."

name: NEBULA_ENCOUNTER_KNIGHT_STORM
text: It appears this beacon is home to not only an ion storm, but a Knight vessel as well!

name: NEBULA_KNIGHT_ENGINES
text: Immediately after jumping into the beacon, your engines sputter and malfunction. Something is jamming them, and not longer after it's revealed who. A Knight vessel slips out of the nebula, offering to "fix" your engines for a bit of scrap.

event.text: You aren't paying any fee for your 'broken' engines. Outraged at your refusal, the Knight vessel attacks!
You undo the damage they have done. Unsurprisingly, this does not deter them from assaulting you regardless.
The Knight captain can't help but snicker as they board and pretend to work on your engines, scoop up some scrap, and leave.

name: KNIGHT_CLAN
text: A Clan vessel has taken a rest nearby. You aren't sure why they're here so far outside of the nebulas where ships are hunting for the crown.

event.text: "Ah, didn't think there wasss anyone elsse here who wassssn't busssy getting their asss handed to them by Nightsss'ss men. Idiotsss don't even know the Palace isssn't in a nebula, and that there'ssss no way Nightsss would dare leave the comfort of hisss hidey-hole."

"Ah, we've come here for the greatessst hunt known to the galaxy. Three headed beetle creaturesss, mutated Ssslug and Mantisss hybridss, and the mythical Sssalt Man are nothing compared to the prize we're after. The CROWN. Issss there anything better you could imagine?"

choice.text: Offer to buy any map data they have.

event.text: The Clansmen are more than willing to offer the data, knowing you're no threat to the title they're after.

choice.text: Offer to take them with you.

event.text: You explain that you're heading to the Palace yourself, and can take them there if they want. Shockingly, the Clansman is more than willing, but he wishes to test you. "I will not work aboard any ssship who is not as ssskilled at the hunt as I am. Let usss duel, and I ssshall only sssurrender sssshould you injure me to the point that I cannot proceed without medical aid!" Sounds easy enough, except the Clansman has used a combat augment to jam your Shields!
Your shields are restored. The Ranger will have to rely on conventional tactics rather than low blows.

choice.text: Offer to take them with you.

event.text: You explain that you're heading to the Palace yourself, and can take them there if they want. Shockingly, the Clansman is more than willing, but he wishes to test you. "I will not work aboard any ssship who is not as ssskilled at the hunt as I am. Let usss duel, and I ssshall only sssurrender sssshould you injure me to the point that I cannot proceed without medical aid!"
You take this chance to attack the Clansmen while they're distracted.
Messing with the Clansmen might not be the best idea. Better to take this chance to rest.

name: KNIGHT_CLAN_OFFER
text: You find the Ranger you spoke with earlier, injured, but surprisingly still alive. "You are truly an excellent fighter! I could think of no one better to work for. Here'ssss to hoping we get that crown, friend!"

name: KNIGHT_PALACE
text: You've arrived at the royal palace at last. Slug infrastructure isn't always the most stunning, but you must admit the view in front of you is magnificent. It is no wonder Nights is so reluctant to give up his crown.

event.text: As you approach the massive overhang, you can see signs of struggle. It appears Slocknog has already made his move on the palace, along with a fleet of loyal Clairvoyant vessels.

Slocknog has begun speaking to the crowd, which consists of both eager supporters protesting against Nights, and the well armed Knights holding them back. "Give it up Nightsssss. Come out of that palace and take part in the sssame fesstival every other king before you has eagerly participated in! You ssstole that crown, by cheating might I remind you, but if you're truly the brave fighter you claim to be then ssssurely you can protect your throne."

Slocknog urges Nights to come out several more times, then gives up and waits. There's a moment of silence, finally followed by Night's raspy voice over the intercom. "Fine, you sssshriveled pisss colored sssmelly sssson-of-a-bitch! I'll come out alright!" A few minutes later, Nights' signature ship, the Black Raven, comes bursting out of one of the hangars firing directly at Slocknog's much larger cruiser. Immediately, chaos breaks out.

The battle around you seems to have consumed the landscape for as far as you can see. Both sides seem to be equal in size. You could easily get involved and influence the outcome of this brawl, but who is the right choice?

choice.text: Aid Slocknog - he seems reasonable enough, and might be able to bring the Slugs to a glory age.

event.text: With Slocknog in charge, the Kleptocracy might finally be able to progress past this stage of barbaric thievery. The Federation aims for a better galaxy, and you'll be damned if you don't do something to see it through.

choice.text: Aid Nights - he seems like the king the Slugs you know would want.

event.text: Nights might seem bad on the surface, but to raise this much of a following surely the guy must have some redeeming qualities in the eyes of the Slugs. If you're going to be involved, you might as well pick someone the Slugs want.

choice.text: Who are we to partake in these matters?
Things might get hectic, let's leave while we can.

event.text: Better not to risk it. You pull away from the planet.

name: KNIGHT_PALACE_RESOLUTION_SLOCKNOG
text: As the Black Raven crashes into the lake, the fighting suddenly seems to come to a halt. You land your ship next to the Clairvoyant Cruiser, where Slocknog smiles and shakes your hand. "I of coursssse could have done it on my own, but... thank you, captain. Thisss isss twice now you have gone out of your way to help me. May the ssstarssss ssshine brightesst between usss, eh friend?"

event.text: While you watch the ship be fished out of the lake, you remember the Clansmen from earlier, and get the urge to retrieve the crown for yourself, though it won't be easy. Assuming they're still with you, that is.

choice.text: Your Clansman is alive, let's go for it.

event.text: The Slugs have just found the Black Raven's wreck, and have dropped it onto the bank. You'll need stealth to get over there undetected.
You cloak the ship and pilot closer to the wreckage. Now, you'll need to be able to teleport your crew onto the Raven without being seen.

event.name: KNIGHT_PALACE_RESOLUTION_SLOCKNOG_BOARD
event.text: Now that your crew are aboard, the stakes are a lot higher. Unfortunately, it's not easy to see in the dark corridors.

Oblivious to their surroundings, your crew end up caught by one of the salvage team, and are shot! You have no choice but to pull away, but it's too late. The guards are now on high alert, and your ship takes heavy damage.

removeCrew.text: Fortunately, your crew is able to be cloned, but that won't reverse the damage you've taken.

choice.text: Bean Sylvan is alive, let's go for it.

event.text: The Slugs have just found the Black Raven's wreck, and have dropped it onto the bank. You'll need stealth to get over there undetected.
You cloak the ship and pilot closer to the wreckage. Now, you'll need to be able to teleport your crew onto the Raven without being seen.

event.name: KNIGHT_PALACE_RESOLUTION_SLOCKNOG_BEANS_BOARD
event.text: Now that your crew are aboard, the stakes are a lot higher. Unfortunately, it's not easy to see in the dark corridors.

Oblivious to their surroundings, your crew end up caught by one of the salvage team, and are shot! You have no choice but to pull away, but it's too late. The guards are now on high alert, and your ship takes heavy damage.

removeCrew.text: Fortunately, your crew is able to be cloned, but that won't reverse the damage you've taken.

name: KNIGHT_PALACE_THEFT
text: Your Clansman grabs the crown, holding it up to admire. However, a band of Saboteurs burst in and see your crew, and draw their lasers to shoot. Your team is almost killed before the Clansman shouts for them to stop, declaring themselves the new king by rule of the Crown Theft Contest. The Slugs are dumbfounded, but no one protests.

event.text: Your crew waltz out of the wreck, crown on-top his head for all to see. You're amazed to see as the Slugs all around, Slocknog included, bow down, willing to accept this change of events...

win.text: The galaxy is now a slightly worse place thanks to you.

name: KNIGHT_BEANS_THEFT
text: You grab the crown and hold it up to admire it. However, a band of Saboteurs burst in and see your crew, and draw their lasers to shoot. Your team is almost killed before Bean Sylvan shouts for them to stop, declaring themselves the new king by rule of the Crown Theft Contest. The Slugs are dumbfounded, but you raise the can of beans into the air and no one protests.

event.text: Your crew waltz out of the wreck, the crown ill-fittingly placed around the can of beans who drags it around him. You're amazed to see as the Slugs all around, Slocknog included, bow down, willing to accept this change of events... Like seriously, why are they so fine with this?

win.text: The galaxy is now a slightly worse place thanks to you.

name: KNIGHT_PALACE_RESOLUTION_SLOCKNOG_REAL
text: Once Nights' corpse has been recovered, he is moved to a hearse ship for later. The crown too is recovered, broken but miraculously not obliterated. The Slugs gather together to discuss what to do next.

event.text: Slocknog appears surprised that he isn't included with the crowd. As he attempts to speak to them, an angry member of the crowd speaks up. "You have no right to be here! Alwayssss ssspinning that ssstory about Nightsss cheating or whatever, but in the end you ssstill losssst. Ssssure you were a better king than Nightsss, but you ssstill just cost usss the livessss of DOZENSSSSS of our fellow Sssslugssss jusssst for your little coup!"

These words seem to resonate with nearly everyone present, and soon a mob has formed, marching towards Slocknog, demanding he be punished. The only reason no one suggests executing him is because no one has any clue who to elect in his stead.

choice.text: These people need further influence - use a show of force to put Slocknog back in power.

event.text: Considering you've become so heavily involved in Slug politics already, you might as well go the extra mile. You head back to your ship and approach, firing a warning shot upon the crowd. Once you have everyone's attention, you demand Slocknog be in charge once again. The crowd is reluctant, but the Clairvoyants remain loyal to their king and move to support him.
"Well my friend, thisss isss now the THIRD time. Heheh, I'm forever in your debt I ssssuppossse. Perhapsss thisss isss a good ssstart to repaying you."

choice.text: Suggest that the Slugs hold an election the proper way - through a vote.

event.text: Surprisingly, this revolutionary idea is not immediately rejected. Persuaded by recent events, the Slugs seem to genuinely consider settling their differences and staging a government reform for the better good. However, one member of the crowd inquires, "Then what ssshall happen to Sssslocknog?"

"Well, if it isss a choice between death or working aboard the sssship who hasss worked sso valiantly to assssissst me, I think I ssshall prefer not dying. Farewell to all of you, I hope you rot without me." Slocknog sharply turns and slithers onto your ship.

"I- what? You have ssspent ssso much effort to help me, and yet now you ssssentence me to death?" Slocknog attempts to run, but is quickly caught by some other Slugs and dragged away. You are thanked and rewarded by the Slugs citizens who you have helped so greatly.

name: KNIGHT_PALACE_RESOLUTION_NIGHTS
text: As Slocknog's cruiser crashes into the lake, the fighting suddenly seems to come to a halt. You land your ship next to the Black Raven, where Nights is chuckling. "HAH! That'll ssshow that idiot what happenssss when you messs with Nightsss, baby!" Nights pumps his tentacle into the air triumphantly, and you don't bother mentioning you did all of the work.

event.text: You watch as the Slugs get together a team to fish the cruiser out of the lake. Once Slocknog's corpse has been recovered, he is moved to a hearse ship for later. The Slugs gather around, trying to decide how to proceed with the festival.

Furious, Nights storms up to them demanding they hand back the crown to him, but the crowd refuses. "You basssstard, you don't dessserve ssshit! Had you jussst done your duty asss a king and handled thisss asss ssomething other than an overgrown man-child, we wouldn't have the corpsssess of dozensss sssmoldering in front of the Royal palace!" shouts someone from the crowd, shockingly appearing to be straight from Nights' inner circle.

These words seem to resonate with nearly everyone present, and soon a mob has formed, marching towards Nights, demanding he be punished. The only reason no one suggests executing him is because no one has any clue who to elect in his stead.

choice.text: These people need further influence - use a show of force to put Nights back in power.

event.text: Considering you've become so heavily involved in Slug politics already, you might as well go the extra mile. You head back to your ship and approach, firing a warning shot upon the crowd. Once you have everyone's attention, you demand Nights be in charge once again. The crowd is reluctant, but faith seems to magically return to his followers, and the Knights of Nights move to support their king. This works, and soon enough Nights is re-elected king.

Nights might be an egregious and irredeemable asshole in many ways, but he apparently has enough of a conscience to thank you personally. Extending the greatest show of goodwill that he can, likely to gain favor from you in case of future issues, he dispatches two guards of his inner circle to assist your mission, followed by heaps of scrap.

choice.text: Suggest that the Slugs hold an election the proper way - through a vote.

event.text: Surprisingly, this revolutionary idea is not immediately rejected. Persuaded by recent events, the Slugs seem to genuinely consider settling their differences and staging a government reform for the better good. However, one member of the crowd inquires, "Then what ssshall happen to Nightsss?"

choice.text: He can work for us to pay off his debt to the galaxy.

event.text: Nights isn't eager about the idea, but the Slugs seem to find great humor in banishing him to work aboard a Federation vessel. Greatly preferring paid labor aboard a ship over public execution by disintegration ray, Nights accepts, and soon after you've got a new crew member aboard.

Nights suddenly drops any show of bravery and cries out in terror, but it's too late. The crowd can't be convinced otherwise, now that the idea has been reinforced by your word. As Nights is dragged off to some underground prison, you are thanked and rewarded by the Slugs citizens who you have helped so greatly.

name: LANIUS_LANGUAGE
text: A Lanius ship hails you, asking a favor. They speak your language moderately well, but it could use improvement. "Requesting, scans data, for using as improvements of translation."

choice.text: Agree, knowing it will likely take some time.

event.text: As expected, the data scans take a fair bit of time, but you can tell the Lanius are very happy. They offer to pay you.

choice.text: Suggest the Lanius join your crew to learn even more.

event.text: The Lanius agrees to your suggestion and comes on board.

choice.text: (Lanius Crew) Your Lanius seems to have picked up some knowledge of your language. Maybe they can help?

event.text: With the help of your well learned Lanius crew, the data scans proceed in a reasonable timeframe. The other Lanius happily offers to pay you.

choice.text: Suggest the Lanius join your crew to learn even more.

event.text: The Lanius agrees to your suggestion and comes on board. They seem to be getting along nicely with your own Lanius.
"Ok. Thanks many considering." They fly away, leaving you alone at the beacon.

name: LANIUS_INJURED
text: A single Lanius drifts through space. They don't seem responsive to your ship, but scans confirm that they are alive.

choice.text: (Lanius Crew) Assure the Lanius that you mean them no harm when you bring them on board.

event.text: It seems the Lanius has been severely injured by something, and a good chunk of their body is missing. They probably won't live much longer, unless you can help.
The Lanius melts down the metal and assimilates with it. You watch as the knife-like structures on its body slowly reform.
Now fully healed, the Lanius gladly joins your crew to pay off its debt for you saving its life.
Somehow, the Medbay's nanobots are capable of repairing the damage to the Lanius' body. Grateful for saving its life, the Lanius joins your crew.

choice.text: There's nothing that can be done, let them die.

event.text: You ignore the Lanius and carry on with your mission.

name: LANIUS_FREEMANTIS_DEAD
text: You're contacted by a confused and irritated Lanius. "Free Mantis board. Asphyxiate, stupid. Save one, keeping alive pain. You want?"

event.text: The Lanius drop the unconscious Mantis off on your ship and head back to theirs. Once the Free Mantis wakes up, they're surprised to see themselves on a Federation ship, but are more than glad to serve under your command.

choice.text: We don't need any more crew.

event.text: "We keep can't. TAKE!" The Lanius forcibly board your ship, trying to give you the Mantis, and the struggle turns into a full on fight!

name: LANIUS_LUNG_SCAN
text: You're hailed by a Lanius vessel, which surprisingly is equipped with a better translator than normal. "We want more learn about other species and expand scientific reach. Please consult your human staff. We are pay you."

event.text: Your Human is nervous to go, and the Lanius make no attempt to reassure them. They bring them aboard their ship into a special oxygen filled room for research. Now you must wait...
Your Engineer is nervous to go, and the Lanius make no attempt to reassure them. They bring them aboard their ship into a special oxygen filled room for research. Now you must wait...
Your Medic is nervous to go, and the Lanius make no attempt to reassure them. They bring them aboard their ship into a special oxygen filled room for research. Now you must wait...
Your Soldier marches along with the Lanius, fearless as ever. They bring them aboard their ship into a special oxygen filled room for research. Now you must wait...
