Your Technician is nervous to go, and the Lanius make no attempt to reassure them. They bring them aboard their ship into a special oxygen filled room for research. Now you must wait...
You don't have time to participate in their strange study. You apologize and end the call.

name: LANIUS_FREE_STUFF_MV
text: You stumble across a badly damaged Lanius craft. It jumps away as soon as it sees you. Looking around the area, you discover a number of destroyed Rebel automated ships. It must have been quite the fight. You scrap what remains.

name: LANIUS_RESEARCHER_CONTACT_MV
text: A Federation science craft is docked with a few Lanius ships. You hail them and ask what is going on. "Greetings! We have been attempting to understand our region's newest visitors, the Lanius, although we have been making little headway in deciphering their language."

choice.text: Ask if they have anything that could help your mission.
(Lanius Crew) Offer to copy your translator's data suite.

event.text: Your Lanius crew had tweaked the ship's translator to slowly improve itself over time. The data collected from your interactions with the Lanius could be very helpful to these scientists.
You wish them well and prepare to jump.

name: LANIUS_RESEARCHER_CRAFT_MV
text: A merchant ship is docked with a Lanius transport. You message them to see if they need any help. It turns out they have been studying the Lanius' ability to reshape metal.

event.text: They respond, "We haven't the foggiest idea how it works. They appear to meld part of their bodies into the metal and reshape it. They have been willing to demonstrate their ability if you have some extra metal that you would like converted into something."

choice.text: Give 45 scrap to craft an augmentation.

event.text: You transfer over the scrap and watch the master craftsmen work. They easily reshape the metal into pieces they can use and then add various additional materials on their ship to construct the augmentation. You thank them and load it onto your ship.

choice.text: Give 50 scrap to craft a weapon.

event.text: You transfer over the scrap and watch the master craftsmen work. They easily reshape the metal into pieces they can use and then add various additional materials on their ship to construct the weapon. You thank them and load it onto your ship.

choice.text: Give 40 scrap to craft a drone schematic.

event.text: You transfer over the scrap and watch the master craftsmen work. They easily reshape the metal into pieces they can use and then add various additional materials on their ship to construct the schematic. You thank them and load it onto your ship.
You thank them for the information and prepare to jump.

choice.text: (Lanius Crew) Offer to help in the process.

event.text: Your crewmember offers to aid in the process to speed it along. They think it can be performed a bit more efficiently with the extra help and request less scrap.

choice.text: Give 35 scrap to craft an augmentation.

event.text: You transfer over the scrap and watch the master craftsmen work. They easily reshape the metal into pieces they can use and then add various additional materials on their ship to construct the augmentation. You thank them and load it onto your ship.

choice.text: Give 40 scrap to craft a weapon.

event.text: You transfer over the scrap and watch the master craftsmen work. They easily reshape the metal into pieces they can use and then add various additional materials on their ship to construct the weapon. You thank them and load it onto your ship.

choice.text: Give 30 scrap to craft a drone schematic.

event.text: You transfer over the scrap and watch the master craftsmen work. They easily reshape the metal into pieces they can use and then add various additional materials on their ship to construct the schematic. You thank them and load it onto your ship.
You thank them for the information and prepare to jump.
While replicating their innate ability would have immeasurable consequences on commercial manufacturing, your mission has a much higher priority at the moment.

name: LANIUS_TRADER_TRANSLATOR_MV
text: A Lanius merchant appears to have a significantly improved translator as you clearly understand their message. "Metal content more than sufficient. Does your ship care to exchange resources for our excess metal?"

event.text: They leave without a word.

choice.text: Decline but ask about their translation device.

event.text: "Yes. It is quality. Our ship contains excess. Care to purchase?"
Your ships dock and you are more than a little surprised when the Lanius you spoke with boards your ship. It appears the 'device' you purchased was one of the beings that learned your language.
"No matter. This one does not mind this ship." They pull away and you are left to wonder what it meant by that. Perhaps the translation device has not yet been perfected?
They leave without a word.

choice.text: (Lanius Crew) Ask for an alternative trade.

event.text: After a short discussion you do not understand, the trader comes back with a second proposal.
They leave without a word.

name: LANIUS_ASTEROID_COLONY
text: This beacon appears to host both an asteroid field and a colony of Lanius. Despite the chunks of scrap metal floating along with the rocks, an ominous sign that several ships met their demise here, the colony itself looks peaceful, at least as far as Lanius go.

choice.text: (Lanius Crew) Have your Lanius contact the colony.

event.text: The Lanius welcome you closer, offering to trade.

choice.text: Ignore the colony and leave the beacon; the asteroids are dangerous enough.

name: LANIUS_MUTUAL_FEAST
text: It seems two Lanius ships are squaring off here. An Elite, who seems to have gotten too big for their britches and decided to consume one of their lackeys, and a highly menacing regular Lanius ship that is not willing to give up without a fight.

event.text: You've decided to tackle the Elite Lanius. You arm the weapons and engage.
You've decided to tackle the Lanius. You arm the weapons and engage.
You charge your weapons, which quickly gets the Lanius ship's attention.
Unfortunately it is not your mission to save every person affected by this war or the Lanius invasion.
You move in and power up your weapons. Detecting the threat, they stop what they were doing and prepare for a fight.
You ignore the ship and prepare to jump.

name: LANIUS_SCARED_CIVILIAN_MV
text: You arrive at the beacon to discover a civilian ship fleeing from a lone Lanius craft. The civilian messages you, "Help! The metal monsters are coming to melt down our ship!" Strangely, no active weapon signatures are detected.

event.text: The civilian ship hastily retreats while you intercept the path of the ship and lock on weapons. It turns and prepares for a fight.
You ignore the ship's pleas and watch as it hastily escapes. Oddly, the Lanius ship makes no move to chase it. You wonder if they were ever a threat at all.

choice.text: Try to contact the Lanius ship.

event.text: You approach the ship without activating weapons and the civilian ship says, "Don't go any closer! Just kill them!" before hastily making their retreat.

choice.text: (Lanius Crew) Try to contact the ship.

event.text: Your crewmember opens a channel with them. It seems they are scouting for a merchant's guild which is seeking to establish connections with the other sentient races. You suggest they invest research time into developing better translators and ask if they are selling anything at the moment.

name: LANIUS_DORMANT_EVENT_MV
text: You have picked up a Lanius vessel drifting in this sector. There is no damage to the hull, and it appears to be powered down.

event.text: As you scan the vessel, the scan frequencies awaken the Lanius crew from hibernation - and they're hungry for raw materials!

name: LANIUS_DORMANT_INVESTIGATE_MV
text: The vessel appears to be dormant. It is likely there are Lanius on board, but they may be in hibernation until the ship comes within range of new materials.

event.text: You don't disturb the ship.

choice.text: (Lanius Crew) Send over a Lanius crewmember to plunder the ship of resources.

event.text: Your crewmember manages to salvage some resources without waking the hibernating crew.

choice.text: Navigate carefully around the ship and strip what materials from the hull you can.
(Upg. Piloting) Engage the autopilot to strip the ship safely.

event.text: The computer matches the rotation and speed of the target ship, and you take the opportunity to gather what residual scrap you can without awakening the Lanius crew. You get an excellent haul!

name: DISTRESS_LANIUS_FEEDING
text: A distressed Slug captain hails you while a Lanius ship has attached itself to the top of the Slug vessel and is slowly melting down the hull. "Could you do ussss a favor and pleasssse tell the Laniussss not to eat usss? We tried ourssselvessss but they would not ressspond. It would be greatly appreccciated."

event.text: To your surprise the Lanius ship refuses to detach from the Slug's hull, rather dragging them along with it. Signs detect the Lanius are trying to jump away. If they manage to jump, they'll likely cause extreme damage to the Slug ship, if not completely destroying it.

choice.text: (Lanius Crew) Have your Lanius convince them to let the Slugs go.

event.text: Reluctantly, the Lanius ship detaches from the Slugs and flies away. That was easy...
Before the Slugs can even respond, the Lanius ship returns, weapons blazing. It blasts its way through the Slug ship and attacks you next.
You bid the Slugs farewell and leave them to dealing with the Lanius.

name: DISTRESS_LANIUS_FEEDING_WIN
text: "Thank you for your assssissstanccce, I don't know if we could have gotten out of that one otherwissse. Accccept thisss asss a gift."

name: DISTRESS_LANIUS_FIGHT
text: You immediately do a short-range scan after arriving at the beacon. It appears to be coming from a small civilian vessel under fire from a Lanius ship. Not all Lanius are content with simply scavenging the wrecks of previous battles.

event.text: You move in to intercept the ship. Detecting a greater threat, the Lanius prepare to fight.
Your crew seems unhappy to leave the civilians to such a fate but you try to convince them of the greater good. You don't speak of your own misgivings, however.

choice.text: (Lanius Crew) Have your crew admonish their captain.

name: DISTRESS_LANIUS_TRAP
text: You are too late - whatever once was emitting the distress signal from this system drew a Lanius ship as well as your own. Having consumed the original target, the Lanius turn their attention to your vessel.

name: DISTRESS_LANIUS_SLUG
text: The distress signal from this system is coming from a Slug vessel under attack by the Lanius! The Slugs beg for assistance as the Lanius tear into their hull plating.

event.text: You prepare to attack the Lanius.

choice.text: Leave the Slugs to their fate.

event.text: You leave the Lanius ship alone, and prepare to jump to the next beacon.

name: DISTRESS_LANIUS_MANTIS
text: The Mantis ship in this system looks like its distress beacon is malfunctioning... likely due to the Lanius ship mining their hull and sub-systems! It doesn't look like the Mantis ship will last much longer.

event.text: The Lanius don't seem to have noticed you yet - but they will. Launching into the fray, you target the Lanius vessel!

choice.text: Leave the Mantis to their fate.

event.text: The Mantis ship is quickly overcome by the Lanius vessel, and you move away as the Lanius feed on the remains.

name: DISTRESS_LANIUS_ROCK
text: A distress beacon pulses weakly from a Rockman ship in this system... their hull (and their crew) are being mined by the Lanius, lasers and weapons tearing through the ship!

event.text: The Rockmen need your help - you target the Lanius ship and grimly prepare for battle.

choice.text: Leave the Rockmen to their fate.

event.text: As you make your escape, the Rockman's ship's engines explode, and you watch the Lanius ship slowly feed on the remains - and the crew.

name: LANIUS_ZOLTAN_PEACE
text: A small group of Zoltan ships at this beacon chatter back and forth. They hail you promptly. "Brief scans show you operate a Federation vessel. You are therefore obligated to help us. We have come to make peace with the Lanius race, but we need additional firepower in case something bad happens. You will follow us to these co-ordinates and make sure the negotiations go smoothly, understand?"

event.text: The Zoltan transmit the co-ordinates and mute you, returning to their conversation.

The Zoltan at the other end flinches, frantically switches from anguish, to anger, to sorrow, and finally to utter defeat. He concedes some supplies before hastily leaving with the rest of the squadron.

choice.text: What? We don't take orders from you.

event.text: "Why I never! You have some nerve." It seems you seriously offended the Zoltans, because now their weapons are online and they're attacking.

name: QUEST_LANIUS_ZOLTAN_PEACE

unvisitedTooltip.text: Meeting spot of an exchange between Zoltan and Lanius ships.

text: Things don't seem to be going well at the Zoltan's destination. You must be a little late, because the Zoltans are trying desperately to negotiate with the Lanius while they draw closer like predator to their prey.

event.text: The Zoltan leader speaks slowly to the Lanius, as if that will help them understand. "Hello, my metal friends. We have brought you a wonderful proposition for peace. We request full access to all territory in your sector, the rights to all of your trade routes, etc, in return for the nobility of being allied with the Zoltan rac-" the Zoltans are cut off when one of the Lanius grows bored and fires a missile straight into their engines, destroying the ship. Chaos ensues, and you figure it's time that you leave.

choice.text: You were given a job. Protect the Zoltans.

event.text: It doesn't take much longer for the Lanius to turn hostile. You swoop in to defend your 'employers'.

choice.text: Those Zoltans were jerks, fight them off with the Lanius.

event.text: The Lanius might not be accustomed to the traditions and language of the other races of the galaxy, but they aren't stupid. Whatever these Zoltans want to negotiate isn't in the Lanius' bests interests, and you've decided to take a stand.

name: LANIUS_ZOLTAN_PEACE_ZOLTAN_WIN
text: The Lanius ship appears to be an Elite, though its received critical damage. "Federation... savior. Recruitment, option, yes?" It seems the captain wants to work on your ship, given their ship is near destruction and the Zoltans have proven an unsatisfactory ally.

name: LANIUS_ZOLTAN_PEACE_LANIUS_WIN
text: "You have performed... Satisfactory at protecting our squadron. Though you were far from perfect, I do not have the time to fully evaluate your performance. I shall pay you adequately, but do try harder next time, should this situation arise again."

name: LANIUS_BEACON_EATER
text: You detect a damaged vessel docked with the jump beacon. It appears the Lanius are absorbing metal from the beacon, risking destroying it and becoming stranded.

choice.text: (Lanius Crew) Ask if they require assistance.

event.text: After a time you are told they were damaged and unable to repair their ship due to a lack of metal. They offer to exchange a piece of their ship's equipment for some scrap or other useful materials.
You release the material out of the airlock and the Lanius quickly collect it and start melting it down. They are grateful for your assistance and send over a ship augmentation.
You release the material out of the airlock and the Lanius quickly collect it and start melting it down. They are grateful for your assistance and send over a ship augmentation.
You release the material out of the airlock and the Lanius quickly collect it and start melting it down. They are grateful for your assistance and send over a ship augmentation.

choice.text: (Ship Repair Drone) Send a drone to help.

event.text: As soon as the drone gets close, a Lanius in a type of spacewalk maneuvering unit grabs it and immediately starts breaking it down for metal. You prepare for a fight but they appear quite grateful for the act. They start to use the metal to repair key portions of their ship. From what you can understand from the translator it appears one of their crew wishes to join you.

name: ENCOUNTER_LANIUS_ASTEROID
text: This beacon appears to have been set up within an asteroid field to access a mining settlement. However, half of the settlement has been disassembled by a number of Lanius scavengers. Their military escort moves in to scare you off.

name: ENCOUNTER_LANIUS_PULSAR
text: There appears to be some sort of research station near a pulsar, although it's hard to tell since a portion of it has been melted. The Lanius ship that has been working at it moves in to intercept you, totally oblivious to the threat of EM pulses.

name: ENCOUNTER_LANIUS_PDS
text: Upon arrival you are immediately surrounded by chaos: a planet's Anti-Ship Battery is firing on a number of Lanius ships; one of the combat ships mistakenly believes your ship has arrived to assist the planetary defenses. Combat positions!

name: LANIUS_HARVESTER_MV
text: Your scans have picked up a Lanius vessel in this system: it appears to be navigating a rich debris field, harvesting the minerals.

choice.text: Attempt to harvest some for yourself.

event.text: As you attempt to navigate the debris, you come too close to the Lanius ship - and they proceed to try to harvest you!

choice.text: (Upg. Piloting) Engage the auto-pilot and safely harvest the debris.

event.text: With help from the computer, you are able to keep a comfortable distance between you and the Lanius ship, and you are able to gather resources from the debris field without conflict.

choice.text: (Adv. Piloting) Engage the auto-pilot and safely harvest the debris.

event.text: With help from the computer, you are able to keep a comfortable distance between you and the Lanius ship, and you gather a considerable amount of resources from the debris field without conflict.

choice.text: (Magnet Arm) Use your Magnet Arm to safely harvest the debris.

event.text: With the help of your Magnet Arm, you manage to harvest a decent amount of scrap from the debris field without getting too close to the Lanius ship.
You go on the offensive and power up your weapons - with any luck, you'll soon have the mineral field all to yourself.
You charge up your drive and prepare to make the next jump. No sense in antagonizing the Lanius if you don't need to.

name: LANIUS_PUN
text: You receive a hail from a mysterious source. A grim voice whispers to you, "knock... knock..."

event.text: "Lanius phyxiate you!" You hear the distinct sound of crew teleporting aboard!

name: LANIUS_CONFUSED
text: You hear several thunks on your hull, followed by scraping. Scans show Lanius have landed on the ship and are now eating their way through the hull!

choice.text: Send out a crewmember to try and communicate.

event.text: One of your crew, clad in a space suit reserved only for situations like this, heads out the airlock to communicate with the Lanius. The Lanius are shocked to see someone else. "You look like boat from trash? Usual junk when eat." It seems they mistook your ship as a wreck.

choice.text: Assure them that you aren't a wreck.

event.text: The Lanius apologize for their misunderstanding. Most of them detach from your ship and float away into the vacuum of space, but one Lanius does not wish to go with the others. Instead, they desire to stay with your crew.

choice.text: This isn't worth our time. Just fight them off.

event.text: It doesn't take long for the Lanius to make their way into the body of the ship. Prepare to defend the ship!
It doesn't take long for the Lanius to make their way into the body of the ship. They're somehow surprised to see crew onboard, but that doesn't stop them from attacking!

name: ENCOUNTER_LANIUS_ELITE
text: The Lanius Swarm usually consists of many independently operating groups, but powerful and very old Lanius known as the Welders function as the 'leaders' of the Swarm, whenever leadership is necessary. They aren't known for being particularly friendly either, and the Welder ship here has decided your ship will look better as scrap!

name: LANIUS_GOLD
text: At first you're certain this beacon hosts a very close star, but it's in fact a very bright, golden Lanius ship. On it is a strange golden Flak gun. It looks expensive, but not terribly efficient as a weapon. Still, maybe you could steal the weapon from them?

event.text: The Lanius ship must be very heavy, as it very slowly turns to face you and defend itself.
You have no interest in the golden Lanius ship.

name: BEACON_EATER_START
text: It appears the distress call is coming from a civilian station. One of the few brave souls left trying to defend their weak claim to this territory, it seems they've now fallen victim to some sort of attack. Fearful help will never arrive, they're willing to pay you to sort out the issue. They just give one warning - these Lanius aren't like the usual.

event.text: The civilians weren't kidding about the Lanius being... different. A fervent and bizarrely colored Lanius vessel is disassembling the nearby beacon. If they succeed, it would cut off the entire system from the Atlas!

choice.text: (Anointed) Ask them to stop and give you the parts.

event.text:
The Anointed hails the Augmented ship. She communicates to them in their own language, making it difficult to understand what they are talking about - but the body language is fairly telling. The Augmented bow in reverence to their queen and offer massive amounts of scrap, as well as the set of beacon parts that they harvested. Once they are done with their tribute, they take their leave and disengage.
					
					"They perform well, but now that we here, we take their tribute ourselves. We keep this in case we meet Beacon Eater." She notices your confusion. "He is... trouble king. We very estranged, he not respect my people's... vision. Might see him."
"Interruption not! Gathering! Gift the Beacon Eater! Queen demanding!" With that brief refusal, the Lanius go back to tearing apart the beacon. The only evident option here is to fight!
You decide the best option to handle the situation is to fight the Lanius ship.

choice.text: We have other matters to attend to.

event.text: Lanius are no small threat and you aren't sure its a good idea to get involved with any 'strange Lanius', especially when you have a much more important mission at hand.

name: BEACON_EATER_START_WIN
text: "Thank you so much, you saved us from what could have been a slow and painful death from isolation. I don't know what we were thinking building a station here... Hopefully the beacon will remain functional until a repair team can arrive, but for now let us pay you for your assistance."

choice.text: Ask if they know what the 'Beacon Eater' is.

event.text: "Oh... I know a little. From what I understand, he goes by many names. I've heard he feeds exclusively on beacons, which is where his current name comes from. The King of the Lanius Swarm is extremely ancient and vindictive. His swarm is the one that has claimed this territory, and they've been terrorizing the settlers here ever since the Civil War. I'm not sure what you could possibly hope to do, but if you could try and stop the attacks, I'm sure the Union as a whole would be grateful."

choice.text: Stay behind and take some time to salvage the 'gift'.

event.text: You scoop up some of the parts left behind from the battle. The Rebel fleet will likely be catching up to you by now, but you can probably use these later.

name: BEACON_EATER_START_ANOINTED_BYPASS
text: "Thank you so much, you saved us from what could have been a slow and painful death from isolation. I don't know what we were thinking building a station here... Hopefully the beacon will remain functional until a repair team can arrive, but for now let us pay you for your assistance."

choice.text: Ask if they have any more information on the 'Beacon Eater'.

event.text: "Oh... I know a little. From what I understand, he goes by many names. I've heard he feeds exclusively on beacons, which is where his current name comes from. The King of the Lanius Swarm is extremely ancient and vindictive. His swarm is the one that has claimed this territory, and they've been terrorizing the settlers here ever since the Civil War. I'm not sure what you could possibly hope to do, but if you could try and stop the attacks, I'm sure the Union as a whole would be grateful."

name: QUEST_BEACON_EATER
text: You've certainly found... something. A humongous artificial mass of garbage hastily thrown together from millions of tons of scrap metal hosts a swarm of Lanius, flickering about like bees in a beehive. None of the ships pay you any mind, but rather carry with them heaps of metal to add to the structure. In the center of the massive sphere between it all, you notice a much more refined vessel of gigantic proportions.

event.text:
"It has been some time since I have been to this sector. Exactly as I remember it." Strangely, her translator seems to be interfacing with the Beacon Eater's own communication device, allowing for you to understand her sentiments more clearly.
			
			"So, the Anointed has come crawling back to the land of the Lanius. Have you run out of glowing green boxes to munch on?"
			
			"Truth be told, I prefer the purple ones. But what would you know about having discerning tastes? You gorge yourself on whatever's large enough to fit inside that bottomless pit you call a body. But you are never satisfied, even when I send my followers to appease you."
			
			"Enough. I've had it with you. It was you who schismed when you wouldn't listen. I'll bring about your demise, here and now."

A crackling sound screams through your intercom, followed by a robotic voice. It seems they have a much better translator, because you can actually understand what they're saying, minus some grammar issues. "Pestilent outsider. Our kind endured millenia of suffering under the Forefathers, and stand here triumphant. Still, you learn not to grant us the space and respect of the last standing elder race? Get OUT of my territory, or I will tear apart your puny bodies like your invasive beacons I devour."

choice.text: This guy and his swarm are a threat, and we need to destroy them.

event.text: You raise the weapons and attack the Beacon Eater. Indignant towards you for attacking, the cruiser lurches forward to meet you. "If this is your choice, be it so. I will look forward to your death."

choice.text: Try to negotiate with them to stop eating beacons.

event.text: You try in vain to negotiate with the Beacon Eater. "You are deaf? Unclog ears and listen to words I am saying. This sector belongs to my people. You are invaders. Pests. If you desire your own extermination so much, then I will appease you."

choice.text: Dear god, this thing is huge. We have to leave.

name: BEACON_EATER_WIN
text: As the Beacon Eater falls, defeated, the entire swarm around you freezes in apprehension. In one last desperate effort, the Beacon Eater claws his way through your airlocks, dragging his deteriorating body towards you. "I... I have lived longer than your species has been alive. Yet, this is how I dying? Pity..."

choice.text: We still have the beacon parts. Give them to him.

event.text: The Beacon Eater assimilates the part into his body, healing rapidly. "You... you have saved me. This is unusual mercy." The elder Lanius attempts to stand as his body continues to take back its original shape. "I have never known such gratitude of outsiders. The Forefathers... they never would have done the same."

"I dare not speak their name. Long ago, there were 5 ancient empires. The Imperials, the Dynasty, the Swarm, the Utopians, and... the Forefathers. They made the technology you use to lay war on existence. In the end, they destroy themselves and nearly all other empires. Only the great Swarm resist them! In my immortality I have lived through the worst of those days. It is where I have learned to trust none but my own. If all kinds tended to themselves, and themselves only, war there wouldn't be."

choice.text: Sounds like what the Rebels want.
(Ancient Activator) We have a hibernating Forefather.
He won't last long, just put him out of his misery.

event.text: A blaster charge to the back of the head is all it takes to finish off the once threatening King of the Lanius. The Lanius ships outside stir once again, and you receive several hails at once.

name: BEACON_EATER_REWARD
text: It seems the entire swarm had been watching the spectacle. "Outsider King murder! Bow, bow!" You can't stay for long, but accept the tribute from the concerned Lanius and hope that this victory will be enough to discourage the ravaging of Union settlements a little longer.

name: BEACON_EATER_REWARD_SAVE
text: "You compare me to the visions of the great tyrant Wentworth? I am insulted; had you not bested me here, dead you would be now. My ship... it is in ruins. I have a great debt to pay off, and an insatiable curiosity. I will journey with you and see if your people are worthy. If you are truly different from the Forefathers. Perhaps... perhaps we can yet find truce."

choice.text: Ask about the strange Lanius ship you saw earlier.

event.text: You explain to the Beacon Eater the origins of the gift. "Hmm... the Anointed returns. Long ago, my people had great schism. In the end, two halves were made. The repugnant 'Augmented' left on a great exodus to harness the power of the Forefathers. The rest, pure and clear minded, remained loyal to me. We do not speak of them unless we must. Be fortunate it is you who carried this gift. If it were them, I would have waged a war so great it would tear the galaxy in half. How dare she try to settle such irreconciliable differences."

name: BEACON_EATER_WIN_ANOINTED
text: As the Beacon Eater falls, defeated, the entire swarm around you freezes in apprehension. In one last desperate effort, the Beacon Eater claws his way through your airlocks, dragging his deteriorating body towards the Anointed. "You've won. There must be no more place in this galaxy for my old ways after all. Pity... I guess your ideals will become dominant after all."

choice.text: We still have the beacon parts. Give them to him.

event.text:
The Beacon Eater assimilates the part into his body, healing rapidly. "Your friend... has saved me. This is unusual mercy." The elder Lanius attempts to stand as his body continues to take back its original shape. The Beacon Eater looks between you and the Anointed. "Do you seek reconciliation, after all that has happened?"
			
			The Anointed folds her arms. "Conflict was never my goal. However, you should know I am not here at my own behest. I am not here to change your mind, nor am I here to end your life. Maybe you should stop prattling and start listening for a change."
			
			"Yes... Hmph. I am not used to being overpowered by another. Maybe it's time to show the flexibility that I had forsaken in order to resist the Forefathers."

"I dare not speak their name. Long ago, there were 5 ancient empires. The Imperials, the Dynasty, the Swarm, the Utopians, and... the Forefathers. They made the technology you use to lay war on existence." He pauses and gestures to the Anointed. "Well, you've encountered it by now, I suppose. The technology that she uses to satiate herself. It cannot be used responsibly! That was my belief, that I could only trust myself. If you purport to be strong enough to use this technology, yet wise enough not to fall into the same power madness as the others, perhaps friends we can be."

choice.text: (Ancient Activator) We have a hibernating Forefather.
He won't last long, just put him out of his misery.

event.text: The Anointed glows with power and thrusts her arm into the Beacon Eater's chest, absorbing his body and devouring him fully. In the process, his translator seems to have been destroyed, returning her speech to how it was before. "Beacon Eater too troublesome. Still, could have ended things peacefully. Maybe better. We leave here now."

name: BEACON_EATER_REWARD_SAVE_ANOINTED
text:
"My ship... it is in ruins. I have a great debt to pay off, and an insatiable curiosity. I will journey with you and see if your people are worthy. If you are truly different from the Forefathers. Perhaps... perhaps we can yet find truce. As for you..." He turns to the Anointed. "Your people are welcome here, as much as their ways still disgust me. I only ask that they avoid proliferating Forefather technology among our people."
    
	"We can accept this compromise." The two Lanius perform some sort of gesture of agreement.

name: BEACON_EATER_REWARD_FOREFATHER_ANOINTED
text:
"That's impossible! By the coloration, this is... a dissenting Forefather? Ah, I see your confusion. I did not see fit to mention, but a small minority of the Forefathers seek to upend the control that their technology imposes upon others." He turns to the Anointed. "I take it that the Activator was your doing?"
    
	"Yes. Do you now see how it serves your ends to follow us?"
    
	"I do. You must let me accompany you! I wish to hear the Forefather dissenter's words."

name: BEACON_EATER_REWARD_FOREFATHER
text: "That's impossible! By the coloration, this is... a dissenting Forefather? Ah, I see your confusion. I did not see fit to mention, but a small minority of the Forefathers seek to upend the control that their technology imposes upon others. You must let me accompany you! I wish to hear the Forefather dissenter's words."

destroyed.text: The Beacon Eater's cruiser splits apart, marking the end of their reign of terror. There is plenty of scrap left behind.

deadCrew.text: You've killed all that remains of the Beacon Eater's crew, marking the end of their reign of terror. There is plenty of scrap left behind.

name: FEDERATION_BASE
text: The Federation base in this reality is just as impressive as the one back in Universe 0. Much of the city below has been evacuated, but the capitol building, the center of operations, is still operational. If the Flagship destroys it, the Federation will be powerless and this reality will be lost.

event.text: Luckily you've arrived here before the Flagship. One of the few remaining Federation support ships patches up your hull and gives a few supplies.

name: LASTSTAND_WARP_REAL
text:
Name: Federation Capital
	Type: Friendly
	Unique: True
	Dominant Faction: The Federation
	Rebel Threat Level: !CRITICALLY HIGH!

	The Federation Capital is your final destination. Under siege by the Rebellion, to save this reality you must eliminate the Rebel Flagship before it destroys the Federation base.

choice.text: There's no more time for other sectors!

name: TRUE_LAST_STAND_START_EMERGENCY
text: It seems your impromptu departure from Node 17 has spelled disaster for the Federation. The Flagship has already reached the base and the Federation forces here are overwhelmed. There's no time to waste, you need to get to the base immediately!

name: TRUE_LAST_STAND_START_EXTREME
text: The second you exit light speed, it becomes clear something is wrong. It looks as though the entrance beacon is under attack by an MFK Ace!

name: LAST_STAND_START_EXTREME_FINISH
text: The MFK Ace has been taken care of, and you scrap the remains before carrying on. You contact the survivors of the Federation fleet, including Admiral Tully himself.

name: DETERGENT_WIN
text: Before you can leave, you receive another hail from Tully. "Wait - is that detergent you have? Oh thank Newton, the Rebel blockade has drained us of essential supplies, and we have a surplus of uniforms to clean. It's not much, but with this, maybe we can get our troops back into shape!"

event.text:
DETERGENT MODE COMPLETE!
			Congratulations Renegade on successfully completing DETERGENT MODE! It was a turbulent journey for certain, but you've pulled through triumphantly! The Federation shall have dirty laundry no more, thanks to you.

name: DETERGENT_WIN_TULLY
text: Before you can leave, Tully brings up another subject. "Wait - is that detergent you have? Oh thank Newton, the Rebel blockade has drained us of essential supplies, and we have a surplus of uniforms to clean. It's not much, but with this, maybe we can get our troops back into shape!"

event.text:
DETERGENT MODE COMPLETE!
			Congratulations Renegade on successfully completing DETERGENT MODE! It was a turbulent journey for certain, but you've pulled through triumphantly! The Federation shall have dirty laundry no more, thanks to you.

name: TRUE_LAST_STAND_START
text: You've finally arrived at Node 17, the Federation Capital. You've heard the stories of this conflict back in Universe 0, the reality where the Multiverse tech was discovered. Now, you're about to take a part in it. Your actions here will either save or doom this reality.

event.text: With a quick scan of your ID, you are allowed through the beacon without issue.

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "So you're the Multiverse ship I've heard about? You've come a long way, and I can only hope it's all paid off. You're the Federation's last stand against the Flagship."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "Oh dear god, the Rebellion's sent ANOTHER Flagship? We're screwed... wait, you aren't with the Rebels. Universe 0 sent the Rebel's super weapon to destroy the super weapon? I guess it's about freaking time we fight fire with fire."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "A... pirate? I didn't know we hired mercenaries... Not that it's an issue, you're here now and you're probably the best chance we've got."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "Is that... Tuco? Which one of you hired Tuco as a Renegade? Well, I appreciate your... dedication to the Federation. Let us just hope that it pays off."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "A gambling vessel. I'm not certain where these ships are coming from, but if you're the key to defeating the Flagship, then I'm not going to complain."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "That's a very bright ship you have. I'm sure a fascinating story stands behind it. I'd love to hear it some day, assuming we aren't all dead at the end of this."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "In all my years, I never thought the Federation's last chance, our saving grace, would fall upon... a Slug Pleasure Cruiser. I can't imagine how you stand piloting that thing. At least, it looks like you've made it combat ready enough to face the Flagship."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "Woah, your ship has taken quite the beating. If I didn't know better, I would have assumed you showed up already dead. Let's hope that isn't the fate you await."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "I thought the Dynasty was determined to avoid the Federation and let us battle to extinction with the Rebels? Has the Prime Reaper finally changed his mind and given us a second chance? Well, I'm grateful. We need all the help we can get against the Flagship."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "I can't seem to explain it, but witnessing your ship gives me the urge to make an Old-Earth reference, but I'm afraid it would be too outdated."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center "A Lanius vessel? Or... whatever that is. Not sure where you got that paintjob from, but let's hope your ship is as deadly as it looks."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "Your ship looks like the holograms I've seen of the original Multiverse drive. I hope that means you've brought the best tech you could, because you're our last line of defense."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "I wasn't told we were receiving more reinforcements from the Engi. I'm glad, because our forces are almost dried up."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "I didn't think the Zoltans would ever show up. Glad to know they had the dedication to bring exactly one ship."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "What in god's name are you? I've never seen a Zoltan ship or a creature like you before... But it seems you're a better ally than the Ministry if you've actually come to help us."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "I didn't know the Federation had access to Duskbringer tech. I'm not sure how to think about this, but we have more pressing matters."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "Support from the Hive? I can't say this was expected. Not that I'm complaining, we need all the help we can get against the Flagship."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "Is that the Gyges? I thought that ship was destroyed in the Federation-Mantis war... I'll never get used to this Multiverse stuff."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "Oh, I did not realise your ship was of Free Mantis origins. I didn't predict what valuable allies they would be, but I suppose it makes sense, with Mantis being such excellent fighters."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "The Rock Elders sent a cruiser to fight for us? I can't imagine their reasoning, but you're our last chance if we want to win this fight."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "I thought the Outcasts were indifferent to the war. Well, I'm not one to turn down the help. We need every ship we can get to take down this Flagship."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "I'm surprised the Lost Suns took the effort to provide any assistance. Perhaps I underestimated them as allies. I'm glad you've arrived, we're on our last legs and need all the help we can get."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "A cult? I... sure, not the strangest thing I've seen. Let's hope that massive ship of yours is ready for the Flagship, yes?"

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "Assistance from the Crystalline people? Not the last thing I expected, but certainly not the first either. Let us both hope your Crystal tech will stand against the Rebellion's Flagship."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "Slugs? Why did it have to be Slugs... I'm sure you're here looking for a reward, and perhaps we can work out a deal afterwards. But first, we need to take out the Flagship. The Federation can't stand much more of this attack, and if you came all this way I'm certain you mean business."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "I didn't realize the Eargen Republic had the resources to send in a ship to help the Federation. No less, I'm glad you're here. Let's hope those tales of the once mighty Leech military were true and we're about to see a resurgence, because we sure as hell need it."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. He recoils in shock at the sight of your ship. "A Coalition vessel? This must be some joke... the only reason I can fathom receiving support from the Coalition would be our mutual enemy in the Rebellion. If so, then we can use all the help we can get, even from unlikely allies."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "Orchids, hmmm? I didn't think your kind would take it upon yourselves to assist in this battle. I'm grateful for the reinforcements, we're running thin on soldiers and ships and every ounce of help is worth millions."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "Vampweeds? I cannot say I expected any support from the Confederacy. Is all of that drama from the Federation-Mantis War finally water under the bridge? Well, I suspect not... but we can discuss this later. Right now there's a Flagship that needs killing."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "A Shell cruiser, huh? I heard your kind was rather reclusive... well, I appreciate your assistance. Let's hope that your efforts not go in vain, yes?"

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "Is that... a Shell cruiser? It somewhat resembles one, but it's definitely unlike any I've seen before. Well, whatever you are, your help here today will be greatly appreciated."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. He recoils in shock at the sight of your ship. "A Lanius warship, how interesting. I've never been certain of the Lanius's loyalties or motivation, but if you've come this far I have no doubt you've come to aid us in our fight."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "It's good to know the Union still has our backs. Every day it feels more and more Unionists turn to the Rebellion, but if the Union is still producing loyal Renegades back in Universe 0 then we might just have hope. We're all counting on you, captain. Make me proud."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "Good, looks like you've brought a well-armed Federation ship. Welcome to the Last Stand, captain."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "Ah, a Stealth ship, no wonder I never got any clear readings on the details of your vessel. No matter, let us both hope that your ship will be strong enough to take down the Flagship."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. He recoils in shock at the sight of your ship. "I never believed in a million years the ship who would be saving the Federation would be a Rebel vessel. I'm sure you have your reasons for betraying the Rebellion, and I'd love to hear them, but we have more pressing matters to deal with, such as the Flagship."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. He takes a step back as he takes in your ship. "Um... I don't know what you are, or why Universe 0 hired an automated ship as a Renegade, but if whatever you are is the solution to our problem then... be my guest? But I'll be keeping my eye on you..."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "A Federation automated cruiser? I had no idea they were purposing these for anything but research. Well, I hope your combat systems are up to the task. We can get back to exploring the final frontier once the Flagship has been defeated."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "W.I. sent a ship to assist the Federation? Seems... paradoxical, but I've seen far stranger Renegades come by before. If you're here to help, we'll take any we can get. Good luck against that Flagship, captain."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "A Kestrel? Don't see many of those outside of salvage fleets. Looks like your ship has come full circle... I can only hope it'll pay off."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "That is quite the colorful ship you have there. The Monks are pacifists, yes? Well, let's both hope you have a plan for dealing with that Flagship."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "Hmm, you're that merchant I've heard so much about. Sylvan, wasn't it? Odd, I swear you already arrived here a while ago... I may never wrap my head around this Multiverse stuff. Regardless, I'm glad to have you here. Let's hope you're prepared for that Flagship."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "Monks? I... I don't mean to be disrespectful, but aren't monks, you know, normally pacifists? I guess you're the exception then. As long as you deal with the Flagship, I don't care who you are."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "I swear, every day another race comes popping out of the Multiverse. This time it's... Salt? I think I've heard a legend or two about you. Let's hope you stay true to your legacy, yeah?"
On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "Ack! Spiders?! I hate spiders! God damn it, just looking at your ship gives me shivers."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "Your ship there, well, it strikes a strong resemblance to a vessel I knew from a long, long, long time ago. Never matter, that's far in the past. Let's focus on the present right now, we don't have time to reminisce."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "You'd probably expect me to be surprised to see my own ship here, but this is actually the 7th iteration of myself I've met so far. Now go get that Flagship, you beautiful bastard."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. As soon as he sees your ship, he hangs up immediately, but reconnects not long after. "No. You can't be serious. They sent THIS ship to save us? Is this some sick stupid joke?" Tully sighs. "Well unfortunately, you're the Federation's last hope. Try not to throw it all away, okay? We're all counting on you now."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. As soon as he sees your ship, he hangs up immediately, but reconnects not long after. "Horse? Horse friend!" Tully pauses and corrects his posture. "Er- sorry about that. I don't know what came over me. But, if you take down that Flagship, please let me pet a horse."

On the vidscreen appears several Federation and Engi officers, as well as Admiral Tully in the center. "Your ship... I've never seen a kind like that before. Clearly, the Multiverse still holds many secrets I have yet to see. If you understand what I'm saying, and you're friendly, then please. We need any help we can get in this fight. We're all counting on you, as strange as that sounds."

You scan your ID, but something appears wrong. A nearby Federation ship approaches, and you notice their weapons are online. You receive a hail from the ship. "You've been on quite the escapade in your journey here. I'm afraid the Federation simply cannot support someone with so many bad marks on their record. If you want any shot at forgiveness, eliminating the Flagship would be a good place to start." On that note, they cut comms.

name: LAST_STAND_START_2_TURZIL
text:
Tully then takes notice of Turzil, who had been standing behind you the entire time. "Turzil! I'd heard about what happened to your U0 counterpart, and was worried that you met a similar fate. I take it the Harmony isn't treating you well?"
	
	"Indeed, Admiral. It is [fortunate] I was able to -escape- from Harmony space unscathed."
	
	"You can say that again. Now, I can't really do much to help your situation out as things stand, but perhaps if you help take that Flagship out, we can convince the Harmony of this reality to leave you be. Wishful thinking indeed, but it's all we have left at this point."
	
	"Consider it already [done]."

name: LAST_STAND_START_2_STANDARD
text: "I'm afraid we don't have any more time to chat. Is there anything you need before you face the Flagship?" Tully orders the support ships on stand-by, awaiting your command.

event.text: Tully dispatches a Federation support ship to repair your hull.

choice.text: Request fuel and a sector map.

event.text: Tully dispatches a refueling drone to restore your fuel reserves, and transfers map data of the sector.
Tully dispatches a resupply drone to restore your reserves.
Tully dispatches a trained Federation soldier to serve on your ship.

choice.text: We need not of your assistance. The Great Eye will guide us.

event.text: You make a prayer to the Eye, wishing for save travels through this sector. The eye abides, and you find your ship stocked and ready to go.
As soon as Tully lays his eyes on the box, he changes his posture completely. He permits you inside the Federation command.

name: TULLY_CONTACT
text: Tully sits down with you, and places the box on the table in front of you. "Do you know what's inside this package?" You shake your head. "Well I'll tell you. Absolutely nothing." The confused look on your face makes Tully chuckle. "I gave these packages to several important Federation officials. They are to be given to those who they deem trustworthy and are to be brought to me. It's a sign that you really are worthy of this final fight. We best get going then, this Flagship won't destroy itself."

name: LASTSTAND_EMPTY_BEACON
text: Now that you're all ready to go, you have some time to do something on the ship. These moments will be few and far between in this sector, so take this chance to do whatever you might need, talk to your crew, and look at your mission report one last time!

name: BOSS_AUTOMATED
text: It appears this ship is also equipped with an advanced AI system. Now that the crew is dead, it has taken control! You sense oxygen levels dropping on the Flagship as well...

name: BOSS_DESTROYED
text: Its explosion rocks your ship and you shudder with relief. You did it. The Federation is saved....

event.text: Thanks for playing! Keep in mind this is still in beta and we have not created a satisfying conclusion to the game. Head to our forums to give us some feedback and let us know that you beat it. Thanks!

name: BOSS_ESCAPED
text: Just as you finally gain the upper hand it finds a way to make an FTL jump. You've got to keep up the assault!

name: BOSS_TEXT_1
text: This is it... The Rebel Flagship. If you are able to destroy this monstrosity, the Federation fleet will have a chance of surviving. There's no turning back!

choice.text: Perhaps there could be a reconciliation of our ideals without war?

event.text: The Flagship's commander blinks, confused. "Hah, spoken like a foolish, peace loving monk! You would not know the importance of this movement! Your loyalties to the Federation blind you from the importance of the Rebellion! When have YOU ever gone up against oppression?"

choice.text: We inspired a rebellion within the Rock Homeworlds to overthrow Stonewall.
We defied the Ministry and saved an entire planet from their oppression.
We went up against the Hive and raided their private hatcheries.
We overthrew Tyrdeo and brought about a new era to the Eargen Republic.
We dethroned Nights and convinced the Kleptocracy to turn to democracy.
We exposed the flaws of the Duskbringer movement by stopping a Syndicate attack that attempted to frame the Federation.
We saved the life of the Confederate Premier and ousted Coalition conspirators within their government.

event.text: The commander scoffs. "Oh, how pitiful. I tire of this conversation. There will be no peaceful resolution to this confrontation." He cuts comms, and the Flagship continues to charge its weapons.
The Flagship doesn't take long to notice you. Before it can begin to target you, Jerry taps into the Rebel comms and requests them to pause, demanding they put him on a line with Vance.
The Flagship doesn't take long to notice you. It powers up its artilleries and approaches.

As you approach the Flagship, you receive a hail from its captain. "You... you're the monster who murdered Jerome Wentworth. You hideous, repulsive, vile scum. You claim we're villains, yet you murder the kindest spirit in the whole galaxy in cold blood? Vance gave us direct orders to see to it your mission ends here, but frankly? I don't need those orders. I'm going to enjoy watching you die, as will all the rest of the galaxy."

name: FLAGSHIP_JERRY
text: Not too long later, Vance appears on your screen, his bright orange uniform and massive, muscular figure standing out from the faded white of the officers around him. You aren't sure where Vance is, but that no longer matters.

event.text: Vance stares down to look at his star nephew, a look of confusion upon his face. "Jerome? Have you been taken by this scum to be used as a mere trading good with me? How pathetic of the Federation. Do not worry nephew, I will send my finest strike force to rescue you." Jerry shakes his head. "N-no sir. I'm no hostage. I've come to bargain."

"Bargain? You aren't making any sense boy. Spit it out already. How much are the Feds demanding for your release?" Jerry shakes his head again. "I'm not a hostage Uncle. I joined these men and women on my own volition. I... I hope to end this war. Can't you see how pointless this is? We fight this endless war for what? When does it end? Ever? There's infinite universes, surely you can see how pointless this is!"

Jerry tries to continue, but Vance cuts him off. "You.. you left the protectorate? Then Cyra... Cyra... no. No, this can't be... A-and my nephew? A traitor? My own... nephew?" A tear comes to Vance's eye, but he wipes it away immediately, then turns his back to the screen. "Enough of this. If this is your decision, then so be it. You will die a short sighted fool, just as the Renegade. Goodbye, Jerome."

Jerry collapses to his knees, shocked and speechless as how easily he was betrayed. "I should have known..." Jerry chokes up a sob, and holds his head in his hands while tears form puddles on the ground.

removeCrew.text: Jerry sits in the corner, crying. The Flagship approaches, weapons charging. You want to console him, but you have to get going.

event.text: Suddenly, Jerry gets back up to his feet, wiping away the tears. "Well, there's only one thing left to do now." He draws out a massive Gatling gun. You aren't sure where he got it from, but you don't have the time to question it.
Before you can proceed on to the Flagship, Jerry pauses, and walks out of the room.

removeCrew.text: You have no idea where Jerry is going, but you follow him.

event.text: Jerry enters the room where the Equinoid is sleeping...

removeCrew.text: You have no idea what Jerry is doing, and watch in confusion.

event.text: Then, Jerry proceeds to mount the pony! "Alright. Now I'm ready."
Before you can proceed on to the Flagship, Jerry pauses, and walks out of the room.

removeCrew.text: You have no idea where Jerry is going, but you follow him.

event.text: Jerry enters the room where the Equinoid is sleeping...

removeCrew.text: You have no idea what Jerry is doing, and watch in confusion.

event.text: Then, Jerry proceeds to mount the pony! "Alright. Now I'm ready."

name: BOSS_TEXT_2
text: You chase down the Flagship and discover it is heavily damaged from the previous fight. Scans indicate that it has redirected considerable power to its drones. Get ready for a fight.

event.text: The Flagship might be weakened, but it is still formidable. Keep up the fight!

Suddenly, a small automated vessel breaks off from the fleet in the distance. You receive a hail from the shuttle. "Hello. This is an automated message sent from Admiral Vance of the Rebel fleet. We have taken into consideration your past victories, and the considerable damage you have already dealt to the Flagship. With this in mind, the Rebellion no longer holds interest in this reality. We offer our surrender."

name: BOSS_TEXT_3
text: You're not certain how it's able to keep fighting with the amount of damage it has sustained. It looks like it's transferred power to defensive systems as well as... some kind of super weapon. Be prepared... this is it!

name: BOSS_TEXT_3_VANCE
text: As you approach the Flagship for a third time, an ASB shot flies past your ship and nearly collides with the Flagship. In the distance, the Rebel forces have turned amongst each other. It appears as though word of Vance's betrayal has caught on, and it's created a schism in their forces. Expect additional fire support during this final stretch!

name: BOSS_NEGOTIATE_1
text: "So, you can invade the homeworlds of some barbaric aliens and convince them to turn against themselves. That is nothing compared to the mission of our movement! We seek to bring peace to the galaxy. I doubt you know anything of peace."

choice.text: We saved an entire city and memorial from a siege put on by the Rebellion.
We came to an alliance with the Primal Reaper by helping them repel one of your assaults.
We saved the last of an endangered alien species from the EHG.
We liberated an entire civilian sector from the hacker clan.
We managed to convince the Crystalline Empress herself to be open to the rest of the galaxy.
The Rebellion is not peaceful! The Federation is what's bringing peace to the galaxy.

event.text: The commander laughs. "Oh, how pitiful. To bring peace, there must first be war! The Rebellion will rid of the dangerous xenos of each reality. I tire of this conversation. There will be no peaceful resolution to this confrontation." He cuts comms, and the Flagship continues to charge its weapons.

name: BOSS_NEGOTIATE_2
text: "And how might have you accomplished those? Through killing? As to be expected. The Federation and Rebellion are not any different when it comes to war, but where the Federation is weak, the Rebellion will stand strong! You have delayed this fight for too long. I doubt you would be capable of taking on a ship as powerful as this!"

choice.text: We destroyed one of your Flagships back in the Rebel Stronghold. If we did it once, we can do it again.
We destroyed the original Flagship in the Spectral Wastelands. If we did it once, we can do it again.
It's no Flagship, but we destroyed an Auto-Dreadnaught. We can handle anything the Rebellion throws at us.
It's no Flagship, but we destroyed an advanced W.I. Auto-Cruiser prototype. We can handle anything the Rebellion throws at us.
It's no Flagship, but we destroyed an MFK Gunboat. We can handle anything the Rebellion throws at us.
It's no Flagship, but we destroyed a stolen Rebel Gunboat. We can handle anything the Rebellion throws at us.

event.text: The commander chuckles. "Indeed we will. There will be no peaceful resolution to this confrontation, let us prepare for battle." He cuts comms, and the Flagship continues to charge its weapons.

name: BOSS_NEGOTIATE_3
text: "So you are the one responsible for that? Mighty impressive, but that ship was nothing compared to what you're about to face! You will find our Flagship is far better prepared for a tiny cruiser like yours. Enough delay, you will not escape this fight."

name: NODE17_FREEMANTIS_GLORY
text: A Free Mantis Dropship approaches. "Federation friends! The Pakatakalaka clan happy to see you! We having made it all the way out here to help. Just us, though, rest busy back home... but we having no glory there! We wanting collect many Rebel skulls! Our ship having many troubles with Rebel missiles though..."

choice.text: We're short on crew, do you want to join us?

event.text: "Are you having teleporter? Then yes! For the honor of Federation!"

choice.text: We're short on crew, do you want to join us?

event.text: "Are you having teleporter? Then yes! For the honor of Federation!"

choice.text: We're short on crew, do you want to join us?

event.text: "If we are joining your crew, we are having to stay on board your ship... Not want! Wanting to kill Rebels up close!"

choice.text: (Aether Technology) Offer them some advanced shield technology.
Offer to take a look at their engines.

event.text: "Renegade is wanting to spar? Then let the winner destroying the Rebels!"
"Wishing you well too!"

choice.text: (Aether Technology) Offer them some advanced shield technology.
Offer to take a look at their engines.

event.text: "Renegade is wanting to spar? Then let the winner destroying the Rebels!"
"Wishing you well too!"

name: NODE17_MANTIS_AETHER
text: You upgrade their shields using your Aether technology. They should be able to ward off a few missile shots at the start of a fight.

event.text: "Renegade is doing impressive things! Can't thank enough!" The Pakatakalaka shower you with scrap and a complementary gift.

name: NODE17_MANTIS_ENGINE
text: Their engines are pretty rudimentary, but you have the scrap to bring them up to snuff. This will probably help them out at least a little bit.

event.text: "Grateful to Renegade for advice! Will keep engines upgraded from now on." The Pakatakalaka hand you a complementary gift.

name: NODE17_BLOCKADE
text: On the nearby planet, a massive battle between the Federation and Rebel invaders is raging on. You receive a hail from a Federation Dropship still trying to make its way through the atmosphere.

event.text: "How'd you get down there so quickly? Nevermind, doesn't matter. We're supposed to be bringing reinforcements, but we can't get past the Rebel blockade. Since you're already down there, do you think you could help our troops? It could be the difference between victory and defeat."

You find the Federation battalion. They're in bad shape, and are cornered in the city's center. Their commander, a young man by the name of Conrad, gratefully receives you. "We don't have much time until the Rebels find us and rain all hell on our forces. We need to be as prepared as we can be. If you can help in any way, it would be greatly appreciated."
"Perfect, this'll help us greatly. Thank you so much Captain."
"Perfect, this'll help us greatly. Thank you so much Captain."

choice.text: (Upg. Medbay) Provide medical attention to the soldiers.

event.text: "Perfect, this'll help us greatly. Thank you so much Captain."

choice.text: (Med-bots) Provide medical attention to the soldiers.

event.text: "Perfect, this'll help us greatly. Thank you so much Captain."

choice.text: (Repair Drone) Dispatch the drone to fix up their equipment.

event.text: "Perfect, this'll help us greatly. Thank you so much Captain."

choice.text: (Medical Drone) Dispatch the drone to heal the wounded.

event.text: "Perfect, this'll help us greatly. Thank you so much Captain."

name: NODE17_MILITIA
text: "It is an honor to serve the Federation! This is the last stand of our reality, and you are surely the last one capable of saving us! Anything you need, we will give you." The Militiaman pounds their chest in a traditional Unionist display of loyalty.

event.text: The Militia ship beams over a team of repairmen who get to fixing up your hull at once. They salute one last time before jumping away to return to the fight.
The Militia ship beams a weapon from their cargo that they aren't using. They salute one last time before jumping away to return to the fight.

The Militia ship beams over a soldier from their crew, who swears to do everything in their power to assist you. The rest of the Militiamen salute one last time before jumping away to return to the fight.
Agast at your sudden betrayal, the Militia ship puts up as best a fight it can against you.

name: NODE17_CIVILIANS
text: A Union civilian ship is attempting to escape from the ever-present dangers of this sector. "Whether the Federation wins or not, there's no safety left in this damn place! We have to get out of here... damn it, we have to flee this reality! Please, we're almost out of fuel. Do you have any to spare?"

event.text: You transfer your fuel to the Unionists.
"Oh thank you Captain. This is why we've always supported the Federation. Just make sure you glass that Flagship so it doesn't all go to waste." The Civilians give you some scrap.

choice.text: We have no need for this fuel anymore. Give them as much as we can.

event.text: You transfer your fuel to the Unionists.

"Oh my... This is so much more than we could ever need. We'll certainly be able to escape with all of this! This is why I've always supported the Federation. Just make sure you glass that Flagship so it doesn't all go to waste." The Civilians are so grateful, they give you a military grade weapon that they no longer need on their ship, as well as some scrap.
Unfortunately, you cannot risk letting go of your fuel reserves at that point. You apologize to the Union ship and decline.

name: NODE17_DISGUISE
text: The ship nearby is broadcasting a call on Federation channels. "This is Captain Boggs of the Federation fleet. We are requesting support from any nearby ships in the local system."

choice.text: Do they think we're stupid? Attack!

event.text: You catch the captain of the ship saying, "Crap, they're onto us. Ready the weapons!"
The ship is surprised that you're helping them, but they gleefully accept the supplies.
You fly away from the strange ship and mute their call.

name: NODE17_DEPOT
text: This beacon is home to a makeshift Rebel drop point, a place for transport ships to deliver supplies. It's protected by a well armed MFK guard - but if you can destroy it, any supplies currently kept at the platform will be yours.

event.text: You raise your weapons and attack the guard.
You move past the platform and continue on your mission.

name: NODE17_DEPOT_WIN
text: You've defeated the guard. You scrap the remains before investigating the platform.

event.text: The platform appears to be completely unmanned. You steal as many supplies as you can, and a military grade weapon.

name: NODE17_EVACUATIONS
text: A Federation city at this beacon is underway with evacuations. A few Rebel ships are skirmishing with the border patrol, but the real threat lies at a distant but quickly approaching Rebel squadron. A few massive Federation Heavy Carryships are collecting civilians, but they won't arrive in time before the Rebels can begin their full attack.

choice.text: Pick up as many civilians as possible and bring them to the Carryships.

event.text: You manage to rescue a few dozen civilians. It's extremely cramped in the cargobay, but it's all worth it. Most of the civilians hurry out of your storage into the safety of the Carryship, except for one, who offers to stay behind and aid you in your mission.
As you're leaving, you notice an Elite Rebel ship tailing you. A fight is unavoidable.
It's too risky to endanger your ship in such a way when you're so close to the final battle. You hope most of the civilians can make it out alive.

name: NODE17_EGGMAN
text: A Rebel fleet has gathered around a planet with a rather largely populated Federation metropolis built upon it. It appears the leader of the fleet, an overly rotund and almost egg shaped man aboard an Engineer vessel, is shouting at a crowd that has gathered in response.

event.text: The engineer frantically gestures while he speaks. "-I've come to make an announcement: Colonel Hedge is a bitch ass idiot. He slept with my wife. That's right, he-" there's some fumbling with the mic, but the speech promptly resumes, "was "THIS BIG", and I said 'That's disgusting!' So I'm making a call-out to all of you! Hedge, you've-" again, the mic cuts out momentarily. "It's the size of this ship, except way smaller! And guess what? Here's what mine looks like!"

The crowd screams as a massive ASB cannon extends out of one of the nearby fleet ships. "That's right baby! He slept with my wife, so guess what, I'm gonna... uh... sleep with this planet!" The humongous ASB cannon fires, but the shot travels much higher, missing the planet and striking the moon instead, causing the giant rock to shatter as if it were made of glass. "That's right, this is what you get, my SUPER LASER CANNON! HOW DO YOU LIKE THAT, HEDGE? I SLEPT WITH THE MOON, YOU IDIOT! You have 23 minutes before I get bored of waiting and destroy this entire city. You will surrender yourself immediately. Now get out of my sight, before I sleep with all of you too!" The transmission ends.
You move to attack the Engineer ship. Unfortunately, the fleet is also firing upon you from a distance.

choice.text: Hunt down Hedge and force him to surrender.

event.text: It seems many people in the crowd had the same ideas as you, and people have begun to gather around Hedge's ship, but he's already begun the climb into the atmosphere by the time you arrive. Fortunately for you, you have a ship to follow him with, and you rocket off in his direction. In the distance, it appears the fleet is firing at both of you!

choice.text: Leave before you get slept with.

event.text: Nothing good can await the crowd below, but there's nothing you can do about it now.

name: NODE17_FLEETSHIP_ARGUE
text: This beacon is under attack by a squadron of Rebel fleet ships! They're targeting a populated planet with several large cities.

choice.text: Hail the Rebels and demand they cease firing on civilians.

event.text: The leader of the Rebel squadron responds, glaring at you with a smirk. "You want us to stop our attack? Are you daft, thinking we would take orders from an enemy Renegade vessel? No less a repugnant one from Universe 0?"

choice.text: Think of how many human lives are on that planet! Your attack will kill them as well as the aliens you seek to rid this galaxy of!

event.text: "You speak elegantly, but we have already calculated this sacrifice. The lives of a few will be traded for the good of the many. It's simple arithmetic."

choice.text: What if we could tip the scales?

event.text: The Rebel captain nods slowly. "Uhuh... I see where you're heading. But what possibly could you give us that would be worth giving up this chance today?"
You present your offer to the Rebel, hoping to reach out their better side.
"You think this is going to do anything? I'll make this in an hour from business investments." The Rebel spits and turns away from you.
Indignant, you raise your weapons and attack the Rebel ship.
You double down on the bribe, increasing the scrap in hopes it'll make the Rebels leave. The Rebel captain ponders this for a few moments...

event.name: FLEETSHIP_ARGUE_BRIBE
event.text: "You make an interesting offer. It's still not much all things considered, but it's enough to make me... reconsider. I don't know for what reason a butcher like you cares so heavily about civilian lives, but our fleet is needed elsewhere anyways."

Once the Rebels have jumped away, the civilians below cheer for you. "We knew from the beginning what Universe 1 would do to us, but we'll never give into their brutish methods! The Federation needs all the help it can! Take everything we can offer, and stop that Flagship!"
You propose a hefty amount of scrap in hopes it'll get the Rebels to reconsider and leave. The Rebel captain ponders this for a few moments...

choice.text: Oh, nothing. I was just hypothesizing.

event.text: "How disappointing, but not unexpected. It seems this was all nothing but a waste of time. Now get out of my way, Renegade scum."
The Rebel captain turns silently momentarily, staring blanky at you. Next thing you know, the ship's weapons are hot and they're firing at you!

choice.text: The Rebellion has better things to do than attacking innocent civilians.

event.text: The Rebel captain snickers. "Of course, of course! Your point is clear. Why waste time attacking civilians, when there's a Renegade in need of handling!"

choice.text: There's no way that we can help.

event.text: A tragic fate awaits the innocent lives on that planet, but there's nothing you can do.

choice.text: Prepare to fight the Rebel ship!

event.text: You move in to intercept.

choice.text: There's no time, get ready to jump.

event.text: You try to block out the horrors of war and focus on your mission.

name: DISTRESS_NODE17_DECAYING_ORBIT
text: The remnants of a battle litter this beacon. The surface of a nearby planet is desperately sending out a distress call about a wrecked defense satellite that is currently falling out of orbit. It will likely cause both short and long-term harm. Unfortunately, an aggressive Rebel ship is flying towards you. You only have a short time to address the situation before the Rebel starts attacking!

choice.text: (Adv. Engines) Quickly tow the satellite back into orbit.

event.text: Using your ship's powerful engines, you attach your ship to the satellite and steer it back into orbit. The Rebel arrives just as you finish.

choice.text: (Adv. Cloaking) Cloak your ship as you tow the satellite.

event.text: You cloak your ship to buy yourself enough time to correct the satellite's decaying orbit. Once your cloak wears off however, the Rebel is quick to attack.

choice.text: (Pilot Jammer) Turn off the incoming Rebel's piloting to buy yourself enough time to tow the satellite.

event.text: The Rebel ship starts to drift as their ship loses control. This gives you the time to correct the satellite's orbit before the fight can start!

choice.text: (Engine Jammer) Jam the incoming Rebel's engines to buy yourself enough time to tow the satellite.

event.text: The Rebel ship sputters as the engines falter. This gives you the time to correct the satellite's orbit before the fight can start!

choice.text: Try to steer the satellite back in place.

event.text: Try as you might, you don't have the time to fix the orbit of the satellite. The Rebel ship arrives before you make any progress.

name: NODE17_SATELLITE_SAVED
text: With the satellite orbit properly corrected, the planet expresses their gratitude. You're given a hefty amount of scrap and a weapon to boot!

name: DISTRESS_NODE17_FLAMINGFED
text: The distress signal at this beacon is coming from a nearby Union refueling station, but before you can hail the station yourself, you receive a hail from a Federation officer on board.

event.text: "Thank god someone arrived in time. Our ship sustained heavy damage near a class-M dwarf star. We managed to teleport to this station, but we couldn't reach the engine controls through the flames... and our now vacant ship is on a collision course with the station. Please, help us. Help us all."
You move to intercept the out-of-control ship.

tooltip.text: The station's proximity alarms begin blaring over your comms - if you're going to stop this ship, you're going to have to work fast!
