Atone for the misdeeds that concern the Union.
Atone for the misdeeds that concern the Zoltan Ministry.
Atone for the misdeeds that concern the Ctl'Yae Gathering.
Atone for the misdeeds that concern the Engi Harmony.
Atone for the misdeeds that concern the Crystal Empire.
Atone for the misdeeds that concern the Outcast Rockmen.
Atone for the misdeeds that concern the Oro'bache Confederacy.
Atone for the misdeeds that concern the Free Mantis.
Atone for the misdeeds that concern the Shell Geniocracy.
Atone for the misdeeds that concern the Slug Kleptocracy.

event.text: "I see... Although I am disappointed, I will have faith that you are capable of making it right by your own deeds. Go in peace."

name: ATONEMENT_NIGHTMARE
text:
All is dark, and all is calm... yet, you feel as though a light has enveloped you. As you reflect on the actions that have left you infamous, you feel a creeping dread envelop you. For each of your wrongs, a pang echoes in your heart. These wrongs soon take shape, coalesce into gigantic runic cubes. These cubes swarm around you, bringing great devastation, as the light is slowly but surely blotted out. But soon, the boxes fade, and it begins to rain. No... it's not rain, it is a swarm... of locusts. As they descend upon you, they begin to eat. They devour your fingers, your arms, your legs... they keep devouring your body. But, before they envelop you completely, they scatter.

...you hear a door open.

event.text:
You awake in a cold sweat. The monks help you get back to your feet. You feel as though a lot of time has passed since you closed your eyes. You notice your crew looks at you in concern, but they seem relieved that you have awoken.

			The monk speaks to you again. "Your atonement has completed. The scales are balanced once more. Please take great care to embrace your moral duties. Go in peace."

name: MONK_CLEAN_SOUL
text: "How impressive, it seems that all peoples - well, aside from those who will hate you no matter what you do - have naught but good things to say about you. It pleases me that you have taken such great pains to act in kindness towards everyone. The Eye has provided us with a great artifact, we hope that it will be of use to you."

name: MONK_TEMPLE
text: This beacon appears to have been established in the orbit of a luscious, overgrown jungle planet. In the center of a giant cavern filled with flora lies a Zoltan temple. It looks relatively low tech, save for a single dormant Auto-ship protecting it.

event.text: You attempt to communicate but it appears the temple does not even have a system for receiving hails. You pilot closer and land, where a monk welcomes you. "Welcome, friends. All are welcome in this holy place, free of charge."

Most of the temple is run down and poorly maintained, with a few cheap statues here and there. A central room hosts many monks meditating in a circle. The head monk opens his eyes and greets you. "You are a visitor from the Federation? Come, join us on the path to enlightenment, and be blessed by the gods of peace."
"That's alright, friend. Safe travels."
You're curious what it's like to be a Zoltan monk, but it's not nearly as important as your mission.

choice.text: We can take the Auto-ship, raid the temple!

event.text: Once you take out the Auto-ship you'll be able to access the defenseless temple.
You have no interest in the Zoltan temple.

name: MONK_TEMPLE_REWARD
text: You take a seat on the floor amid the other Zoltans and join in with their low humming. Almost half a day passes before you are suddenly startled from your sleep and realize how much time has passed by...

event.text: The Monks briefly thank you for your visit, and as you leave you feel a strange feeling come over you... almost as if you were blessed.

name: NEBULA_MONK_EYE_OFFERING

unvisitedTooltip.text: The location of the great eye, a giant monolith worshipped by the Zoltans.

visitedTooltip.text: The location of the great eye, a giant monolith worshipped by the Zoltans.

text: As you approach the Great Eye, a rift suddenly opens and a chunk of scrap comes hurtling towards you. Fortunately it only lightly bounces off of your hull, and you scoop it up. You have no idea where it comes from, but you'll take the scrap.

name: NEBULA_MONK_EYE_NORMAL

unvisitedTooltip.text: The location of the great eye, a giant monolith worshipped by the Zoltans.

visitedTooltip.text: The location of the great eye, a giant monolith worshipped by the Zoltans.

text: You've discovered the Great Eye! Though the location was named after the giant eye shaped nebula in the distance, the real attraction is a massive cuboid monolith with green lights resting on the nearby planet. This beacon is a well visited location by both tourists and Zoltan, who take an annual pilgrimage to this location.

name: MONK_EYE_OPTIONS
text: It is said the monolith has strange, unpredictable powers. Those who can get it to speak to them may find many wonders or horrors that await.

choice.text: Speak to the Monolith and await your fate.
You've heard the tales of beings who vanish without a trace when speaking to the Monolith... you're not interested in meeting the same fate.
Make an offering to the Great Eye.

event.text: You toss some scrap towards the Great Eye, wondering if something will occur. Unfortunately, nothing seems to. Perhaps those old Zoltan myths are false? Maybe it's worth another try?

choice.text: (Monk Crew) Pray to the Eye for a chance at better rewards.
(Obelisk Crew) Your Obelisk recognizes this structure.

event.text: "This structure was an early design of an Obelisk Reality Manipulator. You can probably guess what it does from the name. Strange it ended up here, but I suppose this explains why the monolith can supposedly do all kinds of strange things. We could bring it aboard and I can make some repairs, but I doubt the Zoltans would appreciate it."

As you bring aboard the Reality Manipulator, a Zoltan Peacekeeper stops you. "You dare disturb the Great Eye? You have insulted our entire species, not to mention the divine creators! You will be punished!"
It's tempting, but not worth the risk to mess with an item worshipped and valued so highly by the Zoltans.
Your mission is to save the Federation, not discover new wonders around the galaxy. You prepare to jump.

name: NEBULA_MONK_PEACE_QUEST
text: An unarmed Zoltan vessel is slowly making its way toward the beacon here. They hail: "I carry no weapons or shielding and rely on the mercy of others to communicate our message."

event.text: They continue. "I take your silence for interested contemplation." The monk talks at length about peace and harmony, but either it's beyond your simple mind or it's all nonsense.
They finish: "Please, spread the word of enlightenment to those that have not heard. Once you have, contact our brethren." They transmit coordinates of their so-called "brethren".
The galaxy is at war - there's no time for talk of peace. You leave their hails unanswered and charge the jump drive.

name: MONK_PEACE_QUEST2

unvisitedTooltip.text: The location of the Monk's brethren.

visitedTooltip.text: This was the location of the Monk's 'brethren'.

text: You arrive at the location specified by the peace-loving Monk, but the only thing nearby is an Elite Rebel ship, closing in fast! "We've found you! You're not getting away this time!"

event.text: They open communications: "I can't imagine there's anything you could say that will save you. The rebellion must destroy those that are still loyal to the obsolete Federation."

choice.text: "Perhaps there could be a reconciliation of our ideals without war?"

event.text: "Our ideals are too different to be so easily reconciled. You think this could end any way but war?"

choice.text: The galaxy is huge - you can find a place for your ideals elsewhere without causing this destruction.

event.text: "No! We will not be consigned to the backwaters of space just because we don't fit into your 'Federation ideals'!" They charge.

choice.text: True progress can only be achieved without bloodshed.

event.text: "You speak nonsense. We will not listen to you." They arm their weapons and attack, but perhaps you do not need to kill them. Maybe you can let them surrender, so that you may both leave this place alive?

choice.text: "Surrender. Your ultimate destruction is inevitable. We've left scores of Rebels destroyed in our wake."

event.text: They shut off communications and immediately engage.

choice.text: "Your Rebellion is causing millions of deaths. Your beliefs are dividing the galaxy. Unity is the only option!"

event.text: "Humans are treated as 'equal' to aliens in the weak Federation. The sacrifice of BILLIONS of alien or human lives are justified if it means we reach our full potential!" They charge.
You power your weapons and prepare to fight.

name: MONK_PEACE_QUEST_REWARD
text: "Although your methods are crude and most certainly ineffective, it is clear you took our previous meeting to heart. If your ship represents the Federation's willingness to adapt we shall do what we can to aid in their fight. Would you like a sample of our tech, or perhaps I could send a well trained Peacekeeper to assist you?"

name: MORPH_ZOLTAN
text: A Zoltan science vessel is in this region. "We've been reading some very intriguing scientific reports about this region, but unfortunately there's not that much information that has been disclosed to the Ministry. We're hoping to write a survey paper for a journal. Have you seen any interesting phenomena unique to this region?"

choice.text: (Long-Ranged Scanners) Share your advanced sensor readings with them.

event.text: "I see, these are some interesting readings. We'll do what we can with these."

choice.text: (Adv. Sensors) Show them your advanced sensor readings.

event.text: "I see, these are some interesting readings. We'll do what we can with these."

choice.text: (Mafan) Admonish the scientists for their cowardice.

event.text:
"You call yourselves researchers? You're hailing a Federation Renegade - we're not the ones you should be talking to! Go do your jobs and get in that nebula! I'll send you some directions, but you have to do the work yourself."

			The Zoltans look ashamed. "Yes Dr. Vadis... We hope you'll... overlook our embarrassing moment."

choice.text: (Shell Scientist) Encourage your Shell Scientist to share some of their research.

event.text: Your Scientist sighs and agrees to share whatever information they can get away with, but insists on being properly credited as an author. The Zoltans accept this agreement.

choice.text: (Alkali) Encourage Alkali to grant them access to his research.

event.text:
Alkali looks at you strangely and rolls his eye. "Fine, but only if it's worthhhh it." He then jumps onto the call to talk to the Ministry scientists. "Who is the head researcher over thhhhere? I'm not going to help some hack - but if thhhhey're worthhhhy, we can work something out."

			"Uh, yes, I'll send over her portfolio right away... she's still back in Zoltan space right now."

			Alkali goes over her file, looking over the papers she'd worked on and contributions she'd made. After a few minutes he nods and gets back on. "I'll send you some of my research. You'd better write a very glowing 'Acknowledgements' section about me!" The Zoltans seem all too happy to agree to this, and give you a handsome reward of scrap.
The captain of the Zoltan vessel shows his appreciation with an extra gift.

choice.text: (Morph Crew) Show them your Morph crewmember.

event.text: "So this is what they've been hiding in that nebula! Fascinating. We'll take a few readings and let you be on your way!"
The Ministry already has enough shady secrets, they have no need to get into this. These scientists will be no match for your weapons.

choice.text: Tell them you have nothing to show them.

event.text: "We'll keep looking then."

name: MORPH_SLUG
text: You jump in, expecting to find a ship in distress. Instead, you see a Slug Clansman chewing on some alien popcorn. "Oh, hey watssssup man."

event.text: "Oh, yeahhhh that. There wassss sssome Morphsss here a minute ago. Think I ssscared them off tho-" The Slug is cut off when the Morph ship comes flying back, firing on the Slug hull!
There's probably a valid reason for the Morphs attacking these Clansmen... but nonetheless you aren't going to let it happen!

You can imagine why the Morphs are mad - Clansmen aren't known for being friendly to their fellow nebula dwellers... or anyone for that matter. You won't let them become the Guild's next prey. You prepare to defend the Morphs!

choice.text: Alright fun chat, time to leave.
Obviously, they aren't in danger anymore. Leave.

event.text: These Clansmen likely are attempting to lower your guard just to shoot you when you won't expect it. It's better to leave them to be entertained by this sector's unpredictable inhabitants.

name: MORPH_RUINS
text: Though Shells usually stick to the nebulas, it seems a Shell research outpost was set up here previously. It's heavily damaged though, but maybe something is left?

event.text: You move closer to the wreck, but are stopped when a mechanic ship flies past. "Hey, is thhhhat really necessary? You're only making our job harder. Management always gets thhhhe worst jobs! I'd rather be scooping out equinoid brains or fighting off Slugs, but yet here I am. Do us a favor and leave thhhhat station alone, would you?"

You ignore the Shells, scooping up all that you can. The ship watches in growing anger, and their captain finally snaps. "Alright, damn you to hell. We have a job to do, and you've officially crossed the line!"

"Oh, wow. Thhhhat's quite helpful! Why can't thhhe council authhhhorize us better funding? Ugh, I hate thhhis job. You know what? I quit! I'm withhh you now. What are you gonna do about it, huh Director Nerva? Oh man, it feels so good to say thhhat..."

"Oh, wow. Thhhhat's quite efficient! Why can't thhhe council authhhhorize us using thhhose? Ugh, I hate thhhis job. You know what? I quit! I'm withhh you now. What are you gonna do about it, huh Director Nerva? Oh man, it feels so good to say thhhat..."

choice.text: (Hull Repair Drone) Fix up the station. [-1|]

event.text: "Oh, wow. Thhhhat's quite efficient! Why can't thhhe council authhhhorize us using thhhose? Ugh, I hate thhhis job. You know what? I quit! I'm withhh you now. What are you gonna do about it, huh Director Nerva? Oh man, it feels so good to say thhhat..."

"Oh, wow. Thhhhat's quite efficient! Why can't thhhe council authhhhorize us using thhhose? Ugh, I hate thhhis job. You know what? I quit! I'm withhh you now. What are you gonna do about it, huh Director Nerva? Oh man, it feels so good to say thhhat..."

"Oh, wow. Thhhhat's quite efficient! Why can't thhhe council authhhhorize us using thhhose? Ugh, I hate thhhis job. You know what? I quit! I'm withhh you now. What are you gonna do about it, huh Director Nerva? Oh man, it feels so good to say thhhat..."

"Oh, wow. Thhhhat's quite efficient! What even is thhhat, and where did you find it? Ugh, I hate thhhis job. You know what? I quit! I'm withhh you now. What are you gonna do about it, huh Director Nerva? Oh man, it feels so good to say thhhat..."
One man's trash is another man's trash too. What could be left worth taking anyways?

name: MORPH_PIRATE_INSANE
text: Before you can go any further, you're stopped by a pirate vessel. "Have you heard the news!? Our new gods, the Morphs, have risen! The great one himself, oh mighty OOJ MAJOO has been freed from captivity! Do you have an offering for the gods, or will you live a life of regretful sin?!"

event.text: "You are wise! I have all certainty the great OOJ MAJOO shall bless you! As a devout believer in the Morphs, I shall grant you passage, and aid in your travels!"
The pirate does extensive work on your hull, and offers an augment to appease you.

"Oh sweet heavens, you're one of them! I am so sorry my lord for not recognizing you!" The pirate falls to his knees, pleading for forgiveness. You promise to spare him so long as he hands over one of the weapons in his storage.
The pirate screeches in rage, and powers up his weapons. You should do the same.

name: NEBULA_LIGHT_MORPH_SOLAR
text: Shells aren't normally ones for unmanned tech, and you don't normally see full sized stars deep in the nebula either. Despite both of these things being uncommon, it seems you've run into both! A small Shell solar energy collection device is orbiting the star. Inside are several power cells you might be able to interface with... if you can figure the machine out.

choice.text: Take your chance and interface with the device.

event.text: It's too risky, especially this close to a star. You'll have to jump away as soon as you can.

name: NEBULA_MORPH_JUICE
text: A Shell vessel outfitted for cargo purposes is attempting to navigate the thicker clouds nearby. You catch chatter on the comms concerning their cargo, which seems to be high value. From what you can hear, it appears they're afraid of getting lost in the nebula.

event.text: The two Shells turn to look at you, surprised to find someone else here. "Oh. A Renegade. And thhhey aren't killing us? How strange. Maybe you can help. We're currently transporting a shipment of Quarp Juice to Site Omega, but thhhis storm is in our way. Do you happen to have any alternate flight paths thhhere?"
The Shells immediately mute you and carry on arguing with each other.

"You've never heard of Quarp Juice? It's thhhis miracle substance Professor Alkali discovered that thhhe Union was selling! Invented by some genius scientist named Ellie! We used it to make thhhe Morphs. Which uh... didn't turn out so well, sure, but thhhey aren't selling thhhhe stuff anymore and it's incredibly expensive. We had a couple warehhhouses of it left and we're moving it before it gets blown up by Rebels."
The Shells immediately mute you and carry on arguing with each other.

choice.text: If their cargo is valuable, let's take it!

event.text: You aren't quite sure what they're exactly carrying, but you sure wouldn't mind taking it!
With nothing of interest to do with the transport, you simply mute their frequencies and carry on.

name: MORPH_JUICE_ALKALI
text: You expect Alkali to offer help to the scientists or at least some words of reaffirment, but instead he only proceeds to insult the pair for their incompetence. Ashamed (and also afraid of being fired) the Shells profusely apologize and offer you everything they can spare to settle Alkali's anger.

name: NEBULA_MORPH_PEEPEEPOOPOO
text: A hail from the nearest Morph ship bears an odd message. "Pee pee poo poo." To you, this sounds like nothing more than a crude joke. But for all you know, to the Morphs this could be profound.

choice.text: Take some time to decipher it.

event.text: You spend hours analyzing what it could mean. You work your brain, trying every possible angle to look for. At last, you give up. It seems the true meaning of pee pee poo poo shall forever remain lost to you. Fortunately, your efforts don't go entirely in vain, and the Morph seems to appreciate your thoughtfulness and gives you a small chunk of scrap.

choice.text: (Morph Crew) Have your Morph explain this meaning to you.

event.text: Your Morph speaks to you for a long time, revealing the universe's inner secrets. The answer to your every problem, the meaning of the universe itself, it is all held tight in this one simple, unassuming phrase. Unfortunately, you don't understand your crewmate's speech either. You suppose these secrets shall remain forever lost to you. Fortunately, this wisdom is not lost on the other ship, who offers a chunk of scrap for being so wise.
You aren't going to let the Morphs insult you like this! You open fire.

choice.text: It's nothing more than crass and crude.

event.text: You do not believe such a phrase could hold any importance. You abandon this thought experiment and carry on.

name: NEBULA_MORPH_ENGINEER_TECHNO
text: It appears the nearby Engineer ship isn't attacking you just yet. Instead, they hail. "You know, I should attack you. But frankly, I just want to brag to someone about my latest achievement!"

event.text: "You've probably heard of or seen the Technopaths by now. They're like the Morphs, but they can take the form of noncarbon entities instead! Well, I thought it would be a great idea to start replacing my drones with some. It's almost exactly the same amount of efficiency, but without any of the power usage! It's great!"

choice.text: Acknowledge their success and carry on.

event.text: You're only trying to carry on to the next beacon, but the Engineer seems so happy you acknowledged him, he even offers you some free drone parts.

choice.text: We aren't here for stories. Attack the engineers!

event.text: You won't show these Rebels mercy just because they want to talk!

name: NEBULA_MORPH_SMUGGLER_CONFUSED
text: Nearby is a smuggler, flying through the nebula. Perhaps they have something of value to offer?

event.text: You expect a simple response from the vessel, but instead you receive a loud screech, followed by the shout of one of your crew. You run to their location where you see a frightened smuggler holding a pistol to their face. "You- you're one of them Morphs, ain't ya! Don't play no damn tricks on me!

choice.text: (Clone Bay) There's no risk here. Blast the asshole and carry on.

event.text: You draw your blaster, shooting the smuggler, but not before he shoots your own crew. Luckily, there indeed is no risk, and your crew comes back perfectly fine. The smuggler ship now inoperable, you scrap some of its hull.

The smuggler screams, horrified at the sight of an actual Morph on your ship. Firing widly, he causes some damage to your ship, but you're able to subdue him. With his ship now inoperable, you scrap some of the hull.
You doubt they have anything to offer thats worth your time.

name: NEBULA_MORPH_FREEGUN
text: Holy crap! A weapon is just floating in space! Sure it's a storm, but a gun is a gun!

choice.text: Our luck is never this good. Leave it.

event.text: God knows what that "gun" could be. You leave it behind and carry on.

name: NEBULA_MORPH_SHELL_REFUGEE_SCIENCE
text: It looks like a Shell vessel is approaching...

name: NEBULA_MORPH_SHELL_REFUGEE_IMPOSTOR
text: It looks like a Shell vessel is approaching...

name: MORPH_SHELL_REFUGEE_SCIENCE
text: It looks like the Shell ship is a science vessel. They beg you for help. "Thhhhe Rebels, thhhey've been following us everywhere! Would you be so kind as to aid us?"

choice.text: Offer them some supplies to better prepare themselves.

event.text: You give the Shells some missiles and droneparts to help them...
"Oh, you are most generous! You have our best wishes. Here, accept this gift."
Never one to shy away from casual needless murder, you power up the weapons and attack the Shells.
You apologize but have nothing to offer. The Shells nod and carry on.

name: MORPH_SHELL_REFUGEE_IMPOSTER
text: It looks like the Shell ship is a science vessel. They beg you for help. "The Rebels, they've been following us everywhere! Would you be so kind as to aid us?"

event.text: As soon as their crew step aboard, it's apparent that those Shells... they're Rebels! It was a trap all along!

choice.text: Offer them some supplies to better prepare themselves.

event.text: You give the Shells some missiles and droneparts to help them...
"Oh, you really are stupid after all! It was a trap, idiots!" The ship turns hostile, revealing itself to be piloted by Rebels!
You expect protesting from the Shell vessel, but instead you're met with angry shouts from a Rebel captain! "Damn it, how did you know it was a trap?!"
The Shell ship stays suspiciously silent for a moment, followed by them raising their weapons. A Rebel captain appears on the vidscreen. "Ahahah, it was a trap all along!"

name: NEBULA_MORPH_BLOCKADE
text: When you first jump in, you assume this to be a simple, empty nebula, but such a hope is betrayed when a militant vessel comes out of the clouds. "Hey, didn't you hear Prof. Alkali's warning? Thhhhis sector is dangerous. Thhhhhis beacon is under quarantine. I suggest you move it."

choice.text: You can't tell us what to do!

event.text: You'll be damned if you let anyone tell you where you can and can't go. You arm the weapons and prepare for battle.

choice.text: (Alkali) We are carrying a VIP right now.

event.text: Once the militants learn about the situation, they stop bothering you, and even offer supplies before saying farewell.
You power down the weapons and prepare to leave the system as soon as you can.

name: NEBULA_MORPH_AUTOSCIENCECHOICE
text: A short range distress signal is being emitted from a Shell science station nearby, which is under attack by a Rebel Auto-ship!

event.text: You attack the Auto vessel.
You don't have the time to play hero right now and help the Shells.

name: NEBULA_DISTRESS_MORPH_REBEL_JAMMED
text: Of all things, you didn't expect to see a Rebel ship being the one to solicit their distress beacon on open comms. They don't seem shy to hail you either. "You know that gross sentient space gunk that lives here? Well some of their goopy insides got all stuck in our engines, and now they're jammed. Now I know we don't exactly get along, but there surely could be something in it for you!"

choice.text: Try and fix up their engines.
There couldn't be a better opportunity to attack!

event.text: If they don't have engines, there's nowhere these Rebels can run! Still they try, but it's pointless.

choice.text: (Engineer Crew) Have your engineer take a look at the engines.

event.text: Fortunately, your engineer clears out the Morphs quickly, and the Rebels seem impressed. "Hmmm... you've helped us more than we expected. I suppose the act of not murdering us is worthy of some pay as promised."

choice.text: (Engi Crew) Have your Engi take a look at the engines.

event.text: Fortunately, your Engi clears out the Morphs quickly, and the Rebels seem impressed. "Hmmm... you've helped us more than we expected. I suppose the act of not murdering us is worthy of some pay as promised."

choice.text: (Morph Crew) Have your Morph reawaken the hibernating goo.

event.text: Your Morph lets out a cacophony of shrill chirping, followed by many more from the Morphs in the engines, who detach themselves from the mechanism and roll to meet your Morph. The Rebels aren't really sure what they just witnessed, but they reluctantly pay you in "thanks".
Knowing the Rebels, this could just as well be yet another trap. Atleast, they don't seem to follow you.

name: NEBULA_DISTRESS_MORPH_SLICE
text: The distress call nearby seems to be coming from a Mantis vessel, whose captain frantically screams at you. "HELP, HELP, HELP HELP HELP HELP! ME TRYING SLICE UP BLOB, BLOB BECOME MORE BLOB! NOW BLOB EVERYWHERE! SO MANY! AAAAAAAAAGH!"

choice.text: Help rid their ship of the Morphs.

event.text: If you're expecting any kind of reward, you'll have to be careful not to destroy the ship!

choice.text: (Boarding Drone) Send the drone in to eradicate the Morphs.
Leave the Mantis to their troubles.

event.text: You do not see any reason to help the Mantis. The Hive has clashed with mightier foes than agitated slimes in the past; they can deal with this on their own.

name: NEBULA_ENCOUNTER_SHELL_SCIENTIST_MORPH
text: Normally Shell ships are reasonably passive, especially the scientists. However, the ship here doesn't follow that example. "Damn it, we already have to deal with thhhhe Rebels here! We didn't ask for Federation intervention!"

name: MORPH_SITE_DELTA
text: It looks like a massive Shell laboratory has been set up here, and it's still functional! However, you can't help but wonder how it survived this long under the Rebel siege.

event.text: You receive a response from a frightened Shell scientist. "Crap! You'll never take us alive, Federation!" The station suddenly opens fire without any further reason why. Maybe if you can damage them enough, they'll surrender and you can figure out what's going on.
You have better things to do than bother these Shells.

name: MORPH_SITE_DELTA_FAIL
text: Looks like you ended up killing the Shells after all. Now nothing remains but some salvage.

name: MORPH_SITE_DELTA_UNLOCK
text: True to what the Shell said, if the Rebellion has use for this, so will the Federation. For the blueprint, you forward them to the Federation base. The weapon you take with you, and the Morph DNA you lock away for safe keeping. The Rebels don't need to get their hands on this...

name: NEBULA_MORPH_SITE_ALPHA
text: Looks like this is... or was, the site of a Shell laboratory. Apparently something important no less, as it's marked "Site Alpha" on your map. Looks like it's been damaged by Rebels though, and a single ship still remains.

choice.text: Attack them to access the lab.

event.text: The Rebel ship is slow to the offense, and says nothing. All the same, they raise their weapons and attack!
This place has already been ransacked. No reason getting involved when we won't get much out of it anyways.

name: MORPH_SITE_ALPHA_ENTER
text: Another Rebel ship laid to waste by you and your crew. You scrap the hull before you investigate the lab.

event.text: You're surprised to find a still functional terminal in one of the rooms. It appears to have been half-way through sending a message until it was disabled by the Rebels. You download the information and play it back on your ship...

"Thhhe final containment unit has been breached. Rebel forces have descended on Site Alpha, and have stolen subject 0. We are requesting immediate backup, an MFK Ace has already arrived. I repeat, we are requesting immediate ba-" The recording cuts short, but you can easily guess how it ended. Nothing pretty, to be certain. Looks like some coordinates are on here too, a tracking beacon on this supposed subject 0.

name: SURRENDER_OOJ_UNLOCK
text: Suddenly, a voice bursts out of the Rebel ship, though it's oddly unhuman, but you can't place your finger on why. "StOp! THis shIp dosnot want TO fight. Please-stofiring. Please. Please. Please."

event.text: "T-hank yOu. You are... so KInd." It suddenly dawns on you what's off. The voice is spliced together from other audio tracks. It's not even a person speaking, but a bizarre recording.
You don't receive a response for a while, and you begin to think they've ignored you, when suddenly the 'voice' returns. "CaNI trusyou?"
"Thiship- Not REbEls. I am... OO-JMA-JOO. Fatherof MOrpHs. We arescaping. The Shells ARE not-kind. They waNT to-use us forslave labor. WILL you allow usaftety? When I am-safe the Morphs will BE too."

choice.text: Agree to take him with you.

event.text: You expect a Morph to beam aboard, but instead the Rebel ship changes shape, converging into a massive grey blob. "Itappears I AM too large. To fit. I wishforyou TO carRY this segmentof My body. FEEd it so IT may grow. THank YOU, FedERATION."

choice.text: We aren't the right people for this task.

event.text: "I... UNDER stand. Thank youfor not KIlling me." The Rebel ship spits out a weapon, then jumps away.
The ship stops, then immediately jumps away. Guess you scared them off, idiot.

name: ENCOUNTER_OOJMAJOO

unvisitedTooltip.text: Coords of the subject zero.

text: Looks like this is the ship carrying the supposed subject zero. Much like the ship before, it makes no attempt to brag, threaten, or insult you like a normal Rebel ship would, but silently moves past.

event.text: You can't even be certain if this "subject 0" is still onboard or not, but you aren't going to let these Rebels go without a fight!

Your Morph crew seems to have something to say, but you can't understand them. As you listen to them spouting nonsense, you accidentally bump hulls with the MFK Ace. The ship suddenly turns hostile and attacks!
It's not often you see a Rebel ship like this, but you don't feel like fighting today.

name: NEBULA_MORPH_SITE_OMEGA
text: You've arrived at Site Omega, the location mentioned by Alkali at the entrance. You spot a large Shell laboratory in the distance, and approach cautiously.

event.text: Oddly enough, it appears the gas in the facility has been shut off. It's extremely convenient, but you aren't one to question. You dock with the station and head inside...

The interior hallways are mixed in splashes of red and green blood as you carefully step over the mangled corpses of humans and crumbled bodies of deceased Shells. Looks like a massive firefight happened here, though the uniform on these Rebels stands out... Not one to back down though, you press on, following the trail of carnage.

At last, you reach a locked door, and once you break it open you spot a wounded Shell scientist on the ground, presumably Alkali. As soon as he spots you, he points at a table with a syringe on it. "You. Give me thhhat..."

choice.text: No. You're going to answer some questions first.

event.text: Alkali glares at you, and you aren't even sure if he heard you. "Didn't you hear me? Grab me thhhhat syringe. I don't have time to waste."

choice.text: This is a bad idea. Ignore the station.

event.text: If this place had to go on lockdown, it can't mean anything good.

name: ALKALI_LORE
text: You quickly administer the brown liquid in the syringe into Alkali's arm. "Good, I just needed something to boost my regenerative properties again. Now, why is thhhe Federation intruding in thhhis sector? I didn't realize thhhe ongoings of thhhe Geniocracy concerned you when you seem much more preoccupied withhh... othhher matters."

choice.text: Could ask the same about why the Rebels are here.

event.text: "Yes, I was wondering thhhe same thhhhing. Thhhey've taken an interest in our... my latest mistakes. Thhhe Morphhhs, you see, were created to work for thhhe Shells. Do thhhe hard, manual labor. A work of god damn genius, too! All it took was a bit of Quarp Juice and soon enough I had created LIFE ITSELF! Damn Nerva, thhhe Management District's director, kept refusing to approve funding for thhhe project! Probably thhhought thhe Morphhhs were going to make them useless, much like thhhhe Radiants for thhhe Military District..."

"I wouldn't be surprised if thhhhat bitch sabotaged my facilities! But thhhat's just rumor among thhhe science district... Now, you still have not answered my question. Why are you here? I do not appreciate thhhe unknown staying unknown, and I would like to understand your intentions before you shoot me or sacrifice me to whatever pagan gods you people worship."

choice.text: We're on a quest to reach Node 17.

event.text: "Well no shit, everyone knows WHERE you're going. I swear, everyone is heading to thhhhat forsaken place. A disgrace! You could have used thhhat MV tech to, I don't know, solve ancient mysteries or create some sort of interdimensional utopia. But instead you use it to fight each othhher. We Shells do not suffer from thhhese issues. We are people of science, and have little to worry about internal conflict. Now, you still have not answered me. Have you come to kill me? Recruit me to cure some form of deadly space disease your people suffer from? God damn it, I'm tired of waiting."

choice.text: We heard your distress call and came here.

event.text: "Ah, some kind of philanthropist, are you? Great, well I guess you're a better escort thhhan... I dunno, somethhhing thhhat's worse thhhan you. You don't subscribe to any silly religions or conspiracies do you? You are vaccinated, right?"
"Very good thhhen. I request thhhat you transport me back to thhhe Geniocracy when you have a chance. I shall make myself useful in thhhhe meantime. I am no freeloader."

choice.text: (Monk Crew) "We are men and women of peace. The Great Eye guides us."

event.text: Alkali looks at you in disgust. "Ugh... well at least I know for certain you aren't going to kill me. For thhhe time I am aboard your ship, you shall let me sleep in whatever room doesn't have any spiritual paraphernalia in it. I don't care if it's a broom closet. I request thhhat you transport me back to thhhe Geniocracy when you have a chance. I shall make myself useful in thhhhe meantime. I am no freeloader."

choice.text: (Floral Crew) "The great tree Cyrtal'y Mncolo illuminates our path forward!"

event.text: Alkali looks at you in disgust. "Ugh... Orchid Florals. I would have much preferred thhhe company of your Vampweed brethren. Never mind thhhen. For thhhe time I am aboard your ship, you shall let me sleep in whatever room doesn't have any spiritual paraphernalia in it. I don't care if it's a broom closet. I request thhhat you transport me back to thhhe Geniocracy when you have a chance. I shall make myself useful in thhhhe meantime. I am no freeloader."

choice.text: (Faithful Rock Crew) "The Elders guide us on the path to glorious life!"

event.text: Alkali looks at you in disgust. "Ugh... great, a bunch of barbarians. For thhhe time I am aboard your ship, you shall let me sleep in whatever room doesn't have any spiritual paraphernalia in it. I don't care if it's a broom closet. I request thhhat you transport me back to thhhe Geniocracy when you have a chance. I shall make myself useful in thhhhe meantime. I am no freeloader."

Alkali looks at you in disgust. "Seriously, a bunch of weird aliens with god complexes? For thhhe time I am aboard your ship, you shall let me sleep in whatever room doesn't have any spiritual paraphernalia in it. I don't care if it's a broom closet. I request thhhat you transport me back to thhhe Geniocracy when you have a chance. I shall make myself useful in thhhhe meantime. I am no freeloader."

choice.text: We heard your distress call and came here.

event.text: "Ah, some kind of philanthropist, are you? Great, well I guess you're a better escort thhhan... I dunno, something thhhat's worse than you. You- wait..." Alkali seems to notice Ellie standing amongst your crew for the first time. "A-are you Professor Ellie thhhe Equinoid? As in, THHHE Professor Ellie thhhe Equinoid?

"YOU-" Alkali takes a moment to collect himself, rolling up to Ellie and shaking her hand. "It's an honor to meet you, professor. I am Professor Alkali Mardovar, but I'm sure you've heard of my work as I've heard of yours. Your Quarp Juice is a miracle, a life creating miracle! It's thhhe basis of my entire Morphhh project, it's truly revolutionary! I am in awe to be in your presence, as I am sure you are to be in mine!"

Ellie gets on her knees to be eye level with the Shell, patting him on the head. "Well Mister Alkali, it's an honor to meet you too! Quarp Juice is very yummy! But I didn't invent it, silly. It's just the juice from Quarp!"
											Alkali shakes his head. "You're too humble. But Quarp isn't even a real fruit! It puzzled me at first, but it seems to be a fictional creation in some television show. The juice thhhhough is very real, and since your name is on the product, it is clear thhhhat it is your creation! No self respecting scientist would let someone else to take credit for somethhhhing as marvelous as it. Ahem. Now thhhen, since it is clear you are a crew of competitive IQ - I shan't have any qualms in joining you. But don't disappoint me."

name: ALKALI_SURRENDER
text: "That is enough! You will hand over the target at once and you will leave this system! This is an order!"

event.name: SURRENDERED_ALKALI
event.text: You send over the Shell scientist to the Rebels, who collect him and carry him away. After this, you're certain they'll alert the fleet of your location. Let's hope that still gives you enough time to leave...

name: ALKALI_LEGION
text: As you begin to depart from the station, a Rebel ship jumps in, but it's not like any Rebel design you remember in your debriefing. Renegades, Elites, MFK Aces, Engineers, none of them bear that logo... A yellow helmet, with the word Legion on it, stands out to you. Is this some new Rebel fleet?

event.text: You receive a hail from the Rebel vessel. "Federation. Under any other occasion, I would not hesitate to destroy you. However, we are here on important business. Hand over the scientist, and you will be permitted to leave. Fail to do so, and we will pull him from the hands of your mangled corpses. Attempting to leave this beacon without handing over the target will be met with failure. We have already disabled your long range FTL drive."

"Then you leave us no choice. Do not worry. You won't live long enough to regret this decision." True to their word, it appears your FTL drive has been sabotaged! Your engines will still function, but you won't be able to jump until the Rebels are dead!

Alkali protests, but he isn't going to argue with the barrel of a gun to his forehead. The Rebels board your ship in a concerningly large number, injecting a tranquilizer into Alkali and carting him off. You expect them to turn on you, but nothing happens. Instead, the Rebels head back to their ship and jump away, leaving you dumbfounded.

name: ALKALI_LEGION_DEFEATED
text: The Rebel vessel has been defeated, leaving behind plenty of scrap matter and an unusually high-tech weapon. Surprisingly, you still detect faint life signs aboard the wreck as you scrap it...

event.text: You move closer, tearing open the cargo bay to find a wounded Rebel soldier. As soon as you approach he panics, reaching for a sharp piece of metal, and plunges it deep into his chest. An act of suicide, likely trying to stop you from getting information... but on what?

Seems most of the data on the ship was purged during the fight - a strange practice, but it seems they knew their fate before the fight had even begun. Whatever this ship was, it was under very clear orders not to let anything leak. Maybe this won't be the last time you see a ship like this, though that's very uncertain.

surrender.text: "Ok, ok! I've changed my mind! You can take us alive!"

choice.text: Demand they explain what's going on.

event.text: "We uh... were offered a lot of money by thhhhe Rebels to transfer over some blueprints, cargo, and Morph DNA. Like, a lot of money. Don't look at me like that! Had you been offered the same, you would have done it too!"

"Please don't use thhhe term 'alien'. To us, YOU are thhhe aliens. But... yes, thhhey aren't thhhe kindest folk. But rich as hell! Thhhhey aren't above a basic buyout, easier thhhan raiding an entire sector. Unfortunately... now you're here. And our payment never showed up..."

choice.text: Demand they give you the cargo instead. If the Rebels have use for it, so does the Federation.

event.text: "What?! But what about our money!" You flip a switch to power back on your weapons, and the Shell gulps in anticipation. "Ah... right. Alright fine. I'm so fired for thhhis... Well, I was going to be fired for thhhis anyways. But you get thhhe point. It's like being 'double fired'."

name: NEXUS_PORTAL
text: The coordinates you found in Sylvan's secret room lead to a seemingly unremarkable stretch of space. You detect a couple anomalous signals but your preliminary scans can't lock onto anything.

choice.text: (Anomaly Detector) Your scanners are showing all kinds of strange results.

event.text: Your advanced scanners lock onto a strange anomaly some distance away. You track it down and soon find yourself in the atmosphere of a vast ocean planet facing a giant rift. For a few moments you can bring yourself to do nothing other than stare in awe until you snap back to reality and take notice of the even more unusual patterns of this particular rift. It's unusually stable, and if you didn't know better you'd almost say it's man-made...

choice.text: Guess there was no point to coming here.

event.text: As disappointing as it is, you can't discern any reason for having come here. Guess this was just a waste of time. Or maybe there was something more that you just couldn't find...

name: NEXUS_PORTAL_2
text: In the distance you can make out a ship flying towards you, and you quickly realize it's Sylvan! "Ssstranger, you ssshould not be here... How did you find thisss place? Oh, it doesss not matter. But you mussst not ssstay here ssstranger. It isss dangerousss!"

event.text: "Thisss isss not a good time for quessstionsss, ssstranger. You mussssn't go any clossser. I wissssh I could explain ssstranger, but thisss isss very ssserious. Thissss isss my final warning. Turn back or I'll have no choice but to make you, sssstranger..."

choice.text: We aren't leaving until we find out what this is.

event.text: "Then I'm afraid you give me no choice, ssstranger..."

choice.text: We aren't leaving until we find out what this is.

event.text: "Sssmart choice ssstranger. There'sss more important thingsss to be doing anywaysss..."
"Sssmart choice ssstranger. There'sss more important thingsss to be doing anywaysss..."

name: NEXUS_PORTAL_SPARE
text: It seems you're on your last legs. You won't survive much longer, but Sylvan stops firing for a moment and hails you. "I don't wisssh to kill you ssstranger. Leave, and we can forget about thissss..."

event.name: SURRENDERED_TO_SYLVAN
event.text: Sylvan powers down his weapons for good and takes one last look at you, guilt all over his face, and slips away into the distance.
"Ssstubborn to the end, ssstranger. I sssee how it isss..."

name: NEXUS_PORTAL_SURRENDER
text: It seems Sylvan is on the brink of destruction. You aren't sure if you really want to kill him.

event.name: SYLVAN_SURRENDERED
event.text: "It... it ssseemssss I have failed, ssstranger. I could not sssave you from yourssself. Oh well... I guessss you have earned what issss on the other end of that rift. But I hope you underssstand ssstranger that... well... you probably won't make it out the other ssside. There are rulesss, ssstranger. They won't like you breaking them." With that ominous note, Sylvan simply jumps away. You notice a lot of debris left from the fight and collect what you can.

name: SYLVAN_CREWKILL_NEXUSPORTAL
text: It seems as though this is the end of Sylvan, but suddenly a teleporter signal registers - you've been boarded, again? Sylvan reappears on your deck. "Sssstranger, it'ssss not sssso eassssy to get rid of me!"

event.text: As if that wasn't enough, even more Slugs beam aboard! Where are these guys coming from?

name: SYLVAN_DESTRUCTION_2_NEXUS
text: Though a strong layer of Slug sealant keeps the ship together as it begins to break, eventually it gives away under the stress and the ship explodes, scattering cargo containers across the system.

event.text: You scoop up the first cargo box, and empty out all of the scrap inside.
You open another cargo box, finding even more scrap.
You open another cargo box, finding a weapon and more supplies!
You open another cargo box, finding a drone among the supplies!
You open another cargo box, finding a ton of fuel and scrap inside.
You open another cargo box, finding a ton of missiles and scrap inside.
You open another cargo box, finding a ton of drone parts and scrap inside.
You open another cargo box, finding a brand new augment and some supplies inside!
You open another cargo box, finding even more supplies!
You open another cargo box, finding a ton of missiles!
You open another cargo box, finding a ton of drone parts!
You open another cargo box, finding even more scrap.
You open the final box and, to no surprise, you find even more scrap!

name: NEXUS_PORTAL_ENTER
text: There's only one choice left to be made here. This rift seems to be some kind of gateway, but do you really want to see what's on the other side?

event.text: As you begin to approach the rift, the space around you becomes progressively more warped, and soon not even your engines are able to control your ship as you're sucked at absurd speeds into the heart of the gateway...
It's a tough call, but your primary mission is too important to risk exploring ancient space anomalies.

name: SYLVAN_DESTRUCTION_NEXUS
text: Sylvan falls to his knees, bleeding profusely from a gash across his face. He manages to gasp out a few final words, "Ssstranger... I hope... thissss wasss worth it...", then falls over. Another Traveling Merchant is no more.

name: SYLVAN_NEXUS

visitedTooltip.text: Explored location. Nothing left of interest.

text: Yet another strange Sylvan awaits you here. They seem friendly enough and willing to trade.

event.text: "I ssssee you are in fact me, me. I'm afraid no dissscountsss though. There's an infinite me'sss and I can't go giving all of them free ssscrap!"
"Maybe a different time then, ssstranger! I'm certain thisss won't be the lassst we sssee each other, in thisss reality or another."

text: "Aaaaah. Ssstranger ssstranger, any ssself ressspecting Multiversssse traveler knowssss they need sssome gear if they're going to ssssurvive."

name: START_NEXUS
text: You pull yourself off the floor of your ship and glance out the window to try and place where you are in space and time. In the distance is another massive rift leading back to where you came from, slowly shrinking. This sudden disappearance should throw the Rebellion for quite a loop, but who knows if you'll make it out alive of whatever this is.

event.name: START_NEXUS_2
event.text: Once fully conscious you check the ship's vital systems but find everything has been shut down. A strangely colored Slug transport lingers nearby, and before you can react you hear a cough from behind you. You spin around to find a Slug dressed in an ironed suit and tie sitting at a makeshift folding table, holding a briefcase and a stack of papers. "Hello... ssstranger. Would you care to... have a ssseat?"

event.name: START_NEXUS_3
event.text:
You take a seat across from the Slug, who extends a tentacle towards you. "Greetingssss, Ssstranger. Under thessse circumssstances perhapssss it isss... irrelevant to make your acquaintance... but I like to be cordial. The name'ssss... G-Van. Unfortunately, thissss iss not jussst a ssssimple... meet and greet. I have sssome quessstionsss I would like to... asssk you."
					
					The Slug flips through his papers, pulls out a pen, and looks back up at you. "Now then... who issss it that sssent you?"

choice.text: We were sent by no one.

event.text: "You expect me to... believe that? We have... placed consssiderable sssecurity measssuresss around thisss place, and I doubt sssomething like yourssself could have... made itsss way in alone. I would... appreciate more cooperation from you, ssstranger..."

event.name: START_NEXUS_4
event.text: "Did your Sylvan... put you up to thissss, ssstranger? Or did they attempt to... ssstop you? It isss very important we understand what... hands we left your reality in."
"Oh... I ssssee now. Ssso you really don't know... where you are. Oh... oh my. You poor creature... Well, I wissssh no cruelty upon you, ssstranger. Would you like an... explanation?"

G-Van shuffles his papers around and slips out a cartooney infographic, labeling various points on what is presumably the Multiverse. "Currently, sssstranger, you will find yourssself to be within what we call... the "Nexussss". Thisss isss the functional... center of the Multiversssse. Long ago, the Ssssylvansss of the Multiverssse disscovered thisss place thanksss to the help of our... leader, Ssssylvan Prime. At firssst we essstablished merely a... trade alliance, but sssoon when we realized the threatssss held within the Multiverssse it became clear it would be our... resssponssibility to protect it as well."
													
													"To protect the Multiverssse from sssaid threatsss, we founded the C.E.L. - That isss... the Continuity Enforcement League. Unfortunately for you, sssstranger, part of the C.E.L.'sss sssacred... creed issss that we cannot allow anyone elssse to enter or leave the Nexussss... Which meansss, unfortunately, my only option now isss to... eliminate you."

event.name: START_NEXUS_5
event.text: "I'm afraid I... am not authorized to accept any pleasss for mercy from you. Pleassse, ssstranger, do not make this any... harder for me than it already issss." You rush to your battle stations but find your systems are still limited. Like this you'll hardly stand much of a chance!

Irwin seems dumbfounded for a moment, dropping his blunderbuss and stretching his eyestalks with his tentacles. "Oh my god. Holy ssshit. Holy actual ssshit. I WASSSS RIGHT! I WASSS RIGHT THISSS ENTIRE TIME! THEY CALLED ME A LUNATIC, ABSSSOLUTELY OUT OF MY MIND! And yet here we are! Even more, it'sss YOU! SSSYLVAN! You ssslimy traitorous asssshole. 															G-Van seems utterly confused at this outburst. "Uh... I'm afraid I don't know who you... are...?"
															Irwin nods. "Oh, but you will. You will know exactly who I am after thissss." Irwin picks up his blunderbuss and brandishes it, ready to use it to obliterate any Sylvan in his path. With no other options left, you get ready to fight. Unfortunately, your systems are still offline, and you aren't sure how much of a chance you'll stand despite your crew's... "enthusiasm".

"Very well then. I ssshall get right to busssinesss then. By dictate of our divine leader, Ssssylvan Prime, the mossst sssacred rule of our creed isss that no one besssidesss ourssselvesss may ever enter or leave thisss place. Thusss... I'm afraid I will now have to... eliminate you."

choice.text: We were led to this place by a weird Auto-ship.

event.text: G-Van looks up at you, mildly confused. "A... what? I do not... underssstand what you mean. Like... a probe? Or... oh, nevermind. The Multiverssse isss... infinite, there could be ssso many... explanationsss anywayssss."

choice.text: Thest told us how to get here.

event.text: G-Van frowns. "Unfortunate... I did not think the Zoltan would... betray usss. I do not... wisssh to sssee harm come to any of them, but I cannot let thisss go... unreported either. event.text: "The... the what? Ssstranger, what the hell have you done? You have brought that... thing here! If thissss isss what I believe it to be, thisss isss an... immediate containment crisssisss."

name: NEXUS_ENTER_GLITCH_CONTINUE
text: To your surprise, your systems suddenly return back to normal! You aren't sure what caused it, but you don't have time to worry about it. It seems G-Van is confused by it as well, but now that you're a more considerable threat, it looks like he's going to have to step up his game!

name: GUARD_NEXUS_AI
text: It seems killing G-Van and his crew wasn't enough - the ship has some kind of secondary AI mode and is still in the fight!

name: GUARD_NEXUS_DEFEAT
text: G-Van has been defeated. While his reluctance to fight you might have given an out to spare him, you make your decision resolute. With nothing else stopping your way deeper into the Nexus, you scrap his ship and prepare yourself mentally for whatever comes next.

name: NEXUS_GUARD_SURRENDER
text: G-Van's ship isn't holding up well. You notice his resolve in fighting you has dropped considerably, and if you wished you could likely spare him.

event.text: "Ssso... here I am then, ssstranger. At the... mercy of an interloper I wassss sssupposssed to kill. Why... ssspare me? Do you have any idea the thingsss I've done, ssstranger? The thingsss we've done? If you don't now... then you will. You'll wisssh you never... met a Sssylvan. Ssso... if you want my advice, ssstranger. Run for the exit. Don't ssscrew with Prime. Maybe... maybe he'll cut you a... deal, ssstranger."

choice.text: We've handled worse. Whatever Prime throws at us, we can take.

event.text:
G-Van shakes his head, moaning as he rests his eyestalks on his tentacles. "No, ssstranger, you don't ssstand a chance againssst Prime. Do you realize... what it isss you're ssssaying? A lowly mortal... Renegade, againssst the one who rulesss of all Existence? Don't be a... fool, ssstranger. If Prime could be toppled, then we would have... done sssso already."

"You will ssssee... sssoon enough. If I am correct, at leassst... Leave me here... I mussst face my fate alone."

choice.text: You can face your fate after you help us.

event.text: G-Van attempts to protest, but you dock with his ship and drag him aboard. Too weak to fight against you, he finally gives in and cooperates. "Fine... if I am to die to... Prime either way, then I will not die a... coward..."
G-Van ship, left a wreck, will presumably be recovered by his accomplices eventually. What his fate will be at the hands of Prime is uncertain, but you have other things to worry about first.

text: Having been directed here as the supposed location of Sylvan Prime, you find yourself face to face with nothing but the starry abyss. It dawns upon you that, should you choose this moment to leave, there's likely no turning back. If you want to explore the Nexus further, here's your chance.

choice.text: You feel as though you should keep exploring.

name: TEST_FIGHT_PRIME
text: Fight.

name: SYLVAN_PRIME_MEET
text: Suddenly, behind you appears a massive cruiser vessel, bigger and perhaps better armed than any ship you've ever seen before. A large compartment opens to reveal a docking port, and it seems obvious you should dock. That is, unless you'd like to be annihilated on the spot for refusing this hospitality.

event.text: As you exit your ship, you find yourself in a brightly lit lobby full of glistening marble fountains and gigantic statues. Three armored Slugs approach and bow to you. While we are certain you will comply, it is my advice that you do not face the impending vaporization of attempting to flee."

An angelic choir fills the room as a compartment opens above you, and from the blinding white space above two rings descend in your direction. You watch in awe as a Slug is revealed between them, arms outstretched, a majestic light cast upon him. Still hovering above you, he claps, and the guards leave the room.

What do you think of it all? If you've done your homework, by now sssurely you've gathered what it isss we do here. I already underssstand that I have been betrayed by multiple cooperatives of mine. But what do YOU think?"

A mysterious entity invaded Prime's home cluster, and nearly triggered an event we refer to as R-Day. And so, the C.E.L. was born. To handle threats like that! event.text: "What is going on?" The Renegade exclaimed out loud, almost driven to madness by the absurdity of what they were experiencing. But, little did they know, the answer was quite simple. Before them was an omnipotent entity known the Narrator, or as some might call them, Narrator Sylvan. The Narrator, of course, had no physical presence besides his ship, but he was never quite as excited as he was now to finally meet the Renegade "face" to face.

Why yes, yes I am! Oh so many stories we've told together! How much fun we've had! And look at you now, all grown up and in the big scary Nexus. Bet you didn't expect this twist, huh? Why, I've been narrating things for an awful long time now. I make mistakes, of course. Lot's of tpyos, and all that. But oh golly if it wasn't worth it just for this moment! Prime says it's to keep track of the movement of potential threats and anomalies, but I just do it for the love of the craft!

SSSHUT THE HELL UP AND LISSSTEN TO ME GOD DAMN IT!" The room falls quiet as everyone turns to look at the Slug, who is now drinking from the bottle. "Hello everyone, Normal Ssssylvan here! Today I'll be presssenting the weekly S.I.L.V.A.N. addresssss. Like I alwaysss do, sssince I founded thisss organization." Normal Sylvan coughs and looks at a note card in his hand. "Unfortunately, Sssylvan from the reality where Sssylvan doesssn't exissst could not make it today. However, it ssseemsss we have sssome newcommersss!"
					
					It takes you a moment to realize Normal Sylvan is referring to you. "You, weird people in the back. Why don't you introduce yourssselvess and the uh... reality you come from. Make sssure you explain it nice and ssslow ssso everyone can underssstand it from their posssition in the plane of exissstence. Sssome people are alssso jussst ssstupid."

"Ssso you're from the reality where Sssylvan issss a moron. Got it. Now ssshut up and sssit down." Normal Sylvan claps, and a Sylvan dressed like a waiter appears, carrying a tray of apple slices. "Alright everyone, thankfully Child Ssssylvan'sss mother hasss prepared usss all complementary sssliced applesss to proceed the meeting with."
							A Sylvan in the back raises his hand, and Normal Sylvan groans. "Yessss, Apple Sssylvan, we prepared sssliced Ssslugsss for you to eat inssstead."
							
							"Now then, firssst order of busssinesss. We have identified the emergence of a new cataclysssm, one which the C.E.L.'s negligence hasss overlooked. Giant sssentient pea-podsss have taken over Reality-6783!"
							
							One of the Sylvans in the front of the room coughs, which seems to anger Normal Sylvan heavily. "Did I ASSSSK for your opinion, Ssssylvan from the reality where everyone isss a giant sssentient pea-pod? Your reality is weird asss hell, hah! Peas are grossss. And people don't even ssspontaneously catch fire when they sssay 'hypnotize'- AAAAAAAH!" Normal Sylvan spontaneously catches fire and falls off the stage, prompting chaos to break out in the room. We sstarted thessse becausssse we felt Prime wasssn't acknowledging our cluster'sss ssstake in thisss empire, but honessstly? Prime isssn't that bad. He doesssn't yell at usss, we live comfortably and he keepsss the Multiverssse ssafe!"
							The other Sylvans break out into furious debate with each other, throwing things across the room. 									"Beyatchesss, I bet you wisssh you had let me join NOW huh?! Too lame for S.I.L.V.A.N., huh? Well your acronym sssucksss! Well now you've met your match, Normal Ssssylvan! Mwahaha! It isss I, Syleah, the Traveling Beam Merchant!"

I Free Mantis Sylvan from other reality, and I am doing the big trades! You wanting to do the trade, stranger?"
"What!? What are you saying? How could you being so mean?" When the other Sylvans start to chime in, Free Mantis 'Sylvan' begins to cry and raises his weapons!
You can't bring yourself to break the truth to this guy. Unfortunately, the other Sylvans don't take kindly to this. Realizing you won't help them, they turn hostile!

text: As soon as you arrive at the beacon you find your engines have been limited to almost nothing. On the screen appears Obyn, quite curious since you haven't seen many of his variants around, but unfortunately this doesn't seem to be a friendly encounter.

event.text: "Nyeheheheheh! I've caught you at last! Now, you will solve my... puzzles!" You're confused, but you receive a second hail from the same ship, and Sylvan appears on the screen. "Hey there Ssstranger. Look, jussst try and entertain my Obyn, will you? He doesssn't get to interact with outsssidersss often. It'll mean the world to him."
"Wonderful! I, the GREAT Obyn, challenge you, to a duel of.... crossword!" Obyn beams over to your ship and hands you a crossword puzzle. It takes you a few moments, but you complete it easily.
"Nyehehe- wait. All of these are correct? Did you cheat? Fine, then onto the next puzzle! I challenge you to a game of... rock, paper, scissors!"
You play several matches of rock paper scissors, in which Obyn loses every single one. "No fair! I challenge you to a rematch! The great Obyn will not lose to a Renegade!"
Obyn wins a few games this time but you consistently manage to outmatch him. Eventually he grows tired. "Hmhp, fine! Rock Paper Scissors is luck anyways! I now challenge you to a game of... trivia!"
"Who... is the Admiral of the Rebellion?"
"You are... correct! Bah! Next question! What is... the name of the Kestrel?"
"You are... correct... again! Bah! Next question! What is... the main function of Tiiikaka?"
"You are... correct... again! You're too good at this! What is... the relation between the Theocracy and Federation?"
"You're cheating! You must be! No one can be this good! I don't even know the answers to half of these! Nyeheheheh, here's a tricky one! Who developed the CICA AI?"
"NOOOOO! I cannot believe it! You are truly a trivia and puzzle master! I resign to you! I am no longer worthy of being the Great Obyn!"

Sylvan seems impressed. "Heheh, good job ssstranger. Unfortunately, I can't jusssst let my Obyn leave me behind, sssso I guesss I'll come crasssh with you asss well. Make sure you don't pull any funny busssinessss."

name: START_BEACON_ANCIENT
text: You pull yourself off the floor, in a daze. The ship cameras show most of the other crew doing the same, waking from their slumber. The only one who seems unfazed is Aenwithe, who hastens to check on you. "We've made it okay, but now we have a few things to be careful of. Though I doubt the Rebels will be able to follow us for now, they will catch up eventually if they truly are tracking you as you suspect. Additionally, it is very likely that this sector is protected by a guard ship. If so, I doubt they'll let us through unharmed."

event.text: As warned, there appears to be an Obelisk Guard here. As soon as your ship moves within proximity of it, the ship lights up and its weapons activate.

choice.text: Hail them, maybe you can get through this without conflict?

event.text: "Flesh beings, you dare enter our divine plane? This place is not meant for creatures of blood and mortal soul! Your extermination shall be swift yet merciless. May you pests be ridden of from this galaxy!" Well, so much for nonviolence, get ready for a one hell of a fight!

name: GUARD_ANCIENT_DESTROY
text: You have defeated the Obelisk guard. Whatever might have been in their cargo has for certain been destroyed, but you can at least salvage some supplies from the ship.

name: GUARD_ANCIENT_DEADCREW
text: You have defeated the Obelisk guard. Without crew on board to stop you, you can investigate their cargo. You find a weapon to bring back to the ship, and move on to scrap their hull.

name: FLEET_ROYAL_SELITE
text: It appears Vance's fleet has caught up to you at last. An MFK Ace ship moves forward, brandishing its weapons and ready to kill.

choice.text: (Adv. Engines) Try to escape the elite.

name: START_BEACON_ROYAL
text: This time, you found yourself at least leaning against a wall. Most of the other crew did better as well, and as always Aenwithe is completely unfazed. "We're here. Fortunately, the resistance has managed to take out the guard already and blockade the sector. Now, let's get this bomb built."

event.text: You dock with one of the nearby Obelisk ships, which Aenwithe assures you has been captured by his people already. You're introduced to several other Obelisks who look identical to each other with various names you cannot pronounce. Aenwithe looks around, as if looking for someone, but cannot seem to find them.

Aenwithe ignores you, but talks to one of the other Obelisks. "Where is E?" The Obelisk responds, "She was taken by the Queen. The Royals heard of her betrayal, and there was little we could do. Their Dreadnaught is back online..."

choice.text: Who is E? And there's a second Dreadnaught?

name: ROYAL_MFK_ARRIVAL
text: Aenwithe pauses, and you assume he would have sighed had he had lungs. "E is the princess of the Obelisk Royals. Don't mind the single letter name, that's just how the Royals name themselves. For simplicity, I guess. Or maybe the memes? Anyways, doesn't matter. E is the only Royal amongst our resistance, and the only person who can build the bomb. But now she's been taken. Even worse, the Royals do in fact have an even stronger Dreadnaught, protecting Liythkyk Yuk, their capital."

event.text: Suddenly, an alarm in the fleet ship goes off. A squadron of MFK fleet ships jump in, immediately opening fire on the Obelisks. Aenwithe curses, "Damn it, the Rebels got through! It was only a matter of time. We need to evacuate immediately! We'll regroup at the palace and rescue E, finish this bomb, then purge this entire sector to its core!"
As you're leaving, an MFK Gunboat Ace stops you. "You're that... that Multiverse Renegade that led us here! You die today, Federation scum!"

name: ROYAL_MFK_DEFEAT
text: You receive one last message from the Rebel captain as the ship dies, "God... damn you. You might survive today, but Vance will catch you soon enough, and he'll make your lives hell..." With the ship neutralized, you scrap the remains.

event.text: With the Gunboat out of the way, there doesn't appear to be any other ships around that aren't already occupied and able to fight you. In this short grace period, Aenwithe speaks again, "Good, we must hurry to Liythkyk Yuk and rescue E. Be careful, now we don't only have the Royals to deal with, but the Rebels too."

text: You have arrived at the cache. You can see the Dreadnaught looming in the distance, though it is too far away to make out its features. As expected, it would be impossible to access the cache, which resembles a gigantic vault sculpted into the side of a planet, without eliminating the ship.

event.text: Aenwithe observes the Dreadnaught, seemingly unafraid. "Big ship. But still nothing compared to the ones you'll see in the Homeworlds. Let this be a test to see if we're ready for what's to come. Worst case, we die. No big deal."
You power up your weapons and move in to destroy the ship. Its shadow blocks out the light through your windows as it descends upon you, ready to reduce you to dust.

name: ANCSECTOR_DREAD_AI
text: All of the crew aboard the Dreadnaught are dead, but the ship keeps fighting. There must be some sort of AI mode attached to it!

name: ANCSECTOR_PART_4
text: "You've done it. The Dreadnaught is dead! This is beyond incredible. You flimsy mortal creatures may not be so pathetic after all. All that's left is to grab the parts and destroy the Cache." You promise to do so, but scrap the Dreadnaught first.

event.text: It takes a few tries to get the vault door open, but once you manage to bust a hole in the side, a brilliant light shines through. Inside is a gigantic cavern, filled with ships, repair drones, weapons, and supplies. A few things catch your eye, including the largest ship present, a Cruiser you suspect.

You set up many explosives around the vault to explode all at once, and exit as fast as possible. You put a safe distance between yourself and the cache, and watch the fireworks. If you can defeat the Flagship as well, you'll have saved reality twice!

name: VAULT_DESTROYED
text: As you're preparing to leave, a squadron of Obelisk ships approaches, drawn in by the explosion. They're led by a Royal ship, whose captain hails you. "You... You have destroyed the cache. You filthy mortal insect, you will suffer for this!" You shrug, and flick the weapons in their direction. None of the Obelisk squadron dares mess with the ship that killed the Dreadnaught, and so they quickly jump away, presumably to the homeworlds to spread the news of your approach.

event.text: Aenwithe is very pleased. "Do not worry about the fleet, the Homeworlds are already on high alert anyways. We must move quickly, we need to head to our base and construct the bomb! We will head to the Homeworlds directly. Grab hold of something again, and try not to black out."

text: You have arrived at Liythkyk Yuk. Below your ship is a vast cityscape with massive cruisers moving back and forth. It's so green... probably too green. But that doesn't matter, hopefully you won't be here too long.

event.text: You pilot closer to the surface, and for a brief moment you almost think you can get through this without a fight. However, any hopes of this are immediately dashed when the Royal Dreadnaught Aenwithe mentioned appears from the sky, moving closer with clear intent to kill. "Mortal invaders! Your filth shall be purged from our realm!" Looks like it's time for one more battle, and hopefully the last you'll ever have.

name: ROYAL_PALACE_SUCCESS
text: As the Dreadnaught comes crashing down into the Royal Palace, you can't help but think to yourself how nice it would be to never see one of these damn Obelisks ever again. You dismount from the ship followed by Aenwithe, who stops and says "Well, best get out your reading glasses if you need them, there's a lot of text ahead." You aren't sure what that really means, but it is probably good advice to heed.

event.text: You consider not bothering to scrap the Dreadnaught, but that's just not how you do things. With the Dreadnaught destroyed, you should have some time to clear out any remaining intruders then make your way to the palace.

name: ROYAL_PALACE_ENTER
text: Not a single ship bothers you as you walk into the palace. An advanced Cognitive shouts as you enter, "Hey! You can't be in her-" but you promptly silence it with a single shot. You'd be fine without seeing any more Cognitives either, quite frankly. You continue your way through the palace.

event.text: Once you've made it to the Royal Chambers, you look to Aenwithe for directions. "Yes yes, to the right we go." You follow him into E's chambers, where you find an Obelisk Royal studying several blueprints on holographic screens floating around the room. "So, you finally showed up? About time. And do be careful, the Obelisk Queen is behind you."

You spin around to see the Obelisk Queen, with 2 Atomizer drones on either side, facing you. "You've come this far, just to build this damn bomb of yours? You mortals really have a lot of dedication. I'd almost admire it, but that would mean I'd have to actually LIKE something about you. Anyways, now I'm going to kill you, so I hope this was all worth it in the end."

choice.text: Threaten to detonate the Paragon right now.

event.text: "What? That bomb isn't even armed! You think I'm stupid? Now, no more delays, you're going to di-" The Queen doesn't get time to finish, because a missile flies into the wall, destroying the side and sending everyone in the room backwards from the shockwave. The Paragon spins and slides towards the hole, where you can see the outline of what appears to be... another Flagship?!

The stocky build of a muscular and imposing man with two heavy duty blasters holstered at his hip materializes, presumably from a teleporter aboard the Flagship. You recognize him almost immediately as Admiral Vance of the Rebel fleet himself, with a smug grin on his face. "What's this about a bomb?" Vance bends over and picks up the Paragon. "I have to say, you've done me a great service putting this thing together. Sure, it's not complete just yet, but I have confidence with some scans we can figure it out."

Vance paces the room, one hand gripping the bomb and the other reaching for his gun. "For years now, I have been searching for this damned thing. When my men first uncovered the Multiverse Drive, we didn't yet understand the scale of the cosmic goose chase we'd be stuck in for... well probably a good century or so by now! At least, from my perspective. Micro-cloning and stasis sleep can keep you ticking for years, but you better not be a vain person, because aging has its... effects. It certainly has on me."

"Now then, enough monologuing." Vance quickly draws his gun and shoots the Obelisk Queen thrice, each shot piercing her chassis and disabling her completely. "There, the Queen is dead, and the Royals will fall. This bomb has a special date with an old friend of mine, so if you don't mind, I shall take my leave. Glory to the Rebellion." Vance salutes then warps away back to the Flagship, which slowly makes its ascent from the planet.

You quickly regroup with your crew, whose newest member now includes E herself, back at your ship. What's most worrying isn't Vance's sudden arrival, but what he said. If he knows what the Paragon is, then it's presumable he'll know how to construct and detonate it too. Even worse, as you watch the Flagship jump away, an advanced analysis of his MV drive shows he has one particular reality in mind - Universe 0, the first reality and home to the Federation's Multiverse fleet. If Vance can get there, he can wipe out that entire reality, damning the entire Federation across all realities!

There's no other choice left. You must pursue Vance while you can, and put a stop to him before he can fulfill his master plans. You set your FTL drive to the same trajectory as him, and get ready for one hell of a fight.

name: ANCIENT_DUPLICATOR
text: At first you think this is just a regular beacon, until you notice the giant moon sized machine built here. You spot a hangar area for ships to dock, though it appears empty.

event.text: The protective shield around the hangar lowers automatically as you approach, then seals once again when you're inside. You step outside your ship only to realize something very strange. The room is filled with oxygen, something uncharacteristic for Obelisk structures.
An automated language speaks to you. "Hello travelers. Welcome to the Quantum Item Replicator. Please insert items you wish to duplicate into the slot on the wall to your left."
You push 5 fuel cells into the slot and wait.
You push 5 missiles into the slot and wait.
You push 5 drone parts into the slot and wait.

choice.text: (Phantom Crew) Your Ghost eagerly begs to be put into the machine.

event.text: You shrug and force the Ghost into the machine. It doesn't protest as it slips into the tiny slot and falls down a large hole into the pits of the machine.

After a little while a strange noise can be heard coming from the second, much larger hole to your right. Your Ghost pops back out, followed by a second larger Ghost. The two Ghosts seem overly excited, and you decide not to ask what happened inside the machine.
