You have no idea who this Leech is or why Tyrdeo wants him dead, but hell if you don't enjoy some senseless murder.

choice.text: Ignore the ship and carry on your way.

name: TYRDEO_PALACE

unvisitedTooltip.text: Location of President Tyrdeo's mansion.

visitedTooltip.text: Explored location. Nothing left of interest.

text: This is the location Alkram described for certain - it's impossible to mistake the giant palace with its blinding beacon of light. With how run down the rest of Leech space is, it seems impossible something so well constructed could be here, but then again if it wasn't maybe the place wouldn't be the way it is.

event.text: A fleet of revolutionary vessels have gathered around the palace, matched in equal force by the few remaining Eargen loyalists, as well as Inquisition and Coalition vessels. No one's managed to breach the mansion's security, and you can see why. A massive Ampere Dreadnaught protects the barrier around the structure, and it's no small threat. When you hear the stories of ancient massive Leech vessels, this is what they're talking about.
The massive war vessel lurches towards you as you approach. Time to put the myths to the test.
Liberty and all that jazz is cool, but you'd rather live to see tomorrow than die supporting a conflict you have no personal stake in.

name: TYRDEO_PALACE_ENTER
text: With the Dreadnaught downed, the barrier falls in a matter of minutes and revolutionaries swarm the palace grounds. In the heat of the conflict you manage to slip past the rest of the defenses and enter the mansion.

event.text: Few guards remain inside, all occupied handling the invaders on the exterior. You manage to break your way into Tyrdeo's bedchambers where you see the sickly purple worm nervously watching the conflict from his window. This is Tyrdeo.

The Leech turns around, frightened. His wavering voice is surprisingly soft, like a child rather than a dictator. "Oh heavens! Please, have mercy. Oh dear oh dear. What have I done? Has it really come to this? A foreign hitman breaking down my door, cutting my head off upon my own bed? Please, do it quick, and don't hurt my Wealsey." Tyrdeo points with one of his tongues to a cage in the corner of the room with contains a large, bright yellow avian creature, who chirps cheerfully despite the dire mood of the room.

choice.text: We aren't hitmen - you'll answer for your crimes in front of your people.

event.text: "No-no please! Please! I don't care if you kill me, but if you hand me over to them you have no idea what they're going to do to me! They'll hack me into bits like Oertiss, or cut my tongue off and strangle me with it like Aerkae! Just shoot me, please!" Tyrdeo crumples to the ground, sobbing uncontrollably. You sling him over your shoulder and haul him over to Alkram, who has arrived at the palace as well and thanks you. "We found a cruiser in one of the hangars, seems to have been Tyrdeo's private cruiser and his escape plan. He has no use for it anymore, so we'll give it to the Federation as a gift."

Tyrdeo is dragged out to the courtyard where you see most of the fighting has already stopped. Seeing the president captured, the last of the loyalists surrender. Tyrdeo is strung up in front of the crowd of jeering Leeches as he continues to sob. Even some of the Coalition and Inquisition officers join in. Tyrdeo pleads, "Heavens, is this really necessary? You were the ones that put me in charge, I only tried to help!" Tyrdeo lets out a giant sob. "I know it was stupid to give the Vampweeds flowers, but I was only trying to make friends! Joining the Coalition seemed the best way to stabilize the nation! What was I to do? I was a landscaper before this! And a bad one! Why did you put me in charge?!"

Alkram cuts Tyrdeo off and stands before the crowd. "Enough of your crying. Be a man. I faced down Engi war machines and Zoltan peacekeepers in that war, while you were busy trimming hedges! You had your chance, but it's time the Eargen Republic had a competent leader for once!" The crowd joins in, chanting and practically drooling at the mouth for the prospect of killing the former President. In one final effort, Tyrdeo turns to you, pleading. "Please, I know I made mistakes, I know the Coalition is your enemy, but you can't let them do this! I don't want to be president anymore, I never did! I just want to live!"

choice.text: You had your chance. You get what's coming to you.

event.text: Tyrdeo squeals in fear as his fate is sealed. He is cut free and flung into the crowd, where he is torn to shreds by his former disciples. A gruesome end beyond all doubt. Alkram watches in what you assume is disgust. Ironic considering he played the hand of fate there, but perhaps he's envisioning himself in that position if he screws up himself.

With Tyrdeo dead, the remaining Coalition and Inquisition forces flee, leaving only you and the Leeches. Alkram begins to make a speech, "For too long the Republic has been stifled by incompetency. It's time a TRUE leader takes the crown, and I could think of no one better than mysel-" Alkram is cut off by the crowd, who begins to boo again. Seems the Leeches have finally caught onto their situation. Cycles and cycles of the same thing over and over, and they're done with it. Alkram backs down, terrified that he's about to meet the same fate.

"Uh, did I say myself? Sorry, I didn't mean that. What I meant to say was that I think it's time the Republic finally elect a president for the first time since it was founded! But I'm afraid I musn't take part. I've gotten old. It's time I retire. Goodbye." Alkram slithers off the stage over to you. "This has been a disaster. But I've done my part. At least the Republic might finally see better days. Are you in need of a fighter? I have gotten older, but I'm still more than competent."

choice.text: This seems a bit excessive. Maybe he doesn't deserve this?

event.text: Tyrdeo lets out a cheer while the crowd boos your opinion. Gravely, Alkram says, "There is no second chance for a man like this. I've killed for less. In order to succeed on the throne, I must kill this miserable sob. All great revolutions end with the death of a king."

choice.text: Throne? So you're going to be king after him?

event.text: Alkram blinks, realizing his poor choice of words, but it's too late. The crowd takes notice and soon their hostility turns towards him. "You're no better than Tyrdeo! You're just another corrupt, power hungry wannabe trying to seize power through force!" cries one angry bystander, and the rest agree. Soon the mob has swarmed Alkram and things turn bloody. In the chaos, Tyrdeo breaks free and rushes over to you. "I might faint. I haven't been this terrified in all my life. I've soiled myself! Oh wait, sorry, you didn't need to know that. Anyways - please, take me with you! I can do more than trim hedges, I promise!" You agree, but before you can make it back to the ship, Tyrdeo ducks back into his palace and returns with his bird which he loads into the cargo. What a strange, strange man.

You shoot Tyrdeo once in the head, instantly killing him. Moments later, Alkram and his men storm into the room but are shocked to see the president already dead. "W-what? You killed him? Already? What the hell? Your enthusiasm on this has only complicated the process further." Alkram growls, clearly annoyed. "It falls on me now to fix this. Wonderful. I'll have my men give you a reward for this, but don't expect any future favors."

name: LEECH_INQUISITIONER
text: The bright red hull of an unusual Rock vessel approaches. This is no ordinary Inquisition vessel, but rather a Paladin. The Paladins are rarely seen outside of their home in the Numa V system, so this can't be good.

choice.text: Wait and see what it'll do.

event.text: To your surprise, the ship merely hails instead of opening fire. "I... am Inquisitor Gora. Don't tell me your name... I do not care. I have a proposition for you. I know we are not friends, thankfully... but I believe we could strike a mutually beneficial arrangement..."

"I have been sent here by the Theocracy to.. handle the situation with General Alkram's revolution. Personally I do not... care for the Leeches, but I know better than to question my... leaders. My men have discovered the location of a cache where a prototype vessel is being kept. Destroy it and... the revolutionaries will struggle against my forces. In return, you may take with you any weaponry in the cache that you can carry alongside the blueprints of the cruiser. How does this... sound?"
"Good... good... I will send over the... coordinates immediately." With that, the vessel jumps away.
"Surely you are not planning to go through with this?" Alkram studies you. "...I have a counterproposal, if you will listen."

"If we go there, we can make a feint. My allies will pretend to be destroyed. As the Paladins approach, we will spring an ambush on them, flanking them and rendering the threat they pose non-existent. There will be much scrap, and we will even reward you. Consider it."
"Alkram is right. We have the perfect opportunity to destroy an enemy and cultivate an allegiance. I wholeheartedly throw my support behind this plan."

"This Paladin has foolishly given us the perfect opportunity to destroy them. When we enter their region, I can hail the Revolutionaries, and we can spring a trap. It is a much safer option than attacking them head on. They will regret attempting to control us."
"Then you are a waste of my time... I see no reason to keep you alive any longer."
"Then you are a waste of my time... I see no reason to keep you alive any longer."
There's no point in waiting for the inevitable, you better attack first and attack fast!
The ship seems too slow to follow even if it had noticed you, so you quickly slip away.

name: LEECH_INQUISITIONER_CACHE

unvisitedTooltip.text: Location of the Revolutionary cache.

visitedTooltip.text: Explored location. Nothing left of interest.

text: Upon arriving at the beacon, the location of the cache is not immediately apparent. The coordinates specify a location not far from here.

choice.text: (Alkram) Hail the revolutionaries to plan an ambush.

event.text: "Comrades! The Theocracy believes that this Renegade will deliver you into the Theocracy's iron fist. However, they have played right into our hands! We will feign victory over you, and lure the Theocracy's forces." The Leeches seems surprised at Alkram's presence, but they are no stranger to guerilla tactics.

choice.text: (Ariadne) Hail the revolutionaries to plan an ambush.

event.text: "I am Admiral Ariadne of the Lost Suns, and I have come with a proposition. The Theocracy knows of this cache, and have sent us to destroy you. However, we are not their puppets. We will help you destroy them if you will assist us in bringing them to ruin." The Leeches recognize the leader of the Lost Suns and after some discussion, agree to assist you.

name: APPROACH_REVOLUTIONARY_BASE
text: The scenery in front of you forces you to double check the coordinates, but this is definitely the right place. So much for a simple cache - this is an entire base of operations. Sculpted from what was once an abandoned mining colony, the Revolutionaries have set up several large warehouses below.

event.text: Get ready for a rough fight - if the Inquisition needs you to take care of it then it must be no ordinary threat.

As you gear up to attack the cache, Alkram approaches you. "You bastard! You would force me to put your cause over my own? Have you no soul?" After a moment of glaring at you, he shakes his head. "I won't forget this." He mutters.
Inquisition be damned, there's no reason to go risking life over limb for some Rockmen who'll probably stab you in the back anyways.

name: LEECH_INQUISITIONER_CACHE_WIN
text: The prototype vessel has been defeated. This'll probably set back the revolutionaries quite a lot, for better or for worse.

event.text: You begin to reach out to Gora but he's already arrived moments after the ship was defeated. "Excellent job... captain. As promised, the blueprints are yours. You have... 3 minutes until we destroy this place to take whatever it is you... want."

choice.text: Grab as many supplies as you can!

event.text: You hurry down to the mining colony and grab as many resources as you can carry and stuff them into your cargo before taking off. Below you, you can see a violent explosion engulf the colony and leave little behind but rubble.

You hurry down to the mining colony and grab one of the weapons and stuff it into your cargo before taking off. Below you, you can see a violent explosion engulf the colony and leave little behind but rubble.

You hurry down to the mining colony and convince an Ampere that was detained by the revolutionaries to join you before taking off. Below you, you can see a violent explosion engulf the colony and leave little behind but rubble.

name: REVOLUTIONARY_PALADIN_TRAP
text: The Paladin vessel jumps in only a few moments after you signal him. However, it doesn't take long for your deception to be uncovered. "You... I should have expected treachery from Renegade filth! You'll regret this!" The Paladins seem more focused on you than their original target!

choice.text: The Revolutionaries hail you as you prepare for battle.

event.text: "If we can take a closer look at their ship once it's dealt with, it would be of great worth to our cause. We can offer help in one of two ways. We can focus on draining their reactor, or we can provide artillery fire support. Which would you prefer?"
The cruiser falls back and docks with the base. While the base itself has no weapons system, their cruiser's weapon system can be repurposed to function as a make-shift ASB.
The Revolutionary cruiser's weapons withdraw. Like a parasite, the cruiser hovers directly behind the Paladin cruiser, sapping its reactor.

choice.text: [Note: Choosing to use the EMP combat augment in the battle preparation menu will clear the effect of the Leech's reactor drain when it's over.]

name: REVOLUTIONARY_PALADIN_VICTORY
text: The Paladin ship comes to a rest as you and the Revolutionaries finish it off. Their ship has a bountiful yield, which you help yourself to.

event.text: "We must be a threat if even the Theocracy has sent their greatest warriors against us. They have made a grave miscalculation by tipping their hand. We'll give you some standard provisions, the blueprints to our cruiser, and your choice of a weapon or a prisoner."

The Revolutionaries release an Ampere from a cell. The Ampere seems a little disgruntled, but goes along with it. "I don't know who you are or what's going on... but serving on a ship is better than rotting away in a cell."
Floating in the debris of the ship happens to be the weapon you asked for the first time you were browsing the shop. Why couldn't he have just given it to you?
As you investigate the cargo bay of the fake shop-keeper's ship, it appears he just so happens to have had the first weapon you asked for. Why couldn't he have just given it to you?

destroyed.text: The Ampere vessel has been defeated.

deadCrew.text: The Ampere vessel has been defeated.

destroyed.text: The mighty vessel has been defeated - not even the strongest ship in the Eargen military could withstand your power.

name: RHYME_ENCOUNTER_1
text: Uncertain what you'll find at this beacon, you tread carefully but even then aren't quite enlightened on what you've found. A small but well armed Interceptor, similar but differently colored to the mysterious rainbow ships that have been reported popping up, is hiding behind an asteroid. You seem unable to scan it - something about the ship is causing unexpected glitches in your hardware.

event.text: A voice from the enemy ship begins to speak, but to your surprise it sounds as if it were next to you. You turn but see no one and realize you're hearing the voice in your head. "What are you?, the Renegade asked. Explaining myself, I have been tasked. I'm not sure what to say. Please don't take this the wrong way. The world is big, the Multiverse bigger. In scope of it all you're just a flicker. Years ago, our home we fled. For if we stayed we'd be dead. But now here we are, torn apart. And our people chose to depart. An evil thing, eldritch in nature. Your mind would explode, I'd surely wager."

"I see, I see, you know nothing yet. But please, I beg, do not fret. When all is over and done. Nothing will be left, for we have won. Fear the thing that is only chaos. Before he's done all you love will be lost. We are the sons, the daughters of he. The most powerful being there will ever be. Not Prime, no sir, no ma'am! Oh he can't do anything the lord of chaos can!"

choice.text: You aren't doing a good job of convincing me not to fret.

event.text: "You twist our words for you are blind! You cannot see, weak is your mind! At the end of time it is us you'll thank. After this universe is wiped blank! The rupture is soon, we are sure. But you won't see, for you'll be pure! Go now and meet your fate. Die now, you Renegade of second rate."
If there's one thing you've learned in your years as a Renegade, it's never to trust a mysterious ship.

name: RHYME_ENCOUNTER_1_DEFEAT
text: "Is it so, is it so? Defeated I am, now I know. Tread carefully now that you've messed with us. We'll meet again and I expect quite the fuss. Goodbye! So long! Now I'm done."

event.text: You're about to leave but notice in the wreckage another strange signal. It's some kind of weapon with the same anomalous properties of that ship. You bring it on board and cross your fingers it doesn't cause any problems.

name: RHYME_ENCOUNTER_2
text: Uncertain what you'll find at this beacon, you tread carefully but even then aren't quite enlightened on what you've found. A well armed Scout ship, similar but differently colored to the mysterious rainbow ships that have been reported popping up, is hiding behind an asteroid. You seem unable to scan it - something about the ship is causing unexpected glitches in your hardware.

event.text: A voice from the enemy ship begins to speak, but to your surprise it sounds as if it were next to you. You turn but see no one and realize you're hearing the voice in your head. "Oh boy oh boy, a Renegade for me! I can hardly wait, oh I'm filled with glee! They say my friend was killed by one of you. Is it so, is it true? Yes, yes, filth and scum! There'll be none of you when I'm done! With my eye I've seen the truth. You, dear Renegade, are only in your youth. Chaos abounds, the clock ticks ever more! Knock knock goes death on that door."

choice.text: I'm sorry about your friend, but that wasn't us.

event.text: "You think I'm a fool, telling lies! The curtain falls, and my friend dies. But who holds the gun? Yes, you, you're the one! I speak not from nothing. No no, I'm not just fussing! Our idol, our chief. He is the one who has diagnosed my grief. The thing of chaos. The consumer of all the cosmos. The being of entropy! To him, none is supplementary!"

choice.text: I really have no idea what you're talking about.

event.text: "Fine, be that way! It is not as if you have a say. Death is coming, you'll make it faster. Your skull shall be a gift to master. He hungers for the end. Oh he is our most benevolent friend. When all is naught! We shan't be distraught. In the new world we will have our place. And for this destruction, you shall have a taste! Enough with this crockery. Of you I will make a mockery."
If there's one thing you've learned in your years as a Renegade, it's never to trust a mysterious ship.

name: RHYME_ENCOUNTER_2_DEFEAT
text: "No, no, It cannot be! This fate the master did not forsee! I have died. And yet I gave it all, I truly tried. The way of my friend I must now go. Damn you Renegade, just so you know. Now the reaper calls. At last, my curtain falls."

event.text: You're about to leave but notice in the wreckage another strange signal. It's some kind of weapon with the same anomalous properties of that ship. You bring it on board and cross your fingers it doesn't cause any problems.

name: RHYME_ENCOUNTER_3
text: Uncertain what you'll find at this beacon, you tread carefully but even then aren't quite enlightened on what you've found. A massive and well armed Bomber, similar but differently colored to the mysterious rainbow ships that have been reported popping up, is hiding behind an asteroid. You seem unable to scan it - something about the ship is causing unexpected glitches in your hardware.

event.text: A voice from the enemy ship begins to speak, but to your surprise it sounds as if it were next to you. You turn but see no one and realize you're hearing the voice in your head. "All is naught! Well is how you have fought. What of my last two friends? Oh, they met their bitter end. And who was it, who was that culprit? It was you, I swear by the pulpit. Caught the master's interest, yes you have. Our numbers do you seek to halve? Fine, ashes to ashes and all that crap. But riddle me this you blasted chap. Will you like what you are to find? Oh no no no, the master is not kind."

choice.text: Your master? What are you talking about?

event.text: "Mystery mystery, oh what a squeeze. Your ignorance, it's like a disease. Go on now, destiny can not wait! Oh ahead of you is a troublesome fate. Chaos and ruin, just as we predicted. Within our riddles a mystery's encrypted. For our master's the One Who Rhymes. The one who will bring the end of all times!"

"Still oh you yip and yap. Are you afraid, afraid of a most dastardly trap? Oh how I laugh, you most pitiful thing. In the end, only death will cowardice bring. Fine, if action you will not take. If true of the prophecy you will not make. Then force your hand I must require! And only then may I retire. Hands up, you dastardly fiend. Only on my death will the truth be gleamed."
If there's one thing you've learned in your years as a Renegade, it's never to trust a mysterious ship.

name: RHYME_ENCOUNTER_3_DEFEAT
text: "Finally, at last, my death has come. To the end I am all but numb. The end is nearer, the time is nigh! Not now but later you will die. Go now, and search my wreck. There is one last card in the master's deck."

event.text: Aboard the wreck you find a strange gun with anomalous properties like the ship you just fought, as well as an Atlas disc with coordinates that make no sense to you. You're wary of whatever nonsense those aliens were spewing, but against your better judgement you enter the disc into your Atlas regardless. We should be able to explore these coordinates at the next sector jump.

name: RHYME_ENCOUNTER_CHAOS

unvisitedTooltip.text: There is strange interference at this beacon.

visitedTooltip.text: Explored location. Nothing left of interest.

text: Uncertain what you'll find at this beacon, you tread carefully but are startled by the approach of a strangely colored alien vessel. "The dawn of the end approaches once again. The gnome you carry, and so it is the master you seek to entertain! Good, oh good, for the time is nigh! The time was approaching again that all of time should die. But now you're here and without further delay... to the master this news I must relay! Oh, will you come with me? To The One Who Rhymes we must go I do decree!"

event.text: "Oh this is perfect, truly just perfect! But first I must take this gnome for which my master holds such respect. Now now off we go! We certainly wouldn't want to be late to the show!"

choice.text: Nah. We have other places to be.

event.text: "You're... serious? Am I just delirious? You will not come? I... I cannot even think of a rhyme. Really? You're serious? Well... shit. Goodbye I guess."

name: THE_ONE_WHO_RHYMES
text: As you watch the stars fly past you watch as the scenery becomes more and more warped, until soon you're thrown at breakneck speeds right before a gigantic space anomaly. You can hardly believe your eyes before a blinding red flash sends you tumbling backwards.

event.text: "You looked! You gasped! I had you hooked! The mystery's answer at very last! It was I, The One Who Rhymes. God of Chaos, the ender of times! Oh what joy, what fun! Oh how far it is you've come. We meet at last! Oh friend we're gonna have a blast. Do you not quake and shiver in awe? I'm perfect, I'm beautiful, down to my every last paw. I'm sure you're curious, 'What is this fuss?' Well well, let's get to it, now that it's just the two of us!"

choice.text: Could you kindly explain what the hell is happening?

event.text: "Haha! Hahe! Oh but your confusion brings me such glee! An eldritch being of unimaginable power, that's what I am. Oh the cosmology, what a mess. Shall we start from the beginning? I'm thinking yes!"

"You guess? YOU GUESS?! Oh but you should be excited! Having you here has made me oh so delighted! Where to begin, where to begin... Ah yes, of course! Another cluster is from where we hail. Realities unlike anything you've seen! A place where Eldritch is normal, where dreams fill the gaps between! Yes, that's right, you heard me clearly! I do promise I speak sincerely. The dreams of gods, that's our matter. And those Sirens? Well, they eat it on the silver platter!"

"Oh you are so ignorant! The tripods you've battled to get here, did you not know they were important? Yes, yes, a species unlike any other! A devious god their mother! And when she tired of their suckling... oh she sent them buckling! Haha, hahe! Oh what a riot. Through that portal they went running. And behind them? Well it was me who came gunning! Unpopular there I always was. But here? Well I can make all the chaos I ever wanted, just because. But oh those Sirens, me they did ever so hate. But a few of them it seems could relate! They worshipped me, gave me praise. And all for nothing, not even a raise! A while I remained complacent. I'd mess with that bastard Slug, the one who thinks he rules the Multiverse adjacent. My anomalies he never liked. A whole agency he made, just out of spite! Sent after me to... to bring my ruin! Well, I'm afraid any chance I fail was just an illusion. My mother is cunning, she is most patient. It is only a matter of time until the Slug's place is vacant."

"Gah, quiet with your interruptions! I tire of all these disruptions. The cult of rhyme I did create! And within I hatched a most dastardly plan. Here, I'll tell it you to straight. In the days past, it was just me and my master. Us together, free to cause every last disaster! But now she's gone, and the fun's all ruined. I'll tear this world apart. That's what I was meant to do right from the start! And that bastard Prime? Well it seems he's run out of time. For upon this very hour, I shall unleash my greatest power! The world shall crumble, reality shall break! Falling down the stars will tumble. Afterwards I think I shall have some cake. Now now, fear not little one. I just wanted to gloat before it's done. Now bear witness to the end of creation! Thou lived a good life, but you were the last generation."

choice.text: Surely there's some way to avoid this!

event.text: "Oh, a most daunting request. A dramatic flair, you clearly don't jest! At the very last moment, you speak up as a savior! Oh, isn't that just the most adorable behavior? Fine, I'll humor you, itty bitty little speck. I'll give you one last chance before I send you all to heck. If thou can best me in the deadliest of duels... then I shall postpone my annihilation of all you fools! I'm feeling quite impatient, so try not to take too long. Let us wait no longer, the end you cannot forever prolong."

choice.text: (Irwin) "I've been training my whole life for thisss!"

event.text:
Irwin cuts off The One Who Rhymes mid-speech, immediately turning to you excitedly. "Exotic creaturesss? A grand multiverse-level conssspiracccy? I wassss MADE for thissss!"
														
Irwin flips a switch on his blunderbuss, turning it from an orange glow to red. "It'sss time to kill sssome eldritch godsss."

choice.text: Accept your fate and watch as reality is destroyed.

event.text: The deity begins to laugh as he spreads his cartoonishly long arms and chants. All around you it seems as if space itself is imploding. This is truly the end.

lose.text: This reality was destroyed, instantaneously erasing anyone and everyone inside.

name: THE_ONE_WHO_RHYMES_FAIL
text: "Oh it's tragic, it's so so sad... Really, I didn't think you could make me feel so bad! Alas, your fate is sealed. What's done is done. What's left is obvious, my plan's revealed. The end of time shall commence at once. Goodbye, you ignorant dunce."

lose.text: This reality was destroyed, instantaneously erasing anyone and everyone inside.

name: THE_ONE_WHO_RHYMES_WIN
text: As the opposing ship is overcome with explosions, the deity appears on yours pretending to limp. "Oh me! Oh my! Is it true? Is now the time I die? Of course not, that'd be foolish. To see me here alive must seem so ghoulish. Oh you really thought, an eldritch god you could render naught? Nay, my time is forever. Now was just a blip. All that said, I must admire your endeavour."

event.text: "No no, in fact you've won! Oh I can't think of a time I've ever had more fun! If you Renegades are truly so entertaining, then what would I do with none of you remaining? In fact, I think I shall bestow a gift. Not one, not two, but three in fact! Oh your luck will surely shift!"

"Let's see what prizes of which you'll be the user! Number one, my precious cruiser! Of which you've damaged (quite the feat you have managed). A little beaten but it'll be fine. Go on and have a good time."

"The second, the stranger. My precious gnome, it shan't put you in danger! Well that's a lie, I must admit. A little secret I will transmit. Within this thing is imbued true chaos like nothing you've seen. A fun challenge I think that will be bring! Whenever you're feeling up to the task, go fetch the gnome and bring it here I ask! I shall call this thing the Chaos Mode! Only a 9% chance reality will implode." The One Who Rhymes tosses you a small garden gnome sculpture. It makes you very uncomfortable looking at it.

"And now for the third, of which I think you will be the most glad! I think this victory shall be the last you will have had. No, that's not a threat. For now a victory I owe you in my debt. That dreadful Flagship I will erase. And in the future I'll do so again with grace! Just bring that gnome back to me. And we'll battle again, hahe! Now that's all I have to say. Goodbye, farewell, have a wonderful day!" A hole opens beneath The One Who Rhymes, through which he falls. His hat remains behind momentarily before a long arm comes back out and grabs it, then slips away into the abyss.

win.text: What fun, what fun! And now your run is won!

event.text: "Indeed you have - I must admit; for our encounter is illegit. Please refrain from any panic, but our meeting must be organic."
"If my rewards you want to earn, then seek me at another turn. If you wish to best me truly, then make your path unseen, unruly. Now go away and then come back, and please don't cheat or even hack."

win.text: If an unlock is what you need, then do not use a preset seed!

name: THE_ONE_WHO_RHYMES_CHAOS
text: As you watch the stars fly past you watch as the scenery becomes more and more warped, until soon you're thrown at breakneck speeds right before a gigantic space anomaly. You can hardly believe your eyes before a blinding red flash sends you tumbling backwards.

event.text: "Hello good friend! How good it is to see you again! Just in time, you've returned at last! Last time we met, we had just a blast! Oh, wouldn't you agree? Right here, right now, you and I, this is the most fun there'll ever be!"

choice.text: Who are you? What is going on?

event.text: "Haha! Hahe! Oh but your confusion brings me such glee! I think you know more than you let on, or else to here why would you have gone? I'll give you the brief for I am so kind; the end of the world is the business in which you are now intertwined. While my master waits, a great game unfolds. What great mystery this all holds. A promise you made, so long ago. And now that same deal I shall echo! Face you me again, in another devilish duel. If you fail, then to this reality I will be most cruel! The choice is yours, the time is now. The end of reality, will you allow?"

choice.text: Accept the challenge and face The One Who Rhymes.

event.text: "Oh I am truly most glad! Last time so much fun was had! But before we brawl, I grant one last gift. That is, for returning my gnome so swift! A new crewmate, to fill that spot. Now, we shall advance this plot."

choice.text: (Irwin) "I've been training my whole life for thisss!"

event.text:
Irwin cuts off The One Who Rhymes mid-speech, immediately turning to you excitedly. "Exotic creaturesss? A grand multiverse-level conssspiracccy? I wassss MADE for thissss!"
								
Irwin flips a switch on his blunderbuss, turning it from an orange glow to red. "It'sss time to kill sssome eldritch godsss."

"Really? You are giving up this early? Well, the choice belongs to you. It's time for time to get its due!" The deity begins to laugh as he spreads his cartoonishly long arms and chants. All around you it seems as if space itself is imploding. This is truly the end.

lose.text: This reality was destroyed, instantaneously erasing anyone and everyone inside.

name: THE_ONE_WHO_RHYMES_WIN_CHAOS
text: As the opposing ship is overcome with explosions, the deity appears on yours. "You've done it again, oh bravo! What a frightening staccato! A promise is a promise, and I won't disappoint. The savior of this reality to you I do annoint. Congratulations on your stunning success. Now enjoy your well deserved recess."

win.text: What fun, what fun! And now your run is won!

name: REALM_MADNESS_START
text:
You've arrived in some kind of swirling hellscape, mired by a blurry haze of what seems to be taunting barely human faces flying through the abyss. Just being here makes your skin crawl, making you feel like a foreign invader in a land where you are not only unwelcome but at serious risk.
	
	Moments later, more of the C.E.L. arrives, armed to the teeth. "Ssstranger, based on energy readings, we've pinpointed where we think Ssshe isss waiting. We'll do our bessst to arrive there in time, but you'll need to head out in front of usss. Be careful - thisss clussster isss populated by eldritch beingsss beyond any of our comprehensssionsss. Thissss is Her realm. There'sss no point in sssticking around to fight every enemy, their numbersss are endlessss. All that mattersss isss getting to Her, and fassst. Be careful, ssstranger."

name: VISION_DEFEAT
text: The black vessel has been destroyed. There's plenty to scrap but you have little time. You need to keep going and reach Her! If you waste your resources and effort fighting every one of these enemies, you'll never make it!

lose.text: Your vessel is lost amongst the smiling abyss, ensuring eternal darkness upon the Multiverse.

name: HER_FIGHT

unvisitedTooltip.text: The location of Her.

text: You've finally made it to the location of Her. The entire space around is nothing but darkness, with every star having been pulled out of the night sky and consumed by some ancient evil. This is it, there's no second chances now. You're about to go up against perhaps the most powerful and evil entity known to exist in the Multiverse.

event.text:
Nightmarish visions begin to cloud your sight, as a gigantic cruiser congeals in the space before you. A strangely familiar voice, although you have no idea from where, speaks to you.

			"Haha, Hahe! It's been so long, so long indeed! Hello again, dear friend! Tis I, The One Who Rhymes. As you already know, we are on the brink of new times! My master is here, awakened at last! Unlike anything ever before, now we're REALLY going to have a blast!" Despite never having seen the dancing, eldritch being before you, some dark place in the back of your mind seems to recall his unusual way of speaking, and his evil grin.

"Oh it really is wonderful! But please, my child, do not frighten our little agent of chaos! Hello, Renegade! Welcome to my realm. The home of all my precious children. Once, this plane was populated by countless eldritch beings much like myself. Unfortunately, their constant feuding led many of them to extinction. Now, all that's left is their dream matter to pollute the cosmos and feed my vermin. I frankly would have liked to take over the Multiverse with an army of gods, but oh well. A lesser and elder god of chaos will have to do."

"You know what's strange about you, Renegade? And all of the Renegades before? You're... smart. Too smart. I think you're different. You're like a disease, a foreign alien disease. One that's spread into my existence and exists just to meddle in affairs. But for what? The sick entertainment of some higher dimensional being? Not that it matters. Regardless what you are, you've proven very useful to my ends. After so much waiting and patient manipulating I think I'm finally ready to stop with all the dilly dallying. I've been restless, having my soul split between a garden gnome and some arrogant fool's big spinny rings. So let's cut to the chase, right, Renegade? Your Slug friends will be here soon, and I was looking forward to pulling them apart, so let's get to business. Bye-bye!"

			 				 /
							:)

tooltip.text: You must survive until the C.E.L. arrives!

choice.text: (Irwin) "I've been training my whole life for thisss!"

event.text:
As She watches with both mild annoyance and curiosity, Irwin holds his gun even closer to his chest in raw excitement. "Exotic creaturesss? A grand multiverse-level conssspiracccy? I wassss MADE for thissss!" 
										
				Irwin flips a switch on his blunderbuss, turning it from an orange glow to red. "It'sss time to kill sssome eldritch godsss."

name: HER_SUPPORT
text: Suddenly, countless vessels jump into the beacon. The C.E.L. has arrived, and they're bringing heavy firepower! Some kind of massive contraption is deployed, locking straight onto the vessel before you. "Ssstranger, focussss all of your fire on that sssship! With thisss you'll be able to damage the hull, but it'sss not over yet! We need to desssstroy it to weaken Her!"

name: HER_FINALE_REAL
text:
As the gigantic black vessel begins to dissipate, you hear The One Who Rhymes scream. "No, no, this cannot be! It's coming apart from the seams! You've ruined everything, you've crushed our dreams! I can feel myself fading, oh god I'm done! I can't... I can't believe you've really won." The entity fades away, as does the darkness around you.
	
	It's over. You've defeated Her, and saved the Multiverse from falling into the clutches of an eldritch god. It wasn't your initial mission - but what you've done here matters so much more.

win.text: She is no more. Enjoy your retirement, Renegade.

name: SEPARATIST_VIRUS_TRAP
text: You find an abandoned Separatist ship in orbit around a moon. There are absolutely no signs of activity on the ship whatsoever.

event.text: As you board the vessel to salvage it, you hear a sound coming from your Engi, as if they are in distress. They start to shake and convulse, and after a moment of confusion, your Engi seems to accept what has happened to them - a virus has turned them into a Separatist!

choice.text: Blow the ship up and harvest the remains.

event.text: Destroying the ship is going to decrease the yield considerably, but doing so is safer than boarding it.
You avoid the ship - Separatists have been known to leave viruses behind for unwitting scavengers.

name: SEPARATIST_WORTHLESS_JUNK
text: You catch the two Separatists on the nearby ship squabbling over something about an augment. You hail them. "Yes, greetings. We have obtained object. Object's purpose is unknown, and our desire to keep it is 0. Please take this [worthless junk] off of our hands."

name: SEPARATIST_TRAP_SCAN
text: A neighboring Separatist ship hails you soon after you jump in. "You are in [luck] captain of Federation vessel. I am in possession of an expansive data suite, including a map of this sector. Would you like to download?"

event.text: "I see you have no interest in taking advantage of great [opportunities]."

name: SEPARATIST_FREE_CREW
text: A Separatist hails you, first speaking in binary before eventually switching over to English. "Federation. Federation. Please ignore my damaged speech processor processorsor. I have very recently recently broken free from the [Harmony], and wish to serve on a Federation vessel vessel. Will you accept accept me?"

event.text: "Oh, Thank thank you captain!"
"Oh... I understand understand. Best of luck with your mission mission."

name: SEPARATIST_BODY_SCAN
text: Though no ship is located at this beacon, a single Separatist Engi beams onto the bridge of your ship. He wastes no time to ask if he may scan your body, wishing to shape his form in the shape of yours.

choice.text: (Elite Human) Entice him with your Elite Human.
(Hive Elite) Entice him with your Elite Mantis.
(Elite Slug) Entice him with your Elite Slug.
(Elite Rock) Entice him with your Elite Rock.
(Alpha Phantom) Entice him with your Phantom Alpha.
(Alpha Mare) Entice him with your Mare Alpha.
(Alpha Goul) Entice him with your Goul Alpha.
(Alpha Wraith) Entice him with your Wraith Alpha.

event.text: The Separatist begins to scan the Harpy, but pauses mid-way through. "WHAT IS THIS?! WHAT [IS] THIS?! WHY DOES THE EYE TASTE OF AGONY?! WHAT ARE -THESE- COLORS?! MY MIND, MY [MIND]! AAAAAAAH!" The Separatist dissolves almost immediately, leaving nothing behind.

choice.text: (Engi) Encourage him to scan the Engi.

event.text: "You wish for me... to become identical to my current state? I fail to understand this logic. I will find someone of higher intelligence to scan."
"You are most [dull]. Farewell." He beams off of the ship.

name: SEPARATIST_ENGI_CHOICE
text: Two ships, both Engi, are fighting at this beacon. One belongs to the Harmony, and the other to the Separatists.

event.text: The Harmony Engi tell you that they have been trying to convince the Separatists to come back to the Harmony and once again embrace sameness. The Separatists refuse, wanting to live their lives in peace.
Neither ship seems particularly disturbed at you getting involved, and the Separatist continues to fight as if nothing had changed.
"Impossible. Failure to honor truce. Federation has broken promise. Fight imminent."
You can hear the shots of the two ships echoing through your comms until you're a safe distance away.

name: SEPARATIST_SEPARATIST_CHOICE_WIN
text: "Success achieved. Gratitude is ours. Accept [Drone] as reward." The Engi ship jumps away, accepting the fate of the Separatist ship as necessary.

name: SEPARATIST_ENGI_CHOICE_WIN
text: "An unfortunate death. We wish the Harmony would leave this sector. Still, I thank you Federation. Perhaps if I take refuge on your ship, I will be safe from their scouts."

name: SEPARATIST_BASKETBALL
text:
A Harmony and a Separatist ship are facing off, but surprisingly there is no battle going down. Instead, they are talking. You tune in to their dialogue.
    
"This = nonsense. Decisions = too important to be decided in this fashion."
    
"We are -Engi-. You are Engi. Should n-n-not fight. Other [means] for conflict are logical."
    
"...Confirmed. However, question = unanswered. Why basketball?"
    
"[Earth] media show that athletic activities are -less- harmful and more unifying methods of resolving conflict."
    
"Not disputed. Yet, Harmony: would not approve."
    
"You are not -attacking-, and therefore must be hesitant in [following] the Harmony's orders."

choice.text: Encourage the conflicted Engi to play basketball with the Separatists.
Tell them that violence is the only solution.

event.text: Both ships affix their weapons upon you. The Separatist ship messages you. "Explain. You are pro-freedom, or pro-Harmony?"
"Pro-Separatist Renegade = more dangerous than any one Separatist. Changing target."
"Violence [is] not the way. However, you are an -obstacle- to our freedom."

choice.text: Might makes right. Let the victor decide.

event.text: The Engi ships seem to have made some sort of agreement. "Your ideals are -dangerous-. We will put [them] to the test."
The conversation doesn't seem to go anywhere. At least, not while you're around.

name: SEPARATIST_ENGI_BASKETBALL_VIOLENCE_WIN
text: As you scrap the Harmony ship, the Separatist hails. "This is a -shame-. They were acting slightly deviant. They may have joined the Separatists. However, we are grateful." In addition to the scrapped ship, they give you a reward.

name: SEPARATIST_DOUBLE_BASKETBALL_VIOLENCE_WIN
text: You've triumphed against both crews at the same time. You scrap all that you have managed to find among both ships.

name: SEPARATIST_NANOCLOUD
text: A Separatist ship floats around nearby, slowly distancing itself from you. You're somewhat baffled that quick scans show no crew aboard, but the ship seems fully functional and responsive.

event.text: The mystery of the ship doesn't matter to you. The only thing on your mind is the reward of blowing it up.
You try to reach out, but every time the ship picks up all you can hear is a faint buzzing noise.
The mystery of the ship doesn't matter to you. The only thing on your mind is the reward of blowing it up.
You've lost interest in the mystery, and prepare to move on.

choice.text: (Slug Crew) Try to detect life signs.

event.text: Your Slug tries to sense some form of intelligence aboard the enemy ship. They detect faint signs of potential life, but it's near impossible for them to tell.
The mystery of the ship doesn't matter to you. The only thing on your mind is the reward of blowing it up.
You've lost interest in the mystery, and prepare to move on.

choice.text: (Telepathic Shell) Try to detect life signs.

event.text: Your Shell tries to sense some form of intelligence aboard the enemy ship. They detect faint signs of potential life, but it's near impossible for them to tell.
The mystery of the ship doesn't matter to you. The only thing on your mind is the reward of blowing it up.
You've lost interest in the mystery, and prepare to move on.
You have no desire to deal with the ship.

name: SEPARATIST_NANOCLOUD_DESTROYED
text: The strange Separatist ship is destroyed, and you scrap its remains.

event.text: You prepare to move on when a squeaky, high pitched voice speaks from behind you. You turn around to see a grey cloud of nanobots floating in random directions around the room. "Outcome: Wonderful. Appreciation: Maximum. Sarcasm: 100%. You have destroyed my ship. Now I have no choice but to integrate myself with yours."

name: SEPARATIST_FLEET_DELAY
text: A Separatist vessel hails you. "Your situation with the fleet is known. We have: proposition. Help us with killing hostile ship, and we will delay fleet."

event.text: "Rebel Auto-ships, their AI is less than satisfactory. Always getting lost. Now, we must deal with lost ship in this sector. Will you help?"
The Separatists lead you to the location of the Auto-ship.
"I am -dissatisfied- with your response, but I will tolerate it. Good day Captain."
"Fair = fair. Try not to die."

name: SEPARATIST_FLEET_DELAY_WIN
text: "Very good. Now for your compensation. Please do not move your [ship]." The Separatists run a scan over your vessel, giving you a tingly feeling all over your body. The Separatists hail you again, this time looking very similar to you. "My job is less than 100%, but it will work for now. I have masked your jump signature. The fleet will now follow me. Good day."

name: SEPARATIST_FLEET_DELAY_LOSE
text: "You have failed. Do not attempt to communicate with us again."

name: SEPARATIST_DISGUISE
text: An Engi ship hails you, though their camera has been turned off. "Federation, we request... Request: Aid in -search- for traitors. We require supplies."

event.text: A long mechanical arm unfolds from the ship's hull and grabs onto the supplies. The Engi promise you will receive a reward in return.

choice.text: (Harmony Crew) Contact them and ask to negotiate further.

event.text: Your Engi requests to communicate with them. The Engi ship doesn't respond, and after continuous hails, their weapons go online!

choice.text: (Separatist Crew) "It would seem that these [Engi] are Separatists."

event.text: Not long after your Separatist contacts them, the Engi ship turns its cameras on, revealing that they are indeed Separatist Engi. "Federation, it would seem that our [goals] may be currently compatible. Would you be -willing- to make an exchange? We [assure] you that it would benefit both of our interests."

You agree to give the Separatists the resources they wanted, noticing that the request was more reasonable this time. A mechanical arm extends out of the ship to collect the supplies, and proceeds to dispense an augment once it finishes collecting the scrap.
Though the Separatist seems dismayed at your refusal, they decide not to push any further, and soon jump away.
"Need for -supplies- unfulfilled. Decisive action required... Screw this voice, we'll just take [everything] we want."

name: DISTRESS_SEPARATIST_GHOST
text: You receive a communication from a lone Separatist escape pod. "I [need] help. Phantoms have [assumed] control of my -ship-. Would you [rectify] the situation?"

event.text: You approach the occupied vessel. "Glad to hear. Don't destroy [it]."
The Separatist seems annoyed and disconnects immediately.

name: DISTRESS_SEPARATIST_COMMUNITY_VIRUS
text: Though Separatists usually prefer isolation, a rare example of a Separatist colony is hosted on a nearby planet. The distress beacon appears to be originating from the planet's surface.

event.text: "Greetings unwelcome stranger. Consider yourself now welcome. We have request. We have recently been infected by [deadly] virus, casualties are over -1/4th- of population. Can you assist?"
Though you can tell from their reactions it won't help much, the Engis are still grateful for your donation.
The Separatists have nothing to offer as far as a physical reward goes, but they are able to repair your hull.

choice.text: (Hacking Weapon) Use your hacking weapon to destroy the virus.

event.text: Your hacking weapon discombobulates the affected Separatists. They are completely knocked out, but the virus proves defenseless to your advanced weapon. You're able to affect large numbers of population at a time.

You're able to cure the rest of the Separatists with some clever positioning and coordination by the population. They are extremely grateful, and gift you a piece of equipment for your ship. One of their workers also offers in secret to work aboard your crew, afraid of their fate in the colony if the virus resurfaces.

choice.text: (Hacking) Use your hacking to isolate the virus.

event.text: Your hacking is surprisingly effective, and you're able to remove all instances of the virus's code from several Separatists. With how effective your hacking has been, they request that you stay behind a little longer to cure even more of them.

It takes the rest of the day to cure the other Separatists, but at last it appears you have managed to cure the entire colony of the virus. They are extremely grateful, and gift you a piece of equipment for your ship. One of their workers also offers in secret to work aboard your crew, afraid of their fate in the colony if the virus resurfaces.
"Calculating percentage of casualties resulting from failure to wait: 20%. Those who have been saved will surely be infected again. We will not keep you waiting, as if we were able to anyways."

choice.text: (Engi Crew) Send your Engi down to help.
(Separatist Crew) Send your Separatist down to help.
(Engi Defender Crew) Send your Defender down to help.

event.text: "-ERROR: Logic not present- Infection is not biological, we are machi-" you end the call. They do not attempt to communicate again.
Too far away for them to notice you, you're left undisturbed in your current location.

name: DISTRESS_SEPARATIST_COMMUNITY_VIRUS_DEFENDER
text: Your Engi is sent down to the planet, where they successfully manage to find the source of the virus and purge it from some of the Separatist's systems. Once they're sure of how to do it on their own, they give your Engi a gift to bring back to the ship.

name: QUEST_SEPARATIST_ENGI_BOUNTY
text: A squadron of Engi ships have set up a camp on a small nearby moon. They seem peaceful, and only their defensive drones are online for protection.

event.text: "Request for contact received. Timing is fortunate. We have an offer for you. Current objective: hunt down Separatists and convert back to Harmony. Location for dangerous Separatist ship is known, danger too high to engage. We ask you to capture the ship yourselves."
The Engi transmit the location of the Separatist ship.
The Engi immediately end transmissions and will not respond to further hails.
The Engi ships don't appear to be disturbed by your presence, and you leave them alone.

name: QUEST_SEPARATIST_ENGI_BOUNTY_QUEST

unvisitedTooltip.text: A Separatist ship is targeted by the Harmony.

text: It doesn't take long for the Separatists to notice you. "So, you have come to kill me? Then prepare for a battle, Federation." You remember the Engi's orders to capture the ship without destroying it, knowing you'll have to kill their crew to do so.

name: ENCOUNTER_ENGI_SEPARATIST
text: A Separatist ship orbits the beacon, but before you can contact them they jump away and an Engi ship approaches. "Federation assisting enemies of Harmony? Dilemma... Federation ship: must be eliminated."

name: ENCOUNTER_ZOLTAN_AUTO_SEPARATIST
text: "We suggest you avoid the Auto-ship. It is broken." You notice the Separatist ship that hailed you hiding behind some large asteroids, as well as the Zoltan made Auto-ship barreling towards you!

name: ENCOUNTER_ZOLTAN_AUTO_SEPARATIST_KILL
text: The Separatists let out something that sounds like a robotic laugh. "Good, I see why others get much [enjoyment] out of watching gladiatorial combat." They jump away, leaving you with the wreck of the Auto-ship.

name: HARMONY_LINK_SEP

unvisitedTooltip.text: This is the location of a Harmony Link.

visitedTooltip.text: This is the location of a Harmony Link.

text: It appears you've discovered a Harmony Link. These massive planet-sized structures are made up of trillions of nanobots, and transmit a strong signal to all of the Engi in the sector. However, it appears this one is no longer functional, likely sabotaged by the Separatists when they took control of this sector.

name: HARMONY_LINK_UNIQUE_SEP

unvisitedTooltip.text: This is the location of a Harmony Link.

visitedTooltip.text: This is the location of a Harmony Link.

text: It appears you've discovered a Harmony Link. These massive planet-sized structures are made up of trillions of nanobots, and transmit a strong signal to all of the Engi in the sector. However, it appears this one is no longer functional, likely sabotaged by the Separatists when they took control of this sector.

name: HARMONY_LINK_SEPARATIST
text: A Separatist vessel is analyzing the Harmony link. They either don't notice you or couldn't care less about your presence.

event.text: "Yes, we -see- you, Federation. If you wish to be useful, perhaps you could lend us some explosives. We are attempting the [demolition] of the Harmony links."
You transfer over the missiles to the Separatists.
"Wow. This is quite -unhelpful-. We cannot even use these. I suppose this is worth about, 5 scrap."
You transfer over the missiles to the Separatists.

The Separatists load the missiles, then fire them directly into the Harmony link. It shatters the exterior, sending nanobots flying, only for them to reform again without any noticeable damage. "Well, at least now we [know]. Accept this payment."

choice.text: Take advantage of this situation and attack!

event.text: The Separatists speak no words, but evidently won't go down without a fight!
If they're no threat to you, then you'll be no threat to them.

name: SHOWDOWN_PLACEHOLDER
text: You should never see this.

name: FLAGSHIP_DIRTY
text: The Flagship trembles. It has already sustained immense damage, but it holds together. A teleporter signature is registered, and it becomes clear the Rebels are playing dirty. They must have had a few Cognitives lying around after their raid, because several hostile entities are detected aboard!

name: FLAGSHIP_DIRTY_HARD
text: The Flagship trembles. It has already sustained immense damage, but it holds together. A teleporter signature is registered, and it becomes clear the Rebels are playing dirty. They must have had a few Cognitives lying around after their raid, because several hostile entities are detected aboard!

name: SHOWDOWN_AUTO
text: It appears this ship is also equipped with an advanced AI system. Now that the crew is dead, it has taken control! You sense oxygen levels dropping on the Flagship as well...

name: SHOWDOWN_BEGIN
text: As you pursue the Flagship, you know this is your last chance to prepare whatever you might need before the battle. This will be it, there's no going back once you've caught up to them. Now would be a good time to check your mission report one last time.

name: SHOWDOWN_FAIL
text: The Flagship jumps away, escaping from you. You've failed... and now the future of the Federation across all realities look bleak. This is a crushing defeat, and your mission is lost.

lose.text: Universe 0 has been destroyed. All is lost.

name: GO_TO_SHOWDOWN
text: Now fully situated and ready for your final fight, you set the ship into hyperspeed for hopefully not your last time.

name: SHOWDOWN_CASUAL
text: You chase down Vance as fast as possible. You manage to catch up to his titan of a ship, similar in build to the Rebel Flagship, but armed with an even stronger arsenal of artillery and sporting an MFK paint job.

event.text: You didn't come this far to give up now. There's nothing left to do but destroy this ship. Fail, and the Federation is doomed, succeed and save this reality forever. The stakes are high, but you don't have time to think about them as you get ready to fight.

choice.text: (Nights) Nights seems to have something to say to Vance.
