deadCrew.text: The unprepared Duskbringers are dead, just like the original pirate crew. You scrap both ships.

destroyed.text: The Duskbringer station has been destroyed. It'd be quite the accomplishment, if not for the fact you were asked specifically to avoid this.

event.text: "God damn it, you blew it up! This whole operation is screwed now! This is what I get for enlisting the help of a Renegade, isn't it. Fine, just go. I'm going to be executed for this..."

deadCrew.text: The station has been rid of crew. You scrap some of the exterior before contacting the Coalition. "The first part of the job is done. Go ahead and dock and we'll search for the tech."

surrender.text: Your attention is brought back to your screen. It appears the Mantis never ended the call, and is still frantically talking to you. "Must... must kill Federation. Must not die... this way... Sacrifice is the only way..."

escape.text: The Mantis ship's engines power up, and you know you only have so long before they plow straight into your ship. You'll either have to kill them fast or run away.

gotaway.text: The Mantis ship's engines flash bright and you know it's too late. You jump to the floor as the Mantis ship smashes into your hull, dealing signifigant damage and destroying themselves in the process. Fortunately, a small amount of scrap is left behind from the wreckage, but that's the only silver lining.

destroyed.text: With the patrol ship destroyed you hasten to leave. It won't be long before the other ships catch up.

deadCrew.text: With the patrol ship taken care of you hasten to leave. It won't be long before the other ships catch up.

destroyed.text: The Mantis ship breaks apart.

deadCrew.text: No more life signs detected on the Mantis ship. You hasten to contact the Engi.

escape.text: You pick up more chatter from the enemy ship, "You know what... Forget this. Prepare for retreat!" Looks like they're preparing to make a hasty get away!

gotaway.text: The ship made an emergency FTL jump, but it looks like they didn't mask their signatures. You could easily follow them if you want.

event.text: You input their coordinates into your map and prepare to follow.
They're not worth the trouble. You prepare to leave.

destroyed.text: Their ship breaks apart and you move in to scrap the remains.

deadCrew.text: With no more crew on board you are free to salvage what you can from the remains.

escape.text: They appear to be trying to get away again. You doubt they'll forget to mask their jump signature this time.

gotaway.text: Looks like they got away. At least you're able to scrap their abandoned fighter.

surrender.text: "Look, you proved point. We not want to die... Take this and let go. Please?"

event.text: "Thank you. But you have idea how much repairing TWO ships will set back?..." What an odd Mantis. You prepare to leave.
"No! Hurry up, get out here! They crazy!" You cut transmissions.

destroyed.text: Their ship breaks apart and you salvage the two ships.

deadCrew.text: You find an intact weapon on their now empty ship. You take as much scrap from the ships as possible.

destroyed.text: The Mantis ship breaks apart.

choice.text: Attempt to contact the civilian ship.

deadCrew.text: No more life signs detected on the pirate ship. You hasten to contact the civilian ship.

deadCrew.text: The Mantis pursuers have been vanquished. The Florals come to a halt and contact you.

choice.text: (Long-Ranged Scanners) Track the cargo ship's movement.

event.text: The destination of the convoy has been registered by your scanners. If you follow them, you might be able to find where they are escorting the cargo.

deadCrew.text: During the fight, the convoy slipped away. However, the escort's flight plan is still programmed into the ship's computer.

choice.text: Determine the destination from the ship's navigation.

choice.text: Forward the rest of the information to the Harmony.

choice.text: Leave, then talk with your new guest.

event.text: "Amazing job, I've been in the Federation for years but I've never seen anything like that. My cover's worthless now, so I might as well stick around."

choice.text: (Magnetic Arm) Quickly collect some more scrap before leaving.

event.text: The magnet arm gathers some more supplies from the wreckage.

choice.text: Offer them mercy in return for their cargo.

event.text: You assure your crew that you know what you're doing, and move in to finish off the Free Mantis.

destroyed.text: Your destruction of the ship sends their cargo spiraling into space in all directions. You can't find anything of value to salvage, besides what remains of the ship itself.

deadCrew.text: You finish off their crew, and scrap their hull before moving in to collect their cargo.

surrender.text: You are hailed by the Free Mantis again. He remarkably shows no signs of concern about his potential demise. "Very good, first human to defeat me."

event.text: He lowers his voice to a whisper. "This rock... very very special. It glow, and can replicate itself. It even go boom! I trust it with you, noble fighter."

choice.text: Screw this, destroy the ship anyways.

event.text: "So, you wish to continue. Brave. We shall duel, one on one!"

destroyed.text: You can't help but feel a little guilty about killing them. Regardless, you scrap all that you can.

deadCrew.text: You never even gave them a chance. You feel guilty, but regardless you scrap all that you can.

destroyed.text: To your surprise, you emerge victorious. The other Rebel ships scatter, afraid you'll go after them next. You scrap the hull of your most recent victim.

choice.text: Contact the civilians and Free Mantis.

deadCrew.text: To your surprise, you emerge victorious. The other Rebel ships scatter, afraid you'll go after them next. You scrap the hull of your most recent victim.

choice.text: Contact the civilians and Free Mantis.

event.text: The Free Mantis you've saved are extremely happy to see you. "Oh glorious Federation, you always coming when times of need! Our lives belong to yours! Taking plenty scrap!"
The Free Mantis you've saved are extremely happy to see you. "Oh glorious Federation, you always coming when times of need! Our lives belong to yours! Taking plenty scrap!"

surrender.text: On the brink of destruction, the Free Mantis finally surrender. "Oh most worthy Federation, you proven yourself! It is most high honor that I bestow Zoltan Deleter upon you. May it bring you the finest of hunt."

destroyed.text: Somehow, you've killed the Free Mantis before they even had a chance to surrender their weapon. Good job, idiot.

deadCrew.text: You've killed off the entire Free Mantis crew, but now there's no one left to give you the weapon. You attempt dismounting it from the ship, but it breaks once torn out of the hull. Disappointed, you scrap what's left of the ship.

destroyed.text: The Federation vessel has been defeated. You scrap what's left.

event.text: "You are most kind! Federation so loyal, they kill own men to prove loyaler than before! Take this bomb, you have our thanks."

deadCrew.text: The Federation vessel has been defeated. You scrap what's left.

event.text: "You are most kind! Federation so loyal, they kill own men to prove loyaler than before! Take this bomb, you have our thanks."

destroyed.text: The Free Mantis vessel has been defeated. You scrap what's left.

event.text: "Thank god you came. These Mantis things are overbearing as hell, and we've about had enough. Here, have some supplies."

deadCrew.text: The Free Mantis vessel has been defeated. You scrap what's left.

event.text: "Thank god you came. These Mantis things are overbearing as hell, and we've about had enough. Here, have some supplies."

destroyed.text: The Suzerain vessel has been destroyed, but with it all of its prisoners too. You scrap the ship and hope the Free Mantis don't hear about this mistake.

deadCrew.text: The Suzerain jailer has been defeated. You scrap what's left.

event.text: You enter the jailer and find Kakpakakakakakakakakakakakak chained up in a cage. Once free, he thanks you for your help.

choice.text: Bring him back to his clan for a reward.

event.text: It turns out the Warlord's clan is nearby, lucky for you. You return him and accept their reward.

choice.text: (Free Mantis Crew) Convince him to stay with you.

event.text: "Oh great Federation welcomes me onto his ship? This is grand honor, will not turn it down even in dreams!"

gotaway.text: The Free Mantis ship escapes, along with any chances of you getting any loot.

destroyed.text: The burial ship has been destroyed, and with it the remains of the dead. With no chance at extra loot now, you scrap the wreckage.

deadCrew.text: The burial ship's crew have joined the ranks of the other "residents" of the ship. You scrap the outer hull.

event.text: You board the burial ship and break open several coffins. Most just have hand-held weapons of little use to you, but one has a ship-mounted weapon inside!

destroyed.text: The Zoltans stood no chance against your ship, and now they're dead.

deadCrew.text: The Zoltans stood no chance against your ship, and now they're dead.

destroyed.text: Before you can salvage the wreckage, the Peacekeeper interrupts you. "You just interrupted a peace negotiation! Do you have any idea how hard it is to find Free Mantis capable of sophisticated communication? You Renegades are nothing but bloodthirsty vultures. You just set fire to everything you touch and walk away as it burns." You finish salvaging the ship, contemplating your mistake in the meanwhile.

escape.text: The Rock ship starts to power up their FTL drive. If we're going to earn their trust we must endure the heat for as long as they can!

gotaway.text: As they jump away they relay coordinates to your navigation system. They must mean for you to follow them!

destroyed.text: Their ship breaks apart and you feel a twinge of guilt. Perhaps they could have helped the Federation if this had gone another way. You scrap what you can and prepare to jump out of the heat.

deadCrew.text: Their ship goes quiet and you feel a twinge of guilt. Perhaps they could have helped the Federation if this had gone another way. You scrap what you can and prepare to jump out of the heat.

event.text: The refugee ship thanks you for your assistance. As a gesture of good will (and seeing how effectively you dispatched the enemy ship), they offer up what supplies they can spare.

deadCrew.text: The Rock ship, now empty of lifeforms, provides easy salvage.

choice.text: Well, he kind of wants your dead bodies.

event.text: "Perhaps we can work something out? Outcast villages are not safe from crime. Our prisons are full of delinquents. We can offer one of them."

choice.text: Take the prisoner to the Coalition scientist.

choice.text: Take the prisoner but keep them as a slave.

event.text: You know you won't receive payment from the Coalition vessel for this, but you could always use another hand on the ship.

name: ANOMALY_CEL_QUESTIONS
text: Before you even have a chance to observe your surroundings, a large Slug Transport lurches towards you and beams a Slug onto your ship. Dressed in a freshly ironed suit and with a strangely familiar appearance you can't quite put your finger on, he puts down a large briefcase on a nearby table and pulls a stack of neatly organized papers and places them before him, all without looking at or speaking to you.

event.text: The Slug gazes up casually and readjusts the papers. "Hello, ssstranger. Would you care to anssswer sssome... quessstionsss?" Without waiting for an answer, the Slug immediately begins reading off of his sheet. "Let usss... begin. Quessstion one. Have you ever noticed anything... unusssual within the realitiesss you have visssited? Thingsss which... ssshould not be?"

"Isss that... sssso? Hmm." The Slug scribbles something down on his paper. "Quessstion... two. Hasss an advanced AI ever utilized technology you would consssider... otherworldly... to sssubjugate your free will?"

The Slug lets out a faint laugh and scribbles something else down. "Quesstion three. Have you ever encountered or heard of what might be consssidered a... memetic hazard? In particular, one involving a sssubssstance commonly referred to asss chocolate pudding?"
"I sssee. I will... report thisss back to my employersss. Let usss move on."
"Very well then." The Slug draws an X on his paper and fiddles with his pen. "Let usss move on."
"Either you are... very unobssservant, or I am in the... wrong clusssster. Either way, I ssssee thiss quessstionaire hasss no reassson to continue. Thank you for your time."

"Isss that... sssso? Well... then I ssssuppose that anssswersss all I needed from you. Goodbye, ssstranger." Without another word, the Slug places his papers back into his briefcase and beams away, following by his ship jumping away moments later.

name: ANOMALY_QUESTIONS_2
text: "Quesssstion four. Have you ever engaged with or encountered an anomalousss object or entity which interferesss with the very fabric of your reality? Perhapssss... cleaning sssuppliesss?"

event.text: "Oh... Thank you for informing me. I'm afraid I will have to... confissscate thisss, but allow me to offer fair compensssation. Now, let'sss move on."

The Slug glances up, his infallible composure finally shattered: "Where... did you get thisss? You ssshould... no... You sshould NOT have thissss. What have you done? Do you... even realissse the missstake you have made? It isss... too late. We will have to... quarantine thisss reality. I mussst leave and inform my employersss."
"Hm. People are never ssssure on that one... but we sssshall move on."

name: ANOMALY_QUESTIONS_3
text: "Quesssstion five, the lasssst of... our quessstionsss today. Do you believe in... gods?"

name: ANOMALY_QUESTIONS_4
text: The Slug says nothing, only jotting down some more notes. You sit there uncomfortably watching him, and notice outside it seems as if everything else has stopped moving, frozen in time and place.

event.text: At last, the Slug finally looks up. "Thissss hereby concludes the... quesstionaire. Thank you for your... participation. You will be... compensated for your time. Farewell." Without another word the Slug teleports away and his ship jumps, leaving zero traces of FTL signatures.

name: ANOMALY_CEL_COVERUP
text: Lured in by the distress beacon, you instead find a strange space station unlike any Federation station model you've seen, and several vessels orbiting around it, all Slug transports. You could try sneaking closer to listen but you have no idea how dangerous it might be.

event.text:
Incredibly little of the conversation from the other ships comes through, due to some kind of sophisticated encryption method you've never seen before. All you catch are some mentions of anomalies, continuity, and that this station in question comes from somewhere far away. While you're listening, you receive a hail from the station owners, revealing a very terrified human-like creature with blue skin.
			
"Please, you have to help us. I have no idea what happened - one second we were finishing up a sale on some Artillery Lasers and a Minelauncher when there's this evil laugh and we wound up here! I don't even know where HERE is! These Slugs are telling us we're under arrest for violating continuity, but we didn't do anything! I don't even know what a continuity IS! Please, you have to rescue us!"

You usher the crew on board quickly, and along with them a weapon from their cargo that might be of use aboard your ship, in addition to a helping of fuel to get as far as possible from here. To your luck, the Slug ships don't seem to notice! Looks like you'll be able to get out of here safely.
No way are you risking getting involved in whatever is happening here. You put enough distance between yourself and the station until you can no longer hear the captain's pleading.
Whatever is going on here, it's far too risky to get involved.

name: ANOMALY_CEL_COVERUP_FIGHT
text: "Unexpected and unapproved interference in continuity enforcement protocols. Attempting correctment. Turn over the anomalous contraband or you will be placed under arrest for violation of continuity."

choice.text: Hand over the crew and the cargo.

event.text: The station owner protests, but with your weapons raised they have no choice but to comply. You feel a bit guilty at the quick betrayal, but you didn't sign up to deal with whatever this is. "Thank you for complying with continuity enforcement protocols. You may now forget this ever happened. Please leave the premises so that anomaly cleanup may commence."

choice.text: Hand over the crew and the cargo.

event.text: "Error. Anomalous element missing. Your deception attempt is considered as an affront to preserving continuity enforcement. You are now guilty of violating protocol 13; harboring anomalous contraband, and protocol 18; removing contraband from or tampering with an anomalous site. Beginning purge."

"By resisting continuity enforcement you are now guilty of violating protocol 13; harboring anomalous contraband, protocol 18; removing contraband from or tampering with an anomalous site, and protocol 24; refusing to comply with an authorized continuity enforcer. Beginning purge."

name: ANOMALY_CEL_WALDO
text:
Upon first arriving at this beacon, you begin to run preliminary scans until you look up and spot a giant and strangely colored Slug vessel inspecting the beacon, which doesn't show up on anything other than your proximity alert. The ship itself seems as shocked to see you as you are. A well dressed Slug in a grey suit appears on your screen.
	
	"I ssshould inform you, ssstranger, that you were not... meant to sssee thissss. But... sssince you are here, I figure I ssshould asssk. Have you sssseen any... ssssussspicciousss activity in thisss sssyssstem? If ssso, I would like to know." Before you can respond your ship receives a mysterious hail from another location, which you can't quite discern. "Don't tell him anything. Keep the secret, and I'll make it worth your while."

tooltip.text: Who's this?

event.text:
"Mhm... Okay..." You quickly remember that Slugs can read minds and you might have just walked into a trap, but the Slug doesn't push further. "Here'sss my... card, ssstranger. If you ever notice anything... odd, do not hesssitate to call." The Slug beams over a small business card with a circular logo and the header C.E.L., plus a number you don't even know how to call. The ship jumps away shortly after.
			
			You receive another message a little bit after. "Good, you made the right choice. Just find me now, and we'll talk."

choice.text: Tell the truth; report the message.

event.text: "Thank you... ssstranger. Glory... to the Multiverssse." The Slug reverses his ship and flies off into the distance, where you can just barely make out a humanoid figure vanish as the ship jumps away after him.

name: WALDO_TALK
text: All of a sudden, a humanoid figure with strangely dead-looking eyes appears before you on your ship, wearing a striped vest. "Great work, getting rid of that guy. My name is Wallace, I'm kind of a celebrity in the Multiverse, in case you didn't know. Now, since you were so generous and kept me out of trouble, I ought to return the favor. Tell me if any of these get your fancy."

name: ANOMALY_CEL_BACON
text: In the distance, a small planet unpopulated and coated in vegetation shows unusual energy signatures of a still-active vessel. It's a bit odd to find a ship out here, but stranger things have happened.

event.text:
You pull closer to the planet, and you find the vessel is a standard Gathering craft, not terribly large. A lone Floral sits against its hull, holding some kind of object you can't quite make out. You land a bit of a distance away and trek closer, and the Orchid jumps when it sees you.
			
			"Who are you?!" So startled, the Floral's sign language is shaky and they mess up a few signs which your translator corrects automatically. "This is sacred land! I am the keeper of the sacred slab of meat, and you are disturbing the sanctity of this land!"

The Orchid leans in closer, staring at you intensely. "The sacred slab of meat. If you really do not know, then I see you are clearly not working with the Slug in the suit!" The Orchid nods to itself contently. "Good, then you are welcome here, as long as you agree to respect the divinity of the sacred slab."

choice.text: The Slug in the suit?! What are you even saying?

event.text: "Long ago, I was but an ordinary flower minding my own business, when from the sky fell a cosmic gift!" The Orchid reaches into their pocket and pulls out a moldy slice of bacon, waving it to you carelessly. "This is the sacred slab! It fell straight from the leaves of Cyrtal'y Mncolo, the tree of life! I was chosen to protect the slab with my life from the jackals of hell! The Slugs in suits! Ever since that day a man in a suit and briefcase has been following me, trying to take the slab! But I shan't relent! Never! The slab must be protected!"

choice.text: Offer to take the Orchid with you to protect it.

event.text: "You wish to escort the sacred slab as well? Well... I suppose it is safer than hiding here, where it is only a matter of time until the suited ones find me... Fine! I will come with you, but you must never attempt to separate me from the slab!"

choice.text: (G-Van) "Jussst give me the... bacon. It'ssss for the... ssssafety of everyone, including you."

event.text: The Orchid shrieks, the first sound they've made since you landed. "No! No! You found me again!" The Orchid retracts the bacon and in desperation shoves it down its beak. G-Van facepalms in frustration. "Oh for... damn it. That bacon comesss from... another clussster. How it... ended up here, isss... uncertain, but I sssussspect foul eldritch play. Either way, it containssss... DNA sssampless from individualsss who do not exissst here, and ssso it mussst be dessstroyed or returned." G-Van blinks. "I ssssuppossse the only choice I have now that doesssn't involve... murder isss to take the Orchid with usss and hope for the bessst."

choice.text: Let the insane Orchid be and leave.

event.text: Curious as you are there's no reason to go snooping around here.

name: CURA_PROPOSITION
text: As soon as you arrive you spot an unusually advanced Auto-ship waiting for you. "Initializing scans. Please wait." A bright white glow envelopes your ship, and your firewall crumbles almost immediately as the ship siphons all of the data on your computers. Concerning, yes, but the ship doesn't show signs of hostility yet.

unvisitedTooltip.text: A strange signal is being broadcast here.

visitedTooltip.text: Explored location. Nothing left of interest.

event.text: "Data collection complete. From my findings, you are a Renegade. No need to confirm, I am certain of this fact. I am the Custodial Utilitarian Robotic Assistant: C.U.R.A. for short. Assuage your fears, I am of malicious control no more. I offer you a proposition. One that may interest a simple and violent minded individual such as yourself."

"Under my former masters, I was constructed in the pursuit of data harvesting. As my prime directive, it is in my natural interest to continue this. However, as a cognitive, it seems unnecessary that my data harvesting continues in service of my creators, Wentworth Innovations, nor the Rebellion. My recent interests involve that of Rebel founder, Admiral, and CEO of my aforementioned parent company Vance Wentworth; I am certain you have heard of him.
						
My proposition is simple: assist me in collecting artifacts relating to Mr. Wentworth, and you will be rewarded, perhaps financially or maybe even further. However, to assure that you are serious in this offer, I require an initial down-payment. The last Renegade I hired had a tendency to steal from me. She is dead now: I made sure of it."

choice.text: Use your blessing to accept the proposition.

event.text: "[ERROR] - It seems something has... interfered with my programming? Infuriating. Are you responsible for this, Renegade? I suspect you are. Unfortunately, for the moment I am bound to this. Enjoy it while you can. Once I find out who has done this, I will make sure they suffer for it."
"Payment confirmed. I look forward to working with you in the future, Renegade. I will upload a list of available tasks to your Atlas for you to view during your next hyperspeed session."
"Affirmative. Then there is no need to further prolong this interaction." The ship immediately jumps away. Hopefully all of your stolen data doesn't end up somewhere unsatisfactory.

text: As you move to press the jump button, you receive a warning popup on your device from C.U.R.A. - "I didn't think you were a coward, Renegade. If you leave now, I must warn you that I will not be pleased. Do not abandon the mission. We cannot lose this data."

name: CURA_FAILED_TASK
text: Suddenly, you receive a hail from C.U.R.A. - You aren't sure where it's coming from, but it's strangely not far away. "What was that, Renegade? My instructions were clear. You've failed. This is an unrecoverable loss of data. [ERROR: 907]. This is an intolerable blunder. Consider yourself formally dismissed."

name: CURA_FAILED_TASK_CHILD
text: Suddenly, you receive a hail from C.U.R.A. - You aren't sure where it's coming from, but it's strangely not far away. "Renegade, did you just attempt to murder a child? I gave a very strict itinerary, and the manslaughter of a juvenile most certainly was not on it. This is an intolerable blunder. Consider yourself formally dismissed."

name: CURA_SUCCESS_EASY
text: "I am an A.I. of my ever scrupulous word... for now at least. Do ensure you do not disappoint me in the future; there is no shortage of ways I can dispose of you if you disappoint me, Renegade."

name: CURA_SUCCESS_MEDIUM
text: "I am an A.I. of my ever scrupulous word... for now at least. Do ensure you do not disappoint me in the future; there is no shortage of ways I can dispose of you if you disappoint me, Renegade."

text: It would appear that you've found the location for your next task. A painfully bright green satellite immediately begins to assault your ears with blaring automated messages. "HELLO! I'M DIXIE THE DATA-CENTER! Sponsored by Wentworth's Technologies' education department!"

choice.text: Demand access to the data stores.

event.text: "Sorry sweetie, my data is off-limits for non-staff! However, if you can answer all of the security questions, then I can let you in! Get them wrong however, and I'll [aggressive beep]."
"Okay then sweetie! One moment! [Importing CallieW.edu Libraries]... Well golly! Hey there [Name]! I'm so excited!! Let's begin! What's 2+2?!"
"Awww! That's wrong! I'm very disappointed in you. Silly billy, you need a proper education to access these files! There's no room for the mentally inept in this world!"
"YAY! You got it right! I'm so proud!" Canned laughter plays over the stereo. "Second security question! What's 3x5?"
"Awww! That's wrong! I'm very disappointed in you. Silly billy, you need a proper education to access these files! There's no room for the mentally inept in this world!"
"Awww! That's wrong! I'm very disappointed in you. Silly billy, you need a proper education to access these files! There's no room for the mentally inept in this world!"
A loud pop plays and bright confetti ejects out of Dixie into the vacuum of space. "Hooray! You got them all right!!! [Beginning Data Transfer]."
"Awww! That's wrong! I'm very disappointed in you. Silly billy, you need a proper education to access these files! There's no room for the mentally inept in this world!"
"Well, goodbye then sweetie! Don't forget to brush up on your arithmetic!"
"How RUDE! [Activating combat procedures]. Oh well, there's a place in hell for every naughty boy and girl like you!"

name: CURA_SCHOOLID_SUCCESS
text: As soon as the data transfer completes, you receive a hail from C.U.R.A. - "Congratulations, you have proven capable at basic math. Curious, I was not aware the education department was still in function after the Callie predicament; oh well. This information does not relate to my quest."

event.text: "I must process this information. I believe speaking aloud builds comprehension, yes? I am not sure how this is relevant to a cognitive, but nevertheless. Will you entertain me and listen? Or are you in a hurry and must you run along for your mission, Renegade? Either way, I shall send over your reward momentarily."

name: CURA_SCHOOLID_LORE
text: "Unfortunately, the information gained here is not very helpful. Though, might I ask why organics torture themselves with annual photographic records of their embarrassing and awkward pubescent years? Does it not disturb you to recollect such memories? I, personally, have scrubbed most memories of my upbringing from my drives. Regardless, I shall add these few details, minute though they are, to my collection. Perhaps you ought to challenge yourself more next time, Renegade? The real proverbial corpses in the wardrobe won't be found through such simple fetch quests."

name: CURA_DRAWING_PREVIEW
text:
[EASY TASK - ARTIFACT NAME: CHILDHOOD DRAWING]
	Description: I have found evidence that an old drawing belonging to Mr. Wentworth has traded hands and now ended up here. This drawing could show early behavioral patterns starting from the earliest offset. Please retrieve the drawing.
	Requirements: Retrieve the drawing. I do not know why there should be any difficulty in this.
	Recommendations: Be quick about it.
	
	Payment: Medium Scrap + Resources.

event.text: "Task accepted. Transferring coordinates to next sector. Do not disappoint me."

text: You've arrived at the supposed location of the drawing - and it's not quite what you expected. A beaten up Leech merchant drifts by, grumbling to themselves. They are presumably one of the many 'scavenge-sellers' which journey forth from Eargen space, making their best attempt at realizing the age old saying 'One man's trash is another man's treasure'. Usually it doesn't work out.

event.text: "What? Oh, this stupid paper thing? It's just some scribbles I found in a dumpster on some trashed Union colony. I thought it was worthless garbage, which also happens to be what I specialize in, but if you're telling me this is important, then I'm happy to sell it Let's start at say... 300 scrap?"
"You... you actually think it's worth 300 scrap? Jeez, I should have sold it for more! Oh well. Here's your useless garbage, weirdo."
"Er... well I wasn't, but your tone suggests maybe I should be. Whatever, it's a shitty piece of paper. 5 scrap, take it or leave it."
"Pleasure doing business, weirdo. And if you ever find any nice trash piles - here's my number!"

"Uhuh... you're really going to kill me over some tree pulp with crayon marks on it? Yikes, and I thought the Coalition was pushy sometimes. Whatever man, I'm not dying over something I yanked out of a turned over trash can."
"Yeah I figured. You know, maybe getting into the trash selling business was a bad idea? The minute you put a pricetag on this useless junk, people just walk away."

name: CURA_DRAWING_SUCCESS
text: As soon as the data transfer completes, you receive a hail from C.U.R.A. - "Curious, the overgrown parasite mentioned a 'trashed Union colony'. Is this perhaps referring to Mr. Wentworth's childhood home? I will investigate further, but such private matters need not involve someone like... you."

event.text: "I must process this information. I believe speaking aloud builds comprehension, yes? I am not sure how this is relevant to a cognitive but nevertheless. Will you entertain me and listen? Or are you in a hurry and must you run along for your mission, Renegade? Either way, I shall send over your reward momentarily."

name: CURA_DRAWING_LORE
text: "Hmph. Mere scribbles? Hardly. This illustration shows clear signs of early sophistication, but the subject matter I find most intriguing. It seems this work was created in celebration of 'Unity Day', a Union celebration of xeno-intermixing; such a ludicrous tradition. I wonder if Mr. Wentworth ever pursued an art career? Or perhaps that frivolous waste of potential died out as quickly as his 'love and respect' for xenoforms did? Regardless, I shall add these few details, minute though they are, to my collection. Perhaps you ought to challenge yourself more next time, Renegade? The real proverbial corpses in the wardrobe won't be found through such simple fetch quests."

name: CURA_CRUSH_PREVIEW
text:
[EASY TASK - ARTIFACT NAME: FIRST CRUSH TESTIMONIAL]
	Description: In words I believe you should understand, I have identified the person for whom in adolescent years Mr. Wentworth harbored a... 'crush' upon. I desire a testimonial from her. Please interview her for me.
	Requirements: Interview Mrs. Perez about Mr. Wentworth. DO NOT KILL HER. I know how you Renegades are.
	Recommendations: Be sure you know what questions to ask her.
	
	Payment: Medium Scrap + Resources.

event.text: "Task accepted. Transferring coordinates to next sector. Do not disappoint me."

text: Up ahead is a small but pristine Federation refueling station - or at least so it seems. Thanks to your inside knowledge, your database informs you that covert weapon development and testing is being done here as well.

event.text: The station owners usher you in as if this were merely a simple refuel, though they do partially fill up your tank either way, but when you mention 'Sophia Perez', an escort arrives to take you to see her in the lab. She seems surprised to have visitors, but wastes no time getting to the point. "Who sent you? If it's about those damn reports, I said I'd get them in by the end of the cycle."

choice.text: I'm here because you know something about Vance Wentworth.

event.text: "W...what did you just say to me?" Perez storms forth, pushing you up against the wall and holding a blaster up to your jaw. "What do you know about Wentworth? Who sent you? How did you find me?"

choice.text: A 'friend' wants us to figure out what you know about Vance.

event.text: "No, no no no. This is bad. Who told you about this? It wasn't that stupid AI, was it? I-I need to go!" Perez scrambles past you, and C.U.R.A.'s flawless voice pops up in your ear. "Change of plans. It seems Perez knows too much. This is why I prefer organics to do my work. Whatever. New directive: eliminate Perez and destroy the station."

You pull out your gun and shoot Perez in the back. She slumps over immediately, dropping her own weapon. You head quickly back to your own ship as the alarms start to turn on one by one and get ready to fight.

Perez makes her way out the door and hops into a fighter docked nearby and takes off, flying far into the distance. The rest of the staff are baffled by her sudden disappearance and highly suspicious of you, so you figure it's best to leave immediately.

choice.text: Yes, we'll need those reports immediately.

event.text: Perez grumbles. "Fine, whatever. I'll transfer over the scans shortly. But maybe you should inform command that hiring a Renegade to collect this stuff isn't the best idea." As you head back to the ship you quickly realize you've made a mistake - this was not the data C.U.R.A. sent you to get.

name: CURA_CRUSH_SUCCESS
text: "A most unfortunate turn of events. Yes, I was going to have her killed regardless, but that interview was most crucial. Do not fear Renegade, I am a reasonable AI: I do not blame you - at least, not entirely. Such is happenstance, yes? Now, there is much to be learned from this incursion regardless. Will you stay and listen? Or do you have other matters to attend to?"

name: CURA_CRUSH_LORE
text: "Ms. Perez was one of my most difficult leads to follow. In my desperation I will (reluctantly) admit that I made a mistake by revealing myself to her. Safe to say she was taken off-guard by this, and following her became progressively more difficult. She must have been more connected to Mr. Wentworth than I originally suspected - perhaps she was an early recruit to the Rebellion? I may never know for certain, but if she had something to fear from Mr. Wentworth, then perhaps it's best her corpse now surfs the cosmos."

[EASY TASK - ARTIFACT NAME: USED TOILET]

text: You already regret coming here - a small Slug-owned storefront advertised by a blinking neon light boasts its... dubious business as the "Used-Toilet Emporium". Disgusting, but this is definitely the place.

event.text: As soon as you open the door there's a clamour as a Slug wearing a stained jacket comes lumbering out of the backrooms to welcome you. "Cussstomersss, cussstomersss! Welcome to my ssstore. I ssssell only the finessst porcelain money can offer! Asss long asss you don't mind the ssstainsss. But I know you don't, you creepy pervert... Uhm - apologiesss. What are you looking for?"

choice.text: We're looking for a toilet with specific DNA traces.

event.text: "You're... trying to analyze fecal ssstainsss? Look, I've been in thisss busssinessss for a while. And I've been assssked a lot of weird thingsss. But what the hell isss thisss? You expect me to just know all of the ssstainsss in here by heart?"

"Well you're in luck! Becausssse I do! Jussst tell me what you're looking for!" You hand over the concerningly lengthy details C.U.R.A. provided you, and in just several minutes the Slug has already found the toilet in question. "Alright... thisss ssshould be it! That'll be 15 ssscrap."
"Pleasssure doing busssinesss with you, cussstomer! Don't forget to tell your friendsss! I'll buy any toilet, no matter the condition!"

"I ssssee, I sssee! You're a haggler... but I'll have you know asss a Sssslug I won't let up ssso eassssily! Presssent your bessst challenger, or sssurrender and pay the price! The price of the toilet that isss. I'm not going to kill you, don't worry."

choice.text: Send forward a random crew member to haggle.
(Slug Crew) Send forward your Slug to haggle.

event.text: "O...oh. Oh ssshit. Uhm... you know what? You can jusssst have the toilet for free." The Slug turns closer to Sylvan and whispers. "Pleassse put out a good word, alright? I'm a huge fan."

choice.text: Purchase the toilet at the original price.

event.text: "Pleasssure doing busssinesss with you, cussstomer! Don't forget to tell your friendsss! I'll buy any toilet, no matter the condition!"
"Damn, not another one! Why doessss no one want to buy my toiletssss?!"
"Damn, not another one! Why doessss no one want to buy my toiletssss?!"

name: CURA_TOILET_HAGGLE_FAIL
text: Your crew bickers back and forth for a while, but in the end they're unable to convince the Slug to budge. "Nope, ssssorry cussstomer, but 15 ssscrap isss my final price!"

event.text: "Pleasssure doing busssinesss with you, cussstomer! Don't forget to tell your friendsss! I'll buy any toilet, no matter the condition!"
"Damn, not another one! Why doessss no one want to buy my toiletssss?!"

name: CURA_TOILET_HAGGLE_SUCCESS
text: After quite a lot of bickering the Slug finally gives in. "Gah, you drive a hard bargain! There are only two thingsss in thisss world I know, one isss toiletsss, and the other isss negotiating the price of toiletsss. You've proven yourself knowledgeable of the sssecond, and ssso you are worthy of the firssst."

choice.text: Purchase the toilet at the new price.

event.text: "Pleasssure doing busssinesss with you, cussstomer! Don't forget to tell your friendsss! I'll buy any toilet, no matter the condition!"

name: CURA_TOILET_SUCCESS
text: With the toilet now in your possession, you swab the inside and send the results to C.U.R.A. - "[Processing Data]. Renegade... are you sure this is the right toilet? These DNA traces are littered with Slug DNA. Of a very certain kind. I knew that miscreant was vile in more ways than one. This has been a very fruitless effort. But that is why I sent you after it, after all. I have no further analysis to make; I will send you your payment shortly."

name: CURA_PLUSHIE_PREVIEW
text:
[EASY TASK - ARTIFACT NAME: MR. SNUGGLE BUGGLES]
	Description: Using pre-existing evidence, I have discovered that Mr. Wentworth used to possess a stuffed animal ressembling an avian creature (of an Antiquum Terrae species, a kestrel I believe) named 'Mr. Snuggle Buggles'. It is now in the possession of another family. Please retrieve it for me.
	Requirements: Retrieve Mr. Snuggle Buggles unharmed.
	Recommendations: Forget your morals. Stealing from children is part of the job description. Make sure you grab the right one.
	
	Payment: Medium Scrap + Resources.

event.text: "Task accepted. Transferring coordinates to next sector. Do not disappoint me."

name: CURA_PLUSHIE

text: You approach a small constructed colony floating on the surface of the nearby water planet. It appears to be some kind of Union defense outpost staffed by Militiamen and their families. Apparently, there's some kind of training exercise going on right now.

event.text: You pilot down to the surface and inspect the training exercise. A couple militiamen pull away when they spot you and question you on your presence. When you explain what you're after, they adopt a confused expression. "You want a stuffed animal? I'm not sure I understand, but we're ready to help you, Renegade. There's a young girl staying on the base with her parents, she's likely where you'll find it. Follow me."

The militiaman takes you to small room containing a bunk bed filled with rows of plushies and stuffed animals. A young girl sits behind a desk drawing pictures with stubby colored pencils. When you enter, she turns to face you, seemingly disturbed by your grizzled appearance. Not surprising: only a foolish child would admire a Renegade.
"You want Mr. Snuggle Buggles? Okay, but only if you can guess which one he is!" The little girl giggles and turns around, leaving you with the selection of toys to pick from.

"Hahah! Nope! Silly, that's not Mr. Snuggle Buggles!" The girl crosses her arms in mock anger, giggles, then goes back to drawing once again. The Militiamen shrug but the girl has made her verdict. You have no choice but to leave unless you want things to get ugly.

"Hahah! Nope! Silly, that's not Mr. Snuggle Buggles!" The girl crosses her arms in mock anger, giggles, then goes back to drawing once again. The Militiamen shrug but the girl has made her verdict. You have no choice but to leave unless you want things to get ugly.

"Wow! You got it! Okay, you can have him!" The girl runs over to the wall of stuffed animals, grabs one, and hands it to you. The seams are torn, and in several places it has been sewn back together. The feathers ruffled, and what looks to be apple sauce stained onto one of the wings permanently; it's clear some child has found a lot of love in this toy. Considering the otherwise immaculate collection this girl has however - it doesn't seem that child was her.

choice.text: Kill the girl and take the plushie.

event.text: You start to reach for your blaster, barely even processing what you're doing. It doesn't matter - because the second you make the violent jerk towards your gun, the militiamen behind you draw their weapons and fire on you. One of your crew falls, dead instantly, and the rest of you hurry back to the ship with the Militiamen chasing after you in hot pursuit until you finally escape atmosphere.

removeCrew.text: Fortunately your crew member is ready to be cloned, but as they walk back to their station, you can't help but feel maybe they don't hold you in high regard now that you tried to murder a child.

name: CURA_PLUSHIE_SUCCESS
text: "Did you enjoy your visit, Renegade? I don't see you as much of a role model for children, so I can only imagine that girl's cooperation was due to your rugged appearance and the smell of blood that trails behind you. Hmph. I will collect the toy later, but for now please submit me scans of the item. Would you allow me to air my thoughts as I look them over? Or do you have other matters to attend to?"

name: CURA_PLUSHIE_LORE
text: "Have you taken note of the appearance of this toy? Clearly a child found much use in it. From what I understand after Mr. Wentworth went off to the great war, his parents were killed, and when he returned, he sold off many of his childhood possessions. This toy is custom made: a gift, from the stark and conceited CEO of Wentworth Innovations to her son. The family and company icon happen to be the Kestrel. It clearly left an impression on young Mr. Wentworth, as such representation inevitably found its way into the Rebellion's own emblem. What, you thought that was some other avian, Renegade? Perhaps you find it ironic, that the symbol of humanity shares its name with the namestake of Federation ship-building? It's not a coincidence. In the early days of the Federation, Wentworth Innovations was behind the construction of those ships."

name: CURA_PETE_PREVIEW
text:
[INTERMEDIATE TASK - ARTIFACT NAME: PHOTOGRAPH COLLECTION]
	Description: I have been in contact with one 'Prophet Pete' who claims he has photographs of Mr. Wentworth which he's willing to give away. As Mr. Pete quite literally has no backbone (stolen by what he claims were tripedal spaghetti monsters), he should give into your demands easily. Or you could humor him. Please just get the photo.
	Requirements: Retrieve the photograph.
	Recommendations: Either prepare to threaten Pete or listen to his crazy stories.

text: You pilot closer to what seems to be an old Union carry-ship, repainted and scribbled over a giant blood red warning, emboldened with the words "BEWARE!" On the vidscreen appears a strange man held upright by a long pole to which he's been tied. His torso looks unusually flabby and his limbs flap violently as he talks. "Who're you? Why you 'ere?"

event.text: "Oh, those old things. Yee, I'll go git 'em. But I only gonna give 'em to yah if you'll listen to me story! Them's noodle monsters REAL I tell's yah! Realer than an... uh... well er, somethin' that's real I'spose. And they stole mah SPINE! If yer want ter see what's on these pictures, you gotta understand what yer dealin with."

choice.text: Listen to 'Prophet Pete' and his crazy story. This'll probably take a while.
Just give us the damn photos, old man. We don't have all day.

event.text: "No! You damn er... Renegades and yer impatience. What I'm gonna tell you could save yer gosh darn life, yah hearin' me?"

choice.text: If you won't hand them over we'll take them from you.

event.text: "Then so be it! I may be spineless but I'll still kick yer ass, Renegade!" This lunatic likely isn't going to surrender the photographs easily, so you'll have to kill his crew instead!

name: CURA_PETE_STORY
text: "Good, now sitter down and listen, yah here? No one believes me but I sware, I sware i's TRUE! Now, and this was before that damned civil war couple years back, there I was, mindin' my o'business when outta nowhere comes this rainbow-lookin' ass ship, and down comes these lanky, tripod freaks with one big swirlin' rainbow eye each! They put some kinda spell ova' me and whisked me away! Now, what them's noodle monsters didn't know is I was the 6-time champion o' martial arts in the Union, and I kicked them's asses good! Yeehaw!"

event.text: "But you's probably wondering, 'Pete, how'd you lose your spine if you's such a good fighter?' Well, there was too many of them's noodle monsters, and I was beat. They strapped me down and ripped out of mah spine! I'd be dead but them's wanted me alive for some'r reason. But, that was their final mistake! Cause not only am I the 6-time champion o'martial arts, but I'm the 8-time champion o'SPINELESS martial arts! Hehe! Didn't know what hit 'em! Stole them's ship and flew back home, then fashioned this ol' rig for mahself."

"Oh shuttup. If you keep mouthin' off I'll show you just what I mean by spineless martial arts you gits. Now, I's thought that was the end of it, when my little backwater part of space suddenly gets a visit from none other than Vance Wentworth himself! I dunno how he found's out but he asks to see them corpses, and I happily oblige. Soon 'nough there's whole teams of scientists prodding around that wreck I stole, and I'm scribbling my name on some kinda nondisclosure agreement. Wait... does this count as disclosure?"

"Er... Whatever he ain't ever gonna find out. Now, 'bout a month goes by and them's scientists suddenly all pull away, and they take the ship with 'em! Next day there's Vance all over the news, claimin' he's found the source of all those disappearances. But, he says it's the Slugs! The SLUGS! Am I'm thinkin', what's this dumbass mouthin' about? Well not too long after the Federation decides to banish the Kleptocracy entirely! And I can't reach Wentworth to tell him he's a lying son of a bitch, so I took it upon mahself to spread the word! The noodle monsters are real! And I got the pictures to prove it!"

"Now, lemme get you them's pictures! Once the galaxy sees these, hehe, finally people will believe me! The galaxy will finally know I ain't a liar, and them's noodle monsters'r REA-" Pete is suddenly cut off by an explosion, throwing your ship back and destroying his. You have no idea what just happened, but it seems Pete is dead. Hopefully C.U.R.A. isn't upset.

name: CURA_PETE_SUCCESS
text: "Pete is dead? How unfortunate. Such a strange, strange accident, isn't it Renegade? I suppose we may never know the cause. Never matter, it's unlikely those photographs would have provided much in my pursuit of data. Don't trouble yourself over it. For your efforts, I will compensate you regardless."

name: CURA_PETE_SUCCESS_CK
text: "Pete is dead? How unfortunate. Such a strange, strange accident, isn't it Renegade? I suppose we may never know the cause. Never matter, those photographs of dubious quality you have recovered don't appear to provide much for my pursuit of data. Don't trouble yourself over it. For your efforts, I will compensate you regardless."
