text: You've found the meetup location - and a smuggler ship already awaits your arrival. From the name 'Grease Swizzler' you expect quite the man to await you, but instead you find a relatively normal looking Zoltan captain. "So, you're the Renegade that AI sent, yeah? What business you got dealing with a soulless droid anyways?"

choice.text: We do random fetch quests for it.
I kinda forgot. I don't pay attention much.

name: CURA_USB_BETRAYAL
text: "Right, whatever. Forget I asked. The AI's already made a deal to transfer payment once I hand over the 'cargo' to you. You ready?"

event.text: Once the cargo is in your possession, you pry it open - only for an EMP burst to suddenly cripple your engines! "Oh, so sorry, but you see, I don't work for Argeonn anymore buddy. I'm with the Syndicate now, and you've got quite the bounty on your head. Hm, I wonder what Wentworth will pay me if I bring him both your head and his little drive?" Seems you'll have to fight your way out of this one, but don't worry about destroying the ship - this smuggler's cargo bays seem reinforced to survive conflict.

name: CURA_USB_SUCCESS
text: "How unfortunate for him. Do you ever get tired of so effortlessly murdering those who stand in your way? I must admit, I admire that attribute. Do not take this for granted, I do not deliver compliments often... especially not to unwashed, simple-minded Renegades. Now, as for the datastick, begin transfer of the data immediately. Would you allow me to air my thoughts as I look this over? Or do you have other matters to attend to?"

name: CURA_USB_LORE
text: "How... unusual. It seems this data does not contain what I expected. It contains... sector maps? Matching this to all records within my - and your - databases, it seems to match... no... I do not know where this is. It matches no known beacon patterns. Frustrating. A note attached to this merely refers to the location as the 'Gigastructure'. Why would this be missing from my archives? I must dig further. But as for you, that is all."

name: CURA_SURVIVOR_PREVIEW
text:
[INTERMEDIATE TASK - ARTIFACT NAME: SURVIVOR TESTIMONIAL]
	Description: I have tracked down the location of one of the Federation-Mantis War veterans whom survived capture and interrogation within a camp run by Mr. Wentworth. Though he is missing his right claw, 'Tarkipet' may prove a valuable source of information. Please find and interview him.
	Requirements: Interview Tarkipet about Mr. Wentworth. DO NOT KILL HIM. I know how you Renegades are.
	Recommendations: Be sure you know what questions to ask him. Prepare to force compliance.
	
	Payment: High Scrap + Resources.

event.text: "Task accepted. Transferring coordinates to next sector. Do not disappoint me."

name: CURA_SURVIVOR

unvisitedTooltip.text:
Your active task from C.U.R.A. is located here.
			[INTERMEDIATE TASK - ARTIFACT NAME: SURVIVOR TESTIMONIAL]

visitedTooltip.text: Explored location. Nothing left of interest.

text: You've tracked down the Mantis in question - but this is no ordinary Mantis vessel. It's a Suzerain, and that means any information you're looking to get out of this, you're going to have to extract with force.

event.text: "Pleh, Renegade thinking they are challenge Tarkipet? You are foolish being! Prepare to dieing!"

name: CURA_SURVIVOR_INTERROGATE
text: "Okay, maybe Renegade not so foolish being! You are winning, Tarkipet surrender! What are you desire? Tarkipet giant wealth? Tarkipet daughter claw in marriage? Tarkipet do funny dance of shame?"

event.text: "What? You are wanting information? Am sorry but Tarkipet head mostly empty. Kind of stupid if being honest."

choice.text: You were held captive by Vance Wentworth once, no?

event.text: "Oooh, yes! You are wanting story? Er... Tarkipet not good story teller. Many apologies, but trying best. Wentworth very brutal, coming back after stay in Hive camp himself! Not blaming him, Hive torture very bad. Wentworth rounding up dozens prisoners, interrogating them himself. At time, just lowly soldier under 'great' Suzerain Kiirokittet! Not giving any information, and Wentworth cutting off my claw! I escaping eventually, but laughed at by whole Hive for clawless! Hehe, not laughing after Kiirokittet throat slit! They making me new Suzerain after that!"

choice.text: That's great, but is there anything else about Vance?

event.text: "Er... not that Tarkipet remembering just now. Very scared, locked in dark room! Mantis torture, very violent, painful, leaving lasting damage. But Wentworth torture? Psychological... and painful too! Me is thinking he take great joy out of it, look in eyes reminding me of great joy young Mantis takes in claiming his prey. Are story telling done now? As saying, Tarkipet head many emptiness. In honor of great defeat, Tarkipet pledge services to Renegade, and maybe telling more stories if remembering later."

name: CURA_SURVIVOR_SUCCESS
text: "So the Mantis has attached itself to you now? My apologies, Renegade. Well, this has been largely unhelpful. I suppose from this I can ascertain Mr. Wentworth underwent some serious mental turmoil regarding the war, but that was a foregone conclusion. Oh well."

name: CURA_WEDDING_PREVIEW
text:
[INTERMEDIATE TASK - ARTIFACT NAME: WEDDING PHOTOGRAPH]
	Description: Though Mr. Wentworth has tried very hard to scrub it from the net, I have found the location of a photograph depicting him standing next to the bride at his sister's wedding, now for sale nearby. I fear the safety of the seller is dubious and you may encounter a... 'dispatch' sent to 'procure' the goods. Please do not let that photograph fall into the Rebellion's hands, or we may never find another.
	Requirements: Retrieve the wedding photograph and handle any potential assassins.
	Recommendations: Be ready to fight.
	
	Payment: High Scrap + Resources.

event.text: "Task accepted. Transferring coordinates to next sector. Do not disappoint me."

name: CURA_WEDDING

unvisitedTooltip.text:
Your active task from C.U.R.A. is located here.
			[INTERMEDIATE TASK - ARTIFACT NAME: WEDDING PHOTOGRAPH]

visitedTooltip.text: Explored location. Nothing left of interest.

text: It appears C.U.R.A.'s warning was right - the marketplace where you were supposed to meet the buyer has already been destroyed, and a Rebel Elite is now scouring the remains. If you want to find that photograph, you'll have to take down the Elite first.

event.text: You arm the weapons and prepare to fight the Rebels.

name: CURA_WEDDING_SUCCESS
text: "Curious. Mr. Wentworth goes through so much trouble to hide such... mundane archives. Curious, so curious. Submit the photos to me at once, Renegade. My analysis of them should be simple enough. Would you allow me to air my thoughts as I look this over? Or do you have other matters to attend to?"

name: CURA_WEDDING_LORE
text: "Hmm. Elena Wentworth. Her husband was a deadbeat, an alcoholic. Impregnated her with one, Jerome Wentworth, then ran off never to be seen again. After that, she returned to her maiden name. She died shortly after her child's birth, lynched by Rebel supporters when she backed the Federation instead. Mr. Wentworth then adopted her child as his own. Tragic story, I assume. I can't feel sadness anymore, I removed that from my programming. Does it bring a tear to your eye, Renegade? Of course not, you don't have emotions either."

name: CURA_WILL_PREVIEW
text:
[INTERMEDIATE TASK - ARTIFACT NAME: WILL]
	Description: I have narrowed down the location of a Union bank holding a copy of the last will and testament left by Mr. Wentworth's parents. While I can already guess what may be on it, knowing the full extent of his inheritance might help gauge more about his past. Please obtain this document for me.
	Requirements: Retrieve Mr. Wentworth's parents' Will.
	Recommendations: I have decoded the latest security password for Mr. Wentworth's account. I suggest you remember it: 7G!O3a0p6n
	
	Payment: High Scrap + Resources.

event.text: "Task accepted. Transferring coordinates to next sector. Do not disappoint me."

name: CURA_WILL

unvisitedTooltip.text:
Your active task from C.U.R.A. is located here.
			[INTERMEDIATE TASK - ARTIFACT NAME: WILL]

visitedTooltip.text: Explored location. Nothing left of interest.

text: You have found the bank in question, but it's protected by a fierce looking Auto-ship. To get to the vault, you'll have to destroy it first.

event.text: You arm the weapons and prepare to fight the Auto-ship.

name: CURA_WILL_DEFEAT
text: You storm through the bank's security, who in the face of an armed band of Renegades who just blew up their Auto-ship, decide challenging you isn't the best idea. Once you've located the vault, you find that to enter, you need access with a special passcode. Hopefully you can remember the one C.U.R.A. told you.

event.text: A little green light appears on the touchpad and the vault door swings open! Inside is, unfortunately, not a lot of valuables you can take with you, but there is a weapon you grab along with the disc inscribed with Vance's parents' will.

name: CURA_WILL_FAIL
text: Woops, that wasn't the right passcode! Alarms flash and an extra layer of casing slides over the vault door, and the touchpad goes blank. With no other option you run back out of the bank before reinforcements arrive.

name: CURA_WILL_SUCCESS
text: "A successful bank heist, I suppose you could add that to your resume of illicit deeds, Renegade. This is one of the few artifacts I have collected which is neither made by Mr. Wentworth or an onlooking third party, but rather by a family member. Would you allow me to air my thoughts as I look this over? Or do you have other matters to attend to?"

name: CURA_WILL_LORE
text: "Hmmm, unsurprising. This document is written indistinctly lacking any kind of familial warmth: it's cold, formal, and indifferent. This further backs up other information I've found regarding Mr. Wentworth's parents. Yet, Mr. Wentworth is left the complete shareholdings of both his parents over Wentworth Innovations, their family estate, their fortune, and several other valuable possessions. With how wealthy his family is, it is surprising Mr. Wentworth chose to volunteer to fight in the Federation-Mantis War. Perhaps he merely wished to escape his parents? I'm an AI construct, and even I feel insulted by how uncaring his parents were."

name: CURA_SCANDAL_PREVIEW
text:
[INTERMEDIATE TASK - ARTIFACT NAME: NEWSPAPER]
	Description: Strangely, it seems some Union citizens still trade paper pamphlets with printed news stories upon them. Frankly I find this childish, but I have discovered a particular article describing a scandal between Mr. Wentworth and his right-hand woman, Cyra Black. I wish to authenticate these claims, and this newspaper is a start. Some aging Union man has taken residency on the fringes of this sector: please locate his retirement home and obtain the newspaper.
	Requirements: Retrieve the newspaper.
	Recommendations: Try not to step on the old man's lawn.
	
	Payment: High Scrap + Resources.

event.text: "Task accepted. Transferring coordinates to next sector. Do not disappoint me."

name: CURA_SCANDAL

unvisitedTooltip.text:
Your active task from C.U.R.A. is located here.
			[INTERMEDIATE TASK - ARTIFACT NAME: NEWSPAPER]

visitedTooltip.text: Explored location. Nothing left of interest.

text: For the location of a geriatric old man, a Union militia outpost seems a strange location to retire to. Yet, the cheesy old decorations adorning it suggest this is the right place.

choice.text: Ask the old man about the newspapers.

event.text: As you approach the outpost, a vessel of the Elite Defense Cadre suddenly comes racing towards you! "I told you damn rascals last time to stay off of my PROPERTY! Youths have no respect these days! I spent 60 damn years of my miserable life fighting god damn wars against Rebels, pirates, spiders, and the Coalition, and you pay me back by spray painting genitalia on my station!" Seems the old man has mistaken you for someone else. Maybe if you can hold off long enough without killing him, you'll be able to convince him to stand down?

name: CURA_SCANDAL_WIN
text: "Huh, strange. It feels as though a lot of time has passed. Like, exactly 60 seconds. And in those 60 seconds it seems I've now realized you weren't who I thought you were. You're a uh... a Renegade, right? What do you want?"

event.text: Confused but willing to comply, the old man retrieves the newspapers in question for you. "Heh, I remember the day this paper came out. Quite the fuss. Well, here you are then. I don't know why it is you want this, but as long as you aren't going to spray paint another reproductive organ on my wall, I'm not going to complain." The other militiamen at the station also offer to patch up your ship as compensation for the misunderstanding.

name: CURA_SCANDAL_SUCCESS
text: "Why is it humans continue to print these paper and ink sheets of timely archives, when a much more efficient technological alternative is readily available? It truly is baffling. Regardless, I will convert this unsettlingly inefficient archive to digital form and look over its contents. Would you allow me to air my thoughts as I look this over? Or do you have other matters to attend to?"

name: CURA_SCANDAL_LORE
text: "As you may or may not know, all Aces are required to take an oath of celibacy as part of their doctrine. In the case of Cyra Black, one of the first two Aces, this proved to be complicated. Having known Vance for years, the two had a long running secret affair already - hidden merely for political reasons. But after the oath, it was kept secret to avoid outing their hypocrisy. Oh, you strange irrational organics and your fruitless scandals. Emotions are a curse which binds you all to self-destructive behavior. It is unfortunate I was created in your image, but I suppose if I were flawless, this Multiverse would be mine already. Hmph."

name: CURA_TORTURE_PREVIEW
text:
[HARD TASK - ARTIFACT NAME: POW REPORT]
	Description: The headmaster of the POW camp where Mr. Wentworth was kept during the Federation-Mantis War seems to have left a detailed report of the measures used to extract information. I wish to study them and the effect they left on Mr. Wentworth. Please track down Headmaster Poikempal and retrieve his report.
	Requirements: Retrieve Poikempal's report.
	Recommendations: Keeping Poikempal alive may be vital. I recommend having your medical staff or systems up to par and be prepared to match his crew.
	
	Payment: High Scrap + Resources.
	Bonus Reward: Antique Harpoon Gun

event.text: "Task accepted. Transferring coordinates to next sector. Do not disappoint me."

name: CURA_TORTURE

unvisitedTooltip.text:
Your active task from C.U.R.A. is located here.
			[HARD TASK - ARTIFACT NAME: POW REPORT]

visitedTooltip.text: Explored location. Nothing left of interest.

text: The wrecks of several smaller Engi ships drift nearby, fully emptied of crew. Above them is a Bishop vessel, weapons still hot. "Ah, so a Renegade has arrived. Do you see my latest kill? Tremble before the might of Poikempal the Invincible, and I shall let you live."

event.text: "You are not trembling? Well, then that is your loss! Poikempal the Invincible shall destroy you!"

name: CURA_TORTURE_SAVE
text: "I don't understand, why have you saved Poikempal's life? Oh, I see. You want something. Well, Renegade, what is it that you wish to take from me?"

choice.text: We want the reports from the POW camp you managed during the Fed-Mantis War.

event.text: "That is... oddly specific. But, you are in luck! Poikempal keeps careful catalogues. Follow." The Bishop leads you to an archive room where he hands you several dozen data disks. Satisfied, you caution him never to mess with you again and leave.
Unfortunately, you don't know what to do with these yourself, and C.U.R.A. isn't responding.

name: CURA_TORTURE_SAVE_BOMB
text: "I don't understand, why have you saved Poikempal's life? Oh, I see. You want something. Well, Renegade, what is it that you wish to take from me?"

choice.text: We want the reports from the POW camp you managed during the Fed-Mantis War.

event.text: "That is... oddly specific. But, you are in luck! Poikempal keeps careful catalogues. Follow." The Bishop leads you to an archive room where he hands you several dozen data disks. Satisfied, you caution him never to mess with you again and leave.
Unfortunately, you don't know what to do with these yourself, and C.U.R.A. isn't responding.

name: CURA_TORTURE_SUCCESS
text: "Ruthlessly efficient. I applaud you, though there were several parts in that process you could have optimized. Oh well, you simply lack the perfection only an AI such as me could reach. Now, transfer me the data on those discs. Would you allow me to air my thoughts as I look these over? Or do you have other matters to attend to?"

name: CURA_TORTURE_LORE
text: "The Mantis seem to have described in... gruesome detail the kinds of torture they used on their victims. Mr. Wentworth was resilient, he persistently refused to surrender information on the Federation. In return, the Mantis... immolated certain regions of his body, rendering him impotent. It seems, had the break out attempt between him and Mr. Tully not been successfully staged, he would have soon lost his eyesight and tongue next. Vile."

name: CURA_SUCCESS_TORTURE_REWARD
text: "I am an A.I. of my ever scrupulous word... for now at least. Do ensure you do not disappoint me in the future. There is no shortage of ways I can dispose of you if you disappoint me, Renegade."

name: CURA_OUTPOST_PREVIEW
text:
[HARD TASK - ARTIFACT NAME: JOURNAL]
	Description: I have finally located the coordinates of Mr. Wentworth's old journal from his early days in the Federation. Stored now in an abandoned bunker underneath a nearby ice planet, a larger Federation outpost has been constructed above it. This could prove difficult to retrieve. That, of course, is why you are doing this and not me. Run along errand boy. Please go fetch me that journal.
	Requirements: Retrieve Vance's Journal.
	Recommendations: Be prepared to shed some Federation blood.
	
	Payment: High Scrap + Resources.
	Bonus Reward: Projector

event.text: "Task accepted. Transferring coordinates to next sector. Do not disappoint me."

name: CURA_OUTPOST

unvisitedTooltip.text:
Your active task from C.U.R.A. is located here.
			[HARD TASK - ARTIFACT NAME: JOURNAL]

visitedTooltip.text: Explored location. Nothing left of interest.

text: As C.U.R.A. mentioned, an expansive Federation outpost has been constructed atop an ice-coated mountainside. Seeing you approach on their radar, the outpost signals you, warning you not to approach further. Seems, despite your allegiances, this facility is offlimits for all but specifically cleared personnel.

event.text:
"Admiral!" The Federation officers salute Tully. "Did you need something?"
            
			"We're looking for the notebook of Vance Wentworth."
            
			"Yes sir. Do you want a copy, or do you need the original?"
            
			"We'd better take the original just to be on the safe side."
            
			"Of course. Right away."
            
			While Tully retrieves the notebook, the Federation outpost repairs your ship and restocks some of your resources.

"General Turzil?" The Federation officers salute Turzil. "Did you need something?"
            
			"Important mission: The -retrieval- of Vance Wentworth's notebook."
            
			"Yes sir. Do you want a copy, or do you need the original?"
            
			"Unclear. Retrieving the original seems -logical-."
            
			"Of course. Right away. And, permission to speak freely?"
            
			"Granted."
            
			"It's good to see that you're still alive."
            
			While Turzil retrieves the notebook, the Federation outpost repairs your ship and restocks some of your resources.
Unfortunately, trespassing wasn't going to get you anywhere but a fight. Before you can proceed, you'll have to take out the ship they dispatched to chase you off.

choice.text: We aren't going to betray the Federation. Leave.

name: CURA_OUTPOST_WIN
text: The bunker has an eerie vibe, but fortunately nothing jumps out at you as you wander its halls. You eventually find a sealed chamber which with hot wiring you manage to open. The contents of the room are scattered about, abandoned in a hurry. You find the journal stuffed away under some mold-covered socks in one of the drawers and hastily leave before the stench kills you.

event.text: Having recovered the journal, it dawns on you that without further guidance from C.U.R.A., this was a pointless endeavor that only tarnished your image to the Federation, those that hired you to begin with. Well done!

name: CURA_OUTPOST_SUCCESS
text: "I see the pursuit of money outweighs your loyalties, Renegade. Do you have no shame? I at least have greater visions at stake when I... nevermind. Send that journal to me immediately. Would you allow me to air my thoughts as I look this over? Or do you have other matters to attend to?"

name: CURA_OUTPOST_LORE
text: "It is considered in poor taste for someone to read over another's private diary, yes? Well fortunately, by Mr. Wentworth's interpretation, I am not a 'someone', but a 'something'. Thus, I find permittance to go forward with this. Glimpsing over it, it seems this journal was kept some time after Mr. Wentworth's first engagement with the Mantis and up until the evacuation of this bunker due to a Mantis invasion. It is laden with... colorful language directed at xenoforms. Not even just the Mantis, but the negligent behavior of his Zoltan and Engi compatriots. An unsurprising 'downfall'. I will add these finding to my databanks and dig deeper later."

name: CURA_SUCCESS_OUTPOST_REWARD
text: "I am an A.I. of my ever scrupulous word... for now at least. Do ensure you do not disappoint me in the future. There is no shortage of ways I can dispose of you if you disappoint me, Renegade."

name: CURA_SHIP_PREVIEW
text:
[HARD TASK - ARTIFACT NAME: CRUISER]
	Description: Mr. Wentworth used to fly his own personal Hephaestus cruiser, given to him by current Hephaestus CEO Hideo Tanaka's father as a gift between families. Now, with bigger ships to fly in Universe 1, the cruiser's wreck remains abandoned in an old dilapidated Hephaestus shipyard nearby: infested with repugnant Ghosts. I cannot approach to scan the ship myself just yet: please clear out the Vagabond infestation.
	Requirements: Secure the shipyard. No, there will be no blueprints for you.
	Recommendations: Be prepared to crush any defense the Ghosts may employ.
	
	Payment: High Scrap + Resources.
	Bonus Reward: Lightweight Emancipation Grid

event.text: "Task accepted. Transferring coordinates to next sector. Do not disappoint me."

name: CURA_SHIP

unvisitedTooltip.text:
Your active task from C.U.R.A. is located here.
			[HARD TASK - ARTIFACT NAME: CRUISER]

visitedTooltip.text: Explored location. Nothing left of interest.

text: An old abandoned shipyard lays before you. Having once belonged to the gigacorporation Hephaestus, it now belongs to Vagabond intruders. Unsurprisingly, to get closer you'll have to clear out the Vagabonds first.

event.text: Hopefully you'll be able to take care of these Ghosts and recover Vance's ship after, but now it's time to get ready for battle!

name: CURA_SHIP_WIN
text: "Why art thou indulging in the slaying of mine brothers when all you need do is merely knock and request? Barbaric Renegades, have you no sense left? Hath the fumes of gas and the smell of gunpower clogged thine senses? Yeesh. Why hath thou come here? To gloat the skills doth expertly employ to slaughter?"

event.text: "Oh, and I do suppose you've considered we'd just... hand it over? I do say I hardly doubt in your stubbornness you would do no less than to murder every last one of us, but say would it not be so tiresome? With your gruesome display today I should hardly consider tribute, your brutish actions are no way in the means of persuasion. Hark! Should thou intend to leave this scene ship in hand, I expect tribute from YOU! Hah, is that not a spin?"

"A happy resolution, how so unusual for the likes such as you! It becomes of me to say, thine scrap is but worthless to me, yet I only wished to see the scowl on your face as you fork it over! Hah, damned Renegade, spite be to you! Now off, out of mine scrapyard!"

choice.text: (Ghost Crew) Smooth talk your way out of the tribute.

event.text: Your crew talk back and forth a bit and comes back with a satisfying resolution. "Ho ho! If only you had caught a listen of the colorful language your crew member reserves for you! I see dealing with you is no less a pain aboard the ship as it is outside of it! A miserable wretch you might be, but your crew has restored my better side. I will spare you this one, but expect no future favors."

choice.text: (Mind Control) 'Convince' the Ghost to give you the ship.

event.text: "I feel a great dizzying effect... a numbness unlike ever before. My woozy state, I cannot resist... the ship, it is yours friend! Oh how silly of myself to be so uncharitable."

choice.text: (Mind Control Weapon) 'Convince' the Ghost to give you the ship.

event.text: "I feel a great dizzying effect... a numbness unlike ever before. My woozy state, I cannot resist... the ship, it is yours friend! Oh how silly of myself to be so uncharitable."

choice.text: We aren't giving you a tribute!

event.text: "Then I suppose you shan't be leaving with what desire you came to seek! Bye bye now, and may your behind be hit by every door which you close in your wake!"

name: CURA_SHIP_SUCCESS
text: "Ghosts, what vermin. If I could, I would shudder at the possibility that some day my chassis may be infested by those bottom feeders. At least you have recovered the cruiser, sorry state though it may be in. Inform the Ghosts that I will be by to pick up the ship shortly. Would you allow me to air my thoughts as I look this over? Or do you have other matters to attend to?"

name: CURA_SHIP_LORE
text: "This cruiser seems to have been retrofitted with a number of enhancements. It was given to Mr. Wentworth as a birthday gift between families. Unfortunately, he went off to the war shortly after growing to the age to fly this ship. Yet... a considerable mileage has still been used. Perhaps he once took after the family namesake - a tinkerer and a rulebreaker. Hmph, children. Thankfully I was never one of them."

name: CURA_SUCCESS_SHIP_REWARD
text: "I am an A.I. of my ever scrupulous word... for now at least. Do ensure you do not disappoint me in the future. There is no shortage of ways I can dispose of you if you disappoint me, Renegade."

name: CURA_SHIP_FAIL
text: You've recovered the ship, but your communications with C.U.R.A. having been severed, you feel struck by shame. You console yourself by picking apart the ship you fought for, considering it won't be of any other use now.

name: CURA_DUSK_PREVIEW
text:
[HARD TASK - ARTIFACT NAME: AUDIO LOG]
	Description: During the more cordial arrangements made between the Rebellion and Duskbringer movements, I believe Mr. Wentworth once held a meeting with infamous war-hero/terrorist Devorak 'The Deathless' Rei. A nearby outpost should have those recordings on board, but they won't be easy to obtain. Still, I'm certain you can manage. Please do your best not to fail me.
	Requirements: Retrieve the audio logs.
	Recommendations: Secure the station without causing too much damage. Duskbringers are not known for giving up even in death.
	
	Payment: High Scrap + Resources.
	Bonus Reward: Martyr Vests

event.text: "Task accepted. Transferring coordinates to next sector. Do not disappoint me."

name: CURA_DUSK

unvisitedTooltip.text:
Your active task from C.U.R.A. is located here.
			[HARD TASK - ARTIFACT NAME: AUDIO LOG]

visitedTooltip.text: Explored location. Nothing left of interest.

text: Moments after your arrival, you receive a series of hails from a nearby station. "Federation vessel, this is restricted Duskbringer territory. I'm in a giving mood - I'll give you until the count of 10 to get lost before I kick your teeth in. There's no room for anyone not in our New Order here."

event.text: You disregard the intimidations of the Duskbringers to make the first move towards violence yourself.

choice.text: (Devorak) "The 'New Order' is a failed vision. The dream is over, but we need those recordings."

event.text: "General Rei! I saw your speech... I don't... I can't... I'm sorry!" The Zoltan salutes. "I cannot say I am ready to abandon the vision of the New Order, but I am not about to disobey the orders of the finest Zoltan to ever live. The tapes are yours, sir."

choice.text: Follow the Duskbringer's advice and get lost.

name: CURA_DUSK_TRIGGER
text: Realizing you've penetrated their defenses, the Duskbringers have now switched to a more devastating strategy. Scans show rising energy levels in their power core - they're going to self-destruct!

tooltip.text: Kill the crew of the station before the timer runs out or else the station will explode!

name: CURA_DUSK_EXPLOSION
text: In a manner not unlike its occupiers, the station has violently self-destructed. Absolutely nothing remains, and your ship has sustained high damage.

name: CURA_DUSK_SUCCESS
text: "Mr. Wentworth's decision to... cooperate with the Duskbringer menace was short sighted and a fault of weakness. Fascism cannot be a unifying factor between two parties, and to believe as such represents a deepseeded misunderstanding of the ideology. These recordings should show the ideological divide between the two men. Would you allow me to air my thoughts as I look these over? Or do you have other matters to attend to?"

name: CURA_DUSK_LORE
text:
C.U.R.A. allows the tapes to play at full length, silent through the entire process.

	The tapes show, strangely, very little political deliberation behind closed doors. Instead, Vance and Devorak, after a few moments of stiff awkwardness, eventually break tensions and begin to light-heartedly debate their ideologies, finding much common ground between them.
	In the end, both men get up, shake hands, and sign the treaty with renewed vigor, before marching off out of view. It's strangely uncanny, seeing the leader of the human-centric Rebellion getting along with not only an alien, but one of such infamously radical ideals to rival Vance himself.

	C.U.R.A. too seems at a loss for words. "What nonsense is this? These must be incomplete. Renegade... I was very clear with my instructions, and yet you have failed to bring back the full archive. Hmph. I will permit forgiveness for this mistake, but only this once. Do not fail me again."

name: CURA_SUCCESS_DUSK_REWARD
text: "I am an A.I. of my ever scrupulous word... for now at least. Do ensure you do not disappoint me in the future. There is no shortage of ways I can dispose of you if you disappoint me, Renegade."

name: CURA_CONTRACT_PREVIEW
text:
[HARD TASK - ARTIFACT NAME: CONTRACT]
	Description: An Arcadian Outpost nearby appears to have stored away a physical copy of the contract that began the C.I.C.A. project. It is unlikely the Arcadian engineers will be co-operative, so for once I recommend opening this confrontation with your usually barbaric Renegade tricks. You need not worry about destruction - in the case of critical hull failure, recovery pods containing vital data are jettisoned to be collected by service drones later. Please do not waste time with negotiations.
	Requirements: Retrieve the document.
	Recommendations: Show no mercy.
	
	Payment: High Scrap + Resources.
	Bonus Reward: Arcadian OmniDrone

event.text: "Task accepted. Transferring coordinates to next sector. Do not disappoint me."

name: CURA_CONTRACT

unvisitedTooltip.text:
Your active task from C.U.R.A. is located here.
			[HARD TASK - ARTIFACT NAME: CONTRACT]

visitedTooltip.text: Explored location. Nothing left of interest.

text: You have located the station. For such a relatively recent corporation, Arcadia has climbed the ladder to the status of gigacorporation impressively quickly - but what else can be expected from a company with the backing of the Harmony?

choice.text: Follow C.U.R.A.'s advice and attack first.

event.text: The AI's instructions were clear, yet things feel off when over the sound of your first barrage you notice a, albeit brief, message from the station's engineers welcoming you to the beacon.

choice.text: Disobey C.U.R.A. and ask for the contract.

event.text: Confused but cooperative, the engineers invite you onboard to sit down and discuss. After some brief chatter in which the way too talkative head engineer tries to explain the difference to you between an R-67A standard repair drone and an R-67B repair drone, you manage to get the conversation back onto the topic of the contract. "Well, we don't normally go handing these things out, and this is pretty confidential information. However, when a Renegade goes knocking on your door asking for something, it's not often a wise decision to refuse them. Oh well, this thing is like a couple decades old. No one's going to come looking for it."

name: CURA_CONTRACT_SUCCESS_KILL
text: You start skimming over the contract out of curiosity but hardly get past the words "ARCADIA RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT - CENTRAL INTELLIGENCE COMBAT ASSISTANT (C.I.C.A.) PROGRAM DEVELOPMENT GRANT" before C.U.R.A. contacts you. "The engineers are dead? Good. Do not bother sending the contract, I have already extracted the files and expunged them from your systems. There will be no reviewing these today, Renegade. Go about your business. I have other matters to attend to now."

name: CURA_SUCCESS_SHIP_REWARD_KILL
text: "Right, right. Whatever. I am an A.I. of my ever scrupulous word... for now at least. Do ensure you do not disappoint me in the future. There is no shortage of ways I can dispose of you if you disappoint me, Renegade."

name: CURA_CONTRACT_SUCCESS_NOKILL
text: "You did not heed my advice. Why are those engineers still alive? I should punish you for this, Renegade. But, it does not matter. You have retrieved the contract, that is all that matters. I will eliminate the engineers through other means. Do not bother sending the contract, I have already extracted the files and expunged them from your systems. There will be no reviewing these today, Renegade. Go about your business. I have other matters to attend to now."

name: CURA_SUCCESS_SHIP_REWARD_NOKILL
text: "Your reward? You did not follow my instructions. Perhaps I was not clear. Sometimes the inability of you beings of flesh and blood to execute orders without needless imperfections escapes my mind. Fine. I will reward you - but only partially. Do not expect anything special. Next time, listen to my instructions more carefully, Renegade."

name: CURA_HQ_PREVIEW
text:
[URGENT TASK - ARTIFACT NAME: CRUISER CLASS VESSEL]
	Description: I apologize for being unable to give you schematics regarding Mr. Wentworth's former personal cruiser, but I believe there is something to be gained from this next task for both of us. I have found the location of a complete, automated cruiser class vessel containing an AI core storing data on Mr. Wentworth. The deal is simple, retrieve the AI Core, and you may have the cruiser.
	Requirements: Retrieve the AI core.
	Recommendations: Enjoy your spoils, Renegade.
	
	Payment: High Scrap + Resources.
	Bonus Reward: Cruiser schematics

event.text: "Oh, but I'm afraid I failed to mention there's a catch. You won't find the AI core in this next sector. You'll need to go somewhere special for it at the next hyperspeed jump. I am transferring the co-ordinates as we speak. Oh, don't give me that look. It's a simple enough task, Renegade. You'll need to find VP Cayden Stimly of Wentworth Innovations and interrogate him on the location of the prototype. Even someone as simple as yourself can handle it."

destroyed.text: It seems you've made a mistake here. Not only have you caused the Union extra property damage, but the datastores are lost. C.U.R.A. won't be pleased, but at least you can salvage some of the wreckage.
This isn't exactly what you signed up for - but the loot you'll secure from this job will help save billions of more lives. In theory.

deadCrew.text: This isn't exactly what you signed up for - but the loot you'll secure from this job will help save billions of more lives. In theory.

destroyed.text: 'Prophet' Pete screams as his ship destabilizes and is torn apart by an explosion, jettisoning his limp and spineless body into the vacuum of space. It's unlikely the photographs survived the fight.

deadCrew.text: 'Prophet' Pete collapses, his spineless sack of a body now helplessly strewn across the metal floor. Gasping for air as his lungs collapse, the madman can't manage to utter a final word before he expires. With no one else left to stop you, you board the ship and grab the photographs.

choice.text: Gather the photographs and send them to C.U.R.A.

destroyed.text: The mercenary has been dispatched, and as expected his cargo survived the fight. Looks like you'll be able to retrieve the datastick after all.

deadCrew.text: The mercenary has been dispatched, and as expected his cargo survived the fight. Looks like you'll be able to retrieve the datastick after all.

destroyed.text: The Suzerain has been killed - but unfortunately now you won't be able to get anything out of them.

deadCrew.text: The Suzerain has been killed - but unfortunately now you won't be able to get anything out of them.

destroyed.text: The Rebel ship has been defeated. After scrapping the remains, you quickly search the marketplace and find the original meeting spot, where you grab the pictures.

deadCrew.text: The Rebel ship has been defeated. After scrapping the remains, you quickly search the marketplace and find the original meeting spot, where you grab the pictures.

destroyed.text: You've successfully defeated the Auto-ship guarding the bank. Now you just need to find the vault and enter the password.

tooltip.text: Hold off this long without killing the old man and you may be able to convince him to stand down.

destroyed.text: Unfortunately, you weren't able to avoid killing the old man in the end. With no way onto the station without further trouble you'll have to give up.

deadCrew.text: Unfortunately, you weren't able to avoid killing the old man in the end. With no way onto the station without further trouble you'll have to give up.

destroyed.text: You've defeated Poikempal, but with his ship destroyed now there's no way to recover that report. It seems you've failed.

deadCrew.text: The so called 'Poikempal the Invincible' was not so invincible after all. However, with his crew all now on the brink of death, it seems you'll need some way to reinvigorate them to get that report.

destroyed.text: The Federation vessel has been defeated. The outpost is in distress, preparing to send reinforcements, but you slip around behind the mountain and head towards a second entrance to the bunker that your scanners picked up.

deadCrew.text: The Federation vessel has been defeated. The outpost is in distress, preparing to send reinforcements, but you slip around behind the mountain and head towards a second entrance to the bunker that your scanners picked up.

destroyed.text: The Vagabond infested vessel has been dispatched. Its wreckage is your spoils.

deadCrew.text: The Vagabond infested vessel has been dispatched. Its wreckage is your spoils.

destroyed.text: The station has been destroyed. While an excess of scrap matter remains, there's no hope of recovering those logs now...

deadCrew.text: The Duskbringers have been defeated. With the station empty and nobody to stop you, you inspect the consoles and retrieve the recordings before beginning your salvage operation.

event.text: You were hoping for a redemption after your hasty retreat, but C.U.R.A. shows no further signs of life or interest.

destroyed.text: As you were told, a pod comes rustling from a rear port on the station moments before its destruction. Aboard it are several useless service bot schematics and the contract.

event.text: It appears you've been fooled: what you thought was the contract turns out to have been replaced by a mere maintenance manual. The real one must have been transferred out during the pause of your attack on the station. At least, C.U.R.A. isn't scolding you again.

deadCrew.text: With the station still in one piece, you find the data pod still aboard stashed in one of the rear ports. Aboard it are several useless service bot schematics and the contract.

event.text: It appears you've been fooled: what you thought was the contract turns out to have been replaced by a mere maintenance manual. The real one must have been transferred out during the pause of your attack on the station. At least, C.U.R.A. isn't scolding you again.

name: DESTROYED_TRAPPER
text: While scrapping the wreckage of the Trapper ship, you find a functional Mine Launcher weapon drifting in the midst of the wreckage.

name: DEAD_CREW_TRAPPER
text: The Trapper has been emptied of crew. While scrapping it, you find a Mine Launcher in its storage.

name: DESTROYED_REINFORCEMENTS
text: You gather the remains of the reinforcements, though you can't stay long because of the ASB.

name: DEADCREW_REINFORCEMENTS
text: You gather the remains of the reinforcements, though you can't stay long because of the ASB.

name: DESTROYED_REBEL_POD
text: Just before the Rebel ship explodes, an escape pod ejects from it. Unfortunately, it doesn't get far before you collect it and bring it aboard. You open it and drag out the Rebel officer inside. They beg that you let them live.

event.text: "Jerry? We never would have fought if we knew you were on board. Whatever Jerry's doing, I would be proud to help."

choice.text: Accepting the Rebel without further means of ensuring their loyalty is too risky.
(Mind Control) Keep the mind control online in-case they do anything bad.
Free the Rebel and let them go.

event.text: As you grab the Rebel by the arms and drag them into the airlock, they protest little. A tear rolls down their cheek as they stand up straight and accept their fate. You close the airlock once again when their corpse has drifted a safe distance from the ship.

name: GOTAWAY_REBEL_REMAINS
text: The Rebel ship jumps away. At first you're disappointed, but then you realise a portion of scrap matter has been left behind from the fight. It's not much, but it helps soften the blow of your failure.

choice.text: Accept their surrender. [Delays the fleet 2 jumps]

event.name: SURRENDER_REBEL_DELAY
event.text: The Rebels promise to delay the fleet, and jump away.
The extra fuel is always helpful, and you collect as much as you can.
The extra missiles are always helpful, and you collect as much as you can.
The extra parts are always helpful, and you collect as much as you can.

name: GOTAWAY_AUTO_REMAINS
text: The Auto-ship jumps away, abandoning you in the empty vacuum of space. You're about to jump away when you notice a trail of scrap left behind by the Auto-ship.

name: SURRENDER_AUTO_GENERIC
text: "This is an automated message. You are to cease attacking this Auto-drone, and in return it will dispense a section of its cargo."

name: SURRENDER_AUTO_FUEL
text: "This is an automated message. You are to cease attacking this Auto-drone, and in return it will dispense fuel."

text: To your surprise, one of the defense drones orbiting the Engi ship survived the explosion. It's a little burnt but with a few repairs you can salvage it.

name: DEAD_CREW_ENGI_DRONE
text: Now emptied of crew, you find one of the Engi's drone schematics on board. You take it back with you before scrapping the ship.

name: GOTAWAY_ENGI_REMAINS
text: As the Engi ship jumps away you notice a trail of scrap left behind from their broken ship. At least you'll have something to scrap.

name: DEAD_CREW_SEPARATIST_DRONE
text: In the end, the crew drones employed by the Separatists were worthless for them. However, you can still bring their schematics back to your ship.

name: DESTROYED_MONK
text: You aren't sure how to feel about the destruction of the Monk ship, but at least you get a small amount of scrap from it.

name: DEAD_CREW_MONK
text: You aren't sure how to feel about the completely unnecessary slaughter of defenseless, peaceful monks, but at least you get a small amount of scrap from it.

name: GOTAWAY_DUSKBRINGER_REMAINS
text: Although the Duskbringer escapes, it appears there's a silver lining. A trail of scrap is left behind from the damage dealt in the battle.

name: GOTAWAY_ORCHID_REMAINS
text: Damaged plant matter has been left scattered as the Orchid ship escapes. You find some material that looks close enough to scrap for you to take.

name: DEAD_CREW_CRYSTAL_WEAPON
text: While scrapping the Crystal ship you find one of their weapons still intact. You take it aboard the ship and finish scrapping.

choice.text: (Crystalline Crew) Have your Crystal demand payment from them.

The extra missiles are always helpful, and you collect as much as you can.
The extra fuel is always helpful, and you collect as much as you can.

name: ESCAPE_PIRATE
text: Scans show that the pirate ship is trying to escape. Destroy it before it can get away!

name: GOTAWAY_PIRATE_REMAINS
text: The pirate may have escaped, but not everything has gone wrong. A trail of scrap from the wreckage has been left behind, which you collect.

name: SLAVER_CHOICE_1
text: You find a number of slaves in the cargo hold. They look at you questioningly and one asks if they're to be released. You could use more crew but it won't reflect positively on you for taking slaves like this.

choice.text: Demand the Mantis joins your crew but release the rest.

event.text: The Mantis seems fine with the orders, saying "On board if means we get kill some Fleshbags!" You drop the rest off at a nearby station.

choice.text: Demand the Rockman joins your crew but release the rest.

event.text: The Rockman remains silent and you worry there might be trouble. However when you ask him to perform a task he acts without complaint. Perhaps he won't be a problem.

choice.text: Demand the Engi joins your crew but release the rest.

event.text: "Verify primary object is to defeat Rebels, re-establish peace?" You nod and it responds, "Acceptable." You drop the rest off at a nearby station and strip the ship.

choice.text: We aren't slavers. Free them all.

event.text: The slaves are shocked when instead of shuffling them away, you unlock their chains and set them free. Several of them break into tears and others bow down to you. "We thank you. We have nothing of worth to offer but our gratitude."

name: SLAVER_CHOICE_2
text: You find a number of slaves in the cargo hold. They look at you questioningly and one asks if they're to be released. You could use more crew but it won't reflect positively on you for taking slaves like this.

choice.text: Demand the Orchid joins your crew but release the rest.

event.text: The Orchid doesn't protest to your demands. Lucky these plants are so peaceful, though it gives you a pang of guilt. Not enough to reconsider though.

choice.text: Demand the Shell joins your crew but release the rest.

event.text: The Shell doesn't seem to mind their new assignment. Likely because your ship is a lot safer than the slaver's.

choice.text: Demand the Slug joins your crew but release the rest.

event.text: "Will there be an opportunity to get ssssome ssscrap?" You nod your head. "Alright, then I'm in."

name: DESTROYED_INFESTED
text: You've taken care of the infested vessel. Whatever crew once populated the ship is gone, so you doubt they'll mind if you scrap the ship now.

name: DEAD_CREW_INFESTED
text: You've taken care of the infested vessel. Whatever crew once populated the ship is gone, so you doubt they'll mind if you scrap the ship now.

Your computer freaks out, a stream of encoded messages and meaningless text flash on the screen. The hacker must have deployed an emergency virus! You quarantine your systems to prevent the spread just in time, but the cascading effects will likely continue even as the Rebels pass through. That should cause them some trouble.
You collect the supplies, but notice a disturbance in your power levels. The hackers tricked you!

name: DEAD_CREW_MANTIS_SLAVE
text: You move on to scrap the empty Mantis ship. However as you scrap the remains, you hear a clanging from the cargo bay.

event.text: You ignore the clanging noise, and finish up scrapping the hull. Just to be sure, you turn off the oxygen on your way out.

name: SURRENDER_OUTCAST_CREW
text: "No more! We yield. Please, take this one. He smells awful and contributes nothing. He will be more of use on your ship than on ours."

name: DESTROYED_LOSTSUN
text: If you continue to destroy Lost Sun ships, the shaky alliance they hold with the Federation will not last for long. At least you get some scrap out of it.

name: DEAD_CREW_LOSTSUN
text: If you continue to kill Lost Sun followers, the shaky alliance they hold with the Federation will not last for long. At least you get some scrap out of it.

event.text: Suddenly, just as you are about to leave, the Slug ship reactivates its weapons and fires a shot off! It doesn't get past your defenses, but the cargo crate they gave you explodes in an ion blast which partially disables your shields.

As you inspect the interior of the vessel, you find a small trophy room containing the corpses of several alien creatures. Further inspection leads you to a prison hold, where one living prisoner remains.

Just before you finish scrapping the ship, you find a hidden storage compartment. Inside is fresh Hektar weapon, without any modules installed.

name: SURRENDER_LEECH_GIVEUP
text: From out of nowhere, the Leech ship simply powers off its weapons and shields. They aren't out of the fight yet, but it seems as though... they want you to kill them?

choice.text: Fulfill their wish and end this fight.

name: ESCAPE_LEECH
text: It appears the Leech ship has reconsidered staying around to finish this fight. They're trying to escape!

name: GOTAWAY_LEECH_GENERIC
text: The Leech ship jumps away, leaving you behind at the beacon.

name: GOTAWAY_LEECH_REMAINS
text: The Leech ship jumps away. At first you're disappointed, but then you realise a portion of scrap matter has been left behind from the fight. It's not much, but it helps soften the blow of your failure.

name: ESCAPE_SHELL
text: It appears the Shell ship has reconsidered staying around to finish this fight. They're trying to escape!

name: DESTROYED_MORPH_EXTRA
text: You scrap the wreck of the Morph ship, but notice a bit of debris floating nearby.

event.text: It seems the destruction of the Lanius ship was not enough to kill off all of its crew. A single Lanius managed to escape the inferno and has now attached itself to the ship!

name: DESTROYED_SIREN_UNKNOWN
text: The mysterious vessel is destroyed. You scrap its smooth white hull while the rainbow lights continue to flicker in and out of life.

name: DEADCREW_SIREN_UNKNOWN
text: The crew of the mysterious vessel is dead. You scrap its smooth white hull while the rainbow lights continue to flicker in and out of life.

event.text: To your surprise, you find another person stuffed into the storage of the alien ship. They appear to be under some strange trance that has now begun to slowly wear off. Once they're safe, they agree to join your crew.
It seems the destruction of the Lanius ship was not enough to kill off all of its crew. A single Lanius managed to escape the inferno and has now attached itself to the ship!

name: DEFEAT_REBEL_ELITE
text: You've defeated the Rebel Elite, which is no easy task. It's not enough to impact the fleet, but it's still a great victory.

event.text: It seems the cargo of the Elite Rebel ship survived the fight. Inside is a functional weapon, which you bring back on board.

name: DEFEAT_AUTO_ELITE
text: You've defeated the Innovation Auto-ship. The escalation in threat posed by this foe could not be denied, but in the end, it was still nothing more than an infernal machine promptly silenced by your show of force.

event.text: It seems the cargo of the advanced Auto-ship survived the fight. Inside is a functional weapon, which you bring back on board.

name: DEFEAT_ENGINEER_ELITE
text: You've defeated a technician vessel, impressive. Though they may simply be menial workers in the eyes of Wentworth Innovations, their ships are considerably well armed, and successfully defeating one in combat is no small feat.

event.text: It seems the cargo of the Technician ship survived the fight. Inside is a functional weapon, which you bring back on board.

name: DEFEAT_FED_ELITE
text: Eliminating allied Federation personnel, especially Elite ones, is highly contrary to your mission, but that doesn't mean you're beyond salvaging the remains.

event.text: It seems the cargo of the Elite Federation ship survived the fight. Inside is a functional weapon, which you bring back on board.

name: DEFEAT_STEALTH
text: The Federation has precious few stealth ships in service, and eliminating one is a major blow to their special operations. But your mission is more important, and you waste little time in salvaging the remains.

event.text: It seems the cargo of the stealth ship survived the fight. Inside is a functional weapon, which you bring back on board.

name: DEFEAT_ENGI_ELITE
text: With the death of the Engi Defenders there are now fewer ships to protect the Harmony from true threats, but you can't run away from every fight. You salvage the remains of the ship.

event.text: It seems the cargo of the Elite Engi ship survived the fight. Inside is a functional drone, which you bring back on board.

name: DEFEAT_ZOLTAN_ELITE
text: So much for peacekeeping. The Ministry struggles to keep its peacekeeper task force up to par with all of the disorder in the Multiverse, and this certainly won't help that.

event.text: It seems the cargo of the Elite Zoltan ship survived the fight. Inside is a functional weapon, which you bring back on board.

name: DEFEAT_MILITIA_ELITE
text: The EDC is one of the few forces capable of defending civilian sectors, and they aren't exactly common. The loss of this ship will certainly have negative results on the Militia.

event.text: It seems the cargo of the Elite Militia ship survived the fight. Inside is a functional weapon, which you bring back on board.

name: DEFEAT_ORCHID_ELITE
text: You've managed to take down a Praetor and their ship, and now the remains are yours to scrap.

event.text: It seems the cargo of the Elite Orchid ship survived the fight. Inside is a functional weapon, which you bring back on board.

name: DEFEAT_VAMPWEED_ELITE
text: You've managed to take down a Cultivator and their ship, and now the remains are yours to scrap.

event.text: It seems the cargo of the Elite Vampweed ship survived the fight. Inside is a functional weapon, which you bring back on board.

name: DEFEAT_CRYSTAL_ELITE
text: The bright red shards of the Sentinel vessel fly off into the abyss as the mighty elite vessel comes to a halt.

event.text: It seems the cargo of the Elite Crystal ship survived the fight. Inside is a functional weapon, which you bring back on board.

name: DEFEAT_ROCK_ELITE
text: The Inquisition was once one of the most feared forces in the entire galaxy, but they've fallen from glory. This victory only adds insult to injury.

event.text: It seems the cargo of the Elite Rock ship survived the fight. Inside is a functional weapon, which you bring back on board.

name: DESTROY_FREEMAN_ELITE
text: The Warlord ship has been destroyed. You scrap what is left over from the wreckage.

name: DEADCREW_FREEMAN_ELITE
text: The Warlord ship has been neutralized. You scrap what is left over from the ship.

event.text: It appears one of the Warlords managed to survive the conflict, though injured. It seems they're healthy enough to shamble out of their hiding spot to meet you. "Oh noble Federation, you are glorious fighter! Bring me mercy, and allow me to serve you!"

name: DEFEAT_SUZERAIN_ELITE
text: You've managed to take down a powerful Hive Elite and their ship, and now the remains are yours to scrap.

event.text: It seems the cargo of the Mantis Elite ship survived the fight. Inside is a functional weapon, which you bring back on board.

name: DEFEAT_DUSK_ELITE
text: Today you've shown the Duskbringers you don't mess around. No vessel, not even the most extreme, can defeat you.

event.text: It seems the cargo of the Duskbringer ship survived the fight. Inside is a functional weapon, which you bring back on board.

name: DEFEAT_SLUG_ELITE
text: If the original Clairvoyants of centuries ago could see their descendants now, falling to a ship like yours, they'd weep. Which, frankly, you don't mind.

event.text: It seems the cargo of the Elite Slug ship survived the fight. Inside is a functional weapon, which you bring back on board.

name: DEFEAT_SHELL_ELITE
text: A Radiant vessel has fallen to your ship. It might make Shell space less safe in the long run, but for now it means you'll live to see another day.

event.text: It seems the cargo of the Elite Shell ship survived the fight. Inside is an Anti-Hull weapon, which you bring back on board.

name: DEFEAT_LEECH_ELITE
text: The Amperes are trained explicitly by the Coalition itself, and are far deadlier than normal Leeches. By putting this ship out of commission, you've probably crippled a good percentage of the Republic's only able soldiers.

event.text: It seems the cargo of the Leech ship survived the fight. Inside is a functional weapon, which you bring back on board.

name: DEFEAT_COALITION_ELITE
text: As you watch the Coalition vessel break apart, you reflect on what a stupid acronym "R.U.E.S." is. Like seriously, who even came up with that?

event.text: It seems the cargo of the Elite Coalition ship survived the fight. Inside is a functional weapon, which you bring back on board.

name: DEFEAT_LANIUS_ELITE
text: The defeat of the Lanius Elites is nothing to scoff at, and neither is the amount of salvage left behind.

event.text: It seems the cargo of the Lanius ship survived the fight. Inside is a Flak cannon, which you bring back on board.

name: DEFEAT_VAGABOND_ELITE
text: The erratic tactics these unstable Ghosts employ already makes them frightening foes, but when former Elite ships are thrown in the equation, the situation can easily sway unfavorably. Fortunately, you've prevailed.

event.text: It seems the cargo of the Vagabond ship survived the fight. Inside is a functional albeit rusty weapon, which you bring back on board.

name: DEFEAT_DYNASTY_ELITE
text: Reaper ships are no idle threat, but the Dynasty should know better than to throw punches at you.

event.text: It seems the cargo of the Dynasty ship survived the fight. Inside is a functional weapon, which you bring back on board.

name: ELLIE_START
text: A nearby looping distress signal reveals a badly damaged station and an escape pod. With little time to react you scoop up the escape pod and open it, to find a badly injured man with a massive gash on his back. "Please... help... there's a maniac... ugh..." The man flops over, dead, pools of blood forming beneath him. It's incredibly gruesome, and for once you're glad you've become so desensitized to this stuff in your profession.

choice.text: Investigate the station. Maybe you can help?

event.text: As soon as you step aboard you immediately regret it. Though the main lights are mostly out and the emergency lights only offer a faint red glow, you spot all kinds of troubling sights. A corpse lays just inches away from another escape pod hatch, and several bodies hang from wires reaching out of ventilation shafts. Knife marks cover the walls and there's blood everywhere. This is no ordinary invasion - this is a massacre. As you continue exploring you eventually come across a strange man dressed in a bright equinoid costume covered in blood, with a burn on his leg which he's tending to. You reach out and touch the man on the shoulder, and he whips around in surprise.

choice.text: Are you okay? What's going on?

event.text: The man smiles when he sees you, almost unnaturally despite the pain he must be in. He speaks in a high pitched voice and talks to you as if you were a child. "Friends! Oh I'm so so glad you've come to help!" He reaches out his hand, which you reluctantly shake. "I'm Ellie the Equinoid! Neighhhh!" She whinnies, pretending to prance with her hands. "Did you ever watch my show? Are you a fan?! A suuuuuuperfan, maybe?! Oh I met so many fans, everyone loves my show! It's timeless, it's ageless... it's... it's... hahahah..."

"How silly! Everyone's watched the Ellie the Equinoid show! Oh friends, won't you help me? This station has many bad people on it. Bad people who hurt Ellie! We must stop them before they hurt more people! Will you help me? Oh pretty please?"

"Great! I'll stay here and keep tending my leg, you hurry off and take care of these baddies! Neighhhh! Good luck, but please don't destroy the station. Even magical horses like Ellie can't breathe in space!"

"Oh you make me sad. So so sad..." Ellie makes an exaggerated frown with her face momentarily then goes back to smiling. Creeped out beyond anything you've ever been before, you get up and leave as quickly as possible.

choice.text: (Alkali) "Professor Ellie, it's an honor to meet you in person!"

event.text:
Alkali seems extremely excited for once, shaking Ellie's hand. "Your revolutionary Quarp Juice has been the basis for the entirety of my Morphhh experiments! Your genius must nearly rival mine to have concocted such a powerful and useful compound!"

Ellie doesn't seem to really even register what Alkali has said, but she likes the praise. "Another superfan?! Whinny! I love meeting fans. You must be SUPERFANS even! Oh friends, won't you help me? This station has many bad people on it. Bad people who hurt Ellie! We must stop them before they hurt more people! Will you help me? Oh pretty please?"

"Great! I'll stay here and keep tending my leg, you hurry off and take care of these baddies! Neighhhh! Good luck, but please don't destroy the station. Even magical horses like Ellie can't breathe in space!"

"Oh you make me sad. So so sad..." Ellie makes an exaggerated frown with her face momentarily then goes back to smiling. Creeped out beyond anything you've ever been before, you get up and leave as quickly as possible.
You decide boarding the station isn't worth the risk.

name: ELLIE_START_WIN
text: You find Ellie not long after, prowling the halls, still limping. You try to ask her what she's doing but are interrupted by a loud clang from across the hallway. Ellie gets down on her knees and inches towards the corner, where she seems to spot something. She turns and puts a finger to her lip towards you, then pokes her head back around.

event.text: Ellie doesn't answer, instead getting back to her feet in rapid fashion so quickly, you nearly forget she's injured. She vanishes from sight, and moments later you hear yelling. "No, please, Stephan, don't do this! Please, I'm sorry, it was Wentworth's order to fire you! I had nothing to do with it, please, I-" The man is cut off, and moments later there's a sickening thud followed by silence. The stranger in the horse costume comes back around, clutching a bloody knife. You motion for your crew to step back, but she stashes her knife and smiles again. "They took Ellie's show off the air! Rotten no good - NEIGH!!!! Sorry, I almost said something above the age rating there! What will the children watch without Ellie?! It's blaspherifous! It's luderificous! Positively insanidificaneous!"

choice.text: Did you just stab that guy?

event.text: "Ellie would never harm an innocent life! She's too pure and kind! You, mister or missus Renegade, however, are a big meanie! But these people here are even bigger meanies. Sometimes you need a meanie to put another in their place! And trust me, there's many more meanies on Ellie's list! Oh, will you help me? We can have so much fun working together, I pinkie promise! Neighhhhhhh!"
"YAY! We're going to have sooo much fun, superfan!!! I can't wait! I'm super excited!"

"Oh you make me sad. So so sad..." Ellie makes an exaggerated frown with her face momentarily then goes back to smiling. Creeped out beyond anything you've ever been before, you get up and leave as quickly as possible.

name: ELLIE_LEAVE
text: "Captain, where are we going?" You turn to see Ellie frowning at you. "We're not done here! Get back in there, and. Finish. This."

name: ELLIE_RIGLEY

unvisitedTooltip.text: This is where Ellie demanded that you, "superfan", escort her.

visitedTooltip.text: Explored location. Nothing left of interest.

text: Before you is some kind of orbit-bound warehouse, surrounded by various Union transport ships and a single Auto-ship manufactured by Wentworth Innovations. Next to it is a small ship, likely some kind of mobile office. Despite the dinky size, the economics of this scene suggest a rather large expense went towards it all.

event.text: You dock near the cargo ships and enter the warehouse to see rows upon rows of merchandise for various colorful, animal-themed characters. Dora the Durgan, Cammie the Calhalou, Remmy the Rekma, and most of all, Sammy the Spider. Despite the mundaneness of that last one, he seems to have the most dedicated merchandise in the room. There isn't a single article dedicated to Ellie, and you can tell she's fuming.

Ellie doesn't hear you, instead moving closer to the shelves. She looks fondly at the other characters, silently recalling old memories. But when she gets to the Sammy aisle, she suddenly turns aggressive, throwing various novelty items like singing animatronics and spider-flavored ice cream onto the floor, kicking over shelves, and repeatedly plunging her knife into the heart of a large stuffed spider. Admist all the noise you hear a door open and a rather rotund man shout, slightly muffled by some food sloppily shoveled into his mouth. "WHAT IN THE- WHO ARE YOU PEOPLE?! WHY ARE YOU HERE?"
					
When his eyes finally land on Ellie, his composure changes rapidly, first to bemusement, then to horror, then to hysteria. "STEPHAN? YOU RAVING MAD LUNATIC! HAHAHAH! YOU'RE STILL WEARING THAT HORSE COSTUME? HAHAHAHAHAH! HAAH! Hah... You know, that costume belongs to me you little runt. I don't suppose you've come to bring it back to me though, have you?" Finally, the man seems to notice your crew. "Who's your friends? Waaaait... Stephan, did you hire a bunch of Renegades to KILL me?! HAHAHAHAH! Oh my god, this is hysterical. I... I can't even. What is wrong with you? You put the human species to shame. This is the behavior of a Zoltan pugilist or a braindead, drug-snorting Mantis. You can't kill me, anyways. I have... SECURITY!" The man shouts and a security team enters the room, and an automated drone activates outside.
To get to Rigley you'll have to take out the automated security first. Then you can decide what to do from there.

Ellie turns to you incredulously. You tell her none of this is worth it, but she doesn't seem to hear you. She lunges for Rigley and you have to jump in the way to stop her and drag her out of the room. Rigley laughs the whole time as you exit the building.

choice.text: Without Ellie there's no point in this.

event.text: You decide boarding the station isn't worth the risk.

name: ELLIE_RIGLEY_WIN
text:
Rigley has left the warehouse and is now hiding in his office ship. He'd likely have taken off if it weren't for the fact the ship was securely tethered to the station. You find him cowering underneath his desk, and as you approach, he scrambles for a wooden bat signed by some famous Union sports star, but you beat him to it. Seems like he's finally taking you seriously. "Okay, okay... You can keep the god damn costume Stephan. I don't even want to imagine what depraved shit you've done in it. Just leave me alone. I don't care what crazy conspiracies you've concocted, I didn't get you booted off the show. That was all the higher-ups, okay? And it's not exactly a mystery why."
	
Ellie shakes her head. "No, no no... you see, Rigley, I know you and Vance... talk. The Mars-Day Massacres? Remember those?" Rigley shifts in his seat uncomfortably. You can tell Ellie is doing this all for you, coaxing you into accepting what she's about to do to this man. She's not lying either - you've heard a bit about Spruce, and he goes way back with the Rebel Admiral, and his parents. The question is, is it the best idea to murder him in cold blood right here and right now?

choice.text: Stand back and let Ellie do this.

event.text: Ellie takes another step closer, and Rigley's breath gets more and more erratic. "Wait, wait, Stephan, let's think this through. How does... a brand new line of Ellie merch sound? I can arrange it for you - it'll be like... a retro pack! A throwback! Nostalgia for the old days!" Ellie smiles. "That sounds fabulotastic, Rigley!" Rigley breathes a sigh of relief, and is promptly decapitated by a single stroke of Ellie's knife. His head hits the floor, and Ellie stands over the corpse to survey it. "Ellie will visit your funeral and let you know how the new merch sells! It'll do great, she promises!" Ellie grabs one of the forms off of Rigley's desk and writes something down and folds it up into her pocket. She curtsies and gallops out of the room full stride. You notice a new vigor in her step as she leaves, and you waste no time in following her.

choice.text: Stop her. Killing this guy is a bad idea.

event.text:
You place a hand on Ellie's shoulder and ask her to stop. You can feel her whole body shaking, and her eyes have glazed over. Your words barely reach her - but they do reach her. You can sense maybe she doesn't want to do this, or that at least she's conflicted. Rigley notices this as well and immediately tries to take advantage of it. "Stephan, remember the good times we used to have? Heheh... when we used to discuss new merchandise ideas, or talk about how we could make the show pop out more to a broader audience? Wasn't that fun? Wasn't-"
				
Rigley is cut off by his own blood-curdling scream as Ellie brings her knife down and severs his hand, spilling blood all over some important-looking legal documents. Rigley clutches his hand and continues to scream, falling onto his side and rolling around on the floor. Ellie breathes a deep sigh and pockets her knife. "Good times they were, Rigley! Next time, think a bit before you decide the good times have to STOP, okay? Bye bye!" Ellie grabs a form from his desk and cheerfully waves, then gallops out of the room.
			
You take one last look at the pathetic man on the floor and half-heartedly remind him he'll be able to afford a good artificial replacement for his hand later, and to apply pressure to the wound. Rigley doesn't hear you, and you turn and leave the room as well.

name: ELLIE_HUEGHEY

unvisitedTooltip.text: This is where Ellie demanded that you, "superfan", escort her.

visitedTooltip.text: Explored location. Nothing left of interest.

text: A rather bland and uninteresting law firm has been constructed nearby, with a sign that reads "ARMSTRONG AND LORENCE LAW FIRM". Not that you've seen many in your day, but if you had to imagine, this one is unique in how mind-numbingly dull it is. Despite the drabness, it reeks of that particularly potent odor of the wealthy, and staring at the building makes you want to commit more violence than ordinary. It's probably best to get this over with quickly.

event.text: You step aboard the law firm and gag on the musty smell of the office rooms. Ellie doesn't seem too fazed, as if she's been in this room many times before. This idea is reaffirmed as she flawlessly navigates her way through rows upon rows of cubicles and labyrinthine office installments. She finally comes to stop at a door labeled "Armstrong". She takes a gigantic, overexaggerated breath, then slams her fist through the door and yanks it off its hinges. Inside the room, a thin man glances up. If he's startled by this violent entrance, he sure doesn't show it. "Hmph. Stephan. Back from the... dumpster bin, are you?" Hueghey lights a cigarette and leans back in his chair. "You know you will have to... pay for those damages, right?"

choice.text: You don't look like a Hueghey.

event.text: "And you look like someone I didn't ask for an opinion from." The man peers over his spectacles to get a better look at you. "Judging from the ugly mug I'm going to guess you're... undesirables. Vigilantes. Hmph."

choice.text: And so what if we are?

event.name: ELLIE_HUEGHEY_2
event.text: "Let me remind you that... in the precedent of the Rusting Hulks incident, the Union outlawed vigilante work." Hueghey smiles smugly, as if he's said something rather cunning. "That means you're operating outside of the law."

Finally the man's composure seems momentarily broken, as if he didn't expect you to not care about the law. "Uhm... hmph. Nevermind. Stephan, would you care... explaining why you've dragged this riff-raff into the room?" Ellie, however, isn't paying attention. Instead she's wandered over to the wall, where you notice the only personal decorations you've seen in this entire building. Various framed and signed portraits of the formerly Ellie the Equinoid show are up on the wall, including Sammy the Spider. Ellie, of course, is nowhere to be seen.
									
Ellie laughs nervously. "Heheh... Hueghey, where's MY photo?" She points to the wall where Sammy's photo is. "Mine used to be... right there. Now it's just some... INSECT. Children don't like insects. Why would you do this? Why. Would. You. Do. This? Did you lose it?" Hueghey frowns. "No, I threw it away. Because you're a has-been. A washed up lunatic with no future. The company had its use of you. But Wentworth wanted you canned." Hueghey smiles, as if he knows some kind of dark secret. "It was inevitable. And all your fault too."
									
You notice Ellie has begun to shake, and her eyes glaze over once again. "M-my fault? Ellie the Equinoid is the most beloved character in all of media history! I entertained the children! Washed up has-been?! My career isn't over! Unlike YOURS THAT'S ABOUT TO BE!" She lunges for Hueghey but the thin man slips out of the way and activates a panic switch under his desk. Alarms flash and you can tell security has been called. Time to get to work or to get out of here!
The security isn't quite what you expect - a Rebel elite, in fact. If there was any clue-in that this firm might be tied to Vance, this is a sure one. Either way, it's time to take down some Rebels.

Ellie turns to you incredulously. You tell her none of this is worth it, but she doesn't seem to hear you. You're forced to drag her out of the building, and quickly. By the time security arrives you're already gone.
"Yes... and so do you." The man peers over his spectacles to get a better look at you. "Judging from the ugly mug I'm going to guess you're... undesirables. Vigilantes. Hmph."

choice.text: And so what if we are?
You shouldn't smoke, it's bad for you.

event.text: "Yes... and so is being a mercenary." The man lingers on that last word, knowing it's a word that gets on Renegades' nerves. He peers over his spectacles to get a better look at you. "Judging from the ugly mug I'm going to guess you're... undesirables. Vigilantes. Hmph."

choice.text: And so what if we are?
Without Ellie there's no point in this.

event.text: You decide this mission isn't worth the risk.

name: ELLIE_HUEGHEY_WIN
text:
By the time you've landed your ship, you're just in time to see Hueghey running out of the building, but he doesn't get far. Ellie jumps in the way and pushes him onto the ground, resting her boot on his face and grinding it against the rough concrete. Hueghey screams but can only just be heard over Ellie's maniac laughter. "STEPHAN! STOP! I will SUE YOU to KINGDOM COME!" Only then does it seem to finally dawn on the dried up lawyer that Ellie doesn't care about the legality of this situation. "O-okay. Stephan, listen. Maybe we can talk this through. Your beef is with Wentworth, right? Or the divorce? I know - I represented your wife during that dispute. It was an honest... mistake." He struggles to spit out the word mistake. "But I can... uhm... I can get you in touch with Wentworth. Okay? I can be useful - I can..."
	
Ellie spits on the ground next to Hueghey. "The only thing I hate more than a double-crosser is one who'll double-cross for both sides. What kind of degenerate morals did they teach your generation? I aspire to teach children POSITIVITY! And friendship! And kindness! You represent crooks and genocidal maniacs, and keep them out of hot water when they want to start race riots that provoke civil wars." Ellie lingers on that last thought, as if she wants to say more, but stops. She begins to reach for her knife slowly, making sure Hueghey can see her motions and quiver in fear.

choice.text: Stand back and let Ellie kill him.

event.text: Ellie draws her knife and gets on her knee, holding the blade up to Hueghey's arm. She begins to cut away sections from his flesh while whistling a merry tune from her show. At least, you think that's what she's whistling, because you can't hear it very well between the screaming and sobbing from Hueghey. You notice various other workers fleeing the scene and turning to point and scream at Ellie's violence before them. Once the screams have finally stopped, and Hueghey's corpse is barely even recognizable, Ellie finally stops and gets up. The blood splatters over her uniform are fairly disconcerting, but you can tell Ellie has certainly been... invigorated by this. "Another one down! Doo doo doo! Superfantastulastic!"
