choice.text: Stop her. Nothing good will be gained by this.

event.text:
You've been desensitized to violence, and may commit a fair share of it yourself, but you know what's about to happen next is going to be purely sadistic brutality. This man is shameful, but he's no Vance Wentworth. His punishment deserves to be at the hands of the law - the very thing he pretends to protect. You tell Ellie this much, and she seems to listen. "Okay Hueghey! Superfan over here decided you get to live today! Normally I wouldn't be this nice, but since I already set up that fire bomb in your office, I think we can call it even!" Hueghey stutters. "F-fire bomb?"
			
Ellie pulls out a switch from her pocket and presses the button, and shards of glass rain down from above. You look up to see billows of smoke forming from one of the windows. Ellie bellies over in laughter, "This is why you don't smoke, kids! You'll set all of your life's work on fire!" She wipes away a gleeful tear and walks back to the ship, making sure to step on top of Hueghey on her way. You give the man no pity of your own and follow her.

name: ELLIE_REMMY

unvisitedTooltip.text: This is where Ellie demanded that you, "superfan", escort her.

visitedTooltip.text: Explored location. Nothing left of interest.

text: The nearby establishment is no casino nor bar - it's actually a Militia outpost, albeit a fairly casual one. Various non-militia civilians wander about, and a section in the dining hall hosts a group of rough but friendly looking militia soldiers that are engrossed in lively banter. It shouldn't take too long to find 'Remmy'.

event.text: Simply following the noise of the crowd of militiamen, you realize the banter is being casted over a routine poker game. As you approach, the contrasting bright pink of Ellie's suit causes many heads to turn. One man in particular, a very unusually small Rockman, seems to be the most shocked of all. "Stephan? What in the blazes are you doing here?" The Rockman pulls out a seat and offers Ellie to sit, but she ignores him. "Remmy, I found you! Fuh-fuh-fuh-found you! You thought you could hide from me? Well you were wrong!"

choice.text: Wait, you're the one who plays Remmy?

event.text:
The Rockman nods. "Yes, though it's not something you'd find out without digging. I don't know why I took the job, it's been nothing but hell. It's why I also run this Militia gig - the Union has no laws protecting the equal pay of immigrant species, and I was never paid as much as anyone else. Certainly not as much as Stephan." Upon mentioning the other actor in the room, the Rockman turns back to Ellie. "Stephan, we're not at work right now. You don't need to call me Remmy anymore, heh. It's just Gos." Gos sticks out his hand, which you instinctually shake despite the purpose of your mission here. The friendly and unintimidating composure of the Rockman has disarmed you, and even Ellie seems a bit reserved. Even still, she sticks to the script.
					
"Remmy, Remmy, Remmy. You can lie all you want, but Ellie knows the truth! She's an honest horse, and she knows a liar well!"
Gos seems genuinely hurt. "Stephan, are you accusing me of getting you fired? We've been friends since day one! You were the only one on that cast that treated me like an actual person, and not some kind of alien defect or unwanted invader. We used to go for rides in the Equinox, we designed merchandise ideas together, we hung out after work almost weekly! What they did to you was terrible, and it's a large reason why I quit! But being nice to the newcomer doesn't mean I turned my back on you! Michael seems like a good guy, and he's a great actor. Good with kids, and he plays Sammy well. He's certainly nowhere as dedicated to the role as you are, but you can't blame him for a decision made all the way up the ladder to W.I. when they bought the studio!"
Ellie begins to scream and shout, kicking over tables and tearing up some paintings on the wall. Startled by the sudden violent actions, multiple Militia soldiers have abandoned the poker game and now have their hands on their weapons. "LIAR! LIAR! LIAR! YOU'RE A RAT! A TRAITOR! DON'T LIE TO ELLIE, SHE KNOWS THE TRUTH! A-and... and... and my friends here will back me up! Right? You wouldn't betray me, would you superfan?" You don't know what's prompting Ellie to act like this, but she turns to you, pleading for your support.

While the idea of fighting all of these Militiamen doesn't excite you, you stand your ground behind Ellie. Gos seems at a loss, but the other Militiamen don't hesitate. The threat now apparent, the station turns hostile and you have a fight on your hands!

"No, no no no no no no! You can't seriously be... how could you DO this superfan?! Fine, I'll do this MYSELF. LIKE I ALWAYS HAVE TO!" Ellie reaches for her knife, but as her eyes dart across the room and sees just how outnumbered she is, she stops. "I..." Ellie straightens her shoulders and takes a deep breath in and out, and her composure changes very suddenly to friendly. "You're right Gos, you wouldn't betray me, would you? You... you'd never betray your best friend Ellie! Remmy and Ellie, they're the most iconic duo in media history!"
Gos nods carefully. "Just like old times, yeah? I know the divorce hit you hard Stephan, and getting fired even more, but you can't make it alone in this screwed up Multiverse. I can try my best to help you, but in the end you have to help yourself first."
							
Ellie shakes her head. "Ellie IS helping herself! She's on the right path, don't you worry best friend! Okay, well I have to go now, space is big and there's a lot of children out there who need Ellie! Bye bye! Let's go, superfan!" Ellie gallops out the door and back to the ship.

You go to follow but Gos puts a hand on your shoulder to stop you. "Hey, thanks for that. Just... keep an eye on him, okay? He's always been a bit... well I'm not sure how to put it politely. A bit loopy, I guess. Back when he joined Flowers and Sunshine, the company was in the dirt, and Stephan was nothing but a deadbeat actor who had fallen from grace. When his wife left him, and took his kid as well, he devoted himself to the role like crazy. He got acting tips from Cornelius Parrysmith, the most renowned method actor in the Multiverse, but he also started to... believe he WAS the character. I like the guy, but I also know he needs a friend. When he got fired, everything went downhill. I don't actually know why they sacked him, though I heard rumors it came all the way from the top. He practically single-handedly brought the company to fortune! I have a sinking feeling he won't stop until he's gotten 'Sammy'. Don't let him hurt Michael, okay? There's a lot of scumbags at W.I., but we actors are just trying to make a living." Gos nods and pats you on the back. "Alright, that's all I had to say. I'll have my boys give you a little something on the way out. Always good to see someone protecting the Federation."

choice.text: Without Ellie there's no point in this.

event.text: You decide this mission isn't worth the risk.

name: ELLIE_GOS_WIN

Finally, she paces back to the center of the room and stands over Gos, staring him in the eyes. "This is what happens to traitors, Remmy. Do me a favor and say hi to Sammy in h-e-double hockey sticks!" Ellie performs one single swipe of her knife against Gos's throat, sealing his fate. As the Rockman bleeds out on the floor, Ellie wipes the blood from her knife and marches out of the room with less of her usual childlike manner.

text: The coordinates Ellie gave you take you straight to a well constructed and evidently expensive piece of real-estate, seemingly a vacation home. Even more bafflingly, an MFK Ace is parked outside as some sort of guard. To get inside, you'll have to kill them first.

event.text: As soon as you reveal your ship, the MFK ship locks on and attacks. Get ready for combat!

name: ELLIE_PAUL_WIN
text: With no more need for stealth, Ellie breaks down the front door and barges her way inside. You and your crew march your way to the highest floor, where a sickly thin man in a bathroom stands staring out a window. A row of TV monitors on the side show security footage of the wrecked MFK and front door. "So, you've arrived at last, Stephan. When I heard the news of your hijinks with Spruce and Armstrong I wondered if you'd be coming here next." The man turns around, revealing a long scar that cuts through his now-missing left eye. He bows to you in mock hospitality. "Welcome to Casa de Lancastor. I hope you don't mind the mess, a bunch of neanderthals and a freak in a horse costume just broke into my house. Please, why don't you have a seat?" Paul sits, legs folded, in a padded swivel chair facing several uncomfortable folding chairs.

event.name: ELLIE_PAUL_SIT
event.text: Your crew all take a seat except for Ellie, who of course is in her usual lone-wolf self. Paul seems almost bored by her presence rather than frightened. "So, Stephan. Do tell me why you're here."

event.name: ELLIE_PAUL_2
event.text:
"Well Pauly, superfan here and I came to pay you a little visit! A little payback for all your hard work getting me tossed in the dumpster! Let's face it, you were always jealous of me! Ellie's grace always overshadowed your creative genius, and you know the show would have been NOTHING without me! Flowers and Sunshine would be a ghost town if not for little ol' Ellie. I'm a superstar, a superfantasticalasticstar!"

Paul breaks out into full on laughter, curling into a ball in pain from how much he's laughing. "HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAH! JEALOUS?! OF YOU?!" Paul scoots closer, his smug smile receding and replaced by a menacing look. "I gave you a chance to climb up from the ground, you psycopathic lunatic. I built this whole damn show, and you just rode on my success. Acting tips from Cornelius Parrysmith? What a riot! The only person more insane than Cornelius I've ever met is YOU. You were a drugged up, smoke-addicted dumpster fire who couldn't act for shit. Why do you think your wife left you, huh? Because she couldn't stand to be around you. You're disgusting, you're worthless."
					
Ellie slams her knife into the desk in front of her, leaning in closer. "I AM NOT WORTHLESS! I AM BELOVED, I AM FABULOUS, I AM THE GREATEST CHARACTER IN ALL OF MEDIA HISTORY!"

Paul snorts. "No, you're just delusional. Ellie's ratings were tanking long before you were fired. Kids got tired of the gimmick. They don't want wholesome, happy bullshit. They don't want morals. They want to be entertained. Comedy's gotten darker. Kids have matured. The Civil War really changed this great nation, and for the better I say! The Union's ready to handle the truth, that this Multiverse is a dangerous place and they need to be ready to fight for their right to live here. Vance has the right idea. Those Rebels are out risking their lives to make things better for all of us, but until that happens we can't keep up with the goo-goo ga-ga fluff."

Ellie shakes her head repeatedly. "No no no, you're lying! You're a lying liar who lies! Children will always love me! I was fired because of a grand scheme orchestrated by Vance Wentworth! Don't lie to me!"
					
"I don't need to lie to you. You just need to stop pretending you're the main character in everyone else's life. Yeah, Vance was the one who ordered you to be fired. Because what kind of example were you setting for his nephew? After what you did to his sister? You wretch, he ought to have executed you for treating her that way. Instead, he just gave you the boot. It's well known you're a Fed-sympathizer anyways, and people like that aren't all too popular in these parts. Just consider yourself lucky you don't have lead lodged between your last remaining three brain-cells and get lost. Go find the dumpster you crawled out of and lock yourself in, for the benefit of everyone."

Ellie lunges for Paul, grabbing him by the throat and pulling him onto the ground. She begins maniacally beating him with her fists, but the man makes not even so much as a whimper as he's assaulted. It seems he's accepted his own fate, and doesn't even care. The question is, what benefit will this bring?

Ellie continues to beat Paul, her fists getting bloodier and bloodier, and Paul's face is slowly reduced to a pulp. Once the man's lost consciousness, Ellie stands up and brings down her boot to his face, caving it with a sickening splurt of blood. Out of breath, she collapses into a shivering heap next to the corpse of the former-director. Not sure what else to do, you lift her up and carry her back to the ship.

Ellie doesn't hear you, continuing to beat Paul until you're forced to pull her away kicking and screaming. "LET ME AT HIM! LET. ME. AT. HIM! HE DESERVES IT! THE SWOGGLIN! THE DINGUS! THE..." Ellie struggles to find another PG insult to use. In her desperate searching, she finally calms down and collapses to the ground in a shivering and sobbing heap. "I'm not a failure... I'm not... a failure..." Paul seems to only barely even be conscious, and his facade of indifference has broken. Amidst the quiet sobbing of the two men, you lift Ellie up and carry her back to the ship.
Paul flinches. "Sit."

The director lets out a tired sigh. "Fine. Stand there like a moron and be uncomfortable." Paul turns towards Ellie, who's standing off to the side glaring at him. He seems almost bored by her presence rather than frightened. "So, Stephan. Do tell me why you're here."

name: ELLIE_SAMMY

unvisitedTooltip.text: This is where Ellie demanded that you, "superfan", escort her.

visitedTooltip.text: Explored location. Nothing left of interest.

text: The coords take you to a gigantic and busy urban city, with heavy traffic from off-world. From the flood of advertisements you receive approaching the surface, it seems Sammy is on some kind of galactic tour, traveling with the other Flowers and Sunshine mascots on a live televised performance for children all over. Security seems extremely tight due to the size of the event, and if you had to guess they might already know Ellie's coming. What really catches your eye though is the bright blue and spider-shaped cruiser that seems to be smiling upon the crowd below. If you had to guess, this is how the cast of the show's been getting around, though the arsenal of weapons is certainly... a strange addition.

event.text:
You sneak aboard the building where the event is being held, slipping through the back stages. Ellie moves with complete purpose, no galloping or horse noises. She stares forward laser focused, searching for one man and one man only. Eventually you reach the dressing rooms, where a couple cast members half-dressed in their costumes see you. "Hey, hey, you people can't be back here! Fans aren't allowed backstage even with a pass until after the concert's over! Damn it, where's security..."
Ellie spreads her arms and lets out a high pitched squeal. "Dora! Cammie! You guys are here! It's me, Ellie! I don't need a pass, silly, I'm the main character of the show. So forgetful." Ellie fakes a large sigh. "But I'll forgive you both because today is a very exciting day! The day Ellie gets what she deserves!"
The two mascots turn to each other. "S-Stephan? Wh-wh-what are you d-doing? Holy shit, when we heard about Rigley... and Hueghey... Stephan- what is WRONG with you?! You're insane!"
			
"Oh no, you guys too?! All around me, traitors, traitors, traitors! What's a horse to do? I'm so tired of this madness. The Multiverse has gone to crock. The only thing that can save it now is Ellie. Ellie and her best friend, superfan! Now. Get. Out. Of. My. Way." Ellie pushes her way past the mascots, who fall to the ground and don't even bother to get back up. You glance back at them before following Ellie into the room marked with a large blue "S". Inside, a tall but rather ordinary man sits in a padded chair facing a mirror, doing breathing exercises. He doesn't hear you come in, but when Ellie grabs him from behind and throws him to the floor, it gets his attention.
"S-SECURI-MMPH" Sammy is cut off by Ellie's boot in his mouth. "Now now Sammy. Naughty little spider. I caaaauuuught you! Ellie caught you! Heheheh!" Ellie sways her hands back and forth and does a little song and dance. Sammy struggles to escape from underneath Ellie but to no avail. However, clearly either someone heard his shouting earlier or the two mascots reported your crew, because you can hear shouting from outside and heavy footsteps. From the sound of it, there's quite a few guards on their way. You need to leave, and quickly.

There's no choice here - you're outnumbered and if you stay, you'll either be arrested or way too many people will die. Ellie isn't listening as usual, so you grab her by the arm and yank her out the door. As soon as you leave, Sammy runs out in the other direction, yelling for security to follow you.
					
You make it safely outside the building and back to the ship, but not before a fully-suited woman jumps out in front of you to block you from getting to your ship, blaster in hand. She's a Rebel of some kind, but from her black and yellow uniform you can't quite tell what rank. Either way, not the kind of individual you'd expect to see here. "So it's true! The deranged actor IS hunting down Flowers and Sunshine's cast members. When word reached Vance in Universe 1, well... there was quite a lot of hysteria! You have to imagine, after all your history... and to hear you're still out there! He thought you were dead, or in a loony bin somewhere at least. Unfortunately, you must understand Stephan, that Flowers and Sunshine is a member of the Wentworth Innovations family, and you aren't a part of that family. It's against business interests to leave you or your Renegade friends as liabilities. I was dispatched, hand chosen, from Universe 1 to make sure you STAY fired this time."
					
The Rebel turns to you. "Vance sends his best regards, by the way. You're the one they sent to dismantle the Flagship? Really? Not who I would have chosen, but then again I have the intelligence to side with the liberators, not the oppressors. Now... I COULD kill you with my ship... but I think it'd be more entertaining for you to die to that big stupid looking blue spider. Hah." The cruiser from earlier powers on in the distance, its already out of place arsenal now humming with power. No more time to waste, it's time to fight!

name: ELLIE_SAMMY_WIN
text: As you fly back past the stadium, you notice the collateral damage from the fight has left the venue in disarray. The front entrance is on fire and emergency services are doing their best to get inside, while crowds of people are either paralyzed in their seats or fleeing to any exit they can find. While you're focused on the crowds, Ellie runs up to you and reports she spotted Sammy crawling around on the stage, trying to find help. "We have to go after him! Pull the ship in closer!"

choice.text: What? Seriously?! Haven't we done enough?

event.text:
Ellie draws her knife on you, demanding you pull the ship in closer. Not wanting to start another fight, you do as she says. To your shock, once you're close enough to the open roof of the stage, Ellie rushes for one of the airlocks and leaps out. She catches herself on one of the tarps, tearing it and swinging her way down to the stage. She hits the floor and rolls, and for a moment you think she might be dead from such a long fall. However, she gets up again with a limp and continues to approach Sammy, knife drawn. The crowd screams in terror, but their eyes are glued on the scene.
			
"ELLIE'S BACK! ELLIE'S BACK ON THE STAGE EVERYONE! CHEER FOR ME!" Ellie spins around, stumbling because of her leg. She flicks her knife from out of her suit and points it directly at Sammy. "Sammy the Spider, you're no hero of any child! You're a monster, teaching the youth the degenerate morals of an era of Rebel filth! You're a disgrace to everything this show has ever stood for! And to think, you fired me! You kicked Ellie the Equinoid OFF THE ELLIE THE EQUINOID SHOW! YOU LUNATIC!"
"Stephan, please, stop! My name is Michael, I'm just an actor! You're just an actor! It's just a kid's show!"
"SHUTTUP! SHUTTUP! YOU KNOW NOTHING! YOU- YOUR FAVORITE MUSIC IS RAP MUSIC! YOU HAVE NO TASTE!"
"Stephan, I don't even listen to rap music! Before this job I was just an Ellie imitator who worked gigs at carnivals and birthday parties! I was a nobody, and you were my hero! I remember watching you as a kid, you brought me so much joy! I-I drank quarp juice every day at recess! I still have my Ellie plushie from when I was a kid! I didn't fire you, I-I swear! I just got lucky, scoring a birthday gig for Vance's nephew! Ellie was his favorite character too! Vance thought I was good, but he didn't like the character! He told me he was planning to buy the studio, and add some new characters! He suggested I might play a role well! I was so excited... I had no idea I was going to be REPLACING you! I thought I'd get to work alongside you!"
Ellie stutters at the mention of Vance's nephew, but seems to shake it off. "LIAR, LIAR! LIAR! DON'T GIVE ME THAT MALARKEY! NO NO NO! THERE IS ONLY ONE ELLIE! YOU CANNOT BE ELLIE!" Ellie grabs Michael by the leg and with an impressive display of upper-body strength tosses him behind her. As Michael tries to get off the ground, Ellie plunges her knife into his shoulder, twisting it. Her smile grows wider and wider, as blood coats her uniform. "ELLIE THE EQUINOID WILL ALWAYS BE THE GREATEST. CHARACTER. IN ALL OF MEDIA HISTORY! AND I. WILL ALWAYS. BE HER!"

choice.text: You've stopped enough of these murders. Maybe you can stop Ellie again?

event.text:
With no time to waste, you call out to Ellie. Though your voice is mostly drowned out by all the screaming, it seems to reach Ellie regardless. She pauses, knife still in hand, and glances over at the crowd. Thousands of eyes stare down on her in terror, many of them children who used to revere her, or would have once if they had been old enough to watch her show in the past. Ellie falters, then glances back at Michael, whose whimpering has subsided and been replaced with quiet submission, ready for his fate.
					
"Ellie... El... oh my god." Ellie stands up, and looks at her hands, soaked in a crimson red. "What have I done? What have I become? Ellie... Ellie would never do this. Ellie doesn't... murder people. They were right. I'm insane. I'm wearing a bloody horse costume and I'm completely insane. How did I get here? HOW DID I GET HERE?" Stephan begins to scream, collapsing to his knees and putting his hands on his head. "WHAT HAVE I DONE?! ELENA? ELENA? OH MY GOD ELENA YOU WERE RIGHT! I BELONG IN AN ASYLUM... I... I belong in an asylum..." Stephan falls to the floor, sobbing. "I'm sorry Michael, I'm sorry... god what have I done?"
Michael, still in shock, struggles to respond, but when he does it's in a strangely composed manner. "You need to see a doctor. And you need to get as far away from Ellie and this show as you can. It's messing with you, man. This job made you go crazy. I think... I think I'm going to pass out." And so Michael does, leaving Stephan all alone on the stage. "Renegade.. I guess superfan isn't the right word... what do I do? What becomes of me? Michael's right... god how did I ever think I could come back from this." He tears off the gigantic horse head and throws it off the stage, revealing a messy tangle of grey hair and an aging man. He doesn't look menacing in even the slightest without the costume, just a sad old man with a broken life.

"Really? After all of this, you'd still keep me around? I don't... I don't understand. I'm nothing but a liability. I guess it's a chance. A chance to be something. I can't make up for what I've become, but in whatever years I have left maybe I can do something. Thank you, Renegade. Not for sparing me, but for sparing all the people I tried to kill. You're the hero to children that I never could be. We need more people like you."

choice.text: Convince Stephan to turn himself in.

event.text: The only thing that could keep Stephan, and the rest of the galaxy safe, is locking him away. Even he knows this now, and hearing it from you has little effect. "Yes... yes I suppose that's what I must do. I still... I still feel myself clinging to the idea that maybe things can still go back to how they were. I'm a monster. I'm a lunatic. And I guess the only place for those things, if not at the bottom of an ocean, is in an asylum. Thank you, Renegade, for sparing all those people I tried to kill. Be the kind of hero to children that I never could."

choice.text: All you can do is watch in horror.

event.text:
With nothing and no one able or willing to do anything now to reach Ellie, the inevitable is all that is left to occur. In a final stroke of both knife and fate, Michael falls with a severed neck. Ellie stands, murder weapon in hand, and receives with open arms her standing ovation of screams and tears. "They love me! They love Ellie! They always have! They always will! HAHAHAHAHAH! HAAAHAHAHAH! I'm a star!" Ellie turns to you, arms still wide. "Superfan, the day of Ellie is now! No more Sammy! There is ONLY. The Ellie show. And that is all that there ever will be!"
					
Before you now stands a monster, a monster that perhaps if you had chosen differently, you could have prevented. But now this is your responsibility. You doubt Ellie will go much further in life from here, but she might still be of use to you in the mission. After that though is another story.

You say nothing to Ellie but yank her arm and run back to the ship. Still lost in her dreamland, Ellie skips and dances her way back to the ship with you. The Federation probably won't be very happy with you for enabling this.

You have no use on your ship for someone as far gone as Ellie is now. She'll only become a liability for you and your crew. You head back to the ship, while reinforcements descend on the stage in the distance. Chances are, Ellie's moment of glory won't last for much longer.

name: FILLER_SIGNAL
text: A Federation encrypted signal is being broadcast from a nearby planet.

choice.text: Send an away party to investigate.
