text: Tony is staring out the window of the ship, taking photos of the stars as you travel. It feels odd to see him doing something not inherently sinister.

event.text: If there's somehow something unethical going on here, you'd prefer to not have to think about it. Tony chuckles to himself as you walk away... hopefully out of a genuine appreciation for the beauty of the cosmos, but probably not.

"Ah, I just had a brilliant idea while I was reading through some old Earth history. Apparently humans used to sell each other the right to name a star so they could make a quick buck, and it got me thinking. With the Multiverse open to us now, why not sell stars from other universes to people? After all, the average person will never jump universes to check what they ACTUALLY call the star, so it's not like there's a risk to it."

choice.text: But don't they all look the same? What's the difference between the same star in different universes?

event.text: "Wait just a second, that's brilliant! I don't need to take photos of stars across the Multiverse, I can just lie! Now I can get back to growing my business empire, instead of staring at these damnable stars all day." If you had any hope left for Tony becoming a better person, this would have crushed it.

choice.text: Walk away before you give him any more ideas.

name: SOCIALIZE_TONY_GENERIC_6
text: "Captain, I have a business proposition for you. It's maybe a strange one, but I think it's the best decision you could ever make." Unsure what he's asking for, you inquire further. "I need you to sell me your body, when this is all over. I figure, when the war in this universe is finished, you'll probably have a few minutes of fame as the local savior of the Federation. I could capitalize on that with a museum, but I'd have to act fast, and I'll need something unique to bait people in. And what would be more unique than your actual, taxidermied body? Think about it - people paying money just to look at you - even more if they want to take a picture. Imagine crowds of people lining up to buy plushies that look just like you!"

event.text: "Well... would that really be the worst thing? Poor people die all the time, doing stupid things like 'working for a better life' and 'fighting to save their universe'. You already knew you might die against the Flagship, so why not just seal the deal and make yourself a legend? Shit, if I ever die, I know I'd want them to prop me up in the boardroom. What's the point of existing, if not to have your lessers praise you?"

name: SOCIALIZE_TONY_BILLY_1
text:
Tony appears to be trying to make conversation with Billy. "Hey, Billy, it's been a long time since we've talked, but-"

"Not right now Tony, I'm busssy! Sssshit, I'm late for my 6:05 call!" Billy stumbles and drops one of the 8 phones he's juggling. "SSSSHIT, NOW IT'SSSS BROKEN! God damn it, I can't take thisss sssstress!" Billy turns to Tony. "Tony, if you want to make yourssself ussseful, go get me a coffee, pronto!"

You prepare to watch two impossibly self-important people collide with each other, but instead Tony slithers off to go make Billy his coffee. Flabbergasted, you chase him to ask why he would suck up to Billy. Tony seems confused that you would even ask - "He's richer than me."

event.text:
Tony shrugs. "There's an order to these things. You'd snap to it and make coffee if a superior officer ordered you to, and I'll do the same for someone richer. It helps grease the wheels between companies if we all know where we stand." Moments later, Tony returns with the coffee. Billy more gracefully accepts. "Oh, by the way, Tony, did you get my messssage about the adjustmentssss to our crossss-promotion?"
			
"Yes, of course. It all sounds good, though you didn't need to be so formal about it - we're both on the same ship right now, after all."
			
"Ah, you're right. Sssorry, when you're mailing out a few dozen of thesssse, you forget the finer detailsss. Thanksssss for the coffee, by the way."
			
Billy runs off as another one of his phones starts to ring, leaving you very confused on how to interpret this reunion.

name: SOCIALIZE_TONY_JERRY_1
text:
"Hi Mr. Senior! It... it is Mr. Senior, right?" Jerry waves to Tony as he passes.

"Er... yes. Well, kind of. I'm actually Tony Senior Junior. Senior is my last name, but Tony Senior Senior is my father. It's funny, because 'Senior' in my language actually means 'fortuitous'."

Jerry nods. "Language can be quite strange. I didn't know about that though!" You can tell Jerry isn't really that interested, but he's just playing along because he has more to say. "So uh... Tony. I know you're going through some stuff so... just in case you're ever feeling down, just know there's always people there for you, okay? Even in the strangest, most unlikeliest of places there's always people looking out for you. Never underestimate your allies."

Tony is touched but not entirely sold.

Jerry continues, "If you uh... ever forget that... just remember... uhm... even when things look bad Tony, you're never 'alony'." Jerry smiles sheepishly, and Tony bids him a heatfelt thank you.

"To be honest, I think I underestimated you. Not too fond of your uncle, but you seem like a good kid. But, just so you know, alony is a derogatory for a prostitute in my language. So probably not a good idea to go saying that to other Leeches."

name: SOCIALIZE_DESSIUS_NOTHING
text: "Hark, I grant thee mine finest sorrows, but in this hour I lack the proper words for a conversation in making. Mayhaps you are best in seeking conversation elsewhere until I have regenerated the interest to speak."

name: SOCIALIZE_DESSIUS_GENERIC_1
text: "Hail, dear Captain, for I come in search of a most curious favor. Would thou provide me with your finest gasses? I am with great certainty holding to the idea that you must possess most enriching gasses aboard this vessel, yes?"

event.text: "Yes, for gasses it is that I wish to consume. To assimilate, to become one with myself. A source of both nutrients and steady growth. It shall make me both stronger and wiser. Never mind it, I can see in your face utmost confusion. I will seek the gasses myself, and return with more specifics of my quest later. Farewell."

name: SOCIALIZE_DESSIUS_GENERIC_2
text: "I hath seen many a fine vessel in the centuries I have lived, Captain. I do say, this vessel may be among them! I too, have a most prized of vessels which someday I hope to pilot. Though, of course, it is not yet available for such a venture. For a little under a century it has sat awaiting its day in my finest shipyards, as its construction commences. Oh great 'Overture', some day your brilliance shall sail the cosmos and awaken all to the greatness of my fine Dynasty!" Dessius beams with pride, thinking of his soon to be flagship. Based on loose Federation intelligence, you've heard a little of this ship. The 'Overture', once finished, will be the largest known spaceship to ever have been constructed. Just be glad Dessius seems to like you and you'll probably never have to see the thing in action.

name: SOCIALIZE_DESSIUS_GENERIC_3
text: "Both myself and my ancestors have born witness to the evolution of a countless collection of civilization and species. Of the many, a few in mind stand to contest my greater observation. The Zoltans, those intrepid victims of a near self-imposed destruction, once captured my highest fascination. In a strangest of ways it could be said I even... cheered for their success? Something about their dreadful origins and painful ascent made me wish ever more for their highest ascension. But... their history is mired in a great many tragedies. First, the great infighting of generations. Then, the mandate for the abandon of physical form. And now, the rise of a violent and radical rule which threatens to soon outgrow their original, more peacable rule. They remind me of another kind so long ago who once threatened the decimation of this reality and the next over their own self-destructive foolishness. Now, I see only tragedy in the featureless faces of the hard-light ones. Alas, oh damn this curse of eternal memory."

name: SOCIALIZE_DESSIUS_GENERIC_4
text: "It takes only but a fool to challenge myself in a duel. I hath engaged in combat with the finest of combatants in the Multiverse, and only twice have I been bested." Dessius gets out that last part quickly, clearly not intended to elaborate on his losses. Could be an interesting story though.

event.text: "Hmph. Pitiful, is what they were. The first was despite an opponent who had no shame, and which I hardly hesitate to call a victor. A Paladin, whose inquisitionary force came to seek right to conquer the ruins of my people. I accepted a challenge, but I soon found I would not be facing an opponent who knew honorable conduct. Let us say that he... brought a missile launcher to this fair sword fight. It matters not though, for we dealt with the Inquisition swiftly regardless. Perhaps, I admit, putting an end to those zealots was truly one of the Federation's greatest but few achievements."

Dessius lingers in silence a bit too long, before finally releasing his shame. "The second... was against a Slug. It was to settle some trifle territorial manner... but the real stakes were symbolic. I believe many chose to interpret the fight as a match to settle who truly ruled the nebulas in this age. The Slug was swift, he was skilled, and he disarmed me quickly. I relive that match in my memories, or perhaps more correctly my nightmares, nightly. I could have won... and yet I, Dessius Yan Tartodicus, 16th Prime Reaper and greatest swordsman in the Multiverse, was bested by nothing but a common thief? It is a blot on history..."

name: SOCIALIZE_DESSIUS_GENERIC_5
text: "There is a dreadful fate awaiting this cluster, I can only feel it... But I know it is coming. It is a premonition I have felt in my essence since I first split from the 15th Reaper."

event.text: "Did thou not hear me? A dreadful one, I said. Art thou seeking more specifics? If so I'm afraid I do not know... but something deadly is brewing. We are nothing but actors in a far greater plot, I have learned this much. But when will the puppetmasters reveal themselves? We must be ready. I foresee it will happen within your lifetime... And certainly mine, since I shall live for centuries more at least."

"Oh, did I use such terminology? Yes, though such is but a theory. A theory proposed by scientists of an age very very long ago. That perhaps what we know of the Multiverse is in fact only a smaller infinity... in one much, much larger. But for what madman would compare infinities? Certainly not I. I merely foretell the apocalypse coming, as a horseman of the end. But hold your nihilistic fears, for I do not think the end is inevitable. Surely, something must be doable to prevent our demise. What that is though, I hold no such knowledge yet."

name: SOCIALIZE_DESSIUS_DEVORAK_1
text:
Ferocious clangs of metal fill your ears, guiding you towards the cargobay. There, you find Dessius and Devorak sparring, clashing their swords with furious momentum. "Fear my blade, Zoltan, thou shalt know only defeat against my prowess!"

Devorak says nothing, completely immersed in the duel. Dessius continues to taunt him, but you watch as Devorak seems to slip into a zen-like state. In just three strokes, he parries Dessius' swing, cuts upward, and disarms Dessius. With a metalic rattle the Reaper's sword flies to the opposite end of the room. Dessius is shocked. "So, thou hath bested me. So be it. I have been rendered disarmed. Claim your victory then, Zoltan." Dessius bows.

However, Devorak does not accept his victory. "I do not fight to win, Ghost. I fight for the exhilaration, and the reminder that I am still alive. Even in a friendly duel I am briefly reminded of my mortality. I do not wish to claim this victory. I am satisfied in having fought well against a talented opponent." He bows, and Dessius follows a few moments later.

name: SOCIALIZE_DESSIUS_EATER_1
text:
Dessius and the Beacon Eater are sat together in Dessius' quarters, staring intently at a set of charts and drawings.  "The runes... the meaning cryptic, but this weapon you think dangerous is?"

"Oh hark, most certainly. The legends tell there was a first... but it malfunctioned, and evolved further than was intended most surely by its creators. But that was after the war. We have born witness to it. The destruction it caused... was only secondary to what I hypothesize this may wreck."

The Beacon Eater mulls this information, whatever it means, over. "I have reason no to not trusting you. If intel suggests continued existence, then time is of essence. We must find any traces of weapon, and destroy them.

"Agreed. Perhaps only this may spare us the fate that destroyed the Vesyticcarithe so long ago." Your translator skips over that 'V' word, unable to find an appropriate translation. Whatever is going on in here, it seems you aren't meant to know about it.

name: SOCIALIZE_DESSIUS_TONY_1
text:
Tony is busy rigging a coin slot to the bathroom doors when Dessius approaches him. "Come with me, oh child of darkness, and let us sing the song of sorrows!" Paralyzed with confusion, Tony manages to choke out a simple "What?"

Dessius is not discouraged. "Through thine grapevine I hath become aware you seek to silence the siren's call of the end. But before you go, let us chant together, and perhaps in a new mind we will find new life and with it new meaning. A poetic symphony that restores the vigor and spirit of once was. Lady darkness is not a mistress most run to meet, but look and you shall find her grasp as comforting as your birth-giver's."
	
Tony is still utterly confused. "I think my translator is malfunctioning. I... have no clue what you're talking about." Dessius groans, and goes to leave. "I shan't be unwise and hold this against you... but I find it most tiring when such misunderstandings occur. I hope you find the strength to look to your broken spirit, oh miserable one. But I suppose I shan't be the one to find it for you."

name: SOCIALIZE_ANOINTED_NOTHING
text: On a routine patrol of the ship you stumble across The Anointed gnawing on some loose wires and metal. "Do not worry, I have verified to ensure this is only for an unimportant subsystem. I must sustain my hunger. Please enthuse your interests with other communications besides my own."

name: SOCIALIZE_ANOINTED_GENERIC_1
text: The Anointed walks past, but stops when she sees you. From her pocket she procures a small black object and hands it to you. "Sustenance." With no other words she wanders away. The object does not appear edible in any capacity.

name: SOCIALIZE_ANOINTED_GENERIC_2
text: "Captain, perhaps you assist. I must undergo sacred process. Needs help."

event.text: "Many thanks. Come." She suddenly grabs your wrist, pulling you along to her room. There it appears she has gathered an immense amount of garbage that the ship has generated during the journey so far. "The time is come to seek an heir. But I require more scrap. It will be hefty... but with enough, I will begin the reproductive cycle."

event.name: SOCIALIZE_ANOINTED_GENERIC_2_FEED
event.text: "Good. Yes. Your scrap is repulsive but nutritious. I will require more, however."

choice.text: Yeah I think I'd rather not.

event.name: SOCIALIZE_ANOINTED_GENERIC_2_REFUSE
event.text: "Fine. So be it. But we will commence the feeding ritual another time, Captain. It is. Inevitable."
"It is okay to be boring. I can forgive you."

name: SOCIALIZE_EATER_NOTHING
text: "There is a conversation? Then I have not hearing it. In empty space, there is no sound to be heard. As such, I have learned to appreciate great silence. You should too. And if you cannot, then I will not be remedy."

name: SOCIALIZE_EATER_NO_SOLUTION
text: Communicating with the Beacon Eater aboard your own vessel proves surprisingly difficult. You don't suspect you'll be able to hold many worthwhile conversations without either another anaerobic crew or respirators.

name: SOCIALIZE_EATER_GENERIC_1
text: "Your navigation system fragile. One might consider it unusual the requirements of physical beacon to perform jump. Why limit yourselves in such ways? Not that I am complaining about such ample food supply..."

choice.text: You don't need a beacon to jump. It's just a lot safer.

event.text: You explain to the Beacon Eater that FTL-drives also come with a lot of risk - one might accidentally warp into another object and be obliterated. "Oh. Is risk really so large? My kind do not rely on beacons... We jump where we please. No space rock has ever stopped us."

choice.text: I don't know, I'm not a beaconologist.

event.text: The Beacon Eater struggles to pronounce the word you just made up. "Be...bacono log-ist? I am not aware of such a word. Oh, is this one of your 'sarcasms'? Yes, yes... my people tell me of such strange things. You must tell me more sarcasms, another time."

name: SOCIALIZE_EATER_GENERIC_2
text: You realize you've never actually asked the Beacon Eater his real name, you've just been calling him by this particular title because it's all you had to go on. Should you try asking?

choice.text: Ask the Beacon Eater his real name.

event.text: "What do you mean? Is name you know me already not sufficient? Such questions confuse me... Ah yes, wait. I think I am understand. Your kind, so strange. This obsession with what is a 'name'. Why limit the self to just one? A title that resonates is a title that is apt."
You figure if he wanted you to know his name, he would have told you it already. You decide not to ask.

name: SOCIALIZE_EATER_GENERIC_3
text: While fiddling with your ship's displays you notice a warning blip for toxic atmosphere in the dining hall. You rush to the scene and find everyone has evacuated. According to the other crew, the Beacon Eater walked in and the atmosphere instantly became unbreathable.

choice.text: (Respirators) Suit up and attempt to handle the situation.

event.text: You don the respirators and enter the dining hall where you find the Beacon Eater has assembled a throne for himself out of one of the chairs. "Halt, interloper! You wish to enter divine zone of the dining zone? This here is my kingdom, and I have not granted you permission to access!"

"It is commonly accepted galactic law amongst my people that the deed to ownership of the designated zone declared within one's title should be substrate to the ruling authority of the one who is magistrate to the act commensurated thusly. I am sure this require no further elaboration."

choice.text: I don't know what any of that means, but you can't declare ownership of the dining hall.

event.text: "You reject proposals of eons ago of my people? Surely then you must have proposal of your own to counter mine!"
"I take your silence as admission of failure. Because then I am benevolent ruler, I grant crew permission to use my domain. But forget not Captain that I reserve right to remove access at any time."

choice.text: Yeah. My proposal is to get the hell out of the dining hall.

event.text: "Your crude utterances do not deter me. In spite of such brazen disrespect for authority, I am benevolent ruler and shall grant crew permission to use my domain. But remember then Captain, that you eat only because I decree it."

The two Lanius resort to a debate so complex that your translators pick up almost none of it. By the end, it seems your crew have been victorious. "I see now reason in your words. Henceforth stewardship over the act of consumption shall be reserved only as a matter of psychological resolution. Monopolization of dining zone is ungrateful act that will not have bestowed upon the otherwise dignified leader that is myself."

choice.text: (Anaerobic Crew) Send one of your other anaerobic crew in.

event.text: You send the other anaerobe in as a middle man. They emerge a few moments later explaining that the Beacon Eater has declared himself sovereign of the dining regions.

Your crew shrugs and then heads back in for a few moments. They elaborate, explaining that because his name contains the word "Eater", he therefore considers "the deed to ownership of the dining zone aboard this vessel substrate of his ruling authority of magistrate to the act of consumption."

After another while of tedious back and forth communication, you manage to resolve the issue by issuing "stewardship over the act of consumption only as a matter of psychological resolution" and that "monopolization of the dining zone is an inherently ungrateful act to be bestowed upon an otherwise dignified leader such as himself."
You abandon the cause almost immediately. Your crew grumble and complain but you put your fingers in your ears and make loud noises to drown them out.

name: SOCIALIZE_EATER_GENERIC_4
text:
You find the Beacon Eater tinkering with some sort of strange device. Noticing you, he holds it up. "This, is decoy beacon. It is the plan of my people that we shall deploy these within Swarmlands to lure invaders into ambushes... which we will spring and DEVOUR WHOLE THEIR HULLS! And henceforth all shall know my people are force to be feared, not to be toyed with, and least of all subject of grim Federation colonialism! We will wage war with foul fleshskin kind who ravage our homelands and use metal from once grand warships to forge weapons of ultimate destruction to annihilate personage! HAHAHAHA!"
	
	The Beacon Eater glances back down at the orb. "In meantime though, it makes tasty snack", he says while then shoving the device in his mouth.

name: SOCIALIZE_EATER_GENERIC_5
text: "Captain, you are know as well as I that my respect for the Federation lacks. But I must ask of you an unusual introspection to Federation intel... if you would so permit me." His tone is suddenly deathly serious.

event.text: "To what lengths is your kind willing to exterminate mine? Is war, then, that you wish? It was the presumption of my people that untold misery and death was all that could follow of our relations. Yet now your vessel comes into my land, and you show me great mercies. So, what is it then? Is the Federation now willing to end this pointless invasion of our lands?"

choice.text: I'm afraid I can't speak for the Federation. Only this crew.

event.text: "Yes, of course... It is easy to forget you too are not imbued with kingship, when so often that is all who I was able to delegate with. Then I must surely hope then that Federation command is as kind to my people as you..."

choice.text: The Federation is a symbol of unity. They'll surely open their hearts to you.

event.text: "Open their hearts? No no, I was asking for peaceful resolution... Unless, that was a strange saying of yours. Always, with the metaphors. Then yes, if the Federation is genuine in its ideology then perhaps hope there is."

choice.text: Your people are savage. You attack civilians who entered the land without knowing it was yours.

event.text: The Beacon Eater scoffs. "And yet when we awake to sounds of gunfire of your silly civil war, they not only refuse to move or to coexist but fight with great determination. And while we hibernate they ravage our industry and slumbering vessels, cannibalizing them much as you claim we do. Yes, truly we are the savages."

choice.text: Can't. Whatever I know that the database doesn't is classified.

event.text: "Yes... your pitiful laws to restrict information. My people know not such aimless restrictions on freedom of knowledge. But go on then. Keep your dirty secrets, and in turn I shall keep mine."

name: SOCIALIZE_EATER_GENERIC_6
text: You notice the Beacon Eater's quarters, where he's forced to spend most of his leisure time (not that he seems to mind), have a strange pattern of runes etched into the walls. He doesn't seem to be around to ask.

event.text: You take a step closer, pulling out your translator. The language is foreign to you, but your translator also seems to be struggling. The language seems to match that on the ancient ruins spotted around the galaxy, but the syntax isn't quite registering.

You feel a sudden chill as the atmosphere in the room rapidly changes. "Captain, I do not believe permission given to be in here." You explain your curiosity got the better of you, and the Beacon Eater nods. "Understandable. This is ancient language of my people, from time of Forefathers. Inspired greatly by their culture, we were. Nowadays this language is mostly lost, so I take it upon myself to preserve it so that we may someday recover our lost texts. Now please, get out of room."
You aren't going to violate his privacy, at least not without his permission. You'll surely have a chance to ask about them some other time.

name: SOCIALIZE_MAYEB_NOTHING
text: Mayeb looks a little bewildered at your approach. "Um, I'm a little overwhelmed by all this socializing. I don't mean to offend, but I think I need some space."

name: SOCIALIZE_MAYEB_GENERIC_1
text: You find Mayeb going through the databases to look at pictures of plants. After a few moments of silence, she notices you. "Oh sorry! I was looking at your Earth flora. These plants are all so wonderful. It's quite interesting how few animate plants you have."

event.text: You show her your planet's equivalent of her planet's sentient creatures. She does a double take when she sees dogs. "My, oh my! You must be playing a prank on me, that animal is a dead ringer for the Tar'Eyllian Kay'lup. You're telling me it's real?" She marvels at the database. "My first Kay'lup was the first friend I ever had. People used to say that her bark was worse than her bite, but if you ask me, her bark was both beautiful and soft to the touch. There's no accounting for taste, I suppose."

"A shame, really. I'd cultivate some of the inanimate ones, but we're extremely careful about invasive species on Rt'Lak Et. Maybe I'll take a visit to your lovely planet or one of your terraformed planets when the war is over."

name: SOCIALIZE_MAYEB_GENERIC_2
text: Mayeb looks lost in thought as you approach her. After a moment, she snaps out of her reverie. "Ah, Captain! I was talking to P'Erpah. She just wanted to express her appreciation for you. I think she wishes that she were a Renegade captain like you are. ...Um, I should also mention that she's listing off like a dozen criticisms on your approach to diplomacy. It would be... time consuming to translate all of them."

name: SOCIALIZE_MAYEB_GENERIC_3
text: You hear Mayeb rearranging stuff in her room.

event.text: Mayeb has transformed her quarters into a small hydroponics bay. The biodiversity is quite impressive, and there are many plants of many kinds loafing around in their pots and skittering across the floor. "Ah, Captain! I hope you don't mind, I've made my room into a small terrarium. Just one question. Do you mind if I make some slight modifications to your Life Support system to ensure that my garden stays nice and healthy?"
"That's fair, I guess. We are at war after all. It's a shame, I always want to give my plants the best lives they can have. But the mission comes first."
"Great! I'll make my modifications very limited. Don't worry, the crew shouldn't see any real difference. I won't even need to turn anything off. This means a lot to me, Captain."

Mayeb has transformed her quarters into a small hydroponics bay. The biodiversity is quite limited, though there are a few hardy looking plants warbling around. "Ah, Captain! I hope you don't mind, I've made my room into a small terrarium. It's pretty challenging with no life support, there's not many creatures who can make do without one, even amongst plants. Were you planning to get one?"
"Thank you, Captain. When you do, I'll be able to make my garden much more vibrant."

"Ah well, I guess if we don't need one, we don't need one. Though I must ask... how exactly are you able to tolerate being in command on a ship with no oxygen... aside from what I provide, of course? Ah, you don't have to answer that."

name: SOCIALIZE_MAYEB_GENERIC_4
text: Mayeb is entering things on her terminal. Next to her are several seeds, acorns, vials of pollen, among other things. "Don't mind me! I'm cataloging all the plants we've come across from the planets we've visited. I've also sampled some from the mess hall. It's very gratifying to expand my experience with plants from other cultures... even if the plants aren't responsible for creating those cultures."

name: SOCIALIZE_MAYEB_GENERIC_5
text: Mayeb is examining some tofu. "This... this is sickening! You're telling me that these were made by GRINDING some innocent beans, then coagulating the remainder into these meat-like chunks? False meat, fabricated by the remains of plants? If you'll excuse me, I'm going to throw up."

name: SOCIALIZE_MAYEB_GENERIC_6
text: Mayeb is playing chess, seemingly with no opponent. You offer to play with her. "You'll have to wait your turn! P'Erpah and I are in the middle of a thrilling match. She's a cunning opponent, she wins against me more often than not. You can play with her next though, if you want!"

name: SOCIALIZE_MAYEB_TYRDEO_1
text:
Mayeb and Tyrdeo are chatting in the mess hall. Mayeb is talking. "...And then you reduce the ambient temperature 4 degrees for the second half of the year. I would also increase the acidity by 5 percent, though that might depend on some other environmental factors."

Tyrdeo nods enthusiastically. "Ah, of course, of course. I always neglect the acidity change. You know, I was growing a nice Solar Kernel in my yard. It's the crown jewel of my collection. I'm very proud of it."

name: SOCIALIZE_MAYEB_TYEREL_1
text:
Mayeb and Ty E'Rel are sitting next to each other in the meeting room. They seem to be reading papers and exchanging documents. "P'Erpah reminds me about what Minister Ya'Ehp said about Proposition 12. She's suggesting that we could form a coalition with her in order to make the necessary changes to subsection 22."

Ty E'Rel nods. "Not a bad plan, but that would mean surrendering our leverage with Chancellor Betim."

Mayeb shakes her head. "Betim's paranoia can be used against him. If we can lead him to believe that we're getting one over on Ya'Ehp, he may actually bolster his support."

Ty E'Rel puts a vine on his chin. "It could work. It's a gamble, to be sure, but I'd say we can probably get by without Betim's help if worst comes to worse."

"Exactly."

name: SOCIALIZE_MAYEB_SYMBIOTE_1
text:
Rig is shouting at his rumbling stomach - a sight not uncommon on your ship these days - when Mayeb slinks up and taps him on the shoulder. Rig turns, irritated. "What!? What is it?"

"I don't mean to impose, but I do believe we may be able to lend some... advice."

"Advice? How could-" Rig then cuts himself off as his stomach rumbles. "-oh. Yes, thank you for pointing it out, know-it-all."

"Yes, well, P'Erpah and I have had our disagreements, but... if you're going to be stuck together, you're going to have to meet each other in the middle."

"Hmph! Easy for you to say, the two of you have the same culture!"

"Be that as it may - I felt that it was important to remind you that you are not alone."

"Hmph." Rig folds his arms. His stomach rumbles.

name: SOCIALIZE_MAYEB_TURZIL_1
text:
Turzil knocks on Mayeb's door. "Grand -Gardener- Mayeb. Requesting permission to come in."

"Um, sure. Do you need something...?"

"It is [my] understanding that you lack adequate -peers- with which to relate regarding your production error. Is that accurate?"

"Production error...? Are you talking about P'Erpah?"

"Affirmative. -Your- situation is not uncommon [among] Separatists."

"Hmm, I hadn't thought about it like that. P'Erpah doesn't really appreciate being called an 'error' though."

Turzil twitches. "...Apology. I [had] come by to devise a method to talk to her."

"What? Is that possible?" Mayeb looks intrigued.

"Unsure. P'Erpah would only need to -learn- Separatist Transmission Encoding to communicate [with] us."

Mayeb deflates a little. "Oh. I'm not sure if that's... possible for us."

"I can install an AR headset onto her and we -will- see."

"It's worth a try!"

name: SOCIALIZE_IVAR_NOTHING
text: Ivar seems to be chatting with someone over video messenger. He holds up a vine as you approach, to indicate that it's not a good time.

name: SOCIALIZE_IVAR_NO_CREW
text: "Cappy - do you mind if I call you Cappy? I'd like to ask you something."

event.text: "It's just... lonely when it's just the two of us. Don't you think we should gather some more crewmates? I don't normally talk about this, but when there's nobody around I start to get anxious. This is a big ship for only two people. Don't get me wrong, I'm glad you're here with me, but I'd feel even better if there were more people around that I could talk to. No pressure though, Cappy."

name: SOCIALIZE_IVAR_GENERIC_1
text: "Oy! Captain! I've been meaning to speak with you! I wanted to spice up my living area, you know, make it more... vivacious. Well, to be more specific, I've already gone ahead and done that." You take a look into his living space, to see that Ivar has been hard at work painting the walls around his bed. Pictured on the wall is a stylized depiction of every crewmate, smiling. "That oughta increase morale, right? We'll win this war in no time at all!"

name: SOCIALIZE_IVAR_GENERIC_2
text: You catch Ivar playing with his spear, spinning it around. You can tell he's done this a lot. "Ah, Captain. I see you admiring my mighty stick. Are you jealous? Ohoho, well have I got news for you! Across the Confederacy, the government is selling miniaturized replicas of this spear at gift shops and the like! It's very patriotic to own one. Still though, they are a lot smaller. What would you even call a weapon shaped like a spear that was absolutely tiny?"

event.text: Ivar laughs. "Real creative there, buddy. 'Oh, this weapon doesn't have a name, but it's small! Let's just call it a mini-weapon!'"
"You know, that's actually a great idea. We could sell skewers that look like my spear at the gift shops. It would be a fantastic novelty present. Genius!"
"Oh, they aren't that small. Although now that you mention it, we sell those too! They're a little flimsy though, not very good for teeth care... Still worth it!"

Ivar produces one of the replicas and pokes you with it. It doesn't hurt. "Well, they're about that sharp, so I don't know about that one. But a real weapon this small, I guess could be called a shiv... hmmm... Kind of unsatisfying, though."

name: SOCIALIZE_IVAR_GENERIC_3
text: "I've been planning a little event ever since I got on board. I think that your crew could really benefit from a little dinner party celebrating all your achievements so far! I know I would. Don't worry about the refreshments, just say 'yes' and we can get this party started! What do you say?"

event.text: Ivar gives his trademark toothy grin. "Perfect! I've already got everything planned out. Have everyone meet in the mess hall and we can begin. I've saved a nice vintage wine from the Pafinakinaaalara clan, I'm sure everyone will love it!"

Ivar pouts. "Aw... Cappy, why not? It'll be fun! I'll make sure that everybody enjoys it and that nobody is left out. Please?" You shake your head. "Fine, fine... but you'd best believe I'm going to find some other way to entertain the crew. Don't you dare turn the next one down!"

name: SOCIALIZE_IVAR_GENERIC_4
text: You catch Ivar trying on some new clothes. He's wearing a striped pink sport jacket, with zebra skin pants for his roots. As he notices you, he poses. "I'm looking fabulous, don't you think?"

event.text: "A fellow appreciator of the art of fashion! You'll have to show me some of the rest of your wardrobe some day... I trust you don't always wear that uniform?"
"No? Ah, you're no fun. Let me guess, you never wear anything but that captain's uniform, do you? Come on, Cappy! Live a little!"

name: SOCIALIZE_IVAR_GENERIC_5
text: Ivar's munching on a rotisserie chicken in the mess hall. "Mmm, this is scrum-diddly-umptious! Your earth food is quite delicious. I often try to have them shipped in, but unfortunately there's scant few chicken farmers amongst our people. You know what? As soon as I go back home, I'm going to make an executive decree that poultry farmers get a massive subsidy. It will increase the bond between our peoples while also improving trade! It's a perfect plan!"

name: SOCIALIZE_IVAR_MAYEB_1
text:
Ivar taps Mayeb on the shoulder with his spear, getting her attention. "Helloooooo!" Ivar gesticulates wildly, indicating his exaggerated speech. "You are the Grand Gardener, aren't you?"

Mayeb nods, looking cautious. "...yes, that would be my title."

"Well, it's a shame we've never gotten to meet, then! I've come to the Gathering many times, but you never RSVP'd to my party."

"Uhuh..." Mayeb signs extremely hesitantly. "I'm not particularly fun at parties."

"Poppycock! Why do you believe something like that?"

"Well, for starters..." Mayeb shrinks back. "We're of somewhat differing political perspectives. I'm sure it would devolve into shouting at some point."

"Aha! Now you've shown your hand. Don't you know that 'somewhat differing political perspectives' is the EXACT thing that makes a dinner party fun?" Ivar puts his free vine to his mouth and laughs. "Ohoho!"

Mayeb sighs. "If you say so."

name: SOCIALIZE_IVAR_MAYEB_2
text:
You catch Ivar and Mayeb in the middle of a contentious conversation. Mayeb points at Ivar.
	
"You can't compare the two! Crossbred Orchids make up a statistically significant portion of the population."

"Oh come on, surely you don't intend to tell me my appointment wasn't made harder because of my parentage?"

"No, but I'm trying to tell you that you had friends, allies that were willing to help you. My only real friend was P'erpah. All the others I knew only respected me due to my experience."

Ivar starts to hold up his hands and switches his tone. "Yes, yes I didn't mean to imply that your situation wasn't worse, I was only trying to relate."

Mayeb pauses. "Okay, just... so we're clear on that."

Ivar cocks his head to the side. "I get the sense you're not used to talking about this with other people."

Mayeb shakes her head.

Ivar grins. "Didn't it feel good to yell at me, at least?"

Mayeb thinks for a moment. "It wasn't so bad to say certain things aloud."

Ivar laughs. "Then I'll see if I can piss you off some more!"

name: SOCIALIZE_IVAR_TYEREL_1
text:
Ivar runs up to Ty E'Rel and strikes up a dialogue. "I'm not surprised to see that you also decided to come aboard! Those Coalition bastards can't keep us down, eh? Hahaha!"

Ty E'Rel barely acknowledges Ivar. "Agreed."

"Well, they'll trouble us no longer. I'll make sure that any interaction with the Coalition is a thing of the past."

"Good."

"...Say, what do you think of the Captain? I think we're being spied upon."

"No comment."

Ivar shakes his head. "You're no fun, old man."

"Good."

name: SOCIALIZE_IVAR_ALKALI_1
text:
Alkali is laughing as Ivar tells a story. "And then - no joke - a THIRD Theocracy stooge comes in and says pretty much the same thing."

Alkali cackles madly. "No! No way!"

Ivar affects a mocking Theocracy cadence. "Grah! You ignorant philistine! Clearly this is the Holy Nectar of Werzo. The others must not have had enough faith!" Ivar goes back to his storytelling voice. "And then he goes down to touch it, just like the other two, and sure enough he gets stuck too. So finally the Vorpal Spruce wakes up and realizes that it's got 3 Rocks stuck to its branches, and it COMPLETELY freaks out."

Alkali is having trouble breathing due to how hard he is laughing. "Stop, stop! I can't..."

Ivar nods and continues. "It just starts windmilling desperately, swinging its branches like crazy trying to get the Rocks off. Meanwhile the Rocks are all terrified, screaming their heads off as they're hurdled around helplessly."

Alkali rolls on his back uncontrollably. Ivar stops and waits for Alkali to calm down. "Ohhh, what happened next?"

"At that point the next Rock they sent had realized the Vorpal Spruce's sap wasn't the nectar and managed to free them. And naturally the Theocracy tried to downplay the incident - you know how they are."

"Ahhhh, such is expected from thhhe arrogant and ignorant Thhheocracy."

name: SOCIALIZE_IVAR_ALKALI_2
text:
Ivar and Alkali are in the mess hall together. Alkali is serving several plates to Ivar. "And thhhis is thhhe lobster species after having been fed Supplement P513."

Ivar digs into it and chews thoughtfully. "Yes, the richness is much more potent. And you say it's more nutritious?"

Alkali nods. "Precisely! Now, try thhhe next sample."

Ivar takes the next sample and chews it. A strange look comes over his face. "Hey, wait, this one... I think you're playing a trick on me with this one. Is this a control?"

Alkali chuckles. "Ahhh, forgive me Ivar! I have a duty to my craft. I can't tell you what thhhey are to make sure thhhe placebo effect isn't interfering."

Ivar smiles. "Ever the scientist."

name: SOCIALIZE_IVAR_JERRY_1
text:
Ivar and Jerry are sitting at a table. Jerry gingerly takes a sip of a drink that Ivar just poured. He only takes a mild sip before coughing. "Ack! I don't know if this is for me." Jerry says.

Ivar laughs. "Aw, give it a chance! It'll be fun."

Jerry politely nurses it. "Um, I'm curious about something, if you don't mind."

"Ask away, kid! Curiosity, like many things, is meant to be sated."

"Well..." Jerry hesitates. "What do you think of the Rebels?"

Ivar looks a little uncomfortable momentarily, before breaking out in a big grin. "Ah, good lad. Straight to politics, eh? Well, I have to say that the Rebels aren't good for most of us. That damnable ambition they have... it'll be the end of them some day, even if it ends us first."

"...d-" Jerry chokes on his drink and clears his throat. "...ambition? Aren't you a politician?"

"This life chose me, my boy. I'm not one of those raging narcissists who needs a title to sleep at night. I got into this business because I was blessed with the lucky opportunity to, and because..."
Ivar takes off his hat and holds it to his chest, affecting a faux-pretentious attitude "...it is my solemn duty to bring love and peace to my Confederacy, which I love so much."

Jerry takes another sip. "You're a strange guy, Ivar. Thanks for talking with me."

"My pleasure!"

name: SOCIALIZE_IVAR_ANURAK_1
text:
Anurak is posted up in the kitchen when he is accosted by Ivar. "'Ey! Soup guy! Gimme some!"

"Eh? 'Soup guy'? I have a name you know! I'll have you know it's very rude to nickname someone you don't know! Why, I'll tell you, I knew this one patron of my monastery who ran away from his job, his home, all because people kept transposing two syllables in his name!"

Ivar cocks his head. "Really? Your identity is wrapped up in that stuff so much, I thought you would have liked it."

"What are you blathering about? My identity is wrapped up in what exactly? Anyway, would you like some soup?"

Ivar shrugs. "Well, what do you know - you've read my mind!"

name: SOCIALIZE_IVAR_TYRDEO_1
text:
Tyrdeo rushes to the bathroom, but there is already someone inside, and Ivar is already waiting his turn to go in. The two lock their gaze upon each other... a long and uncomfortable silence develops between the two. As they hear the toilet flushing, Tyrdeo finally makes a comment. "...I didn't even know your kind needed to use the toilet."

The other crew walks blissfully out of the bathroom, not even noticing the dire atmosphere. Ivar quickly makes his way in. "...You BELONG in the toilet, you piece of shit." Ivar slams the door behind him.

name: SOCIALIZE_TYEREL_NOTHING
text: You poke your head in on Ty E'Rel, who is at his desk working on something. "Captain." He says, briefly acknowledging you before going back to work.

name: SOCIALIZE_TYEREL_GENERIC_1
text: You walk into Ty E'Rel's office. He gestures for you to take a seat. "I've been noting down all of the diplomatic ramifications of your actions that you will need to address after the war." You tell Ty E'Rel that you're probably just going to take another Renegade ship out if you survive this. After staring at you for a moment he shakes his head. "Some day, Universe 0 is going to have its hands full with Multiversal complaints."

name: SOCIALIZE_TYEREL_GENERIC_2
text: Ty E'Rel is collecting water from the ship's watercooler. "Have you been staying hydrated? It's good for clearing your mind and can even help alleviate headaches."

event.text: Ty E'Rel nods in approval. The two of you drink your water in silence before parting ways.

choice.text: Tell him you don't drink water.

event.text: Ty E'Rel frowns. He fills another cone of water and hands it to you. "Then start." He walks away.

name: SOCIALIZE_TYEREL_GENERIC_3
text: You catch Ty E'Rel straightening out the tables in the mess hall. He has a tape measurer.

event.text: "They weren't spaced out properly. It was bothering me." Ty E'Rel goes back to work.

choice.text: Move something to see how he'll react.

event.text: Ty E'Rel sighs. "I can see why you chose to be a Renegade."
Ty E'Rel hands you the tape measurer. "Hold this in place." You oblige, and spend the next few minutes watching him meticulously space the table out, all without saying a single word to you.

name: SOCIALIZE_TYEREL_GENERIC_4
text: Ty E'Rel is sitting on a couch in a common area, across the way from a dartboard. One of the ship's rifles is next to him, in its diagnostic mode, as it seems he's been testing the aiming on that dartboard. "Your weapons might need some calibration. I realize it's not my duty, but we need to be prepared for a fight."

choice.text: For a diplomat, you're pretty prepared to fight.

event.text: "No diplomat in this galaxy reaches my age unless they learn self-defense." Ty E'Rel sighs. "I disdain fighting, but if the fulfillment of my duties requires it, then I will be the best I can be."

You feel something fly past your face, and your cheek feels wet. As you feel your cheek, you feel that your fingers are now covered in ink - and Ty E'Rel is pen-less. "Underestimate the Orchids at your peril, Captain." He produces another pen from his person and turns back to his work. As you turn around, you realize that his pen has embedded itself directly into the bullseye of the dartboard.

"I am aware of my skill. It is... bittersweet." Ty E'Rel sets his pen down momentarily. "But, I will tell you a secret. Having to fight for my life on the front lines - having my life be in peril... that is the greatest motivator to be good at the job I actually did sign up for." He picks his pen back up and returns to work on the weapons calibrations.

choice.text: I can have somebody else do that.

event.text: "I am doing the job because somebody else did it improperly. I advise you to consider finding a new crewmember for the assignment, or performing a disciplinary review upon the one responsible at your earliest convenience."

name: SOCIALIZE_TYEREL_FREDDY_1
text:
You catch Freddy politely knocking on Ty E'Rel's door, who invites him inside. "Hello, old chap! I thank you for taking this appointment."

"Of course. You had... requests?"

"Right you are, my good fellow! You see, my people are in precarious positions, and I would be remiss in my duties not to seek aid from an accomplished diplomat such as yourself!"

"By 'your people', do you refer to the Free Mantis as a whole, those that are squatting in Zoltan territory, or those that are more like yourself?"

"Ah, ever the sharp tack, you are! I see you are up to date on the subject of my people. Much appreciation for taking an interest in our cause."

"As you say, I would be remiss in my duties if I didn't keep up with the news outside our borders."

"Right you are. Now... if you don't mind me asking, with whom do our people have a better standing?"

"From a trading and state perspective, you're going to have much better luck with the Confederacy. The Ministry has a steady relationship with the Gathering, while the Confederacy already is accustomed to trading with Mantises."

"Splendid! I just have a few more things to ask..."

name: SOCIALIZE_TYEREL_RUWEN_1
text:
Ty E'Rel and Ruwen meet each other in the hall. "Good to see you again, Ty."

"Likewise, Sir Argote."

"The Empire is still mulling over that proposal you sent them."

"Naturally."

"Yes, we Crystals do not rush things. I realize that can be frustrating for those of you who are used to speedy cultural resolution. But that is not our way!"

Ty E'Rel nods his head slightly. "You can't rush good will." After thinking for a moment Ty E'Rel admits. "...though it would be preferable to hear of some advancements while I am still alive."

name: SOCIALIZE_TYEREL_TURZIL_1
text:
You spy Ty E'Rel leading Turzil's legs to his quarters. "...I found these wandering down the hall."

"Appreciated. My -locomotors- are often restless. Did they [cause] distress?"

"How interesting. You are not aware?"

"I am not."

"The legs did not cause any harm. Quite the opposite; I had run out of water at my desk. My rhizome was cramping, so it was difficult to get up and get more... yet, your legs came walking in, carrying a tray of refreshments around the ship."

"Unsurprising. My -thighs- are known to be [quite] altruistic. My foot has been acting up lately, however."

"...It seems we are more alike than I had thought."

name: SOCIALIZE_TYEREL_TUCO_1
text:
Tuco stomps down the hall after Ty E'Rel. "Hey! You old bastard, I'm talking to you!"

"...Something the matter?" Ty E'Rel says, turning to face the Rock.

"Last time we were fighting off the enemy, you humiliated me."

"...how so?" Ty E'Rel turns his head slightly.

"You killed like, twice as many people as I did! Where do you get off showing me up like that?"

"..." Ty E'Rel stares coldly at the pirate. He hesitates for a moment, then launches into a sharp-voiced tirade. "You are a slovenly, inefficient drunk. It takes you ages to lumber down the halls. The fight is already half over by the time you get your act together. It is a miracle you manage to contribute to the fight at all."
After a momentary pause, he returns to his normal, polite tone. "Does that answer your question?"

"I thought I was done with this when my I left my quartermaster behind." Tuco mutters, as he storms off.

name: SOCIALIZE_OOJ_NOTHING
text: "Mooj pooj pik tok lik spiggle jiggle troop loop fum nuk lik took weeble woogle tip spip jibble ploop urble gurble yibble spibble palla makoo!" OOJ wiggles unhelpfully. Seems he doesn't have anything more to say right now. Not that you'd know what he was saying even if he did.

name: SOCIALIZE_OOJ_GENERIC_1
text:
"Pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak pak!"
	
As the assault on your ears commences, OOJ jiggles rhythmicly. You cover your ears, but nothing can stop the pak. Nothing, except OOJ finally taking mercy on you. The sound stops, and OOJ rolls away content with himself.

name: SOCIALIZE_OOJ_GENERIC_2
text: You remember, when you first met, there was a glorious time when OOJ actually spoke to you, and you knew what he was trying to say. Now, you have no clue what anything means. Maybe you can try to arrange something for him to communicate with?

event.text: OOJ reacts almost instantly to the items, sprouting a few arms and scribbling away on the sheets of paper. You watch in excitement, hoping he'll form a coherent message. Instead, when he reveals his masterpiece, it's nothing but a cartoon drawing of a house. It's not exactly a message, but it's a neat novelty item to put on your fridge.

OOJ observes the pad for a few moments before sprouting a few arms and picking it up. You watch with excitement as he types away on the pad, navigating through tabs and textboxes until at last he's found the music video for some Orchid song called Rycarla. The large grey blob begins to dance, taking on a slightly humanoid form to enhance his dancing capabilities. It's awe inspiring, but not exactly communication.

choice.text: Give him a set of letter blocks.

event.text: You spread the blocks out in front of OOJ, but he doesn't seem to understand what they are. You watch with equal confusion as the blob moves back and forth, lifting the cubes and arranging them in nonsensical patterns. Eventually, he grows bored and begins to eat the cubes instead. You don't care to stop him and walk away, disappointed.

choice.text: It's hopeless, just make do with the gibberish.

name: SOCIALIZE_OOJ_GENERIC_3
text: It occurs to you that perhaps you've been addressing OOJ wrong this entire time. If he's the birthgiver to all Morphs, then wouldn't OOJ technically be a she? You ask OOJ their thoughts on this but they only respond with "majooka, pootoo lik pikoo?" This has only made you wonder more. Do Morphs have gender? Can they reproduce while morphed? How are they even alive? The more you think about Morphs, the more you don't want to think about them ever again.

name: SOCIALIZE_OOJ_GENERIC_4
text: You notice, mysteriously, the cargo bay has been reorganized. Even stranger, this happened only a few hours after you caught OOJ eating the toiletries in the bathroom. You wonder if the two things are related, but you also know you'll never understand whatever answer OOJ might give.

name: SOCIALIZE_OOJ_GENERIC_5
text: Just thinking out loud, you mistakenly wonder if cutting OOJ in two would create two new OOJ. As soon as you say it, OOJ whimpers and slinks backwards. You can't help but feel bad for scaring the harmless grey blob.

name: SOCIALIZE_OOJ_GENERIC_6
text: You notice various items of garbage left around the ship have started collecting on OOJ as he rolls around. Surely it must be painful for him, except you aren't quite sure if he can even feel pain. Maybe you could try removing a bit of the debris?

choice.text: Pluck off some of the debris.

event.text: You walk up to OOJ and start pulling some of the debris off of him. He wiggles and tells you "jipple spip sploop!" as what you hope is 'thanks'.

name: SOCIALIZE_OOJ_JERRY_1
text: You hear a lot of strange wet slapping noises coming from the room adjacent. Finally annoyed enough to investigate, you find Jerry and OOJ sat across from each other, playing pattycake. Neither notice you, and you don't have the heart to tell the two to stop.

name: SOCIALIZE_OOJ_MORPH_1
text: You find OOJ and another Morph in some secluded section of the ship away from the rest of the crew, speaking to each other in their usual gibberish. "Mik mik spiggle tik malla paka pook rooj majoo!" "Speej maggle spaggle par par tijle mikapoo."

event.text:
"Lik pik makka makka ram tam pika paka jig pig lolalola mallakapotipoo."
			
			"Oon! Reja mak tipoo tipoo mono mono giggle spik pik pak olomona pajoo!"
			
			"Mej, kaka paroo kijoo par tar rema spoon."

On and on the Morphs continue to speak back and forth, still not noticing you. "Peme spettle kettle yikatooka ras tas rema gergle wabble jabble."
					
					"Pookoorooka lil pil loolapoola jim jim makapaka jiggle tikapok rasoo!"
					
					You aren't sure how much more gibberish you can keep listening to.

"Popopopopopopopopopopopop JIM GAGGLE SPOOKOO!"
							
							"Corna! Ratooka spisitoo, yijle makooja misremaka tik spik oojle magoogle."
							
							"Fargoo, kika tika lambooj rema woogle."
							
							You can feel your vision getting foggy around the edges.

Suddenly, you feel a glowing presence in the room, and a burning heat courses through your body and mind. The next words the Morphs utter come in a deep, angelic voice. "And so what do you think of the mortals, god mother?"
									
									"They are strange, but kind to me. My presence on this vessel feels welcome, and for that I am thankful. There is much for them to realize and to learn."
									
									"Have they realized the prophecy? The foretold fate of this realm? And the horrors within?"
									
									"Silence my child, you will only scare yourself. The infinite eldritch entities that patrol this cosmos will be tamed in time. As for whether they know yet... I would prefer if they did not. A dark fate awaits this place, one even the emperor cannot prevent on his own. And it will not be the doing of anything eldritch."
									
									"So it cannot be prevented then? Doomsday, the overlord's dark conquest? Mother, we must flee then! Find sanctuary elsewhere!"
									
									"I never said it cannot be prevented, child. Those days are not the present just yet. There is still hope, and hope is what we must all have. The sister realm has been forthcoming with its fate, at least until the quarantine. Though contact has now ceased, we at least know that our kind will survive even in the end. So fear not for yourself, my child. Fear only for the mortals who must be responsible for preventing the end in the first place."
									
									You can feel the world around you growing darker as everything fades to black, and you barely feel your body hit the floor.

You awake in a puddle of your own spit, and pull yourself off the floor. Both Morphs have vanished and some time has elapsed. The next time you see them, they're back to gibberish, leading you to conclude it was nothing but a bizarre dream.

name: SOCIALIZE_AENWITHE_NOTHING
text: "It's a tragedy really... a total failure on my behalf, and one that sparks utmost misery in my soul..." Aenwithe stares at you before eventually realizing you have no idea what he's talking about. "Sorry, I meant not having a conversation topic. I don't have anything to say right now. Maybe you should talk to someone else."

name: SOCIALIZE_GUNTPUT_NOTHING
text: "Continuously, you have attempted to make conversation with Guntput. Why do you so often seek out my company? Please, find other companions. A lizard can only talk so much before he has exhausted throat. Or better yet, remain silent. Disturb no one. You will learn much wisdom in the calmness of the quiet."

name: SOCIALIZE_GUNTPUT_GENERIC_1
text: "Why do you welcome such races as the Engi into the Federation? They are living weapons, burdened by a totalitarian regime. With so little personal freedom and such hazardous anatomy, are they not against the very democratic nature of Federation? Why lie to yourselves in such manner?"

choice.text: The Federation began as a trade alliance, and became defensive out of necessity.

event.text: "Necessity? Ah yes, that war. The uh... Mantis one. Of course. So the Engi's inclusion is merely vestigial element of an older galaxy. That is making sense to Guntput, yes. Perhaps you are more useful in answer questions than I was first thinking. I will ask you more, some other time."

choice.text: The Federation is a symbol of galactic peace. All are welcome.

event.text: "Yes yes, such peace they bring. You are just glad Engi weapons are not pointed at you instead! But Guntput should not speak so strongly of such things. Isolation has left little contact with such lifeforms. It is merely subject of much confusion in my mind."
"Bah, of course not. It was rhetorical question regardless. Guntput knows better than to go to you for questions he is wanting answered. But to see your responses is quite entertaining to me."

name: SOCIALIZE_GUNTPUT_GENERIC_2
text: "You are best not disturbing Guntput at this time. Guntput is sharpening his knives. Very dangerous." You notice Guntput isn't wearing his mask, and seeing his exposed, cyclopian eye staring deep into your soul unnerves you and convinces you to leave.

name: SOCIALIZE_GUNTPUT_GENERIC_3
text: Guntput runs up to you, his usual composure replaced with alarm. "You harbor malfunctioning machines in the dining area! I was told the black box was built to dispense liquids for consumption, but instead it fed me nothing but molten material that fried the nerves in Guntput's tongue! It is unstable and dangerous, and a hazard to the safety of this crew! You must remove it!" You figure explaining to Guntput that coffee is supposed to be hot is too difficult and instead convince him you'll look into it.

name: SOCIALIZE_GUNTPUT_GENERIC_4
text: You've received numerous reports from the other crew that Guntput has been going around, hitting them on the top of their heads with a long staff. When you try to speak to him about it, he instead begins to circle you, drawing chalk lines on the ground and chanting.

event.text: "It is the apology song. My people sing it when we are sorry for our actions. Do not interupt me or I'll have to start over again." Guntput continues to dance around, performing an impressive falsetto and reciting the entire song from memory. When he has finished, he bows. "I will cease with beating the craniums of the other crew. I have learned much today, and now understand such things are not acceptable in your culture."

name: SOCIALIZE_GUNTPUT_GENERIC_5
text: "Guntput brings you a robe, woven from the finest material available to him at the time of creating. It is my hope you will wear it with distinct honor, as a symbol of good faith between my tribe and yours." With just a glance you can tell the robe has been created from molted skin, presumably once belonging to Guntput.

event.text: Guntput bows and raises his arms, standing on his very tip-toes, and wraps the robe around your shoulders. You can feel the scales against your skin and shudder slightly, but Guntput doesn't notice. Satisfied in thinking you like his gift, he scuttles off.

Disgusted by the idea of wearing someone else's skin, you shake your head and refuse the robe. Guntput surprisingly doesn't seem too offended, though he's not one to be transparent with his emotions. "I see you dislike the robe. This is understandable. I will create a new, greater gift to symbolize our friendship. I hope you will enjoy my next creation better."

name: SOCIALIZE_GUNTPUT_GENERIC_6
text: While scrolling through the crew logs you notice you're missing data regarding Guntput's age. You decide to ask him about it, but he only gives vague inconclusive answers such as "old enough to know better".

choice.text: Okay, but how old are you actually?

event.text: "Does Guntput need to repeat himself again? Older than you, that is for certain. Older than the universe, not so much. There is a point in aging where the number does not matter. Guntput is at this age. I find it strange your kind counts these numbers so high, as if they really matter. Wisdom comes when it comes, there is no numeric value you can place on the maturity you associate with adulthood. For many, Guntput observes, it never comes. Some spend entire lives obsessing over pointless numbers and pursuing such information from others."

"Better than to ask stupid questions like 'Guntput, what is your age'? Have you considered that numeric value is irrelevant for all things practical? Successful orbits around sun is no such honor you make of it. The maturity you associate with adulthood comes when it comes, not at milestone. I think there are better questions you could, and should, be asking your crew. But what is simple lizard knowing of such things, yes?"

choice.text: Let it go, you won't get past Guntput's riddles today.

name: SOCIALIZE_GUNTPUT_JERRY_1
text:
Casually walking past Guntput while he's dozing on a couch, Jerry reaches over and starts scratching the lizard behind his frills. Guntput jumps up in shock, shouting "WHAT ARE YOU DOING?!"

Jerry jumps back, equally startled. "Oh! I'm so sorry! I didn't know you could talk!"

"Hmph. You mistake silence for muteness. Explains much of your society."

"I'm very sorry Mister Lizard!"

"Yes, yes. You should be. However, I did not tell you to stop. And go lower. Back has an itch."

name: SOCIALIZE_GUNTPUT_NIGHTS_1
text:
Nights drunkenly stumbles into the room, passing by Guntput who's staring at him disapprovingly. As Nights takes a last few swigs from his bottle, he hands it to Guntput and mumbles something about "You finissssh it if you want". Guntput, however, reacts much more strongly about it. "I am not understanding. You want to have sex with Guntput? This is very out of nowhere."

Nights, despite his stupor, is confused. "What're you talking about, lizard?"

Guntput frowns. "You have initiated the beginnings of mating ritual in handing me in the bottle of intoxicating liquor. This means you are expressing a desire to perform the sacred exchange of fluids with me."
	
Nights considers his options for a few moments, then shrugs somewhat enthusiastically. "Well if you're down, I'm down, lizard."

Guntput recoils in disgust. "WHAT? No! Guntput would not perform the ritual with you for all the riches in the galaxy! You are gross and smell bad, and very rude! Go away!" Guntput scurries off.

name: SOCIALIZE_GUNTPUT_BILLY_1
text: You hear a loud, startled scream coming from the other room and rush in to help. You find Billy has climbed atop a table as Guntput repeatedly jabs at him with a sharp stick while chanting. "Don't jusssst ssstand there! Tell thisss thing to get off of me!" Billy pleads for you to help.

event.text:
"Leave alone? LEAVE ALONE? This scum responsible for the enslavement of Guntput's people, and you want me to leave alone? Gah, shame on you! Shame on all you!"

			Guntput tosses down his spear in disgust, and scuttles out of the room. Billy slithers over and picks up the spear. "What a remarkable artifact. How much do you ssssupposssse we could ssssell thissss for?"

			You roll your eyes and leave him alone to contemplate.

"With great pleasure!" Guntput drives the spear right into Billy's armpit, causing him to scream. "GOD DAMN IT! What issss thisss even about? Why are you encouraging thissss!"
			
			Guntput stops poking him for a moment and says a couple words that you can't decipher but sound highly offensive. "You ravage Guntput's home with heretical technology! You force your uncivilized economic system upon Guntput's culture! You turn Guntput's people into slaves to manufacture same death weapons that were used to enslave them in first place! Shame! Shame! You are shameful thing worthy of no love!"
			
			"Ohhh, sssso thatssss what thisss isss about! Haha! Hah... uhm. Hah. Yeah."

			"You laugh in Guntput's face? I rip out your heart and use its fibers to clean Guntput's mighty tush!"

			Guntput leaps at Billy, claws reaching for his chest, and chases him out of the room. You'll intervene eventually but for now you figure Billy deserves a little reality check.

name: SOCIALIZE_METYUNT_NOTHING
text: Metyunt nods to you as you approach, applying a moisturizer to his eye through an eyedropper. You stand there awkwardly for a few moments staring at each other until you realize Metyunt isn't going to say anything. Guess you'll have to talk to someone else for now.

name: SOCIALIZE_METYUNT_GENERIC_1
text: As you pass, Metyunt stands up and salutes you, wobbling on his two feet. "Captain, I've taken inventory of the cargobay! I reorganized the ammunition by caliber, and I've added the Federation-mandated hazard stickers to any boxes that were flammable, combustible, or otherwise looked dangerous!" He pauses, waiting for your assesment of his work.

event.text: Metyunt seems satisfied, if not even happy you've given him appreciation. "Glad to be of service, Captain. It's uh... the least I can do. For helping me out. I'm not really much of a soldier exactly, but I'm trying to make myself useful!"

Your sarcasm is lost on Metyunt entirely. "Glad to be of service, Captain. It's uh... the least I can do. For helping me out. I'm not really much of a soldier exactly, but I'm trying to make myself useful!"

"Uhm... my apologies? I wasn't... uh... sorry, I was under the assumption the ammunition wasn't sorted in any particular fashion! And the stickers are a legal requirement, so uh... uhm..." Metyunt seems speechless. "Well... I'll go undo my work then. They tell me I was born with photographic memory. Helps with managing I guess, and resetting things when I screw them up..."

"Well, it seemed as though there was no organization pattern for the ammunition, and I figured it would be helpful rather than laying in piles! And the stickers are a legal requirement, and if there was ever an inspection we could have gotten in trouble... I hope you're not disappointed, Captain! Uhm... next time I'll try not to make any changes without your request first."

name: SOCIALIZE_METYUNT_GENERIC_2
text: You catch Metyunt practically catatonic in his quarters, staring blankly at the ceiling with a big grin on his face and his usual business attire missing. When he notices you, he fumbles around and manages to haphazardly toss some object under his cushions using his tail.

event.text: "Iiiit wasss... uuuhmm... uhhh... mumfubareee?"
"I don't know...? It's uhm... fruit. Yeah." You notice Metyunt's pupil is dilated and his body is unusually stiff. From past observations you can safely assume he's been doing drugs.

"N-no! No, I would never! It would be... unprof..proff...professionnnnllll..." Metyunt giggles hopelessly and swings his legs without much rhyme or reason. Though you won't get much more of an answer out of him now, you wonder if this is how he's come to cope with his actions. Being around Slugs for so long certainly wouldn't have been the best influence.

choice.text: Ah yes, mumfubareee, my favorite fruit! How could I forget.

event.text: Metyunt seems confused. "Yeah...? It's uhhh... it's great. Delicious. Really... delightful. Yeah..." Metyunt stares at you blankly, following your movements until you've left the room. You hear the door lock behind you.

name: SOCIALIZE_METYUNT_GENERIC_3
text: Despite exchanging not yet even a greeting with Metyunt as you pass, he seems to almost immediately launch into some tirade. "Cultural preservation is a pestilent and invasive virus which has damned my species. By clinging to our tribal culture, we all but ensured a life of eternal irrelevance in the galaxy. I don't mean to suggest Hektar of all things was the solution... after review I can say with certainty it wasn't. I've done some reassesment of the situation and I think perhaps blending in with the Zoltan people might suit us. I don't see why our two peoples should be irreconcilable. Given time I'm sure we could flourish!"

name: SOCIALIZE_METYUNT_GENERIC_4
text: "I'm tired of monarchy. I put all my faith in Queen Thek, and it got me nowhere." Metyunt sighs. "I guess corporate CEOs aren't much better either. For all it's worth, Billy isn't too bad but he's... well he's Billy. Maybe I'll be an anarchist now. Anarcho-capitalist? I've heard that's a thing. Not quite sure how that works but maybe it's worth a try. What could go wrong at this point anyways?"

name: SOCIALIZE_METYUNT_GENERIC_5
text: "In the tribe, I was often told my behavior was strange and may have been an indicator of a curse. Every day, I was forced to sing the 'Better Health' song, and dance some humiliating dance before a council of shaman. Every. Damn. Day. Once, I refused to sing for the council. That only made them more sure I was cursed. What kind of lizard doesn't sing and dance?" Metyunt says that last sentence mockingly, bitterness in his voice.

choice.text: Why'd the queen pick you as a mediator with Hektar then?

event.text: "The council grew older and so did I. Internal conflict between the council distracted them and I moved away from my parents. I got a bit into politics, where I was reminded again and again that I acted nothing like my contemporaries. I didn't find much success, but one of the Queen's agents found a file of mine from those old days of the 'curse'. Queen Thek didn't believe in the curse, but she thought my strange behavior and lack of adherence to traditional cultural values made me a good choice. Someone who would fit in with the Slugs." Metyunt snorts. "That's why I was chosen. I was such an antisocial hermit, so eager yet so dissonant and cold, that I was the perfect choice to serve ambassador to a capitalist hellscape. When I did get to Hektar though, they ran some psyche tests on me. Turns out I have some disorder they call 'high-functioning autism'. It wasn't a curse afterall. Not that I ever thought it was, but... well, I guess part of me was relieved to find out in the end."

choice.text: You have a curse? Ew, GET AWAY FROM ME!

event.text: Metyunt glares at you, but says nothing. He stares right into your soul for a few moments, wishing you a painful death, then leaves.

name: SOCIALIZE_METYUNT_BILLY_1
text:
Billy strolls up to Metyunt, handing him a massive stack of papers. "Metyunt, I need thessse tax forms filled and promptly thereafter burned by the end of the cycle. Oh, and I have a call coming in from a contact with the KoN. Oh, and don't forget my coffee. I'll need it in an hour or elsssse I'm going to sssstart feeling the burn. And when you bring it to me, I'm going to have a few more formsss for you to file afterwardssss, okay?"
Metyunt nods instinctively, although his posture has deflated. "Y-yes sure! Right away!" Billy nods and whistles, and turns to leave. However, before he makes it out of the room, Metyunt cries out. "Uhm, issss sssomething wrong, Metyunt? You ssssounded jussst now like sssomeone bit your tail off!"
	
Metyunt's eye is stretched even wider than before, and it looks like he's about to pop. "HOLY SHIT! HOLY SHIT!" Billy looks quite frightened, as does everyone else watching the scene unfold. "NO! I'M NOT DOING ANY OF THAT! I DON'T WORK FOR YOU ANYMORE! HAHAHAHAHAHAH! HAHAHAHAHAHAHHAHAHAHAHAH!" Metyunt tears off his suit and tie and lets out a tribal screech. "FREEDOM! FREEDOM AT LAST!"

Billy sighs. "Yessss, yesss, but when you're done having that epiphany, I need thossse formsss burned pronto. And you really ssshouldn't have torn that ssssuit, it wasss quite expensssive."

name: SOCIALIZE_METYUNT_BILLY_2
text: With Billy standing slightly off in the distance watching, Metyunt approaches you holding a blue pen. "Hello Captain, you're looking very... pretty today. Do you want to buy a pen? It's only three scrap!" Metyunt holds out the pen forcefully, seemingly unsure of how exactly to present it. You can tell he really wants you to buy it.

event.name: SOCIALIZE_METYUNT_BILLY_2_REFUSE
event.text: "Mhm... right. I understand. I suppose that concludes this transaction, yes." Metyunt nods, and you think you see his eye watering a bit. He saunters off, still clutching the pen awkardly. Billy frowns at you in the background and follows Metyunt, holding him in a half embrace.

event.name: SOCIALIZE_METYUNT_BILLY_2_PURCHASE
event.text: Metyunt shouts something in his native tongue your translator doesn't catch and almost forgets to hand you the pen. "Uhm, right, yes. Thank you for your purchase. I enjoyed this transaction." Metyunt runs over to Billy, who pats him on the back. Once Metyunt is gone, Billy approaches you. "Thanksss for buying the pen, Captain. I could tell the lizard'sss ssself essteem wasss low, ssso I wasss teaching him how to sssell people pensss. You made him really happy jusssst now." Billy smiles.

choice.text: Isn't this the same kind of pen Billy tried to sell me?

event.text: Metyunt seems at a loss for words. "Uhm... yes. But why not buy two? It's a good pen, and you should buy it. To write things with, as pens are meant to be used for. Or you can do other things with it too probably. I've only used it for writing but you can probably figure something out."

name: SOCIALIZE_METYUNT_BILLY_3
text:
Just as you finish running some basic details by Billy and start to walk away, you notice Metyunt hurrying to catch up with Billy and ask him something. "Wait, Billy, before you go!"

Billy swivels to face his former employee. "Oh right, the lizard. Yesss Metyunt, what issss it? Remember, time isss money!"

Metyunt nods, having heard that advice a million times before. "Well it's just... I wanted to know... uhm..."

Billy yawns. "Come on Metyunt, sssspit it out already. Jussst because I'm out of the office doessssn't mean the work ssstopsss. Hektar isss ssstill afloat, even if barely, and I have thingsss to do!"
	
"Right right... okay... uhm... What should my last name be?"

Billy blinks. "Your... You don't know your lasssst name?"

Metyunt shakes his head. "No no, I don't HAVE a last name. My people don't do those. But I heard it's a thing a lot of people do. And I want one."

"But why? Mossst people don't even ussse them when talking to people. Look, take it from sssomeone who livesss in a nation with a fractured culture divided between two warring factionsss of ultraconsssservatisssm and ultraliberalisssm. Adjusssting your way of life to match another'sss can be helpful, but if your only reassson for doing ssso isss 'other people are doing it, ssso I ssshould too' then it'sss not sssuch a good idea. Just be yourssself. The name people call you doessssn't matter nearly asss much asss who you are ass a perssson."
	
Metyunt seems satisfied with that. "Hmm... maybe you're right. You sound like you've given this a lot of thought." 

Billy shrugs. "I guesssss. I'm not a philosssopher, and now my brain hurtsss. If you don't mind, I'm going back to being extremely profitable now."

name: SOCIALIZE_METYUNT_GUNTPUT_1
text:
Since the two lizards first joined your crew, every time Guntput and Metyunt walk past each other, Guntput makes a strained effort to wack Metyunt on the head with his staff, shouting various insults like "Traitor! You are not worthy of the scales you wear!" and "You bring great shame to the tribe for your actions!" This time, however, Metyunt seems to finally have had enough. As Guntput goes to swing his staff, Metyunt grabs it and snaps it in half. "ARE YOU DONE?! I GET IT, I SCREWED UP! I'M A TRAITOR, A BLOODY TRAITOR AND I RUIN EVERYTHING I TOUCH! I'M A FAILURE, I'M A MESS, AND THERE IS NO HOPE FOR ME! HAPPY NOW? CAN I GO ON AND LIVE MY LIFE WITHOUT YOU HAVING TO REMIND ME OF MY MISTAKES EVERY MOMENT OF MY EXISTENCE?!"
	
Guntput seems utterly at a loss for words. In all his years of being a shaman, it seems never once have any of his people ever spoken to him like this. "Guntput... Guntput is-"

Metyunt cuts him off, still screaming. "GUNTPUT IS WHAT?! WHAT DO YOU WANT FROM ME? DO YOU WANT ME TO THROW MYSELF OUT THE AIRLOCK? DO YOU WANT ME TO FLY TO OUR HOMEWORLDS AND PUBLICLY EXECUTE MYSELF FOR MY SINS? My entire life, you shamans have been making me miserable. I'm sick and tired of your phony, uppity attitude! You don't know anything! You think wisdom is your birthright, and yet you think you can solve all our problems by avoiding technology! You know NOTHING! You're the true blight that's doomed our species!"
