Metyunt storms off, leaving Guntput behind still trying to find words. Unable to think of anything, Guntput quickly shuffles away in the opposite direction, too ashamed to even look at you or anyone else.

name: SOCIALIZE_OBYN_NOTHING
text: Obyn is busy combing over many elaborate maps and star-charts, drawing lines and placing pins on various locations. He ignores you entirely, focused with absolute attention on the activity. Guess you won't be squeezing any conversation out of him.

name: SOCIALIZE_OBYN_GENERIC_1
text: "There comes a point in your life that you have to wonder, 'For what reason am I still going?' I just... I keep asking myself this. When you're the last of anything, it's hard to justify your own existence. And now the Multiverse just seems to taunt me. Infinite Obyns, technically not really the last... and yet we're all just the same person. Never once have we met a female Obyn, or anything of similar nature. And yet, I go on. I haven't the slightest clue why, except for this feeling that I have to. That going on is what I MUST do."

name: SOCIALIZE_OBYN_GENERIC_2
text: "When I was still with Sylvan, we would often write poetry together. I guess it's just... sort of a thing I liked doing. Did Sylvan like it? No clue, but he's just like that. Rarely actually tells anyone what he does or doesn't like, and you can't always rely on his actions to clue you in either. I do wish I still had some of those poems, but after the breakup I got rid of most of them."

name: SOCIALIZE_OBYN_GENERIC_3
text: "Lovely cycle, Captain." You nod to Obyn as you pass, but he stops. "Say, Captain. May I pick your brain on something?"

event.text: "Do you reckon there's more of me out there? As in, my species."

"Yes, yes, of course. But... well, I've traveled the multiverse. And yet every reality we come to, its just more of the same. I've even met myself a couple times, and yet (tried though we may) no children could we bear. It seems as though even infinite realities isn't enough for me..."

choice.text: Keep looking. Surely there's a reality out there somewhere with what you're looking for.

event.text: Obyn smiles. "Thank you, Captain. I will keep looking. It's practically all I know at this point."

choice.text: Strange indeed. Maybe the multiverse is more limited than we thought?

event.text: "It would seem so from my experience. Yet, there's stories of such strange things happening... Pudding realities, planets made of solid gold... There's definitely infinities out there, and yet its almost as if something is keeping us from reaching them. Keeping me from reuniting with my people..."

choice.text: You tried having babies with yourself?

event.text: "I- look, that's not the important part, okay? I was desperate... okay, well. Desperation wasn't the only factor. Don't tell me you wouldn't do the same, okay?"
"Right, yes. Of course Captain. Not that I expected you to have all the answers to the universe, but... well, I guess I was just hoping for some encouragment, is all."
"Oh. Well, I appreciate your frankness... But, I don't think I can bring myself to believe you. I HAVE to hope. What else do I have if I don't have hope?"
"Uh, yes, of course. No bother. Wasn't terribly important anyways!"
Obyn blinks, then laughs. He laughs heartily, until he notices your blank stare. "Captain, do you need medical attention?"
"Rrrrright. Okay... well, uhm. See you later then?"

choice.text: Nod, and then pretend to pass out.

event.text: You nod your head and then flop to the floor. Obyn is speechless, but he lifts your body from the ground and carries you away to go find medical attention. You drama queen.

name: SOCIALIZE_OBYN_GENERIC_4
text: You notice Obyn scribbling away on parchment in his quarters. You poke your head in to ask what he's doing. "Ah, Captain. I was writing down some poetry. At some point I was going to ask if you wanted to listen, but... well I never worked up the courage. Seeing as you're here though, would you like to listen?"

event.text:
Obyn clears his throat.
			
			"Oh dear abyss, 
			Your starlit waters,
			Are but my bliss.
			
			Freedom found,
			for those who wander.
			Nowhere bound,
			yet never somber."
			
			He looks up at you, expectantly. "Thoughts?"
"You lie, of course. No need to spare my feelings." He stashes the poetry. "But uh, thanks. For listening. Haven't had someone to share my poetry with in quite a while."
"Mhm. I'd ask for feedback but, well I'm sure you're busy. At least I know I'm going somewhere with all of this..."
"Right, right." He stashes the poetry behind him. "Thank you for your honesty, Captain."
"Oh... well, I feared... but... well, thank you for your honesty." Obyn forces a smile. "Maybe I'm wasting my time, but I suppose it's something to do between the action."

name: SOCIALIZE_OBYN_GENERIC_5
text: You notice Obyn spinning a strange gold disk between his collosal fingers. You inquire as to its purpose, which Obyn happily explains. He holds up the disk, revealing it to be a carving of an eye. "It's a gift from an old friend. A religious token of some kind."

event.text:
Obyn sighs. "Was never a big one for religion myself. There was an old pantheon my people used to worship. A mostly benevolent, but certainly harsh, group of deities. But... well, after what happened to us, either the gods were never real, or they were never worth believing in to begin with..."
			
			Obyn pockets the token. "It's a harsh world without a guiding light, friend. But, we all make do. Take care."

choice.text: (Anurak) I see you kept my token!

event.text:
Anurak pops his head into the room, noticing the disk. "Old friend, you still have that old thing? Why, I'd have never guessed it'd mean so much to you!" He waddles over and attempts to wrap his tiny arms around Obyn's humungous torso. Obyn is resistant at first but eventually gives in and the two embrace.
			
			You can't help but feel a little awkward just standing there and decide to leave them alone.

name: SOCIALIZE_OBYN_METYUNT_1
text:
While patrolling the halls you notice Metyunt trailing Obyn. When Obyn bends down to pick something off the ground, Metyunt accidentally bumps into him.

"Oh! Er, hello. Lizard man. I didn't see you there with, uh... your short sature and all."

Metyunt clumbsily fixes his glasses. "I think you would make a marvelous business opportunity," he blurts out.

"Erm, excuse me? Should I take offense to that?"

"What? Oh, no no. Uhm... your salt. I meant. The novelty would serve as a catalyst for assured profit."

Obyn notices you watching and gives you a look like he's asking for help.

choice.text: Shrug and let this play out.

name: SOCIALIZE_OBYN_METYUNT_1_HELP
text:
As you get closer you notice Metyunt's eye is buldging. He looks as if he's drugged. You try to calm him down and get him to explain his thoughts.
	"Billy always told me that capitalizing on opportunity is what makes the man. I should always be on the lookout for opportunity!"

event.text: Metyunt gives you a quizzical look. "Exotic salt."

choice.text: So you... want to sell Obyn's skin?

event.text:
"Oh."
					
					Metyunt pauses.
					
					"Nevermind." He scurries off, stumbling as he goes. You remind yourself to check his room for any hidden drug stashes later.

name: SOCIALIZE_OBYN_METYUNT_1_IGNORE
text:
Obyn grunts and looks back to Metyunt, who seems to be talking to himself.

"Are you okay, lizard man? You don't look well."

"BUSINESS!" Metyunt screams and clutches his head, pulling on his fronds. Obyn takes a few steps back in shock. "WHY CAN'T I DO BUSINESS?!"

"What business?"

"Billy told me to always look for opportunity! Never let opportunity get away! Capitalizing on opportunity is what makes the man! SO WHY CAN'T I DO IT?!"

Metyunt seems to be practically catatonic. Obyn reaches for words but eventually gives up and goes back to his station. With no other option you pick Metyunt up and bring him back to his quarters.

name: SOCIALIZE_OBYN_TUCO_1
text:
You hear a loud commotion coming from one of the nearby rooms. You poke your head in and find Obyn and Tuco both stood atop a table, arm in arm, singing loud sea shanties. Or at least, they sound like sea shanties. Your translator isn't picking up any of the words and if you aren't mistaken, they're both singing different lyrics.
	
	You consider telling them to stop, but it's not worth the effort. They're clearly both drunk and will likely be unconscious in less than an hour.

name: SOCIALIZE_OBYN_ANURAK_1
text:
"Dear friend, might I inquire as to your favorite kind of soup?" At first you think Anurak is speaking to you, until you realize he's looking at Obyn.
	
	"Anurak, and I mean no offense, but do you ever talk about anything other than soup?"
	
	"Oh of course! I have many things to talk about other than soup!"
	
	There is an awkward silence as the two look at each other. "Uhuh." Obyn nods. "Well, to be honest I've never given it much thought."
	
	"Oh my, oh my! A man who doesn't know his favorite kind of soup? No no, this cannot do... this cannot do! Quickly friend, we must hurry to the kitchen! Oh so many soups to try!"

name: SOCIALIZE_OBYN_ANURAK_2
text:
Obyn and Anurak appear to both be hanging out in Obyn's room. Anurak is sitting upright in a chair while Obyn is flopped over his bed, writing something.
	
	"Now I'm no busybody and I'd never gossip - but I can't help but contain my curiosity! How is our old friend... er... oh dear. Begins with an S... Si... Sivilian? Yes, that was his name!"
	
	Obyn is shocked. "You forgot Sylvan's name? God, Anurak, I knew you were forgetful, but come on!"
	
	"No no no! I... uhm... Okay so maybe I forgot his name! I'm bad with names, alright? After so many trips back from the Clone Bay, you start to lose your mind a little! I was just asking how he was..."
	
	"He's... fine. I saw him recently, in fact. It was a strange encounter, but a pleasant one." Obyn smiles fondly. "Well, the reunion specifically. The circumstances not so much."

name: SOCIALIZE_QUEEN_NOTHING
text: The Queen seems to be fashioning together a makeshift nest out of some random bits of metal and other ship-bound items. She seems rather content with it and, since you aren't certain if she's eaten yet today, you decide it's best to leave her alone.

name: SOCIALIZE_QUEEN_GENERIC_1
text: Several of the crew have been complaining about strange rumbling noises coming from the air vents, but no one wants to investigate. Eventually, you're pushed into looking. As you climb to look into the one of the shafts where a noise can be heard, 8 red eyes stare right back at you. You stare back for a few terrifying moments, until the eyes all blink and disappear with a few clicks. Guess those noise complaints will go unresolved.

name: SOCIALIZE_QUEEN_GENERIC_2
text: The spider queen seems to have fallen asleep in the middle of the lounge, which means no one's gone inside for hours. You could try to wake her up... but there's a reason people are afraid of her.

event.text: You take a brave journey into the lounge, and try to shake the queen from a distance. She shuffles slightly, then stirs awake. You take a few steps back, but she only purrs and saunters out the door. Maybe she isn't as much of a threat as people think.

name: SOCIALIZE_QUEEN_GENERIC_3
text: The queen trots up to you, carrying on her back a bundle of webbing, some metal scraps, and a stray fork. She tosses it to you as if it were a gift and looks at you expectantly. Both with a warm heart and a fear of what will happen if you refuse it, you pick up the ball of scrap and the queen purrs.

name: SOCIALIZE_A55_NOTHING
text: You attempt to talk to A55 but get no response. At first you think he's ignoring you until you realize he's entered Power Save Mode. It's strange he even has that, but you suppose you'll have to talk to someone else right now.

name: SOCIALIZE_A55_GENERIC_1
text: You find A55 powered off in the middle hallway. It's fairly problematic that you have to keep powering him off to do other things, and you hope this doesn't have any long lasting consequences on him.

name: SOCIALIZE_A55_GENERIC_2
text: "Yo ho ho, fiddledeedee, being a pirate is 103!" A55 drives past shouting this, before stumbling over a set of stairs and crashing into the engine room. "Ow! Captain, I've become stuck within the inner-machinery of the engines! I believe you will need a blowtorch, arg! Please come quickly, it is immensely painful!"

name: SOCIALIZE_A55_GENERIC_3
text: You poke your head into the broom closet that you've repurposed as A55's quarters and find it full of hundreds of tiny paper pirate hats like the one he always wears. Spotting you, he comes rolling by to explain. "Arg! My hat is me most precious possession, but I've afraid it does not last very long in the water. Quite ironic for a pirate, I saw it wise to make as many backups as I could ever need in case my hat were destroyed! Not that it would ever happen, 'cause if ye touch old A55's hat yer gonna wish you were walkin' the plank, aye!"

name: SOCIALIZE_A55_GENERIC_4
text: "Arg, matey! Lass. Laddy. Mate? No... Lad. Er... Yo ho ho." A55 rolls away.

name: SOCIALIZE_A55_GENERIC_5
text: Out of curiosity, you ask A55 where his name came from. Instead of his usually jolly response, A55 turns gravely silent. "I cannot access those memories, Captain, without specific authorization. Would you like me to try?"

choice.text: Encourage A55 to try and access his old memories.

event.text: A55 powers down for a moment, but when he reboots his eyes are a bright red and his voice sounds the same as the one spouted by ordinary Rebel Auto-ships. "Warning. Memory recovery failed. Cannot access restricted data without authorization code. If you believe this is an error, please contact engineering head E.W." A55's eyes return to their usual orange. "Apologies, but I simply couldn't get past the blockage. Arg, how unfortunate. Lemme tell you Captain, if I could get all me old memories back, I would! For the future then it seems it'll have to wait!"

A55 apologizes. "For what it's worth Captain, what I can remember about the name was all the engineers who made me mocking me. I don't mind though. Ho ho, the one good thing about being a robot is you can't help but have thick skin, aye!"

name: SOCIALIZE_A55_GENERIC_6
text: You debate the ethical controversy over whether or not A55 deserves his own quarters aboard the ship. Frankly, he still seems fine living in the broom closet. It's certainly better than the previous location next to the toilet at least.

name: SOCIALIZE_A55_DOCTOR_1
text:
Nearby, the ship's Doctor Drone is busy self-calibrating when A55 rolls up nearby and begins to talk to it.

"Arg gorgeous, you must be a pirate, because you're haulin' quite the booty!"

"FAILED TO RECOGNIZE COMMAND. ARE YOU IN NEED OF CRITICAL MEDICAL AID?"

"I see how it is, lass! Playing hard to get! Capt'n A55'll get you some day!"

name: SOCIALIZE_A55_DOCTOR_2
text:
Nearby, the ship's Doctor Drone is taking stock of the ship's organic reserves when A55 rolls up nearby and begins to talk to it.

"You're quite the dastardly thief my girl, for ye've stolen me heart!"

"MISSING CRITICAL RESOURCES TO BEGIN TRANSPLANT. PLEASE PROVIDE DONOR HEART TO BEGIN MEDICAL PROCEDURE."

"Ye can't keep evadin' me forever lass! But it's alright, I love me a good chase!"

name: SOCIALIZE_A55_DOCTOR_3
text:
Nearby, the ship's Doctor Drone is doing patrols in case anyone is in need of aid when A55 rolls up nearby and begins to talk to it.

"Arg! I've 'eard of a cutlass, but you're more of a cute lass, if ya get me?"

"ORGANIC PATIENT NOT DETECTED. GOING INTO SLEEP MODE."

"Ah, too tired are we? Well ye get yer energy love, 'cause Captain A55 keeps ye up all night long, ahar!"

name: SOCIALIZE_A55_DOCTOR_4
text:
Nearby, the ship's Doctor Drone is performing a backup of its databanks when A55 rolls up nearby and begins to talk to it.

"Arg lass, did Vael send you? 'Cause me thinks you might be an Angel!"

"INJURY NOT DETECTED. PLEASE REITERATE COMMAND."

"Oh come on lass, I worked hard on that one! It wasn't even pirate themed!"

name: SOCIALIZE_A55_DOCTOR_5
text:
Nearby, the ship's Doctor Drone is regenerating its lolipop reserves when A55 rolls up nearby and begins to talk to it.

"Ahoy! I've had many a treasure chest, but I've never treasured a chest like yers, ahar!"

"CHEST INFECTIONS ARE NOT TO BE TAKEN LIGHTLY. TAKE A LOZENGE AND COME BACK TOMORROW IF SYMPTOMS PERSIST."

"Arg, ye can bet your sweet booty I'll be back tomorrow, and the day after that too!"

name: SOCIALIZE_A55_DOCTOR_AENWITHE_1
text:
A55 rolls up to where Aenwithe seems to be calibrating some subsystems and begins to beg. "Oh great cube of science, please oh could you fulfill my one wish?"

Aenwithe seems confused. "Your... wish? I fail to understand what it is you're referring to. I'm not a genie in a bottle."

"Arg, could you design a cognitive? One to install in my lovely Doctor Drone? Oh she's so sweet, but sometimes I long for a companion that will love me back!"

"A55, I can make the Doctor Drone sentient, but I can't make it love you."

A55 doesn't seem fazed by this. "Arg, there'll be no need! No one can resist my charm!"

Aenwithe lets out a mechanical sigh but finally agrees. "When the mission is over, I'll make you a cognitive companion. But if things won't work out between you, don't come crying to me."

name: SOCIALIZE_A55_JERRY_1
text:
In the breakroom, A55 rolls up to Jerry with a cacaphony of metallic thuds while Jerry is trying to figure out a rather complicated crossword. "Arg, shy but kind blonde kid! Yer uncle was er... Admiral Vance Wentworth, right?" Jerry nods. "Yeah, he was, uh... pirate... robot?"
	
"Arrrr. So, if you's was kin'n blood of the admiral, and I was say... the brain child of one close colleague of his. That's makes us cousins, don't it? Yeah? Ain't that right matey?" A55 sticks out his non-buzzsaw hand to Jerry. "Well, mister... do you prefer I spell out 'a-5-5' or do you want me to call you 'asshole'?" A55 shrugs. "You can call me either, cousin. Family's more than just names!"
	
Jerry nods. "Well, Captain A55. What you just said doesn't... make much sense at all." A55 frowns. "Oh... I see laddy. I'm sorry. I just... well I have no family. I had a pirate crew! But they're in the past now." Jerry stops the drone. "BUT - if it'll make you happy, we can still be cousins. Or brothers. Or whatever. Family is more than just blood too." Jerry shakes A55's hand and the two go to work on the crossword together.
