removeCrew.text: Fortunately, the Clone Bay has already revived your floral friend. Whether he'll stay a friend is debatable, because he's currently scowling at you for your stupidity.

choice.text: (Praetor Crew) Send in your Orchid crew to put out the fire.

event.text: You wait for a while, but your Orchid crew never returns. You receive another hail; "It uh... looks like your friend just walked into the blaze and died within seconds. I'm sorry, best I can offer is a small consolation."

removeCrew.text: Fortunately, the Clone Bay has already revived your floral friend. Whether he'll stay a friend is debatable, because he's currently scowling at you for your stupidity.

choice.text: (Cultivator Crew) Send in your Cultivator crew to put out the fire.

event.text: You wait for a while, but your Cultivator crew never returns. You receive another hail; "It uh... looks like your friend just walked into the blaze and died within seconds. I'm sorry, best I can offer is a small consolation."

removeCrew.text: Fortunately, the Clone Bay has already revived your floral friend. Whether he'll stay a friend is debatable, because he's currently scowling at you for your stupidity.

choice.text: Nevermind, we'll just stick to shopping.

event.text: Looks like you can't help after all. Best to stay out of this.
Docking with a burning marketplace doesn't sound like a good idea for anyone who doesn't like being on fire.

name: STOREEVENT_ORCHID_FARM
text: A small, peaceful Orchid farm has been established nearby. It seems a bit strange to see plants growing plants, but you suppose it's no different to humans raising animals. Looks like they're selling off some of their old farming equipment, among other things.

choice.text: Look around at what they're selling.

event.text: You have no need for any of their special offers, you'll stick to shopping.

name: STOREEVENT_CRYSTAL_COLLECTOR
text: A rotund Crystalline being appears on the vid screen. "Aliens! A grand opportunity. I am a collector of the strange artifacts you call "scrap" and would love to trade!"

choice.text: Give him a gift of 40 scrap.

event.text: "So much scrap! A generous gift, but I cannot let this go unpaid! An exchange for a piece from my own heritage will do."

choice.text: (Scrap Arm) Show him how to construct a scrap arm.

event.text: "A device solely for the collection of precious metal material? Magnificent! I cannot let this go unpaid! An exchange for a piece from my own heritage will do."

choice.text: (Magnetic Arm) Show him how to construct a magnetic arm.

event.text: "A device solely for the collection of precious metal material? Magnificent! I cannot let this go unpaid! An exchange for a piece from my own heritage will do."

The Crystal jumps up and down in excitement. "Ooooh, I had no idea piles of child corpses were of high value! One with a greater ethical compass than mine might be concerned, but I will buy these for a handsome price!"

name: STOREEVENT_CRYSTAL_TRANSLATOR
text: Looks like you're receiving a transmission from a nearby Crystal ship, but it comes out heavily garbled. You don't have a clue as to what they're saying.

choice.text: Try and translate what he's saying.

event.text: You try for a while to decipher his message, but during the silence the Crystal pops back on, now speaking normally. "Apologies, I'm still accustomed to not having to use my translator. I'm a merchant vessel, would you care to trade?"

The two Crystals speak with each other, and the other one speaks again, now completely normal. "Apologies, I'm still accustomed to not having to use my translator. I was not expecting to see more of our kind aboard a Federation vessel! Well, I suppose it's not that strange. But still quite pleasant! I'm a merchant vessel, would you care to trade?" On top of the offer, he also throws in a show of good will because of your crew.
Miscommunication shmiscommunication. If you can't understand what they're saying, then everything they say could and probably is a threat. Best to just murder them without further questions.

name: STOREEVENT_CRYSTAL_WEAPONS
text: A Crystalline station is running a market here, selling Crystal weapons to travelers.

event.text: Apparently, the rampant savagery of the pirates and Rebels around you have gotten to you, driving you so far off the edge you've decided to open fire on a harmless Crystal station for next to no reason.

name: STOREEVENT_CRYSTAL_PIRATES
text: Supposedly the nearby station is a Crystalline marketplace, but it looks suspiciously empty.

event.text: Hopefully the station's crew are all okay and you've just missed something, but you aren't willing to risk your own crew to find out.

name: STOREEVENT_FREEMANTIS_FREE
text: A Free Mantis vessel is here; always a pleasant sight for any Federation captain. Looks to be a merchant - what might he have in store?

event.text: "Oh captain captain! Shining skies bringing great blessings in our meeting here! You must accept gift, if you are wanting trade!"
"And now, buying of things may commence!"

choice.text: (Free Mantis Crew) Request an even greater gift.

event.text: "And now, buying of things may commence!"
"Awful awful captain! You anger me. You not accepting gift of friendship, then you are not friend nor living much longer!"

name: STOREEVENT_FREEMANTIS_BADPRICES
text: Looks like a Free Mantis market is nearby. Various Mantis chatter away about synthetic pheromones and other stereotypical Free Mantis things. One part of the market catches your eye in particular however - a vendor offering discounted resources.

event.text: "Good friends, I offering fuel of incredible value! Half off, buying them now while you can!"
"Most excellent of purchasings! Hoping you are enjoy."
"Most excellent of purchasings! Hoping you are enjoy."

"Oh? By how much so? I am forgetting standard prices..." You can probably get him to lower the price of one... but it's unlikely he'll be able to comprehend changing both. You have to pick your battles with these guys.

choice.text: Fuel is usually a lot cheaper.

event.text: "Ah, I am understanding now. Me thinking..."
"Most excellent of purchasings! Hoping you are enjoy."
"Most excellent of purchasings! Hoping you are enjoy."
"Oh, alright then. You are having wonderful day!" You bid farewell to the Mantis and head to the market.

choice.text: Missiles are usually a lot cheaper.

event.text: "Ah, I am understanding now. Me thinking..."
"Most excellent of purchasings! Hoping you are enjoy."
"Most excellent of purchasings! Hoping you are enjoy."
"Oh, alright then. You are having wonderful day!" You bid farewell to the Mantis and head to the market.

choice.text: (Free Mantis Crew) Have your Free Mantis explain.

event.text: Unconfident in your own ability to talk "reason" with the Free Mantis, you send your own crew instead. Unfortunately, he just gets confused too. Eventually they deliberate the price of fuel to be somewhere around 300 scrap. You'd protest, but the vendor is so happy for your help, he offers you a crate of resources for free!
None of the Mantis seem bothered by your presence, though they don't break out into crazed idolization either. Honestly, it's a relief.

name: STOREEVENT_FREEMANTIS_REPAIRS
text: A Free Mantis merchant nearby is broadcasting a looping advertisement; "We doing repairs! Come, discount price, we fix hull, we fix furniture, we fix broken marriage! Fixing anything! Come buy buy and buy!"

event.text: A Free Mantis mechanic eagerly waves at you to come in. Looks like they're selling some things on the side. To browse them though, you have to buy a repair job of some kind.

choice.text: (Free Mantis Crew) Request a free repair. [7$]

event.text: "Anything for brother and friend of Federation! Enjoying store!"

choice.text: Wait for your repair job to finish...

event.text: "Anything for Federation officer! Enjoying store!"

choice.text: Wait for your repair job to finish...

event.text: "Hoping you are happy with services, and enjoying store!"

choice.text: Wait for your repair job to finish...

event.text: "Hoping you are happy with services, and enjoying store!"

choice.text: Wait for your repair job to finish...

event.text: Like any rational person, you have decided today is a good day for needless murder. Have fun.

name: STOREEVENT_MANTIS_RARE
text: Merchants are not highly respected among the Mantis race, so few undertake the profession. You're mildly surprised to receive an advertisement from a nearby space dock. Might be worth looking into?

choice.text: (Hive Mantis Crew) Request to dock safely.

event.text: "Hmmmh, you are seeming ally. Okay, I am trading with you. Making profit, rewarding as killing prey! Well, not as much. Death is very fun."
"The great Kazaaakplethkilik, coming in shop? Yes, this will do good publicity stunt! Business between killers, shall be very rewarding! Accept free sample of killing tool!"
You can never be sure when it might be a trap - and when it's a Mantis, the odds are pretty high.

name: STOREEVENT_MANTIS_WHALE
text: A Mantis crew here has hunkered down in the abdomen of a long-dead space-whale - the only way, presumably, for them to operate their black-market trade without detection. Worth a look?

event.text: Your approach is met by a curious Mantis ship with distinct spikes of power in their weapons system. "Federation come to shut down? Refusal!"

choice.text: (Hive Mantis Crew) We wish to shop here.
Well now that you mention it...

event.text: "We is not tolerating of this! We steal goods and sell goods fair and rectangle! Federation not take away right!"
"Gooood. And not letting door hit you on way out. Heh..."
It might not be such a good idea to go delving into a Mantis-run black market.

name: STOREEVENT_MANTIS_WHALE_CONVINCE
text: "Hmph. Bad of mine, then. Come, we have extensive stock. Slave offerings, there."

event.text: No need for slaves today. You'll stick with regular goods.

name: STOREEVENT_MANTIS_WHALE_KAZ
text: "Oh mighty Kazaaakplethkilik! We admirers of you, even if you having... heated business with Hive. Come in, prized customer. Accept tribute of ours!"

event.text: No need for slaves today. You'll stick with regular goods.

name: STOREEVENT_MANTIS_DEATH
text: Looks like a Mantis trader is here. These are pretty hard to come by, and you wonder if he'll be willing to trade with a Federation vessel.

event.text: "Federation wanting trade!? Haha, I laugh! You wanting earn right to trade, then we fight to death!" The Mantis doesn't even give you time to explain that you can't trade if you're dead and attacks! Maybe if you beat them up a little, they'll listen?
The odds are not in your favor that this encounter would be friendly... better to stay way.

name: STOREEVENT_MANTIS_DEATH_TRADE
text: "Oh, hum. You are making many of senses. Okay, I am stopping."

event.text: "Yes, only fair. Am sending Engi to fix hull."

name: STOREEVENT_MANTIS_REBELS
text: The market nearby is broadcasting on Mantis frequencies, but all you see is a Rebel transport!

event.text: "Not Rebels any longer, this vessel belong to Hive! Rebel crew, now slaves. Slaves for you, if money you are having!"

choice.text: Just buy some stuff from the Rebels' stores.

event.text: You arm the guns and attack the Rebels, but on the other end all you hear is angry clicking... Looks like the Mantis are now in control of this ship!
You aren't sure what's going on here, but it's safest to not approach.

name: STOREEVENT_ROCK_RACIST
text: Rock traders are more common than you'd think, but they aren't always happy to deal with anyone. The ship here is no exception, and refuses to trade with you unless you pay a fee of ammunition.

event.text: The Rockman grunts and agrees to let you browse his wares.
You sure as hell aren't paying a fee to trade with some racist Rockmen. You'll just take what you want from their lifeless bodies instead!
The Rockman says nothing and flies away. A waste of a jump...

choice.text: (Theocracy Crew) Request to skip the fee.

event.text: "Ah, a fellow Rockman! Peculiar to see one of us aboard a Federation vessel... but I'm willing to be more generous to one of our own."

choice.text: (Zoltan Crew) Request to skip the fee.

event.text: "Ah, a Zoltan! I am intrigued to see what curiosities you might have to offer! Come in, browse my wares!"

choice.text: (Floral Crew) Request to skip the fee.

event.text: "Ah, a traveler from the Gathering. In the spirit of friendship, we will waive the fee."
Entering a hypnotic state, the Rockman welcomes you onboard and even pays you some scrap out of "kindness".

choice.text: (Mind Control Weapon) Change the trader's mind.

event.text: The weapon overrides the Rockman's judgement. You are welcomed onboard and gifted with scrap for your time.

name: STOREEVENT_ROCK_MINELAUNCHERS
text: As soon as you jump in, the voice of a Rockman blares throughout your ship. "Visitors, come in and visit my brand new Mine Launcher Emporium! We sell Mine Launchers! And other things, because no one buys the god damn Mine Launchers! But please, buy my Mine Launchers!"

event.text: "Oh good, oh good! Visitors at last! Have you come to purchase a Mine Launcher? Oh please, my stock is expansive, endless even!"

You expect the Rockman to get offended, but instead he gets even more excited. "I found this a long time ago. I've been holding on to it for someone special. You're the first person to show any interest, so here you go!"
"I hope you enjoy it!" The Rockman claps with joy. You take a browse of the market as well on your way out.
The Rockman's voice suddenly turns cold. "Head left, you'll find the general marketplace..." He storms off, his thunderous footsteps shaking you as he goes.
You have some time on your hands while you do your shopping.
Why are so many people adamant on selling these things still? They won't for much longer if you have a say in it!
The station continues to target you with a slue of enthusiastic advertisements, but you simply fly away.

name: STOREEVENT_ROCK_CRYSTALS
text: A collection of Rock vessels have gathered around a nearby planet. They look pretty invested in their trading, but you aren't sure how they'll receive you.

event.text: You land on the planet and find the Rockmen trading with each other, and various Crystal weapons are on display. Your approach seems to have upset them however, and a figure who looks to be some part of the Rock Clergy moves forward to interrogate you.
"Brother! Welcome! Come, take a look at all we have to offer. We have many holy items on sale!"
"Oh sweet lord, oh heavens, ohhhhhhhhh" The Rockman nearly collapses as he seems to enter some sort of state of prayer. The Rockmen shower you in gifts and offer to trade.
"Ah, so you are one of our allies from the Gathering. In the spirit of friendship, we will permit you to view a small portion of our collection."
Intruding on the business of multiple Rock ships sounds like suicide. Better to not get involved.

name: STOREEVENT_ROCK_CRYSTALS_TRADE_CONVINCE
text: The Rockman grunts. "You will be permitted to trade with us, but we refuse to let you have access to our Crystalline tech. It is too holy for Federation commons like you."

name: STOREEVENT_ROCK_MISSION
text: The station here looks to be a Rock mission. These pop up from time to time to try and convert other species to the Rock religion. They're also usually accompanied by a market, but you aren't sure what they might expect from you in return.

event.text: You're stopped by a Rockman with a long staff, topped with the skull of a former-heretic. "Do you know the holy words? Are you pure? Prove yourself or face the might of the Inquisition!"
The Rockman laughs. "Then PROVE IT! Recite to me Rothedi 78:598."
The Rockman growls, and calls for security to chase you out of the station, while its weapons come online to fight you off.

Your Rockmen pauses, then lets out a massive release of flatulence, filling the room with an unbearable stench. You assume the missionary will be insulted, but instead he cheers. "You are a talented scholar of the holy texts! I am proud to have you aboard my station. Please, accept this gift."
Your Crystal giggles a little while they are lying, but the missionary doesn't seem to notice. Stricken by fear, he sends one of his fellow priests to join you while you're let into the market.

Your Floral crew apologizes that they are biologically incapable of replicating the verse precisely. They offer to instead use a similar piece of scripture to their own religion - doing a bizarre dance punctuated with a release of a floral scent. The Rock pauses, but nods. "Very well. Though you are incapable of replicating the holy words, you understand their spirit."

choice.text: (Slug Crew) Your Slug seems to think something is funny.

event.text: Your Slug explains to you that the verse in question involves a dance and a timed release of flatulence, though they struggle to keep a serious composition throughout this explanation. They then charge straight to the missionary, move around in a circle, and secrete a large amount of slime on the spot. The missionary appears to be deeply offended by this. "What, what trickery is this? How dare you mock our Holy Words! I should've known that your kind would never appreciate our sacred endeavours!" The station arms its weapons to fight you off, though only after they clean up the mess your Slug left behind.

choice.text: (Telepathic Shell) Have your Shell figure out the answer.

event.text: Though your Shell initially objects to the idea after discovering the answer, they eventually oblige. They proceed to roll up to the missionary, spin around in place and violently combust. You have no idea what they just did, but the missionary seems pleased about it. "It seems the Holy Words have spread to new untold places! The Elders would surely be pleased of this revelation! Take this, as a sign of our gratitude."
Your mind tricks seem to do the job, and the missionary lets you in. Better hurry up though, for there's no guarantee your trickery won't be discovered.

Your weapon blindsides the Rockman, who is instantly fooled into thinking you have spoken the words rather than fired upon them. Better hurry up though, for there's no guarantee your trickery won't be discovered.

choice.text: (Unfaithful Rock Crew) "Your holy text are lies!"

event.text: The Rockman breaks into laughter. "HAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHHAHAHAHAHAHAHHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAHAH... Hah... heh... hoooo... You are an ignorant idiot. Yet, you could be helped. I can reeducate you. Make you loyal to the Theocracy! I demand this if you want to access our market peacefully."

choice.text: Let them reeducate your Cultist to access the market.

event.text: "Good. They will become a follower once again. In the meantime, you may access the store. Try anything funny, and you won't see your crew ever again."

choice.text: Let them reeducate your Commando to access the market.

event.text: "Good. They will become a follower once again. In the meantime, you may access the store. Try anything funny, and you won't see your crew ever again."

choice.text: Let them reeducate your Outcast to access the market.

event.text: "Good. They will become a follower once again. In the meantime, you may access the store. Try anything funny, and you won't see your crew ever again."
"Then perish!" Only two words, but their intent is clear as the station suddenly turns hostile.

choice.text: (Tuco) Introduce them to the Dread Pirate himself.

event.text: As soon as Tuco strides out of your ship onto the station, the missionaries flee in terror. You hear what seems to be a ship taking off a few minutes later. The Rock clergymen still on the station offer you a gift as thanks for their newfound freedom, and offer to trade with you.

Terrified at the sight of the Lost Sun admiral, the missionaries submit immediately. Some of the less-convinced clergymen even revolt. They still offer to trade, but provide a gift for their newfound freedom as well.

The Rockman slinks back in fear as Vortigon takes a step forward. He takes the missionary into a different room, and when they return, the other is now wearing the blue robes of a cultist. You know better than to ask questions at this point, but fortunately it seems you can now trade here.
"Bahahaha! You think the Theocracy cares what the Federation demands of us? You hold no authority over our holy work! Get lost!" The station turns hostile!

The missionary chases after you, shouting. Unfortunately for him, as a Rockman, he's far too slow. However, a team of security officers have made their way onto your ship, and you'll have to take care of them before you can leave!
There's little moral quandary here, for Rock fanatics are feared across the galaxy for their brutal methods. You're only helping make this galaxy a safer place.
Rock fanatics are infamous for their brutality and merciless ways of forcing their religion on others. This isn't the kind of place you want to be shopping at.

name: STOREEVENT_LOSTSUN_VOLCANO
text: It looks like the Lost Suns have set up a weapons stockpile on a station around an ashen planet laden with craters. If you're lucky, they might be willing to trade.

event.text: A gruff Lost Sun officer answers the call. "Yes, what do you want?" It's obvious by the look on his face that he's not in a good mood.
"With a Renegade?" He looks at you suspiciously, before shrugging. "Fine, we could use the scrap. Don't make any funny moves. I know what your kind is like."

"This post... it is boring! I and many of my brethren in arms took this posting in the hopes that we could watch the planet down below undergo a beautiful eruption. Our scientists clocked it as a source of high potential for volcanic activity. And yet, it refuses to pop! We even tried to agitate the planet with explosives to no avail. A Commando can only go so long without witnessing a resplendent explosion!"

choice.text: (Adv. Sensors) Tell them the exact spot to aim their explosives.

event.text: You use your fully upgraded sensor suite to map out the seismic and volcanic activity. Your ship identifies several active fault lines on the planet, the ideal areas to agitate with explosives. The Lost Suns receive this data and immediately follow your exact instructions of where to bombard the planet. Shortly afterward, a massive eruption occurs, visible from orbit, the extent of which your sensor suite fully captures. The Rockmen beam down to the planet to frolic amidst the downpouring lava, blissfully enjoying the planetary lava bath.

choice.text: (Powerful Ballistics) Demonstrate the effectiveness of superior firepower.

event.text: You pick a spot that seems to have a decent amount of activity and aim your missiles. With a few volleys, the planet finally reacts with a massive eruption, visible from orbit. The Rockmen beam down to the planet to frolic amidst the downpouring lava, blissfully enjoying the planetary lava bath.

You use your Temporal Manipulator to accelerate the pressure buildup beneath the surface of the largest volcano. After some careful work, the natural equilibrium of the planet is disturbed and a massive eruption occurs, visible from orbit. The Rockmen beam down to the planet to frolic amidst the downpouring lava, blissfully enjoying the planetary lava bath.

You use your Reality Manipulator on the planet. The device instantly transforms the entire planet into a burning hellscape, with volcanos flooding the entire surface with a downpour of lava. The Rockmen watch in amazement at the transformation.

You set your ship down on the surface of the planet and rig the button to send its signal after you've cleared the distance from your own ship. However, as your shuttle ascends and your landing site briefly becomes the system's second sun, you can't help but feel like you needed that ship for something...

lose.text: Looks like you're now a permanent resident of the Lost Suns' station... but at least they enjoyed your display.

event.text: "Hmph. Yes, very well."
The station doesn't hesitate to activate its defenses.
You keep your distance from the Lost Suns.

name: LOSTSUN_VOLCANIC_ERUPTION_STORE
text: The officer's disposition has completely changed, now clapping heartily as he watches out the window in amazement. "Federation friend! I cannot tell you how happy this makes me. Please, take a gift from our stores, and feel free to make an offer on anything else you wish to buy."

name: STOREEVENT_LOSTSUN_ESCAPEES
text: The store at this beacon hosts an unusual sight - a Theocracy vessel, hovering within sensor range of a Lost Suns outpost. Despite what you'd expect, neither of them are charging weapons, and you detect comm chatter between the two.

event.text:
"I told you, our supplies are running thin - we won't make it to asylum before they run out. We've already forsaken the Elders' teachings, why must we prove ourselves to you?"

"It's not a matter of proving yourselves, it's a matter of resources. This outpost wasn't made to hold refugees, and I'm not authorized to give out supplies without payment."

"You would knowingly send us away without enough fuel to reach our destination? How can you call yourselves liberators?"

"Every ship we send to our shelters could be a spy for the Theocracy, and yet we tell them where to go, time and time again. You still have better odds out there than if you had stayed on the homeworld."

choice.text: Give them enough fuel to get to their destination.

event.text: You announce your intentions to both parties, then jettison a container of fuel towards the refugee ship - they're hesitant, but soon move to collect it. A few moments later, you receive a call from their captain.

choice.text: (Ariadne) Demand that they assist the refugees.

event.text: As Ariadne steps on screen, you swear you can see the light fade from the station owner's eyes. "Hello there! I'd love to stay and chew you out, but we're in a bit of a hurry - these refugees need fuel, and a full inspection of their ship for Theocracy tracking devices; I trust I don't need to tell you that's an order." The Commando wanders offscreen in shock to do his duties, and you soon receive a call from the outcasts.

"Listen here, pebble. I don't know if you're allowed to help THESE fellas, but I think your superiors would say that I've done enough for you to be due a favor... either that, or you could say I threatened you! It's a lie for now, but we could fix that!" The Commando on the other end stammers, but eventually agrees; the outcasts hail you shortly afterwards.

choice.text: (Theocracy Crew) "You arrogant disgraces! How dare you poison the galaxy with your repugnant presence!"

event.text: While your Rock rages on the comm, the heretics move away from the station as they both begin charging weapons!

"You... you DARE to offer us such a flagrant insult to the dignity of an entire species? Not even the Elders would stoop to such mockery!" Enraged, the Theocracy ship begins charging weapons, and even the Lost Suns station begins firing on you!

choice.text: Tune them out and continue to the store.

event.text: You don't have time to intermediate every argument in the Multiverse. You quietly close communications and move to dock with the store.

choice.text: Ignore them and stick to shopping.

name: LOSTSUN_REFUGEES_GIFT
text: "I don't know what we would have done without you... here, take this. We weren't eager to sell off our own weapons for fuel to someone who clearly didn't trust us, but I suppose we could all use a bit more trust out here."

name: STOREEVENT_VAMPWEED_TERRAFORMER
text: A Confederate terraforming station hails you. "Looking for a place to shop? You may be in luck! While in the process of evaluating this planet as a new candidate for hosting a gardenworld, we found an abandoned pirate colony! We have no use for this stuff, so we're selling it off to anyone interested! Come on in and shop!"

event.text: With no need for a place to shop, you can instead make a profit picking off these Vampweeds!

choice.text: Ask to check the ruins yourself for anything they missed.

event.text: "You want to waste your time picking through emptied out pirate caches? Be my guest. If you change your mind and want to shop, we'll still be here." You figure you can realistically do one search and still have time to shop, but anything past that might be a stretch.

name: VAMPWEED_TERRAFORMER_1_CHOICE
text: You take a step back and survey what you've found. Now is time to decide if you want to keep going.

name: VAMPWEED_TERRAFORMER_2_CHOICE
text: You return to the ship to contemplate. You could still return to the store, although the fleet is bound to be catching up by now. If you do keep searching though, there won't be any time left to visit the store.

name: VAMPWEED_TERRAFORMER_3_CHOICE
text: By now, the terraforming station has closed for the day and the Rebel fleet is surely catching up by now. Your crew are getting frustrated, but it's not too late to do another sweep.

name: VAMPWEED_TERRAFORMER_5_CHOICE
text: You receive a hail from the Vampweeds, who are clearly concerned. "Are you okay down there? You've been away for almost an entire cycle! You should get sleep, or something!"

name: VAMPWEED_TERRAFORMER_6_CHOICE
text: By now, you've searched every hut, combed through every scrap pile, investigated every cargo container, explored every hole, and checked every drawer in the entire colony. There's surely nothing left, and your time has been thoroughly wasted. The Vampweeds are also starting to get mad - they need you out of the colony soon so they can begin their terraforming by the start of the next cycle.

choice.text: It's time to quit - just leave.
No! We must search one last time!

name: VAMPWEED_TERRAFORMER_SEARCH_6
text: Despite many groans and scowls, you order your crew back out there one last time. It's going to be fruitless, of course, just like all the previous searches. Yet you're adamant regardless. Your crew march back out there and once over the camp... but all of their reports turn back nothing. All the places you've already searched can be searched again and again, but they'll never turn up anything new. With no other choice and full of disappointment, you're finally ready to give up.

event.text: Suddenly, one of your crew calls in with a strange report - the metal detectors have found an incredibly, barely perceptible anomaly a bit south of the camp. They start digging, and come across a hidden trapdoor burried under mounds of soil! It leads to a secret pathway untouched by the Vampweeds, full of all sorts of valuables! You report your findings back to the terraformers, and they're dumbfounded. Impressed by your resilience, they allow you to keep everything in the secret cache.

name: STOREEVENT_VAMPWEED_SPORES
text: A Vampweed marketplace is looping an automated message. "Have excess spores? Ready for harvesting? We'll buy them in bulk! No extra fees!"

choice.text: Ignore the offer and just visit the store.
Recruit one of their scientists for your mission.
(Vampweed Crew) Have your Vampweed's spores harvested.

event.text: Although you're a bit unsure of the idea, your Vampweed assures you it's a perfectly healthy and normal process. In fact, it's even recommended by doctors that they get spore cleanings regularly. They return a little while later after you've finished shopping with their payment in hand.

choice.text: (Cultivator Crew) Have your Cultivator's spores harvested.

event.text: Although you're a bit unsure of the idea, your Vampweed assures you it's a perfectly healthy and normal process. In fact, it's even recommended by doctors that they get spore cleanings regularly. They return a little while later after you've finished shopping with their payment in hand.

The store owners are absolutely stunned to see such an important figure entering the facility. They immediately bring in their best physician to do the process, and try to plug their business as much as capable in hopes they may get an endorsement.

The store owners are absolutely stunned to see such an important figure entering the facility. They immediately bring in their best physician to do the process, and try to plug their business as much as capable in hopes they may get an endorsement.

name: STOREEVENT_VAMPWEED_INSURRECTIONIST
text: A Confederate arms dealer nearby is peddling weapons to passing ships, but with a specific "request" of their clients - they'll only sell to Confederate-born citizens and Coalition supporters, certainly no one loyal to the Federation.

event.text: The dealers nod to your crew and allow them in, but refuse to allow the rest of your crew inside. Your Vampweed continues on nervously while you wait in the ship hoping there won't be any issues.
The dealers nod to your crew and allow them in, but refuse to allow the rest of your crew inside. Your crewmember continues on nervously while you wait in the ship hoping there won't be any issues.

choice.text: (Upg. Mind Control) 'Convince' the Vampweeds to sell to you.

event.text: While you won't have very long to stick around, hopefully the mind control lasts just enough to pick out what you want and leave.

choice.text: (Mind Control Weapon) 'Convince' the Vampweeds to sell to you.

event.text: With a quick strike from your weapon, you gain access to their store. You're going to have to make it fast, they'll likely have questions if your weapon wears off.

choice.text: Attempt to lie your way into the store.

event.text: No matter who they are, you won't stand for any Coalition sympathizers! Time to fight.
As much as you don't agree with their politics, these guys have a right to refuse you service. You won't cause a fuss.

name: STOREEVENT_REBEL_ANNOUNCER
text: You come across a large trade station. However, as soon as you approach a warning goes out to all ships in the region: "Do not associate with the Federation sympathizers. All who oppose the Rebels will be punished."

choice.text: Search among the stores to see if someone will sell to you.

event.text: You decide it's better to not push your luck and move on.

choice.text: (Engineer Crew) Pass yourself off as Rebels.

event.text: As a former Rebel themselves, your engineer has a few tricks up their sleeve for getting you into the market safely. You find a vendor willing to sell to you, though you can tell they have their suspicions.

choice.text: (MFK Ace Crew) Pass yourself off as Rebels.

event.text: As a former Rebel themselves, your MFK Ace has a few tricks up their sleeve for getting you into the market safely. You find a vendor willing to sell to you, though you can tell they have their suspicions.

choice.text: (Mind Control Weapon) Alter the announcer's opinions.

event.text: You locate the source of the announcement and fire your mind control weapon at the speaker, who rescinds his previous statement. Hopefully you will have enough time to shop before he can figure out what just happened.
You locate the source of the announcement and 'convince' the speaker to rescind his previous statement. Hopefully you will have enough time to shop before he can figure out what just happened.

choice.text: (Upg. Mind Control) Alter the announcer's opinions.

event.text: You locate the source of the announcement and 'convince' the speaker to rescind his previous statement. In addition he apologizes by offering complimentary supplies. Hopefully you will have enough time to shop before he can figure out what just happened.

choice.text: (Adv. Mind Control) Alter the announcer's opinions.

event.text: You locate the source of the announcement and 'convince' the speaker to rescind his previous statement. In addition he apologizes by offering considerable complimentary supplies. Hopefully you will have enough time to shop before he can figure out what just happened.

name: STOREEVENT_REBEL_XENOPHOBE
text: A looping message from a nearby store plays, "All are welcome to shop, with one stipulation. Xeno scum are forbidden to shop here! Humans only, or get lost!"

choice.text: We have no aliens, dock safely.
Try and dock despite having aliens aboard.
(Non-Sapient Crew) Pass off your alien crew as pets.

event.text: The store-owners consider for a bit, but seem to accept this, and allow you inside.
A racist market isn't something you're interested in shopping at.

name: STOREEVENT_REBEL_FRIENDLY
text: A Rebel transport is making small repairs nearby, but they seem to be some kind of merchant. You expect a fight, but receive a secret hail. "Our military escort is still a few beacons behind, scattered by pirates. Truth be told, I think this war is silly. I'd be willing to trade, but we have to be quick."

event.text: The Rebel captain shrugs, and says nothing more. It's probably best you get out as quick as possible.

name: STOREEVENT_REBEL_FRIENDLY_WIN
text: The escort is disposed of, but the Rebel captain seems shaken. "I... I'm on the wrong side. I won't do this any longer. Hurry up and buy whatever you need, I'm coming with you."

name: STOREEVENT_REBEL_ENGINEER
text: Rebel Engineers aren't always as aggressive as other Rebels, and fortunately it seems the one here is as you've heard. In fact, looks like they're looking to trade for the scrap needed to repair their Auto-ships.

event.text: The Engineers also offer a few drone schematics.
"Well if you aren't going to be helpful, then we'll just blow you up!"

name: STOREEVENT_AUTO_VENDER
text: Looks like an Auto-Vendor is nearby, but its programming won't let it trade with you unless you find a way to spoof it.

choice.text: Try and scan your fake ID.
(Engineer Crew) Rewire the Auto-ship to trade with you.

event.text: Fortunately, you're able to hack into the Auto-ship and reconfigure it to accept your Federation ID.

choice.text: (Hacking) Rewire the Auto-ship to trade with you.

event.text: Fortunately, you're able to hack into the Auto-ship and reconfigure it to accept your Federation ID.

choice.text: (Adv. Hacking) Rewire the Auto-ship to trade with you.

event.text: Fortunately, you're able to hack into the Auto-ship and reconfigure it to accept your Federation ID. You also leave a little present for the fleet, by setting the ship to explode when a Rebel ship communicates with it.

choice.text: (Hacking Weapon) Confuse the Auto-ship to trade with you.

event.text: You fire your weapon at ship's processing unit. The ship stutters momentarily, before accepting your Federation ID as valid.
It's not worth the risk to try and trick an AI, you might as well get some scrap from it.
You have no interest in this Auto-vessel, so you decide to ignore it.

name: STOREEVENT_DUSK_FRIENDLYISH
text: As Zoltan supremacists, the Duskbringers aren't keen on trading with anyone outside their species. Usually they don't get along with Ministry citizens either, but the ship here seems alright with dealing with any Zoltan, just not other races.

event.text: The Duskbringer captain seems pleased to see your crewmate, and ignores the rest of your crew.

choice.text: (Zoltan Shield) Submit yourself as a Zoltan ship.

event.text: It's not the most convincing alibi considering your vessel is registered under the Federation, but somehow you manage to gain access to the marketplace. You have to be careful not to let it be clear that your ship isn't quite what you claim.
The Duskbringers are your enemies. It doesn't matter if they're open to other Zoltans or not - they're still fascists and xenophobes, and that's enough in your book to warrant their death.

name: STOREEVENT_DUSK_PROTOCOL
text: The Duskbringers are notorious for being even stricter than the Ministry. Looks like the station here is open to trading with anyone, a surprising find, but there's a million protocols in place.

choice.text: Take some time to learn the rules first.

event.text: It's mind-numbing reading through all of this nonsense, but at least you feel like you're finally confident enough to approach. Luckily, looks like you've done everything right. Hopefully this was worth it.

choice.text: (Zoltan Crew) Your crew understand the rules.

event.text: The Zoltans are raised to understand these kinds of things quickly. It only takes a minute of skimming the hundred page list of rules to understand everything you need to do, and fortunately their knowledge pays off.
You couldn't care less if they don't mind trading with Feds. They're your enemies, and you'll be doing everyone but themselves a favor by killing them!
You aren't stupid. These rules are designed to trick up anyone who isn't a Duskbringer, and you won't fall for it.

name: STOREEVENT_DUSK_TAXES
text: A Duskbringer merchant hails you, seemingly very annoyed. "Federation? Pirate? I don't care. Damn Rebels deployed some stupid auto-tax collector in this system and it's driving me nuts. Kill it, and I'll trade with whoever you are."

event.text: Looks like this "tax collector" is a lot deadlier than you expected. You aren't even sure this thing IS a tax collector, but you want that store, so you'll do what you must.
You've decided that you're not going to do vandalism for the Duskbringers, and instead opt to take them out.
The Duskbringer calls you a coward and cuts comms before you can respond.

name: STOREEVENT_COALITION_MYSTERYRACE
text: A Coalition merchant is present; quite the oddity considering these Federation-wannabes consist of perhaps the 4 most aggressive races in the galaxy. Except Slugs, but they aren't very nice either.

choice.text: Hail them, maybe we'll get lucky?

event.text: What kind of fool would you be to think you could get along with a Coalition ship anyways? You avoid the ship.

name: STOREEVENT_COALITION_RACES
text: Looks like a trade-hub between the different races of the Coalition was set up here. You might be able to sneak in if you have any of the appropriate crew.

event.text: Thanks to your crew, it's not hard to gain access. You're even given a fresh Anti-Bio weapon on your way in!
Thanks to your crew, it's not hard to gain access. You're even given a fresh Missile weapon on your way in!
Thanks to your crew, it's not hard to gain access. You're even given a fresh Bomb weapon on your way in!
Thanks to your crew, it's not hard to gain access. You're even given a fresh Flak weapon on your way in!
It's a total waste, but you don't have anything to sneak in, and attacking the market would be suicide.

name: STOREEVENT_COALITION_FORCE
text: Looks like there's a Coalition market here! As you could expect, they certainly aren't trading with you, a Federation ship, unless you can find some way of convincing them...

event.text: You hail the station, but before you can even get a word out, their Slug captain bursts out laughing. "HAHAHAHAHAH! No."

choice.text: Attack them, force is the only way to convince these guys.

event.text: If you can do enough damage to the station, you might be able to convince them to sell to you.
It might not be the greatest idea to try and make a Coalition station trade with you when they're your sworn enemies.

name: STOREEVENT_DYNASTY_NOAIR
text: It appears a small rogue planet is drifting through the system here. To you, it looks uninhabitable, but it looks like the Dynasty has set up a market on the surface. There's only one catch... there's nothing to support aerobic crew here.

event.text: Fortunately, your crew has come to save the day. You send them down to check out the market.
Fortunately, your respirators have come to save the day. You send down your crew to check out the market.
Fortunately, your crew has come to save the day. You send them down to check out the market. They get some odd looks, but no one protests.
Fortunately, your crew has come to save the day. You send them down to check out the market. They'll have to hurry, but you can't stick around too long anyways.
Fortunately, your crew has come to save the day. You send them down to check out the market. They'll have to hurry, but you can't stick around too long anyways.
Unfortunately, there's no way the Dynasty is going to make a special case for you. You'll have to do your shopping somewhere else.

name: STOREEVENT_DYNASTY_DOOMSDAY
text: "The Demons are coming! Are thou prepared? Most probably not! Stock up, gather your arms, and seek shelter before the demons come! Better yet, wander down to Ol' Yethredi's Doomsday and Demon Preparation Center, and purchase everything you need to keep yourself safe!"

choice.text: See what he has to offer.

event.text: "Come on in, come on in! There be many items to see, and keep no shyness! Yethredi has all the time! Well not particularly, because doomsday IS coming, but you get what I'm saying."
With no particular interest in the special items on display, you just take a look at the general shop.

choice.text: (Phantom Crew) Request that he help you with the fleet.

event.text: To your surprise, Yethredi is more than willing, despite the implications. "Doomsday approaches everfast. I fought the demons on the frontlines once, and many of my brothers I witnessed fall. When the time came, it was going to be my honor to stand one final fight against them. So yes, traveler, I will help you. I will help all of us. Reaper have mercy on our metaphorical souls."

choice.text: (Dessius) Request that he help you with the fleet.

event.text: To your surprise, Yethredi is more than willing, despite the implications. "Doomsday approaches everfast. I fought the demons on the frontlines once, and many of my brothers I witnessed fall. When the time came, it was going to be my honor to stand one final fight against them. So yes, traveler, I will help you. I will help all of us. Reaper have mercy on our metaphorical souls."
Unfortunately for Ol' Yethredi, he's about to become the next victim in your unending spree of murders.
Not much point in sticking around. The 'demons' aren't anything new to you anyways, and Auto-ships are hardly a doomsday level threat to be preparing for.

name: STOREEVENT_DYNASTY_CREWKILL
text: You receive a hail from a Dynasty ship orbiting a station nearby. Looks like they have an... unusual request for you.

event.text: "The times of prosperity have come along with your arrival. We find ourselves in an unusual and unfortunate position. Against better judgement we let Vagabonds aboard our station for trading. Now, they've taken siege of it, and we have been forced out. If you can kill them for us without destroying the station, we would be willing to trade."
"Exercise caution - we will not be pleased if there is no station for us to return to after this."

choice.text: (Vagabond Crew) Make a deal to trade with the Vagabonds instead.

event.text: You decline the Dynasty ship's offer, then secretly dock with the station. The Vagabonds aboard are happy to see one of their own and offer to trade.
You have no idea what the offer is, but you have no business dealing with Ghosts.

name: STOREEVENT_SLUG_TRAP
text: A Slug transport ship is stationed near the beacon with a military escort ship. They message you, "We have been waiting for a customer for agesss. Care to see our waresss?"

event.text: "Oh well... We ssshall wait here then." You cautiously put distance between your ships before preparing to jump.
"Before we get ahead of ourssselves, I need to explain sssome ground ruless of our transsaction. Thesse are dangerouss timess, yess?"
"Firssst... We accept no tradesss, couponss or refundss. Purchasess are final. Underssstand?"
"We hold no liability for productsss damaged post ssale. We offer no insurance or customer sservice. Not a problem?"
"Fine... Not everyone appreciates good dealss..."

choice.text: (Slug Crew) Our Slug senses someone aboard the ship. Investigate it.

event.text: It looks like the merchant was trying to stall you while someone teleported on board. You catch him before he could finish and he teleports away. You expect a battle, but the merchant seems frightened more than anything. "I wasssn't doing anything! I was uh... bringing you a gift! Yessss! Please don't kill me, who'sss going to hoard my money otherwissse?"

choice.text: (Telepathic Shell) Our Shell senses someone aboard the ship. Investigate it.

event.text: It looks like the merchant was trying to stall you while someone teleported on board. You catch him before he could finish and he teleports away. You expect a battle, but the merchant seems frightened more than anything. "I wasssn't doing anything! I was uh... bringing you a gift! Yessss! Please don't kill me, who'sss going to hoard my money otherwissse?"

choice.text: (Lifeform Scanner) Your scanners have picked up activity aboard the ship. Investigate it.

event.text: It looks like the merchant was trying to stall you while someone teleported on board. You catch him before he could finish and he teleports away. You expect a battle, but the merchant seems frightened more than anything. "I wasssn't doing anything! I was uh... bringing you a gift! Yessss! Please don't kill me, who'sss going to hoard my money otherwissse?"

name: STOREEVENT_SLUG_HYPNO
text: A huge Slug teleports from nowhere onto the bridge! Before you can open fire, he's spread his wares across the helm and is brandishing things at you.

event.text: As you approach, the Slug suddenly breaks out a pocket watch and waves it in front of you. "You will give me all of your money, and then you will drink the water in your toiletsssss. OooOoOOOooO!"
The Slug pauses, then continues to wave the watch. "Uh. You are going to give me all of your money, then play the Federation national anthem with your own flatulence!"

choice.text: No, I don't think I will.

event.text: The Slug growls. "YOU WILL GIVE ME ALL OF YOUR MONEY AND THEN YOU WILL DANCE LIKE A BALLERINA!"

choice.text: (Mind Affecting Weapon) Explain to him that hypnosis doesn't work with a watch.

event.text: "Oh. I need a machine for thisss? Well that'ssss lame. I need ssscrap to afford that... You have ssscrap, right? I have thingsss! We can trade!"

choice.text: (Mind Control) Explain to him that hypnosis doesn't work with a watch.

event.text: "Oh. I need a machine for thisss? Well that'ssss lame. I need ssscrap to afford that... You have ssscrap, right? I have thingsss! We can trade!"

It seems like this Slug is some kind of hypnotist. It's not your Slug that told you that, it's the fact he is now brandishing an old pocket-watch and is waving it in front of you. When he realizes it's futile, he gives up and offers to trade.
You aren't sure if he meant well or not, but this Slug isn't taking this insult lightly. You'll have to chase him off with force, though hopefully that isn't too hard.

name: STOREEVENT_SLUG_ASTEROIDS
text: Looks like the nearby Slug colony is embedded on a large asteroid, somewhat unusual but nothing remarkable. The only thing is, this is a pretty dense field, and you aren't sure if you can make it through without harm.

choice.text: (Slug Crew) Hail the colony and see if they can send a merchant to you.

event.text: Fortunately, the colony's managers are more agreeable than you would have thought. A ship is dispatched to trade with you.

choice.text: (Adv. Shields) Make your way through safely.

event.text: As the saying goes, it takes a brave person to set foot on a Slug colony - it can take weeks to get the mucus out of your clothes - but there's business to be done.

choice.text: (Upg. Engines) Make your way through safely.

event.text: As the saying goes, it takes a brave person to set foot on a Slug colony - it can take weeks to get the mucus out of your clothes - but there's business to be done.

choice.text: (Cognitive Crew) Have your Cognitive chart a safe path through.

event.text: As the saying goes, it takes a brave person to set foot on a Slug colony - it can take weeks to get the mucus out of your clothes - but there's business to be done.

choice.text: (Upg. Piloting) Make your way through safely.

event.text: As the saying goes, it takes a brave person to set foot on a Slug colony - it can take weeks to get the mucus out of your clothes - but there's business to be done.
Traveling through an asteroid field just to deal with some Slugs is the kind of choice only a captain dumber than you would make.

name: STOREEVENT_SLUG_SHADY
text: The nearby Slug station is soliciting various (suspiciously) reasonably priced items. In fact, it seems so normal, that you're almost certain it's a trick.

choice.text: (Slug Crew) Make all of your deals through your Slug.

event.text: Through the entire transaction, everything goes completely normal. Guess it was all a false alarm, though you're still cautiously poking through the cargo looking for stowaways or stolen goods.

choice.text: (Adv. Sensors) Keep an eye on the ship while you shop.

event.text: Despite your enhanced security through the entire transaction, everything goes completely normal. Guess it was all a false alarm, though you're still cautiously poking through the cargo looking for stowaways or stolen goods.

choice.text: (Upg. Doors) Lock down the ship while you shop.

event.text: Despite your enhanced security through the entire transaction, everything goes completely normal. Guess it was all a false alarm, though you're still cautiously poking through the cargo looking for stowaways or stolen goods.
You're the shoot first, ask questions later kind of guy. No questions will follow this time of course, it's just a metaphor. Happy murdering!
You know better than to let curiosity get the better of you. These Slugs can go fool someone else.

name: STOREEVENT_SLUG_SHADY_DOCK_LEAVE
text: As you attempt to leave, the station suddenly turns hostile! Seems about right that it actually was a trap after all.

name: STOREEVENT_LEECH_ASTEROIDS
text: It takes a brave merchant, regardless of your race, to construct a store so close to an asteroid field. Not that these Leeches seem to mind, considering their homeworld is already covered in far denser fields.

choice.text: (Defense Drone) Offer to let them duplicate your drone schematic.

event.text: The Leeches are grateful, as the defense drone will help make their questionable life choices slightly less questionable. They offer you some supplies for free.
The asteroid field might be deadly, but that won't stop you from being a public menace to everyone you come across!

name: STOREEVENT_LEECH_SCAVENGER
text: You guide yourself towards a decently sized scrapyard with a couple Leech mechanics working on disassembling various alien ships. The scrapyard owner hails you. "Need some parts? We got all kinds of junk here!"

event.text: You fork over your scrap to the Leech and hope you get something worthwhile.

choice.text: (Lanius Crew) Have your Lanius use their abilities on the metal.

event.text: Your Lanius melts the metal down and reforms it into individual components. Thanks to this, you're able to get a much larger yield of scrap than you spent here!
You aren't spending money to buy literal garbage. Not counting the fact that your money is quite literally garbage.

name: STOREEVENT_PIRATE_ODDSHOP
text: A very strange pirate market has been set up nearby. A small stream of traffic comes and goes, and it looks safe enough.

event.text: Inside the market is a rather odd scene. To the left is a booth selling likely extremely illegal Slug narcotics, to the right are several alien slaves kept in cages, and up ahead is a long slender pirate running what he calls the "Traveler's booth".
You step carefully around all the alien waste and you look at the various aliens in cages.

choice.text: Nothing here is of interest. Leave.

event.text: At the very least, the booth and maps here are clean. The same cannot be said for the pirate selling them.

choice.text: Buy a map of the sector.
Buy what the pirate calls an "Engine Overdrive Capacitor MK III+".
Nothing here is of interest. Leave.
Nothing here is of interest. Leave.

event.text: You aren't looking to make any black market deals.

name: STOREEVENT_PIRATE_AWKWARD
text: Pirates nowadays are just commonplace. Hell, if there wasn't a pirate here, you'd have been more surprised. Looks like the station here is a market of sorts, and they're open to trading with anyone.

event.text: "Uewh... Feds. You aren't here to arrest us, are you?" When you shake your head, the pirates relax and show you where they're keeping various crates of resources. Apparently, they won't let you trade until you've bought one.
As you're carting the crate back onto your ship, you notice the crate suspiciously bears the Federation logo! Where did this come from?

choice.text: Ignore it and move on to the store.

event.text: As you're carting the crate back onto your ship, you notice the crate suspiciously bears the Federation logo! Where did this come from?

choice.text: Ignore it and move on to the store.

event.text: As you're carting the crate back onto your ship, you notice the crate suspiciously bears the Federation logo! Where did this come from?

choice.text: Ignore it and move on to the store.

event.text: These scum are still outlaws, regardless if they're running a market or not. Time to bring their villainy to an end.
You aren't looking to make any black market deals.

name: STOREEVENT_PIRATE_REFUELING
text: A small platform orbits near this beacon - it looks like a fueling station of some sort, recently taken over by pirates, and it is cheerily broadcasting reasonable prices in a spectrum of frequencies and languages. This takeover must have been very recent...

choice.text: (Upg. Weapons) Approach with your weapons armed. Make it clear you aren't messing around.

event.text: Your show of force makes it clear you aren't going to take any funny stuff from these pirates. They open their store for you almost immediately, but don't offer any extra fuel...

name: STOREEVENT_PIRATE_SECURITY
text: You receive a wide-band automated message from a black market nearby, "Welcome to our humble trade depot and shipyard! All are welcome, but try any funny business and our 152 automated turret satellites will tear your ship to shreds!" Unusual for pirates to place high value in security, but you suppose it makes sense.

event.text: Some smugglers welcome you inside, and offer some less-than-legal services and goods.

choice.text: (Adv. Hacking) Hold the market hostage with their own turrets.

event.text: You remotely take control of all of the smuggler's turrets, and start firing on their ships. Once their entire fleet is crippled, they give in to all of your demands.
The minute your weapons even come online all 152 turrets swivel towards you and open fire, causing massive damage to your hull. A smuggler vessel moves in to engage.

name: STOREEVENT_SHELL_BOWLING
text: A Shell market and arcade nearby is advertising itself as "Captain Strike's General Market and Bowling Gallery!"

event.text: When you step inside, you're greeted by a mascot-wearing Shell who claims to be Captain Strike himself. "A Renegade? Just my luck! If you ain't a square, thhhen you'll challenge me to a bowling match. Beat me, and you'll take home thhhe trophy!"

choice.text: Bowl with him, even though the fleet might catch up a little.
That's a waste of time. We'll stick to shopping.

event.text: The immature Shell makes a rude noise as you walk past and head to the market.
You flick on your weapons and engage the Shell station. Pffft, who even likes bowling anyways?
What kind of purpose does a bowling gallery have for a Federation vessel? None, you reckon.

name: STOREEVENT_SHELL_BIOLOGIST
text: Shells are fascinated by science, but independent scientists often struggle to fund their endeavours. A prospective biologist has set up a small market selling military goods for scrap, as well as a few of his personal projects.

choice.text: See what special things he has to offer.

event.text: The Shell perks up when you inquire about his other projects.

choice.text: Buy an External DNA Bank augment.
Buy a crew with synthesized memories.
(Shell Crew) Offer to hire the scientist.

event.text: Realizing this is his chance to finally go somewhere in his career, the Shell is more than willing.
The Shell frowns but says nothing more.
You have no interest in the Shell's special offers, but you will take a look at the military goods.

name: STOREEVENT_SHELL_MEDICAL
text: A Shell laboratory is set up next to a marketplace. The lab offers various services relating to medical systems.

choice.text: Switch your Medbay to a Clone Bay for extra cheap.
Switch your Clone Bay to a Medbay for extra cheap.

event.text: You're good with the systems you have.

name: STOREEVENT_LANIUS_METAL
text: You arrive to discover a number of Lanius ships docked at what appears to be a station. You hasten to leave but are relieved when they message you in your language. "Buy? Sell? Traders." It seems not all Lanius are unfriendly to strangers.

event.text: This is a rare opportunity, and you aren't passing it up.
"Free scrap, giving? Generosity. Overwhelm, watering of eye duct. Metaphor."
Despite the unprecedented friendliness of these Lanius, you've turned on them, and are now attacking!

choice.text: You cannot take out a loan at this time.
Just get what we need and leave.

event.text: You're only here for military supplies and nothing else. Let's just shop and get it over with.

name: STOREEVENT_TONY_LOAN
text: To your surprise, it seems next to the Tony's marketplace is the office of a loan shark boasting various offers. These could be useful, but you should be cautious of the predatory interest rates. Tony's might be reputable, but it is a Leech-run business. The only person who'd trust a Leech is the same person who'd trust a Slug.

event.text: The Leech running the office, who doesn't even give you a name, seems more than happy to give you some scrap. Too eager, in fact. By the time you've already signed your name, he only then informs you there's a 40% interest rate. He warns you to make sure you can pay off your debts, because you don't want to mess with "The Worm".

He warns you to make sure you can pay off your debts, because you don't want to mess with "The Worm".

The Leech running the office tries to wave you over, shouting out various alluring offers, but your mind is resolute. You won't fall for this trap. Not this time.

name: FINISH_BEACON_DEBT_REUNION
text: You've arrived at the Long-Range Beacon. Unfortunately, it seems you've run into LaRoache once again! A beefy Leech vessel brandishing the Tony's logo approaches, and on screen appears a tutting Ampere with a fedora, a cigar, and a striped vest. "Alright punk, you's got away real slick last time, but I'm about to put the kibosh on that. Since I'm feeling a little generous today, I'll give you anotha chance: but it's gonna cost you's... Big time. LaRoache ain't messing around."

event.text: "Ah, and things were just about'a get interestin'! Oh well, guess you's keister is saved for another day, eh? Alright alright, hurry along now. LaRoache has other business to uh... attend to. Don't let the Long-Range relay hit you on the way out, heheheh..."

Heheh, problem is I'm tryin'a run a business here, you know. It ain't charity. So why don't you do your pal LaRoache a favor and uh... hand over the tender, eh? Otherwise I'm gonna have to... heheheh... Oh, and no running, you's hear? I've jammed your FTL drive till this business is handled."

I'll keep it short for you's slow renegade brain here this time: pay off your debt or sleep with the Aquarians!"

name: DEBT_COLLECTOR_ESCAPE
text: "Alright, I've had enough of this baloney. You's can keep your stinkin' money, I'm getting outta here!"

event.text: "So long, sucker! Hahah!"

name: DEBT_COLLECTOR_DEFEAT
text: "Ah shit, I ain't getting myself out of this one am I? Well played, Renegade. Well... played..."

name: TONY_GARBAGE
text: Aboard the station you're disgusted to find the floors littered with trash and even what looks to be a spare kidney. It's repulsive and much like the rest of Leech territory smells like something just died - which is probably true.

choice.text: Just deal with it and shop.

event.text: An unusually short and overweight Leech comes out, glaring at you through his thin eye-slights. "Waddya want? I expected you to have blue hair or something." When you explain the state of the filth, the manager only laughs. "Hah, you think I care? If you wanna clean it up be my guest, but I sure as hell ain't gonna waste my time with it."

choice.text: As a matter of fact, I will clean it.

event.text: The manager breaks into laughter but you ignore him and grab a broom from the nearby storage closet with help of one of the staff. It's a tedious process that takes way too much time, and most of your crew begin to ridicule you for your stubbornness. Nevertheless you push on until the store looks brand new.

choice.text: Inform the manager the job is done.

event.text: You find the Leech has been laughing the entire time, but now that you're done he cold stares at you in pity. When he makes no motion to so much as even thank you for your actions, you storm over to the trashcans and grab as much junk you can find that might be worth anything.

choice.text: (Upg. Weapons) Show that ungrateful asshole what for.

event.text: Out of pure spite for all the time you wasted, you power up your guns and lay fire down upon the store. You make certain not to hit anyone but completely destroy their stock. Terrified, the manager suddenly changes his mind and gives you a giant reward.

choice.text: (Children Cannon) Show that ungrateful asshole what for.

event.text: Out of pure spite for all the time you wasted, you unload the cannon and decide to drown the store in piles of corpses, leaving the area in a far worse littered state than it even was previously. Utterly shocked, the manager tosses you a giant reward once he's done crawling out of the mess you made in a baffling but evident show of dominance.

name: TONY_COMICS
text: You browse the inside of the store, taking note of a large selection of comic books. Normally you wouldn't pay them any attention - but they seem oddly... non-fictional. You catch flavorful depictions of famous figures like Devorak the Deathless, Admiral Tully of the Federation, and a retelling of the events of the Federation-Mantis War. You doubt they're of any worth to you, but they might be some light fun reading.

event.text: You pick up one of the Devorak books and bring it to the cashier, which earns you a few strange looks from the other shoppers. Once back on your ship you flip open the comic book.
You pick up one of the Tully books and bring it to the cashier, which earns you a few strange looks from the other shoppers. Once back on your ship you flip open the comic book.

choice.text: Buy some Fed-Mantis War comic books.

event.text: You pick up one of the war books and bring it to the cashier, which earns you a few strange looks from the other shoppers. Once back on your ship you flip open the comic book.

choice.text: We aren't buying goddamn comic books.

name: TONY_CHILD
text: You board the station but are greeted only by the dysfunctional harmony between a child screaming in the distance and a concerned mother shouting. One of the Leech staff approaches you. "Please, you gotta help us. Some idiot got their kid lost and the noise is driving us mad. You're a Renegade, right? Can you eliminate the child?"

choice.text: You want us to... kill a child?

event.text: "Uhm I uh, I just meant uh... well... yes? If you have a better solution I'm all ears, but as long as you shut that woman and her screaming infant up we'll pay you."

Your crew rushes into action, quickly tracking down the child. They quickly snap its neck and return to you to confirm the kill. Your entire crew looks on in horror at what you just did, but the store owners don't seem to care at all. They grab one of the nearby Hektar modules and toss it to you as a reward for your manslaughter.

You power up your weapon and lock onto the position of the child, quickly eliminating it. Your entire crew looks on in horror at what you just did, but the store owners don't seem to care at all. They grab one of the nearby Hektar modules and toss it to you as a reward for your manslaughter.

choice.text: (Boarding Drone) "New prime directive. Eliminate the child."

event.text: Your drone stirs to life and immediately seeks out the child and terminates it immediately with a lethal injection. It returns to you and confirms the kill. Your entire crew looks on in horror at what you just did, but the store owners don't seem to care at all. They grab one of the nearby Hektar modules and toss it to you as a reward for your manslaughter.
You give the Leech an odd look and walk away. Looks like you'll just have to put up with the crying while you shop.

name: TONY_CHILD_FOUND
text: You successfully track down the location of the lost child and bring them back to their mother. She's so grateful she pays you, and the store's staff give you one of the Hektar modules they swiped from the storage room.

name: TONY_BALLPIT
text: Seems this store in particular has an additional section specifically to serve as a children's play place. However, it seems to be under lockdown. Considering the rest of the store is functional, you can't imagine whats wrong.

event.text: You find a half-asleep Slug guarding the door, who's startled awake by your question. "What? Huh? Oh, ssssome dumbassss lost their toy in the ballpit and we gotta get it out. Two problemsss. One, the kid in quessstion isss ssome kind of Rock prince, and if we don't find hissss toy we're all ssscrewed. Sssecond, the ballpit comesss from ssssome kind of ssstrange ancient ruin we were led to by sssome jackasss in a big purple transport vesssssel with a bunch of lasssersss."
"Are... are you sssserious? Caussse like, our sssearch partiesss sssstill haven't returned and they've been gone for hourssss.
Ancient ruin or not, you can't waste time looking for some spoiled brat's toy when you have an important mission at hand.

choice.text: Ignore it and return to shopping.

event.text: Strange as it is, the playplace is of little concern to you.

name: TONY_HQ
text: This beacon seems to be located next to a massive ring-station covered in dozens of stores, factories, and restaurants. Your Atlas informs you this is "Tony Sr's Mega Shopping Center Deluxe", some kind of experimental mega-mall created by the same man responsible for the Tony's retail line. Some say the Leech tycoon himself lives somewhere aboard. It seems multiple distress signals are coming from inside.

event.text: The inside of the station is a gruesome sight. Corpses of staff and shoppers litter the halls. Some still seem to be alive but only barely, and there's seemingly little you can do to save all of them. Moments later the distress call mysteriously shuts off. Guess you arrived just in time, but what could have caused this?

Eventually you find a band of survivors, several armed security guards. "Thank god someone came! We're under attack from the Syndicate, seems they have some beef with Mr. Senior. We held them off for a while, but then this ship arrived carrying what looked like an MFK Ace! He stormed through here and killed everyone in his way. He's trying to break into Mr. Senior's vault in the command center, and there isn't much time left!"

choice.text: What does the Syndicate want with Tony?

event.text: "Dunno, but I think it's got something to do with Hektar. See, there's only two big names tied to that company anymore, and one of them's Tony. The other happens to be Vael, and he's the leader of the Syndicate. I heard down the grapevine that Vael was hoping for Hektar to fail to give him an excuse to seize their assets, and if that's the case, then Mr. Senior's the only thing standing in his way. But that's just an educated guess. I'm just a security guard!"
You're on an important mission, you can't waste time investigating crimes in a city-sized shopping mall.

name: TONY_HQ_ANGEL
text: You leave the main shopping area and fly towards the command tower where you find a strange Stealth ship laying down fire on the last of the station's security turrets. When they spot you, they warn you not to approach. "So Tony sent a Renegade to save his ass? Cute. Look here and listen pal. Name's Cancer. They call me an Angel of Death, one of Mr. Vael's finest. Now, the last thing you wanna go doing is upsetting the boss, man. So just turn on around and skiddadle, understand?"

event.text: "Welp, then don't say I didn't warn you!" The ship turns its weapons on you and attacks!

name: TONY_HQ_SAVE
text: The strange pirate ship is defeated. You scrap its remains.

event.text: With the ship out of the way you enter the command tower, where you find a large vault door, protected by a security code. Taking one wild guess, you try typing in 'password' and it immediately grants you access.

Inside the vault is a grisly sight. Overturned tables and emptied deposit boxes all surround a massive white Leech that you can only assume used to be Tony Sr., hanging lifeless from the ceiling. The gravity of the scene before you is abruptly undercut, however, as you spot an identical Leech in the back of the vault, prying open an emergency exit.

The Leech jumps with a start, slamming his own tail in the exit door. "ARGHHH! Oh, damn it! Who the hell are you, and how - or why - did you get past not only my own security, but the mercenaries outside?"

choice.text: The mercenaries are dead. You're safe now.

event.text: "What? Did you think I was hanging my own body double for fun? You didn't save me, all you did was screw up a perfectly planned business transaction!"

"Well, I'd hope so, given that I didn't want Vael to either. The poor bastard was supposed to find 'my' dead body and walk away thinking he'd won, so I could pop out in a few days as Tony Jr., claim my father's business with a will I just wrote up, and leave the Syndicate empty-handed. But now Vael's just going to be angrier, and you've ruined my trick. You may as well just kill me now - there's no way you'll be as brutal as them."

"Oh god damn it. Why? Even if Vael doesn't manage to kill me, I'm not going to be able to hold on to my business under this kind of pressure, and I'll never find another body double as good as that; what's the point of living if I have to be one of you poors again?"

choice.text: You could try and make amends.

event.text: "For what? Look, I'm not apologizing for being the face of this company. People want cheap crap and shady loans, and Tony's provides. If someone takes issue with how I run my business, they're welcome to try and kill me over it."

"That... is a good point. I suppose no-one but you knows that the poor bastard over there was a body double - any chance you have room on your vessel for one more? I've already emptied out this vault, but you Renegades like ships, right? I'll have one of mine sent to your hangar, just get me out of here before Vael sends another Angel!

You agree to shoot Tony, and he thanks you. Before you follow through, he orders the remaining staff to give you a reward before he closes his eyes and you pull the trigger. It's pretty messed up, but at least this is what he wanted.

choice.text: (Symbiote) "Glad to see someone else wants you dead."

event.text: "My god... Rig? Is that you? How are you here?" You have no idea what's going on, but Tony explains. "7 years ago, Tony's was nothing but a small chain - local only to the Republic. I hoped to change that by expanding into genetic experimentation; what army could turn down Mantises with the durability of a Rock?. I met with representatives from Zulfiquar to discuss how we'd go about securing test subjects, then a Slug ship arrived and... demonstrated my ideas on them. The surgeons had no idea how to handle the situation. Tony's eventually went galactic when we started the loan program, but I never forgot about you, Rig."

"You never forgot?" Rig turns to Tony, eyes glowing with fury. "If you didn't forget, then why are we still stuck like this?" 
																"Oh, you know how it is, you put a project to the side for five minutes, then before you know it, a few years pass you by..." Tony trails off, clearly aware his lies aren't working. "Alright, alright. I got into contact with them a few months after the incident, trying to get their technology from them - but every single time I get close, they vanish. But I have their location now... any chance you'd want to get your revenge on them, rather than me?"
																"Fine. But this isn't over - not until I can have my damn body to myself again."

name: BUTT_BUDDIES

unvisitedTooltip.text: Supposed location of the Slugs responsible for harassing Tintan and Rig.

text: The coordinates are surprisingly accurate, leading you right into the den of what appears to be some kind of hacker ship.

event.text: You hail the Slugs and put Tony and Rig on the screen. Rig slams his fist on the table, finally ready to get vengeance after all of these years. "You rotten, despicable slime balls. After all this time I- WE'VE finally caught up with you! Now you're going to finally explain what the point of ALL of this is!"

The Slug captain looks utterly confused but soon realizes what is going on. "Oh-OH! It'sss YOU! HAHAHAHAHAH! HAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAHAAAAAHAHAH! Oh my god! Thisss isss hilarioussss! Gersssslin, get the recorder, I need an archive of thisss. Oh... oh boy. Look, weirdo. It ain't nothing persssonal, alright? Long time ago, we were approached by thisss ssstranger in a suit and tie, who told usss you were gonna be resssponsssible for sssome kind of uh... extinction-level event Multiverssse-wide."
No one's going to miss these assholes. Hopefully this should prove to be quite cathartic.

choice.text: Tony and Rig aren't with us. This isn't worth our time anymore.

event.text: It was dumb to come all the way out here for something as petty as revenge.

name: BUTT_BUDDIES_REVENGE
text: It seems during the fight the two main Slugs escaped on a lifepod, but you quickly scoop them up before they can get away, finding a small grey-and-purple machine stashed in a corner of their vessel as you do. You bring them back on board to deliberate what to do with them. Rig and Tony both propose one simple punishment - treat them with their own medicine.

event.text: Rig drags the two Slugs out of the room by their tails as Tony grabs the mysterious device, and together they lock the two criminals in an airlock with their machine active. One screams as the other chokes, and the two roll on the floor in agony, flesh stretching and warping as the machine attempts to resolve their anatomies into a single creature, until a loud BANG rings through the air and the process stops, leaving a smoking device and a heap of dead Slug. You can see Tony and Rig aren't quite as satisfied with this as they had hoped, but they're glad to finally have laid them to rest.

Torturing the Slugs like that will do no one any good. Instead, you grant them a quick and painless death. You can tell Tony and Rig aren't quite as satisfied, but the death of the Slugs satisfies them nonetheless.

name: BUTT_BUDDIES_REWARD
text: Tony and Rig cannot thank you enough for your help. As a reward for finally settling this, Rig gives you a special prototype weapon blueprint under works by Zulfiqar.
